(102)then:recas :rdo stuno sheste /)krung da ga pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /
— — : sgyu richu / ’ sna / ) sti tsho4

rnying rgyud/ sgroslo (10 2)1121 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po khro bo rdo rje'i rigs kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo rnal 'byor grub pa'i rgyud ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3dang po/ rnal 'byor rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor rjes su 'jug pa'i le'u/ 50gsum pa/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u/ 75bzhi pa/ dam tshig gsang ba mchog gi le'u/ 84lnga pa/ rnal 'byor brda'i le'u/ 97drug pa/ rnal 'byor bde ba'i tshogs kyi le'u/ 100bdun pa/ 'das pa sngon byung gi le'u/ 110brgyad pa/ skong ba las kyi bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 122dgu pa/ rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 1421

bcu pa/ gsang sbyor sgrub pa'i le'u/ 155bcu gcig pa/ rdo rje tshe bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 162bcu gnyis pa/ tshogs chen 'dus pa'i bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 165bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 184bcu bzhi pa/ rmad byung rdzas kyi le'u/ 184bcwa lnga pa/ mngon shes rig pa'i bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 199bcu drug pa/ rdo rje thal chen gyi sgrub thabs kyi le'u/ 201bcu bdun pa/ mchog phran thabs kyi bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 203bcwa brgyad pa/ sgyu ma rdo rje'i bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 204bcu dgu pa/ thig le sgrub pa'i le'u/ 205nyi shu pa/ dregs pa can gnon pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 208nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'khor ba thams cad sgrol ba bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/210nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ dug gsum dbang bsgyur ba zhes bya ba'i bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 212nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ 'khor lo dbang sgyur gyi sgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 213nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ bdud rtsi sman gyi bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 214nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bka' gsang 'khor lo'i bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 220nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ rdo rje me'i cho ga bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 222nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ rdo rje gsang sngags kyi le'u/ 227nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ sgyur ba phyag rgya'i le'u/ 230nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ mchod pa dam pa gsang ba'i le'u/ 231sum cu pa/ rdo rje glu'i le'u/ 232sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor 'jug pa'i le'u/ 237sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ rdo rje dbang gi le'u/ 2402

sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ ngo mtshar bstod pa'i le'u/ 245bsdur mchan/(247) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(286)1122 dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa 287dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 287gnyis pa/ don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi byang chub kyi sems ye shes su bskyed pa'i le'u/ 290gsum pa/ chos thams cad gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 292bzhi pa/ yi ge phreng ba'i 'khor lo bkod pa'i le'u/ 295lnga pa/ sgyu 'phrul bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 298drug pa/ dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u/ 299bdun pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pa dang gsang sngags kyi le'u/ 302brgyad pa/ yan lag dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs nas phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u/ 305dgu pa/ rdo rje bkod pa gsang ba dam tshig gi le'u/ 308bcu pa/ dbang sbyin pa'i le'u/ 312bcu gcig pa/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 313bcu gnyis pa/ tshogs bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 316bcu gsum pa/ shin tu gsang ba man ngag gi le'u/ 317bcu bzhi pa/ mnyes pa'i le'u/ 319bco lnga pa/ khro bo rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor sprin rnam par spros pa'i le'u/ 320bcu drug pa/ khro bo'i tshogs chen po'i gsung gi dkyil 'khor spros 3

pa'i le'u/ 328bcu bdun pa/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ 330bco brgyad pa/ mchog sbyin dam pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 331bcu dgu pa/ dam tshig gi le'u/ 331nyi shu pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i le'u/ 333nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ khro bo la bstod pa'i le'u/ 336nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ mnyes pa dang yongs su gzung ba'i le'u/ 337bsdur mchan/(338) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(3go)1123 rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba thams cad kyi me long zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 350dri ba rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba bshad pa rtog pa'i rgyal po/ 350dang po/ mtshan gyi don gyi bshad pa/ 355gnyis pa/ gleng gzhi rnam par bshad pa'i le'u/ 358gsum pa/ gleng bslang ba bshad pa'i le'u/ 368bzhi pa/ lta ba ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 371lnga pa/ spyod pa rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 379drug pa/ dkyil 'khor ma lus par bshad pa'i le'u/ 391bdun pa/ dbang bskur ba ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 442brgyad pa/ dam tshig ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 450dgu pa/ bsgrub pa ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 461bcu pa/ phrin las mtha' yas pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 473bcu gcig pa/ lam gyi khyad par ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 4804

bcu gnyis pa/ lhun gyis grub pa ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u/ dzinabacu gsum pa/ mthar phyin pa'i le'u/ 501rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang /ban+de tsā na ku mā ras bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad nas bi ma la mi tra nyid la ze mo dge slong mas yang dang yang du zhus/bsdur mchan/(505) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(533)1126 gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa/ 534dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 534gnyis pa/ gleng bslang ba'i le'u/ 537gsum pa/ don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi byang chub kyi sems ye shes su bskyed pa'i le'u/ 539bzhi pa/ chos thams cad gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 540lnga pa/ thams cad la chos nyid kyi rgyu yod pa dang rigs rgyud chad pa dang rigs brgyad so sor dbye ba'i mdor bshad pa'i le'u/ 543drug pa/ yi ge phreng ba 'khor lo bkod pa'i le'u/ 545bdun pa/ khams nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsdus nas/ thams cad ma lus par dbyings su bkod pa'i le'u/ 548brgyad pa/ sgyu 'phrul sgrub pa'i le'u/ 551dgu pa/ shin tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan bstan pa'i le'u/ 553bcu pa/ dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u/ 554bcu gcig pa/ gzhal yas khang dbub pa thabs dra ba'i le'u/ 5575

bcu gnyis pa/ gsang sngags kyi le'u/ 558bcu gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang gsang sngags kyi le'u/ 560bcu bzhi pa/ don dam pa dang /kun rdzob kyi byang chub kyi sems las phyag rgya gsung gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 561bco lnga pa/ thams cad yum gyi dbyings su 'dus pa shin tu gsang ba'i le'u/ 562bcu drug pa/ phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u/ 564bcu bdun pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen po thabs dang shes rab tu 'byung ba phyag mtshan gyi le'u/ 567bcwa brgyad pa/ mtshon cha dam tshig phyag rgya glu'i le'u/ 573bcu dgu pa/ rdo rje bkod pa gsang ba dam tshig gi le'u/ 576nyi shu pa/ lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis dngos grub len pa'i thabs te mchod rten gdab pa'i le'u/ 579nyi shu gcig pa/ dbang sbyin pa'i le'u/ 582nyi shu gnyis pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sgrub pa'i le'u/ 583nyi shu gsum pa/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 586nyi shu bzhi pa/ tshogs sgrub pa'i le'u/ 588nyi shu lnga pa/ shin tu gsang ba man ngag gi snying po'i le'u/ 590nyi shu drug pa/ gsang ba chen po man ngag gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 592nyi shu bdun pa/ bsnyen pa'i le'u/ 594nyi shu brgyad pa/ khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin rnam par spros pa'i le'u/ 595nyi shu dgu pa/ khro bo'i tshogs chen po gsung gi dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u/ 604

sum cu pa/ phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u/ 605sum cu gcig pa/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ 608sum cu gnyis pa/ dgyes pa chen po'i byin brlabs dang yon tan mchog ston pa'i le'u/ 710sum cu gsum pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i bsod nams sbyin pa dam tshig gi le'u/ 614sum cu bzhi pa/ dgyes pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig gi le'u/ 616sum cu lnga pa/ 'jigs byed chen po sngags kyi bzlas pa snying po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 617sum cu drug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gdug pa'i tshogs byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 618sum cu bdun pa/ rdo rje snying po las thams cad kyi le'u/ 622sum cu brgyad pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen po brtan par gzung ba bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i le'u/ 623sum cu dgu pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las sman sgrub pa'i le'u/ 625bzhi bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs 'byung ba'i le'u/ 630bzhi bcu gcig pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nas che ba'i yon tan ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 632bzhi bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid dbab pa'i gsung gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 637bzhi bcu gsum pa/ byin bsdu ba dang dam tshig dbab pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i thugs rje zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 6387

bzhi bcu bzhi pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen po dam tshig gi mchod pa'i longs spyod ces bya ba'i le'u/ sna 642bzhi bcu lnga pa/ thub pa chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i tshogs kyi gdug pa'i las 'dul ba'i le'u/ 644bzhi bcu drug pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen po rab tu rgyal bar byed pa dam tshig mchod bkod pa'i le'u/ 646bzhi bcu bdun pa/ shin tu 'dul bar gyur pa gnas dang /snying po dbul ba'i le'u/ zhigabazhi bcu brgyad pa/ bka' drin dran pa'i glu zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 652bzhi bcu dgu pa/ dam tshig chen pos bud med btul ba'i le'u/ 655lnga bcu pa/ mchod sbyin gyi le'u/ 658lnga bcu gcig pa/ dam tshig gi le'u/ 659lnga bcu gnyis pa/ dam tshig sum brgya drug cu pa'i rtsa ba bco lnga pa mdor bshad pa'i le'u/ 661lnga bcu gsum pa/ chos thams cad khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang / rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi mes sbyong ba'i le'u/ 662lnga bcu bzhi pa/ lhaḥthams cad ma lus par 'dir 'dus pa'i le'u/ 663lnga bcu lnga pa/ shin tu gsang ba'i khro bo nye bar bstan pa'i le'u/ 664lnga bcu drug pa/ drag po hom gyi le'u/ 665lnga bcu bdun pa/ thams cad ma lus par dbang du bsdus te/dbang gi hom gyi le'u/ 667lnga bcu brgyad pa/ rgyal po rgyas mdzad kyi rgyas pa hom gyi le'u/ 669lnga bcu dgu pa/ thams cad ma lus par zhi bar gyur nas zhi ba'i hom gyi le'u/ 6708

drug cu pa/ lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 671drug cu gcig pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang /sa bcu gnyis dang /thabs kyi mchog dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa yid dang /chos su 'dus par bstan pa'i le'u/ 674drug cu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nges pa'i don ma lus par mtshan nyid med pa'i phyag rgyar thim pa'i le'u/ 675drug cu gsum pa/ che'i cho ga dbang dam pa shin tu gsang ba'i le'u/ 677drug cu bzhi pa/ pra dbab pa'i le'u/ 680drug cu lnga pa/ lha chen po bsgrub ba dang /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dkyil 'khor bkod cing bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 682drug cu drug pa/ mnyes pa'i le'u/ 686drug cu bdun pa/ skyes bu dam pa blo rtsal rab gcig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong ba'i le'u/ 687drug cu brgyad pa/ dam tshig sum brgya pa rtsa ba bco lnga mdo bshad pa'i le'u/ 691drug cu dgu pa/ bzhugs gnas khang pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 702bdun cu pa/ ro langs bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 704bdun cu gcig pa/ bro gar rtse 'jo'i le'u/ 707bdun cu gnyis pa/ rang bzhin sku'i dkyil 'khor du bsdu ba'i le'u/ 714bdun cu gsum pa/ shin tu gsang bar bya ba rgyud dngos grub thob par bya ba'i le'u/ 716bdun cu bzhi pa/ hom rnam bzhi'i le'u/ 718bdun cu lnga pa/ rmad du byung ba'i dam tshig bco lnga 'di ltar yang

bshad pa'i le'u/ 719bdun cu drug pa/ dam tshig rnam par spros pa'i le'u/ 722bdun cu bdun pa/ dbang po dang yul du 'dus pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 746bdun cu brgyad pa/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig gi le'u/ 764bdun cu dgu pa/ yongs su gsung ba'i le'u/ 767brgyad cu pa/ chos nyid kun du mi 'gyur bar bstan pa'i le'u/ 767bsdur mchan/(769) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(809)1125 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo'i phreng zhes bya ba/ 810dang po/ bden pa gnyis bstan pa'i le'u/ 810gnyis pa/ dam tshig bstan pa'i le'u/ 811gsum pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 812bzhi pa/ mchod pa'i le'u/ 812lnga pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 812drug pa/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 813bdun pa/ lha'i mtshan nyid dang dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 813brgyad pa/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i le'u/ 814dgu pa/ sngags kyi le'u/ 814bcu pa/ phyag rgya'i le'u/ 815bcu gcig pa/ rig sngags gcod pa'i le'u/ 819bcu gnyis pa/ khro po'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi le'u/ 826bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje srin mo'i le'u/ 82710

bcu bzhi pa/ khro bo bcu'i rtsa ba'i sngags dang las kyi sngags ril 'dus pa'i le'u/ 827bco lnga pa/ rdo rje srin mo'i sngags kyi le'u/ 828bcu drug pa/ phyag rgya'i le'u/ 828bcu bdun pa/ las kyi le'u/ 830bco brgyad pa/ drag po'i las kyi le'u/ 830bcu dgu pa/ drag po hom gyi le'u/ 831nyi shu pa/ drag po'i phur pa'i le'u/ 831nyi shu gcig pa/ drag po'i gtor ma'i le'u/ 831nyi shu gnyis pa/ drag po'i sbyor ba'i le'u/ 832nyi shu gsum pa/ gnas bstabs pa'i le'u/ 832nyi shu bzhi pa/ dbang gi las bstan pa'i le'u/ 832nyi shu lnga pa/ dbang gi hom gyi le'u/ 833nyi shu drug pa/ dbang gi phur pa'i las bshad pa'i le'u/ 833nyi shu bdun pa/ dbang gi gtor ma'i le'u/ 833nyi shu brgyad pa/ dbang gi sbyor ba'i le'u/ 833nyi shu dgu pa/ rgyas pa'i las kyi le'u/ 834sum cu pa/ rgyas pa'i hom gyi le'u/ 834sum cu gcig pa/ rgyas pa'i phur pa'i le'u/ 834sum cu gnyis pa/ rgyas pa'i gtor ma'i le'u/ 834sum cu gsum pa/ rgyas pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u/ 835sum cu bzhi pa/ zhi ba'i las kyi le'u/ 835sum cu lnga pa/ zhi ba'i hom gyi le'u/ 835sum cu drug pa/ zhi ba'i phur pa'i le'u/ chi 83611

sum cu bdun pa/ zhi ba'i gtor ma'i le'u/ 836sum bcu brgyad pa/ zhi ba'i spyod pa las kyi le'u/ 836sum cu dgu pa/ las bsdus pa'i le'u/ 836bzhi bcu pa/ las sgrub pa'i phan yon gyi le'u/ 836bsdur mchan/(842) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(850)yod:/ dkar chag gi zur ma na/ chos tshan (1121)pa'i mtshan byang rgyas drags pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod

sngag /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po khro bo rdo rje'i rigs kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo rnal 'byor grub pa'i rgyud ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta ②gu h+ya dz+nyā na arba ②gar+bha gro dha badz+ra ⑤ku la tan+t+ra piṇ+ḍa ⑤tha bit+yā (9)yo ga sid+dha du nā ma ma hā yā (nyen smu tra/bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po khro bo 6)rdo rje'i rigs kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo rnal 'byor grub pa'i rgyud ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bcom ldan 'das dpal sgrol byed thugs rje'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i yidus gcig na/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po rdo rje sa nga (1te ru 7ka gsang ba mchog gi bdag po byin gyis brlabs kyi kyisnyedabang phyug /mi zad mdzod kyi bkod pa/ che ba'i don la dam pa'i spyod pas bskyod pa de/ rmad du byung ba'i don 'di nyid bshad pa'i gnas gsang ba'i yang gsang ba kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang thig le bdal ba'i klong yi/ ye 'byam ⑫102—3

rmad du grags pa'i gzhal yas rgya phyogs su yongs su ma chad pa/ chos nyid kyi nam mkha' las cho 'phrul gyi sprin kun du 'thibs pa 0)byang chub kyi char mngon par 'bab pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba bdas par gyur pa/ ye shes kyi myu gu mngon par bskyed pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa/ rtse mo kun du rgya mnyam pa / rin po che'i rgyal pos rnam par brgyan pa/ mu tig gi lcang lo dang /chun 'phyang ②dang / lda ldis mdzes pa/ nyi ma chen pos gsal btab pa/ zla ba chen pos phra bkod pa/ skar ma dang shin tu skar ma dag gis gzer spras pa/rdo rje rin po che'i 'od snang bas kun du mdangs phyung ba'i mkha' la/ rlung nag gi phung po rgya yongs su ma chad 9 par mnyam pa/ khrag gi phung po dba' klong du 'khrug pa/ rgya phyogs su yongs su ma chad pa/ ma tang gi gnas dang / pris ma 'bur 'phang bar ( chags pa/ rus pa phung po rgya kun du mnyam pa'i gzhi la 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang 'od zer kun du 'phro ba/ ga bu cung brtsegs pa'i rtsig pa la/ gnam lcags kyi gzer ta le bar btab pa/ rtsibs kun du nyi ma dang zla ba rangs pa dang ma rangs (5)par 'phyo ba/ nya chen po'i ka gdung la nya phran dral sti drab gtams pa/ zla ba'i ka rten dang / nyi ma'i ka lo dang / sbrul chun gyi ka rgyan la sogs pa( )/ hūṃ gi thog dang / me'i char mngon par 'bab pa / chos nyid kyi bla res rnam par brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi lda ldis mngon par bres 99pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang 'phan gyis bklubs yipa/ sbrul nag gi za ra tshags dang / sprin nag gi grib so lta bus gzhol ba'i bar bar (1thams cad na rin po che dang / mu tig dang / me tog gis mdzes pa/ 'khor ba'i maṇ+ḍa la yo bkram la bam ril che chung dang / khog skam stod smad dang / yan lag ring 102—4

thung dang / dbang po'i phreng ba dang / rdo rjes kun du spras pa/ sgo dgus kun du gsal sgrubar gyur pa'i gnas na rdo rje rgyal tshab ces ①bya ba'i zhe sdang rdo rje dang glu/ rdo rje go phur zhes bya ba'i nga rgyal rin chen dang / rdo rje ging zhes bya ba'i 'dod chags pad+mo dang / rdo rje kurma zhes bya ba'i phrag dog sna tshogs dang /rdo rje bya rog ces bya ba'i drod kyi rtags 'dzin dang / rdo rje dus mtshams zhes bya ba'i mthun cha'ajug gi bka' sdod dang / rdo rje spun thams cad dang / rdo rje ming thams cad dang / rdo rje rig 'dzin thams cad dang / rdo rje lus thams cad dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor thams cad dang / rdo rje ngag thams cad dang /rdo rje las thams cad dang / rdo rje yid ③thams cad dang / rdo rje ma thams cad dang / rdo rje ging thams cad dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro thams cad dang /rdo rje shugs kyis 'gro bo thams cad dang / rdo rje phra men ma ④thams cad dang /rdo rje kun tu 'bar ma thams cad dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin thams cad dang /rdo rje (5)srin mo thams cad dang / rdo rje slas dang / byi mo dang / bran (6)mo la sogs pa bud med thams cad dang / rdo rje mngag pa la sogs pa'i rdo rje khro bo thams cad 'du bar gyur pa/ rdo rje rigs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang /'gying bag gi tshul gyis bstengs pa mi mnga' bar rdo rje'i gdan la 'khor mang po dang thabs cig ⑦tu bzhugs pa ni 'di lta ste/ cho 'phrul chen po nam mkha'i dbang phyug ces bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / cho 'phrul chen po rnam grol sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / cho 'phrul chen po rnam grol sgrogs (kyepa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / cho 'phrul chen po thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / nam mkha'i bu mo dbang mo zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang /102—5

nam mkha'i bu mo dga' sdud ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / nam rimakha'i bu mo rnam par gdung ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / nam mkha'i bu mo sgrol yotshom zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo la sogs te/ shin tu gsang ba chen po'i 'khor dang / gzhan yang dam tshig chen po'i 'khor 'di lta ste / dam tshig chen po rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / dam tshig chen po nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / dam tshig chen po pad+ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / dam tshig chen po bkod pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / dam tshig chen mo rdo rje dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo 3chodang / dam tshig chen mo nor bu'i dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / dam tshig chen mo pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / dam tshig chen mo rgyan gyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo la sogs te/ shin tu mi 'da' ba chen po'i 'khor dang /gzhan yang tshad med pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ gsang ba chen po (gubyams pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / gsang ba chen po snying rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / gsang ba chen po dga' ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang / gsang ba chen po btang snyoms kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas dang /gsang ba chen po bde ba'i dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang /gsang ba chen mo 'joms byed dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / gsang ba chen mo dga' ba'i dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / gsang ba chen mo khyab pa'i dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / shin tu tshad med pa'i 'khor dang / gzhan yang rol pa chen 102—6

po'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ rol pa chen po'i sangs rgyas yak+ṣa he ru ka zhes bya ba dang —/ rol pa chen po'i sangs rgyas rak+ṣa he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / rol pa chen po'i sangs rgyas gig sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / rol pa chen po'i sangs rgyas bi shwa he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / rol pa chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma yak+ṣa sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / rol pa chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma rak+ṣa sho ①ri ka zhes bya ba dang /rol pa chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma rnyig sha sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / rol pa chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma bi shwa sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / shin tu rol pa chen po'i 'khor dang / gzhan yang 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ 'jigs byed chen po'i (gesangs rgyas te sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / 'jigs byed chen po'i sangs rgyas ke sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / 'jigs byed chen po'i sangs rgyas pa ①sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / 'jigs byed chen po'i sangs rgyas bi shwa he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma te sha sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma ke sha sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma be shwa sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang /'jigs byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma bi shwa ri4༄sho ri ka zhes bya ba la sogs pa shin tu 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor dang / gzhan yang 'joms byed chen po'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ 'joms byed chen po'i sangs rgyas trag sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / 'joms byed chen po'i sangs rgyas hri 45)sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang /'joms byed chen po'i sangs rgyas ka sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / 'joms byed chen po'i sangs rgyas bag sha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / 'joms byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma trag sha sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / 'joms byed chen mo'i rnal 102—7

'byor ma tri 6)sha sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / 'joms byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma ②ka sha sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / 'joms byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma bag ①sha sho ri ka la sogs te/ shin tu 'joms byed chen po'i 'khor dang / gzhan yang za byed chen po'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ za byed chen po'i sangs rgyas ru ti he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / za byed chen po'i sangs rgyas rag ti ④te ru ka zhes bya ba dang —/ za byed chen po'i sangs rgyas kha hi he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / za byed chen po'i sangs rgyas sa ha he ru ka zhes bya ba dang / za byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma ru ti sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / za byed chen mo'i ⑧rnal 'byor ma tag ⑥ti sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / za byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma kha hi sho ri ka zhes bya ba dang / za byed chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma sa ha sho ri ka zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor rab tu mang zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i he ru ka mtha' yas pa sha stag rnams dang / gzhan yang gsang ba'i bu mo'i 'khor 'di lta ste/gsang ba'i bu mo dkar mo zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba'i bu mo rkun mo zhes bya ba dang ske/ gsang ba'i bu mo rmongs mo zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba'i bu mo stir langs ma zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba'i bu mo sbos mo zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba'i bu mo gtum mo zhes bya ba dang / gsang ba'i bu mo sme sha can zhes bya ba dang /gsang ba'i bu mo ma tshogs ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa shin tu gsang ba'i bu mo'i 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / gzhan yang dga' ba'i bu mo'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ dga' ba'i bu mo seng gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / dga' ba'i bu mo bya rgod gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / dga' ba'i bu mo stag gdong ma zhes bya ba dang /dga' ba'i bu mo wa gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / dga' ba'i bu mo khyi gdong ma 102—8

zhes bya ba dang / dga' ba'i bu mo dur bya ①gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / dga' ba'i bu mo khu gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / dga' ba'i bu mo mun gdong ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa shin tu dga' ba'i bu mo'i 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /gzhan yang shin tu gus pa'i bu mo'i 'khor 'di lta ste/ shin tu gus pa'i bu mo rta gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gus pa'i bu mo phag gdong ma zhes bya ba dang /shin tu gus pa'i bu mo spre'u gdong ma zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gus pa'i bu mo thal byed ma la sogs pa shin tu gus pa'i bu mo'i 'khor dang / gzhan yang shin tu gsod ②pa chen po'i sras kyi 'khor la 'di lta ste/ shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal stag (kyegi mgrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal g.yag gi mgrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal sha ba'i mgrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal gzig gi mgrin zhes bya ba dang /shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal rta'i stimagrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal spyang ki'i (snyemagrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal seṅge'i 6)mgrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal dom gyi mgrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod pa chen po dpal phag gi mgrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod (7)pa chen po dpal dred mo'i mgrin zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje gsod ma zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje dur khrod ces bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje gtun khung zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje gtum mo zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje mda' snyems ma zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje sgra 'byin ma zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje za byed ma 102—9

zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje 'dren ma zhes bya ba dang /shin tu gsod ma chen mo rdo rje spor ma zhes bya ba dang / shin tu gsod ma chen mo'i 'khor rab tu mang po rnams dang / de dag la sogs te rdul phra rab snyed dang thabs cig 6go/ /yum rdo rje kun du bzang mo sa nga sho ri gas kyang nyid kyi sku la rnam par 'khril te/ mdun gyis bltas nas thabs cig (7go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des chos thams cad dgongs pa mnyam pa nyid la shar bar mkhyen nas sku mnyam pa nyid mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ngang la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gsung mnyam pa nyid mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ngang la rnam pa bzhugs ( so/ /thugs mnyam pa nyid mi dmigs pa zhes bya ba'i ngang la rnam par bzhugs te/ 'jug pa'am/ ldog pa'am/ rnam par ldog pa mi dmigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des dbyings kyi ngang la mi g.yo bar brnal gi)bzhin du yum rdo rje kun du bzang mos stong pa nyid kyi glu 'di blangs te rnam par bskul to(57/ /yod med stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor mthus/ /nam mkha' bzhin las dam tshig nye bar gshegs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par grol ba'i klong / /mi gnas mi dmigs nam mkha'i dbyings nas bzhengs / /zhes bskul nas/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba (pemachog gi bdag po des chos thams cad byang chub sems la shar bar mkhyen nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rdo rje'i sku mngon du phyung ste/ dper na nam mkha' dang (8)ba las zla ba dri ma med par 99shar ba lta bu'o/ /de nas yum sa nga sho ri ka la gzigs te/ 'dzum pa rnam par mdzad do/ /dper na nyi ma stong las 'od kyi zer bkye ba lta bu'o/ /de nas 'od kyi zer de dag las byang chub kyi sprin 7mngon 102wa 10

par 'khrigs te/ rol pa'i char mngon par phab pas rol pa sna tshogs kyi 'brug dang / rol pa sna tshogs kyi glog dang / rol pa sna tshogs kyi mchod pa dang rol pa sna tshogs kyi glu dang / rol pa sna tshogs kyi gar dang / rol pa sna tshogs kyi rnga dang / dung dang ker kor dang gling bu dang rol pa sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang /rol pa sna tshogs kyi 6)sgeg pa dang steg pa dang / 'khyud pa dang steng ba dang /sbyor ba dang bstim pa dang mnyes pa dang / rol pa sna tshogs kyis gsol ba dang myang ba dang / 'cha' ②ba dang bde ba dang / spro ba dang / 'jo ba dang /'jug pa dang / rol pa sna tshogs kyi (gyidaga' ba chen po la 'jug pa rnam par mdzad degi)/ de nas yum kun du bzang mo des spyan zim bag gis rnam par 'dud pa'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das gsang ba (5rimachog gi bdag po la rnam par bltas te/ rnal 'byor sbyor ba'i phyag lus kun du sa la brdabs nas rol pa chen po'i glu 'dis gsol pa btab po/ /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs thugs dam dbyings kyi lha/ /longs zhiraspyod rdzogs mdzad rol ba chen po'i sku/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skal bzang (pedapal khyod bdag /thabs kyi (gerol pas bde chen dbyings nas bzhengs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi kyi)bdag po des glu des bskul bar thugs su chud nas/ bde ba chen po'i ngang de las cho 'phrul chen por rnam par bzhengs te/ rnam par 'gying ba dang / rnam par brjid pa dang / gar gyi phyag rgya chen po dang / rnam par bshad pa sna tshogs dang tu )/ zhabs kyi brkyang bskum dang / sku'i 'gyur bag dang / smin ris kyi 'bri ku ta 6stebasgyur ba dang / sprul pa'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha' thams cad kun du khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas thams cad dang thams cad la mtshan ma 102—11

dang ske/ rnam pa dang / yod pa dang / med pa thams cad la gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des yo)kun la khyab par mdzad dege/ de dag gi rang bzhin du rnam par gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje kun du bzang mo de ngo mtshar du gyur te/ yang rnal 'byor pa'i phyag lus kun du sa la brdabs te/ cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i glu 'dis gsol ba btab bo/ /ye shes sgyu mas (mirnam par rol pa'i sku/ /thabs dang shes rab che la mnga' brnyes (gepa'i/ /'phags rje sprul pa mang po 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs mdzad bzhengs (gesu gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi (6)bdag po des rdo rje rol pa'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas yum rdo rje kun du bzang mo dang / dam tshig chen po ⑦rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa 987'khor shin tu mang po rnams ngo mtshar du gyur te/de dag thams cad mgrin gcig tu rdo rje rol pa 6)de kho na'i glu 'dis bskul te gsol ba btab po/ /e ma'o⑩/ /yid bzhin sku mchog nam mkha' lta bu las/ /khyab pa'i byin brlabs 1stordo rje gar mdzad cing / /gzi brjid sprin dpung rol pas bsgyings 32pa'i sku/ /thogs med rdo rje rol pa'i cho 'phrul ston/ /e ma'o(snye//yid bzhin gsung mchog sgra brnyan mi)lta bu las/ /snyan pa'i byin brlabs skerdo rje brjod mdzad cing / /yan lag rgya mtsho mi zad bkod pa'i gsung / /seṅge sgra yis gsang sngags rgya mtsho ston/ /e ma'o7/ /ye shes snying po nyi ma lta bu las/ /ye shes byin brlabs 91 rdo rje bde mdzad cing / /thig le spros bral rnam par mi rtog 1nyathugs/ /rnam grol de nyid nges pa'i cho 'phrul ston/ /mi shes blun rmongs 'dam bying 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal rgya 39mtshos bcings pa thabs kyis 102wa 12

khrol6) / /ma rig mun pas ldongs pa don gyis phye0/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rol pa'i gru ①yis sgrol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi thugs chen po/ /ye shes don gyi snying po mchog dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor theg chen rdo rje kun 'dus rgyud/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la rgya cher bshad du gsol/ /a la la ho zhes nges par btud de gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des rdo rje rol pa de kho na nyid kyi glu des gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas 'khor thams cad la rnam par gzigs te 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'dzum pa mdzad pas thugs rnam par dag pa'i klong linas rig pa'i nyi ma brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang mi lang ba'i ⑤'od zer dang bcas pa 'byam (6)klas pa khyab (7par shar bar mdzad do / /'od zer de dag re re las rdo rje he ru ka rab tu mang ba'i tshogs bshad (8ripar mdzad do/ /de dag re re las kyang sangs rgyas 'bum phrag 'khor so so'i zhabs 6)'bring bcas pa lhun gyis grub par mdzad do/ /de dag las rig pa'i nyi ma'i char mngon par phab pas mun pa'i klong thams cad gsal ⑩bar mdzad do / /rig pa'i chos kyi 'brug sgra dang / rig pa'i chos kyi char dang / rig pa'i chos kyi glu sna tshogs dang / gar sna tshogs dang / rig pa'i chos kyi mchod pa sna tshogs byung ste/ 'byam thinaklas pa'i nam mkha' la sgra sna tshogs phan tshun dang / yan man dang / snrel zhi la sogs pa thams cad du khyab par ling long phyad par byung ngo / /mchod pa'i char yang mngon par phab/ rmad du byung ba'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang ling long phyad 8rmad du byung ba'i thugs kyang lhang nge'o / /rmad du byung ba'i gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang a la la ho zhes sgra sgrogasaX / sangs rgyas 'bum phrag kyang gsung dbyangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 102—13

sgra gcig tu/ e ma'o 91)rmad byung rol pa'i chos kyi don byung ngo zhes sgrogs /'khor 'bum phrag dang gdul bya sna tshogs spro ba'i ngo mtshar skyed(5)/ rig pa'i rtsal sbyangs don gyi che ④ba phyung / ngam zhing ngo mtshar bar gyur te thams cad nye bar gnas so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des 'khor rnam par sbyong ba'i rdo rje rgyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms ⑤par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje sngags kyi tshig 'di 6)gsungs so / /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rdo rje 'du bar bsdus pa yi/ /dam tshig chen po'i rig 'dzin rnams / /bla 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i gral 'khod de(7)/ /rigs pa 8)yin pa rigs min 'gyur/ /skal (9cib bzang po'i dam tshig 'di/ /skal ba ngan la 'bab mi 'gyur/ /de las 'das na de rlag yibyed/ /hūm̐ gro dha dz+wa ya 1lhas ma ya/ rak+ṣa dz+wa la sa ma ya/ yak+ṣa dz+wa la sa ma ya/ tsit+ta mdza la sa ma ya zhes gsungs pa tsam gyis zhal ljags kyi dbang po 'od me dpung chen po las khro bo 'od kyi phreng ba 'bar ba dang / srin po (1na'od kyi phreng ba 'bar ba dang /gnod sbyin 'od kyi phreng ba 'khrug pa dang / za byed 'od kyi phreng ba 'bar ba brgyud samar byung bas ru tra can dang / bdud dang / srin mo dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin ngo 'dang / 'jug sred dang / srid med dang / dbang phyug dang / stobs ldan dang / spre'u dang / ra dang / lu 'de dang / sbrang ma dang / bya rog dang / me khyer dang / 'khor ba dang / chu dang / sa dang / nam mkha' dang / me dang / sgra dang / bsam ngan la sogs pa brlag stes/ mi gnas par gyur cing rmad du byung ba nyid du mdzad do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag mkha' la 'khyil ba dang / 'khor mang po dag shin tu skrag 102—14

ste gsol ba 0)btab pa/ e ma'o(ge/ /e ma bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa las/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des zhal gyi chamadangs phyung ste/ 'od zer de dag ye shes kyi 'od zhi zhing 'khyil ba dang / mdzes shing bde ba dang ldan pas thams cad rangs par byas pas rtsisnod du rung bar rnam par sbyangs nas 'od de ⑤dag 'od kyi gnas su thim par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des yimi gnas pa'i ye shes chen po'i klong nas nges par bzhengs nas seṅge rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra lta bus don gyi bkod pa/ gsang ba'i nges pa/rgyud kyi dzina'agrel pa/ rtags kyi rol pa/ rdo rje rnam par bsgyings pa'i gzhung chen po sgra 'dis bshad do/ /a o oṃ/ sa ma ya/ a dhi/ gu h+ya/ pu ti a ho ku la ma tong bying ta pa dra a mo gha yī (8)shwa ra sa ya na/ gu ti a la la ho zhes cang mi gsung ngo / /kun du mi gsung / rab tu mi gsung / gsungs pa mi 'gog 'gog pa ma yin/ ma gsungs pa nyid na rgya cher bshad pa'i ngo bor bzhugs so/ /rnam par bzhugs nas dam tshig chen po rdo rje sems dpa' la zhal gzigs te/ 'dzum pas bskul 59ba rnam par mdzad do/ /de nas dam tshig chen po rdo rje sems dpa' 7des bskul bar rnam par rig nas rang gi stan las langs nas/ rang gi mtshan ma gnas lngar reg par byas nas dzistertse pad+ma'i (gesteng du bzhag nas/ lus sa la brdabs pa'i phyag rnal 'byor gyi lugs su byas nas1 / seṅge'i ñtsa)lta stangs kyis tsobyas nas ston pa'i zhal du bltas te/ rdo rje rgyal po tshogs bdag dgongs su gsol/ /chos kyi rgyal po mi g.yo rgyal tshul mdzad / /rgyal mchog rgyal po chos kyi rgyal po'i mthus/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la 102—15

rgya cher bshad du gsol/ /a la la ho zhes gsol ba btab pa las bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des rdo rje las kyi bka' ba de ①byin gyis brlab khupa'i phyir rdo rje rnam par spro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /badz+ra kurma tsakra satwa raṃ/ zhes gsungs te/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi 'khor lo gcig sems dpa' rdo rje'i lag tu babs par gyur nas las kyi rdo rje'i dbang thob par gyur te/ rnam par rol pa chen po shin tu bla bkyal geba'i spobs pa can du gyur to/ /byin gyis brlabs nas kun du mi gzo ba chorab tu bag dang ldan pa chen por gyur to/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rje des las kyi mtshan ma de lag tu blangs te/ stabs ⑤sna tshogs dang / gar tshanyadang / glu (7)sna tshogs rdo rje tshig tu len cing rdo rje rgya gram las kyi 'khor lo de lan rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor (nyanas grangs gnyis dang lnga bsgyur bas/ zhing khams mtha' dag rnam par g.yos te/ g.yos/ rab tu g.yos / kun du rab tu g.yos/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul / ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg /'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs / kun du rab tu 'khrugs/ 'ur rab tu 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur/chem rab tu chem/ kun du rab tu chem par gyur te/ zhing khams thams cad ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor sha stag (97tu gyur/ bcud yul thams cad ni phyag rgya chen por gyur/ rnam par rngam pa'i tshul gyis ston pa'i mdun logs su seṅge rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdan la 'gying bag gi tshul gyis kyirnam par gnas so/ /de nas 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs phal mo che rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma bcom ldan 'das sems dpa' rdo rje 'di ni 'di 102—16

ltar mthu che ba/ 'di ltar byin rlabs che ba/ 'di ltar rgya che ba/ 'di ltar mkhas pa/ 'di ltar gsal zhing zab pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi ①thugs las skyes pa lags ⑧so/ /zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs sems dpa' rdo rje 'di ni byang chub kyi sems thams cad kyi phyi mo/ snying rje thams cad kyi bdag po/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rje btsan / byang chub sems dpa' rig pa 'dzin dupa thams cad kyi yab/rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi mes chen po/ mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi ded phyidapon/ bdud thams cad kyi yang bdud chen po/ chos thams cad kyi mdzod / ye shes thams cad kyi 'byung gnas chen por gyur pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa mnyam pa'i dus/ pha mtha' las kyang pha mtha'/ dpag tu med cing bsam du med pa/ 'byam liklas pa'i dus nas bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin te / chos thams cad kyi ⑦rang bzhin du sbyor zhing gnas pas na/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs las skyes shing thams cad kyi yab tu gyur pa yin te/ de 'dra'o zhes bka' stsal pa las 'dus pa'i 'khor thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te/bcom ldan 'das 'dis 90ni 'di ltar ngo mtshar lags so5nye/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'di ngo mtshar lags so/ /sems dpa' rdo rje dam pa la logs su btud de lus sa la brdabs pa'i phyag rnal 'byor lugs su byas te/ rmad du byung ba'i me tog dang / tshogs kyi mchod pa sna tshogs byas te/ 'di ltar rmad byung ngo mtshar khyod/ /sangs rgyas thugs las rgyal skyes pa/ /ci ltar zhing 'dir snang zhig gu/ /rnal 'byor yab gyur rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngo mtshar khyod 102—17

kyis spyod pas na/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /sgrub 6)pa'i lam mchog dam pa dag /tshig gis mtshon de gsal bar mdzod/ /a la la ho zhes gsol pa btab po/ /de nas dam pa rdo rjes rdo rje bskor te bsgyur nas brjid bag tu tshig tu phyimatshon te smras pa/ oṃ rmāḥ(gurgyu/ a la la ho/ rgyal ba'i sras pos cang mi gsung / /mi gsung bas ni rgya cher bshad/ /bshad du med pa'i chos 'di ni/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bshad de/ /de ltar ston pa rgyal mchog kyang / /rnam par brjod par mi bzhed de/ /rgya cher bshad par dgongs pa'o/ /skye ba med pa'i chos rnams ni/ / ma skyes (4)par yang snying por bzhed/ /snying po'i don du gang gyur pa/ /tshig tu smra ba legs ma yin/ /spros pa nyid na gol ba zhes / /rgyal ba rnams kyis yang dag bshad/ /de bas rdo rje rgyal po nyid/ /bka' ma (57stsal bar dgongs pa 'o/ /dgongs pa'i don rnams gang 'byin pa/ /ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan ltar/ /dgongs don rig la snang gyur pa/ /ma skyes snying po'i don gyis na/ /tshig tu spro bar 6)ma yin na'ang / /mtshan ma tshig gi rnal 'byor pa/ /tshig la zhib cing don la rtsing / /tshig phyir blo 'brang rtsal zhan 71rnams/ /bkri 987phyir bsam pa rangs bya ba/ /mi dmigs pa las dmigs pa yi/ /cho 'phrul tshig gis mtshon pa ni/ /bder kyi)gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi thugs/ /gsang ba de nyid snying po'i don/ /mnyam nyid byang chub theg chen po/ /gsal khobar bkod de nges brjod kyis/ /rgya chen 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams nyon/ /nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi snying po ste/ /stong par sbas pa'i don 'di la/ /dpes mtshon tshig gi lde mig gis/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i sgo dbye byas/ /sbas pa'i don 'byin gsal byas pa/ /sā 61lu 102—18

phub khrod snang me bzhin/ /bsal 0)bteg snang rnyed sa ler 'dug /zab mor spyod pa la mos pas/ /gang zhig don la 'dris pa yi/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /mthun ②pa'i dmigs bcu dper bzhag ste/ /rnal 'byor can gyis shes par bya/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu ③mi lam dang / /gzugs brnyan dri za (gegrong khyer dang / /brag ca (gechu zla mig yor dang / /chu bur 'khrul dang mgal 6)mer snang / /sgrub dang gsang sngags spyod pa dang / /grub pa dang ni gnas dag dang —/ /bzlas pa'i sgra dang phyag rgyar rtog /ting 'dzin lta ba cho 'phrul brtag /ji ltar sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /skyes bu dag gi rtsol ba dang / /sman dang sngags kyi sbyor ba las/ /dbang po yid 'phrog cir snang yang / /de la 'gro 'ong ga la yod/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid kyang / /yig 'bru rdzas kyi sbyor ba las / /grub par snang yang rang bzhin med/ /ji ltar smig rgyu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /zhing pa'i dus kyi zla ba la/ /drod dang nyi ma'i sbyor ba las/ /byis pa gdungs pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /chu yi 'du shes ci bskyed kyang / /tshim pa'i rgyud ni ga la 'gyur/ /gsang sngags ming gi khyad par yang / /rang bzhin mi dmigs stong pa la/ /mtshan ma'i tha snyad ming du btags/ /de nyid stong pas ming 7mi dmigs(mi / /dper na rmi lam rang bzhin ni/ /skyes bu gnyid kyi dbang gyur na / /thang cig (1)skad cig yud tsam dang / /lo la sogs pa de bzhin du/ /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin myong / /sangs nas ci yang mi dmigs ltar/ /de bzhin sngags kyi spyod pa dag /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la/ /spyod pa'i rnam pa cir snang yang / /rtags rten dmigs pa kun dang bral/ /gzugs brnyan snang ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /dper na gdong dang me long lasatsho / /brten 102—19

nas bzhin gyi gzugs byung yang / /red par gyur pa ga la yod/ /de bzhin sngags kyi dngos grub kyang / /sgrub dang ting 'dzin yo byad las6)/ /brten nas dngos grub tshul 90byung yang / /gsol thob dmigs pa ga la yod/ /dri za gnas pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /mkha' 'am yid kyi mkha' ngos la/ /dri za'i gzugs ni gar byung yang / /grong khyer de yang de nas byung / /byung nas de yang mi rtag ltar/ /gsang sngags grub pa'i gnas dag kyang / /chos sam yid kyi mkha' ngos la/ /rnal 'byor gsang bdag gar bskyed par / /de nyid gnas pa'i gzhal med khang / /byung yang de la gnas mi 'gyur/ /brag ca grag nya pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /dper na ngos la sgras rkyen (7pas/ /ci bzhin sgra ltar brag ca 'byung 67/ /byung yang sgrar thos dmigs pa med/ /de bzhin sngags tshig 7bzlas pa'i sgra/ /dper na med las yod brtags (7pa'i/ /mtshan ma la brten 9stong pa'i sgra/ /brjod pa tsam du bstan par zad/ /ji ltar chu yi zla ba ni / /sgrib med mkha' las zla shar ba/ /gzugs brnyan dang 7ba'i chu nang snang / /snang yang gzung ba'i rtog med pa/ /de bzhin gzugs snang phyag rgya yang / /sems kyi mkha' las skur gsal ba/ /phyag rgya rig nyinya'adzin ngo la snang / /de ltar snang yang 'dzin rtog bral/ /ji ltar char gyi rgyun bzhin du/ /chu las chu bur rnam par 'gyur8/ /de yang gcig gi 1 rnam pa las/ /mang po'i rnam grangs du ma 'byung 〉〉/ /sdud cing phyir yang dum bur 'chad/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa yi/ /ting 'dzin rnam pa mang por 'dod/ /'khrul pa snang ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /spros bral dngos po stong pa las/ /srog dang shed can byed pa po/ /sems can pa la sogs par snang / /mig nad ngo la rdzas 1632—20

ltar snang / /'khrul pa kho na snang bar zad/ /de bzhin sngags kyi lta ba yang /cho 'phrul mang po cir 'phrul ba/ /snang ba med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /'khrul pa sna tshogs snang bar zad/ /rnal 'byor can gyis de ltar ltardzi/ /ji ltar mgal me'i rang bzhin ni/ /gang dag lag na mgal me thogs/ /bskor na 'khor lo'i rgyun ltar snang / /de la 'khor lo'i rang bzhin med/ /de bzhin sngags kyi cho 'phrul yang / /mi mnyam mnyam pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ji ltar dmigs pa'i don 'byung ste/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs rgyun mi 'chad/ /de phyir mtshan ma'i chos thams cad/ /mtshan med ngang du gcig pas na/ /rtog ②pa'i bag chags ci 'byung ②yang / /chos kun dbyings su gcig pa'i phyir/ /rtog 'jug spros pa'i mtshan ma kun/ /ma byung ma skyes dbyings nyid la/ /g.yos pa med cing cho 'phrul 'byung / /yon tan sna tshogs cher 'byung ba'i/ /gter gyi dbyig 'di gang mthong ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan yang / /skad cig gcig la de la 'dus / /de bas yid bzhin rin chen 'di/ /ldog pa med pas dang du blang / /don dam yang dag gter gyi mchog /rnal 'byor kun gyi nor mchog ste/ /gang rtogs de 'thob gcig pu nyid/ /'brel med gzhan gyis (pethob par dka'/ /bdag med gnyis bral bde chen klong (5)/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba che/ /ye nas lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /thig le chos nyid ye 'byam (6)pas/ /kun khyab bdal ⑦bas snying por 'dus/ /mi dmigs spros bral byang chub sems/ /zab mor snang ba'i nges don 'di/ /mkha' la mdud 'drar (gugating dpag dka'/ /rnal 'byor dmigs ldan blo chung zhing / /gang zhig rtsal zhan de rtog pa/ /g.yor mo'i tshul du bdag brtag pa/ /brtags (9)kyang rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /102—21

dper na nyi ma'i snying po la/ /mig gi 6)dbang pos rab brtags (kyen/ /de brtags gdon de mi rtogs kyi/ /'od kyi rtsizer gyis ⑤mig rdzir ⑥'gyur/ /de 'drar byis pa'i rang bzhin (1)gyis/ /zab mo'i don la cir brtags kyang / /yang dag don de mi mthong gi/ /blo zhan byis pa ga chad brgyalani/ /brtag tu med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /rtog pa can gyis mi rtogs yonyete/ /gang zhig de don mi rtogs phyir/ /g.yang sar ltung bob ci cha yod/ /gdod nas ma thos shin tu dge / /bsam dang bral bas de bzhin gzhag /mi brtags 7bzhag pa'i chos 'di gang / /byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan/ /bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur te / /bstan du med cing go bar dka'/ /tshig gis brjod pa kun dang bral/ /'di zhes bstan du ga la yod/ /med pas bstan pa'i dmigs mi phyed/ /mi dmigs chos la blo sbyangs shing / /yid kyi me long gsal byas na/ /nam mkha' dag la rab brtags na/ /snang ba med pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur de nyid 'gyur/ /chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' gang ming rjod 6)byed pa/ /brjod pa de nyid dngos po ste/ /dngos po de yi ming brjod kyang / /nam mkha' de la 'gag mi 'gyur / /de bzhin mi rtog rjod 32byed pa/ /brjod skipa de nyid rnam rtog steyi/ /rnam rtog de yi ming brjod kyang / /mi rtog de la 'gag mi 'gyur/ /de 'drar sems kyang de ltar blta/ /sems nyid gzhan du ma grub ste/ /de bzhin chos kyang grub ma yin/ /sems dang chos nyid gnyis med de/ /sems nyid gang yin chos nyid de/ /chos nyid kyang ni de bzhin no/ /chos sems gnyis med ldan gyur pa/ /bla med byang chub chen por bshad/ /sems ni nam mkha' lta bu 102—22

ste / /rnam par rtog bral gang mi rtogs/ /de bzhin sa gzhi chen po ltar/ /bla med byang chub myu gu skyed/ /me yi rang bzhin ltar snang bas/ /rmongs pa'i bud shing sreg par byed/ /rlung gi rang bzhin yin pas na/ /mi shes pa yi rdul kun sel / /chu yi rang bzhin yin pas na/ /nyon mongs gdung ba kun sim byed/ /sman gyi rang bzhin yin pas na/ /'khor ba'i gcong rnying ①rnam par 'byin/ /de ltar rtsi yi ②rang bzhin pas/ /'tsho ba rnams kyi ②gsos su 'bab/ /de bzhin rno dbal rang bzhin pas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rnam par gcod/ /nyi ma lta bur snang ba yis/ /mun khang snang ston sel bar byed/ /ri rab lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /brtan po mi 'gyur g.yo ba med/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /mi g.yo ba la byin brlabs gi)che/ /sems ni 'di ltar cho 'phrul bas / /de phyir 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis su snang ba ma yin te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bzang ngan las/ /gnyis kyi 'du shes phye ste bstan/ /sems las yang dag ye shes 'byung / /de bzhin bde dang sdug bsngal 'byung / /chos dang sangs rgyas ye shes 'byung / /dge 'dun yang ni de bzhin no/ /'di las pha rol phyin tshogs dang / /byang chub dang ni pad+mo 'byung / /'di las rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /dri med rin chen dpa' sbyin 4)'byung / /de bzhin rdo rje dpag med dang / /sna tshogs rgyal ba 'di las 'byung 55)/ /'di las phyag rgya sna tshogs dang / /rig pa'i snying po thams cad 'byung / /'di las 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /sdug bsngal nga rgyal phrag dog 'byung / /gti mug dag kyang de bzhin te/ /'di las khams gsum thams cad dang / /skyes pa bud med ma ning 'byung / /'di las 'dod (ledang 'dod gzir dang / /nyon mongs 102—23

gdung 'dod chags pa 'byung / /ri dang skye bo de bzhin du/ /nam mkha' dang ni rlung dag dang / /sreg 6)pa'i me ni rab tu 'byung / /'di las sa dang chu dang ni/ /rdo dang sa bon myu gu 'byung / /de bzhin glog dang skar ma dang / /nyi ma zla ba sprin rnams 'byung / /de bzhin spyod dang mi spyod kun/ /thams cad thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dper na nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /sprin dang na bun khug rlangs dang / /zla ba nyi ma skar tshogs dag② /snang yang nam mkha' bzhin ⑧du gnas/ /de bzhin sems kyi nam mkha' las/ /mtshan ma'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang / /chos nyid nam mkha' bzhin gnas par/ /rnal 'byor can gyis blta bar byaX/ /de lta bu yi sems nyid ni/ /rtogs dang ma ⑤rtogs rang bzhin la/ /lta ba'i khyad par so sor blta/ /rtog pa can gyi ngo ga la / /rtog rdo ripa 'khrul pa'i ngo bor snang / /kun du nyer 'jog lam tshor la/ /kun du rdul gyi phung por snang / /tshogs spyod snying rje gnyer 'jog la/ /thams cad sgyu ma'i rang bzhin ltar/ /de nyid mnyam par shes gnas na/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin mthong bar gnas/ /ye shes rang snang nam mkha' la/ /nam mkha' nyid du snang bar zad/ /brjod bral mthong med dmigs dang bral/ /mthong ba med pa'i don 'di ni/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad/ /bde gshegs snying po byang chub la/ /dgongs pa 'di las gang mi mnga'/ /lta ba de dang ldan bzhin du/ /dam tshig nam mkha' lta bu la/ /bsrung dang mi bsrung phyogs dang bral/ /'di 'o zhes ni bsrung du med/ /bsrung 97ba'i rnam grangs ji snyed cig /dus gsum rgyal bas gsungs mod kyang / /bsrung 6)ba'i mdo ni gcig tu 'dus/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor bas/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i 102—24

dam tshig bsrung / /de yang bsrung du med na bde/ /gzhan pa theg pa chung ba rnamasam/ /bsrung ba'i mtshams dag bsrungs nas ni/ /skyon yon chos la blang dor byed/ /bsrung dang bral ba'i chos rnams ni/ /bsrung du med pas de bzhin gzhag /de bzhin pa yi dam tshig la/ /ji bzhin pa yi blo gzhag 6)ste/ /brjed ②pa med pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /bsrung ba med pa'i ngang du bsdamal/ /bsrung med nam mkha'i dam tshig 'di/ /ji ltar grags pa'i rang bzhin la/ /sdom dang tshul khrims so sor snang / /byis pa rnams ni tha tshig sdom/ /bden gnyis rgyu la ston par grags/ /bla med mchog la dam tshig spyod/ /gcig gi don las ma g.yos kyang / /'dul dbang ngo la so sor grags/ /kho na nyid ldan dam tshig mchog /de dang gang ldan dam pa ste/ /de las 'das na 'tshig ④par 'gyur / /de phyir dam tshig chen po ni/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar dpa' bos bshad / /rgyal ba dpa' bo (gyethams cad la/ /dam tshig 'di las yong mi mnga' / /spyod pa dag gi khyad pa ra yang / /chos nyid bya btsal ⑥kun bral la/ / bsgrub dang sgrub ⑦pa'i dmigs pa med/ /'khrul pa gcod pa'i skye bo dag /dmigs med byang chub bde chen la/ /sdug bsngal rtsol sems bcug pas nor/ /bya ba med pa'i chos nyid la(nya/ /nyon mongs bya med spyad pas 'khrul/ /rang byung lhun grub gnas bzhin (9)du/ /byis pa'i spyod pas ci btsal yidagos/ /gang zhig 'dod de ci zhig sgrub/ /ci spyad ci bsgrubs ci btsal 4steyang / /sdug bsngal nyid de byang chub med/ /dmyal ba sangs rgyas chen po la/ /sdug bsngal byang chub lam nyid de/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sa gnyis dang / /theg pa'i khyad par ci bstan pa/ /byed rtsol 7bcas pa thams cad 'khrul/ /bla med byang chub 102—25

gegs su che/ /gang zhig btsal ①med bde chen don/ /sems kyi klong 'dis ma mthong na/ /sgrub dang rtsol ba ci spyad kyang / /byis pa don med kyi na 'khyam/ /btsal (kyedu med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rtsol ba'i spyod pas ci zhig bya/ /'dzin pa med pa'i chos nyid la/ /tshig 'dzin nor ba'i rtsol byar med/ /bgrod du med pa'i chos nyid la/ /bgrod pa'i dkyil 'khor ming dang bral/ /bsam ⑧du med pa'i chos nyid la/ /rtog sems bsam pa'i dmigs 4)dang bral/ /btsal ⑤med pa yi chos nyid la/ /btsal 96)med ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /mtha' dbus med pas bdal (7)ba che/ /phyi nang med pas ye gsal khyab/ /skyon yon med par (8)lhun gyis rdzogs/ /bsgrub du med pas btsal 6)sems bral/ /gzung du med pas dmigs dang bral/ /thams cad mkhyen pas byin brlabs 0che/ /gdod nas byang chub snying por gnas/ /spyod pa'i khyad par 'di lta bu/ /des na gcig las med bzhin du/ /spyod mthun 17rtsol ba'i rang bzhin la/ /rnam rtog spyod 7pa so sor snang / /'khrul pa thams cad 'khor bar spyod/ /rgyu 'bras mi slu bden don spyod/ /mi dmigs pa la nam mkhar (nyespyod/ /de ltar spyod pa kun spyod kyang / /dam pa'i don de spyod mchog nyid/ /dam par gyur pa thams cad la / /dam pa'i spyod pa de las med/ /skyes bu mchog gis de skad bshad / /the tshom cimed par shes par gyis/ /ma bcos 7byang chub de bzhin nyid / /bsgom du med pa'i chos nyid la/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa ste/ /ting 'dzin zhes ni gdags su med/ /bsgoms kyang rnyed pa ma yin la/ /de bzhin ma bsgoms tshastor ba med/ /bsgom 3 tshochos sna tshogs cir snang yang / /bsgoms nas de yi ngang mi gnas/ /de bas byis pa'i spyod yul yin/ /dper 102—26

na byis pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /sa la sogs pa gzugs sna tshogs/ /mdzes par byas nas skad cig mthong / /mthong ba nyid na ma grub ste/ /skad cig kho nas zhig gyur nas/ /sa la sogs pa'i rdul du snang / /de bzhin rnal 'byor byis pa yis/ /gzugs la sogs pa sna tshogs bsgomatshi/ /sems kyi bye brag skad cig la/ /yid kyi rgyu ba sna tshogs 'byung / /byung ba bzhin du de ma grub/ /sems kyi skad cig dran pa la/ /yid kyi ②dmigs pa rgyun chad nas/ /byung tshor chad pa'i mtha' spangs te/ /chos rnams nam mkha' lta bur ni/ /brjod med rgyun mi 'chad par dmigs/ /de don phyin ci ma log par/ /brjed ③med ting 'dzin sgom pa'i mchog /ci phyir chos kyi dbyings nyid ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'dus ma byas/ /bsam du med pas nam mkha' 'dra/ /brjod du med pas gzugs dang bral/ /kun gzhi ①kun du nam mkha' la/ /yid ni mkha' la nyi shar 'dra/ /rnam shes nyon mongs sprin gyis khebs/ /'du byed rlung gis kun bskyod de/ /gsal dang byung (de'ajug sangs dang 'gag /rnam shes mtshan ma'i rtog pa yis/ /kun gzhi nam mkha' mthong mi ster/ /kun gzhi mthong nyid chos sku ste/ /'di don nam mkha' (kham brjed pa/ /ting 'dzin chen po rgyun mi 'chad/ /gang zhig 'di don yid 'chang ba/ /gzugs kyi dngos po cir snang yang / /sems ni ye nas mya ngan 'das/ /bde chen sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /dgongs pa 'di las yong mi mnga'/ /snang ba med pa'i nam mkha' 'di/ /ting 'dzin chen por gnas bzhin du/ /'di las glags te ci zhig tshol/ /rgyal bas btsal (7)kyang yong mi rnyed(8na/ /'di las gzhan du gang tshol ba/ /btsal ba nyid na tshe chad 'gyur(9da/ /gzhan nam dman pa'i sgo 102—27

rnams ni/ /ting 'dzin med pa'i chos nyid la/ /'dzin pa'i ting 'dzin bcug pas nor/ /de dag la ni gang spyod rnams/ /then tsher mig ni nam mkha' la/ /phra rab then thag 'dzud pa ltar/ /byis pa las gang byed pa de/ /shed can dag gis byar mi rung / /shed can spyod pa'i nam mkha' de/ /then tsher nam mkhar shong mi 'gyur/ /de bas gzhan la bstan 0)pa min/ /bstan na byis pa ga chad 'gyur② / /chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i dngos/ /gsal bar 'od stong nyi mas 'grub / /byin brlabs (gu'od kyi zer phreng tsam/ /sgyu ma ltar snang mtshan mar thob / /mi g.yo mtshan med rang bzhin dngos/ /skye med sems kyis ma mthong ba / /byis pa 'drid pa'i rtsed mor snang / /dngos grub chen po'i sems nyid de//yid bzhin 'byung ba rin po che/ /ji ltar dmigs shing bsgyur bar 'gyur/ /grub pa'i don chen thams cad rdzogs/ /sems kyis sems kyi litshul mthong na/ /dngos grub ces de dag las 'ong / /gang gis stsol te su yis blang / /stsal dang stsol bar byed mi dmigs/ /dper na chu dang me long dang / /mkha' dang ral gri 557shel la sogs/ /gsal bar byed pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rnyog med la sogs 67bltas gsal ba/ /chu la sogs pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /de la ngo mtshar che mi 'byung / /sems kyi chu gsal nam mkha' la/ /nyon mongs sprin gyis 9)rtog med na/ /dngos grub nyi zla skar tshogs bkram/ /sgrib med byin brlabs ⑧ngang gis 'char/ /kun gzhi tsonam mkha'i snying po de/ /nyon mongs yisprin gyis gting spungs pa/ /shes rab rlung gis ma gtor yibar/ /ga zha mkhan gyi spyo 'dri yis/ /sgrib bsal 12chos nyid gsal 'dod pa/ /ji ltar chus gsher byis pa dag /nyi ma sprin ldan grib ma yis/ /shin tu bsgribs (/nyapar gyur pa na/ /102—28

sprin chen 'dus pa'i phung po la/ /kha yi dbugs kyis ①bus byas na/ /sprin bsal nyi ②'od gsal 'dod 'dral/ /de phyir rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /sems nyid don la rnam brtags te/ /kun gzhi dum ba shes par bya/ /sems nyid de la bltas gsal ba/ /rtsa ba dang ni gang ldan pa/ /dus dang tshigs dudang lor gyur yang 6)/ /yal ga lo 'dab 'bras bur bskrun/ /rtsa ba'i sa bon med mi 'gyur/ /ci ⑦ltar sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /nan gyis mtshan pa'i dngos grub dag /byis ⑧pa'i sems kyis blang 'dod na/ /de yang mtshan mas de rangs 'gyur/ /dper na me yi rang bzhin dag /sa dang nags tshal sreg byed pa/ /rgyu rnams tshogs pa'i bden pa las/ /med las yod pa'i bden par snang / /de ltar mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor yang / /mtshan ma'i cho 'phrul thob 'dod pa/ /mtshan ma'i rgyu rnams tshogs pa las/ /mtshan ma rangs pa'i mtshan mar snang / /shin tu skar ma rgyal rnams la/ /byang chub spyod pa cher 6)spyod pa'i//dam pa'i don la cher dmigs pas/ /gsang mchog rig pa'i dngos grub myur/ /mtshan mar mi rtog rang bzhin gyis/ /zab mo'i don chen go ba ni/ /nges pa'i don gyis thag gcad ⑩de/ /mnyam pa'i don la yid ches bya/ /ji ltar mkha' la tshig tsam du/ /ngang du brjod pas rjod byed kyi/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad dang bral bas/ /ji ltar 'khrigs kyi smig 5nyergyu dag /snang ba nyid na med pa ltar/ /chos so cog gi rang bzhin gsal/ /gsal ba nyid na de mi dmigs/ /thabs chen gting zab shes rab lam/ /spros bral mtshan ma'i 'phrang tsolas 'das/ /gtos ches yangs pas lam gnyis bral/ /dbus mtha' mi dmigs mnyam pa'i lam(/gye / /gcig tu mnyam par chud nas ni/ /yul med tshol ba'i sems bral 102—29

de / /blang dor gnyis kyi mtha' spangs nas/ /gnas pa med pa'i tshul gyis gnas / /chos nyid dbyings su ro gcig phyir/ /shes dang shes bya gnyis med de / /ye nas shes nyid chos shes na/ /chos nyid gzhan nas btsal ci ①dgos/ /dper na sgyu ma'i bde sdug kyang / /bsal nas gnyi ②ga mi chadamigs ltar/ /'khor ba 'gyur ba'i bde sdug kyang / /mnyam par rang bzhin don gyis mnyam / /ji ltar dus rnams thams cad dag /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas ni / /sgros tshig rjes su ma 'brangs ④na/ /mnyam 'gyur dus rnams ga la dmigs / /mkha' la ngang gis gzugs med phyir/ /dmigs su zin par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /sems kyis ma skyes don mi dpogs/ /skyon dang yon tan gnyis 'byed pa/ /rtogs nas gnyis kyi don spangs te/ /rang bzhin mnyam par don bzhag 5na/ /bsgom zhes ming du brjod par zad/ /gnyis su lta ba ma skyes phyir/ /gnyis kyi 'du shes ci byung 6)yang / /rang byung zhi ba ma bkag chos / /ye nas ma bcos don gyis gsal/ /ma skyes rnam dag byang chub sems/ /mi gnas ye shes thugs dang mnyam/ /rig dang ma rig khyad par las/ /'khor 'das rten dang 'brel bar snang / /rnam rtog med phyir zhi ba med/ /'dzin par ma yin spros bral min/ /drang ba'i don bstan ma gtogs par/ /don la tshig gis brjod du med/ /snang yang med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /shes blo yod pa'i sems mi 'byung / /mnyam nyid stong pa'i don 'di la/ /don ldan stong pa'i sgro mi 'dogs/ /ma bcos rang bzhin zhi ba yi/ /mtshan ma'i rtog bral shes ldan pas/ / med do 7tsam du'ang mi dmigs na/ /byung tshor 'dzin par ga la 'gyur/ /thams cad mi gnas byang chub pas/ /btsal (minas grub pa 102—30

ma yin yang / /sgyu ma sangs nas 'khrul bral bzhin/ /spros bral ye shes snying por gnas/ /'khor bar rtogs pa dug yin te/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi shes na/ /dug 'thungs bde ba ga las 'ong / /sbyar ①legs dug nyid sman du 'gyur / /'khor ba'i las rnams de ltar snang / /'khrul snang dug gzer bzod dka' ltar/ /ma rig 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal snang / /rmi lam sgyu 'phrul ②mi zad pas/ /shin tu nyam thag chagadungs pa'i tshe/ /'chi bdag bdud kyis zin 'dra la/ /mgon btsun gzhan gyis mi phan te/ /bdud sel rtsi dang 'dra bar ni/ /yang dag lam mchog rtogs par bya/ /dug nad smyo sangs 'byang ba la / /skad cig ma la mi bzod cing / /sman dang sman pa'i rtsol bsgrubs ④pa/ /sangs nas de dag mi dmigs ltar/ /'khor ba mi dmigs 'khrul pa la/ /rmi lam nad sel rtsol dzo sgrub ltar/ /sgrub dang ting 'dzin rtsol byed kyang / /'khor ba stong 6)rtogs nyid byang chub/ /sgyu (7)ma rgyu 'bras mi slu bzhin/ /blun rmongs ngo la de ltar snang / /mnyam nyid rig pa'i rtsal can dag /'khor ba 'khrul pa'i tshig tsam du/ /ma nor lam rig blo la gsal/ /de la rtsol thob rlom sems med(she / /sems nyid don dang ma mnyam na/ /tshig gis mnyam pas don mi dpogs(9) / /'khrul 'khor mnyam las ma g.yos kyang / /log rtogs yisgyu ma'i tshul tsam snang / /sems nyid ye sangs rgyas rig nas/ /rig pa'i don la brtson sbyor zhing / /rang 'byung 17yon tan rtsal sdud 7pa/ /'khrul par 'brel ba ga la yin/ /byang chub sems ldan bsam 4gerdzogs na/ /ye shes mchog ldan mnyam nyid sku/ /ting 'dzin mchog ldan bla ma'i dbang / /dge bsags mchog ldan lus spyod pa'i/ /bsod nams mchog ldan gzugs kyi sku/ /rnam brusmin 102—31

tshul gyis 'grub 6)mi lta/ /btsal tshunas thob par mi byed de/ /rgyu yi dus nyid 'bras bu'i mchog /dpyod ②pa'i sems nyid ting 'dzin ni/ /sems can dus na don la spyod④/ /lhun grub sa la bgrod mi byed/ /'khor ba'i sa shes bde ldan gnas/ /mi gnas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yang / /byang chub 'khor ba'i lam dang 'brel⑤/ /sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid ma bkag tshul/ /rang byung rtog 0bral gcig tu mnyam/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi don btsan ⑦par/ /chos nyid la yang chos nyid gsal/ /mnyam pas mnyam zhes tshig brjod kyang / /mnyam pa'i don dang mthun tsho tshomi 'gyur/ /byang chub de yang mi dmigs te/ /mi gnas zhes ni gang brjod cing / /gnas dang dmigs pa'i gnas 'dzin pa/ /gzung 'dzin zhes ni de la bya/ / sgyu 'drar 6)byang chub sems med na/ /dngos bral yul med stong pa dag /mkha' la rang bzhin mi gnas zhes/ /bstan pa de ni yod ma yin/ /bsam gtan lus ni gtsor byed dang / /gnas de lus kyi phyag rgya kun/ /mtshan mar mngon par zhen las byung / /mtshan med sems la bya btsal 7med/ /smig rgyu bzhin du lus red na/ /gnas dang phyag rgyar dmigs pa med/ /byed spyod ched du ston byed cing / /bya med bya ba'i dmigs pa'ang med/ /de nyid ma skyes gzhi med pas/ /gnas bder lus bcos kha na med/ /zhen par 'chos lam spyod byed pa/ /de nyid gzung 'dzin rnam rtog ste/ /bsam gtan lus dben dben ma yin/ /mkha' la sems dben dben pa'i mchog /sems nyid dben pa'i gnas yin te/ /'di ni rnal 'byor spyod mchog gnas/ /bla yigab ri phug gzhal med min/ /sems nyid dpag yas (nyagazhal med mchog /'di ni rmad byung nor bu'i gzhal/ /phyi dang nang med kun du nang 6rte/ /'du bar 102—32

'dus pa tshogs ma yin/ /sems la ye shes tshogs 'dus mchog /chos kun 'dus pas lus pa med/ /dpag med rgyal ba mnyes pa'i tshogs/ /kun rdzob 'byor pa yo byad min/ /sems nyid 'byor pa lardzas dang ldan/ /lhag pa'i rdzas mchog 'di shes na/ /bsgrub ②'grub 'di la the tshom med/ /sgom ①par byed pa sgom ④pa min/ /bsam bya dmigs su med pa ste/ /'di ltar sems kyi gsang sgom pa/ /don la sems sgom ting 'dzin mchog /bsrung zhes bsrung bar bya mi dmigs/ /stong par sbas pa'i sems nyid de/ /mtshan mar 'das nas tshig shes na/ /bsrung ba'i gsang ba dam pa'o/ /tshig tu mnyam brjod mnyam mi dmigs/ /sems nyid rang dag mnyam pa las/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid lhag par med/ /'di don mnyam shes mnyam pa'i don/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa spyod min te/ /sems la sems gzhol rol spyod pa/ /thabs che yangs pa spyod pa'i mchog /byang chub don gyi phyi mo ru/ /sems kyi phyi mor ye gnas pas / /gsol thob mtshan ma'i ming mi dmigs/ /dngos grub chen po rgyun mi 'chad / /de ltar sems kyis sems mthong na/ /ye shes kyis ni chos nyid mthong / /dus kun du ni skye 'gag med/ /sngon ma mthong ba'i don mthong 'gyur / /de yang dngos po cang mi mthong / /thams cad rang bzhin med pa zhig /blo la 'gyus (gepa kho nar zad/ /de lta bu yi gyedon mthong na/ /mtshan mar mthong ba ci yang med/ /sgyu ma tsam du tshul shes nas/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i don snang 'gyur/ /kha cig dag ni de (pedon la(she/ /mthong ba ci yang med 'gyur na/ /snang ba zhes ni ci 5)phyir gdags/ /med pa'i don dang 'gal 'gyur zhes/ /the tshom za 'gyur de dag la/ /mthong ba med pa'i don de nyid/ /102—33

yid kyi ngo la snang 'gyur na/ /snang zhes de phyir brjod par bya/ /de bas 'khrul pa ma zad par/ /nam mkha' mthong ba med pa de①/ /de nyid yid la snang 'gyur yang / /gzugs la snang bar 'gyur ba min/ /sems nyid bden par ma mthong na/ /yid la mtshan med don gsal dang / /mtshan ma 'khrul par rgyu ba gnyis/ /'dren mar rgyu byed 'bral 'gyur min/ /de nyid bden par mthong 'gyur ②na/ /de nas de ma thag tu yang / /yid kyi rgyu ba rgyun chad nas/ /sngar 'khrul mtshan ma'i chos bral te/ /des ni bden pa mthong ba yin/ /de bas 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs/ /sems ni yang dag lam nyid de/ /mkha' la bya lam rjes med bzhin/ /gol med lam zhes 'dren pas bshad/ /de ltar bshad pa'i lam de yang / /kun gyis (mirtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /tshig tu mtshon te ④bshad mod kyang / /dmigs med tshig gi yul bral ba/ /de yi (5)rang bzhin de yin na/ /rang bzhin gzhi las mtshan mar g.yos/ /de la ming med ming btags rgyus nye/ /yin dang ma yin the tshom (7skyes/ /de las 585rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur te/ /de bsal don phyir mtshan ma yi/ / tshig gi (9)tshogs kyi rnam grangs las / /sgo mo dpag tu med par bshad/ /de yis nges don rjes bcad 7pa/ /thugs kyi klong 1lhanas bton pa yinyan/ /tshig gi sgron mas don btsal tu ba/ /lam nyid ji ltar yin zhe na/ /dran byung rjes su 'brengs yin ni/ /'khor ba'i gnas su 'khor bar 'gyur/ /dran 'byung g.yo ba ci bkag pa/ /de dag 'gog pa nyid du 'gyur/ /dran byung med par blun pa ni/ /mu stegs can lam mun par 'gyur/ /'di zhes sems su gcig bzung tshan/ /mtshan ma rtog pa'i ri bo yin/ /snga phyi med ces phyang bcad na/ /med ⑩de chad pa'i mu sna can yin/ /102—34

gzhi yi don las ①yud tsam zhig /cir g.yos skye 'gag byung ba de/ /rnam grangs lam de 'phel 'gyur gyi/ /lam gyi chos nyid ga la 'gyur/ /dper na 'gro gang byis pa dag /grib ma spangs nas rnam dag tshol/ /rang las byung ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /btsal ②na grib med dag mi rnyed/ /don nyid ye nas gnas bzhin du/ /sems nyid sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis/ /sha thang bar ni don tshol ba/ /don med bdud kyi ③las yin no/ /don la (4)tshig tu brjod pa ni / /nam mkha' dag la rtsod ⑤pa 'dra/ /tshig tu sman dang dpyad (7bshad kyang / /nad pa'i tshogs la mi phan no/ /sems nyid don du ma shes na/ /tshig tu don brjod don mi rtogs/ /'khor ba spangs nas 'das tshol ba /gzugs btang nas ni grib tshol 'dra/ /lam nyid ji ltar yin zhe na/ /ma rig ye shes tha dad min/ /ma rtogs rtogs pa lam du gcig /sems 'di sna tshogs par snang bas/ /sna tshogs sems su gcig pa yin/ /dper na gser du gcig pa las/ /dbyibs dang gzugs ni tha dad par/ /skyes 57)pas so so'i ming du grags/ /grags kyang gser gyi ngo bor gcig /de bzhin sems kyi rang bzhin la/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul khyad par gyis/ /ji ltar bltas dgu (5der snang yang / /snang yang sems las gzhan mi dmigs/ /sgron mar 'bar ba'i rin chen ni/ /gal te ngan khung sbas gyur kyang / /de nyid yon tan rang snang bas / /'od ni mkha' la gsal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems nyid rin chen sgron / /lus ngag 6)'khor bar bying gyur kyang / /rang byung rang zhi rang yosnang bas / /shes rab chos nyid mkha' la gsal/ /sems nyid nam mkha' nyu 'drar mtshungs te/ /kun khyab stong gsal sna tshogs 'byung / /byung tshor g.yo 'gog 102—35

thams cad kyang / /rang bzhin gyis 6)'byung ngang gis zhi/ /mdor na ji ltar brtags bsams bzhin/ /'gyur bas thams cad ngo bor snang / /ma bcos ②g.yo ba med nyid la/ /sna tshogs rgyu 'byung mi skyon zhing / /cho 'phrul mi 'gag nyam nga med/ /ci ri )bzhin nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /blo bzhag ma g.yengs kho nar zad/ /de ni skyes mchog don po che/ /de sems dus gsum thams cad kyi//sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i ngo bo yin/ /de lta'i don la ring zhig nas/ /shes shing 'dris par gyur pa na/ /nges don mthong ba'i nyams drod ni/ /don dang mjal ba'i rtags chen yang / /man ngag lung gis brgyad ④'char te/ /nges par don gsum myong bar 'gyur/ /de dag thog tu phebs pa yiX/ /drod chen rtags su bstan pa yin/ /de yi zhar las byung ba'i drod/ /'khor ba'i chos la snying rje yi/ /byang chub sems kyang skye bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma rtog ⑥pa'i chos rnams la/ /yid mi ches pa'i 'du shes skye/ /chos rnams 'di ltar yin pa las//'di ltar 'khrul pa ngo mtshar che/ /ya mtshan dpyod pa'i 'du shes 'byung / /'di don ma shes 'gro ba rnams/ / rtsol sgrub (pedaka' ba'i thabs chen gyis/ /yang dag don tshol lam re ring / /bsags pa'i 'bras (0bu yod 'gyur yang / /don de mthong bar yong mi nus/ /de 'dra'i 'du shes 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes pa'i nyams drod ni/ /skal dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gang / /rgyud 'gros ⑨tshig gis ma bkrol 7bar/ /sems las chos byung 'bum phrag yas6nya/ /smra ba'i sgo mor thams cad gsal/ /don la nges pa'i gtan tshigs dag /tshig tu mtshon te 'byin par nus/ /de ni chos sku mnyam nyid dang / /dbyer med gnyis su med pa yin/ /rten 1 pa'i gsung thugs sku brnyan dang / /de ni 102—36

mtshungs pa yod min no/ /zhi lus mthar 'gog skyon ①gnyis dang / /de ni mtshungs pa yod ma yin/ /sa la slob pa'i sems dpa' dang / /de yang mi mtshungs ③rgyal bas gsungs/ / rig 'dzin ②drang srong don dpyod dang / /lus 'dra sems ni yong mi mtshungasabya/ /de phyir rnam dag lam chen ni/ /sems kyi gsang 'di yin pas na/ /skal ldan 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs/ /lam 'di shes par bya ba las/ /btsal ⑤bar bya ba'i rgyu ⑥med de/ /lam 'di shes pa de nyid kyis/ /dka' ba'i rtsol ()sgrub ma byas par/ /thams cad thams cad grub (kyepar 'gyur/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs de bas na 6)sems 'di ni lam zhes bya'o/ /'khor ba zhes bya'o/ /sems can ⑩zhes bya'o/ /gru zhes bya'o//bgrod pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub ces bya'o/ /sems zhes 7bya'o/ /shes rab ces bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /gnas zhes 'bya'o/ /rab ces bya'o/ /mchog ces bya'o/ /phul zhes bya'o/ /bla na med pa zhes bya'o/ /zab pa zhes bya'o / /gsang ba zhes bya'o/ /gting dpag dka' ba zhes bya'o/ /chos zhes ⑫bya'o / /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas zhes tsobya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jug pa'i phyir ni lam mo/ /'khrul pa'i phyir ni 'khor ba'o/ /ma shes pa'i phyir ni sems can no/ /sgrol ba'i phyir ni gru'o/ /bskyod ④pa'i phyir ni bgrod ⑩pa'o/ /bde ba'i phyir ni byang chub bo/ /dran pa nges pa'i phyir ni sems so/ /mkhas pa'i phyir ni shes rab bo/ /gsal ba'i phyir ni ting nge ⑩'dzin to(she/ /phyin pa'i phyir ni gnas so/ /zla med pa'i phyir ni rab bo/ /ngo mtshar ba'i phyir ni mchog go/ /'phags pa'i phyir ni phul lo/ /dbang byed pa med pa'i phyir ni bla na med pa'o/ /gting ring ba'i phyir ni zab pa'o/ /gab 102—37

pa'i phyir ni gsang ba'o/ /phra ba'i phyir ni gting dpag dka' ba'o/ /kun 'byung ba'i phyir ni chos so/ /sa non pa'i phyir ni byang chub sems dpa'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i phyir ni sangs rgyas te/ /sems dpa' chen po de'i phyir na rnal 'byor gyi lam 'di shes par bya ste/ /lam 'di ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum mo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad 'di las 'byung 0)ba'i phyir na gzhi'o(mi/ /mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam 'di nas gshegs par gyur to/ /da ( ltar stong pa nyid kyang lam 'di nas gshegs pa ste/ /de'i phyir lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na de'i phyir lam 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab ces kyang bya'o/ /de bzhin du yum zhes kyang bya ba dang / sras zhes bya ba dang / bdag po zhes bya ba dang / gdung zhes bya ba dang / srog ces bya ba dang / nor zhes bya ba dang /⑤ bran zhes bya ba dang / sku zhes bya ba dang / gsung zhes bya ba dang / thugs zhes bya ba dang / yon tan zhes bya ba dang / phrin (snyelas chen po zhes bya ba'o(6)/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thabs chen po dang / shes rab chen po dang / byang chub chen po dang / dbang chen po dang / de bzhin nyid dang / 'da' bar dka' ba dang / chos nyid la zad mi shes pa dang / snying rje chen po dang / rnam par brjid pa dang / sna tshogs su ston pa dang / thams cad du mkhyen pa dang /cir yang 'byung ba dang / mdzad pa sna tshogs pa'i phyir de dag ni de ltar yin par shes par bya'o/ /de'i phyir yang lam 'di yongs su shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du 'dod pa chen po zhes kyang bya'o/ /'tsho ba chen po zhes bya ba dang /longs spyod chen po zhes bya ba dang / yo byad chen po zhes bya ba dang / rgyu zhes 102—38

bya ba dang / rkyen zhes bya ba dang / 'bras bu zhes bya ba dang / spyod pa zhes bya ba dang / cho 'phrul zhes bya ba dang / phyag rgya zhes bya ba dang / bsnyen pa zhes bya ba dang / nye ba'i bsnyen pa zhes bya ba dang / sgrub 6)pa zhes bya ba dang /sgrub ②pa chen po zhes bya ba dang / tshogs chen po zhes bya ba dang / kun du rdzogs pa zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yul la 'dod pa sna tshogs pa dang /dmigs pas 'tsho ba dang / 'jol nyog tu spyod pa dang / dgos pa sgrub ③pa dang / 'bras bur byed pa dang / kun du log pa dang / don grub pa dang /smin par bsags pa dang / rang bzhin du gyur pa dang / bya ba byed pa dang /sna tshogs su 'byung ba dang / mtshan mar bstan pa dang / rnam par 'dud pa dang / shin tu mdzad pa dang / 'dod pa byed pa dang / lhag par 'dod pa dang —/ kun du 'byor pa dang / lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir yongs su shes par bya'o / /gzhan yang ④'dus pa chen po'i tshogs 'di la ni thams cad yod de/chos thams cad ni rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum du 'dus par shes par (5)bya'o/ /gsum gang zhe na/ rgyu'i rnal 'byor dang / rkyen gyi rnal 'byor dang / 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum yang 'di nyid yin zhing 'di las 'byung bar shes par bya ste6)/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ rgyu ni 'khrul pa gcig shes te chub par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di nyid shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du mtshan ma gnyis dang / rtog (7)pa gsum dang / log pa bzhi dang / nyon mongs pa lnga dang /phung po lnga dang / dbang po lnga dang / rgyu drug dang / rkyen bcu gnyis dang /skye ba bcu gnyis dang / rang bzhin bcwa (5)brgyad dang / spyod pa bcu gcig dang / smin po)pa bzhi dang / lam lnga dang / gnas drug dang / mu gsum 102—39

shes te chub par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di nyid shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'dod pa'i 'bras bu'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir te/ lam de nyid ma rig pa'i phyir 'khrul pa zhes bya'o/ /yul dang gnyis su gyur pa'i phyir na mtshan ma zhes bya'o / /dus gsum dngos por rtog 6)pa'i phyir rtog pa zhes bya'o/ /nges pa las log pa'i phyir don las gol ba dang / mnyam pa las gol ba dang phyogs las gol ba dang gzhi las gol ba'i phyir log pa zhes bya'o/ /rgyu 'bras kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyir mun pas 'thibs pa dang / sred ②pas gdungs pa dang /sdong pos non pa dang / mi phyed pas 'thas pa dang / kun nas 'khrugs pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa zhes bya'o/ /kun nas 'dus pa'i phyir rgyu 'dus pa dang /rkyen du tshor ba dang / mtshan mar shes pa dang / thams cad nas byed pa dang /rnam par rig pa'i phyir phung po zhes bya'o/ /sgor gsal zhing yul la dbang byed pa'i phyir mthong bar dbang ba dang / thos par ①dbang ba dang / tshor bar dbang ba dang / myong bar dbang ba dang / reg ④par dbang ba'i phyir dbang po zhes bya'o/ /'bras bur byed pa'i phyir 'dzin par dbang ba dang / mnyen par byed pa dang / chags par byed pa dang / g.yo bar 'bud pa dang /skyed par gsal ba dang / dus su red pa'i phyir rgyu zhes bya'o/ /rkyen du 'brel ⑤pa'i phyir sa bon dang / rtsa ba dang / myu gu dang / ldum bu dang / yal ga dang —/ sdong po dang / 'dab (5)ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang /snying po dang / skams 7pa'i phyir rkyen zhes bya'o/ /mtshan ma skye ba'i phyir mthong ba skye ba dang / snang ba dang / thos pa dang / sgra brnyan dang / tshor ba dang /dri dang / myang 8ba dang / ro dang / reg pa dang / shes pa dang / chos 102wa 40

skye ba'i phyir skye ba zhes bya'o/ /mtshan ma'i chos nyid can gyi phyir/ /mthong ba'i chos nyid dang / snang ba'i chos dang / lhang nge ba'i chos dang / thos pa'i chos dang / grags ①pa'i chos dang / gsal ba'i chos dang / tshor ba'i chos dang ske/ dri'i chos dang / tshim pa'i chos dang / myang ②ba'i chos dang / ro'i chos dang / bro ②ba'i chos dang / reg pa'i chos dang / reg bya'i chos dang /nges pa'i chos dang / shes pa'i chos dang / chos kyi chos dang / rtogs pa'i chos nyid 'dzin pa'i phyir chos nyid ces bya'o/ /mtshan mar spyod pa'i phyir 'du shes sgyur ④ba'i spyod pa dang / dbang du spyod pa'i spyod pa dang / rnam par g.yo ba'i spyod pa dang / sgros su 'dogs pa'i spyod pa dang / zla las gal ba'i spyod pa dang / kun du 'tshig pa'i spyod pa dang / bla bkyal 'tshal ba'i spyod pa dang glu/ chags pa 'dzin pa'i spyod pa dang / kun du bdud kyi ⑤spyod pa dang /phyin ci log pa'i spyod pa dang / gnyis la rten ⑥par spyod pa'i phyir spyod pa zhes bya'o / /'bras bur smin pa'i phyir rdzogs par smin pa dang / rim par smin pa dang —/ glo ⑦bur du smin pa dang / bsgyur rkite smin pa'i phyir smin pa zhes bya'o/ /bgrod 6)par byed pa'i phyir gdung ba'i lam dang / 'gog pa'i lam dang /mun pa'i lam dang / 'dam gyi lam dang / yang ba'i phyir lam zhes bya'o/ /brten par byed pa'i phyir bzod ldan gyi gnas dang / yid ldan gyi gnas dang /mnyam ldan gyi gnas dang / 'dod ldan gyi 'oganas dang / rtsod ldan gyi gnas dang / dga' ldan la gnas pa'i phyir gnas zhes (1bya'o/ /bde ba'i mu la tsobazung ba'i phyir ngo bo nyid kyi mu dang / byed pa dang dbang phyug gi mu bzung ba'i phyir mu zhes bya'o/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs rkyen gyi rnal 'byor ni 'di lta ste/102—41

shes pa gcig shes te chub par 'dod pas kyang / lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du don gnyis dang / tshul gsum dang / thabs bzhi dang / chos lnga dang ske/ rigs drug dang / mdzad pa chen po bcu gnyis dang / cho 6)'phrul chen po bcu gnyis dang / ye shes bco ②brgyad dang / sa'i khyad par bcu gcig dang / sku bzhi dang / lam lnga dang / 'bras bu chen po drug dang /byang chub chen po gcig shes te chub par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di nyid shes par bya'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang rkyen tsam du spyod cing 'bras bu'i rkyen du 'gyur (geba'i phyir te/ lam de nyid ma nor bar shes pa'i phyir de (7shes pa gcig shes 97bya'o/ /bden pa gnyis su snang ba'i phyir don gnyis pa zhes bya'o/ /mtshan nyid gsum gyis sbyor ba'i phyir kun brtags mthun (7)pa la yod pa'i tshul dang / gzhan dbang mi mthun sgyu pa la med pa'i tshul dang / rjes su dpag pa gnyi tshonaphyog ma yin pa'i phyir tshul zhes bya'o/ /mkhas pas zin pa'i phyir khad kyis 'jug pa'i thabs dang / rkyen la sbyor ba'i thabs dang / mngon par 'jug pa'i thabs dang / thams cad rdzogs pa'i phyir thabs zhes (9)bya'o/ /rang bzhin la gnas pa'i phyir kyirgyu'i chos dang / lam gyi chos dang / rtogs pa'i chos dang / 'bras bu'i chos la gnas pa'i phyir chos zhes bya'o/ /phyis 'byung bar shes pa'i phyir rgyu'i dran pa dang / 'bras bu'i dran pa dang / sgra'i dran pa dang / sbyor ba'i dran pa dang / gnas kyi dran pa dang / mngon sum pa'i dran pa dang / rig pa'i phyir rig pa drug ces bya'o/ /gzhan gyi don du mdzad cing 'gro ba'i don la 'jug pa'i phyir ngo bo'i tshul dang / bltams (1pa'i tshul dang / rol pa'i tshul dang / mnga' dbang chen po'i tshul dang / thar par 102—42

gyur pa'i tshul dang / dka' thub chen po'i tshul dang / sangs rgyas pa dang bdud btul ba ①dang 'khor lo bskor ba dang / bdud btul ba'i tshul dang /cho 'phrul ston pa'i tshul dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul gyi phyir mdzad pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /sna tshogs su 'phrul pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul dang ske/ snang ba'i cho 'phrul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / kun rjod ②pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / bsam gtan gyi cho 'phrul dang / byin brlabs (0kyi cho 'phrul dang / skye ba'i cho 'phrul dang /stobs kyi cho 'phrul dang / yon tan gyi cho 'phrul dang / 'bras bu'i cho 'phrul dang / de'i liphyir cho 'phrul zhes bya'o/ /phyi nang gi chos thams cad shes pa'i phyir nang gi chos thams 95)cad shes pa (zhesadang / phyi'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / phyi nang gi chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / stong pa'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / don dam pa'i chos nyid shes pa'i ye shes dang glu/ 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / mtha' mi dmigs pa'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / dus gsum gyi chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / blang dor mi dmigs pa'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / rang bzhin gyi chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang /chos can gyi chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / dmigs pa med pa'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / mtshan mar mi rtog pa'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / ngo bo nyid kyi chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / dngos po mi dmigs pa'i chos thams cad shes pa'i ye shes dang / brten te gnas pa'i phyir 102—43

mi gos pa'i rig ①pa dang / mi nyams par rig pa dang / mi sgrib par rig pa dang spyo/ rdzogs par rig pa dang / ma ②g.yos par rig pa dang / mnyam pa nyid du rig pa dang / gnyis su med par rig pa dang / yongs su dag par rig pa dang / kun du legs par rig pa dang / de ma thag par rig pa dang /rdzogs par chub pa'i rig pa la brten pa'i phyir sa zhes bya'o/ /kun du brjod ③cing ngo bo nyid du gnas pa'i phyir ngo bo nyid dang / chos nyid dang / rdzogs longs spyod pa dang / 'dren par sprul pa'i phyir sku zhes bya'o/ /bgrod cing 'jug pa'i phyir tshogs dang / sbyor ba dang / mthong ba dang / bsgom ④pa dang ske/ mtha' zad du phyin pa'i phyir lam zhes bya'o/ /rgyu la don yod pa'i phyir gcig tu rdzogs pa dang / thams cad du mkhyen pa dang / yongs su khyab pa dang ske/ tshogs su 'byung (3)ba dang / kun du dbang ba dang / dgos pa tshang ba'i phyir 'bras bu zhes bya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs pa'i phyir byang chub chen po zhes bya'o/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor ni 'di lta ste/ma nor ba gcig shes te chub par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du nges pa gnyis dang / yon tan gsum dang / dgongs pa bzhi dang /chen po lnga dang / tshogs pa drug dang / 'byung tshul bcu gnyis dang / ting nge 'dzin bcu gnyis dang / ye shes chen po bcwa 6)brgyad dang / rnal 'byor chen po bcu gcig dang / sgrub tshanapa chen po bzhi dang / sbyor ba lnga dang /dngos grub chen po drug dang / rdzogs pa chen po gcig shes te chub par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu nyid 'bras bur grub pa'i phyir gtan la phebs pas 98)ma nor ba zhes bya'o/ /the tshom kyi)mi za ba'i 102wa 44
