phyir thabs kyis nges pa dang / shes rab kyis nges pas nges pa zhes bya'o0)/ /'dod pa 'byung ba'i phyir yang (miyongs su khyab pa dang / rlabs su che ba'i yon tan dang / rtsis las 'das pa'i phyir yon tan zhes bya'o/ /thabs kyis ldem por dgongs pa'i phyir mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa dang / mtshan nyid kyi phyir dus gzhan la dgongs pa dang / gnyen po'i phyir grangs gzhan la dgongs pa dang / bsgyur chaba'i phyir don gzhan la dgongs pas na dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /lhag par 'phags pa'i phyir mngon pa dang / bdag nyid chen po dang / de yin ④pa dang / thams cad du che ba dang / kun du rdzogs pa'i phyir chen po zhes bya'o/ /kun nas tshang ba'i ⑤phyir/ mnyam pa chen po dang / 'byor ba chen po dang / 'dus pa chen po dang / rig pa chen po dang / dbang chen po dang / 'dres pa chen po'i phyir tshogs zhes 6)bya'o/ /gzhan gyi don du 'byung zhing 'gro ba'i tshul dang mthun ( pa'i phyir gnas su bskyod pa dang / mnyam par gyur pa dang / mdzes par gshegs pa dang / spro bar spyod pa dang / gsang bar sbyor ba dang / mtshan ma bcom pa dang / mdzad pa med pa dang /seṅge'i gsung sgra dang / nges par rdzogs pa dang / tshom ngam chen po sprul pa mdzad pa dang / yongs su dag pa'i phyir 'byung tshul chen po zhes bya'o/ /gsal zhing mi gtong ba'i phyir sems kyi spyod pa ste/ rnam dag dbyings kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / snang gsal yel (8'phyo'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mi zad mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / mngon par rtogs 5༄pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thams cad rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'byung chen sprul pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /dbang sgyur thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rtse gcig 8'phros pa'i ting nge 'dzin 102—45

dang / tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rin chen myu gu'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dug 'joms sman gyi (2)ting nge 'dzin dang / bya ba byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyir ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / rgyu'i ye shes dang / thams cad 'byung ba'i ye shes dang / yi ge'i ye shes dang /phyag rgya'i ye shes dang / sprul pa'i ye shes dang / cir yang mdzad pa'i ye shes dang —/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / nam mkha' lta bu'i ye shes dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes dang / rin po che lta bu'i ye shes dang / nyi ma lta bu'i ye shes dang —/ snang stong gsal ba'i ye shes dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /so kyisor rtog ( pa'i ye shes dang / bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su gsal ba'i phyir ye shes chen po zhes bya'o/ /'dun pa sems pa'i rigernal 'byor dang / bka' sdod las kyi rnal 'byor dang / rigs chen 'byed (5pa'i rnal 'byor dang / rtags ⑥kyi rnal 'byor dang / gsang sgo lung gi 979rnal 'byor dang / spyod pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang / mtshan ma rtags kyi rnal 'byor dang / lung chen thob pa'i rnal 'byor dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor dang / rtsal chen sbyong ba'i (3)rnal 'byor dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang / lhun gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor du gnas pa'i phyir rnal 'byor zhes bya'o/ /mnyam pa nyid du grub pa dang / bde ba chen por grub pa dang / yongs su rdzogs par grub pa dang / thams cad lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir grub pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur tho sbyor ba dang / thabs dang shes rab tu sbyor ba dang / dbyings 1 )dang ye shes su sbyor ba dang /sems dang chos su sbyor ba dang / las dang thugs rjer sbyor bas sbyor ba chen po 102wa 46

zhes bya'o/ /srid pa rgya mtsho dbyings su tshim par grub pa dang / 'khor ba rgya mtsho bdag gir grub par gyur pa dang / bdag nyid chen po lhun gyis grub par gyur pa dang / dmigs pa gang yin pa de bzhin grub par gyur pa dang / cho 'phrul rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med par grub pa dang / don dam bcud kyis rnam shes rgyas par grub pa'i phyir dngos grub chen po zhes bya'o/ /rnam grangs thams cad byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen por rdzogs par grub pa'i phyir rdzogs pa chen po gcig ces bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs sa'i khyad par chen po bcu gcig non par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di la bslab par bya ste gang zhe na/'gyur dbang ma nges pa'i 0)sa dang / brten pa gzhi'i ②sa dang / gal chen sbyor ba'i sa dang / mi ldog gnas pa'i sa dang / bslab pa rgyun gyi sa dang /cho 'phrul sprul pa'i sa dang / bsten pas khyad ①par du 'gro ba'i sa dang /dmigs pas 'bras bu skye ba'i sa dang / gnas pas mi 'gyur ba'i sa dang /bdal ba chos nyid kyi sa dang / rdzogs pa spyir chib kyi sa ste/ sa 'di dag non par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di la bslab par bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs 'di lta ste/ rnal 'byor bslab pa'i mtha' bcu chib par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di la bslab par bya ste/ gang zhe na gzhi dam tshig 'dis bzung ④bar bslab pa dang / rgyud thos pas dgrol bar bslab (5)pa dang / phul du mkhas par dbyung bar bslab pa dang / sgo kun nas sdud (7par bslab pa dang /rim pa dbang gis bgrod par bslab pa dang / la spyod pas dor bar bslab pa dang / thag lta bas gcad (7༄par bslab pa dang / nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyis blang bar bslab pa dang / don man ngag gis bsgrub par bslab pa dang /102—47

mdo gcig tu bsdu bar bslab pa'o/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ yon tan gyi che ba sbom ①par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di la bslab par bya ste / gang zhe na/ che ba nyi shu dang / rol pa nyi shu dang / cho 'phrul nyi shu dang ske/ sdom pa nyi shu dang / brjid pa chen po nyi shu dang / tog chen po'i nor bu'om/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs 'di lta ste/ rmad du byung ba'i mthu chen po nyi shu thob par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di la bslab par bya ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ 'jig rten chen po drug 'phang bar 'dod pa dang / chu'i phung po chen po rngubs te bskam ②par 'dod pa dang / rlung gi bskal pa bcing bar 'dod pa dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bum dgye bar 'dod pa dang /bsreg ri7pa'i bskal pa chen po gsum gzhil bar 'dod pa dang / nam mkha' thams cad ba spu gcig gis dgang bar 'dod pa dang / ba spu gcig las sangs rgyas bye ba dgye bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas bye ba ba spu gcig gi nang du shong bar 'dod pa dang / 'khor ba thams cad ba spu gcig tu rngub par 'dod pa dang / ba spu gcig gis 'khor ba thams cad la khyab par 'dod pa dang / bskal pa'i 'khor lo chen po ring du bsrub ④par 'dod pa dang / thung du bsrub (33par 'dod pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo chen po mnyam par bskor bar 'dod pa dang / 'khrug par bskor bar 'dod pa dang / las kyi 'khor lo chen po rgyun du bskor bar 'dod pa dang / rgyun gcad 6)par 'dod pa dang /srid pa'i 'khor lo bzlog (77par 'dod pa dang / lugs su bskor bar 'dod pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo chen po rgyun gcad par 'dod pa dang /dmyal ba'i 'khor lo chen po dong sprugs sgyu par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di la bslab 102—48

par bya'o/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ rnal 'byor rtog pa'i ri bo brgyad cu ①tsa gcig gzhil par 'dod pas kyang lam 'di la bslab par bya ste/ dngos gzhi'i ⑤rtog pa dgu dang / mtshan ma'i nirtog pa dgu dang —/ rtags ④kyi rtog pa dgu dang / rkyen gyi rtog pa dgu dang / las kyi rtog pa dgu dang / spyod pa'i rtog pa dgu dang / bskyod ⑤pa'i rtog pa dgu dang ske/ zhen pa'i rtog pa dgu dang / mngon par rtog pa dgu'o/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ ltung ba'i sgo dgu shes pas kyang lam 'di la bslab ⑥par bya ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ bdud chen po'i ris su ltung ba'i sgo dang / mu stegs kyi khams su ltung ba'i sgo dang / srin po'i khams su ltung ba'i sgo dang / gnod sbyin gyi ris su ltung ba'i sgo dang / ru dra chachen por ltung ba'i sgo dang / bgegs chen por ltung ba'i sgo dang / lha chen po'i ris su ltung ba'i sgo dang / sho gam gcan chen gyi ris su ltung ba'i sgo dang / dmyal ba chen por ltung ba'i sgo'o/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs gzhan yang 'di lta ste/lam 'di shes par 'dod na sangs rgyas kyi chos shes par bya'o/ / ci lta ci (sheltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni rtag par yang blta'o/ /chad par yang lta'opon/ /skye bar snang ngo / /dmigs par yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di ni 'dod chags dang bcas pa'o/ /zhe sdang dang bcas pa'o/ /gti mug dang bcas pa'o / /nga rgyal dang bcas pa'o/ /phrag dog dang bcas pa'o/ mtshams med pa lnga dang bcas pa'o/ /de dang nye ba lnga dang bcas pa'o/ /lci ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /log pa brgyad dang yang bcas pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs 'di lta ste/ srog gcod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /ma byin par len pa 102—49

dang bcas pa'o/ /'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang bcas pa'o/ /brdzun ①dang bcas pa'o/ /phra ma dang bcas pa'o/ /ngag rtsub mo dang bcas pa'o/ /tshig khyal pa dang bcas pa'o/ /brnab sems dang bcas pa'o/ /gnod sems dang bcas pa'o/ /log par lta ba dang bcas pa'o/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs de bas na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos de rnams la spyod par 'dod pas lam 'di la bslab par bya'o/ /shes par bya'o/ /goms par bya'o/ /klong du gyur par gyis shig ces sems dpa' rdo rje dam pas gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi na/rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rnal 'byor rang bzhin gyi le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas 'khor der 'dus par gyur pa'i 'dus pa phal mo (5)che'i tshogs kyis rmad byung gi phyag rnal 'byor lugs su byas nas/ sems dpa' rdo rje dam pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems dpa' chen po smra ba'i seṅge khyod la bdag cag shin tu zhu bar spobs na gnang stiba'i skabs dbye bar gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / smra ba'i seṅge des 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs ji ltar zhu ba'i don gnang gis 9bkun du spobs pa skyed la zhu ba'i don gsol cig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs kyis a la la ho 96zhes gsol to/ /smra ba'i seṅge chen po khyod kyis rgya cher bshad pa'i rnal 'byor rang bzhin chen po'i don gyi rjes su bdag cag 'jug par 'tshal na/ 'di la 'jug pa'i sgo du mchis/ thabs ji ltar lags/ lam gang ltar bde/ sems dpa' chen po 'di'i don rgya cher bshad du gsol/ de 102—50

skad ces gsol pa dang / smra ba'i seṅges bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag legs so shin tu legs so/ /nges par legs so/ /khyed kyis zhus pa'i don 'di rnams ngo mtshar 6)che ste/ chos thams cad la ②'jug pa'i sgo gsal zhing rgya che bar ③byed de/ rna ④stogs (snyel gus par nyon cig gsal bar bshad par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor gyi nang du seṅge'i gsung sgra yis 6)chos rnams kyi sgo 'byed pa 'di ⑦gsal bar bshad par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi sgo mo 'di/ /grangs mang bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /mdo ru bsdus na gsum du gsal/ /rtsol bas 'jug pa'i sgo mo dang / /grub pa thabs kyi sgo mo dang / /mthar phyin 'bras bu'i sgo mo'o⑧/ /dang po la yang gsum yod de/ /mtshan nyid thabs kyi sgo mo dang / /thub pa dzi)rigs kyi 'jug sgo dang / /grub pa lung gi gsang sgo'o/ /de dag sgo mo re re la'ang / /gsum gsum yod par 'dren pas bshad/ /gnyis pa'i sgo la'ang gsum yod de/ /shes rab rtogs pa'i sgo mo dang / /ting 'dzin goms pa'i sgo mo dang / /smon lam grub pa'i sgo mor gsal/ /tha ma mthar phyin sgo mo la/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgo zhes 7bshad/ /'jug pa'i lam la'ang 'di lta ste/ /dam pa gsum du gsal bar bshad/ /'dren pa chen po'i sde snod dang ske/ /thub pa chen po'i 'jug sgo dang / /dam pa chen po'i mdzod gsum mo/ /'jug pa'i thabs kyang 'di lta ste/ /thabs las thabs byung thabs gsum ste/ /don dang yi ge ting 'dzin gyis/ /rjes su gang gis brtag 41byas na/she/ /'jug pa'i thabs kyi dam pa'o/ /don gyi rjes su 'jug pa yang / /don ni chos nyid snying po la/ /rjes su 'jug pa'i sems yin te/ /sems nyid chos la sbyor ba'i skabs / /rnam pa bcu zhes 'dren pas bshad/ /bcu nyid gang dang gang zhe yi 102—51

na / /'dun pa skye ba'i gnas skabs dang / /rtsol ba 6)sbyor ba'i gnas skabs dang ske/ /bslab la (mi'ajug pa'i gnas skabs dang / /'du shes 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs dang / /sbyor chen la 'jug gnas skabs dang / / ro nyid tshor ba'i gnas skabs dang / /( )yul la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs dang / /rtog chen nyid la phebs skabs dang / /de nyid gdeng ④du gyur pa'i skabs/ /las su rung ba'i skabs dang bcu/ /bcu po de dag re re yi/ /skabs su sems dang chos phrad pas/ /rig pa byang chub sems re 'byung / /byang chub sems ni gang zhe na/ /'di yi grangs kyang rnam pa bcu/ /g.yo ba byang chub sems nyid dang / /de bzhin smon pa byang chub sems/ /ldang ba byang chub chen po'i sems de bzhin sbyor ba byang chub sems/ /'jug pa'i sems dang dge ba'i sems/ /mi 'gyur ba dang rig pa dang / /gnas pa dang ni rdzogs pa'o/ /byang chub sems zhes ris1grags pas na/ /sems bcu chu)dag tu rgyal bas (7bshad/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin de/ /skabs bcu (8)dag tu sbyor bas na/ / gzugs brnyan chos nyid ngo la snang / /yo)gzugs brnyan rang bzhin ci ⑩ltar snang / /phra mo tsam gyi skar ma dang / /de bzhin skar ma tha mal pa/ /skar ma chen po dag dang ni/ /zla ba tshes gcig rnam pa dang / /gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga / /brgyad dang bcu drug rnam pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan dag tu snang ba ste/ /dngos por snang ba cang ma yin/ /chu zla lta bur gzung du med/ /sems kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba dang / /chos nyid gsal ba'i nyi ma gnyis/ /yul dang dbang po'i tshul lta bur/ /dbyings dang ye shes rang bzhin gsal/ /'di ni rnal 'byor sbyor ba'i lam/ /bgrod par byed pa'i thabs chen yin/ /lam 'di 102—52

goms par bslab ①bya na/ /rnal 'byor bslab ②par bya ba'i mtha'/ /gnas bcu dag kyang 'di lta ste/ /ji ltar sa gzhi gshin ①pa la/ /brten nas sa bon btab pa las/ /'bras bur smin par gyur pa yis/ /'tsho bar byed pa'i srog 'dzin ltar/ /chos nyid kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i/ /dam tshig 'di la brten nas ni/ /dngos grub lo tog ④min pa yis/ /dge ba'i srog 'dzin dam pa'o/ /bslab pa 'di yi dam tshig ste/ /bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin du/ /goms par bya ba rab tu gces/ /ji ltar cang shes kyi ling dag /sdom byed sgrog gis bcings gyur pa(snye/ /bgrol byas bde blag ⑥byang 'gyur na/ /ci la'ang thogs med 'gro ba ltar/ /sems kyi cang shes dbang po 'di/ /mi shes bcings pas ⑦bcings gyur pa(kye/ /rnam grol thos pa'i sgo mo yis/ /shes rgyud kun grol thogs med 'gro/ /'di ni mi shes rgyud (9)'grol ba'i/ /bcing bar bya ba 'gro ba ste/ /rgyud nas dgrol ba'i bslab pa ru/ /goms par bya ba rab tu gces / /ji ltar ri mthon 7rtse mo la/ /sgyid mi lug par brtson (me'adzegs na/ /mtho sar phyin cing rtse non pas/ /yul khams rtogs shing lam la mkhas/ /de bzhin shes rab mthon ri la/ /skyid mi lug par mnyan bsams na/ /kun gyi phul du shes rab phyin/ /mkhas pa'i ye shes tshad med do/ /don la mkhas par bya ba de( / /phul du dbyung ba'i bslab pa ste/ /shes rab chen po 'di dag la/ /goms par bya ba rab tu gces/ /dper na bung ba khung tshol ba/ /(kun du 'jug cing byung nas ni/ /rang gi 'dzul khung gang yin par/ /nges par 'jug cir 4steganas pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor don gyi rjes tshol ba/ /spyod sgo ci yo da bstun te bsdu/ /lta sgor 'jug cing brtags skebasdur na/ /ma nor nges 102—53

pa'i dbu ma la/ /chos nyid don gyi rjes gcad 0)phyir/ /sgo mo kun nas bsdur ba yi/ /bslab par bya ba'i mtha' yin te/ /goms par bya ba rab tu gces/ /ji ltar ②rgyal rigs rgyud byung ba/ /mang po'i dbang por dpon bstabs te/ /'khor lo la sogs rin chen gyis/ /kun la dbang sgyur ①thob pa ltar/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rgyud byung ba/ /chos kyi dbang por dpon bstabs te/ /phyag rgya la sogs rtags chen gagyis/ /rim par kun gyi thog mar 'gro/ /'di ni dbang gi khyab (5)par te/ /sa la rim par 'byung ba yi4)/ /rtsal gyis bgrod cing bslab pa'i mtha'/ /goms (7)par bya ba rab tu gces/ /ji ltar glang po chur 'jug pa/ /tsham tshom chags thogs yod med par/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod brod tshul gyis/ /mi ldog pha rol phyin pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor nges par spyod pa'i blo / /brtul zhugs rgya mtsho'i chur 'jug pa/ /rtsal chen spyod pa'i brod tshul gyis / /chags thogs med par 98)dor ba'o/ /bslab par bya ba'i mtha' yin no//spyod pa'i bslab pa dam pa ni/ /goms par bya ba rab tu gces/ /ji ltar khyung chen mkha' lding ba/ /gshog (9)pa'i rtsal gyis nam 'phang gcod⑩/ /ngam grog chu klung mtha' yas kyang / /gshog rlabs 'og tu kun chud ltar/ /rnal 'byor mnyam nyid mkhar lding ba/ /theg pa'i spyod sgo mtha' yas kyang / /mnyam pa chen po'i 11don gyis ni/ /lta 'phang rlabs kyis thag gcad 6)pa'o/ /'di ni re dang dogs pa yi/ /the tshom 1 gcod pa'i lta ba ste/ /don la sems kyis blta rmub ste/ /bslab pa 'di dag goms pa gces/ /dper na rgya mtshor 7nor len mi / /sbrul dang chu srin sbrang ma las7/ /sogs pa gdug pa'i sdug bsngal kun/ /dka' ba nyams su blangs nas 'grubanya 4/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor bde tshol ba/ /102—54

rnam rtog bying rmugs phyar g.yeng ①dgra/ /gzhom par dka' ba'i las 'di dag /nyams su blangs na bde thob rnyed/ /'di ni ting 'dzin dam pa yi/ /nyams su blangs pa'i bslab pa ste/ /sems kyi ②goms par bya ba'i las/ /'dris par bya ba rab tu gces/ /ji ltar mun pa dug dang rdzas/ /sman snang gser du bsgyur bas na/ /'gyur rtsi niman ngag med pa'i mis/ /dka' ba'i las chen sna tshogs pas/ /sdug bsngal spyad kyang mi 'grub ④ste/ /su zhig man ngag ldan pa'i mis/ /tshegs med gyi na'i tshul gyis na⑤/ /bsgyur bas sman snang gser 'gyur ltar/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i don sgrub pa/ /kun gzhi gnas 'gyur man ngag dang / /gang dag mi ldan pas kyang ni/ /dka' ba spyad kyang 'grub pa min/ /sems kyi gsang 'di sus mthong ba/ /de dag man ngag ldan pa ste/ /'dod pa'i don mchog gang yin pa/ /de dag tshegs med gyi nas 'grub / /don rnams sgrub par gang byed pa/ /man ngag can gyis 'grub pa'i phyir / /don rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba yi/ /bslab pa 'di dag rab tu gces / /dper na kun du rgyu ba'i mi/ /'dod pa'i yul du 'gro byed na/ /yul gyi rnam pa mtha' yas kyang / /bgrod pa'i lam gnas gcig las med/ /de bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos bstan (6༄kyang / /bkri zhing drang ba'i tshig yin te/ /bsam pa'i yul ni gcig pa'o/ /don rnams gcig tu sdud pa yi/ /bslab par bya ba dam pa ste/ /nges par gcig las med pa'i phyir/ /'di dag goms par bya ba yin/ /bslab pa 'di la goms gyur na/ /lobs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas te/ /lobs pas lam la mkhas par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi yon tan chen po yang / /rmad du byung ba thob 102—55

par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags chen po'i khyad par ni/ /thams cad thams cad bya'o cog /byin gyi rlabs 0)kyi spyod pa'am/ /dbang sgyur thabs kyi spyod pa ste/ /dper na nam mkha' (mirgya mtsho 'am/ /ji ltar me dpung rgyal po 'dra/ /de yang de yul che chung gi / /khyad par nyid kyis brlabs pa yinaX/ /rgyal po de yang khyad par gyis/ /dbang sgyur bya ba'i khams rnams la/ /che chung rim pa yod pa yin⑤la/ /rnal 'byor sngags tshul de ltar snang / /thabs chen spyod la 'jug pa yang / /bab chod thad du 'jug pa ste/ /dper na glang chen chur 'jug pa/ /rab dang glang nechen bab mi bab/ /de yang rtsal sgyid ⑦drag zhan gyis/ /la la thad du gcod pa la/ /la la bsogs su 'gro ba yin/ /la la chung zhig bshad ⑧thabs 'gro/ /de ltar rnal 'byor rgyu nyid na/ /'bras bu'i don la bab chod kyang / /rtsal 'phang mtho dman 6)khyad par gyis/ /ji ltar nus tshad der snang phyir / /sa dang gnas skabs ye shes dang / /sgrib dang gol sa rtog pa dang / /spyod dang dam tshig ting 'dzin dang / /dus dang dngos grub mthar phyin dang / /lta ba'i khyad par gnas gyur rnams/ /thams cad gcig las med na 7yang / /grangs dang dbye ba'i bye brag rnams/ /snod kyi rtsal dang sbyar nas ni/ /chos rnams kun gzhir gcig pa la/ /kun gzhi gnas 'gyur rnam pa lngas/ /bye brag lam gyi chos su snang / /gzhi nyid rgyu yi kun gzhi dang / /sbyor ba 'dun pa'i kun gzhi dang / /snang ba don gyi kun gzhi dang / /'gyur ba med pa'i kun gzhi dang / /btsal 41med gnas pa'i kun gzhi lnga/ /skabs lnga dag tu gnas 'gyur bas/ /sa yi khyad par bgrod pa yin ste/ /de yang gnyis kyi chos 'di dag /kun kyang yongs kyis tsho rnal 'byor dang / /'gro don gsum gyis 102—56

'gro ba ste/ /dge don dang ni sgrub pa po/ /rig 'dzin zhes ni rdzogs pa yin/ /des na rtsal gyi lakhyad par gyis/ /dang po las kyi rnal 'byor la②/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor chung ngu rnams/ /rang rang rtsa ba bor nas ni/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor la / /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i tshul/ /spyod par byed dang don 'dod pa/ /sbal bus mkha' lding las spyad kyang / /btsal rtsiba'i yul ni chad pa yin/ /nor bu las kyis 'phang rjodams pa/ /rang skal 'tsho ba'i ched bor nas/ /rgyal po thabs kyis 'phang mtho ba'i/ /longs spyod che la dmigs bcas kyang / /de dag mi 'thob 'tsho bral bzhin/ /skal ༅ldan can gyi don 'di dag /skal zhan dag gis 'grub par dka'o( )/ /sna tshogs gter gyi khang pa dag /rgyal po'i mdzod du gyur pas na/ /spyod sgo 'jug pa thams cad kyang ske/ /dka' thub phyi nang khyad par gyis/ /rin chen sna dgu'i rim ⑧pa dag /so so'i las thabs mtho 6)dman gyis/ /yul de gcig las 0med na yang / /yig tshang sgo dgu 0so sor spyod7/ /rgyal por gyur na 8de kun la/ /dbang sgyur byed pa'i bdag po yin/ /mi gnas chos kyi dbyings nyid dag /blta ba'i yul du gyur pa na/ /rig pa rtsal gyi khyad par gyis/ /blta yul gcig las med na yang / /so so yi'ajug sgo kun nas spyod/ /dbyings kyi rang bzhin gcig pa la/ /rtsal 'phang mtho snyidaman khyad par gyis/ /skas kyi gdang tsobu rtsi ba ltar/ /sa dang theg pa'i khyad par du/ /mtho tsodaman rim par snang ba yin/ /mnyam par gyur pa'i gzhi gcig la/ /mthun (shedang mi mthun (mdon gyis ni/ /dper na khang pa sgo mangs zhu )bzhin/ /sa dang theg pa so so'i sgo/ /mi mthun (nyaso sor snang ba yin/ /so so'i theg pa'i sgo rnams la/ /'jug pa la sogs ma 102—57

sbyangs kyang / /kun gyi rtsa ba 'dir bcad 6)pas/ /gcig ste ②tha dad yongs kyis med/ /de ni ri dang lhun po 'am/ /kun du rgyu dang gzhon nu ltar/ /mthong thos ston pa'i khyad par ni/ /don gyis de ltar yod pa yin/ /des na chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba'i (7sems 'di yin pas na/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dpes mtshon te/ /kun gyi rtsa ba shes par bya/ /'di ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lam gyi thabs la mkhas pa ste/ /lam stor lam btsal lam rnyed pas / /nye lam bde rnyed grub pa'o/ /rnyed pa'i lam nyid gang zhe na/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa yin te/ /sa bcu rim gyis ④bgrod pa'i phyir/ /sa yi khyad par bshad par bya/ /'di yi gnas 'dzin spyod pa'i sa/ /rnam pa bcu phrag gcig gis rdzogs/ /'gyur dbang ma nges sa 'di la/ /bcos ma phra (5)men spyod pa dang / /tshul rtags 'dzin dang mos pa dang / /dge la 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor lnga/ /'jug ldog ltung dang bcas pa yis/ /kun du 'khor zhing ma nges pa'o / /'dun pa sems pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas shing spyod pa'i sa zhes bya/ /bsten pa gzhi yi sa 'di la/ /dang po (6)las can rnal 'byor dang / /bslab pa sbyong dang nges pa la/ /dag dang ma dag gis spyod pa'o/ /bka' stisdod las kyi dang po pa/ /gnas shing spyod pa'i sa zhes bshad/ /gal chen spyod pa'i (8)sa 'di la/ /gnas shing spyod pa'i sa yin te/ /rigs chen 'byed pa'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams kun/ /gcod sbyong sbyor ba'i tshul nyid kyis/ /legs nyes stobs chen byed pa'o/ /bslab pa rgyun gyi sa 'di la/ /g.yo dang thob dang brtan pa'i drod/ /de bzhin rtags chen g.yo ba dang / /thob pa nyid dang brtan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa drug po dag /bslab pa'i 102—58

gnas bcu mthar 'byin cing / /ji ltar zla ba yar tu)gsal bzhin/ /bslab pa'i ye shes 'phel 'gyur te/ /don la mi skrag ngo mtshar skye/ /dpyod sems 'jug pa'i shes pa des/ /ngan song mi ldog chadagon par 'jug /bar chad dag kyang de la byung / /gsang sgo lung gi rnal 'byor dang / /spyod pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang / /mtshan ma rtags kyi rnal 'byor gsum/ /gnas shing spyod pa'i sa zhes bshad/ /bsod nams gter gyi sa 'di la/ /spyod pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyid/ /mos pa dag cing 'dun pa'i gnas/ /rtsal (bcan blo yi bsti gnas sa/ /bslab pa'i mtha' bcu spyir chib pa'o/ /bsten pas khyad ④par 'gro 'di la/ /dbugs chen phyin pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /rigs chen 'dzin dang mnyam rdzogs che/ /nges par spyod dang rtsal chen sbyong / /yul la 'jug dang rig par sbyor/ /bdun nyid rdzogs par 'gro ba ste/ /bslab pa'i rgyu 'bras 'di bcu la(5)/ /goms par byed pa'i tshul du sbyor/ /ngal bso 4)ba la thams cad mthong / /mi ldog sa la goms byar (7)med/ /'di dag sbyor ba gzhi gcig kyang / /so so thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sgrib (khul sa zhes rtsi byed cing / /ye shes re re 'char ba'o/ /des na bslab pa'i mtha' gcig la/ /mi ldog la sogs rdzogs chen rnams/ /mnyam pa la bzhag (9)re re la/ /ye shes re re 'char ba ste/ /tha ma rang byung nyid kyis rdzogs/ /mthar phyin pa dang thob pa dang / /mi ldog rnams la rim pa bzhin/ /rmi lam dag dang sgra brnyan dang / /mngon sum nges pa ci rigs par / /rnal 'byor rdo rje gral sko (11ba/ /rdo rje rdo rje che ge mo/ /zhes ni nyid dang sa khams dang / /zhing khams kun du bsgrags byas nas/ /rnal 'byor lung rab ston pa'o/ /dmigs pa'i yi 'bras bu skye 'di 102—59

la / /grub pa'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /nges par 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor gsum / /rgyal ba'i thugs las rgyal skyes shing / /rgyal ba'i sras po gdung 'tshob pa/ /khyad par rtsal 'phang kun rdzogs shing / /ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba'o / /gnas pas mi 'gyur sa 'di la/ /tshogs chen 'dus dang rtsal chen rdzogs / /gsum du rdzogs par shes bya ste/ /phyag rgya chen po sgyu ①ma yin/ /'khor los (7sgyur ba'i rgyal chen po/ /mthong ba'i gnas nas bcu drug pa/ /rdzogs pa'i gnas na longs pa'o/ /bdal ba chos nyid sa 'di la/ /rol pa rgyan ①gyi rnal 'byor dang / /bde ba che dang thig ler rdzogs/ /gsum nyid du ni rdzogs pa la/ /yul don ye shes de sbyar ba/ /shes par byas pas thams cad rdzogs / /sgyu ma'ang sgyu ma yin spyod la/ /rdzogs pa spyir chib sa 'di ni/ /bcu yi tha ma dang po las/ /mthar rdzogs kun gyi thog yin te/ /klong ④yangs nam mkha'i snying po la/ /sprin med nyi ma (5)'bum gyis bdal6)/ /cir snang ci ④yang ma yin pa/ /mi skye mi 'gag ngo bo la/ /ci (7ltar bltas dgu 6)der snang ba/ /theg mchog spyi rgya'i rlabs ⑩kyis bcad/ /de yang lta ba'i khyad par gyis/ /bdag nyid chen po'i rnal 'byor dang / /lhun gyis 9/1grub dang klong yangs chub/ /gsum 7rdzogs rang byung bdal ba'o(nya/ /'di ni rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lam/ /rnal 'byor can gyis bgrod par bya/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams//don gyi rjes ni tshol 'dod na/ /tshig 'ga' thos pa tsam gyis ni/ /chog pa'i 'du shes ma skyed cig /khyed kun rnal 'byor yin mod kyi/ /yang dag don la rnal mi 'byor/ /spyod pa cha)'gyur bar byed mod kyi/ /yang dag don du yong ma gyur / /chags sdang las la zhen mod kyi/ /dam pa'i don la yong ma zhen/ /102—60

longs spyod rgya cher byed mod kyi/ /chos nyid don gyi ro ma 0)tshor/ /bdag med phyogs bral zer mod kyi/ /nyon mongs lnga dang yong ②ma bral/ /brtul zhugs rtog pa choms ①mod kyang / /gzung 'dzin rtog pa yong ma choms④/ /de bas 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /thos pa tshig gi sgron ma yis/ /yang dag don gyi gser btsal na/ /rtogs (5)'dod spre'u 'di bzung tsonas kyang / /rkun mo byi la btags ④byas te/ /gse khung skar khung kun dgag ducing / /khang stong phang phung khyabashig nas ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor ⑩mdzod kha phye na/ /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas yin/ /yang dag don gyi lam tshol na/ /rtog pa'i skyon lnga spang bar bya / /rtog pa rags pa'i ri bo dang / /mtshan ma rgyu ba tshor ba dang / /byung tshor skyon lnga bsal (nyebar bya/ /rtog pa la yang gnyis yod de/ /rags dang phra bar snang ba yin/ /de bzhin mtshan ma che chung gnyis/ /rgyu ba ring po thung ngu gnyisal/ /de bzhin tshor ba gsal mi gsal/ /byung tshor gnyis su snang ba yang /myur ba dang ni bul ba'o/ /'di ni don la sgrib pa yi/ /rtog nyunyepa chen po'i gegs yinyachen yin/ /ci phyir don de mi mthong phyir/ /mun pa dang ni 'khrigs tsopa dang / /kun 'idu 'thibs dang sprin phung dang / /na bun lta bur bsgribs pa yis / /yang dag mi gsal mthong mi 'gyur/ /'di yang bye brag gnyis gnyis te / /mun pa mun nag chen po dang / /kun nas 'thibs pa lta bu dang / /kun du 'khrigs dang bsgribs pa dang / /'thibs pa chen po chung ngu gnyis/ /sprin chen 'thibs dang 'al 'ol dang / /na bun gtams dang ban bun gyis/ /gnas ngan gsum dang mi'i gnas dang / /'dod khams bzhi yi lha gnas dang //gzugs kyi khams dang gzugs med khams/ /nyan thos rang rgyal gnas su 102wa 61

ltung 1/ /ltung bar 'gyur ba'i skyon chen ni/ /mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba rnam drug yin / /rang bzhin yul la g.yeng ba dang / /de bzhin phyi rol g.yeng ba dang / /nang dang namatshan ma'i zhugayeng ba dang / /yid la byed dang gnas ngan len/ /'di dag rab tu bsal gobar bya/ /bsal srinas don la mnyam bzhag cheyi/ /mnyam pa'i don la sgrib pa'i skyon/ /rnam pa lnga 'byung 'di lta ste/ /byung tshor dbang gis g.yeng ba dang / /bying rmugs dbang gis 'thibs pa dang / /'dzin chags dbang gis 'gog pa dang / /ther zug dbang gis rtog pa dang / /phyal ba'i dbang gis med pa ste/ /'di ni mnyam pa'i skyon yin no/ /skyon chen de dag glan pa'i chos/ /sems kyi lon 'di rgyal bas bshad/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rnam par mi rtog don tshol na/ /gcig pu dben pa'i sa bzung ste/ /tshad ma gsum dang ldan pa'i blos/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rjes gcad mo pa/ /yod med sngon thog ga las byung / /brtags pas rtog pa ltas (8)las byung / /rtog pa sgyu 5)mar rab shes na/ /rtog pa'i ri bo zhi bar 'gyur/ /des ni gnas ngan gsum mi ltung / /rtog pa gang las byung zhe na/ /mtshan ma'i chos las byung ba yin/ /mtshan ma 7sgyu mar rab shes na/ /mtshan ma'i (1chos rnams zhi bar 'gyur/ /des ni 'dod khams tha mar min/ /mtshan ma gang las byung zhe na/ /dran pa rgyu ba dag las byung / /dran pa skyon du shes gyur na/ /rgyu ba'i skyon rnams sel bar byed/ /mthu des 'dod khams gnyis par min/ /rgyu ba gang las byung zhe na/ /tshor ba dag las byung ba yin/ /dag cing skye bar bya ba med/ /tshor ba sgyu 12mar shes gyur na/ /skyon gyi tshor ba sel bar byed/ /'dod khams gsum par ltung mi 'gyur/ /tshor ba gang (1 las byung zhe na/ /byung 102—62

tshor phyi nang dag las byung / /dag cing skye bar bya ba med/ /de nyid skyon du shes 'gyur ①na/ /de ltar shes pa'i mthu yis ni/ /'dod khams bzhi par mi ltung ngo / /byung tshor gang las byung zhe na/ /sems kyi chos las byung ba ste/ /sems nyid sgyu ⑧mar rab shes na/ /sems kyi chos rnams zhi bar 'gyur/ /phung po gzugs brnyan 'dra ba la/ /sems nyid smig rgyu lta bu yin/ /yod med gnyis kyi mtha' las grol(kye/ /de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod khams lnga par ltung mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid yod pa'i dngos po 'am/ /med ces bya bar mi lta bar/ /mu stegs can du ltung mi 'gyur/ /bying rmugs can du ma gyur pas / /'du shes med par ltung mi 'gyur/ /'du shes rjes su ma 'brangs par/ /sems can gnas su de mi 'khor/ /kun gzhi'i gi)don la goms pas ni/ /nyan thos gnas su de mi ltung / /stong zhing zhi bar mi byed pas/ /rang rgyal lta bar de mi ltung / /rnam dag stong par mi byed pas/ /byang chub spyod par ltung ma yin / /mnyam nyid stong pa'i don dag la/ /so so tha dad mi 'byed pas/ /sa cayi rim par mi ltung zhing / / rim gyis sbyang (bzhing 'phar (7ba med/ /yang dag don gyi rang bzhin ni/ /ci la mi gnas mi yin (7)cing / /ci yang mi mthong thos pa med/ /cir yang mi byed byed dang bral/ /ci yang thos pa rdul tsam med / /cir yang snang ba med pa de/ /de ni snang ba dam pa yin/ /bsam du med pa'i chos nyid ni/ /bsam du med pas de bzhin gzhag /rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid la/ /sems kyi gyin da (bskad cig mas/ /mi g.yo rgyun tu dran par bya/ /de ltar don la mnyam bzhag na/ /rtags kyi tshor ba 'di ltar 'byung / /drod dang rtags dang cho 'phrul dang / /mngon shes dang ni ye shes 102—63

'byung ske/ /drod ni g.yo dang thob pa dang / /rtags ni byung dang brtan pa dang / /cho 'phrul byung dang rdzogs pa dang / /rig pa phra mo thams cad gsal/ /des ni don rnams rdzogs pa yin/ /dper na mun pa sangs pa dang / /snang ba byung dang nam mkha' dang / /kun du mthong dang thams cad gsal/ /de ltar shes pa'i mthu yis ni/ /bag chags mun pa kun bsal ①te/ /ji ltar rlung gis sprin phyags ②ltar/ /skad cig tsam gyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /sgrib pa'i phung po 'phyag par 'gyur/ /ji ltar mar mes mun bsal srin/ /mun nyid snang bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /skad cig ma yi don rig pas/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i mun pa sel/ /de ltar rig pa'i skyes bu ni/ /don la rig pa'i sgo bye ④zhing / /chos kyi mig dang de ldan pas/ /mthong thos tshig le'u tshig bzhir bsdebs/ /sa pa yin pas don la spyod/ /chos kyi mig dang ma 6)ldan na/ /mu mtha' yas pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ /don gyi tha snyad ci brjod kyang / /nor ma nor gyi don mi dpogs(5)/ /tshig phyir blo 'brangs dmu rgod de/ /bslab ⑦pa'i sa dang lam pa yina'apho/ /tshig don 'bum phrag ci brjod kyang / /gzhan la ston par ma byed cig /bstan na rdo rje bka' rkun de/ /dmyal ba rdo rjer de ltung 'gyur/ /gang dag tshul 'chos (97mkhan dag gi/ /don la blo shed ma bye bar/ /tshig dang yi ges khrid nas ni/ /mi shes bzhin du chos bstan na/ /sems can thams cad srog srogs 7pas/ /mi shes chos ston de bas lci/ /de bas mnyam pa'i don 'di la/ /bstun te cig 17car 'jug shes na/ /bsgom pa'i yun ni ring thung dang / /las 'phro yod dang med pa dang / /nam grub 7snyam pa'i khar ma lus / /mnyam pa'i don la mnyam bzhag 1 na/ /de ma thag tu rig pa 'char/ /102—64

mnyam pa'i don las ma g.yos na/ /gzugs khams gnas su de mi ltung / /mnyam pa nyid la ma chags na/ /gzugs med khams su ltung mi 'gyur/ /mnyam nyid mngon du gyur pas na/ /nyan thos gnas su de mi ltung / /ci yang med pa'i don mthong na/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni de la bya/ /des ni 6)ting 'dzin khyad par 'di/ /rnal 'byor can gyis 'dris par bsgomaphyi/ /thams cad mi rtog skye med cing / /rtog pa'i mtha' spangs nam mkha'i dbyings/ /ji bzhin mi g.yo mnyam pa nyid/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa yul las 'das/ /yul med nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /snying rje chen po'i byang chub sems/ /nyi ma stong gi dkyil 'khor shar/ /mtshan ma'i chos rnams kun la khyab/ /nyi ma 'bar ba snying po las/ /'od zer yig 'bru'i mchog tu gsal/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i yi ge a/ /cir ①yang 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin las/ /sprul pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad 'byung / /de yang rtsal gyi (0khyad par las/ /dbugs kyi yul dang tshor ba dang ske/ /thos dang mthong ba la sogs te/ /sems kyi yul dang nam mkha'i dbyings / /chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas klas par/ /rang bzhin yi ge bsgyur yi ge / /yan lag yi ge so so yi/ /rtsa ba la sogs gzhi gcig bcas/ /'phro 'du tshad kyang phyag rgya yi/ /tshom bu'i grangs kyang de bzhin no/ /'di ni dang po'i 'jug rims te(zhe/ /mthar gyis 'dris shing goms byed pa'o/ /yi ge'i ye shes las skrun (7te/ /don byed pa dang phyag rgyar skyed(7༄/ /rgya mtsho gnon dang nam mkha'i skas/ /rlung bcing ba dang rgyun bzlog dang / /bsreg (shepa'i bskal pa gzhil 6)ba dang / /nyi zla zhon dang 'jig rten 'phang / /sa la 'dzul dang ri rab 'degs/ /stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug tshul dang / /gzhig dang spar 102—65

ba la sogs te/ /bsam bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /goms pa las su rung ba yi / /rnal 'byor rtsal chen sbyong bar (1)zad/ /bzlas pa (mimathar phyin grub pa dang / /bcing pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /bsam pa las su rung ba dang / /don mthong ba dang tshig grub pa/ /bya ba yongs su dag pa dang / /don gcig ⑧yul la so sor snang / /des na ting 'dzin khyad par yang / /dbyings nyid gcig la sgom mod 9gekyi/ /rnal 'byor rtsal gyi khyad par gyis/ /bsam pa'i yul ni sna tshogs te/ /dang po'i sa la gnas pa yi/ /brtsam (5)pa sa kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /'dun pa sems pa'i rnal 'byor las(le/ /sogs pa'i rna 'byor rnam drug po / /shes rab rtsal gyi (8)'phang dmas pas/ /ting 'dzin la yang chung ba ste/ /don la mthong bar mi 'gyur te/ /rang gi kyi)mos pa'i lha sgom yin/ /lha yi sa bon gang yin pa/ /kha dog tshon gyis phye nas ni/ /sna yi dbugs la rgyu byas te/ /dbugs kyi yul du gyur tshad yinyadu/ /zung bsgril phar 'phro (1stegasal ba las / /'phro 'du'i gnas su bskyed lto par bya/ /rang gi chag botshad dang sbyar ba'i / /sku yi khyon yang de tsam mo/ /gnyis pa'i sa la gnas pa yi/ /bka' sdod las kyi rnal 'byor las7/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi po7/ /ting 'dzin rtsal gyi khyad par ni/ /sa bon rang bzhin yi ge la/ /'od zer 'bar bar bcas pa de/ /dri byung (1 yul ni tshun chad du/ /'phro 'du gsal bar bskyed pa las/ /rang gi chag tshad gnyis bsgyur ba'i/ /sku yi khyon yang de tsam mo / /gsum pa'i sa la gnas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor lung gi bka' bsgo las1nya/ /sogs pa'i rnal 'byor rnam gsum po19/ /dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin 'di ltar 'dod / /lha yi sa bon gang yin pa/ /rang bzhin yi ger ( 7bsgyur byas te/ /102wa 66

'od zer 'bar dang bcas pa yis0)/ /thos pa'i yul ni tshun chad du/ /'phro 'du gsal bar byas pa las/ /rang gi chag tshad bzhi bsgyur tsam/ /sku yi khyon yang de tsam mo/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rim pa bzhin/ /lha yi khyad par gang yin pa/ /yi ge'i rim pa bzhin byas nas/ /'phro 'du'i tshad kyang de bzhin te//rim pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /'phro 'du gsal bar gyur pa dang / /sems kyi ⑤lcogs tshad tshun chad du/ /sku yi khyon gyi khyad par yang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas 5)klas par④/ /sku yi khyon gyis gang bar bsgom/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /yi ge'i rjes su don dpags na/ /yi shes don rnams ston par 'gyur/ /ci phyir don nyid yi ger snang / /dbyings las a byung a las ni/ /yi ge'i tshogs byung sna tshogs 'phros/ /a (geni rang bzhin yi ge ste/ /rten dang bral bas rgyu rkyen med/ /kun la khyab pas nam mkha' 'dra/ /a ni chos nyid cho 'phrul te/ /chos nyid zab mo'i ngang las ni/ /cho 'phrul yi ge a byung bas/ /as ni chos nyid mtshon par byed/ /a las yig 'bru'i tshogs 'phros te/ /tshig tshogs bstan pa rgya mtshor grags/ /yi ge'i sgra skad kun bzung ste/ /sna tshogs yi ge'i skad du bsgyur/ /yig 'bru 6)yan lag mang po rnams/ /rang bzhin a yi ngang (7)du 'dus/ /thugs kyi klong nas a byung bas / /a yi 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ /mgur gyi gsang bar shar ba las/ /gsung sgra yi ge lngar 'phros pa/ /a/ ka kha ga gha nga / de nas a yi 'od zer de / /ljags kyi zla gam pad+mar tshon)'phros/ /ljags kyi mthil 5)du 'khyil ba las/ /'od zer yig 'bru lngar shar ba/ /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ de nas a yi 'od zer de/ /ljags kyi rtse la 'phros pa las/ /'od zer yig 'bru bcur 1 rishar ba/ /ṭa ṭha ḍa 102—67

sgye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ de nas a yi 'od zer de/ /zhal gyi sgo nas 'phros pa las / /cho 'phrul yi ge lngar shar ba/ /ba pha ba bha ma/ de nas a yi 'od zer de / /phyi rol yul du 'phros pa las/ /cho 'phrul yi ge sna tshogs 'phros/ /ya wa ra la sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ i yī u u e 6)e o au i aḥ/ a las cho 'phrul 'od 'phros pas/ /yi ge'i phreng ba tshogs byung ste/ /yi ge'i ②yan lag ye shes la/ /sangs rgyas sku yi sa bon byung / /dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /sku dang gsung thugs sprul pa'i tshogs/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs mdzes par snang / /des na yi ge'i rang bzhin ni/ /rgyal ba'i sku nyid yin par bshad/ /a ni thugs kyi sa bon te/ /ka la sogs pa dang po lnga/ /mgur gyi gsang ba'i rang bzhin yin/ /gnyis pa tsa 95)la sogs pa lnga/ /zla gam ljags kyi rang bzhin yin/ /gsum pa ṭa la sogs pa bcu/ /ljags kyi rtse mo'i rang bzhin yin/ /bzhi ba pa la sogs pa lnga/ /zhal gyi sgros las byung bar bshad/ /lnga pa ya la sogs pa yi/ /bcu tshan gnyis kyi yi ge dag /sku las 'phros par ④rab tu bshad/ /zhabs kyi 'khor lo'i 'od zer las/ /sgrib pa sreg pa'i yig 'bru ha(5)/ /gsang pa'i mkha' yi 'od zer las/ /cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i yig 'bru k+ṣa/ /sku yi khrun tshad lte ba las/ /'dod pa 'byung ba'i yig 'bru hwa/ /thugs kur 'khyil pa'i dpal 6be'u las/ /mtshan ma dag pa'i yig 'bru sha /phyag gi 'khor lo'i 'od zer las/ /cho 'phrul ston pa'i yig 'bru shu/ /skyes bu chen po'i dpung pa las//rtog pa 'joms pa'i yig 'bru la/ /skyes bu chen po'i sta zur las/ /'dod chags sreg pa'i yi ge ra/ /skyes bu chen po'i dku 97skabs las/ /gti mug sel ba'i yi ge wa/ /skyes bu chen po'i byin pa las/ /'khor ba gnon pa'i yig 1(32—68

'bru yasti/ /skyes bu chen po'i spyan gnyis las/ /rang bzhin yi ge i gnyis shar / /skyes bu chen po'i snyan gnyis las/ /rang bzhin yi ge u gnyis shar/ /skyes bu chen po'i shangs ②gnyis las/ /rang bzhin yi ge e gnyis shar/ /skyes bu chen po'i tshems gnyis las/ /rang bzhin yi ge o gnyis shar/ /skyes bu chen po'i spyi gtsug nas/ /rgyal ba'i gas bon i du shar/ /des na yig 'bru'i yan lag kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs/ /oṃ ni sku yi rang bzhin te / /āḥni thugs kyi mtshan nyid do/ /yi ge'i phreng ba mang po kun/ /gsung brjod gsung gi rang bzhin no/ /āḥbyani chos sku'i rang bzhin te/ /oṃ ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /yig 'bru 'bar ba'i phreng ba rnams/ /sprul pa 'dren pa'i sku zhes bshad/ /a ni chos kyi dbyings yin te/ /oṃ ni rig pa'i ye shes yin/ /yig 'bru 'bar ba'i phreng ba rnams/ /chos dang chos nyid rang bzhin yin/ /a ni brjod pa'i rgyu yin te/ /oṃ ni tshig tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyu / /tshig gi tshogs nyid yi ge yin/ /yi ge ring ba'i tshig gi mdzod/ /yi ge 'od zer 'bar 'phros pas/ /chos dang chos ma yin pa rnams/ /ngag gi dbang po kha phye ste/ /don dang tshig tu rgyas (7par 'gyur/ /sgra skad kun gyis bsdus 6)pa'i tshogs/ /yig 'bru phreng ba'i ngang du rdzogs/ /tshig dang yig 'bru thams cad kun/ /oṃ gyi rang bzhin ngang du rdzogs/ /oṃ gyi cho 'phrul thams cad kun/ /a yi rang bzhin dbyings su zhi( nye/ /a ni gig 'bru kun gyi gter/ /a nyid (8)chos kyi dbyings su thim/ /des na rgyal ba sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje de/ /'dul ba'i dbang gi (9)khyad par gyis/ /cir yang 'gyur ⑩zhing cir yang snang / /sa dang nam mkha' me dang rlung / /chu la sogs 102—69

pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /'dul ba'i 'gro ba de rnams la/ /sa dang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i/ /chu dang rlung gi zhi ngo bor snang / /gang dag sku yis 'dul ba'i tshe / /sku dang gzugs brnyan ring bsrel dang / /rten la sogs pa tha dad par//'jig rten kun du ston par 'gyur/ /gsung gis 'dul ba'i dus byung na/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu lasal/ /sogs pa'i ①sgra skad sna tshogs dang / /yi ge'i gzugs su bstan nas ni/ /'khor ba'i khams su snang bar byed/ /ci'i phyir zhe na yi ge ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin te/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin yin pas na/ /thabs kyi bye brag sna tshogs kyis/ /thams cad grol bar mdzad pa'o/ /de bzhin yi ge'i tshogs 'di yang / /yan lag sbyor sdud sna tshogs kyis/ /thams cad tshig tu go bar byed/ /yi ge rang bzhin ye shes ni/ /so so'i don rnams bshad par bya/ /a ni ma skyes ye shes yin/ /rang bzhin (4)thams cad stong bar ston/ /ka ni bya ba'i ye shes te5/ /lam gyis thams cad grol bar ston/ /kha ni khyab par byed pa'i sgo/ /mi dmigs thams cad grol bar ston/ /ga ni don du gyur pa'i 6)sgo/ /yul med thams cad grol bar ston/ /gha ni gnas pa'i sgo yin te/ /gcig tu ma nges grol bar ston/ /nga ni 'dzin pa med pa'i sgo/ /'dzin bral thams cad grol bar ston/ /tsa ni 'gag pa med pa'i sgo/ /cir yang snang bas thams cad grol / /tsha ni 'da' ba med pa'i sgo/ /'bral ba med pas thams cad grol(5)/ /dza ni ma byung ba yi 9sgo/ /mi gnas pas ni thams cad grol/ /dzha ni rtog ma bral ba'i sgo/ /dri ma dag pas thams cad grol/ /nya (7ni spyod dang bral ba'i sgo//bya ba med pas thams cad grol/ /ṭa ni nga rgyal med pa'i sgo/ /ri bo med pas 102—70

thams cad grol/ /ṭha ni sgyu rtsal med pa'i sgo/ /byed pa med pas thams cad grol / /ḍa ni 'dres pa med pa'i sgo/ /rtsod pa med pas thams cad grol/ /sto ni slu ba med pa'i sgo/ /sgyu ma thams cad grol bar byed/ /ṇa ni yul dang bral ba'i sgo/ /'dzin pa med pas thams cad grol/ /ta ni tha snyad 0)med pa'i sgo/ /brjod pa med pas thams cad grol/ /tha ni rten dang bral ba'i sgo/ /gnas pa med pas thams cad grol/ /da ni gtong (gedang bral ba'i sgo/ /len pa med pas thams cad grol/ /dha ni rang bzhin med pa'i sgo/ /mtshan nyid med pas thams cad grol/ /na ni yul dang bral ba'i sgo/ /'dzin pa med pas thams cad grol/ /pa ni nges par 'byung ba'i sgo/ /'gag pa med pas thams cad grol / /pha ni dngos po med pa'i sgo/ /ci yang med pas thams cad grol/ /ba ni brjod pa med pa'i sgo/ /brjod pa med pas thams cad grol/ /bha ni rdul dang bral ba'i sgo/ /rtog pa med pas thams cad grol/ /ma ni chags pa med pa'i sgo/ /rtag ( pa med pas thams cad grol/ /ya ni chags pa med pa'i sgo/ /gos pa med pas thams cad grol/ /wa ni rgyu rkyen med pa'i sgo/ /'bras bu med pas thams cad grol/ /ra ni rkyen dang bral ba'i sgo/ /dor ba med pas thams cad grol/ /la ni blang ri ba med pa'i sgo/ /yon tan med pas thams cad grol/ /sha ni spros pa med pa'i sgo/ /zhi bas thams cad grol bar byed/ /ṣa ni khur dang bral ba'i sgo/ /lci ba med pas thams cad grol/ /sa ni yang dag gsang (5)ba'i sgo/ /nges pas thams cad grol bar byed56)/ /ha ni rgyu dang bral ba'i sgo/ /rkyen dang bral bas grol bar byed/ /a ni khams dang bral ba'i sgo/ /mtshan nyid med pas grol bar byed/ /i ni mthong ba med pa'i sgo/ /gzugs dang 102—71

bral bas thams cad grol/ /u ni thos pa med pa'i sgo/ /sgra dang bral bas thams cad grol/ /e ni tshor ba med pa'i sgo/ /dri dang bral bas grol bar byed / /o ni tshor ba med pa'i sgo/ /reg 6)dang bral bas thams cad grol/ /i ni cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i sgo/ /cir yang snang bas thams cad grol/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba'i chos/ /yod mthong snang grags chos thams cad/ /yi ge'i tshogs su mngon sangs rgyas/ /yi ger ma gyur gang yang med/ /chos nyid snying po'i (minyi ma la/ /'od zer yig 'bru'i tshogs su 'bar/ /chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu la/ /yig 'bru sna tshogs phra bkod pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od zer las/ /'od kyi du'abar ba'i rdo rje 'bar/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi 4)'od 'phros pas/ /rdo rje snying po'i sa bon zhes/ /rdo rje rigs kyi zhing du grags/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer rin chen las/ /yig 'bru 'od kyi swa 'phros pas/ /rin chen snying po'i sa bon zhes/ /rin chen rigs kyi zhing du grags/ /nyi ma pad+mo 'bar 'phros pas/ /cho 'phrul yi ge'i i du 'bar//pad+ma rigs kyi zhing du grags/ /sna tshogs nyi ma'i 'od 'phros pas/ /cho 'phrul yi ge har gsal bas/ /sna tshogs snying po'i sa bon te/ /las kyi rigs kyi zhing du grags/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /thugs ni rdo rje ye shes yin/ /ye shes dam pas sprul pa yi/ /rgyal ba dpag tu med pa la/ /rdo rje rigs zhes ⑤ bya bar bshad/ /yon tan ye shes rin chen yin/ /rin chen de las sprul pa yi / /rgyal ba dpag tu med pa la/ /rin 6)chen rigs zhes (7bya bar bshad/ /gsung gi ye shes pad+ma 587ste/ /pad+ma (9)ye shes las sprul pa'i/ /rgyal ba dpag tu med pa la/ /pad+mo 7rigs kyi zhing du grags/ /phrin yonyalas bya ba sna tshogs te/ /102—72

sna tshogs ye shes sprul pa yi/ /rgyal ba dpag tu med pa la/ /las kyi rigs zhes ①bya bar bshad/ /sku ni ma bcos de bzhin nyid/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes la/ /sprul pa rgyal ba dpag med la/ /de bzhin rigs zhes ②bya bar bshad / /de bas rigs kyi gtan tshigs ni/ /ma bcos sku ni de bzhin nyid/ /mi 'gyur rigs ni rdo rje'i rigs/ /yon tan kun 'byung rin chen rigs/ /chags med gsung gi pad+ma'i ③rigs/ /bya ba byed pa las kyi rigs/ /sku yi sprul pa thams cad ni/ /de bzhin rigs ④kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin/ /thugs las sprul pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin/ /yon tan yul gyi sangs rgyas rnams/ /rin chen rigs kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin/ /gsung las sprul pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /pad+ma rigs kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin/ /mdzad pa sprul pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /phrin (gelas rigs kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin/ /ci phyir rigs zhes 6)bya zhe na/ /dang po de las byung ba dang / /bar du de yi bya ba byed / /tha mar de yi rgyud 97)'dzin phyir/ /de phyir rigs zhes (8)grags pa yin/ /dper na me dang chu dag dang / /nam mkha' dang ni sa dag la/ /gnas pa'i sems can mtha' dag kun/ /gnas rgyun skyunyid kyi ming 'dzin de/ /me 7la gnas pa'i sems can la/ /me yi yi dgas (nyam zhes zer/ /chu la gnas pa'i sems can la/ /chu srin twa ra na zhes zer/ /ci 7phyir lnga zhes bya zhe na/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /sku dang gsung thugs yon tan dang / /mdzad pa phrin ( las nyid dang lnga/ /rig pa lnga dang lnga nyid du/ /thams cad kun tu gsal bar snang / / des na tsolnga zhes nges par bshad/ /ci 7phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kun/ /lnga po de las ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan las byung zhing gzhan na med//102—73

sangs rgyas mtshan 6)gyi khyad par yang / /mtshan med pa las mtshan btags ⑧pa//thams cad lnga po nyid las dzodakyibatags/ /mtshan gyi bye brag thams cad kun/ /tha snyad tsam du gdags par zad/ /rigs med pa las rigs smos pa/ /'dul ba'i dbang du lngar snang yang / /drang 8)ba'i don te (snyedangos gzhi med/ /ci yang med las ci snang ba/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon byung ba 'dra/ /chos kun nam mkha' 'dra ba zhes/ /gsang ba mchog gi bdag pos tshonabashad/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam mnyam pa yin/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /'khor ba med cing chos nyid med/ /dmigs pa med de mi dmigs med/ /de ltar shes pa mkhas pa yin/ /rig dang ma rig tshul gcig ste/ /de ltar shes pa rgyal ba yin / /sems can rang bzhin sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sems can te / /sems can sangs rgyas gcig pa yin/ /de ltar shes pa (8)rgyal ba'i sras/ /byang chub phyir ni gang ma brnyes99)/ /ma brnyes gang yang de ma brnyes / /brnyes pa med pa'i don mthong na/ /de ni brnyes 7pa'i mchog yin no / /gzhan yang 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /lam gyi ngo bo tshol 'dod na/ /lam gyi rtags nyid dpes mtshon te/ /lam gyi don la goms par bya /mi gnas mig ldan sgron ma 11yis/ /lam gyi rgyu la mkhas par bya/ /bag chags rtogs 12pa'i mtshan ma rnams/ /sna tshogs dngos por snang mod kyang / /nam mkha' dag la smig 1 rgyu 'dra/ /de yang gtan tshigs sanges pa yi/ /dpe yis skimatshon te rtogs bya na/ /mkha' la sprin phung 'ja' tshon (tshadang / /char la sogs pa'i rgyun snang yang / /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul gcig tu zad/ /rtag tu de ltar snang ba min/ /dper na sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yang / /slu zhing 'drid pa (1 7102—74

cir snang yang / /sgyu ma'i 'phrul pa snang bar zad/ /rtag ①tu de ltar snang ba min⑤la/ /dper na rdo yi dngos po yang / /sra zhing mkhregs ⑧pa'i dngos po yang ske/ /btags 6)sam phye (de)mar byas nas kyang / /rlung gi mthu (6)yis gtor byas na/ /de la rang bzhin ga la yod/ /dper na me yi rang bzhin dag /tshang tshing sbar sbur kun sreg 9)cing / /'bar 'phro snang gsal mched byed na/ /chu yi mthu yis rlag (8)'gyur na/ /de la rang bzhin ga la yod/ /dper na rdzas kyi dngos po yang / /me yi mthu yis sreg (sheste'agyur na/ /de la rang bzhin ga la yod / /shes pas zin pa'i sems can rnams/ /gzugs dang dran pa sna tshogs kyi / /dbang po la sogs mdzes gyur kyang / /phung po mi rtag shi 'phos na/ /dngos po brtan 7par mi 'gyur te/ /gzugs rnams so sor zhig nas ni/ /rus pa dag kyang mi snang ste/ /zhig dang rul la sogs pa yis/ /tha mar ci yang mi snang 'gyur/ /ri bo chen po la sogs pa/ /dngos po brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten rnams/ /sreg tsho1)pa'i bskal pa la sogs pa/ /bskal pa gsum gyis brlag (the byas na/ /de la rang bzhin ga la / yod/ /des na dngos po'i chos rnams kun/ /dngos por brtags pa ma geyin pasal/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med par shes/ /'di ni rnal 'byor lam gyi mchog /'dus pa'i tshogs rnams goms par gyis/ /zhes sems dpa'i rdo rje smra ba'i seng ges rnal 'byor mchog gi lam gsungs pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po gerdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rnal 'byor rjes su 'jug pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas smra ba'i seng ge sems dpa'i rdo rje de cho 'phrul chen po sna tshogs ston 102—75

pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ting nge 'dzin de'i byin gyi rlabs ①las zhing khams (0thams cad g.yos par gyur te/ don yongs su rdzogs pa'i snga niltas byung bar gyur to/ /'khor der 'dus par gyur pa rnams la la ni nyi zla'i steng na gnas shing chos nyid kyi nam mkha' la lding bar gyur to/ /la la ni ri rab rgyang mar 'phen/ la la ni stong lagasum chen po'i khams 'phen par gyur to/ /la la ni chos nyid bden pa'i don mthong bar gyur to/ /la la ni seng ge'i khri la (ge'adug par gyur to/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje de yicho 'phrul gyi ting nge 7ci'adzin de las bzhengs te/ 'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis shin tu ngo mtshar che bar gyur nas/ sems dpa'i rdo rje de la rnal 'byor gyi (kyiphyag lus kun dus la brdabs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems dpa' chen po cho 'phrul rgya cher gda' ba 'di don ji lta bu lags/ rtags ci 6)lta bu lags/bdag cag rnams la rgya cher bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa las/ smra ba'i seng ge chen pos bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams 'di dag ni don yongs su rdzogs pa'i ltas chen po yin te/ snga ltas kyi mtshan ma 'di dang sbyar na 'dus pa chen po rnams sa nas sar shin tu 'phar zhing yang dag nges pa'i don mthong ba'i snga ltas yin no zhes gsungs pa las/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs kyis gsol pa/sems dpa' chen po sa non pa'i snga ltas ni ji lta bu lags/ don mthong ba'i snga ltas ni ji lta bu lags/ bdag cag rnams la bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa las sems dpa' rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs legs so/ /khyod kyis zhus pa'i don rgya cher bshad par bya'o/ /rna ba lhogs la gus par nyon cig /sgrub pa don gyi rnal 'byor pa7/ /rnal 'byor don la sbyor ba'i tshe/ /102—76

spyad pa'i las kyi khyad par gyis/ /khams dang sa ni gar 'gro ba/ /mdo don tshul lngas lung bstan no/ /nges pa'i snga 6)ltas byung ba yil/ /'bras bu don gyi khyad par yang / /cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston par nus/ /de nas yang dag bden pa 'thob/ /nges pa'i snga ltas rnam pa lnga/ /rgyu yi dus na 'byung ba ni/ /tshig gi brjod pa 'di lta ste/ /blo rtsal las kyi khyad par yang / /snang ba lus kyi snga ltas dang / /ngo mtshar rdzas rnyed tshul rtags dang / /mtshan ma pra yi rmi ltas dang ske/ /'dun pa mang po'i snga ltas kyis/ /'bras bu gang dang gang 'grub pa/ /mtshan ma gsal bar rgyud las 'byung / /dper na me yi snga ltas ni/ /du ba'i mtshan ma rgyas par 'byung ①/ /du ba gar byung gnas de na④/ /me nyid yod par nges pa yin/ /de bzhin chu yi snga ltas kyang (ge/ /rlangs dang sngabs yidang srog chags 'byung / /de na chu nyid yod par nges/ /rlung gi ltas kyang 'di lta ste / /sprin rnams rgyug cing dum bur 'chad/ /des na rlung chen 'byung bar nges / /rtsi mtshal dzu )lo ma gang byung ba/ /de na gser khung yod pa ltar/ /snga ltas mtshan ma 'di dag gis/ /'bras bu mtho (8༄dman gar 'gyur tho)ba/ /rgyu la mkhas par byas nas ni/ /mtshan ma ci byung de la sbyar/ /bar chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyisa'o/ /srog la bab kyang mi blta (1bar/ /rnal 'byor yul la 'jug pa dang / /ting 'dzin rig pa'i rtsal sprugs la(rte/ /gnyen po kun bsten sa sbyangs nas/ /rnal 'byor sa la brtson par bya/ /'dis ni gdon mi za ba dang / /la la the tshom mi skye zhing / /ma nges la zhugs the tshom yonamed/ /dper na 'jig rten byis pa dag / yun rings tsom la skyo snyib ltar/ /snga ltas byung ba'i sgra thos na/ /shin tu brod dzapas mdun bsu ltar/ /ltas chen byung 102—77

ba'i brod tshul gyis3)/ /shin tu brtson pas bde thob 'gyur/ /de bas snga ltas mtshan ma rnams/ /shes nas brtson par 'bad pa'i rigs/ /blo rtsal las kyi khyad par gyis/ /ting 'dzin drod kyi snga ltas 'byung / /yang dag bden pa'i don bstan na/ /mi skrag mi dngang ri dga' ba skye/ /yang dag don la nges bltas na/ /'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skye/ /yang dag don la 'dris pa dang / /rnam grangs chos la dad mi 'gyur/ /yang dag don nyid mthong ba na(5)/ /tshig la dga' ba mi skye nyagazhing / /don nyid nye bar 'dzin par byed/ /don mthong ba dang ye shes skye/ /ye shes skyes par 57gyur pa dang / /dngos por snang ba thams cad kun/ /sgyu ma bzhin du shes par 'gyur/ /sgyu ma tsam du shes pa la/ /brten nas chos nyid don bltas na/ /snang ba med pa'i don nyid ni/ /snang ba med par mthong bar 'gyur/ /snang med srid pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /cho 'phrul rgyu ba thams cad 'byung / /de nyid bden pa'i snga ltas so/ /de nas nyi ma'i 'od zer gyisnyo/ /rdul phran 'dra ba'i mtshan ma 'byung / /de ni g.yo ⑦ba'i snga ltas so//de nas smig rgyu lta bur na'abyung / /dang po'i drod ces bya bar bshad/ /de nas mtsho 99 yi rlabs ltar 'byung / /bar gyi drod ces bya bar bshad/ /de nas rlung chen lta bur yang / /thogs pa med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /tha ma'i drod ces bya bar bshad/ /de nas yig 'bru'i drod spros pas/ /char chen 'bab pa lta bur 'byung / /de ni thob pa'i drod ces bya/ /de nas mkha' la sprin lding ⑩bzhin / /ting 'dzin rtsal 'phang 11mtho bar 'gyur/ /de ni shin tu brtan khri pa'i drod/ /de nas ta la gcig tsam du/ /bdag gi lus ni dbang med par/ /mkha' la 'phar zhing 'phags par rtsol/ /'di ni shin tu gsal ba'i drod/ /102—78

de nas sa chen g.yo ba ltar/ /shin tu yam ①yom mar mer 'byung / /'di ni dang po'i rtags shes (kyebya/ /de nas ting 'dzin rtsal sbyangs na/ /ci ltar dmigs pa der 'grub ste/ /me yi skye mched der bsgoms na/ / me yi charang bzhin nyid du 'gyur/ /chu yi skye mched der bsgoms na/ /chu yi skye mched nyid du 'gyur/ /rlung gi skye mched der bsgoms na/ /rlung gi skye mched nyid du 'gyur / /yig 'bru'i skye mched der bsgoms na/ /yig 'bru gang ④ltar gsal bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rdzas kyi skye mched du/ /gang ltar bsgoms ⑤pa de ltar 'gyur / /de ni rtags chen thob pa yin/ /blo yi ting 'dzin rtsal rdzogs na/ /ngag gi bden pa'i rtsal 'byung ste/ /sreg pa'i me chen mthong ba na/ /zhi bar gyur cig byas pa yis/ /de nyid du ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /chu klung (nyaganod pa'i rgyun byung na/ /chad par gyur cig brjod pa yis/ /de nyid du ni chad 9)par 'gyur / /rlung chen gnod pa'i rgyun byung na/ /zhi bar gyur cig brjod pa yis/ /de nyid du ni chad par 'gyur/ /nad pa'i tshogs ni mthong ba na/ /gang na na ba'i dmigs der ni/ /se (8 gol gtogs pa (95tsam gyis kyang / /nad rnams zhi bar gyur ces skabarjod/ /nad kyi tshogs rnams zhi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin ngag gis brjod byas pa/ /thams cad ma lus grub par 'gyur/ /ngag gi bden pa'i rtsal rdzogs na/ /lus kyi drod la rtsal 'byung ste/ /gnyid kyi rtog pa choms pa dang / /lus kyi bzod pa thob pa ni/ /'di ni dang po'i drod yin no/ / khams kyi khri1zas dang bral ba dang / /mdangs dang dbang po gsal 'gyur banyunye//'di ni gnyis pa'i drod ces bya/ /shing bal lta bur zhi yang ba dang / /khams bde mi bde mi 'byung zhing / /nad kyi tshogs dang bral 'gyur btso/ /'di ni 102—79

drod chen bstan pa yin/ / khams kyi tshizas la ma bsten ②yang / /dbang po gzi mdangs shin tu gsal/ /'di ni ting 'dzin ro tshor rtags / /gzhan yang lus kyi snga ltas ni/ /mnyam pa'i skyil krung dubacas nas ni/ /khru gang tsam du 'phar ba dang / /ta la gang tsam bar du 'gro/ /'di yang ltas phyechen rtags yin no/ /gzhan yang snang 96)ba'i nam mkha' la/ /gom ⑦pas bgrod de 'gro ba dang / /chu la mi 'bying 58)sa la 'dzul/ /me yis mi 'tshig dzi)rlung bcing ba /'di yang snga ltas chen po yin/ /lus kyi bden pa'i rtsal rdzogs na/ /mthu yi rtsal yang 'byung ba ste/ /mthu yi byin brlabs kyibasam mi khyab/ /gal te dgos sam 'dod pa na(1nya/ /sa 'am rdo 'am bye ma dag /gser dang dngul la sogs par sgyurabi/ /skam sa dag tsol chu 'byin cing / /sol ba dag la ljon shing 'byung ske/ /de la sogs pa'i dgos pa rnams/ /ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar 'grub//spyod pa'i mthu dang rtsal rdzogs na/ /'byor pa'i yon tan rdzogs 'gyur te/ /yid du 'ong ba'i nor 'byung zhing / /'dod pa'i bsams 8pa thams cad 'grubaske/ /rdzas kyi mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /ngo mtshar can yang rnyed 8par 'gyur/ /de dag rung ba'i snga ltas so/ /'gro gang 'du ba'i snga ltas kyang / /kun gyis ⑩bkur zhing dga' ba dang / /kun gyi yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /thams cad 'dul zhing thams cad la/ /dbang sgyur byed pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /de dag snga ltas chen po yin/ /mtshan ma pra yi rmi ltas kyang / /shin tu rgya cher 'byung ba ste / /rnal 'byor can gyis shes par gyis/ /bag chags byang ba'i snga ltas kyang //rtag par gcer bur 'byung ba dang / /khrus chen rtag tu byed pa dang / /dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag pa dang / /chu bo dag las nyi 7rgal ba dang / /mtsho chu dag 102wa 80

la rkyal ①ba dang / /char gyi rgyun gyis ②'khru ba dang / /gzhan gyis bum pa gang ba'i chus/ /bdag gi ①lus la sdugs ④pa dang / /me dpung chen pos sreg ⑤pa dang ske/ /shin tu mthon po'i ⑨rtse dag las/ /rlung gis shin tu g.yeng zhing 'thor / /'di dag bag chags byang ba'i ltas/ /'jigs dang bral ba'i snga ltas ni / /g.yul 'gyed pa las slar log dang / /nad las thar te sos pa dang / /btson ⑦ra dag las thar ba dang / /gshed ⑧ma'i lag nas shor ba dang / /gcan gzan ⑨nang nas bros pa dang / /dug nad dag las sos pa dang / /bcings pa dag las grol ba dang / /thag pa bcad par gyur pa rnams/ /mtshan ma bzang po'i snga ltas yin/ /sa rnams thob pa'i snga ltas ni/ /khri rkang dag la ⑩'dzeg pa dang / /phal pa'i skas (nyel 'dzeg pa dang / /ljon shing dag la 'dzeg pa dang / /gyen du shin tu 'gro ba dang / /ri bo'i rtse la 'dzeg pa dang / /rin chen skas la 'dzeg pa dang / /mchod rten dag la 'dzeg pa dang / /nam mkha'i skas la 'dzeg pa rnams/ /'di dag don gyi snga ltas /nyeyin/ /sa rnams non pa'i snga ltas kyang / /khri mthon steng na 'dug tunyepa dang / /glang po che la zhon pa dang / /seng ge dag la zhon pa dang / /khyung chen lding la zhon pa dang / /mchod rten kha la phyin pa dang / /ri bo'i rtse la 'dug pa dang / /nam mkha'i dbyings na 'dug pa dang / /lus las tsosprin phung 'byung ba dang / /zla ba'i steng na 'dug pa dang / /nyi ma'i steng na 'dug pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor sa la gnas pa'i rtags/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi snga ltas lini/ /rgyal po'i bka' la btags yipa dang / /bka' yi dbang por bskos pa dang / /gzhan la dbang sgyur byed pa dang / /'jig rten skos la 'bebs pa dang / /gzhan gyi sde pa 102—81

dbang sdud dang / /g.yul 0)chen dag las rgyal ba dang / /bdag nyid rgyal por gyur pa dang / /mgo la me tog skye ba (7rnams/ /rgyal ba'i (7sras su gyur pa'i ltas/ /chos la dbang thob snga ltas ni/ /glegs bam zab mo rnyed pa dang / /de bzhin 'dri ba mang po dang / /de dag la ni dpyod pa dang / /gzhan la 'chad cing ston pa dang / /don nyid gtan la 'bebs pa dang / /me long dag la lta ba dang / /shel gyi bum pa gang ba la/ /lta (7zhing brtags te 'thung ba dang / /rin chen nor bu thu ba dang / /'khor lo lag tu babs pa dang / /nyi zla lag pas zin pa dang / /ri rab klad la skor (5)ba rnams/ /chos la dbang thob snga ltas so/ /bden pa mthong ba'i snga ltas kyang / /sngon ma mthong gi yul mthong dang / /stong gsum rgya cher mthong ba dang / /gling rnams gzhan du phyin pa dang / /ri rab kha la phyin pa dang / /nam mkha' rgya cher mthong ba dang / /rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin pa dang / /lag na sgron me thogs pa dang / /nyi ma'i snying por phyilta ba dang / /snang srid dpyod pa byed pa rnams/ /chos la dbang thob ltas chen yin/ /lung bstan thob pa'i snga ltas ni(7)/ /rol mo'i sgra rnams thos pa dang / /'brug gi sgra ni grag 4pa dang / /seng ge'i nga ro grag (97pa dang / /chos kyi sgra yi gtam thos dang / /gzugs brnyan zhal ni 'dzum pa dang / /sangs rgyas gsung thos sku mi mthong / /lha mo glu dbyangs sgrogs (1 1pa dang / /gzhal yas dag la sgra 'byung dang / /grogs po grogs po zhes brjod cing / /chos kyi bgro ba byed pa rnams/ /lung bstan 'byung ba'i snga ltas so/ /de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams/ /ltas chen kun du snang ba dang / /gang zag las kyi dang po rnams/ /rig 'dzin so so'i sa pa ni/ /'gyur ba'i snga ltas bshad pa 102—82

yin / /rnal 'byor las kyi dang po la/ /ltas chen 'di dag gang byung yang / /'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi kun bsal nas/ /don la rtogs shing 0)sa rnams sbyong / /des ni don la reg par 'gyur/ /don la rig pa'i byin brlabs (0kyis/ /rig 'dzin rdo rjer lhun gyis grub/ /rig ①'dzin sa la gnas pa dang / /sa la rtsal chen sbyong ba'i tshe/ /rtsal gyi cho ④'phrul sna tshogs 'byung / /nyi zla zhon nas 'gro ba dang / /ri rab rked (5)nas gsor ba dang / /'jig rten rgyang mar 'phang (phyir ba dang / /sreg ⑦pa'i bskal (3)pa gzhil ba la6)/ /sogs pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad kun/ /khyad par rtsal gyis ston par nus/ /de la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul rnams / /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni cho 'phrul yin/ /rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul ni/ /'dul ba'i 'gro ba thams cad la/ /so so'i skad dang chos mthun ⑩par/ /'dul ba'i sgo ni sna tshogs su/ /so so'i skad du ston par nus/ /de dag rjes su bstan pa yin/ /chos kyi sgo rnams snang ba yi/ /nges pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa ni / /ting 'dzin rtsal gyi khyad par gyis/ /'jig rten khams rnams g.yos nas kyang / /thams cad ngo mtshar skye 'gyur te/ /sems kyi bsam pa rangs byas nas / /so so dga' ba'i ro myang /1'gyur/ /chos rnams snang ba'i cho 'phrul yin / /kun nas kun du brjod pa ni/ /gsang ba'i yi ge'i phreng ba las rtsa 'phrul chos kyi sgra sgrogs spyi pas/ /mthong yod snang grags chos rnams kun/ /kun kyang sngags kyi sgrar grag tsho pas/ /sngags su ma gyur gang yang med/ /des na rtsal gyi khyad par lasar+shari/ /sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung / /zhes smra ba'i seng ge chen po sems dpa'i rdo rjes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u ste 102—83

de nas smra ba'i seng ge sems dpa'i rdo rje de ①mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig gsang ba mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs par gyur pa dang / 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor chen po rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /smra ba'i seng ge sems dpa' chen po khyod nyid ni dam tshig chen po'i bdag nyid du bdag cag rnams kyis mthong ngo / /de skad ces gsol pa dang / sems dpa' chen po des bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams chos thams cad kyi srog ni dam tshig yin par shes par gyis shig /de nas 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs kyis ②sems dpa' chen po la 'di skad ces gsol to / /sems dpa' chen po dam tshig mchog gi gsang ba rnams bdag cag rnams thos par 'tshal/ thos nas kyang rtogs par (7'tshal/ rtogs nas kyang de la gnas par 'tshal na/ sems dpa' chen po rgyargya cher bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / sems dpa' chen pos bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs dam tshig rnams 'di lta ste/ shin tu gsang (5)ba'i dam tshig ni/ /snod ma yin par gyur pa las/ /phyi nang gsang ba gsum dag tu/ /sba 95)ba'i thabs su spyad nas kyang / /gsang ba'i chos rnams gsang bar bya/ /bstan (pepa'i gnas min snod ngan dag /rnam pa bzhis bsdus bye brag rnams/ /ma 'ongs rnal 'byor bcud can gyis/ /shes nas spang bar bya phyir bshad/ /'jig rten pa dang theg dman dang / /mu stegs log lta'i lta la dga'/ /dad med blo zhan g.yeng rmugs shing / /bslab nyan mi brtson byol song mtshungs(gyi/ /102wa 84

dad log dam nyams don las gol①/ /byang chub thag ②pa gting nas chad/ /sems kyi myu ②gu'i rtsa tshig pa/ /ngan 'gro'i 'dam du kha sbub yin/ /snod med 4)kha sbub ⑤de dag la/ /gsang ba'i ༅smra bar bya ba min/ /smras na de nyid kha sbub 'gyural/ /gsang ba'i tshig rnams khar smra yang / /gab pa gsang ba'i don mi shes / /skyon can spa los sgrogs ( )rnams la/ /gsang ba'i don rnams lhag par smra / /bsnyen sgrub nigasang ba'i tshig ⑨rnams la/ /sgra la nyan kyang don mi gnyer⑩ / /snying po'i don gsang mi thub pa/ /bcud 7med 'khor bar zag pa yin / /gsang don mi thub snod ngan la/ /gsang ba smra bar gang byed pa/ /de dang snod med snod ngan gnyis/ /'khor ba'i khams su zag 8par mnyam/ /lta dang dam tshig sgrub pa yi/ /dam pa'i mdzod gsum smra shes kyang / /goms pa'i mthu med gnas ma gyur/ /ngan sgyu 8phrag dog ser snas gdungs/ /bya med chos la blo gtod cing / /spyod rtsing dam ral deng limed par/ /rnal 'byor spyod la lta dman zhes/ /zer ba pham 'gyur 'khor bar 'pho/ /snod ngan 'khor bar 'pho yib la/ /gsang ba'i don rnams smra byed pa/ /gsang ba nyams pa'i dbang gis nayi/ /nyams pa de dang de 'drar 'gyur/ /zla ngan nyams sod can lan 'dren / /kha gsag lce gnyis sgyur byed cing / /sems la nyon mongs lnga bcangs te/ /rku dang sgyu spyod brdzun yinal dga'/ /tshe gcig /nyegrags pa ched phyir du()/ /gang zag phyir 'breng ( )tshig 'ga' la/ /mnyan te brjod 'dod tshul 'chos pa/ /log smra dug can tha ram ltung khrin/ /dug can ltung ba'i snod de la / /gsang ba'i dmigs rnams smra ba ni/ /rnal 'byor nyams pa chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i tha mar de ltung 'gyur/ /'di ltar pham 'gyur snod ngan la/ /102—85

gsang ba gsang chen la sogs pa'i/ /don dang rang bzhin gang yin pa/ / bstan kyang 91)pham ltung gegs su 'gyur/ /de bas bstan par bya ba min/ /gal te bstan par gyur na ni/ /ston smra nyan byed de dag rnams/ /mthong yun phung byed gnyis skrag 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor mkhas gsal don ldan la/ /rnal 'byor mi shes gang dag gis/ /dregs pa'i dbang gis (miphrag dog gi/ /sems kyi rnam grangs ci skyed pa/ /de snyed bskal pa'i grangs mnyam par/ /'bras bu mi bzad ⑦myong bar 'gyur/ /gal te las kyi 'phro len na/ /de snyed bskal par gzod 4)'jug dgos/ /mkhas gsal don ldan gyis kyang ni/ /gong ma bzhin du ngan bsams na/ /de yang gnas ngan len pa ste/ /mkhas pa de la skyo mi nus/ /rnal 'byor don ldan tshul mthun (5)la/ /ngan pa'i tshig gis sems dkrugs 96)shing / /sgro skur rku dang brlang btab na/ /dmyal ba rdo rjer de ltung 'gyur / /zhar las byung ba'i rnam smin yang / /ji ltar rgyu mthun (7de 'drar 'gyur / /skal 8ba dman pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rtsa nyams skyon (9)can rang bzhin ni/ /ngan sems khro gtum ldan pa dang / /mi zad phra 7men las spyod byed / /gang dag mi shes ngang tshul can/ /byis pa'i rang bzhin blo zhan pas/ /shin tu dman pa'i lta sems kyis/ /tshul bcos yonyamakhan la bkur bar byed/ /gang dag dam tshig yon tan ldan/ /byams la gnas shing rtag tu bzod/ /tshul shis bodon gyi gzhung rnams srong / /de dag la ni 'dun pa med/ /dam tshig spre'u ltar spyod bzhin du/ /byang chub snying po thob pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang mi 'byung ngo / /'byung bar yang dag ngas ma mthong / /rgyal ba'i sras 12gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /lam ston skyon sel mkhas pa la/ /kha cig dregs 102—86

dang phrag dog gis/ /khro spong thabs kyis 'osmod par byed/ /de ni 'khor ba'i gting rdo ste/ / nams kyang ②thar pa'i khar ①mi 'byung / /mi shes pa yi rnal 'byor pa/ /yang dag don dang ldan pa'i mi/ /rjes su 'gro bar mi byed cing / /longs spyod 'du 'dzi gang ldan pa'i/ /rjes su 'gro zhing de la 'dud/ /de ni log pa'i lam pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ltang ④dang byang chub khe/ /'ban ⑤thag chad par blo mi 'byung / /zang zing nor dang g.yo sprul khe/ /chung yang cis 6)'grub srog dang sdo(pe/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can/ /bum snod nang gi gsal ba ltar/ /shes rab mdzod kyi gter ldan yang / /srog chags rkun mo'i sder mo ltar/ /khong nas gab sbas don ston la/ /blun po rnams kyis cir mi mthong / /dper na 'di 'drar tshul gcig ste/ /lus la gter 'chang mi dang ni/ /blun por gyur pa'i mi dag gnas/ /'grogs kyang gnyis mtshungs khyad med 'dra/ /ting 'dzin bsngags pa rjod gshebyed cing / /ting 'dzin don du gnyer ba med/ /yang dag bsngags pa rjod byed cing / /yang dag don du gnyer ba med/ /dam tshig bsngags pa rjod byed cing / /dam tshig don du gnyer ba med/ /ji ltar 'gro gang la la dag /nor bu rin chen 'di 'dra ste/ /'dod pa'i yon tan kun 'byung zhes/ /rin chen dag gi yon tan brjod/ /de la 'gro gang gzhan dag gis/ /de ltar 'dod pa 'byung gyur na/ /de ltar cung (9)zad yod dam zhes/ /dris kyang med pas slar smras pa/ /gang zhig dgos pa skong ba yi/ /yon tan cung zad smos par zad/ /de nyid bdag la med ces smra / /de bzhin rnal 'byor mi brtson 7pas/ /bslab par bya ba'i chos bral la/ /chos nyid bsngags pa rjod byed kyang / /de dag la ni chos nyid med/ /de las 102—87

spyod pa'i log spyod rnams/ /dam tshig can gyis spang bar bya/ /rnal 'byor chos 'dzin gang dag gis/ /rnal 'byor nyams 'gyur log sred can/ /gsang ba 'jig 0)pa'i dgrar mthong nas/ /de dag sdig pa mthong ba ltar/ /skyod cing chad pas gcod byed pa/ /skyes bu de ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /dper na blon po gang dag gis/ /nyes byas khrims dang 'gal 'gyur ②na/ /'gal bar mi gtong khrims dang sbyor/ /bka' yi yo srong blon po de/ /rgyal po'i thugs 'dzin dam pa zhes/ /kun du rgya cher grags par 'gyur/ /ldum rar dug gi sdong skyes na/ /bdag pos dug tu shes ma thag /rtsad nas phyung ste med par byed/ /ci phyir ldum zas de dag las/ /dug 'phel gyur na 'chi phyir ro/ /de bzhin nyams 'gyur dug can de/ /brtul zhugs can gyi rnal 'byor des/ /gnas sam lo yis 96sgyugs te spang / /gang dag mi spong mgon byed pa/ /de dag gsang ba'i dam sri yin/ /don la rnal 'byor 4)gang zhig gis/ /tha tshig (7zab mor bcas rnams las/ /bsrung tsho ba'i bsam pa mi g.yo bzhin/ /rtsa ba yan lag bcas rnams la/ /gal te ma tshor zhig gyur kyang (7/ /rnam smin yod kyang rtsa mi nyams//ji ltar glang po e ne ya/ /shi nas ro ru gyur mod kyang / /gi (7wang rtsis ni don byed ltar/ /rnal 'byor nyams de phyi)ror gyur yang / /gzhan gyis bkur ba'i gnas yin zhing / /de yi don byed nus pa yin/ /de ltar mod kyang 'di kun rnams / /rmi lam du yang mthong mi bya/ /ci phyir 'o ma nyung ngu zhig /rul bas 'o ma kun rul bzhin/ /rnal 'byor nyams gyur gcig gis ni/ /rnal 'byor can kun ma rung 7'gyur/ /'khor ba'i g.yul rgyal byed pa yi/ /log pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad kun/ /don la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad 102—88

bsgrims te spang bar bya/ /gal te ma spangs log spyad ①na/ /'khor ba'i g.yul ni rgyal 'gyur te/ /bden pa'i byin brlabs ②mthu chung 'gyur/ /kun kyang dge spyad ③don chung zhes/ /yang dag don las yid byung zhing / /log pa'i chos la spro bar byed/ /kun kyang log pa'i las spyad pas/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs 'byung / /des ni sgro skur gnyis su 'gyur/ /bka' yi chad pa gang yin pal/ /ye shes can ④lta rang bzhin gyis/ / nams kyang ⑤gnod pa yong mi mdzad / /de yi 'khor na gnas pa yi/ /gang dag ma rungs mthu chen rnams/ /rnal 'byor log par spyod rnams kyi/ /skyon mthong tsam na chad pas gcod/ /thams cad ngan 'gror spyi'u tshugs ltung / /sgrub pa'i snod mchog gcig yod de / /'di dang mi mthun ⑥kun rdzogs pa'i/ /rgyud mnyan ⑦don ldan ngang tshul bzang / /ci la chags med gtong ldan sems/ /shes rab rnam grol lde mig gis/ /gti mug tha ram blo phye dunas/ /chos kyi snying po'i mig ldan pas/ /rtag chad phrad tsho mthong dbu ma'i yul/ /ma nor lam du 'jug shes pas/ /sdong po sdong chen rab dul ba'o/ /tha tshig lung las byung ba bzhin/ /gzhung srong yithub par byed pa de/ /rgyal ba'i sras po yin pas na/ /de la gsang sgo dbye bar bya/ /ji ltar dam tshig thub pa ltar/ /de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /yid 'ong 'dod dang bde ba 'byung / /rigs yonya'adzin rgyal ba kun yum mo/ /de bzhin dam tshig thub pa ltar/ /gnas par byed pa'i rten yang yin/ /dam tshig kun gyi srog yin te/ /dam tshig kun gyi nor mchog go/ /dam tshig 'di ni 'jigs pa'i skyabs/ /dam tshig bgrod pa lam gyi mchog /dam tshig chu bo sgrol ba'i gru/ /dam tshig dngos grub dam pa yin/ /dam tshig grogs kyi mchog yin 102—89

te / /dam tshig long ba'i mis bu yin/ /ji ltar dam tshig thub pa ltar/ /gzhan gyi sde pa 'joms pa yin/ /'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal bar byed/ /des na dam tshig rgyun bzhin bsrung dzo / /mdor na bdag gi sgo gsum po/ /dag pa gsum gyi mtha' bzung nas/ /lha dang grogs dang slob dpon dang / /bdag nyid dag pa ma khrel ba'i/ /tshul gsum mi gnod dam bcas gsum/ /yongs su ma nyams mdo bzhi po/ /mthar phyin rgya rtags rnam bzhir bcas/ /mdo don dran pa la bgrang bsngo/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dam tshig ni/ /dam tshig kun gyi thog mar 'gro/ /wa dang cang shes gyi ling dang / /blang dor ming bral ( khro chen bdag /shin tu glang chen myos 'dra'i ri4)sems/ /dpa' rtul (gestag mchog rngam zhing gtum/ /mkha' lding khyung chen lhag mi lta/ /gtum thung dom (67chen sdong gcig pa/ /yid thub mi ldog rgya mtsho'i gser/ /gti mug lkugs 77pa'i blo tshol ldan/ /ri bo mi 'gyur brtan pa che/ /mkha' ltar yangs dog kun dang bral/ /gnam lcags lce yi 87drag shul can/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bdag /zon bag khu 'phrig kha rog 9sems/ /nges pa'i nga rgyal glang tshul ldan/ /zla bral seng ge ri dgas 7rgyal/ /re 'jam bya ltar chags 'grogs blo/ /g.yo ldan lcag chen sgyu ma'i rgya/ /gtsang sme med par kun spyod cing / /thogs med gsod spyod ce spyang khu37/ /che ba'i nga rgyal stag mchog blo/ / kum 'dzem 1 blo ldan nam mkha' lding / /sa thub bag len tsho1 rgyal 'khor skyong / /rnal 'byor brtul zhugs chen po ni/ /bcu gnyis dang ni gsum blor ldan/ /goms nas nyams su len byed pa/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i bka' ba yin/ /dal ba'i rgyud ldan tha tshig can/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /bsrung ⑪102—90

dang brjod dang gsang ba dang / /yan lag spyad pa'i dam tshig dang / /yid 'ong dang du blang ba dang / /brtul hu)zhugs zab mor spyad ②pa dang / /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor thams cad kyi/ /mi 'dor mi spong sbyar ba yi/ /rigs ②ldan shes par bya ba dang / /thob cing grub par bya ba yin/ /re re la yang lnga lnga ste/ /rtsa ba dang ni yan lag las/ /bcu gnyis dang ni brgyad ldan pa/ /spyad par bya ba'i nor mchog yin/ /rnal 'byor byang chub sems rgyud la/ /nges par brtags te spyod pa'i bu/ /zab mor rdzogs mchog bde ba yi/ /blo la nges pa'i lung 'di bstan(4༄/ /'di ni sngar 'gro tha tshig ste/ /zab mo sgrub pa'i sngon logs su/ /rdo rje tha tshig drag po'o/ /gcan 'phrang lam rnams bsrung ba'i phyir / /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig rnams/ /nges pa'i don gyis bsrung ( byas na ) / /de ni dbyig gi snod ri chen yin/ /de ltar spyi yi sdom pa la/ /gnas nas dus kyi skabs 'di ru/ /bsrung bya thub par bya ba ni/ /mi shigs pa ni seng ge ste/ /gcan gzan 8)rgyal po yin pas so/ /za ma tog ni 'dod pa'i gter / /dug spyo ba ni der mi rigs/ /rig chen myu gu'i lcug phran dag /de ni breg 5)pa'i rigs ma yin/ /gangs kyi 'izhun chu khol ma dag /mkhas pas btung bar bya ba min/ /pad+ma'i tshonaze'u 'bru kha ma byetshoge/ /zla zer ma yin kha mi dbye / /ma brtags bug rdol can gyi snod/ /kha mi dbye zhing bcud mi blugs51na/ /don dang mi ldan bcos ma'i rtagasañtsa/ /bsrel zhing spyad par bya ba min/ /shel dkar rin chen sgo keng dag /'dam rdzab khung du bsrub 4mi bya/ /seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma dag /dug can snod du blugs 1 pa min/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /bsreg par bya ba yod ma yin/ /khyung chen gshog tshonapa mkhar 102—91

brkyang ba/ /de dag gcag par bya ba min/ /gnam lcags me yi ngur mo dag /brdab par bya ba ma yin no/ /stag gzig 'drol bas las ①byas pa'i/ /las kyi lhag ma bsdu ②mi bya/ /rdo rje brag chen gtams pa'i gzhi/ /de dag gzhig par bya ba min/ /rdo rje ra ba'i go tshags ni/ /bsdam bya bral bar bya ba min/ /bud shing sreg pa'i sgron ma dag /g.yeng ba'i rlung ①gis bskyod mi bya/ /rdo rje tshig gi chu rgyun dag /'ol kur (gagacad par bya ba min/ /rgyal po bka' rtags phyag rgya dag /nam zhar dbyi bar mi bya'o/ /rdo rje pha lam gtams pa'i mkhar/ /rmang nas bzlog par mi bya'o/ /gtsug gi nor bu 'bar ba dag /rgyal mtshan rtse las dpog mi bya/ /rnal 'byor las kyi khyad par can/ /skal can rnams kyi (midam tshig ste/ /skal bar ldan pa'i nor mchog yin/ /rgyun du spyad pa'i nor mchog ni/ /rdo rje las kyi 67thun tshags dag /rdo rje go phur gatrom chen gyis/ /srog la bar chad byed pa'i dgra/ /nyon mongs 'thibs pa de gzhom bya/ /snyom (nyalas le lo'i dpung bskyed pa/ /thug 6)thub ra chod nga rgyal gzhi/ /dregs byed dbang po myos pa'i bcud/ /dpa' byed rkyen yang bsdam par bya/ /rdo rje gsang tshig ma gtogs pa/ /'dres 7pa gang zag byis pa'i tshig /zur yang brjod par mi bya zhing / /thams cad rdo rje gsang bas bya'o/ /ji ltar gsod pa'i mi rnams dag /gshed ma'i mis ni gsod pa'i 9/me tshe thar ba'i 7thabs la brtson pa kyi bzhin / /le lo'i dgra bcom brtson par 'bad/ /rnal 'byor sgrib pa'i gegs bsal ba/ /dka' thub sdom pa'i mdud pa can/ /'dod dang longs spyod mi mthun dang / /spyi mthun 7nang du mi gcig pa/ /phyi nang can dang gnod byed dang / /'dod myos bying rmugs brkam 7pa dang / /dad 102—92

med rtsa nyams 'phyar g.yeng can/ /mkhas pas bsgrims te spang ①bar bya'o/ /de ni rnal 'byor gegs (miyin te/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod par byed/ /rnal 'byor nges par spyod pa la/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud lnga 'byung / /rnam rtog 'phrig pa'i bdud nyid dang / /de bzhin btang snyoms le lo'i bdud/ /longs spyod 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i bdud/ /tshig rtsub mtshon cha rnon po'i bdud/ /khro gtum ngang thung 'khrug pa'i bdud/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i ①bdud lnga po/ /yang dag don la sgrib pa ste/ /gnyen po byang chub sems mchog gis/ /zhi ba chen po'i ngang du bzlog /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dgra bzhi po/ /thabs la mkhas pas gdul bar bya/ /rdo rje brnag pa gsang 'phel bas/ /ngag gi dbang po nyams 'gyur te/ /kha na ma thos phog par 'gyur/ /de dag bcas kur sti'agyur ba'i dgra/ /lta dman spyod rtsing 'chol ba yis/ /bka' yi gzhung bor log par spyad/ /nor bas bar chad 'byung ba'i dgra/ /dam gtsor spyod pa'i las rnams yin/ /'da' dka' rdo rje mchog gsum po/ /btang snyoms phyal bar shor ba ni/ /rtsa ba rul pa'i ljon shing bzhin/ /bka' chad chen po 'bab pa'i gnas / /brtsam (5 pa las la sbyor ba'i tshe/ /'bad pa'i rtsal yishugs chung ba snariyisal/ /don rnams grub pa (8)ma yin te/ /'bras bur mi 'gyur 'phrog pa'i dgra / /rnal 'byor chen por spyod pa la/ /'dod pa'i nor mchog 'phrog pa'i dgra / /thabs la mkhas pa'i skyes bu yis/ /skyon gyi dgra bzhi spang bar bya/ /srid gsum bsgral 6)ba'i zhing 'di dag /sangs rgyas zhing du rtogs pa ni/ /sa rnams cig 7car sbyangs pa ste/ /zhing rnams dag pa'i mchog yin no/ /khams gsum mchod pa'i rgyu 'di dag /yo byad chen po'i mchog yin te/ /rgyal ba 102—93

thams cad mnyes pa'i rgyu/ /rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa'o/ /'khor ba dur khrod gnas 'di dag /bde ba chen po'i gnas yin te/ /ma nor ma bcos chos kyi dbyings/ /btsal 51)med lhun gyis (gyigrub pa la/ /dug lnga rgyu ba'i rtsa ba dag /ye shes lnga yi rtsa ba steri / /kun shes kun rig ④gsal ba'o/ /rang rig ye shes rang las byung / /rnal 'byor chos mig ldan pa yis/ /nges pa'i don du 'di ltar blta'o/ /'di ni rgyun gyi dam tshig ste/ /brjod du med pa bsrung (snyeba'o / /bsrung 6)ba thub par bya ba la/ /dam tshig rtsal gyi khyad par ni/ /gang dag rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /blo la nges pa'i lung du bstan/ /'dod pas chags dang 'joms pa dang / /gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog rnams/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i dam tshig ste/ /don dang ldan pa'i skyes bus spyad/ /sbyor dang sgrol (7bar byed pa dang / /ma byin len dang ngag sprul byed/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig spyod pa'i mchog /spyad par bya ba'i las yin no/ /rgyal ba sems can thams cad dang / /dngos por brtags pa thams cad kyang / /don gyi ngang du gcig pa ste / /de nyid sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /mtshan ma'i chos rnams thams cad ni / /mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du gsal/ /theg pa 'og 98)ma'i khyad par rnams/ /kun kyang rang rig blo la gsal/ /yon tan ci 'byung mi brjod cing / /'og ma rnams la mi smod cing / /thams cad mnyam pa'i dam tshig ste/ /'di ltar shes na tshogs mchog rdzogs/ /gzugs rnams rnam par snang ba mdzad/ /tshig rnams brjod pa snang mtha' yas/ /rnam rtog kun du sems rdo rje/ /rig dang tshor ba rin chen 'byung / /yid g.yo byed pa don kun rdzogs/ /stan 'gan rang bzhin spyod pa'i gnas/ /zhing bcu dag dang ldan pa na/ /bde ba chen 102—94
