po'i longs spyod de/ /thogs med phrin 0)las rnam bzhir rdzogs/ /phyi yi yul dang nang gi sems/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /de la sgrib dang mi sgrib ces/ /mnyam pa'i rgyal pos yong ma gsungs/ /thams cad mnyam nyid dbyings gyur pas/ /phung (gepo lnga don ye shes lnga/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang phyug ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rig (nada'adzin yin/ /yul dang ye shes rang bzhin las / /gzhan gyi rang bzhin med pas na/ /mtshan ma'i rnam pa cir snang yang //de la chad pa'i gnas med do/ /dam tshig dam pa gang zhe na/ /rtogs ④pa dam pa dam tshig ste/ /rtog 5)par byed pa gang yin pa/ /de ni dam tshig chen po'o/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i ngang la gnas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul las/ /dngos su spyod (6)pa thams cad bya/ /de ni dam tshig chen po yin/ /snod du gyur pa yum gyi dbyings/ /bcud ri7༄rnams rgyal ba yab kyi mkha'/ /'byung 'jug rig pas longs spyod de/ /'di ni rdo rje (8)tha tshig yin/ /srid pa'i sems can thams cad dang / /thar pa chos kyi rnam grangs kun5nye/ /so sor thams cad snang ba ste/ /kun kyang mnyam pa'i ngang du gsal/ /spyod pa'i las dang rtogs ོpa dang / /mtshan mar gyur pa thams cad kyang / /sems kyi phyi nang spyod yul de / /brtags (1na longs spyod tshogs su 'gyur/ /ma skyes stong pa sku yi tshogergya/ /rang bzhin smon med gsung gi don/ /mtshan med yid las 'das pa tu thugs/ /rnam gsum bde chen sangs rgyas so/ /mnyam pa'i lta bas dbang sgyur (7 na/ /'khor ba thams cad dbyings la snang / /las kun rdzogs pa'i mchog yin te/ /gzhan du phrin tsolas lus pa med/ /sdug bsngal byang chub chen po ste/ /'khor ba ye nas mya ngan 'das/ /sgrib pa rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /nyon mongs 102wa 95

kun kyang byang chub don/ /snang ba med pa'i don mthong dang / /sa dang sa yi rim par ni/ /'di dang 'di zhes gzung du med/ /'di ni snang med thob pa'i gnas / /sku dang gsung thugs mi g.yo ba'i/ /ji bzhin nyid kyi ngang la gnas/ /ji ltar bsgyur yang chos nyid pas/ /chad pa'i gnas zhes brjod dang bral/ /med dang phyal ba gcig po 0)dang / /lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i dam tshig che/ /'di zhes ris su chad med pa/ /'di ni bsrung ②ba'i dam tshig go/ /spyad dang spyod par bya med pas/ /srid dang mu stegs 'jig rten pa'i/ /spyod par snang ba thams cad kun/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad spyod do/ /ma spangs lhun grub dbyer med pas/ /dbyings las gzhan na lta g.yul med/ /'di ni lta ba'i dam tshig go/ /sa chu me rlung snod bcud bcas/ /kun kyang rang bzhin chos nyid do//chos nyid don la gzhan med pa/ /rang 'byung 4)ye shes gsal ba'o/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /ma btsal (snyerang la yod pa yin/ /'dod pa 'byung ba'i longs spyod de/ /bde chen longs spyod tshogs yin no/ /ngan song mtho ris thams cad dang / /'phags lam 'khor ba'i chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin so sor 61mi dmigs 977te/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni rang bzhin yin/ /spyod dang gzugs rigs thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin te/ /sku gsung thugs tshig rgya cher ston/ /don rig lithugs kyi rang bzhin no/ /ma skyes pa dang ma byung 3)ba/ /mi gnas pa la chags pa med/ /don gyi khyad par rtogs chud na/ /kun du bzang po khamachog gi sa'o/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun rdzogs te / /thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi don/ /bdag nyid chen por thams cad rdzogs / /lhun rdzogs bde ba chen po yi/ /khyab pa chen por kun bdal bas/ /102—96

sgrib pa kun byang tshogs kun rdzogs/ /rnam grol bcings pa kun dang bral/ /lhun grub bde ba'i gnas chen yin/ /zhes smra ba'i seng ge chen pos gsungs so//rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las dam tshig gsang ba mchog gi le'u zhes bya ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje de chos thams cad brdas mtshon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs pa dang / 'dus pa chen po'i 'khor rnams kyis gsol pa/ sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad ni bdag cag rnams kyis brda 6)rig pa tsam gyi ngo bor mthong ngo / /de nas sems dpa' chen pos bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad ni brda ②dang / tha snyad dang / btags pa tsam du shes par gyis shig /btags pa'i chos thams cad ni phyi nang gang na yang mi gnas te/ chos thams cad la ming gi gzhi med cing btags pa'i tha snyad dang bral ba yin no/ /brda zhes bya ba ni sbas pa btags pa'i tha snyad yin no / /sbas pa'i ③chos rnams gsang ba'i phyir/ /thams cad sba zhing brgyud par bya / /'di ltar brda ④yi sbyor ba la/ /rnal 'byor can gyis shes par gyis(5)/ /de nas 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis (6)gsol pa/ sems dpa' chen pos brda yi gachos rnams rgya cher bshad du gsol/ bdag cag gis kyang chos thams cadam/ /brda yi don gyis (kyebargyud par bgyi/ /brda zhes bgyi ba ji lta bu/ /sbas pa'i chos ni gang dang gang / /mi bstan gsang ba gang gang lags/ /de skad ces kyi)gsol pa dang / smra ba'i seng ges bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig 'dus 102—97

pa chen po'i tshogs/ /brda zhes bya ba sbas pa'i tshig /sbas te gsang ba'i chos rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i spyod pa yin/ /mi bstan gzhan la gsang ba ni / /mu stegs la sogs sde pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor spyod la 0)'phya ba las/ /shin tu blan zhing sba ba'i phyir/ /sbas pa'i brda (miyis bstan par bya/ /brda yi yon tan chen po ni/ /grangs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab na/ /mdor bsdus ①rnam pa bzhi yod de/ /gzhan gyi spyod yul ma yin dang / /rnal 'byor rig pa'i spyod yul dang / /sbas pas grub thag nye ba dang / /gsang ba'i dam tshig mi nyams shing / /brda la dga' ba'i ma sring rnams/ /nye zhing gdung ba'i thabs su 'gyur / /de bas sbas pa'i brda (brnams ni/ /tshig gis mtshon te brjod par bya / /a la la hoḥ57/ a ti (6)pu hoḥphyi/ pra ti bu hoḥ(8)/ ma hā go ru saṃ kra 6)ma/gu 7ya de bī 11sa ma ya/ ma hā h+yePROBPROBPROB/ ma hā pur+sha/ gu ya/ bha ga /ma hā badz+ra / sa ma ya hoḥ/lha/ sa ma 7ya s+t+waṃ/ ra ho ya haṃ/ ra ga yā mi7/ sa ma ya dzaḥ / lhan/ oṃ rmāḥrdu7/ sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ e h+ye hi/ e h+ye gyikhyen/ha he ha/ ha he ha/ ma rta kha/ ma rta kha/ ka ruk+ṣa/ ka ruk+ṣa/ k+ṣ-i ba ri/k+ṣiṃ ba ri/ ra ho haṃ nyanyar ho haṃ/ sa ma ya hi/ a la sto/ a la sto/ kha kha le kha ti(le/ sha da pa/ sha da pa/ kha raṃ khā hi( )/ kha raṃ khā nyirdo nya/ kha le bh+yo/kha le ha na bh+yo/ kha ka kha kha ka kha/ kha gyi ha he/ rak+ṣa khā hi rak+ṣa khā hi/ ha ha he raṃ/ gu h+ya/ gu h+ya/ sa ma/ sa ma/ ma le mu le/ ta le du le/ ma tsa me tsa/ gu h+ya sin+ti snye/ pa ra ma/ pa ra ma/ shi ri hoḥ' / shi ri ho/ ma ma kha ka tram̐/ e e e e/ hri hri/ bh+yo bh+yo/ kha kha le le/ kurma ma ti bh+yo/ rak+ṣa kra ma bh+yo/ rak+ṣa kra ma bh+yo/ kurma ma le/ kurma ma le/ k+ṣu ti sha ne/ k+ṣu ti sha ne/102—98

rak+ṣa kurma/ rak+ṣa kurma/ gro dha k+ṣiṃ/ khā hi bh+yo 0)'a hi bh+yo / tsa le yo/ tsa le yaṃ/pra tsa le/ pra tsa leni/ gar+sha yo/ gun yo/ bi gur+bhe/ bi gurnyi/④ ma mo3 (gertal/ ma mo3 yirta/ ngag brda dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /bya ( sgri (btsan/ byā sgri (9)tsan / ba yaṃ k+ṣiṃ ga ri/ ba yo k+ṣ-i ga ri/ ba byā dz+nyo ba ba ti/ ba byā rnyo ba ba ti/tson ra ha sa(spre/ na ra ha sa/ brnya ka apā la/ bad+dha ka ( pā la/ tsan na ga 〉ske/tsan na ga 〉snyi/ rā tsog rak+ta yo tsa rā yonyeg rak+ta 66tsa/ ru dhi hūṃ )ra ma ta/ ru dhi du stor ma ta/ ka ru ga tsa/ ka ru ga tsa/ ba bya ba ti/ ba bya ba ti/ gi gro ṇa( 2/gi gro ṇa phyi/ thar+sha ta/ thar+sha ta/ dpa' byed kha/ dpa' byed kha/ zla ba rgyas dang rdzogs pa dang / zla ba dkar dang zla phrom mchog /tshe 'dzin kun gyi gtso mo dang / /'jam po thar pa chen po dang / /gal zhes bya ba'i ro mchog dang / /gzi brjid chen po'i dri zhim dang / /bran mo dang ni g.yog 'chang ma 'jam dpal rnon po'i ka tar dang / /mā (20tha ya mā (getha ya/ par+sha ti par+sha ti/ rwa tha ma rwa tha ma/ kha haṃ nya kha tai nya/ rwa ti rtsu rwa ti hūm̐/ shi haṃ tha/ shi haṃ tha/ ka raṃ tha/ ka raṃ tha/ shasti mkha shasti ri kha/ yo ga tsanān 2 yo ga tsakrān/ 'i sgra brda dam tshig gi phyag 'a )rgya'o/ /lag gi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /gar thabs g.yas g.yon bskor nas kyang / /se gol brdabs pa 'dren pa'i brda/ /bskor nas thal sbyar phyag rgya'i brda spe/ /shin tu bskor ri nas spyi bor dgrol/ /'di ni sa mchod pa bzhes pa'i brda/ /bskor nas snying gar bcangs ri nopa ni/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje brtan sa pa'i brda/ /gar bskor shin tu gnyis bstabs sa pa/ /mchod pa stobs 'a par byed pa'i brda/ /gar bskor zhushedabang mo'i spyi bor bzhagane/ /sbyor ba'i don la 'jug pa'i brda/ /thabs kyis spyi bor bzhag 6 )pa 102wa 99

dang / /shes rab dbang mo'i 6)snying gar ( ro/ /thabs kyis chagasang ba g.yas bcug na/ /shes rab thos byed gsang ba yin/ /thabs kyi sa nas g.yas bteg na/ /shes rab nas g.yon bteg pa'o/ /thabs kyis rdo rje phyag rgya bstan / /shes rab pad+mo'i phyag rgya bstan/ /thabs kyis smin ④ma g.yas bskyod na / /shes rab smin ⑤ma g.yon bteg bya/ /thabs kyis phyag g.yon brkyang ba dang —/ /shes rab g.yas kyis 'khyud tshul bstan/ /phyag rgya gar bskor thal brdabs shing / /dbang mo lce la reg pa ni/ /tshogs mchod dus la bab pa'i brda / /lag gnyis bskor nas dbang mo 'thor/ /de nas dbang mo lce la reg /'dza' (67gad 'drim 7pa'i brda thabs so/ /ma hā ging chen kurma dang / /rdo rje drod kyi rtags 'dzin las98)/ /sogs pa'i brda yi dam tshig 6)rnams/ /rnal 'byor can gyis spyad na 'grub/ /lus brda dam tshig kyiphyag rgya'o/ /zhes smra ba'i seng shes 11gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 7rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rnal 'byor brda'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas yang smra ba'i seng ge sems dpa'i rdo rje de rnal 'byor rol pa'i (stetshogs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge yi'adzin de las bzhengs par gyur pa bodang / 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs kyis gsol pa/ smra ba'i seng ge chen po chos thams cad ni rdo rje tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du bdag cag rnams kyis tshamathong ngo zhes gsol pa dang / smra ba'i seng ges bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni rdo rje tshogs yin par shes par gyis shig /ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'dus 102wa 100

pa'i tshogs kyis gsol pa/ sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni rdo rje tshogs kyi ①dkyil 'khor gyi don bdag cag rnams la rgya cher bshad du gsol / sems dpa' chen pos bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs / /rdo rje tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dam te②ske/ /rnal 'byor kun gyis spyad ①pa'i lam/ /sa mchog bgrod pa'i lam 'di dag /'dus pa'i tshogs la bshad par bya/ /brtsam pa las kyi dang po pa/ /rdo rje tshogs la 'jug pa na/ /khyad par rim pa ci ④bzhin du/ /las mchog 'di yi rang bzhin gyis/ /ji bzhin rim par sbyangs nas kyang / /sa rab mchog tu bgrod pa la/ /thabs mchog lnga yis bgrod bya ste/ /rdo rje tshogs dang bsnyen pa dang / /nye ba dang ni bsgrub (snyepa dang / /bsgrub ⑥pa chen por sbyar bar bya/ /ji ltar grangs dang dus chen dang / /mtshan ma byung bar bcas rnams las/ /gab pa'i sba thabs de sbyar nas/ /sus mi rig pa'i thabs chen bya / /de dag gsang ba'i bdag po yin/ /gnas 'dir 'jug pa'i byis pa dag /'jig rten rdul las drangs (7nas kyang / /'gyur dbang ma nges sar gzhag (nyaste/ /ci phyir dang po yin pas na/ /byis pa blo shed 6tam bye bsakyi/ /bzang ngan bde sdug mi shes shing / /bstan dang gsang ba'i dmigs mi phyed/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bka' sgo 'dir/ /gsang sgo mi dbye skrag par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin ngang tshul ma rtogs pa'i/ /so so'i skye bo yinabyis pa las/ /snod med snod byas bdud nyid kyis/ /rnal 'byor 'tshe tsoba'i srog gcod cing / /ma nges ldog 'jug bcas pa yis/ /gsang 'di yigebacas dkar 7'gyur phyir ro/ /des na 'di yi spyod pa yang / /ji ltar 'tsham par bde thabs sbyar/ /de nas 102—101

smra ba'i seng ge de thabs kyi rdo rje tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/rnal 'byor ma chen mo rnams mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gsol pa6)/ smra ba'i seng ge chen po chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni thabs kyi phyag rgya'i rang bzhin du bdag cag rnams kyis mthong ngo / /sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs 'di dag ni brgyud de sbas pa'i tshogs yin par shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor tshogs ldan lha/ /thabs chen phyag rgya sbas tshogs lnga/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs (7bcu drug dang / /bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje can/ /bri bya yang na bsam pa 'am/ /brjod dam bsngos sam mtshan ma la/ /'jig rten dbang po'i chos lugs kyis/ /mos pa la bskyed dran byas te tsho/ /rang bzhin yul nas phab nas ni/ /phyag bya (4)la sogs mchod pa yis/ /rdo rje sman dang rtsir sbyar ba'i/ /yo byad chen po la sogs pas/ /rdo rje thabs kyi 5)tshogs la dbul/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor glu 95)blangs te / /mnyes byas las grub grangs rdzogs nas/ /mchod dang dam skongs (pe'adod pa bya/ /snod du rung ba'i slob 87ma dag /dpa' mkhyen la sogs bya ba yis / /'jug tshul dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /rdo rje tha tshig rnam lnga yis/ /bslab pa'i gnyer rnams ci rigs 9 par/ /rtsal gyi rim par byin nas ni/ /rdo rje gal chen mna' 'dor ro/ /de nas sgrub pa che chung rnams/ /ji ltar 'dod pas nan tan gyis/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor bkar 7bya'o/ /mi nus la sogs mi gnang ba'i/ /dam tshig dag gis 1nyanan chags bya/ /rmongs pa gsang phyir sems bskyed de/ /ngo mtshar tshig gi 'du shes bsgyur/ /shes nas mig la shes bya'i yul/ /thams cad rim gyis bstan par bya/ /drod can 'khyil ba'i blo 1632—102

ldan la/ /rnal 'byor na spar mdzod sgo dbye/ /cing po 'gros kyis 0)dmu rgod la / /gcan 'phrang (mi'akhor ba'i g.yeng rnams bstan/ /rdo rje lung gi tshad can la / /ji ltar nus pa de dbang bskur/ /btsal ③med mi nus yul can la/ /phan pa 'ba' zhig bsngags ④pa yin/ /gnas 'dir yod dang med pa dang / /'od mi bsub (5)cing ljid mi dbab/ /rdo rje blo yi yul can la/ /rtsal chen sbyongs zhes ⑥gdams par bya/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i dbang gral du/ /rdo rje don gyi ltang chen bsher/ /rtsal dang rim pa khyad (7)par dbye(kye/ /so so rigs kyi phyag rgya dag /spyi'am yang na re re'o/ /de nas smra ba'i seng ge de shes rab gzungs 6)kyi tshogs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs pa dang / 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni shes rab tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du gda' bar bdag cag rnams kyis mthong ngo / /de skad ces gsol pa dang /sems dpa' chen pos bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad ni shes rab tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du sangs rgyas par shes par gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad shes rab kyi rang bzhin las byung zhing shes rab kyi rang bzhin du gsal lo/ /de nas 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gsol pa/sems dpa' chen po shes rab gzungs kyi khorang bzhin bdag cag rnams la rgya cher bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / sems dpa' chen pos bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i tshogs/ /shes rab gzungs kyi rang bzhin ni/ /rgya cher bshad kyis 117shes par gyis/ /ji ltar thabs kyis etshogs sbyar ltar/ /gang dag rnal 'byor mar ldan rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma la 102—103

sogs pa/ /lha mo'i tshogs su sbyar nas kyang / /gnas 'dir 'jug dga' la sogs pa/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya mtshan mar sbas/ /rdo rje mnyam 0)pa'i gzungs rnams la/ /mnyam pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /bro gar glu latshig la sogs pas / /rig (gu'adzin rnal 'byor ma rnams bsgrub④/ /ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje de chos thams cad thabs dang shes rab phan tshun dra bar 'brel pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs pa dang / 'khor rnams kyis gsol pa/(5) bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi (6)rang bzhin ni thabs dang shes rab tu 'brel pa'i rang bzhin can du bdag cag rnams kyis mthong ngo / /zhes gsol to/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa chos thams cad ni thabs dang shes rab tu 'brel ba ste/gnyis su med par shes par gyis shig /de nas 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis gsol pa/ sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad dra bar 'brel pa'i don bshad du gsol/ sems dpa' chen pos stibaka' stsal pa/ 'brel pa'i don ni 'di lta ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /phan tshun 'brel pa'i tshul du snang / /chos kun nam mkha'i mtshan nyid las/ /sprul pa bye ba cir yang snang / /gnyis med dra ba'i tshul du 'brel/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i mchog yin te/ /rtsal dang ldan pa nagasang sgo ba/ /'di la gsang sgo dbye bar bya/ /gsang 'dir 9chud pa'i bu rnams la/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' 'di bsgragasakyi/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje rgyal po rgyal mor bcas lnga nyid zung du 'khril ba ni/ /g.yas nas g.yon du 'khril 'khyud sbyor0spre/ /g.yas 102—104

nyid byang chub rdo rje dang / /rang rang mtshan ma 'bar ba'o/ /g.yon gyi sgra snyan 6)dril bu dang / /rtags kyis mdzes par gsal ba la/ /'byo ②zhing 'dud pa'i mdangs ldan pas/ /chags shing g.yo ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /seng chen khyu mchog la sogs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis bsgyings bcas te/ /kha dog lnga yi 'od 'bar bas/ /bcu drug chas ni sgeg pa rnams/ / rim gyis bskyed chadang cig ④car bskyed/ /dbang po'i rim par sbyar bar bya/ /gsang nyid tshogs kyi ⑤'khor rnams kyang / /gnas nas gyur pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /phyag rgya rgyal po yirgyal mor bcas/ /brgyad gnyis zung sgril 'khril 'khyud sbyor/ /sa dang nam mkha' ⑦spyan rdo rje/ /byams dang rdo rje kun bzang ⑧dpal/ /nang dang phyi yi yo byad ni/ /gzhi gnyis dag gis mnyes sbyor ba/ /bsam bya la sogs de bzhin no / /rdo rje sgo dang bcas pa ni/ /rdo rje 'khril 'khyud gsang ba'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor longs 6)spyod che sbyar bas/ /mnyes nas skongs tsophyir rim bzhin dbul / /gsang ba'i 'jug tshul la sogs kyis/ /gsang ba'i don rnams sgrub par byed/ /ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sems dpa' thosterdo rje de rdo rje tsokun du 'brel pa'i dbyings zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /chos thams cad kyi (nyarang bzhin ni rdo rje dra ba'i dbyings su bdag cag rnams kyis yimathong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs dra ba'i dbyings su shes par gyis shig /chos thams cad ni thugs kyi rig 7pa las byung la thugs kyi rang bzhin ni rdo rje kho na yin pa'i phyir ro / /'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dra ba chen 102—105

po'i tshogs bdag cag rnams la rgya cher bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa(1)/ /rdo rje chen po rig pa'i don/ /dra ba 'brel ba'i dbyings nyid ni/ /nges par bshad kyis (mirtse gcig nyon/ /thugs kyi gsang chen rig pa 'di/ /nges pa'i rdo rje yin pas na//rdo rje dbang yul 'brel pa'i don/ /thams cad 'byung bas dbyings shes ③bya'o//rdo rje 'dzin ma 'dzin sogs bcas/ /'khril mnyam pa yang de bzhin te/ /gzugs brnyan 4ting 'dzin rang bzhin gnas/ /rim pa'i tshul bzhin sbyar byas nas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar ro/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i rdo rje de (ltathams cad dus bzhi mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs par gyur pa dang / 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyis chos thams cad ni dus bzhi 6)mnyam pa nyid du gcig par mthong ngo zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad ni dus bzhi mnyam par rtogs 7pa yin te/ chos thams cad ni dus bzhi'i ngang du rdzogs par shes par gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang la dus snga phyir snang ba med do/ /de nas 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mnyam pa chen po'i 8dus nyid bdag cag rnams la rgya cher bshad du gsol / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'dus pa chen po yi 9ni 1 ritshogs/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi 17dus rig (12na/ /dus zhes 1 bya ba'i ming yang med/ / dus bzhi nyamanyam par rab shes na/ /chos 102—106

nyid mnyam pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rdo rje dus kyi lha mo'i tshogs/ /'das dang da ltar byung ba dang / /mi 'byung ba yi cha rnams la/ /dbang sgyur mnyam pa'i rgyal mo rnams/ /'jig dang skye dang smin pa dang / /'gag par gyur pa de dag du/ /rdo rje rnam thar tshad med dang / /sems dang de bzhin mnyam pa yi/ /shes rab 'khor dang dpal gyi dkyil/ /de bzhin rim par rdo rje yi/ /glu gar la sogs yo byad kyis/ /mchod dang 'jug tshul gong ma bzhin/ /cha rnams dus las mi 'da' bar/ /lha yi nyi ma rnams la'o/ /bde ba chen po la sogs pa/ /tshom zhu)bu'am yang na phyag rgya rnams/ /spyir ram re rer sbyar bar bya/ /'das la rnam thar tshogs bskul te/ /da ltar byung dang mi 'byung la/ /tshad med sems dang mnyam par bskrun/ /mnyam pa'i rgyal por de 'gyur te/ /bde gshegs dus kyi (5cirgyal por 'gyur/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i rdo rje de nyi zla'i tshogs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas yang ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs par gyur pa dang / 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs kyis 'di skad ( cices gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni nyi zla'i tshogs su mthong ngo / /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni byang chub sems dang snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin yin par shes par gyis shig /chos thams cad ni byang chub sems las byung zhing snying rje'i rang bzhin can yin no/ /de nas 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das snying rje dang byang chub sems kyi don bdag cag la bshad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos rnams kun gyi yo byad ni/ /snying 102—107

rje byang chub sems yin te/ /yo byad de dang ma ldan na/ /don rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor byang chub sems rdzogs pa/ /bcu drug 6)rdzogs pa'i zla rgyas tshul/ /snying rje ye shes shar ba ni/ /mkha' la nyi gsal shar ba'i tshul/ /don gnyis rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rnal 'byor nges pa'i sa pa yin(gyi/ /nges pa'i sa la bgrod pa ni/ /rdo rje dus kyi rgyun tshogs kyis/ /tshogs chen rnam (guganyis bskrun 6)par bya/ /skar tshogs dbus na zla nya ba/ /bcu drug zhag gis 'a)rdzogs pa bzhin/ /bcu gsum rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i sa/ /bcu drug tshogs kyis rdzogs pas ni/ /mdzes pa'i nyi ma bcu drug gis/ /zla dkyil 'od kyi phyag rgya la/ /mdzes par spras pa'i bde ba de/ /bcu drug tshogs kyis bsod nams bskrun/ /phyed rdzogs tshogs 'phel de phan chad/ /mi dmigs chos la blo sbyangs yin/ /je zhi je zhi mi dmigs pa ste/ /mtshan ma shes ⑦bya bslabs pa ste/ /bsod nams tshogs kyang mi dmigs pa/ /mnyam pas stong par gyur pa na/ /thams cad chos skur rdzogs pa ste/ /sdug bsngal byang chub gnyis med de/ /'di la rmad 'byung (8)sems bskyed de/ /zla ba dus kyis 6)mtshan ma dang / /gsang ba gnyis kyis mchod pa bya/ /phra mo'i drod du byung ba dang / /smyur (7te rang las byung rnams la/ /rtsa ba gcad (/〉phyir yongs rdzogs pas / /the tshom 7med par dang blangs nas1nya/ /dus de nyid du nyi ma 'char/ /dusaradi rgyun gyi bar bcad (thun/ /bsnyen pa dag gis bzlog 7par dka'/ /bar chad byung na gso zhing bskang 7/ /mkha' la zla gsal gra rgyas na/ /sa la rnal 'byor grar 1 rgyas pas/ /bsod nams spel ba chen po dang / /bsngo ba chen po'i las rnams bya/ / des na nya 'bras bu chen po yang / /nyi zla zhon nas 102—108

'gro ba yi/ /rig 6)'dzin sa la slebs (miphan chad/ /dpal chen bcu drug sa la 'grubaske/ /ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje de rgyun du gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas bzhengs pa dang /'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni yi ge rgyun gyi dkyil 'khor du gnas par mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad ni rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin yin la/rgyal ba thams cad ni yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du shes par gyis shig /gsol pa/ yi ge ①phyag rgya'i don gang lags pa bdag cag rnams la rgya cher bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa la(pe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chos kun rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rgyal ba (5 sku gsung thugs su gsal/ /sku gsung thugs dang phyag rgya dag /yi ge'i phreng ba nyid la rdzogs/ /yi ge (6)phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /rgyun du bsgrub par bya ba yin/ /des ni rgyun gyi ting 'dzin thob(pe/ /rgyun gyi rgyun du mi gcad ⑧pa/ /rdo rje nam dang nyi tshod la//yi ge'i tshogs bskyed tshogs sbyar la/ /phud lhag bcas sbyar de bzhin no/ /'di ni don la nye ba'i lam/ /bsod nams bskrun par de myur ro/ /kun rdzogs tshogs kyi rgyu des ni/ /yang dag tshogs chen ci 'dra ba/ /mchog gi bde ba dam pa dang / /de nyid chen por de nyid 'gyur/ /'jug sgo spyod dang lta ba mthunapo) / /thams cad gcig par gyur pa yi/ /rgyu dang rkyen ldan phun sum tshogs / /mdza' tso'aphrod sman dang dgyes sbyor ldan/ /lha dang rig 'dzin rnal 'byor ril(nya/ /ma lus tshogs pas chos 'di spyadapo/ /skad cig yud dam thang cig khyenagam/ /yud tsam nyin zhag zla re 'am/ /lha yi nyi ma bkra shis kyi ri/ /102—109

tshogs la bab zurapa'i dus 'di dag /byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus chen yin/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad rnams/ /phyi dang nang gi khyad par gyis/ /gtsang ma'i kha zas 'byung po la/ /rnam rtog rtog bral rgyal ba la/ /ji ltar 'byor bzhin nan tan bya/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyi ga dang (mi/ /chos kyi don du mi 'gyur ba'i/ /skyon bzhi po dag spangs nas ni/ /de las bzlog pa'i tshul ldan pas/ /rnal 'byor snying dang mig lta bur/ /gdung ba'i 'du shes nyer bzhag 3ste/ /ji bzhin 'dod pa ④nye bar sbyar/ /lha rnams nye bar bya ba dang / /bgegs rnams zhi bar bya ba dang / /don grub shi ba gso ba'i phyir/ /las 'dir spyad par shin tu gces(5/ /tshogs 'di blo chung gsar zhugs pa'i/ /mdun du brjod par bya mi rigs/ /rdzas dang yo byad thams cad kyang / /cis 'dul de ltar stobs kyis 5sbyar/ /des na las 'di khyad par yang / /tshogs la tshogs bskyed sgril 7sbyangs te/ /bsnyen pa dag la goms byas nas/ /bsgrubs pas 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'o/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rnal 'byor bde ba'i tshogs kyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas yang smra ba'i seng ge sems dpa'i rdo rje de (8)'das pa brjod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs par gyur pa dang / 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sngags zab mo spyod (9)pa'i skyon dang yon tan ci lags pa bdag cag gi rig pa la snang bar gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 1632—110

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs gsang sngags chen po'i don ni 6)rab tu spyad par dka' labar shes par gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gsang sngags kyi tshogs ni shin tu me dang 'dra ste/ me ni rgyun du bcangs shing spyad legs na ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du rgyun du laspyad du yod do④/ /me nyid ji lta ba bzhin du spyad na me'i phung po chen (gepor 'gyur te/ spyod par byed pa nyid kyang bsregs/ khyim nas khyim yang bsregs/ rdzas kyi dngos po thams cad kyang bsregs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gsang sngags 'di ni chu dang 'dra ste/chu thabs kyis yizin cing spyad legs na ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dga' ba der spyad du yod de/ chu la dga' ba der thar chu chen po la 'bogs par nus so/ /chu'i rang bzhin dang thabs la ma goms pas ni spyod par byed pa de g.yeng zhing 'chi bar byed do/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags chen po 'di ni gcan gzan (7)gdug pa can dang 'dra ste/ gcan gzan (8)gyis sems can gzhan gyi srog gcod par byed pa yang thabs la mkhas pas ji ltar dga' ba bzhin du dbang du 'du'o / /thabs kyis ma zin na srog gcod par byed do/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags chen po 'di ni sbrul gyi mgo la 'dug pa'i nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ste/sbrul gyi mgo la 'dug pa'i nor bu thabs kyis yongs ri9)su zin na ni dbang du 'du zhing spyad du yod la/ thabs kyis ma zin na ni 'tsho ba'i srog dang 'bral bar byed do/ /de bas na gsang ba chen po 'di ni spyad par dka' bas sngon gyi dus kyi tshe na yang spyad nyes pa'i log pa'i lam pa can mang por byung ngo / /don dang lam la mkhas pa'i skyes bus thabs kyis zin cing spyad legs na ma nor ba'i lam du zhugs pa yang mang por byung bas 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs spyad pa'i thabs la 102—111

yongs su mkhas par gyis shig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'dus 6)pa chen po'i tshogs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags log pa'i lam las byung ba ni gang gang lags/ spyad legs pa'i thabs las (gebyung ba ni gang gang lags/ bdag cag la rgya cher bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs nyes legs kyi rim pa bshad par bya yis ②nyon cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / nga ni dran pa thog ma'i tshe/ /gsang ba spyod pa'i don 'di dag /nges don phal cher nub par gyur/ /tshul 'dra tsam zhig gnas pa la/ /kun kyang phal cher spyod mod kyang / /don dang phrad pa ngas ma mthong / /kun kyang log pa'i lam spyad (gi)do/ /log pa can nyid gang zhe na/ /'di la mi gnas 'di nyams dang / /'di las log dang log tshul spyod/ /'di tshul ma yin 'dir ma nges/ /g.yo sgyus (9bden bcos 'gal ba'i lam/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /bskal pa kun bkod bya ba'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas mngon byung rgyal po de/ /mya ngan 'das par gyur 'og tu6)/ /byung ba'i rnal 'byor bzang rgyan de/ /(7mi shes byis pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /tshul 'chos (gyelog pa'i tshogs bskyangs pas/ /tshom bu lnga brgyar bcas pa zhig /don las gol zhing 'khor bar log /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /rmad byung gsang ba'i bstan pa 'di / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshad ma rnams/ /phal cher mi gnas skabs dag tu / /mi shes ngan rtog can rnams kyis/ /dkrugs 'gyur bka' bslad gzhung 997bor te/ /nor bas bdag nyid sun 'byin cing / /bdag yin gzhan 'di ma yin zhes / /bdag bstod 3nyagazhan la smod pa log /de yang ji lta bu zhe (nya102—112

na / /bskal yo)pa de nyid dus dag la/ /rnal 'byor dpa' sbyin bya ba zhig /don la blo shed ma bye zhing / /lam gyi thabs la mi mkhas pas/ /nges don bka' yi gzhung ②bor nas/ /chos ma yin pa'i chos spyod cing / /gzhan dag nges don spyod pa la/ /khyod kyi de ni don ma yin/ /don mchog bdud rtsi gang yin pa/ /de ni nga yi chos 'di yin/ /zhes ni bdag bstod chagazhan la smodabya/ /'di yang srid pa log pa'i lam/ /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /sngar byung rgyud kyi rjes gnas pas/ /deng ⑤med bzhin du dpon bstabs na/ /tshig gnyer dregs pa'i dbang des ni/ /mi shes bzhin du ras phyogacod pa'i/ /tshul 'chos sems kyi gya gyu can/ /smyon ( )thabs blun pa'i sdig (nyacan yin/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /dge slong dri med spyod pa zhes/ /bya ba'i rnal 'byor tshul 'dra zhig6) /don la mkhas pa'i rjes su byung / /tshom bu 'bum gyi 'khor rnams kyis / /rgyud kyi rjes su byung ba yis/ /don med dge slong de nyid la/ /tshig gi gnyer chen ljid phab ⑩pas/ /gdung 'tshob ces ni dpon bstabs te/ /che ba chen po'i dregs pa skyes/ /mi shes bzhin du tshul bcos te/ /'dra (getshul log pa'i chos spyad pas/ /tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa zhig /dregs pa chen po'i ru drar lilhung / /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /mdza' 'drin /hu bslang ster zhing rnams dang / /rnyed dang bkur stis 'tsho ba'i 'khor/ /gzhan gyi dbang du gyur dogs nas/ /sgo ris rkyang tshan so sor gcod/ /'khor 'di bdag gis smin bya yi8/ /gdul bar bya ba'i zhing yin gyis7/ /gang dag 'di dang ma 'brel zhes/ /nyon mongs tshig gis sgo tshebyed nor/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na / /rnal 'byor na zhi gnas pa zhes/ /bya ba'i tshom bu lnga brgya zhig /shin tu 102—113

gsang sngags spyod do zhes/ /dgon pa'i gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /yul khams chen po de dag gis/ /gnas par gyur pa'i mi rnams kun/ /gdul ①bar bya ba'i zhing rdo du spyod/ /gzhan gyi sde par gyur pa yi/ /dge slong don dang ldan pa zhig /yul der ched du 'ongs nas ni/ /rnal 'byor nges pa'i lam mchog gcig she /rgya cher bstan par bsams pa las/ /dge slong dgon par gnas pa des/ /nyon mongs tshig gi bsgo (47ba byas/ /'khor 'di bdag gi zhing yin gyis / /khyod ni 'di la ma gtogs zhes951/ /sgo (6)dang tshan 6)dang ris bcad (kyepas / /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i lam du lhung / /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /rnal 'byor chen por bsngos gyur la/ /sna 'gas 5ci rgyal gsog 'jog byed/ /gcig yid gcig gis 'byin byed pa/ /nam 1 tshozhar longs spyod thob pa min/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe 1ston/ /rnal 'byor bde ldan shes pa zhes/ / bya ba'i tsotshom bur bcas pa zhig /gsang ba sna rgya cher spyod pa las/ /'khor na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /bud med bzang ldan bya ba zhig /tshogs sbyor shing du bskos pa las/ /'byor pa'i yo byad de dag la/ /ser sna'i sems kyis gsog 'jog byas / /las kyi rnam smin bode yis ni/ /yi dgas 8khyi yi lus su skyes/ /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /gzhan yang rnal 'byor chen po'i tshogs/ /log par spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /log lta spyi brtol (tshagatum khro che/ /sdig spyod don dang mi ldan yang / /bdag ni yang dag yin no zhes/ /bab chol kyi 7bka' rku slu byed bslad 18/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /chos skyong ba 1rtayi rnal 'byor pa / /pra ma de zhes bya ba zhig /don dang lam la mi mkhas par/ /bdag ni mkhan po yin no zhes/ /kun la rgya cher sgra bsgrags nas/ /rgyal ba'i bka' 102wa 114

brkus 'gro ba rnams/ /bslus par gyur pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /log pa can gyi 'jig rten pa/ /mu stegs spyod pa'i khams su lhung hu)/ /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /tha tshig (minyams shing don la rmugs / /dregs pas don la khas 'ches phyir/ /rdo rje rgyal dbang thob li'adod pa/ /khrel med spyi brtol (5)mun sprul 'chal6)/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /rnal 'byor sngags kyi tshul spyod pa/ /pe na ya zhes (7)bya ba zhig /tshom bu brgya (kyedang bcas pa byung / /rtsa ba nyams shing don la rmugs/ /dregs pa chen po'i nga rgyal gyis/ /don la mkhas pa'i tshul bcos phyir/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i dbang mnos pas/ /ri bos srog chags mnan pa bzhin/ /nga rgyal dregs ri9)pa'i ri bo yisatso/ /'khor ba'i las spyod las ngan pa'i/ /srog chags phag gi rigs su lhung / /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /mnyam pa'i don nyid ma rtogs 11par/ /tshig du mnyam zhes rjod the byed cing / /chags sdang gnyis la mngon 'chel 1 ba/ /rnal 'byor las kyis 'khor ba'i lam/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /dge slong bde sbyin bya ba zhig /tshom bu stong dang bcas par de/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i las khal spyod/ /la la chags la mngon par 'chelakyi/ /la las sdang chen gsod yopar spyod/ /chags sdang las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /rak+ṣa srin po'i khams su lhung / /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /gang dag rnal 'byor blo chung rnams/ /rdo rje gral tshogs don glengs / na / /de la 'jigs shing skrag 'gyur te/ / spa zhum (18mi dga' 'byol byed blun//de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /dge slong lhas byin 47bya ba zhig /rnal 'byor dang po'i sar slob tshe/ /rnal 'byor don ldan mang po rnams/ /phal cher tshogs par gyur pa la/ /nges ( ridon gsang ba'i don glengs 21)na/ / lhas byin na 'khor 102wa 115

bcas de las byol/ /don gleng zhi)pa la mi dga' zhing / /ngan pa'i sems kyis phrag dog skyes/ /rang gi gnas su song nas ni/ /mkhas pa de la mi snyan brjod / /las kyi rnam smin de yis ni/ /bskal pa dpag tu med pa ru/ /yang dag don las gol bar 'gyur9nya/ /'khor ba don med gnas su 'khyams/ /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /rnal 'byor nyid kyis rnal 'byor la/ /shin tu gdug pa'i dug mdas gtong ris)/ /tha tshig btsan po rdzong lta bu/ /'joms byed rnal 'byor rang bgegs so/ /de yang ji ④lta bu zhe na/ /rnal 'byor rnam dag blo gros zhes/ /bya ba'i don ldan mkhas pa zhig /mi 'jigs blo gros zhes bya ba'i/ /thabs dang don la mi mkhas pa/ /sde pa mang po (5)skyong ba'i sar/ /rnam dag blo gros 'khor bcas 'ongs/ /mkhas pa 6)don ldan bzod thob la/ /ngan 7sems phyar ku'i sgro skur btab/ /las kyi rnam smin (8)de yis ni/ /mi 'jigs blo gros mnar med lhung lho)/ /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /lta ba dmigs bu dang bral bas/ /yang dag dbu ma'i lam mi gsal/ /spyi yul tsam la ltos spyod pa/ /de ni rnal 'byor long ba'i tshogs/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /rgyal po rab gsal 'dzin pa zhes/ /bya ba'i rnal 'byor can zhig byung / /shes rab lta ba'i mig med par/ /rnal 'byor ming tsam tshul bzung nas/ /sgra thos tsam gyi gzhung 7spyad pas/ /mig med 'khor ba'i khams su lhung / /de 'dra'i tshul du ma spyod cig /de la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /log tu pa'i tshogs su spyad pas ni/ /'khor ba log pa'i tshogs su 'gyur she/ /des na 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /shin tu gsang ba'i chos 'di rnams/ /gol sa che bar rgyal bas bshad/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa yis/ /don dang ldan par bya 102—116

ba gces6)/ /thabs la mkhas par spyad pa yi(mi/ /legs pa'i lam gyi rnal 'byor pa/ /sngon 'das dus na byung ba yi/ /rtsal can rnams kyi don bshad pa//skyes bu mchog gi spyod pa 'di/ /yon tan sgra bsgrags sus thos pa/ /ming tsam gyis kyang de thob cing / /dran pas ngan 'gro las skyob yin/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /shin tu gsang ba'i spyod pa 'di/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa las/ / lha yi 0bu ni 'od ldan de(ge/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i dus bab nas(5)/ /'chi ma'i 4)snga ltas gabyung ba'i tshe/ /mi dga' bar ni 'du shes gyur/ /phyi ma'i 'du shes bskyed pa las/ /mi gtsang zas su za ba yi/ /blun pa'i srog chags lus len par / /rang gi mngon par shes pas mthong / /shin tu 'jigs pa'i 'du shes kyis / /skyabs kyi yul rnams yid la byas/ /gzhan gyi dran pa mi gsal bar/ /gsang ba chen po'i tshogs chen gyis su/ /mtshan ni rna ba'i dbang pos thos/ /thos pa yid la dran byas pas/ /ngan 'gro'i lam las slar log ste/ /tshogs chen spyod pa'i skal ldan pas/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i gnas su skyes/ /de bzhin thos pa dag par spyod/ /rgyal ba mnyes pa'i tshogs 'di la/ /gang zhig dga' zhing 'dun skyed pa/ /gzhan gyi bar chad mi 'byung bar/ /ji ltar mos pa de myur 'thob(1)/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /bram ze'i bu ni byams ldan te/ /gsang ba chen po'i tshogs 'di dag /spyod par mos nas kun du btsal/ /btsal bas rnyed par ma gyur te/ /sa phyogs zhig tu 'dug nas ni/ /shin tu ngus nas smras yi )pa ni/ /e ma'o 1 ribadag gi las re pham/ /skyes nas rgas par gyur par du/ /tshogs chen zab mo'i don btsal na/ /don dang ma phrad las re ngan / /da (7'ong ji ltar btsal na rnyed/ / btsal byas rnyed tsho par yong mi 102—117

'gyur / /thugs rjes ca1bdag la skyabs su mchiskon / /gdung ba sgra 3)cher phyung ba las / /nam mkha'i khams nas 4)sgra phyung ste/ /skal dang ldan pa'i bram ze khyod/ /de ltar yi 5dam la brten 6pa/ /khyod ni don gyi skal ba can/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /khyod la byin gyis rlob nya7)par mdzad/ /de bas lta ba ma g.yel bar/ /sgrib pa sbyang ba'i thabs dag la/ /mkhas shing brtson par bya dgos te/ /rang gi rtsa rnams bgros nas ni/ /khrag chen dag gis mchod pa de//'dod chags dag pa tsan+dan 8chus/ /dmigs nas rgyal ba kun mchod nas/ /de ma thag tu don thob 'gyur9/ /de skad lung bstan thob nas ni/ /dga' ba'i bsam pa cher g.yos te/ /lung bstan pa ltar de spyad pas/ /rig kyi'adzin rgyal ba'i sras su gyur11/ /de bzhin mos pa dag par spyod/ /mthong la skal ldan 'dir zhugs pa/ /thams cad du yang de bzhin te/ /tog ni rtse mor gyur pa bzhin/ /yongs kyi nub pa ma yin no/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ / lha yi (1 bu zhes bya ba ni/ /dge ba'i rgyal po bya ba de/ /tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa zhig /gsang ba rgya cher spyad 1 pa las/ / lha bu ngarin chen 'od ldan de/ /shin tu dad pa cher g.yos te/ /lha rdzas yo byad mang po dang / /bcas nas gsang ba'i gnas der phyin/ /dga' zhing 'dun pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /gus par gyur te der gnas pas/ /cho 'phrul chen po bzhi 'thob ste/ /lha gnas kun du bgrod pa dang / /'byung chen lus las dzisprul pa dang / /ri bo gdeg 1 dang 'phang ba dang / /mi 'chi tshe la gnas pa thob/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog bzhin du/ /mthong ba dag pa'i chos de nyid/ /bskal 1 par nub par ma gyur to/ /de bzhin 'jug pa dag par gyis/ /mthong bas chos 'di yongs dag pas19/ /ye 1(32wa 118

shes sgron ma'i mig rnyed nas/ /bla med snying po can rnams kyis/ /lam rnyed lam du zhugs pa bzhin/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /bram ze kun ri bya ba zhig /chos kyi mig ldan don mthong nas/ /gsang chen gzhung 41)bzhin spyod pa la/ /bram ze kai (57ni bya ba zhig /dad pas don gyi rjes su 'brengs/ /gsang chen 'dus pa'i tshogs mthong ba/ /chos kyi mig dang ldan 'gyur sate/ /don gyi snying po mthong bar 'gyur no/ /lhun grub rtsal chen rdzogs pa yi/ /rig 5ge'adzin chen po'i sa nyid thob/ /de bzhin mthong bas dag par gyis/ /gzhan dag 'dir ni mngon spyod la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis phyogs byed pa/ /de ni dngos dang 'dra ba ste(phyir/ /'bras bu la yang mtho ri skudaman med/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na//rgyal po dbang phyug 'od ldan zhes/ /bya ba'i rnal 'byor can zhig la/ /tshom bu bcu dang bcas pa'i 'khor/ /rig na'adzin spyod pa'i don la zhugs/ /sngags spyod 'bras bu cher thob ste/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul mang po dag /thob pa kun du grags par gyur/ /de la gzhan gyi sde pa yi/ /bram ze dge slob bya ba zhig /shin tu dag pa'i sems bskyed nas/ /'jug cing bslab par zhugs pa las/ /rgyal pos ma gnang gsang sgo bsdams/ /bram ze dad pa ma log par/ /'byor pa'i yo byad ci yod rnams/ /rgyal po'i 'khor du phul nas kyang / /rgyal po gnas pa'i yul phyogs su/ /yid kyis phyogs te /smon lam btab/ /rtse gcig par ni smon lam btab/ /rjes su yi khorang dam par k+ṇi ni/ /yid la byas pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /sgrub 15par byed pa'i rgyal po dang / /sgrub dang mi ldan bram ze gnyis/ /'bras bu mtho 1nadaman med par thob/ /'di ni tshegs ngamed don po che/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i rig 5'dzin yin/ /de bzhin spyod pa gzhan 102—119

dag la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang gis/ /dge ba spyad dang ma spyad gnyis/ /'bras bu mnyam por 6)thob par gyur/ /bsam yas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /rgyal rnams 'dir bslab (mi'adir mkhyen pas/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen du/ /kun gyi bdag por gyur pa yin/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /sngon gyi bram ze gsal byin gyis/ /gsang chen 'di yi don bslabs nas / /rang gi sems la goms byas na(4)/ /sems nyid bden pa'i don mthong ste/ /chos rnams kun la mkhas par 'gyur(5)/ /kun gyi rtsa ba sems yin pas/ /sems las chos byung 'bum phrag yas/ /chos kyi rgyal por der 6)gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas smra ba'i seng ge zhes/ /zhing khams kun du grags par 'gyurasti/ /de bzhin bslab pa dag par gyis/ /tshogs chen gcig gi bsod nams ni/ /skye (nyal nyan thos bsam yas la/ /sbyin pa'i tshogs chen spel bas ni/ /'bum gyi char yang mi phod do/ /ci phyir zhe na gcig mnyes pas/ /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes pa yin / /nam mkha' khyab pa'i rgyal ba dang / /nyag gcig 6)snang ba'i rgyal ba gnyis / /so so ma yin tha mi dad/ /sku dang gsung thugs gcig las med/ /'dul ba'i ngo gang khyad par las/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bstan par zad/ /de ⑩na khyad par de ltar snang / /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /las rnams dag pa'i bram ze ni/ /dge ldan gsal ldan bya ba gnyis/ /dga' ba'i dad pa 6)so sor skyes/ /gcig la gcig ni tha tshig byas/ /gcig gis 7nyan thos bsam yas la /mchod sbyin bya ba rgya cher byas/ /gcig gis tshogs mchod rgya cher byas/ /tshogs la spyod pa'i gsal ldan ni/ /'di tshe gcig la mngon sangs rgyas/ /sbyin pa spel ba'i dge ldan ni/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum gyis grub/ /de 102—120

bas gnas 'dir spyod pa dag /rnal 'byor gsal ldan tshul bzhin spyod/ /'di dag rtag tu su 'chang ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i/ /che yon rtag tu ci 'dra bar/ /don gyi gzugs dang bcas par 'thob/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /khyim bdag mes sbyin 6)bya ba de/ /tshom bu brgya (snyedang bcas pa zhig /rgyun gyi ①rtag par 'di spyad ④pas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa ci 'dra bar/ /skye ba de yis nges par thobaphyi/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /don du nges par sgrub pa'i tshogs/ /rtogs nas smra bar ⑥gang byed pa/ /goms dang brjod dang smos pa yis/ /chos kyi rgyal por de 'gyur zhing ⑦/ /yon tan spyi gtsug nyid du 'gyur/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ /drang srong rnal 'byor gal ya nas/ /drang srong rnam pa mang po la/ /tshogs 'di yon tan rgya cher bsgrags(kye/ /don rnams nges par bshad pa las/ /drang srong mang pos rig 5)'dzin thob/ /ston par byed pa'i gal 7ya na/ /gsang bdag chos kyi rgyal por gyur(spre/ /'on tang tsogasang ba'i don 'di dag /snod dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba la/ /bstan tam bshad dam brjod par gyis/ /des ni yon tan chen po dang / /nga yi spobs pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /des na 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dam ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i tshogs 'di yin/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig blo ldan pas/ /skad cig tsam mam yinathang cig yil / /rgyal ba'i tshogs 'di rab bskrun na/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rig 7'dzin rnal 'byor mtha' dag dang / /tha tshig zab mo skongs tshenas kyang / /chos kyi mig ni thob dzi par 'gyur/ /des ni tshogs spyad yon tan dang / /log par spyad pa'i skyon rnams ni/ /sngon byung gleng /shegazhi bshad pa 102—121

yin / /zhes sems dpa'i rdo rjes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 6)rdo rje bkod 9 rapa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las 'das pa sngon byung gi le'u zhes bya ste bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i rdo rje de bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po de'i zhal du shin tu re zhing bka' sdod pa'i tshul gyis lta zhing kun du brjid par 'khor gyis bskul pa'i sa la sta gon du gnas shing cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas 'khor phal mo ches rnam par bskul bar rig nas rnal 'byor gyi phyag lus kun sa la brdabs nas a la la ho zhes bya ba'i sgra phyung ( /nas mgrin cagacig tu gsol ba btab pa/ e ma rdo rje sems chen po/ /rang rig mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'bar/ /mgon po yon tan bsam las 'das/ /rgyal thob 5khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma rang snang dbyer med sku/ /rnam dag bsod nams mtshan gyis brgyan/ /dpe byad 'bru bkod blta mi ngoms/ /sku lnga'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma rnam dag nam mkha'i dbyings/ /gcig gsung sna tshogs sgrar rig mkhyen/ /bsam 'das brjod med rdo rje'i (tshigasung / /gsung lnga'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma gsang ba nam mkha'i thugs/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo so sor gsal/ /kun rig snying po ye shes mchog /thugs lnga'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma mi mdzad mdzad pa che/ /ma chags chags bral 'dod 7chags mdzod/ /thams cad sgrol ba'i las chen po/ /phrin tsho las mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal tshab 9khyod la gsol ba ni/ /byams mgon thugs rje'i byin brlabs 7kyis/ /sprul pa'i go tshags ru mnyam ste17/ /'khor 102—122

ba'i skyas lings 6)chen po la/ /sdug bsngal shin tu gsad pa'i phyir/ /thams cad dur khrod chen po ru/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i las chen mdzod/ /a ho zhes gsol ba btab pa las/ sems dpa' rdo rje chen po des rnal 'byor pa'i phyag byas nas(snye/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po la zhus pa/a la la ho bde ba chen po'i mchog gsang ba kun gyi rgyal po/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i bdag nyid/ 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs rmad du byung ba'i tshig 55)shin tu rtul phod pa gsol ba 'tshal ba 'di shin tu ngo mtshar lags so/ /'di dag 'dul ba'i dbang du dgongs te/ ji ltar 'tshal ba'i bsam pa rangs par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa las/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des kun du 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i 'khor gyis bskor rib dur khrod rgyan gyi rol pa las rmad du byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas 'khor byin gyis rlob (5)pa'i tshig 'di gsungs so/ /hūm̐ he he phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra tshone gro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la ā ( nor li a li (8ra.u li ta 59 pa li traṃ :7/ kha li ho/ na sha s+t+waṃ bha ya hūm̐/phroṃ phu tsa khā hi phaṭa phaṭa ha la hūm̐ zhes gsungs so/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu /tshamatha' yas pa thams cad dur khrod kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur nas/ g.yos/rab tu g.yos/ shin tu rnam par 'thor ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la 'khor gzhan gyis yid tshod du mi 'gyur ba'i sku'i chos bstan pa ni sku kun du dur khrod kyi bdag po chen por bsgyur nas dur khrod kyi gnas brgyad dang / he ru ma'i gnas bcu dang /dpal gyi chas brgyad dang / dur khrod kyi rgyan chen po dgu dang / /don gyi 102—123

gsang ba yang gsang khyod la 'dud/ /gsang ba ye gsang khyod la 'dud/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po khyod 6༄la 'dud/ /'khor lo snying po khyod la 'dud/ /gsang chen snying po tshul ci lags/ /bka' gsang dkyil 'khor thabs ci lags//'bras bu bde ba'i don ci lags/ /ma 'ongs pa yi rnal 'byor dag /bsgrubs na dang len 'tshal ba yi/ /rig ②par 'gyur ba'i thabs ci lags/ /'byung chen rgyal pos bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa las/ sems dpa' rdo rje dam pa de shin tu bzhad pa chen pos rnam par bzhad des)/ a a he he'i gad rgyangs bsgrags pas 'khor thams cad kyang gad rgyangs kyi sgra chen po sgrogs par mdzad de/ dgyes pa'i 'od zer las shes rab kyi dpal de dgyes pa'i rol mo sna tshogs ling long phyad par byung ngo / /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa des lus kun bsrang (4ste/ dur khrod kyi chas (5)sna tshogs bsar yizhing rtags bcwa ⑦brgyad 'bar bar byas nas brjid pa'i gsung gis gsang sngags rgya mtsho dang ske/ rnam grangs sna tshogs don gyi bsgrub (9pa rtags 5)kyi rol pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di dag bshad do/ /gcig tu yang dag nges grub 7pa'i/ /don la rton byed rnal 'byor rnams/ /thogs /(1med nyid du 'grub 'dod pa/ /ji ltar btso 7blag mkhan dag gis/ /ras dkar na sbyangs pas tshon 'jen geltar / /rnal 'byor las rnams dang por ni/ /skongs tsodang sbyong ba'i las rnams gces/ /zab mor 'jug pa'i sngon logs nas/ /sems nyid gting nas tshar gcad phyir/ /theg pa dman pa'i skye bo dang / /lhan cig ci la'ang mi brnal palo/ /de las gyur pa'i yo byad dag /rus sbal mgo la 'ongs pa dganya /shin tu 'khrugs pa'i sems chen gyis/ /rgya yi mtshos bshugs te spang bar bya/ /102—125

chags tshig la me mi dgos/ /rig pa (1)ye shes me byung bas/ /mtshan ma yi ni (gubud shing bsregs(gyi/ /'jig rten gtor la rlung dgos kyang / /mtshan ma gtor la rlung mi dgos/ /rig pa'i ye shes rlung byung bas/ /mtshan ma'i rdul tshogs rnam par 'phyag /lus bkru ba la chu dgos kyang / /sems bkru ba la chu mi dgos/ /mnyam nyid chu bo khrus kyi rdzing / /ye shes chu bo'i rgyun byung bas/ /bag chags ljan ljin thams cad bkrus/ /oṃ kro dhi shwa ri sarba pā pi sho dha ya oṃ āḥhūm̐ / ro yaṃ khaṃ/ de skad tshig tu brjod pa yis/ /nyams pa'i chad (4)pa mi 'byung ngo / /gcig tu bskang 95ba'i las chen yang / /rigs kyi rdzas dang yo byad rnams / /gnas su bsags nas ji byin brlabs te/ /phyi nang mtshams bcad (7brtan byas nas/ /so so rigs kyi dam tshig la/ /'gal bar gyur pa gang dang gang / /mchod dang bshags dang gnong bkur te/ /yan lag brgyad kyi tshul bzung nas/ /bsam gtan gnas sbyangs rdzas bsab pa/ /gti mug rigs kyi dam tshig la/ /shes nas rtogs par bya rgyu las/ /ma rig log pa'i mthu yis na8) / /tha tshig (9༄drag po yal gyur na/ /pho brang nam mkha'i liṅga la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /a yi rang bzhin 'od gsal bar/ /gsal 'phro 'khrug 7par gyur pa na/ /phaṭa kyis drag tu brdabs pa yis/ /'od 'dril 1 bskal pa'i mkha' gsal bas/ /gti mug ri bo'i mun bsal 1 te/ /byang chub myu gu 'bar bar 'gyur/ /de ltar gsal bar gyur pa dang / /rnal 'byor can gyis tshig 'di brjod/ /e ma'o bder 1rigashegs tha tshig las/ /byang chub sems bde gsal 'bar 7ba/ /don du mi gtong gzhi bskyed de/ /sangs rgyas gdung chen rgyud snyam salas/ /ji ltar zla ba ra ri ltar/ /rgyu las byung ba'i rang 102—131

oṃ sarba ta thā ①ga ta kurma sa ma ya ho/ de skad tshig tu brjod nas kyang / /lus kyi brda yi tshul phyag sbyar/ /des kyang skong ②ba'i las chen 'grub/ /man ngag thabs kyi don mchog ni/ /rtsa ba yan lag de rnams las/ /gang dag nyams par gyur pa la/ /man ngag thabs mchog lnga yis bskang ③/ /nyams pa chen por ltung 'gyur ④na/ /bla mar gyur pa'i skyes bu dag /rgyal po dgu yi spyan lam du/ /sgrub (9pa chen po dgu brtsam zhing / /mchog chen dgu yi brtul zhugs yispyad/ /rang gi gzungs ma gang yin pa/ /bla ma dgu la gzungs mar dbul / /de bzhin rtsa ba yan lag dang / /zla dang zhar las nyams pa la/ /sgrub ⑦pa don gyi khyad par rnams/ /bdun nam lnga 'am gsum mam (shegacig /rim pa bzhin du sbyar byas na/ /des ni skongs 6)pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ / bskang ba'i ⑩phul yang rnam lnga ste/ /bder 6glegashegs rgyal ba mtha' dag kyang / /mdo ru bsdu na rnam lnga ste/ /gti mug zhe sdang nga rgyal dang / /'dod chags phrag dog 'di lnga dag /rtsa bar gyur pa'i don gyis na/ /gzhi yang thams cad 'dis bsgyur bas/ /nyams dang ma nyams tha tshig dang / /longs spyod spong len thams cad rnams/ /'di 8rgyu yin par rig bya ste/ /rgyu nyid rgyur btags dbang gis 4snyen/ /bsgyur bas dug 'gyur sman chen ltar/ /de nyid tha tshig btsan por bsgyuratso/ /'dul ba'i dbang gi 7khyad par gyis/ /de bzhin rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+mor las lnga'i rigs su 'dus/ /de dag thugs ngam mchog nyid kyang / /rnam lngar 'dus par bstan pa la/ /rtogs nas bsrung bsgrub tsodam bcas pa/ /so sor tsho 'gal zhing chag spre nyams na/ /so so nyid du bsab par bya/ /sku yi chag 47nyams gnas su gzhug /gsung gi 'gal 'khrul 102—135

bas / /rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pas/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dudaphyi/ /kun bzang ⑤rdzogs chen ye nas bdal ba la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa ni/ /snang srid rnam dag kun bzang ①yum gyi dbyings/ /'byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams/ /gsang chen rab rdzogs gzungs chen ④bdag nyid ma/ /gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal ba(nye/ /cir yang snang bas bde chen g.yung drung lha/ /'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bdag nyid chen po bcom ldan yab yum dang / /byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje lha mo tshogs yirje tshogs kyi bdag /ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs/ /nyes legs ltang ⑦'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma/ /dpang 6)gyur rdo rje yo)dam can dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rjes 7gdung 'tshob rdo rje thod pa can/ /bdag cag dregs pa'i bdag po 'dir (metshogs kun/ /'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub sems bskyed de'o / /bla med go 'phang 'thob yo par bya ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang / /sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /'da' dka' (tshardo rje dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer/ /spyi dang lhag pa'i khyad par dam tshig rnams/ /snga phyi mnos shing gnyer du rma'o 7'tshal/ /don las gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang / /gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo dang / / klong du 15gyur pa'i haṃ 7rtsal shugs chung ba 6)yis/ /shes bzhin ma (spyi ldan dam tshig 'gal 'gyur 9 〉te/ /dang po'i tha tshig bka' la btags 9 nyapa'i tshe/ /bka' la ( 2ma gus 'gal bgyis dpyas long btogs(nye/ /bar du bslab pa'i gnyer chen phog pa'i tshe/ /bslab la mi brtson don la g.yel ba dang / /tha ma 102wa 140

'di tshe 'bras bu sgrub pa na①/ /bka' dang gzhung bzhin ma lcogs don las 'gal / /tshor dang ma tshor sgrib pa che chung rnams/ /shin tu mi shes ma rig (gedabang gis na/ /ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal bgyis pa/ /dpa' bo thugs rjes ①bdag la bzod par gsol/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /las kyi dbang gis bdag cag ring du 'khyams/ /nyon mongs log par lta ba'i dug 'thungs ④te/ /sdug bsngal nad kyis shin tu gdungs pa la / /bde gshegs thugs rje sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi thar pa'i sman stsal ⑤bas/ /nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i nad rnams zhi mdzad cing / /bla med byang chub snying por 'tsho mdzad pa/ /byams mgon thugs rje'i ⑥bdag la skyabs su mchiX/ /zhes ngus nas/ a la la ho zhes brjod de niganyen po drag por ⑨bsten nas lus gdan khrir phul te/ byang chub sems kyis rnam par 'dud pa'i don la rnam par sbyangs pas lus gcer bu zad mar phyung / gnong ba (nyadrag po'i 'gyod pa byas pas bde bar gshegs pa rnams ⑩mnyes par gyur to / /des sgrib pa byang zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i (nyertags lus gos dang phral nas ldan pa'i thod pa yang zla ba tshes brgyad par gyur to3nye/ /sa thob pa'i rtags su de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs rten du gnas par gyur to/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje de 8dgyes te bka' stsal pa/ mi'i thod pa can rnams 'gyod pa'i las kyis bshags pa legs te/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnam par dag par gyur to/ /da ni shes bya'i sgrib pa dag cing ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir nyan pa'i dbang pos sangs rgyas kyis gsung tsol gsang sngags kyi sgra rnams nyon cig /des ni sa nas sar 'phar zhing 'bras bu yongs su 102—141

rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces gsungs pas 'khor bsam pa rangs yo)par gyur to/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po (kyerdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las skong ba las kyi bsgrub (milugs kyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog nyid ting nge 'dzin rgyas shing rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po yang (geting nge 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /'dus pa'i 'khor rnams kyang sna tshogs 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor (snyegyis chos thams cad ci yang med par mthong ngo / /chos thams cad ci yang med par gsal bar gyur pa dang / chos nyid stong pa'i nam mkha' las brag ca'i 6)tshul du sgra 'di byung ngo / /mi gnas mi rtog bsam dang bral/ /ma chags chags bral yul las 'das/ /ci yang mi 'byung cir ma yin/ /rang byung rang zhi brjod dang bral/ /zhes sgra byung bas (7)ston pa ni don gyi che 97ba phyung (9)/ 'khor rnams ni rtsal sbyangs/ thams cad don la ngam zhing chos nyid kyi nam mkha' mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po nyid snying rje rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas chos nyid kyi nam mkha' la snying rje byang chub sems 7kyi gzugs brnyan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhig shar bar gyur to/ /de nas 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor rnams yang dag par rtog pa 'di ltar skyes te/ e ma chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'di ltar yin pa las 'di ltar ma shes pa'i 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba 'di 102—142

yang snying rje zhes snying rje byang chub kyi sems skyes par gyur to/ /de nas nyi ma'i snying po'i 'od zer las cho 'phrul gyi sgra phyung ngo / /yongs la khyab ①pa'i nyi ma'i 'od / /snying rje byang chub sems yin te/ /rnam rtog mun pa sel bar snang / /yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba'o/ /zhes sgra byung ba las chos thams cad byang chub sems kyi 'od zer du gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i mchog gi bdag po de nyid cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i rgyu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor rnams kyis nyi ma'i snying po las chos thams cad kyi rgyu yi ge a dkar po (bshar bar mthong ngo ske/ /de nas a las (micho 'phrul ④sgra byung ngo / / a ni ⑤chags med yi ge'i mdzod / /cho 'phrul rtog pa kun gyi rgyu/ /nyon mongs 6)skyon bral zla ba'i mdog /cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /zhes sgra byung bas 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis chos thams cad cho 'phrul gyi rang bzhin du gnas par mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po de ci yang mi mdzad pa cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin du snang bar gyur to/ /de nas yum chen mo nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ma zhes bya ba ri de chos thams cad nam mkha'i (gubha gar byin gyis rlob (9)pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /zhugs par gyur pa dang 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor gyis dzochos thams cad nam mkha' khyab pa'i rang bzhin du mthong ngo / /de nas yum gyi bha ga'i snying po las 'od zer mthing ga (nya'aphros nas nyi ma'i snying po'i a la bskul nyu bas yi ge e mthing ga yina'aphros te lding zhing gnas pa las cho 'phrul gyi rang sgra 'di byung ngo / /a ni e yi rang bzhin te/ /a las pa.e byung mkha' khyab bdal/ /mi 'gyur thogs skemed 102—143

bsam las 'das/ /mtha' dang dbus med kun du bdal/ /zhes sgra byung bas/thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin du phyam ②chad par gyur to/ /de nas yang yum chen mo las kyi dbyings phyug mas yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba la ②snyoms par zhugs so/ /des 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor gyis ①chos thams cad rlung gi rang bzhin du gnas par mthong ngo / /de nas rlung de las cho 'phrul gyi sgra byung ngo / /a yi byin brlabs ④ye shes las⑤/ /rlung gi cho 'phrul yaṃ du shar/ /thams cad 'degs pa'i stobs ldan zhing / /rang bzhin g.yo zhing thogs ⑥med 'phyo/ /zhes sgra byung bas rlung gi dkyil 'khor du 'khyil par gyur to/ /de nas yum chos kyi dbyings phyug ma zhes bya ba ⑦des 'bar 'phro me'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor gyis chos thams cad me'i rang bzhin du gnas par mthong ngo / /de nas me'i 'od zer la ⑧cho 'phrul gyi sgra byung ba/ a yi byin brlabs ⑨yi shes las/ /cho 'phrul me yi snying por shar/ /'bar bas gsal byed ye shes 'phro/ /dngos po kun zad me klong 'tshub/ /ces sgra byung bas me'i bskal ⑩pa 'byam klas so/ /de nas yang ⑪yum rin chen dbyings phyug ma zhes bya ba des sdud pa rgya mtsho'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /des 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor gyi 8chos thams cad chu'i rang bzhin du gnas par mthong ngo / /de nas rlabs 0kyi 'od zer las cho 'phrul gyi sgra 'di byung ngo / /rgyu yi yi ge 'od zer las/ /chu yi snying po'i cho 'phrul shar/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'o/ /rlung mtsho 0thams cad rgyas par gyurami/ /zhes sgra byung bas thams cad yum rin chen dbyings phyug ma'i rang bzhin gyis khyab par gnas so/ /de nas yum tsochen mo rdo rje dbyings phyug 102—144

ma zhes bya bas zhing khams thams cad byin gyis rlob ①pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor gyis chos thams cad sa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin du mthong ngo / /de nas sa rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba las cho 'phrul gyi sgra byung ba/ mi dmigs pa las (misna tshogs par/ /snang ②ba'i cho 'phrul 'di byung ba/ /rnal 'byor sa bcu rdzogs pa'i don/ /lhun gyis grub pas bde ba che/ /zhes sgra byung bas sa dgu 'dul ba'i bye brag tu thugs su chud par gyur to/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de ri bo brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /des 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor gyis chos thams cad rdo rje 'bar ba'i ri bor mthong ngo ske/ /de nas de'i 'od las cho 'phrul gyi sgra 'di byung ngo / /rnam dag shes rab mkha' klong nas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i ri bo shar/ /rgya che gting zab nam 'phang gcod / /rtog pa'i ri bo 'joms par byed/ /ces sgra byung bas rdo rje 'bar ba'i ri bos nyon mongs pa'i ri bo thams cad zil gyis mnan no/ /de nas dbyings phyug ma chen mo lnga/ shes rab zab mo'i gzhal yas yum gyi mkha' klong ④rnam dag ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bha ga'i snying po las cho 'phrul gyi sgra 'di byung (gyengo / /bha ga gsang ba'i 'od zer las/ /bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i gzhal 4)yas khang / /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar dpag tu med / /dus gsum rgyal ba rgya (bematsho'i dbyings/ /zhes sgra byung ngo byung bas nam mkha' thams cad pho brang gi gzhal yas 'byam (miklas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog de nyid chos thams cad sku la yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nam phyag rgya thams cad rnam par spro ba zhes 102—145

bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor rnams kyis 6)'khor ba dang mya ngan cha'adas pa'i chos thams cad bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po'i zhabs kyi gdan khri yan chad nas dbu'i gtsug tor man chad du rdzogs par mthong ngo / /de nas yang 'khor ba 'dod pa khams ni chags pa khrag gi rgya mtshor rdzogs/ 'khor ba gzugs kyi khams ni zhing chen gyi sa gzhi bdal ba la rdzogs par mthong ngo / /keng rus la gzugs med pa'i khams rdzogs par mthong ngo / /ri rab kyi kha mu tig gi gcal ①dang ske/ /a sma gar ba'i (7'bar ba'i 'od 'khrigs pa'i nor bu rin po che 'bar ba'i brag gtams pa la/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams rdzogs par mthong ngo / /nor bu rin po che'i steng na rdo rje rtse gsum dang rtse lnga'i brag gtams (5)pa la kri ya dang u pa ya dang yo ga rnams rdzogs par mthong ngo / /rdo rje brag chen gyi steng na pad+ma dkar po'i maṇ+ḍal la bskyed ⑥pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad rdzogs par mthong ngo / /pad+ma'i steng na nyi ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / zla ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi kha sbyor du bkod pa la dbang phyug pho nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi rdzogs par mthong ngo / /dbang phyug pho mo'i steng byol song gi gtso bo brgyad ni rig 'dzin chen po'i rnal 'byor nyon mongs pa sbyangs nas shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyang ba'i (7)phyir dpa' brtun stag dang / 'jigs byed seng 83ge dang / gdug pa'i gzig dang / gtum pa'i dom (9)dang /stobs kyi glang po dang / brjid pa'i ma he dang / 'dzin pa'i chu srin dang /zhe sdang gi sprul rnams la rig 7'dzin thams cad sa la 67yongs su rdzogs par mthong ngo / /gzhal yas chen po 'bar ba la yum kun du bzang mo rdzogs par 102—146

mthong ngo / /me dpung chen po dgu la ye shes kyi sgo dgu brtsegs su 6)yongs su 'bar bar rdzogs par (mimathong ngo / /zhabs brgyad la gsang ba'i yum ①bzhi dang / sgo ma bzhi rdzogs par mthong ngo / /dur khrod kyi rgyan chen po bcwa ④brgyad ni ma mo chen mo bcwa (2brgyad yongs su rdzogs par gsal lo/ /phyag mtshan ⑥bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni phra gamen ma bcu dbyug pa 'phyar ba'i lag na khyung bcu 'bar ba'i kha nas mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phro ba/ mkha' 'gro brgyad dbyug par 'phyar ba'i lag na seng (shege kha glal ba brgyad kyi kha nas ral gri 'bar ba brgyad 'phro ba/ shugs 'gro brgyad dbyug par 'phyar 6)ba'i lag na stag mche ⑩ba gtsigs (spepa brgyad kyi kha nas rdo rje sna tshogs 'phro ba/ ma mo brgyad dbyug par hu)'phyar ba'i lag na mi mgo brgyad rdo rje lu gu rgyud tunyekyis btags nas klad tsol bskor ba/ 'bar ma brgyad dbyug par 8'phyar ba'i lag na me dpung 'bar ba brgyad las thu tsolum 'phro ba ste/ bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su gsal lo/ /phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni khrag 'thung 7'bar ba bzhi/ shing pho dgu mo dgu/ za byed pha bcu gsod byed ma bcu ste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su gsal lo/ /zhal nyi shu rtsa gcig ni srid pa za byed gsang ba'i dur khrod nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gsal lo/ /spyan 'bar ba drug cu yo rtsa bzhi ni he ru ka yab yum drug cu tsho)rtsa bzhir gsal lo/ /dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gsal lo/ /g.yas kyi dbu bdun gyi spyi gtsug nas sangs rgyas kyi sku re re byung ba'i dbu la 'khor lo 'od zer dang bcas pa re re 'bar ba/ dbus kyi dbu bdun zhu tsholas dbu rgyan sangs rgyas kyi dbu re re byung ba'i sku la rin po che'i mchod rten 'bar ba bdun du gsal ba/ g.yon gyi dbu bdun las dbu rgyan zhunyesangs rgyas kyi sku re re byung 102—147

ba'i dbu la nor bu rin po che bdun du gsal ba/ 'khor lo dang mchod rten dang ske/ rin po che de dag gi lte ba dang / bum pa dang / rtse mo las rgyal mtshan chen po bcu 'bar ba ni rgya bye'u lcags kyi rgyal mtshan dang / gdul bya sha ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / gcan gzan 6)gzig gi rgyal mtshan dang / sprul pa rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan dang / rin chen sbrul nag gi ④rgyal mtshan dang / dpa' bo ③stag gi rgyal mtshan dang / gzi mdangs mi'i rgyal mtshan dang / dmar gsal khrag gi rgyal mtshan dang / rtsal chen seng ge'i rgyal mtshan dang / gtum chen dom gyi rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal mtshan de rnams kyi rtse mo gcig tu 'dus te/gser gyi gtsug tor tog (hostong 'bar ba'o/ / de nas ⑤'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor gyis zhabs kyi gdan khri yan chad nas dbu'i gtsug tor man chad du yongs su rdzogs par mthong ngo / /dbu las byung ba'i sangs rgyas nyi shu rtsa gcig dang ske/ rgyal mtshan chen po bcu la rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor yongs su rdzogs par mthong ngo / /dbu'i gtsug tor rgyal mtshan gyi ⑥ste mo la gser gyi tog stong ⑦ni rdzogs pa chen po'i (lirnal 'byor nyid du gsal bar mthong ngo / /de ltar mthong zhing gsal bar gyur pa dang / chos thams cad sku la yongs su rdzogs pa'i don la 'khor thams cad ngam zhing ngo po)mtshar skyes 6 )par gyur to/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnams kyis 17sku la yongs su bstod pa/ e ma'o chos kun sku la yongs su rdzogs pas chos kyi 32sku/ rdo rje che mchog phyag 'tshal he ru ka /chos nyid mkha' la skar tshogs rgyas pa'i sku/ /(snyedabyar gyi char sprin gtibs pa lta bu'i gzugs/ /chu rlabs lta bur brjod pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer bdal ba bzhin/ /theg chen dgu dang 'khor ba'i chos rnams kun/ /phyag rgya 102—148

gcig tu bkod ①nas rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sku gsum lhun grub chos sku tog stong 'bar / /dbu skra kham ②nag ral pa'i cod ②pan can/ /klu rgyal 'bum gyis bklubs ④shing mchod kun 'bul/ /rdo rje gsung gis ⑧ljags sgra brdabs pas kyang / /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra skad 'jigs par sgrogs⑥/ /theg chen don dam gsang sngags sgrogs ⑦pa'i tshig /'bar ba'i smin ma mun ⑤rum glog ltar 'gyu()//spyan dmar bzlog ⑩pa'i sdang mig nyi ltar 'barayi/ /'bar ba'i shangs nas bskal ⑩pa'i tshub tinag 'khyil/ /rdo rje thog dang gnam lcags ser chen 'bebs / /rno dbal mche ba zang 8yag gtsigs pa yis/ /nyon mongs log lta'i tshogs la ngam zhing 'khrug /thod rus sha khrag rkang rus 'bu dang rnag /za byed rngam pa'i zhal du chem chem gsol/ /sbrul gdug ko rlon la sogs 'jigs pa'i rgyan/ /rngam pa'i sku la shin tu brjid par brgyan/ /za byed rngam dang 'jigs byed mang po'i tshogs/ /'bar ba'i phyag mtshan sprul pa'i pho nya mdzad/ /'khor ba kun dang thar pa'i chos rnams kun/ / dpa' bo tsochen po'i gdan du brjid cing rol/ /'gran gyi zla med che btsan gcig pu nyid/ /gsang mchog 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de skad ces bstod pas chos thams cad sku la yongs su rdzogs shing sangs ma rgyas pa med par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po de nyid phyag rgya thams cad phyag rgya bkod pa'i pho brang du gyur to/ /spro ba 8rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba tu)mchog gi (nyabadag po chos nyid rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin 'di gsungs so/ /nam mkha' yonadon gyi glegs bam la/ /skar tshogs 102—149

rig pa'i yig bris te/ /'byung chen bzhi yi sgra bsgrags ①pas/ /gsang sngags chos kyi rgyun mi 'chad/ /chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba yongs su rdzogs sol / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po des bdud rtsi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /stong gsum bhan dha'i ②bzang khong du/ /srid gsum sems can dug chen las/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rtsi sbyar bas/ /bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de mchod pa rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'di skad ces gsungs so / /'khor ba rgya mcho'i yo byad rnams/ /mchod pa rgya mcho3re rgyan yin te/ /srid pa rgya mtsho 4)mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod 6)sprin mchog tu rol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de bzlas brjod rgyun gyi ting nge phyi'adzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'khor ba chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /sems can sangs rgyas snying po (7)shar/ /sgra skad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /thams cad bzlas brjod sngags kyi tshig /ces gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des sbyor ba rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'khor ba shes rab yum nyid la/ /snying rje thabs kyi rgyal po yis/ /'du 'bral med par sbyar bas ni / /thams cad rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed(ci/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de sgrol ba (9)rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te 'di skad ces 7gsungs so/ /'khor ba bsgral ba'i zhing 'di dag /ye shes 'bar ba'i mtshon chen gyis/ /rang bzhin med par bsgral nas 102—150

ni / /mnyam nyid chos sku chen por bton6)/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de sku gdung ②rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dod khams rmang gi ri rab la /gzugs khams bang rim khri 'phang brtan/ /gzugs med bum rten bum par bcasal/ /gdung chen chos skur rgyun du gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /nam mkha' me chu sa rlung rnams/ /rmang gzhi ri rab rten du snang / /bang rim ri bdun bcas pa rnams / /de nyid bang rim khri 'phang brtan/ /ri bo bum rten bum par bcas /'di yang chos sku rgyun mi chad(kye/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje des yang 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dzugs pa'i yan lag bzhi ④mang rten/ /'khor lo tshogs chen khri 'phang (gebartan/ /yan lag dang po bum rten yibacas/ /lcang lo cod 57pan phreng bas bklubs(kyi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des shi ba yongs su slong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ro yi sgrub lugs chen po ni/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas rnams su/ /ro yi rdzas rnams btsal nas kyang / /'dod pa bsgyur 5)ba'i sngags kyis yigadab/ / ro yi steng du gnas nas ni/ //1 ro yi gnyen por bdag bsams nas/ /ro sngags rgyun mi 'chad par bzlas/ /ro la bkrag tsho dang mdangs byung ༷snyen/ /grub par 'gyur ba'i rtags yin te/ /rgyun mi 'chad par ting 'dzin bya/ /ro ni 'gul skibar gyur pa dang / /gser 'gyur rtsis 'di byug par bya/ /ro yi yan lag kun bcings nas/ /sngags ni dag par bzlas 7par bya/ /ro nyid langs par gyur pa dang / /ro yi yi cho 'phrul ston par byed/ /brtul zhugs ldan pa'i skyes bu 102—151

yis / /de tshe ro yi lce bcad nas/ /ro la brdabs na gser du 'gyur/ /de bzhin ji ltar 'dod pa yi/ /rkyen gyis bsgyur na de ltar 'gyur/ /lce bcad ral gri mtshon cha des/ /ro yi bhan dha bcad ①pa dang / /ji ltar 'dod pa'i rdzas 'grub ste/ / bhan dha ②go ru bzung nas ni/ /lce yi ral gri thogs nas ni/ /lha min g.yul yang bzlog (7par 'gyur/ /ro langs grub pa'i rkang mgyogs ④ni/ /dpag pa'i tshad las 'das pa ste/ /skyes bu rtsal dang ldan pa bzhis / /phyogs bzhi dag tu kha bltas (snyenas/ /dus gcig mda' yi rgyang 'phangs nas/ /mda' ni sa la ma 'babs 6)par/ /bzhi ka bar snang las blangs nas/ /skad cig tsam gyis ⑦'jig rten skor(kye/ /skyes bu lag tshod ma yal bar/ /de ma thag tu gnas su slebs6)/ /ro la ⑩'dod pa kun 'byung zhes / /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /ro langs bsgrub (1pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de rdo rje nam mkha'i 6)them skas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /nam mkha' rdo rjer bsgoms yinas kyang / /ting 'dzin red par gyur pa na/ /phan tshun gya gyu'i 'thabs tshul du/ /rdo rje skas la bgrod nas ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su song nas kyang / /snang srid 'jig rten khams la blta/ /des ni sems yul yangs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de rgya mtsho chen po gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rgya mtsho rdo rjes gtams 7par ni/ /ting 'dzin gsal bar gyur pa dang / /rgya mtsho chen por bgrod nas 7ni/ /rgya mtshor gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /ting 'dzin 102—152

rdo rjes bsgral bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de thogs med rlung zla'i dkyil 'khor la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /nam mkha' dag gi liṅga la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / bsgom te ⑨ting 'dzin rtas ②pa dang / /zhing khams kun du bgrod par bya/ /zhes dugasungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des nyi ma rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /nam mkha' dag gi liṅga la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ / bsgoms te ④ting (snye'adzin rtas ⑥pa dang / /mun pa'i gnas rnams thams cad bsal④/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des sreg pa'i bskal ⑧pa gzhil ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /rnal 'byor sdigs mdzub ⑨rtse mo la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal 'bar/ /bsgoms te ting 'dzin rtas ⑩pa dang / /chu rgyun babs te gzhil bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des stong gi 'jig rten rgyang mar 'phen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor las kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /stong gi 'jig rten 'khor (nyeyug bcas/ /shin tu gsal bar bsgoms pa dang / /ting 'dzin rtsal can rab sbyang 8phyir/ /nam mkha'i khams su 'phangs nas ni/ /sa nas sa ru spar bar bya/ /de skad ces gsungs so / /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje de nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bum 'gyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor sdigs pa'i mdzub /rtemo la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba las 'od 102—153

zer 'bar ba 'bum 'phros pas/ /'od zer de dag re re las/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bum 'phros pas/ /des 6)ni mun pa thams cad sel/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de 'byung ba chen po bskal pa'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor lag pa'i 'khor lo las/ /chu zla'i snying po rab shar te② / /bdud rtsi chu bo'i rgyun bab (kyepas/ /sreg pa'i bskal pa'i me chen gsod//ces (gegasungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje de sku'i ⑤phyag rgya 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i liṅga la/ /sangs rgyas ye shes dpal gyi sku/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ngos brgyad la/ /rig (6)pa'i ma mo dpal 'bar ba/ /brgyad du gsal bar gyur pa dang / /ye shes rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des gsung gi phyag rgya 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /pad+ma 'bar ba'i liṅga la/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i yig 'bru brgyad / /shin tu 'bar zhing (7)'phro 'du ba/ /gsung gi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje de thugs kyi phyag rgya 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs (kyiso/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i liṅga (9la/ /yi ge tsū gi 'bru yis bskor/ /mtha' ma rin chen yig 'bru brgyad/ /kha dog mthing gas 7bskor ba ni/ /thugs kyi gsang ba'i ye shes yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje des ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo 'di gsungs so/ /sems ni sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /ji ltar brtags 102—154

pa de ltar snang / /mdo bzhin snang bar ma gyur kyang / /sems nyid brtags pa de ltar 'gyur/ /gdos 0)bcas dmigs bus mi mthong yang / /mngon shes yid (migazugs can gyis mthong / /gang ltar brtags par yun brtags phyin/ /rtog pa rtas ④pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /mngon sum gsal bar red par 'gyur/ /dge dang mi dge'i bag chags dang / /yod dang med pa'i rang bzhin rnams/ /bag (gechags rtas ⑥pa kho nar zadaX/ /de bas ting 'dzin sems nyid gtso/ /zhes ⑧gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po skyurdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des gsang sbyor chen po sgrub pa 'di gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /shin tu gsang ba'i sgrub pa 'di/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gshegs shul te/ /'jig rten gang zag lam yang yin/ /ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogasatso/ /phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs/ /log pa'i lam bzhi 1nyamatha' bsal nas/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug /des na sgrub pa'i lam mchog 'di/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la bshad par bya/ /shin tu gus pas mnyan par gyis/ /de nas 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams kyis gsang ba sbyor ba'i phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i dbang phyug chen po bdag cag rnams la gsang ba'i yang gsang ba/ bka' gsang ba chen po ye shes rmad du byung ba/ sangs rgyas gshegs pa'i shul yang dag pa'i don bdag cag rnams la bshad du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pa las sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de/ btsun mo'i tshogs 102—155

la dgyes par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bha ga gsang ba'i pad+ma ni/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang ste/ /sngon 'das rgyal ba brnal ①ba'i dbyings/ /da ltar bzhugs pa gnas pa'i rten/ /slad kyis byon (mig gshegs pa'i shul/ /rgyal ba rnams la de ltar snang / /de ltar ma shes 'khor ba'i lam/ /rnal 'byor can gyis shes par gyis/ /yul gyi mchog ①ni 'dir gzung ④ba/ /mtshan ldan bkra shis gsang ba'i yum/ / smin dkyus ⑤ring la lag sor phra/ /tshigs mig rlum la phra bar bshad/ /kha nas ut+pal ngad ldan zhing / /yid 'ong mtshan ldan rked ⑥skabs phyed/ /skra ⑦'jam mthon mthing nilcang lor 'khril(9)/ /so dkar tshags dam smin yidakyus ring / /zar ma'i me tog rgyas 'dra'i spyan/ /dpral pa'i dbyes che skra mtshams 17'khyug /sna bzang timadog gsal pad+ma'i rigs/ /lus drang ske ring sems ma'i tshul/ /nu ma'i dkyil 'khor zla rgyas 'dra/ /sha dkar tshags dam 'khril bag can/ /khong dal 'gro na gom pa 'jam/ /skad ni ngang pa gzhon nu sgrogs7/ /ci yang mdzes pa'i stabs tshul ldan/ /skyes bu bla mas yum du gzung ⑩/ /gzungs su byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ /de yi gzugs kyi phung po la/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sa bon lnga/ /'phro 'du gsal bar gyur pa de / /rgyas btab byin brlabs tsodabang bskur nas/ /bde gshegs yum lnga'i sku mchog 7gsal/ /rdo rje thabs la'ang de bzhin te/ /de ltar gsal bar gyur pa dang / /yum gyi mkha' la me ri bsgomacha/ /gsang ba dbus kyi zla gam la/ /byang chub sems kyi spro bsdu bya/ /gzugs brnyan ji ltar gsal ba bzhin/ /chags pa'i mkha' la de bzhin no/ /ma skyes pa dang ma 'gags pa/ /rig pa 102—156

rang snang mnyam pa'o/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag bde chen klong ①/ /mi gnas bde ba chen po'i lung / /rig pa thabs kyi rang bzhin las/ /byin brlabs ②rang dbang ngang gis gsal/ /bzhin mdog dmar po sog nika la/ /dpral ba'i dbyes che smin dkyus during / /mig gi mdangs gsal dkyus su ring / /dung chen thags dam shel mdog chags/ /bzhin gyi gzangs ring kos ko ⑤phya/ /lus la zhim pa'i dri ldang zhing / /kha nas ga pur ngad ldang ba/ /nu ma'i dkyil mtho nu mar 'khyil/ /pad+ma can zhes bya bar grags/ /dung can ma zhes bstan pa ni/ /dkar mo zla ba'i mdangs su gsal/ /bzhin lus dung ltar g.yas su g.yo / /gtsug phud stimathon mthing tshigayas su 'khyil/ /skad che gdangs (shesnyan tshig tu gsal/ /bong chung 6༄lus ni mdzes par snang / /bu mo mig ring yizhes bya ba/ /shes rab gsal zhing 'dod pa che/ /gtso bo nges pa'i brtul zhugs can / /zla gsang dkar dmar rlung kur 0phyi/ /rnam par brdig cing 'khyil pas ni/ /kun gyis drod ni yong mi lon(nye/ /gsang ba sbas pa'i thabs la mkhas / /phyi nang rlung kur yogegaser ltar lci/ /rtog pa med cing don la gzhol/ /bzhin ni gru bzhi'i dbyibs ldan la/ /mig ring phra bshad 'khyil bag chags/ /dkar dmar mdzes pa'i rgyan 8gyis brgyan/ /ljon pa dag gi rigs tshusmos pa/ /sdong po yal ga tsomang po'i dkyil/ /shin tu 'dab ( tshorgyas yal gar legs/ /mthon mthing (nyeskra yi rang bzhin nizhun/ /byang chub sems 'drar lcang lor bshad/ /stod smad kun du phra la legs/ /srid du ring zhing ldem bag can/ /lcug phran zhes bya'i mtshan ma ni/ /bcu gnyis nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ /rdo rje'i mtshon gyis ma phog cing / /mu la rak+tar khri)ldan pa la/ /phra zhing sonyebashad la gzangs ( gesu ring / /102—157
