ban glang (1)ser mo gru bzhi la/ /kham la mig 'bur smin ①tshogs che/ /skra kham ③ma la so che zhing / /sna ④ring 'gram slang (5)ring ba yin/ /ri mo can gyi bud med ni / /nag mo grwa gsum rtsid mgo ma/ /khro gnyer can la gel bag chags/ /sdong gcig yan lag gtan med pa'o/ /skye ba'i rgyu med bkra mi shis/ /mi rig yal ga mes (7tshig yin/ /spyir ni de ltar bstan med ༷kyang / /gang dag dad ldan brtul zhugs can/ /yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong rnams/ /dad pa chags shing lus 'bul na/ /thugs rje'i yul bas kun snyoms bya/ /rnam rtog spong len gang byed pa/ /de dag sgrib pa mu mtha' yas/ /rmad du gsang ba'i mchod pa la/ /gsang ba'i phyag tshang gang byed pa/ /las kyi sgrib pa kun bsal (nyate/ /man ngag gsang ba'i dmigs bu 'thobapo)/ /de ltar brtags pa'i yum de la/ /dri spos tsan+dan la sogs pas7/ /a ga ru dang sbyar ba'i chu/ /khrus kyi cho gas (7dag par bya/ /dri zhim la sogs sna tshogs kyis/ /lus la byug pa sna tshogs bya/ /de nas nang gi khrus chen yang / /shin tu dag par bya ba ni/ /rdzas kyi chu dang rdzas sbyar bas/ /nang gi rdzas rnams dag par bya/ /bur shing snying po la sogs pa / /ro yi mchog tu gyur pa kun/ /rtsi 'am bcud dang sbyar nas kyang / /nang si/ rdzas rnams sbyar bar bya/ /rdzas kyi cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /mi dmigs chos la blo sbyangs 7phyir/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi don/ /rgya cher shin tu bshad par bya/ /phung po sgyu mar snang bas na/ /sems la rang bzhin med par nges/ /snang srid nam mkhar tsho gcig pas na/ /'khor ba sgyu ma yin par nges/ /kun gzhi snyichos kyi mdzod yin pas/ /sangs rgyas gzhan na med par nges/ /byams la yidang ma chags pas yin/ /sdang la 102—158

sems mi 'khrug par nges/ /gnas la nges pa med pas na/ /sa rnams bgrod pa med par nges/ /sems la skye shi med pas na/ /'pho 'gyur dag la nyam mi nga ske/ / des na 0)thams cad sgyu mar snang / /sgyu ma rang bzhin med shes pas/ /thams cad chos nyid snying po yin/ /mtshan ma rtog (snyepa'i dri ma dag /chos nyid chu bo des bkrus na/ /'dzin pa'i dri ma dag par 'gyur/ /de nas rgyan gyi cho ga ni/ /rdzas kyi yo byad yin pas na/ /rlob cing 'phur ba'i chas ①gos dang / /rin chen phrog (gedang rna char zhu)bcas/ /'jol yisgog mgul rgyan tshul sogs pa(8)//dpung rgyan do shal se mo do/ /nor bu rin chen la sogs brgyan/ /rkang gdub lag gdub la sogs pa/ /gser dang dngul la sogs pas brgyan/ /rol mo sgra dbyangs sna tshogs pa'i/ /mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs par bya/ /de nas 'dren pa'i cho ga ni/ /gsang ba'i tshig gis bsre ba na/ /rdo rje lce yi dam tshig gis / /tshig gi brdas ni mtshon par bya/ /sa ma ya ho zhes brjod na/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ kyi)zhes kyang bsre/ /ra ga ya mi zhes brjod na/ /ra ho haṃ yizhes brjod par bya / /ti pa su ki zhes brjod na/ /gan de tsi ta zhes pas mtshon/ /a ti pu ho zhes brjod na/ /pra ti pu ho zhes pas mtshon/ /g.yas kyi smin (nyam bskyod thogebyas na / /g.yon gyi smin mas mtshon par bya/ /nā yiges g.yas kyis yimatshon byas na/ /de bzhin nā yis g.yon gyis mtshon/ /gtsug tor yigatsug tu mtshon byas na/ /de bzhin dpal be'u'i liṅgar mtshon/ /rdo rje liṅga 'od 'phro na/ /pad+ma ze 'bru 'bar 'phro (/zhe'akhyil/ /zhes pa'i tshig gi don rnams bsre/ /bskul nyunyeba'i cho ga khyad par yang / /don gyis 'di ltar bskul bar rigs/ /shes rab nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /thabs mchog zla ba'i 'od la bskul/ /bskul tsho)ba'i cho ga 102—159

rdzogs pa dang / /mchod pa'i yo byad dbul bar bya/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi ngang du gsal bar gyur to/ /shes rab nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi ngang yo)du gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas nyi ma'i zer gyis 'di skad ces bskul to/ /mi g.yo mchog gi rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /rnam par mi rtog shin tu dri med sku/ /'od zer mdangs ldan zla ba rgyas 'dra'i zhal/ /dgyes ②pa rol pa'i don la bzhengs su gsol/ /de skad ces bskul ba dang /zla ba'i 'od zer las 'di skad ces bskul to①/ /yid 'ong 'byor ldan rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbyings/ /shes rab zab mo durnam dag pad+ma'i mdangs/ /sgyu 'phrul rabs (snyel mkhas pa'i spyod mchog ma/ /yid 'ong 'byor ldan cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan / /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yo byad kyi tshogs thams cad shin tu 'bul ba zhes bya ba'i cho 'phrul byung ste/ nyi ma'i 'od zer las sgra byung ba/pad+ma'i ze 'bru 'bar ba 'di/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis ⑥'bul lags na/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje cho 'phrul las/ /byang chub char sprin dbab tu gsol/ /zla ba'i 'od zer las cho 'phrul gyi sgra byung ⑦ba/ e ma yid kyi dga' sde (kyemo/ /gdung ba'i snying phreng shes rab gzungs/ /pad+ma'i ga'u 'khyil pa la/ /bde ba'i rdo rje byang chub 'bar/ /zhes sgra byung bas/ phyag rgya sna tshogs kyi cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur to/ /de nas sems dpa' 6)rdo rje dam pa des 'khor ba ⑩thams cad thugs rjes yongs su bzung ba (1zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 7nas/ thabs mchog zla ba rdo rje ()zhes bya ba las cho 'phrul gyi sgra 'di byung ngo / /'dod pa'i dbang po thams cad ni/ /chags pa'i 'gying ba'i gtso mo yin/ /chags pa (7rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /'dod pa gnas su drang 102—160

bar bya/ /zhes byung ①bas/ 'khor ba thams cad thugs rje chen po'i lhung bzed kyis bzung ngo / /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje de sgrib pa sreg pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i liṅga la/ /a yi ②ye shes 'od 'phros pas/ /chags pa'i sgrib pa'i bud shing rnams/ /me yi ye shes kyis sbyangs ①so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des/ bha ga byin gyis rlob ④pa la snyoms par zhugs nas gsungs pa/'khor bar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /bha ga'i snying por rab gsal ba/ /yum gyi lus kyi yan lag rnams/ /yum lnga'i rang bzhin nyid du gsal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des chags pa thams cad gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs ⑤so/ /chos nyid nam mkhar stirtogs gyur na/ /sbyor sgrol mang po ci byas kyang / /chags sdang drang ba'i thabs yin te/ /rdul cha tsam yang snang ba med / /ces gsungs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad btsun mo'i tshogs thams cad la dgyes pa'i rol ⑦pa la zhugs par gyur te/ mi dmigs pa'i bde ba la ci yang mi g.yo bar gyur to/ / de nas (kyebyang chub sems kyi char chen po pad+ma'i snying po rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab ponyepar gyur to/ /'khor ba thams cad ni rgyal ba'i sras por bskyed/ rgyal ba 'gog pa ⑩ni byang chub sems kyis brlan par mdzad cing srid pa'i myu gu mngon par bskyed/ rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ling long phyad par byung ngo / /rig yona'adzin gyi sems dpa' thams cad ni/ shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs nas chos kyi sku'i nang du brlan par gyur to/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'gro ba thams cad la 102—161

dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i 0)ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i sems can rgyu las byung / /'khor ba'i sems can rgyun chad na(gyi/ /sangs rgyas rgyun yang 'chad par 'gyur/ /'khor ba chos nyid rang bzhin du/ /shes nas smra bar gang byed pa/ /rig pa'i ye shes rang dbang de/ /chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa des chos thams cad grub pa smon lam gyi sgo nas 'jug par mkhyen nas smon gnas chen po'i lam 'di gsungs so/ /'gro drug rgyal ba'i sras po 'di/ /ma rtogs log par 'khyams pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed nas ni/ /'khor ba'i rgyun rnams gcad par bya/ /nyi zla'i nang du bzhag ①nas ni/ /bcu drug sa la rdzogs par 'gyur/ /des na rigs ldan mtshan bzang la/ /don dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa yis/ /sbyor ba'i yan lag kun rdzogs nas/ /yum gyi mkha' dbyings zla gam la/ /grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du bskyedang)/ /rtsibs brgyad zla gam dgur gsal la/ /byang chub sems las phyag rgya'i 95tshogs/ /lha dgu gsal ba'i ye shes bskyed(7/ /des ni thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa tsho77kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las gsang sbyor sgrub pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po de mi 'gyur ba gtan 'pho ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor rig 'dzin gang zhig rnams/ /mi 'pho bar ni gnas 'dod pa/ /102—162

lo gcig gam ni zla gcig tshigam/ /de bzhin zhag gi rnam grangs kyang / /bcwa 9kyelnga'am yang na bdun bar du/ /tho rangs thun tha'i dang po'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /shar gyi phyogs su kha bltas te/ /shar phyogs nam mkhas bsdus ②pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'jig rten bcas/ /thams cad khong du bsdus nas kyang / /dbugs de ⑤slar la mi dbyung ⑤bar/ /rang gi khong du bstim par bya/ /tha mar sna yi nang du bsriskyo/ /de ltar mang por bsgrubs pa dang ske/ /dpal che gzi brjid thams cad 'thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po des rten ⑦pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /gang zhig rten la gnas 'dod pa/ /mtshan ma bzang po'i (3)gnas mchog tu/ /thams cad 'byor par byas nas ni/ /sa las byas pa'i stegs bu bshams5)/ /dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab 7brgyad la/ /zla gam dmar po sgo bzhir ldan/ /mtha' ma rdo rje ra bas bskor/ /dpal ldan tshe yi 4)phyag rgya dgod8/ /rin chen lugs kyi bum pa la/ /tshe rdzas rgyas par byas nas ni/ /mtshan ldan snod kyis 1gekha dgab bya/ /rdo rje gzungs kyis btags yinas ni/ /tshe tshad med par mnga' gsol la/ /dbus su de bzhin gzhag 8par bya/ /rin chen bum pa bzhi rnams la/ /gsang ba'i bu mo bzhi bkod gzhag /ya mtshan byung ba'i bum pa la/ /rigs bzhi sangs rgyas yab yum dang / /so so'i 'khor gyi sems dpa' rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab sdebs yinas ni/ /phyogs phyogs gnas su tshom bur bri/ /sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi rnams gzhagadzin /sems kyi phyag rgya kun bkod nas/ /nyi zla ga 'ur a (/ )yu ni/ /'khyil 'bar 'tsher zhing gsal bar bya/ /a //yu byang chub sems su zhu/ /rgyal 102—163

mtshan mchog ldan rin chen gter/ /dbang bskur ①dpal ldan mdzod ldan ma/ /gsang ba'i bu mo tshe gter 'dzin/ /a (9yu yum bzhi'i thugs kur ①'phros/ /de bzhin tshom bu rim par brgyud/ /rdo rje tshe mchog kun bsdus nas/ /dkar dmar 'od kyis bdag la bstim④/ /de nas rdo rje tshe phreng ⑤bzlas/ /nub phyogs tshe yi dbyings mchog gi⑥/ /pad+ma dbang gi zhing khams su/ /byams ⑦ldan ye shes tshe dpag med/ /thugs kyi dpal be'u chen po ni/ /gnyis gsal 'od kyi ga'u na/ /byang chub sems kyi a yu (nya'abar/ /dmar gsal 'bar ba'i tshe mchog de/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams la 'phro/ /'phros pa dgu lung dam pa yis/ / tsit+ta'i dbugs ⑨la bkrag tu bslan/ /tshe nyams rgyu drug kun spangs nas/ /gzi byin skye ba'i rgyu lnga bsgom/ /byang chub sems kyi a 0yu de / /skye med dbyings su sbas nas kyang / /phyag rgya'i tha mar bdun gyis bshad//dang po sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ /gnyis pa gnon pa'i rgya gram 'bar/ /gsum pa rta mchog dpal gyi rgya/ /bzhi pa rin chen dpal be'u ste/ /lnga pa gser gyi gu 11rgya'o/ /drug pa zla gam dmar po la/ /bdun pa nyi zla ga 'ur 'bar/ /tshe yi ngo bo rgyud gsum po/ /srog gi ngo bor gzhal yas khang / / le brgan ⑫'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /a 6)yu dmar po 'od 'phro ba/ /'chi ba med pa'i srog btsugs te/ /'gyur ba 7med pa'i tsogayung drung yin/ /chos nyid cidabyings su tshe sbas pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba dgrar langs kyang / /de la gzung zhing bstan du med/ /de nas ci bde spyad par bya/ /rdo rje tshe sgrub pa'o/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa de rdo rje khro bo tshe kun du 'phrog ⑩pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /gnas 102—164

'gyur maṇ+ḍal 'bar ①byas la/ /ye shes khro bo 'bar ba yi/ /thugs kyi dpal be'u'i 'od zer las/ /dbang gi lha mo mang po 'phros/ /za ma tog dang bcas pa yil/ /lcags kyu dkar dmar lag na thogs/ /de yis ni'agro drug thams cad kyi/ /tshe dang gzi byin thams cad 'phrogs0/ /za ma tog tu bsdus nas kyang ske/ /tshe yi rig du'adzin rnams la bstim/ /ji ltar 'dod pa gong ltar sbyar / /rdo rje gzi mdangs 'phrog pa zhes bya ba'i mdo'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rjordo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje tshe bsgrub ⑦pa'i le'u zhes bya ste bcu gcig pa'o// // de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa de tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba 'di rgya cher bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di/ /'khor ba thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor can la bshad ⑧par bya/ /nyon cig 'dus pa chen po'i tshogs/ /sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa dag /skyon yon gnyis kyi bye brag las/ /nges par brtags te shes po)pa las/ /blang dor gnyis su sbyar bar bya/ /ri bo chen po 'dus pa'i rtse/ /gangs dkar shel gyi 'dab chen yini/ /seng phrug 'khra nyunyeba'i gnas yin te/ /thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje brag chen gtams pa'i dkyil/ /dgon pa chen po'i phug chen ni/ /gcan chen 'khra ba'i gnas yin te/ /mngon spyod chen po bsgrub 8pa'i gnas/ /dur khrod ngam grog bshung ba'i gnas/ /sum mdo (gegrog 102—165

gle rtsub pa'i ri/ /dur gcan 'khra ba'i gnas yin te/ /chags pa bsgrub 6)pa'i gnas yin no/ /nags tshal dra bas btibs (mipa'i nang / /shin tu btsan zhing 'jigs pa'i ngogs/ /stag gzig 'khra ba'i gnas yin te/ /'dod pa sgrub lapa'i gnas su shis④/ /chu mdo chu 'jigs rgya mtsho'i gling / /chu yi ra bas kun bskor ba/ /chu gcan 'khra ba'i gnas yin pas/ /bya ba med pa'i las la bya'o//der ni yo byad phun sum tshogs/ /ci 'dod bltas te ma thogs par/ /kha na ma tho bcas dang bral/ /'byor pas nan tan mchog bskyed pa/ /khams las gyur pa'i nad chen rnams/ /bcud kyi mchog gis bzlog (5)bya'i phyir/ /rtsi 'am bcu ⑥dam thar pa rnams/ /nyer rdzogs su ni gzhag par bya/ /'dus pa'i nad dang dus kyi nad/ /dug las gyur pa'i nad rnams kyi⑦/ /rkyen gyis bar chad 'byung srid phyir/ /sman dang mkhas pas bcas te sbyar/ /ka pā la dang lcang lor bcas / /ga'u chung la sogs pa'i rdzas/ /phyag rgya che (midang ldan byas la/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i rten du bya/ /sgrub mchog gsang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /skyo ba'i yid rnams bsang 9)phyir dang / /gti mug mun pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ /dung dang 'khar bernga rdza rnga dang / /cang te'u pi bang 7rka ki la/ /snyan par rdzogs pa'i rdzas rnams kun/ /sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rol mo ste/ /nyer rdzogs su ni 'byor par bya/ /shin tu gtams pas tshogs chen ni/ /bla ma rdo rje 'khor lo rgyalatshi/ /gsang ba sbyor ba'i dus chen du/ /sgrub (nyachen sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rnams / /snying rje byams dang dga' snyoms dang / /gdung ba'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /de yang shes dang shes bya yis(7/ /rtsal chen kun du rdzogs pa ni/ /rdo rje snying po 'bru mchog dag /shin tu gtams pas tshogs pa ni/ /bla ma rdo rje 102—166

'khor lo rgyal/ /yon tan mchog gi gter gyur cing / /srid pas zhus kyang zad mi shes/ /rkyen thub dbang lung rdzogs pas ①gzung / /rdo rje kun gyi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /kun sdud kun 'byung 'khrug ②med cing / /nam mkha'i khyon ltar kun la khyab/ /ma ltar byams pa'i yum mchog gzung ni/ /rgyud sbyangs brtul zhugs mchog 'chang zhing / /thogs med the tshom som nyi ༷bral/ /'dzin chags med cing blang dor med/ /brtan ldan gzungs duthub rdo rje ging / /rdo rje drod kyi dus 'dzin cing / /tshig gi 'phen sdud skabs su sbyor/ /yon tan rlabs kyis 'phang bcad de/ /legs nyes dmigs su gal 'dzugs so/ /rdo rje tshig gi gdangs skad can/ /rdo rje mthong ba rnam par dag /ngag gi dbang phyug tshig la mkhas/ /las kyi phreng ba rdzogs byed pa'o(nya/ /'di ltar sbyar ba'i dus chen yang / /nges par brtags te mdo gzung ba/ /rig (7)byed dag gi yan lag las/ /shes par bya ste legs sbyar ba/ /bkra shis lha yi nyi ma dang / /'byor dang dus tshigs bzang po rnams/ /'jig rten mtshan ma'i rtog pa ste/ /brtags (kyen bkra shis mtshan ma 'byung / /dus cha bzhi yi dang po ni/ /mchog nyid mngon spyod ro langs yin/ /dbyar tshe ston sman shis pa ste/ /zhi dang rgyas pa de bzhin sbyar/ /dbang du bsdus pa'ang dbang yin te/ /bam chen gsang ba'i dus su bshad/ /nor 'dod rdzu 'phrul thams cad kyang / /cha bzhir khyab par sbyar ba'o/ /bsgrub 59)pa chen po'i rdzas mchog dag /gal te dus la bab tsogyur na/ /dus 'di dngos grub dus chen te/ /dus 'di mkhas pas yong mi bcag /rnal 'byor las kyi dang po rnams/ /ci ste 'dod pa'i mtshan ma dag /yid 'ong 'byung zhing rtags rnyed pa/ /dam tshig gzungs 'du dus chen yin/ /102—167

sbyangs pas rtsal gyi ①mthar phyin cing / /shes blo'i yon tan tshogs rgyas pa/ /'di dag tshad la bab pa ste/ /dus kyi ②mchog 'di nye bar brtagadu /'di ltar rgyu bzhi ④'byor pa las/ /'bras bu'i dngos por grub pa ste/ /gru dang mnyan pa mkhas pa la/ /bsten ⑤pas rin chen lon ⑥pa 'dra/ /ji srid gnas pa'i rgya mtsho rnams/ /rang bzhin med par kun gcig pa'i/ /bdag med phyogs ༅bral lhun gyis grub/ /gcig las rnam grangs ngang gis med/ /tha snyad dag par yongs chud na/ /nges pa'i don chen de nyid de/ /thams cad dag par 'gyur ba'o(8)/ /bdag dang gzhan du mi gnyis pas/ /bdag nyid bdag gi rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya gzhan na med/ /bdag nyid lhun grub dbang phyug che/ /gang 'dod pa yi dngos po dag /ji lta ba bzhin grub 6)'gyur te/ /rdza yimakhan 'phang lo srub pa ltar/ /gang ltar dmigs pa de ltar 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i khams su gzi che zhing / /'byung chen lnga la dbang sgyur ba'i / /ngo mtshar rtsal gyi khyad par dag /gdon mi za bar 'byung ba yin/ /de ltar brtson pa'i bsgrub (1pa dag /rdzas dang yo byad la sogs te/ /shes dang yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gzhan du reg las med pa ni/ /thams cad tshang bar rdzogs pas na/ /phun sum tshogs zhes 8de la bya/ /gsang chen bsgrub ⑫pa'i las 'di dag /'khor ba'i las dang mthun 8spyad cing / /nyon mongs lnga ltar spyod snang yang / /'od kyis mun pa snang 'gyur ltar/ /skyon ni 8yon tan chen po la/ /g.yo mtshang yidangos grub chen por 'gyur/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i rka bzlog pas/ /mi gnas ye shes rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /gnas rab brtag pa'i gal chen yang / /nam mkha' 'khor lo rdo rje dang / /rin chen zur brgyad ⑩pad+ma'i 102—168

dbyings / /rgya gram la sogs 'dra bar brtag① /sa gzhi ②yang ni de bzhin te//ri bo brtsegs dang bzur ba dang / /de bzhin bsgreng dudang gtams pa'i tshul/ /'dra bar mkhas pas brtag par bya/ /de yang rigs kyi khyad par ni/ /lnga la sogs pa so so yi/ /gnas gnas dag tu rtogs nas ni/ /nor bu rin chen de bsgrub bya/ /skyon gyi duganas dag spang ba ni/ /gshin rje gdug pa'i gdung rtse dang du/ /ma mo rngam pa'i spar shad dang / /srin mo ngus pa'i mchi rjes dang / /gnod sbyin khro bo'i rbab shul dang / /'byung po rkun po 'jol la sogs/ /gnas kyi skyon durnams dgra dang rkun⑦/ /mkhas pas nges par spang bar bya/ /kha na ma thor bcas pa dang / /nyams pa las byung nyen dang bral/ /ma dag pa yi yo byad rnams/ /gdug can pang ⑧du 'ongs pa ltar/ /wa yi brtul zhugs chen po yi/ /bskal pas bshugs te spang bar 6)bya/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs sam/ /bkra shis mtshan ma 'byung ba dag /dga' ba skye bar ⑩'gyur ba yiyi / /yid 'ong gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /rtsod pa nye bar zhi bya'i phyir/ /snying rje ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsgrub 8pa brnag pa mthar dbyung (nyephyir/ /rgyal po rten dang 'khor bcas la/ /bden pas bsgo tsoba'am yang bslang tsob/ /dgongs shig thugs rje rgyal ba'i lha/ /lha klu gnod sbyin sde dpung bcas/ /gangs ri rtse dang rin chen ri/ /kun dga' ldum ra skyed tsomos tshal mtsho rdzing lu ma 'bab chu'i gnas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten thams cad kyi(na/ /gang dag bdag por gyur pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdag nyid kyis/ /sa 'di lhun gyis grub bya'i phyir/ / 'dzam gling yi grub pa'i sa slong tunyen/ /'khor dang bcas pa 'dir 'khod (zhu )la/ /rin chen gter gyi zhunyas gzhi bslang / /zhes 102—169

pas rin chen sna tshogs kyis/ /sa la 0)gnas pas de mgu ②bya/ /des ni bdag gir de (5)'gyur zhing / /nyes pa de dang bral ba yin/ /byang chub spyod ④pa g.yo ba dang / /bsod nams dga' ba skyed pa la/ /shes ldan rdzu 'phrul can gyi bu / /ma skrag phrag dog yong ma skye/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi sgrub (5)pa po/ /bdud 'dul phyag rgya rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /ru dra tshogs kyi rgol ba la/ /skyes bu las kyi don bgrangs te/ /don gyi dbang po'i phyir sbran pa/ /rgyal ba dbang phyug thams cad kyis/ /don mchog yang dag mdzad pa'i tshe/ /skyes bu rtsal gyi (6)khyad par las/ /'di tshe dpang mkhyen dmigs 'byed ma/ /sngon tshe dpal chen gar dbang gis/ /ru dra sde bzhi bsgral nas ni/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyas mdzad nas / /'gro drug thugs rjes bsgral 57)ba ltar/ /rnal 'byor sa la sbyor (kyetshe 'dir / /lha mos mkhyen par mdzad nas kyang / /bde chen sa la bgrod pa'i tshe//ru dra'i rgol ba 'byung ba 'am/ /spyan ldan khyod kyis dpang mdzod cig /sgrub yonyepa'i las mchog khyad par gyis/ /brtsam par bya ba'i las rnams kun/ /mtshan mas mtshan ma gzhom pa'i phyir/ /ro lnga'i mtshan ma brtag ⑩par bya/ /dge bar gyur na der gnas bya/ /gal te shis yonyapar ma gyur na/ /skyes bu thabs la mkhas pa yis/ /gnan skonam spo ba'i las kyis 6)sbyar/ /der ni bsod nams gter ldan phyir/ /rin chen lnga la sogs pa'i rdzas/ /sa gzhi gter chen rgyas par bya/ /bkra shis mchog tu bsngags pa yin/ /sa zhag spos chen rnam lnga'i khu//bsres pas kun du gru bzhi ni/ /maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa'i dbyibs 'dra la/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags ldan pas/ /mtshan ma'i dngos po kun sbyangs te/ /rgyal ba bzhugs skapa'i rten du bya/ /rdo rje byin brlabs tso'abyung gnas dang / /102—170

gnas rnams shin tu brtan bya'i phyir/ /mchog gi sbyor ba dag pa yis/ /sa gzhi gzung zhing byin gyis brlabs0)/ /de dang der ni sa sbyangs te/ /thig gis yul bcad ②skabs dag tu/ /rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i pho brang der/ /rdo rje drag po'i ging chen gyis/ /lce pog gnag po'i dud pas bdug④ /rgyun mi 'chad du byas nas ni/ /khro bo drag po'i sngags zlos shing / /rdo rje khro bo'i stabs kyis bskor / /shes rab yum gyi 'jo tshul gyi/ /rnam gnyis rdzas kyi 'de gu dag /srin bal le'u ⑤sbyar ba yis/ /kun du zla ba'i thig le bya/ /rdo rje rgyal po 'phags rnams kyis/ /so so'i sngags dang rtsa ba'i rgya/ /so so'i stang stabs sbyar nas kyang / /de dag gnas su byin gyis rlobayi/ /gsang ba'i don la zhugs bya'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i las kyi sngon logs su/ /bstan ⑦pa skyong ba'i mgon po la/ /sbyin mchod bsrung (geba'i las chen bcol6)/ /gzhal yas gnas kyi phyi rol du/ /mgon po chaganas pa'i rten gzhi dag /rin chen 'bras sam 'byung khungs sam/ /shing ngam ba so de dag las/ /lugs sam phyag rgya'i gzugs byas yonyete/ /mgon po bzhi ru mnga' gsol te/ /gnas kyi sgo srung tsoso bar bya/ /ri rab gling bzhi'i phyogs phyogs nas/ /rdo rje gsang bdag dbang gi mthus/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i tha tshig can/ /mthu chen mgon po sde bzhi rnams / /so so'i bgegs ris yi 'dul la mkhas/ /chos skyong longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /phrin 〉las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pas/ /rigs bzhi kha dog so sor gsal/ /rang rtags lha yi tsomatshan ma thogs/ /phyi 'khor skyong ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor rtsal sbyong gis/ /rang rang 'khor rnams thub par mdzod/ /bsgrub yipa'i rtsal 'di mthar dbyung zhing / /rkyen gyi (1 bar 102—171

chad bsal ①ba dang / /gsang ba'i man ngag spyad pa'i phyir/ /'jug srid dam sri gnon ②par bya/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag tu/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i gnas dag tu/ /dngos grub ③chu la rdul 'jug cing / /khro bo ④rgyu chen kun 'dus nas/ /gsad (nyecing gnon ⑥pa'i las bya ste/ /ri rab chen po'i ⑦rmang du gtang ⑧/ /ya ma ra 6)dza'i zas su sbyin/ /chu srin 'bar ba'i kha ru brdzang kyi/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas gnon⑩/ /bdun rgyud rigs 8ni brlag 'gyur nas/ / nams kyang 8ldang bar mi nus te/ /byang chub sems ni skyes na btang ⑫/ /badz+ra muṣ+ṭi tso / ma ma ba shaṃ ku ru nan/ sum̐ bhā ⑩ni sum̐ bhā ⑫rna()ske/ de ltar drag po'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgo nas phyi rol bar khang du/ /mkha' 'dra'i khung bu byas nas ni/ /dug dang rtsub pa'i phye ma dang / /khrag sna tshogs dang mi ro yis/ /shin tu bsub 0cing gnon 0par bya/ /de nas rdo rje nang dag tu/ /seng ge'i lta bas bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje gom pas phyogs nas ni/ /khro mig 'bar bas phyir bltas te/ /'gying bag tshul du brjid pa yis/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje spar nas ni/ /phyi nang rdul chen bsal ( )bar bya/ /hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi ( nya'ajig rten na/ /skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal dang / /yod mthong snang grags ji snyed pa/ /kun kyang 'bar ba khrag 'thung (nyeste/ /rngam chen gtum thung she dag 'bar/ /dur khrod dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /rak+ṣa yak+ṣa he ru ka /rak+ta kro dhi dz+wa la kha/ /ha la ha la tiṣ+ṭha phaṭa/ /zhes ()pas khro bo rol pa yi/ /stabs dang ma mo'i rngam tshul dang / /phra limen lhags pa'i rngam stabs kyisal/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje dkrigs pa'i phreng ba dang glu/ /tho ba lcags kyu 'bar ba dang / /'khor lo ral gri la sogs rdzas/ /102—172

kun gyi phyag rgya mtshan mas bskor/ /de ①las 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang / / mig las ②'bar ba'i me mched ①pas/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'dis/ /dmigs sam dngos su sbyar nas kyang / /'bar ba drag po'i yi ge las/ /sreg pa'i dpal chen gur du gtams/ /r+ghaṃ ro rdo rje me yi ri/ /lhun po 'bar ba'i rtse brgyad la/ /'bar ba'i lha brgyad bsgyel nas kyang / /dbang chen rdo rje bka' dhisdod gnas/ /shin tu mi bzad du'abar ba yisaX/ /gtum chen ha la rngam pa'i gzugs/ /lha chen khyab 'jug lpags ⑦bshus nas/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i na bza' bsnams⑤/ /gshin rje ma traṃ ⑨'bar ba yi/ /ro dbyug chen po phyag na 'phyar/ / phra men ⑩dgu khri mang po dag /'bar ba'i tshogs ni gtibs thag bcad7/ /gang la cis 'dul der ston pa/ /tsit+ta tso'abar ba'i me phreng gis/ /do shal mgur chu phreng tsobs sbrengs/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong ⑫/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'khyil cing tso'aphro/ /nam mkha'i khams kun me dpung gtibs/ /rdo rje 'khor lo me lce 'phro/ /dur khrod dgon pa'i sa phyogs dag /me yi ri bo 'bar ba la/ /me yi yi dgas ⑩ma dag las/ /gang yang gnas par mi phod pa/ /steng gi me lce 'bar ba ni/ /'og gi phyogs su 'phro zhing 'khrug /'og gi me lce 'bar ba yang / /gyel du 'khyil zhing steng du thal / /me lce dgu phreng 'bar ba dag /'ur chem 'chad pas 'thab cing 'khrug /dur khrod me ni smug cing 'bar/ /zhe sdang 'joms pas mthing nag 'tshub / /nga rgyal sreg pas ser nag 'phro/ /'dod chags mnyam yonapas dmar nag 'phro/ /phrag ( dog sreg tu)pas ljang nag 'khyil/ /gti mug sel bas smug nag 'khyil/ /'bar chen klong gi 'khor los gtams( )/ /dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal ha la ha 102—173

la ro/ / me'i ri 6)lag chu'i phyag rgya yis/ /gnas sam dkyil 'khor bskor bar bya/ /chos nyid bdal ba'i nam mkha' la/ /ye shes lnga yi 'byung chen brtsegs / /kun gzhi bdal (snyeba'i nam mkha' la/ /bskyed lama'i 'byung chen rnam lnga brtsegs/ /phroṃ las rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal/ /mtha' dang dbus med kun du khyab/ /ta la'i bskyed cing gser tsong dril/ /zla gam dmar ④po dbang gi rgya(5)/ /rbu khaṃ traṃ kha la ti phroṃ/ /zhes pas rnam lnga'i byug pa yis/ /gtor zhing kun du byug par bya'o/ /sgrub mchog skyong ba'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /rdo rje tshig gis 67btab nas ni/ /rgyal sras rig ⑦'dzin bka' 'khor lo/ /'bras bur red phyir byin gyis rlob(gyi/ /rdo rje rgyal dbang chen po des/ /sgrib pa sreg 99)pa'i yi ge ni/ /phreng bar byas te gnas su 'phro/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhag stebi/ /rig 'dzin pho mo'i mtshan mas gdab7/ /rnam lnga'i byug pas kun la gtor/ /rtags kyi phyag rgya lag tu sbyin/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs su spyad/ /'jig rten skyong yistetshul thams cad ni/ /sgyu ma yin phyir shin tu yang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod tshul dag /ji ltar 'byung ba de ltar spyad/ /e ma dur khrod gsang ba yi/ /rmad byung zhing khams dga' (stetshal 'dir / /skal mildan dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras/ /'dus pas tshogs pa'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /e ma'o bodaga' mchog bde chen grogs/ /dam tshig srog gi lu gu rgyud/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa yis/ /sprul pa'i gshog sprugs grwa ⑩rgyas pas1 tsho/ /tshogs gnyis rtsal gyis brlabs pho spar nas/ /chos nyid mkha' la lding bar rigs/ /a yaṃ dza lo khaṃ lha na/ /de ring phan cad 17rgyal ba'i sras/ /dbang phyug yin pas ci tsho 1bder spyod/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod bskyed pa dang / /102—174

dug rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur ba yi/ /māṃ ①las skyes pa'i ye shes kyis/ /zangs kyi dngos po 'ju 'dul bya/ /dam rdzas yo byad longs spyod rnams/ /gong nas cha gsum so so nas/ /shan ma 'dres par sta ②gon bya/ /phyi yi cha la 'jug pa yi / /mchod sbyin spel ba'i yo byad bya/ /de gnyis gnyis pa'i cha dag las/ /mjug (migi rgyal chos longs spyod bya/ /rmad 'byung ④nang gi cha dag ni/ /thams cad gcig tu byas nas ni/ /ras sam shing khyon dag tu ni/ /bsdus te bsgrub ⑤pa'i rdzas kyis dgab/ /byug (6)pa chen pos de la gtor/ /lce pog ⑦nag po'i dud pas bdug /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya dang / /'bar ba'i lta bas brjid par bya / /tsham ngam chen po'i stabs kyis bskor/ /sna tshogs bsur (kyigyi dri chen gdon / /de nas rgyal po'i byin brlabs yi)kyis/ /yo byad de dag bdud rtsi lnga/ /dam rdzas ngo bor yibasdus nas ni/ /de la 'bru lnga'i 'phro 'du las/ /zhu nas phyag mtshan rnam lngar 'bar/ /dag pa'i bdud rtsi chen por zhu/ /shes rab lha mo rig yi7'dzin ma/ /bzhi 'am yang na rnam pa 7brgyad/ /rdzas sam yo byad rang bzhin pas/ /zas mchog gar gyis spyir blangs te/ /longs spyod spel ba'i dbyangs (nye'adis bstenatso/ /bdag cag rig 'dzin shes rab ma/ /rgyal sras lha yi dngos grub 'dzin/ /dgyes pas tshim pa'i longs spyod dag /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu 'am/ /dpag bsam shing ljon 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rmos lo tog rgyas pa yiltar/ /rnal 'byor longs spyod chen po dag /nam mkha'i khams su gtibs nas kyang / /rdo rje dgyes tshogs kun 'dus nas/ /skal ldan rnams kyis rab sprul cig /rdo rje gar gyi dbang sgyur yinas/ /sgeg pas lha mo 'jo tshul dag /'dud cing sdod pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /rol mo'i tshogs kyis 102—175

dga' ba skyed①/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra lā sri ②/ hūm̐/ badz+ra mā le ① ṭ+wāṃ 〉rtsi/ badz+ra gī ti ⑤ hrīḥtrīḥkhyabadz+ra mṛ t+ya ⑦ aḥ.aḥkhru/ rdo rje kurma'i ⑨thabs mchog gis/ /rdo rje glu 'dis gzi byin bskyed⑩/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi longs spyod 'di/ /rtsi mchog bcud kyi snying po ste/ /gzi mdangs rgyas par byed pa'i mchog /bkrag 'dzin gzugs mchog dran pa'i dpal/ /rdo rje can gyi byin stobs kyis/ /skal yib can gyi zas su bya/ /skal med rnams kyi dug tu 'gyur/ /dper na sbrul la 'o ma bzhin/ /sa ma ya dzaḥtsoku su tsa ma ma/ /smug zil lha mo mnyen gsal ma/ /rlan rnams bdud rtsir sgyur byed ma/ /bdud rtsi chu rgyun dngos grub 'dzin/ /rang gnyer las skal chu rgyun 'bebs/ /shing lo 'dab las 8bdud rtsir ⑫sgyur / /'bru thog 8sna tshogs dngos grub 'dzin/ /rang gnyer las skal 'bras bur skyed/ /lha mo sra brtan tsodabang sgyur ma/ /khu ba bcud las bdud rtsir 'gyur / /bdud rtsi zhun chen dngos grub 'dzin/ /rang gnyer las skal brtan ⑩par byed/ /rdo rje lha mo shel mdog ma/ /nyi zer bdud rtsir sgyur byed ma/ /gsal ba mdangs kyi dngos grub 'dzin/ /rang gnyer las skal gzi byin skyed/ /lha mo khro gnyer sngo bsangs ma/ /dur khrod rdzas las bdud rtsir sgyur/ /sha chen sna tshogs dngos grub 'dzin/ /rang gnyer (nyalas skal byin 'bebs ma() rtsi yi lha mo blo gros ma/ /rtsi thog bdud rtsir sgyur byed ma/ /rtsi ()mchog kun gyi dngos grub 'dzin/ /rang gnyer las skal tshim byed ma/ /sman gyi lha mo nor gyi rgyun / /dug rnams bdud rtsir sgyur byed ma/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi 0dngos grub 'dzin / /rang gnyer las skal 'di kun yang / /rdo rje glu yi ( )brten nas ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i yo byad du/ /rol mos dga' ston ( )longs spyod bya/ /de 102—176

nas las kyi gnas skabs 'dir/ /phyi nang mthun ①'jug bka' sdod pa'i/ /gshin rje chos kyi phyag rgya yis/ /bran gyi bya bar dbang bsdus nas/ /phyi mtshams bsrung ②bar dbang bskur te/ /'bur phyiram lugs sam ri mo 'am/ /ci 'dra bar ni byas nas kyang / /phyi khyams sgo yi phyi rol du/ /ma he khri la bzhag nas ni/ /mthun 0pa'i rdzas kyis ⑤mgu byas la/ /de tshe 'di yis bskor ba ⑥byam/ /gsang chen lhun grub pho brang nas/ /las kyi gshin rje'i pho brang nas/ /bcom ldan chos rjes bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin rig ⑦'dzin sgrub pa pos /bka' gsang dugazhung chen 'di sgrub cing / /yang dag don la nges 'jug na/ /'di dag nor bu rin chen te/ /'di la rtod cing bar gcod pa/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po kun/ /khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog yin gyis6)/ /rnam par smin pa'i chos shod la/ /gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor pas/ /bla med 'bras bur ma gyur tsher/ /sa 'di yan chad ma gtang bar/ /dpal chen mi pham yibaka' ma 'da'/ /bdag cag ye nas gnyis med de/ /de 0tsam don gyi dbyings su gcig /phyi 8rol skyong ba'i mu ran la/ rdo rje yal dam thub par mdzod/ /badz+ra ya ma rā dza sa ma ya snyi(nya/ zhes pas gshin rje mnas bsgags te/ /gal te 'das na kho bdag 'tshig /brtsam par bya ba'i las chen po/ /dngos grub 'byung bar byed pa'i rten/ /phyag rgya che dang gzugs mchog gi/ /stegs bu legs par sbyangs na 'grub/ /mtshon pas khrid par byed pa yi/ /rdul tshon 'dus byas rgyu rnams la/ /brnyan ma'i dkyil 'khor bshad bgyi tsob/ /so sor brtags te bshad bgyi ba/ /brtan zhing ngos 'jam khang bu la/ /'bur khung khod snyoms 'phang mtho ba'i/ /kha dog lnga yi gzugs byas nas/ /des ni 102—177

mtshan ma'i dngos grub ster/ /shing shun ras sam dur khrod kyi/ /zhing chen ras la kha dog lngas/ /phyag rgya 'bar ba'i gzugs bris na/ /de yang mtshan ma 'byung ba'i rten/ /rdo dang shel rdo la sogs pa①/ /dung ngam ba so'i rgyu las ni//mkhas pas 'bur du btod ②byas nas/ /mtshan ma 'byung ba'i rten du 'gyur/ /gser dngul rin chen la sogs pa/ /zangs lcags khar ③ba'i rgyu dag las/ /mkhan gyis blugs te ma nyams na/ /de yang mtshan ma'i rten du 'gyur/ /blak+ṣa stibyang chub shing la sogs/ /rgyud shing yal ga mnyen pa las/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs de legs sbyar na/ /de yang rten du mkhas pas bshad/ /mnyen cing sbyin pa'i mchog rnams la/ /bzhin dang 'dril khugs legs sbyar te/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs byas na/ /de yang rten (5)pa'i 'os su 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa'i rgyu rnams la/ /yi ge'am yang na mtshan rtags sam/ /ming ngam thig ler rdzas la bri/ /bsgrubs na mtshan ma'i rten du 'gyur/ /de las re zhig (6)'dir bshad pa')/ /stegs bu la brten lamatshan ma dag /bsgrub pa'i don du brtag gzung (9)ba/ /brtsam ⑩pa'i thabs ni 'di lta ste/ /gong du smos pa'i rgyu rnams la / /stegs bu mdzes shing mnyam byas te/ /kun du gru bzhi cha mnyam 4sprel/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /me long lta bur snying por bya/ /snang byung yang dag byin brlabs 7can/ /ye shes rang byung grub pa'i rdzas/ /bka' gsang rmad byung pho brang du/ /dur khrod rdzas lngas skyang 1nyanal bya/ /rdo rje srad bu'i thig gdab pa/ /cho ga rnam par bshad bgyi ba/ /gsang ba'i lcang lo 'khril mangs tsodang / /rdo rje rgyun thag la sogs pa/ /ring thung maṇ+ḍal 'khor khyud la/ /'jur bemadud can du ma gyur pa'i/ /sum sgril snyoms pa'i yitshad ldan la/ /ye 102—178

shes lnga yi rang bzhin gsal/ /rgyu de byin gyis brlab 6)pa'i thabs thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba yi/ /yi ge gnyis kyi 'phro 'du las/ /dkar dmar 'od kyi gser phreng 'phro/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i thabs kyis da②/ /byang chub sems 'dren 'khal niba'i yum/ /nges par brtags te 'dir bzung ba/ /mtshan ldan bkra shis gsang ba'i yum/ /smin dkyugs ④ring la lag sor phral/ /tshigs mig rlum la phra bar bshad/ /kha nas ut+pal ngad ldang zhing / /lus la ga pur tsan+dan dri/ /yid 'ong 4)mtshan ldan rked skabs phyed/ /skra 'jam mthon mthing chagayas su 'khyil/ /so dkar tshags dam dkar dmar phyed/ /mig gi dkyus ring smin dkyugs dulegs/ /zar ma'i me tog rgyas 'dra'i spyan/ /dpral ba'i dbyes che 6)spa mtshams ⑩'khyug /sna bzang mdog gsal pad+ma'i rigs / /lus drang ske ring sems ma'i tshul/ /nu ma'i dkyil mtho zla rgyas 'dra/ /sha dkar tshags dam 'khril bag chagasatshom/ /khong dal 'gro na gom pa 'jam/ /skad ni ngang pa gzhon nu sgrogasatso/ /cir yang mdzes pa'i stabs tshul ldan/ /skyes bu bla mas yum du gzung / /gzungs mar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /yum gyi phung po gnas lngar 7ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sa bon lnga/ /'phro 'du gsal bar gyur pa dang / /sangs rgyas byin brlabs dbang bskur rdzinas/ /bde gshegs yum lnga'i sku mchog gsal/ /rdo rje yab la'ang de bzhin te/ /de ltar gsal bar gyur pa dang / /yum gyi mkha' la me ri sgomatso/ /gsang ba dbugs kyi zla gam la/ /byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du bya/ /gzugs brnyan ji ltar gsal ba bzhin/ /yum gyi mkha' la de bzhin no/ /de nas rdo rje tshig 'di yis / /lus kyi yumal nges par bsgo/ /shes rab lha mo gsang ba'i yum/ /102—179

'dod dgur 0sgyur ba'i 'phrul mo che/ /chags pa'i tshul gyis ②thabs la 'dud/ /g.yon du 'khril cing g.yas su 'khyud/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis zla gam sbyor/ /gsang ba'i byang chub sems 'dren pa/ /khyod ni lha mo rgyal ba'i sras/ /rang bzhin chos kyi mtshan ldan ma/ /rdo rje las kyi yum yin gyis / /gsang ba'i las rnams kun byos shig④ /lag pa 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i tshogs bkod de(snye/ /gsang ba'i byang chub dkar dmar 'di/ /thig le yi ge'i ngo bor gdabakyi/ /las kyi rdo rje 'bar ba yi/ /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya yis/ /byang chub sems kyi thig 'di drongs/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i las 'di drongs/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i las 'di gyis/ /oṃ tsan+d+ra dha ra hrī ⑦zhes pa'i/ /gsang ba'i thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rdzas mchog 'bar ba'i thig le yis/ /gnas lnga dag gi gzhal yas su/ /gsang ba (shethabs kyi thig le bya/ /srad bu'i sbyor ba de rdzogs nas/ /gol sgrib rtag chad skyon bral ba'i/ /che chung ya yo med pa yi/ /rdo rje dbu ma'i thig 'di dgye/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhal yas su/ /mi dmigs postabadal ba'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /ye shes lnga yi thig 'phros pas/ /bde chen rnam thar phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /kun gzhi nam mkha'i gzhal yas su/ /nyon mongs rtog pa'i maṇ+ḍal la/ / ting 'dzin tso'od zer thig 'phros pas/ /phyag rgya rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /mkha' dbyings gsang ba'i gzhal yas su/ /zla gam pad+ma'i maṇ+ḍal las17/ /byang chub sems kyi thig 'phros pas/ /ye shes sems dpa' tshigasal ba'i tshogs/ /bkra shis dben pa'i gzhal yas su/ /mtshan ma rten gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ /rdo rje srad bu'i thig 'phros pas/ /cho 'phrul gzugs brnyan phyag rgya 'bar/ /stong gsum gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rmad byung rdo 102—180

rje'i thig 'gyed na/ /gsang ba'i dam la gnas pa yi/ /'byung po skye bo gdol pa can/ /rdo rje rtsal gyi hūṃ ring ①las/ /rdo rje mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub/ /phyogs mtshams ⑤bla 'og khro bos gtamasal/ /'bar ba gsang ba'i mtshams bzung duste/ /phyi rol sde pa'i 'drul durnams gcad/ /rdo rje mtshon cha 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /sreg yidang 'joms pa'i drag shul can/ /rdo rje lce yis 'dir brdeg ④bya/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i gzhal yas su/ /rdo rje dpal be'u 'od kyi thig /me long ye shes rang bzhin can/ /rnal 'byor can gyis gdab par bya de bzhin rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhalakhru/ /pad+ma zla ba ⑨'khor lo yiti/ /dpag med nam mkha'i gzhal yas su/ /rigs kyi dpal be'u 'od kyi thig /ye shes bzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /rnal 'byor can gyis gdab par bya/ /rdo rje mkha' la 'khor lo bskor/ /thabs dang shes rab zung ya bzhis/ /so so'i phyag tu gnas nas ni/ /nam mkha' yidabus kyi snying po la/ /srad bu bzhi yi rgya gram ⑫brel/ /de nas rdo rje brtan (nyepa'i sa/ /dbus kyi pho 8brang dgu pa ni/ /rdo rje srad 'bu'i thig chen gyis/ /phyag rgya bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /che chung med par snyoms par bya/ /'dir ni rdo rje mu khyud bdun/ /'byung ba'i rim pa tso drug bar du/ /'khor lo drug brtsegs snying por 'bar/ /gru chad rtsibs ⑩mchan 8me ri 'phro/ /mu khyud tshar (nyegasum 'bar ba'i phreng / /bar khyams bzhis mdzes phyi khyams dang / /lngar gsal sgo dgu shar rdu brtsegs/ /pho brang de yi duganas gnas su/ /phyag rgya'i tshul rnams 'byung ba ni/ /mu khyud mtha' zad yan chad du/ /yab yum drug cu khri)rtsa zhi khri)yi/ /cho 'phrul dam tshig tshad med pa/ /rol ba 'jigs byed 'jigs byed che/ /ka tsa li la sogs par bri/ /102—181

de bzhin za byed yab yum bzhi/ /las kyi lha ste he ru ka /'khor lo tha 0)ma'i rtsibs la dgod/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya dag /gru chad phyi dang phyinang la dgram / /hūṃ chen bcu yi yab yum dag /shin tu mdzes par dang po la'o/ /de nyid la ni ma brgyad dang / /shing chen bcwa ①brgyad rgyas par dgod④/ /gnyis pa'i khyams (snyel mkha' 'gro brgyad/ /shugs 'gro brgyad kyang de bzhin no//gsum pa'i khyams la phra (6)men brgyad/ / de bzhin 'bar ma brgyad ⑦rnams bris(8)ske/ /bzhi pa'i khyams la phor thogs brgyad/ /de bzhin srin mo gzhong thogs brgyad/ /kun du mdzes par bri bar bya/ /lnga pa'i khyams ni tha ma la/ /rdo rje slas dang bran mo dang / /pho nya la sogs rgyas par dgram/ /de yang tshul du dgod pa ni/ /gong ma dag ni rgyu rnams las/ /ka tsa li la sogs pa dang / /ji ltar 'byor pa de ltar bri/ /mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad dang / /rmad du byung ba'i rdzas mchog dang / /rdo rje gsang ba'i rim gyis 6)bkod/ /rdo rje gsang sgo 7bye nas ni/ /ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs nas/ /rang bzhin yul nas phab nas ni/ /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor der rdzogs bya/ /'dir 11yang don gyi khyad par gyis/ /rig (nya'adzin che ba'i sa spar (steb/ /shar gyi gdan gyi khyad par la/ /rdo rje seng ges bteg tu )'khor lo/ /zla ba nyi ma g.yas g.yon gyi/ /zhabs rten 8tshul gyi maṇ+ḍal ni/ /rdo rje rgyal po yab yum bzhugs / / lho yi tshagadan gyi khyad par la/ /glang chen rdo rjes btegs ()'khor lo / /pad+ma g.yas g.yon zhabs brten tshul/ /rdo rje rgyal ba yab yum bzhugs/ /byang gi gdan nye gyi khyad par la/ /pad+ma (1rdo rje bteg ( )rgya gram/ /rdo rje kurma yab yum bzhugs/ /nub bam phyogs sam mtshams gzhan du/ /gzhi rnams 102—182

gcig tu gyur pa la/ /maṇ+ḍal rgyun ma chad pa la/ /rdo rjes gtams shing sbrel byas nas/ /pad+ma phyogs gcig cher 'bar ba/ /kha dog 'bar ba'i 'od kyis dkrigs / /rtsal 'phang che chung khyad par gyis/ /skal 6)dang ldan nam mi ldan pa'i / /la la dag la zla ba ni/ /rangs pa'i gdan gyi mtshan ma la/ /de yang rtsal 'phang che chung la/ /la la rtse gsum rdo rjes mtshan/ /la la rdo rje phyed ②mas mtshan / /la la ma rangs zla gam kha/ /nang du bstan pas mtshan par bya'o/ /la la rtses du'abigs rnam par mtshan/ /la la pad+ma brtsegs pas mtshan/ /la la dag la mtshan ma med/ /la las gdan de mi non te/ /nar ma gang zag mi yi dhirdzas / /so so'i bde ba'i thabs su sbyar/ /kun du bde bar sbyar ba'i phyir/ /pi par stan zhes grags pa ste/ /kun du khyab par lus bder sbyar/ /rmad byung sgrub ⑤pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'jug dang dngos grub gsol ⑥ba dang / /dbang bskur (7ba yi las rnams bya/ /'dod par bya ba bsgrub (kyepa dang / /gtor ma la sogs rdzas kyi rnams/ /cha gsum dag la bgos dzi)nas kyang / /gcig ni sbyin sreg tilas mchog bya/ /gcig la rnal 'byor longs spyod gter/ /gcig ni mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs bskyang / /gnas su bkra shis la sogs kyis / /sgrub yi7pa rdzogs pas mthar dbyung ngo / /dur khrod gsang mchog dbyings nyid la/ /dkyil 'khor dgu brtsegs ()dpal gyi rgya/ /ye shes dgu yi khong gseng gsal/ /me ri 'od kyi thig thag gcad4ste/ /'khor lo tshogs chen bsgrub pa'i sa/ /rnal 'byor rtsal mchog can gyi gnas/ /sgrub pa yirtsa yi skidakyil 'khor deyi/ /dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi mdo/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las tshogs chen 'dus pa'i bsgrub hu tsho102—183

lugs kyi le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa des 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs rig 6)'dzin thams cad nges par 'grub par 'dod na ⑧'di ltar rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin thams cad kun rdzogs nas/ /rigs kyi khyad par 'di dag dbye/ /so so'i rigs su bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje can la dpal be'u ni/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje 'bar ba'o/ /de bzhin rin chen rin chen te/ /pad+ma dmar po 'od kyi dkyil/ /las ni kun du rgya gram 'bar/ /de bzhin rin chen 'khor lor ①'bar/ /so so'i rigs rnams gtsor gzhag ste/ /'khor ni de bzhin mi 'gyur bar④/ /rnam par bkod de legs sbyar nas/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa/ /bsgrub ⑤dang sgrub ༅chen rdzogs par bsgrub/ /ting 'dzin rtsal gyi khyad par ni/ /so so'i rigs ni gang yin pa/ /ting 'dzin bye brag mang po la/ /yid kyi sbyor ba gsal bar bya/ /des ni rig ⑦'dzin gang 'dod pa/ /gsol ⑧bar nges par 'grub 6)pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje rig ⑩'dzin ⑩bsgrub 7pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad ni blang yidor med par rig par bya'o/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bzang ngan rtog skipa'i tshig dang bral/ /bdag dang gzhan du dbyer med de8/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang gnyis su med/ /102—184

ces gsungs so/ /de nas 'khor der 'dus par gyur pa'i rig ①'dzin mi'i thod pa can mang po dag rnam par bkod ②pa rnal 'byor gyi gral nas langs te/a la la ho ②zhes bya ba'i dusgra chen po brjod nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la bdag cag shin tu gnas par 'tshal na/bdag cag durnams kyi dam tshig ni bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gsungs so zhes gsol dupa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi'i thod pa can rnams rang rang ji ltar dga' ba'i dam tshig ⑦rnams spobs ⑧pa skyed la phul cig ces gsungs pa las/ 'dod chags kyi rig ⑨'dzin bram ze mi'i thod pa can rdo rje thal ba'i dbyangs zhes ⑩bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi dam tshig ni 'di lta ste/ ma dang sring 7mo bu mo dang / /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gyi/ /bud med thams cad thams cad la/ /'dod pa'i chags pa ci spyad kyang / /yang dag rig na 8mi gos so/ /zhes gsol to/ /de nas rig 'dzin rak+ṣa mi'i thod pa can zhes bya ba des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi dam tshig 'di lta ste/ / bdag ni gsod la dga' ba ste / /()sems can thams cad bsad nas kyang / /zag pa mi gtsang snyigs tsom dang / /mi sha la sogs thams cad kun/ /zos na dam tshig mchog lags te/ /mthu dang gzi byin 'phel bar 'gyuratso/ /bdag gi dam tshig yide lags so/ / zhes gsol to/ /⑩de nas yang gnod sbyin rig 'dzin yak+ṣa mi'i thod pa can zhes bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi dam tshig 'di lta ste/ mi yi bdag po thams cad la/ /'dod pa thams cad 'phrog pa dang / /gser la sogs pa brkus 4)spyad kyang / /yang dag rig na (temi gos te//102—185

'dod pa grub pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /bdag gi dam tshig de lags so/ /zhes gsol to/ /de nas yang mu stegs rig 'dzin 'od srung yo)ral pa can zhes bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi dam tshig ni 'di lta ste / mi yi mgo bo bcad nas kyang / /bzang dang ngan ni bye brag rnams/ /rig pas brtags te shes byas nas/ /bzang ba'i rtags can bsten bya ste/ /dkar po ra ri lcang lo can/ /'di dag rtag tu sus (mi'achang ba/ /'dod pa thams cad 'grub pa ste/ /rgol ba thams cad 'joms par nus/ /yid bzhin nor bu ci 'dra bar/ / de yi ③yon tan 'di las 'byung ④/ /bdag gi dam tshig de lags so/ /zhes gsol to/ /de nas yang bram ze sha la dga' ba dang /sha za mo'i rig 'dzin ⑤rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi dam tshig ni (6)'di lta ste/ ba glang khyi sha rta sha dang / /mi sha glang chen sha la sogs/ /sha rnams 'dra bar gtsang sme med/ /zos na yon tan sna tshogs 'grub/ /bdag gi dam tshig de lags so/ /zhes gsol to/ /de nas yang srin mo'i rig ⑦'dzin khrag 'phrog (8)ma zhes bya ba la sogs pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 6)dam tshig ni 'di lta ste/ srog chags sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsad pa'i khrag ni dron mo dang / /'thungs yon gzi byin 'bar bar 'gyur/ /bdag gi dam tshig de lags so(nya/ /zhes gsol to/ /lha mo klu mo yo rigs ngan mo la sogs pa bud med kyi tshogs thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag cag rnams kyi dam tshig 'di lta ste/ bro gar yi glu tshig chen po ni/ /thams cad bsten ⑩pa'i mchog lags te / /bro yi 'jo tshul stabs chen dang / /glu yi snyan dngags don yibasgrags 102—186

nas / /yid kyi dbang po thams cad 'phrog /bsten pa'i thabs kyis 'khrig ①spyod pa/ /'di ni dga' ba'i dam tshig ste/ /bdag cag rnams kyi dam tshig lagasal/ /zhes gsol to/ /de nas rig 'dzin de kun gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ②rnams kyi spyi'i dam tshig ni 'di lta ste / dkar nag las ni ci spyad kyang / /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu dang / /rab 'bring tha dad bye brag med/ /de bzhin 'di la bde sdug gam/ /dge dang mi dge'i ①rtsod pa med/ /rnon po'i mtshon gyis ④gcad du med/ /ci phyir rnam pa bdun stong pas/ /thogs pa med pa'i don phyir ro/ /srog kyang bcad cing gsad (snyedu med/ /ci phyir rdzas 'di 'jigs ⑥pas so/ /sdig pa chen po'i las rnams kun/ /bdag gis byas sam gzhan byed bcug /gal te gang gā'i (7bye snyed kyi(kye/ /sems can de la sbyin byin dang / /de bzhin gang gā'i 6)bye snyed kyi//sems can thams cad gsad ⑩pa gnyis/ /yang dag rig la tha dad med/ /nam mkha' dag la rdul dang chus/ /ji ltar mi chags pa bzhin no/ /gang zhig khrel dang 'dzem yonyeldan na/ /dogs pa'i rtog 7pa de bzung bas/ /dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur/ /chags pa'i spyod tu pa la sogs kyisayi/ /lus rnams gdung bar byed pa yi/ /sems can de ni 'du shes chung / /zhes gsol to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /e ma'o 8thod pa can gyi tshogs/ /khyed 7kyis smras pa'i tshig 'di rnams/ /mdud pas bcings pa'i tshig yin te/ /khur dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang dag yang dag ces smra ba/ /yang dag nyid kyi mdud pa ste/ /mdud pa'i / bkrol ba ma byas na/ /tha ram phyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /chags pa'i las rnams 102—187

sbyor ba dag /chags pa'i dbang gis der sbyor na/ /de dag de yi grong khyer du / /gnas 'gyur de yi sems can yin/ /'du shes sgyur ba'i las chen dag /sdang ba'i dbang gis ①sems shor na②/ /shan pa gsod pa'i rig du'adzin du/ /ltung 'gyur sdig pa'i ri bo yin/ /rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang bas ④na/ /gang tshe bde ⑤gshegs rgyal ba'i zhal/ /mi gtsang rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /yongs su bstabs ⑥par gyur na ko/ /de tshe las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /thar med nad kyis bzung nas ni/ /'dam ⑦du bying bar mi 'gyur ram/ /sha dang khrag la sogs pa'i zas/ /dku ⑧ba'i rngad zas chen po ste/ /gang gis yo)zos pa'i lus rnams la / /'byung po dri za kun 'dus nas/ /dri mnam ⑩ra dang bcud rnams 'byin / /des ni gzi mdangs yal 'gyur na/ /ci phyir ci ste de rnams bza' /sems nyid rin chen yod bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi rin chen spyod byed pa/ /log pas log pa len pa'i chos/ /'di dag mdud pa dam po yin/ /dkar gnag ⑪las la khyad med ces/ /thams cad khra bos spyod pa ni/ /rigs med rigs chad log pa'i las/ /'bras bu log pa'i khams su 'gyur/ /bde gshegs mnyes bya'i las rnams la/ /yan lag tshig tu ma dag na/ /nyes byas las kyi rgyu des ni/ /gang gi dus rnams thams cad du/ /dbang po ⑩yan lag ma tshang zhing ske/ /dran pa'i snying po nyams par 'gyur/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pas / /bder (snyegashegs rgyal ba sgom zlos pa/ /cho 'phrul khro tshul bstan pa ltar / /mtshan ma nyid bu yider go na/ /las kyi srin po'i rig 'dzin yin/ /rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad kun/ /mtshan ma nyid du brtags gyur na/ /ci la'ang rtog cing chags pa yisnyi/ /'dzin pa'i phur pa chen por 'gyur/ /a dang 102—188

hūṃ la sogs pa yi/ /rgyu yi yi ge thams cad kun/ /mtshan ma nyid du der brtags ①na/ /tsan+dan sbrul gdug la sogs par/ /ltung 'gyur rtog pa'i gegs ②chen yin/ /khrag la sogs pa'i rdzas chen lnga/ /de nyid dngos por de brtags ③na/ /'byung po khrag gi dri mnam ༷pa'i/ /lus len rigs ni 'dzin pa yi/ /ma bdun rngam pa'i cha lugs su/ /gang zhig rtog par der go na/ /srin mo mi sdug sha za mo/ /laṅka'i ⑤yul du ⑥de dag 'khor/ /mtshan ma'i bla thabs mgo brnyan can/ /der btsan ⑦der bzung dmigs pas ni/ /sho gam gnas kyi gcan chen rigs/ /'dzin cing gnas der rtog par 'gyur/ /las kyi dbang btsan nibran mo'i tshogs/ /de 'dra nyid du de brtags na/ /gnod sbyin chen mo'i tshogs su 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi tshe la 'tshe ⑨ba yin/ /des na mdud pa chen po 'di/ /khur du bshal ba'i ⑩gdos yin te/ /'chal bas lta ba'i mig long ste/ /sems kyi nor bu rin chen de/ /rtag chad khams su stor bar 'gyur/ /de lta'i skyon chen spang bar gyis/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa las thod pa can gyi tshogs rnams rtogs yipa'i 'du shes kyis zin cing rang rang gi spyod pa la skyo ba skyes par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma'o 8bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyi dam tshig ni log pa'i dka' yonyethub tu 'gyur ba lags na/ 'di dag yang dag pa'i dka' thub tu gnas par 'tshal na/ chos thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu ste④/ cir yang 'gyur ba lags so/ /gsang sngags chen po'i lisgo ni bskal pa 8me dpung lta bu ste / bdag cag rnams kyi rtog (nyepa so sor ji ltar mos pa ltar bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgyes pa chen po'i bzhad (nyepa mdzad 102—189

nas / rigs kyi bu rnams ni de ltar zhu ba legs kyis 6)shin tu nyon cig /khyed rnams kyi spyod pa mi dgag par ji ltar dga' ba'i bsam pa so sor rangs par bya ste / 'jig rten mtshan ma'i spyod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams gsang sngags kyi dka' ②thub chen por bya'o/ /rang rang gi spyod pa ma bkag par sgo gsum lhug par spyod cig /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rjes yang 'di skad ces gsungs so/ / kye ma'o ③thod pa can gyi tshogs/ /bud med bud med thams cad kun/ /skyed ④par byed pa'i rten yin te/ /'bras bu smin pa'i zhing yang yin/ /bsgral zhing gdon pa'i gnas yin te/ /shes rab dga' ba'i yul yin no/ /'di la sems gsum gnas pa ste/ /ye nas dag pa chos nyid sems/ /mkha' dang sbyor ba byang chub sems/ /snying rjes sgrol ba gsum sbyar te/ /chos nyid gsang ba nyi shar khyab/ /snying rjes sgrol ba gsum gyis (7sbyar/ /ting 'dzin byin brlabs ye shes kyis/ /chos nyid dur 6)khrod mkha' la bsgral(pe/ /bsgral ba'i rgyu mchog man chad nas/ /shel chen tsa ra la sogs pa/ /de la rgyu drug sa bon gdab / /rang bzhin ye nas de gzhom bya/ /khyad par 'das pa'i yi ge lnga/ /gnas bkod 'phros pas mtha' yas bkang / /thams cad stongs shing zad byas nas / /'dus pa'i yi ge lnga ru gsal/ /de las phyag mtshan ye shes lnga/ /mi gnas ye shes ngang du thim/ /sgrib pa'i phung por smin pa de/ /rdo rje rol pa'i rngam tshogs kyis/ /'jo tshul stabs kyis (8)sbyar bar bya/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ la sogs sngags bcas pas/ /bsgyel te ma rig sgo 67dbye bya/ /rnam shes dbugs kyi sgrom drangs 7la / /rdo rje rgyal po'i rlung sgrom 11du/ /bsdus yo te rdo rje dbugs can la/ /hūm̐ byas sgril ma 1)de la bslan/ /gsang ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /mtshon ④102wa 190

gang 'od 6)du bstim par bya/ /yu ti a haṃ gis sbar ②te/ /gsal na de dang mnyam du gsal/ /rdo rje tshe la bslan ①par bya/ /rdo rje rlung gis dbugs sbar te / /thugs las rlung sgrom lam du sbar/ /nam mkha' chos kyi gzhal yas su/ /nyi ma'i steng na rgyu du gsal/ /ye shes sems dpa' tshon skyigang ba/ /nyi zla ga'u'i bar na (migasal/ /a yang phaṭa kyis bskyod 'phangs pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kur 'phros/ /ye shes sems dpar gsal ba la/ /dngos por snang ba yi'adzin dang bral/ /g.yo 'gul 'phar 'phrig ma chad par/ /rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur te/ /rigs kyi lha dang snying po sbyin/ /rdo rje gdung ba'i glu blangs te/ /man ngag gnas kyi smon lam gdab/ /bzhi tshal dag tu byas nas ni / /sman gyis btab ste ⑦phung por btsal(kye/ /'khor ba'i phung po de bsdus 4)la / /rdo rje stabs dang glu 7yis sbyang / /gnas gnas dag tu bsngo ⑩bar bya/ /phung po mchod pa'i rdzas su bstim/ /rdo rje bra yi las rnams gdab/ /des ni mnyes dang skongs 7pa dang / /rdo rje las rnams 'grub pa yin/ /rnal 'byor las kyi dbang phyug che/ /mtho gtsang shes rab gangs rum tunyenas/ /rig pa'i sder mo sbar shad can/ /nga rgyal dregs pa'i glang po 'joms/ /rnal 'byor rtsal rgyas ④seng phrug rnams/ /rdo rje rtsal chen 'di sbyangs pas/ /rnal 'byor lha mchog gshegs pa'i rten/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /mthu stobs skye ba'i thabs chen po/ /byin brlabs 'phebs pa'i dbang mchog 'disayi/ /rgyal ba'i dngos grub man chad nas/ /mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul thams cad dang / /dregs pa ma rungs sde pa rnams/ /thams cad dbang du 'gyur nges na/ /'byung po gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /'khor ba'i skam gling chen po la/ /ris yi 102—191

drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /rgyud drug 'das pa'i rnam shes srog /dus gsum mtshon gyis bsad ①pas na/ /rtag chad mthar shi'i ②ro gling nas/ /gti mug bam chen ro blangs ①nas/ /bdud rtsi sman chen ye shes kyis/ /rtag chad mtha' las ro blangs shing / /byang chub sems su gsal ba'i phyir/ /ro yi rdzas rnams btsal bar bya/ /khro tshogs byarngam par bdag byas te/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i mig nang nas/ /mthing nag rgyu gi seng 0chen ni/ /'khor ba'i ro gling khams su spro/ /bsgral ⑥pa'i dur khrod mtha' dag kun/ /ye shes rol pa'i shing ⑦du blta/ /khro bo rgyad kyi 'dor thabs kyis/ /tsham ningam chen po'i rngam tshul gyis / / dpa' bo ④rdo rje'i 'dzur 'gros 7sbyar/ /thabs chen bcwa yibargyad stabs kyis 7sbyar/ /'jo ()tshul thabs kyi 8'gro stabs kyis/ /'dzem tshul lta ⑫zhing rnam par rtsen⑩/ /sgra skad sgyur ⑩zhing he nyes sgrogasatunye/ /'thab cing rtsod ⑪pas rnam par rngam/ /'bri 0tshugs lta zhing 'drog tshul spyod/ /g.yas su lta zhing g.yon du 'gyur/ /yid ma ches te phyir yang blta( nyu/ /sdang mig logs kyi 'khyab par blta( ste/ /rdo rje 'gros ⑥su rgyug cing 'gro/ /ha ha ru lu'i rngam sgra sgrogs / /so so'i brda 9 nyaskad 'byin byed cing / /rtod (nyepa'i tshul gyis mchong zhing rgyug /yid bzhin gter chen kha phye (nyanas/ /'dod 'byung rin chen phung po de/ /'khor ba'i rnam smin dpyis phyung nas/ /rnam gsum dug chen gtan sprugs nas//thugs rje rngam pa'i kha long kha/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs chen gyis/ /dngos grub lo tog phral nas kyang / /rdo rje bzhin phyogs ma nor bar/ /shel phur gnyis kyis gsang gnas 7bzung / /nges par gshin pa'i gzhi ma la/ /cung zhig brtod 82de nye 'khor bsgyur nya/ /bzhin phyogs gang ltas tsolegs nyes brtag /102—192

phyi yi bzang ngan de nyid ni/ /nang du nges par gsal ba yin/ /nyes pa'i mtshan byung mkhas pas mnan①/ /gal te dri bas gleng ②slong na/ /de yi the tshom bsal ①ba dag /dngos por spyod la zhugs rnams kyis/ /mtshan mar rtog pa 'di dag rnams/ /'jigs byed bka' la btags 0pa yi/ /'dod chags bdag po nga la gsol/ /ji skad smras pa de bshad kyisaX/ /mtshan ma'i rdzas rnams rtogs par gyis/ /'jig rten mgon khyod bdag la gson/ /bdag cag spyod pa gsol bar bgyi/ /snod kyi mtshan nyid bzang ngan gyis / /nyes dang legs pa 'di las byung / /skyon gyi mtshan ma bdun pa ste/ /kha sbub pa dang gdan las 0bskyod/ /rgyud mi 'phel dang mtshams su gas/ /bar chad 'byung dang bgegs ldang ba/ /mtshan ma ngan pa 'byung ba'o/ /'di dag mkhas pas yong ⑦mi 'chang / /legs pa'i rgyu ni bcu gcig ste/ /gsum gyi dngos grub thob pa dang / /rig 'dzin lam 'gro nam mkhar 'phur/ /khams gsum dbang bsdu ①rdo rje spyanaponye/ /pha rol g.yul zlog 0zil gyis gnon/ /mthu yidang byin brlabs tsotshe 'phel dang / /mtshan ma sasal po 'byung ba dang / /slob ma chu yi rgyud 'phel ba()/ /dmigs pa'i bsam pa 'grub pa dang / /phyi mar sangs rgyas myur ba dang / /dngos grub rnam gsum thob pa ste/ /smon lam bzhin du 'grub pa'o/ /de yang bye brag 'di lta ste/ /phyed du 'gyur na thob thang yin / /sum cha tsam la btang snyoms so/ /de yang so so'i mtshan rtags su/ /brtag cing ming du brjod bya ba/ /dkar po spros med chos kyi sku/ /lcang lo kun rdzogs longs spyod ldan/ /ma 'ongs sprul pa mdzad pa'i rgyun/ /'das dang da ltar ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor sa la 'gro ba'i rigs/ /bder yigashegs 102—193

dus gsum 'byung ba'i rtags/ /rin chen gter gyi ga'u 'di/ /thabs kyi rgyal po dpal gyi dkor/ /pho brang rtags yo)ldan snod bcud rdzogs/ /'phrul zhal yid bzhin 'dod zhi'i ②ba/ /rkang med mkha' la 'gro ba'i mchog /ngo mtshar thog thog rkan ①sgra can/ /rmad 'byung ④gsang ba'i rang sgra dag /rig 'dzin rtsal (snyecan kun la sgrogs⑥/ /nga ni skyes mchog rtsal can gyi/ /rmad byung bsgrub ⑦pa'i rdzas yin pas/ /su zhig dngos grub gang 'dod pa/ /the tsom ⑧med par dus 'dir long ⑨/ /gang dag bka' ltar mi byed cing / /su zhig dam la mi gnas pa'i/ /nga yi gzugs mthong tsam gyis 'tshig /sgra thos tsam gyis brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i sgra byung cho 'phrul ni/ /rgyal ba'i gzhal yas kun las sgrogs(lha / /'di dag don dang ldan par spyod/ /'di ltar grags pa 7nges don ni / /rnal 'byor can gyis shes bya ba/ /thams cad dpal ldan lcang lo can/ /la la bkra shis mtshan ldan te/ /de bzhin paṃ ()tsa ku la yin/ /la la dpyad kyi na sha yin/ /de bzhin mi 'gyur sra mkhregs 8yin/ /ma hā ke sa dpal dang ldan / /ye shes lnga ldan zhes ni bya/ / ā yuḥpha snyil tshe yi mchog /la la me le de byi brtan/ /la la de bzhin kha swa kha/ /kha hu pa yi dpal dang ldan/ /bkra shis don 'byung de lta'o/ /bder 7gshegs mtshan ldan rdzogs pa yin/ /gtsug phud yo tshodage gtsug dpal dang ldan/ /dz+nyā na musti 6)de bzhin no/ /la la dz+nyā na ku ṇ+ḍa li/ /de bzhin khro bo kuṇ+ḍa li36/ /e ka dza ṭi (2 )mtshan ldan pa/ /a bi mu ka rdzogs pa'o/ /'dod pa brtan ldan 31bde ba skye/ /gnyis med don ldan thob pa'o/ /pu tra mang 'phel lcug phran rgyas/ /rdo rje bse phor mtshan rdzogs nas / /shel phor gsang ba'i don 'byung ba/ /sku gsung lhun grub ka pā la/ /102—194

thams cad re ba yid bzhin skong / /de bzhin yon tan rdzogs kun rdzogs/ /bkra shis mtshan ni kun ldan pa/ /de bzhin mi 'gyur g.yung drung brtan/ /mi shigs mdzod yin kun 'byung ba'o/ /cho 'phrul rtags 'byin dam pa 'byung / /srid pa yongs sgrol las kyi mchog /khams gsum dbang sdud khyad par ldan/ /drug gsum gtan sprugs las mchog can/ /mtshan ma'i spros bral nges pa'i don//rigs drug mdog drug dbyibs drug dang / /yon tan skyon rnams sbyar bar bya/ /mang dang nyung 6)ba'i gsang ba ni/ /bcas dkar ②'phel dang mgo mi 'byung / /rjes 'dra la sogs skyon rnams spang / /dug gsum stongs ②mdzad rgyal ba'i bka'am/ /sku gsum smin pa'i g.yung drung rtags/ /sba thabs gsang ba'i man ngag 'di/ /skal ldan rnal 'byor rnams kyi ste④/ /skal med kun gyi rtog pa'i bdud / /ming tsam 'dzin la ga la brten(ldeno// /mkhas pas brtag cing bzang po brten / /dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus chen yang / /gcig dang gsum ni rab tu bshad/ /de bzhin lnga bdun 'bring du grags(nya/ /dgu ni dngos grub tha ma ste / /bcu gcig phan chad yal bar bshad/ /de bas rnal 'byor rtsal can (7gyis / /nges par brtson te (kyebartag par rigs/ /'dod chags bdag pos de skad bshad/ /mtshan ma yin phyir der nges pa/ /mtshan ma can dang mthun nyu)bya'i phyir/ /thabs kyis de dang mthun 7spyod la/ /yang dag don la kha lo sgyur/ /de dag rnam par sbyang ba 1gedang / /'gro drug shin tu g.yeng ba can/ /yid rnams drangs te brten snyo byas nas/ /thabs kyi don la sbyar ba'i tshig /rgyu drug 'dus pa'i sa gzhi la/ /glu bro yi gar gyi rol pa yisa'/ /srid gsum zil gnon tshedabang sdud pa/ /'jig rten mthun tso'ajug spyad par bya/ /dper na 'jig 102—195

rten khams dag na/ /'gro bas 'gro ba 'dul byed pa/ /de ①dga'i las la de zhugs te/ /de dang bsam pa mthun ②spyad pas/ /de dang 'dris srinas de dga' byas/ /de nas de yi drod lon nas/ /de yi 'du shes sgyur ba'i tshig /de snga bdag gi grogs khyod kyi/ /las la zhugs pa shin tu nor/ /'dir nyes las kyi dubasags pa bgrang / /nyes kyang bdag gis khyod dgar byas/ /da ⑤ni bdag dga'i las 'di la/ /grogs khyod shin tu 'jug 6)dgos so/ /byas pas de yi snga sems de/ /zin pas gcig gi phyi sems kyang / /'dzin cing de dga'i ⑦las la 'jug /spyod pa'i las kyang 'di lta ste/ /rgyu drug 'dus pa'i phung po la//ngan song gnas 'joms rdo rje'i rtagasal/ /ye shes thabs kyis snyan pa'i glu/ /rmad 'byung ⑨gsang chen sgrogs ⑩pa'i tshig /nyon mongs lnga yi yis gzhi la/ /yi ge ye shes lnga 8gsal bas/ /'bar ba khrag 'thung sprin phung bzhin/ /khyu mchog lnga yi stabs kyis 8rol/ /seng ge nga ro rngam pa'i glubla/ /rdo rje don snyirab sgrogs ⑩pa'i tshig /rmad byung rol pa'i don byung ba/ /e ma ngo mtshar ya mtshan che/ /dgyes pas rol ba'i byin brlabs yilas/ /rgyud drug rtsad gcod ngo mtshar che/ /mnyam pa chen po'i nam mkha' las/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i me byung bas/ /'khor ba khrag gi yonyergya mtsho skams6)/ /sdug bsngal dbyings su zad mdzad do/ /mi gnas klong sko )nas cho 'phrul ba/ /gtum rngam 'khrug pa'i ngo bor 'bar/ /khrag 'thung sgo nya'abar ba'i sprin 'phros 8 pas/ /srid gsum khrag mtsho rngo nas skams/ /dpa' bo so tsham ngam gyad kyi stabs/ /srin po ma traṃ ( stekhros pa'i glu/ /theg chen rmad byung gsang ba'i tshig /chags pa'i rtod phur gting nas phyung / /mkha' bzhi dbyings kyi bde klong ( nyenas/ /tshom bu 'bum gyi 102—196

cho 'phrul 'phros/ /dgyes mchog rol pa'i phrin ①las las/ /la la shes rab thabs la rol/ /la la thugs rje las la rol/ /la la gdul bya'i yul la rol/ /la la ye shes dbyings la rol/ /thabs kyi rgyal po rtogs pa'i dbang / /che ba lung gi khyad par las/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /rdo rje pad+ma rol ba'i stabs/ /chags med mkha' la gsal ba'i tshig /dug gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i glu/ /'jig rten rim gyis sbyang ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams su rol pa byung / /'jig rten drug gi snying la rol/ /bdag po gtso bo zil mnan nas / /'khor ni snyan (mipa'i tshig gis bsten/ /'khor ba'i lam lnga rgyud bcad bunas / /rnam thar nam mkha'i ngang du bslan/ /gar mchog glog ltar 'gyu ba yin④ / /rmad byung gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yi ge 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul 'phros / /'phro 'du skar ltar 'khrug 45)pa las/ /khams gsum bud shing thal bar rlags⑥/ /rdo rje bu yug skar mda'i stabasaphya/ /rdo rje 'brug chen ldir ba'i glu / /don grub rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig /gdug pa'i dpung rnams rnam par 'joms / /rdo rje sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bas/ /thabs kyi byang chub sems sprin spros / /dbang sdud (8)chags pa'i khyad par las/ /'jig rten bu mo drug dang rol / /seng ge rnam par rol ba'i stabs/ /rdo rje khyung skad 'gyur ba'i glu/ /chags pa rtsad nas gcod pa'i tshig /rdo rje rol pa'i don chen po/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mtshon cha 'bar ba'i yig 'bru 'phros/ /rgyu drug ngo bo rtsad nas gcod/ /dug lnga'i phung po rnam par spros/ /ye shes rno dbal khu)mtshon chen po/ /chos nyid bdal ba'i klong yinas 'phro/ /thabs mchog dbyig gi rtsal shugs las/ /'bar ba'i mtshon cha char ltar 'bab/ /yi ge ye 102—197

shes mtshon cha'i char/ /rdo rje lce yi shugs kyis ①dbab/ /rin chen gter gyi ②longs spyod rnams/ /rtog pa'i ri bo gzhom pa dang / /dug gsum phung po gzhig pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo lcags kyu la sogs pa/ /rten dang gsang chen til mchog dang / /dngas ①ma la sogs sgo kun rnams/ /so so'i cha ru phye nas ni / /thugs rjes nyon mongs sbyong ba yi/ /so so gnyer gyi rang skal du/ /phyag rgya so so'i skabs su gdab/ /de ltar rdzogs par gyur pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal kun gyi tshad 'dra la/ /dbus su thig bzhi le tshe dgu/ /mtha' skor ④'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad bya/ /de la sgo bzhi sgo khyud bcas⑤/ /mtha' zad bskal pa'i me ri bri/ /dbus su dkar dmar kha sprod bri/ /phyogs mtshams yibargyad du khaṃ brgyad bri/ /'khor lo'i bar mtshams (7myu khyud la/ /nang du bltas pa'i khaṃ brgyad gsal/ /rtsibs la nang du lta ba brgyad/ /mu khyud brgyad la phyir lta brgyad/ /gru chad bzhi la nang du lta/ /thig le rnam bzhi bri bar bya/ /phyi rim bar khyams (7de dag la/ /thig le (97nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ /phyi ru lta ba bri bar bya/ /bskal 0pa chen po'i me khyams 11la/ /thig le phyir lta bcu gsal byi7/ /de la phyag rgya rim par dgod/ /maṇ+ḍal sgo ru bam chen gcig12 /glu bro gar gyis rnam sbyangs te/ /dbus su bzhag ste cishar du bstan/ /de yi phung po gzhal yas khang / /r+ghaṃ las bskyed de gsal bar bya/ /de ru phyag rgya'i 7tshogs chen bsgomali/ /rdzas kyi gnas rnams so so la/ /rigs nyi kyi lha rnams rim par dgod/ /de nas rdo rje bsnyen pa yi bya / /byin phebs rtags lung mgu ba na/ /bam de byang shar mtshams su bsgral/ /rdzas rnams so sor bsngos 17nas kyang / /phyag rgya bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /ma nor bar yang dgod de sbyar/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i snod dgu la/ /rmad du 102wa 198

byung ba dgu bkod de/ /'bar ba chen po'i gnas gnas su/ /brjid pa'i tshul du gsal bar bsgom/ /phyag rgya gzhan yang rdzogs par dgod/ /ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang chen zla gam skar tshogs bkram6)/ /rdo rje mi phyed dgur 'bar ba/ /che ba dgu yi khyad par las/ /dpal chen dgu ni sku la rdzogs/ /yum chen dgu ni dbyings la rol/ /dpal be'u dgu ni thugs la 'bar / /'byung chen dgu ni klong du 'khyil/ /khu byug dgu ni rang skad rdzogs/ / bhan dha ②dgu ni dpal dang ldan/ /zla gam dgu ni yum gyi dbyings/ /thig le dgu ni byang chub sems/ /nyi zla dgu ni 'od 'phro 'bar/ /de ltar dgu shu)dgur gsal ba yi/ /dgu klong rgyabha ga gcig gi dang / /dgu bkag gcig phye thig le'i don/ /thams cad 'byor pa rgyas byas la/ /bam dgu phan cad ⑤sman du sbyar/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub blangs te spyad/ /ces bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i rdo rjes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig ⑥pa'i mdo las rmad byung rdzas kyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad ni mngon sum du shes shing rig par bya'o/ /mngon sum gang zhe na/ dran pa mngon du bzhag pas layul la mi gnas pa'i chos thams cad dang / phyis 'byung ba'i chos thams cad dang / sngon du byung ba'i chos thams cad mngon sum mar rig pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mngon sum mar shes pa ni ye shes chen po'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ji lta (8)zhe na/chos thams cad sgyu (9༄ma'i rang bzhin du dran pa mngon du bzhag 57na mngon du 102—199

gyur pa'i 0)chos nyid phyin ci ma log par shes pa yin no/ /chos nyid phyin ci ma log par mngon du gyur na mi gnas pa'i ye shes chen po nyid de yin no/ /de bas na mngon par shes pa rnams dran pa mngon sum mar yid la byos shig de skad ces gsungs pa dang / mngon shes rig pa'i drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mngon par shes pa ni bdag cag rnams kyi (snyedam tshig lags (gyiso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag rnams kyi dam tshig bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rig ④'dzin chen po rnams ye shes chen po'i rgyu mngon par shes pa ni rnam pa ⑤lngar rig par bya'o/ /mig gi dbang po thams cad las/ /zhib tu btags pa'i phye mar bya/ /bcud kyi snying por sbyar byas nas/ /mthong ba'i snying po 'bum bzlas na/ /thams cad ma lus mthong bar 'gyur/ /'di ni mig gi mngon shes so/ /rdo rje lce yis brjod ⑥pa'i tshig /dus sam rgyun du brjod par bya'o / /badz+ra tsak+ṣu gar+bha bit+yā hūm̐/ /rna ba'i dbang po thams cad kyang / /btags sam phye mar byas nas ni/ /bcud kyi snying por sbyar byas te/ /thos pa'i snying po 'bum bzlas na(7)/ /sgra yi bye brag thams cad thos/ /'di ni rna ba'i mngon shes so/ /rdo rje tshig tu brtag (kyepa ni/ /badz+ra gar+bha stam si ho/ /sna yi dbang po thams cad kun/ /bskams sam phye mar byas nas ni/ /bcud kyi snying por sbyar byas te/ /dri sna tshogs dang bsres pa las/ /tshor ba'i snying po 'bum bzlas na/ /sna yi mngon shes thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje tshig tu gzung 6)ba ni/ /badz+ra na ma si rta rtsu/ /lce yi dbang po thams cad kun/ /bskams sam phye mar byas nas ni/ /bcud kyi snying por sbyar byas te/ /ro yi mchog la 102—200

sogs pa las/ /ro yi snying po 'bum bzlas te/ /smra byed lce yi dkyil 'khor ni / /stegs bu khru gang gru bzhi la/ /dbus su gsang ba'i rdo rje bri/ /mtha' ma lce yi pad+mas bskor/ /lce la tshig gi 'od zer 'phro/ /smra ba'i bsgrub ①pas 'di rdzogs na/ /smra ba'i dbang po kha dbye zhing / /ro rnams thams cad shes par 'gyur / /'di ni lce yi mngon shes yinaphyi/ /rdo rje tshig tu brtag ①pa ni/ /badz+ra pā ①sha siṅgā hūm̐/ /snying gi dbang po thams cad kun/ /bskams sam phye mar byas nas kyang / /snying po mchog dang sbyar byas zhing ⑤/ /dran pa'i snying po 'bum bzlas shing / /dpal be'u tsit+ta'i yidakyil 'khor nas/ /dran pa'i rten gyis yongs bskor ⑦te/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa dang / /dbang po thams cad gsal ba dang / /thams cad ma lus shes par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi sems ni shes pa'i mchog /badz+ra tsit+ta sisto (kyergyu/ /lus kyi dbang po thams cad kun / /btags 6)sam phye mar byas nas ni/ /sra mkhregs bcu yidang sbyar byas 7te/ /reg bya'i snying po 'bum bzlas na/ /lus kyi mngon shes thob par 'gyur / /mngon shes 'di dag kun rdzogs na/ /mi gnas ye shes chen po'i rgyu/ /pra mo'ang nan tan mchog tu bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ⑫rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las mngon shes rig pa'i bsgrub tu lugs kyi le'u zhes bya ④ste bcwa tsolnga pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs mchog chen po'i bsgrub tsolugs ni 'di ltar rig par bya'o/ /don la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /las kyi stegs bu chag phyed pa/ /me ris bskor 102—201

te 'bar bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi 6)maṇ+ḍal ni/ /sum brtsegs ②byas pa'i dbus zla chagam/ /brgyad kyis mdzes par bya ba'o/ /phyi mtha' thod pa'i phreng bas bskor/ /de mtha' me dpung 'bar bas bskor/ / de yi duphyi mtha' dmar chen rgyas/ /zla gam dbus su dpal chen 'bar/ /zla gam brgyad la gnas bdag brgyad/ /mthing nag ya tha me rir 'bar/ /de 'og thod pa (9tshar gsum dang / /sgo khyams dur khrod rdzas kyis (7bskor/ /sgo brtsegs ④sgo khyud tha ma bran/ /thams cad gang yin de ltar sbyar/ /phun sum tshogs par gyur pa na//rnam bzhi las kyi maṇ+ḍal brtsam/ /'jigs byed bskal pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /za byed 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /thar pa tsa ra bsgral (8)ba'i phyir/ /drod ldan man ngag 'chang ba des/ /mchog gi byin brlabs gzhag 9)par bya/ /dag pa gsum gyis gzhung bsrang nas/ /gnas mchog dben pa'i ri bo rtse/ /rna nyan phra gsag 7can dang bral/ /'du 'dzi 'gro 'ong chad pa dgayonya /gsang chen spyod pa'i gnas su shis/ /rnam bzhi las kyi rtags nyung na'ang / /gcig gnyis ldan na 'bring du bshad/ /bsgrub yi pa'i rgyal po gdeng ldan pa/ /shin tu brjid cing sran tshugs pa1rta/ /khu 'phrig rtog bral brtul zhugs can/ /las kyi phreng ba lhag chad med/ /dri zhim dag pa'i sman dag gis/ /phyi bkru shi ne da hu yilas / /nang yang dag pa chen por bya/ /tshad mar sbyar ba'i bka' dang ni/ /ldan nas dus btab shin tu brtsam/ /de yang brtag 7pa'i gal chen yini/ /bkra shis mdzes dang ldan 'gyur ba/ /bong tshod lo ni dar la bab/ /rigs lnga'i mtshan dang ldan pa la/ /bsgral ba'i rdzas ti 7su rung ba dang yoste/ /yid 'ong 'byor ldan btsal nas ni/ /bsgrub pa'i rdzas su bya ba de/ /de 'dra'i mtshan 102—202

rtags yod pa ni/ /sa 6)sbyangs sa la slebs (snyepa'o/ /bsgrub ①pa'i rgyu mchog de dag ni/ / 'da' hu man 'das ④dbang po bsgyur/ /rdo rje pra mkhan phab nas ni / /snang srid thams cad dri ba 'am/ /legs nyes thams cad dri bar bya/ /dbang po sgo lnga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i thig le gdab/ /rnam shes 'byung ba'i sgo lnga ru/ /so so 'byung ba'i rdzas rnams gdab/ /so so rigs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /phyag rgya bkod de nyon mongs bsgral/ /bsgral (nyasbyar thams cad sbyangs nas ni/ /mchod dang mnyes dang dam skongs yidang / /dngos grub rnam gsum gang thob blang / /thob nas thams cad ci bder spyad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nas sems dpa'i rdo rjes yang 'di skad ces gsungs sol/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog pa'i bsgrub tsa)pa chen po ni 'di ltar rig par bya'o/ /gong ma bzhin du las brtsams nas/ /thar pa'i rgyu mchog de dag ni/ /rus pa rdo rje thal bar bsgrub(mi/ /rus pa'i tshogs ni thams cad kun/ /bsregs dang lce pog nag por sbyar/ /khyab 'jug ga'u kha sbyar du/ /bcug ste 'joms pa'i phyag rgya dang / /drag po sngags kyis bsgrub (9)byas nas/ /grub na rnal 'byor don ldan gyi/ /bar chad zlog pa'i gnyen por sbyar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po yigerdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje thal chen gyi sgrub yonyethabs kyi le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs pra 7thams cad ni 'di ltar rig par bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa 102—203

gcig la/ /zla gam sgo gcig ①rdo rjes bskor/ /mtha' khyung sgo bzhi ldan par bri / /rgyu mchog dbang po phyed ②ldan shis/ / phyi yi dukhrus rnams byas nas ni/ /shar du kha bstan dbus su gzhagadu /lce ⑤la gzungs thag sna lngas gdags/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis bskor bar bya/ /phyag rgya rdzas dang bcas par dgram/ /de yi khong du gzhal yas bskyed/ /rim par brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'bar ba'i 'byung chen 'bar ba lnga/ /don gyi lha khyimo lnga ru gsal/ /kun gzhi kun du bzang mor gsal/ /de yi thugs kyi khong thag tu/ /thig le zla ba nya rgyas la/ /ye shes sems dpa' chatshon gang ba/ /thugs kur nor bu rin chen 'bar / /dbus su nyi ma'i ga'u la/ /dpal be'u yungs 'bru'i bum pa la/ /hūm̐ dmar til 'brur gnas pa ni/ /bde chen byang chub sems zhes (kyebya/ /rdo rje gsang thag rgyun mi gcadapo)/ /rdo rje kha pra gdab par bya/ /de nas mtshan ma ⑩byung gyur na/ /dngos grub blangs te de bsgral la/ /bskams te bdud rtsi rtsa bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po (1rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las mchog phran thabs kyis bsgrub 7lugs kyi le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos 1)thams cad ni sgyu 7ma'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgyu nya2ma ni dngos por snang yang rang bzhin med pa yin te/rang bzhin med pa'i don ni chos nyid rdo rje yin no/ /de bas na sgyu ma'i chos thams cad khong du chud par bya'o/ /de nas 'khor der 'dus par gyur pa'i lha 102—204

ma yin gyi tshogs bdag sgyu ①ma mkhan zhes bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rnams kyi ②dam tshig ni sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul la gnas shing sgyu ma ched du bgyid lags kyis (mibadag cag rnams kyi don ched du sgyu ma'i chos thams cad bshad du gsol zhes gsol ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshogs bdag chen po sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ni 'di ltar rig par bya'o / /chos rnams thams cad sgyu mar snang / /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin stong pa ste/ /stong pa'i don rnams gang yin pa/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs ④rdo rje'i don/ /stong pa nyid la sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul bye ba mang po 'byung / /de bzhin sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul dang ⑤/ /gyin da tsam gyi rgyu rkyen las/ /cho 'phrul gzugs ni tha dad snang —/ /snang yang dngos por ma grub ste/ /'gyur 'jigs ⑥med pas rdo rje'i don / /kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid kyang / /rde'u dang shing bu'i rgyu dag las/ /sman dang sngags kyis ⑦skyen sbyar nas/ /'bras bu sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul 'byung / /sgyu ma'i gsang tshig sbyor ba ni/ /sgyu ma'i bdag pos 'di skad bshad/ /rgyu (kyel 'dod pa'i gzugs byas la/ /she'u re'u sman gyis ponyebatab nas ni/ /gsang sngags 'di yi sbyor ba bya/ /she'u re'u i ne ya/ /a mo kha a gus gusatso/ /chag shing dag gis brdabs byas na/ /ji ltar 'dod pa sna tshogs bya/ /bsdu bar 'dod na slar bzlog (nyabya/ /des /zhen sgyu ma'i g.yeng (nyeb can/ /drang ba'i thabs kyis bkri bar 8bya/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las sgyu ma rdo rje'i bsgrub lilugs kyi le'u ste bcwa khebargyad pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa 102—205

chen po'i tshogs chos thams cad la dbang sgyur 6)bar 'dod na 'di ltar rig par bya'o / /phun sum tshogs pa kun ldan nas(mi/ /stegs bu kun du gru bzhi la/ /mu khyud gcig (9tu bskor nas ni/ /zla ba kham pa'i dbyibs ④su sbyar/ /sgo bzhi gru chad bzhir ldan bya/ /dbyibs kyis ⑤jig le zlum po la/ /rdo rje dang ni nyi mas bskor/ /dbus su bhan dha 6)dpal ldan la/ /dpal chen yab yum sbyar la gzhag(7) /tshal bu brgyad la gnas brgyad sbyar/ /lte ba bskor te rim par gzhag /thig le shar gyi sgo gang du/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gsang ming dang / /dngos grub gsol bya bris la gzhag /mchod pa'i khyams su gyur pa la/ /bsgrub (shepa'i rdzas dang mchod pa rnams6)/ /rim pa bzhin du mdzes par dgram/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor de dag rnams/ /rdo rje lhags 7pa'i rtags kyis mtshan/ /ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor rdzogs byas nas/ /spyan drangs mchod pa kun bsogs te/ /'jug dang dngos grub gsol ba dang / /dbang bskur (nyalas rnams kun rdzogs nas / /rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dgatu) /cha gsum dang yonyepo sbyin sreg tsobya/ /bar ma mi zad gter du sba/ /byang chub sems kyi chu bo dang / /chos nyid nam mkha'i dbyings chen dang / /bha ga yum gyi sa gzhi la/ /shin tu sba snyiba'i tshul du sbyar / /cha gcig slogazhal yas shar sgo nas/ /bcu gsum bcal yonabar stegs bu bya/ /der ni gnas bdun gtso rnams kyang / /de bzhin bcu gsum lan re la / /gnas kyi mgron (18ni ma sring rnams/ /bdun cu 4)bar du kun rdzogs bya/ /tha mar maṇ+ḍal zla gam la/ /nus na mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i hom/ /rdzogs bya ma lus de mgu bya/ /lhag mar gyur pa 3 kun rdzogs bya/ /snyigs mar gyur pa thams cad kyang / /sba 'am bsreg gam chu klung 'dor/ /rdo rje gnas chen de 102—206

bsrungs ①te/ /gnas ni sba phyir su dag gsang / /mi rigs ②phyir na mtshan ma dag /rang rang gnas su slebs ①par bya/ /gang dag 'du tshe'ang de bzhin no / /'di ni thig le gcig pa yi/ /bsgrub ④lugs yin par rgyal bas bshad/ /'di dag sgrub pa'i skyes bu ni/ /zla ba'i 'khor lo la gnas nas(snye/ /nyi ma'i 'khor lo thogs nas ni/ /yang dag chos kyi dbyings nyid la/ /dbang sgyur byed pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'di yang rim gyis yigong ma ltar/ /thams cad tshul bzhin sbyar byas nas/ /phyi ra ⑦kun du gru bzhi la/ /thig le zla ba gcig tu bya/ /de la srad bu bzhi bsnol bas//le'u tshe dgu ru gyur par bya/ /phyi rol mu khyud thod (kyepas bskor/ /gru bzhi gru chad rab mdzes brgyan/ /de yi (9rimatha' zad khyams gcig la/ /sgo gdong tso sgrub pa po la lta/ /dbus su thig le dkar dmar la/ /kha sbyor bar dag rdo rjes 'brel/ /der ni dpal chen yab yum bzhugs/ /phyi mtshams 0le'u tshe ⑫de brgyad la/ /zla gam brkyang ba brgyad byas te/ /ye shes gnas kyi ma brgyad dgod / /phyi rol sgo gcig khyams de la/ /bsgrub 6nyapa'i rdzas kyis mdzes par dgram / /bsam bya bsgrub skopa la sogs kun/ /thams cad de bzhin 'dir sbyar bya/ /'di ltar grub pa'i skyes bu gang / /chos kyi rgyal por gyur pa ste/ /thams cad kun la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /skyes bu chen por de tso'agyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des cho 'phrul thams cad la dbang sgyur ba zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ba/ /'di yang thams cad de 'drar sbyaratso/ /kun du gru bzhir ldan 'gyur pa/ /102—207
