'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dag tu bya/ /gru chad bzhi yi phyi rol du/ /sgo bzhi dag dang ldan par bya/ /phyi khyams dmar nag me ri klong ①/ /shin tu brjid cing 'jigs par bri/ /thig le dbus kyi snying po la/ /zla gam 'bar bas mtshan par bya/ /rtsibs mchog brgyad la zla gam ni/ /nang du lta ba de brgyad bril/ / rtsibs mchan (7brgyad la'ang de bzhin te/ /rdo rje sgo mo ④bzhi rnams te/ /phyag rgya rim par bkram byas nas/ /bsgrub ⑤pa'i las rnams kun rdzogs bya'o/ /de ltar grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad layi/ /dbang sgyur (7byed pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las thig le sgrub ⑧pa'i le'u zhes bya ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje des (7'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor rnams dregs pa can gyi tshogs thams cad la dbang sgyur 4)bar 'dod na 'di ltar rig par bya'o/ /'di ni byas la sogs pa'i las/ /'di ltar 'byor 0nyadang phun sum tshogs/ /thabs la mkhas dang yo byad dang / /ji ltar rig par 'dir bsdu tu)bya/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal 'dra cig til/ /dur khrod mgo ma yang du bya/ /zur bzhi maṇ+ḍal bzhi byas la/ /bzhi las de bzhis chag res (7bstod/ /de nyid ma tang gzugs yisu bya/ /snying ga ⑩man chad dbus su bsnol / /dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'og tu gzhug /'khor lo 'bar chaba'i thig btab ste1nya/ /dpal chen lnga yi phyag rgya bya/ /khyams gnyis dag gis mdzes pa la / /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya dgod17/ /sgo bzhir rdo rje sgo ba bzhi/ /yan 102—208

lag sprul pa'i mgo brnyan gnas/ /phyi khyams rdo rje me rir ①bya/ /de yi phyi rol phreng chen gtams/ /skam dang ra ri rlon pas bskor/ /de yi phyi rol me bur ②'tshubaske/ /bskal ③pa'i bu yug bri bar bya/ /rdo rje sgo khyud sgo khang ④du/ /gu gu thul dang za ra tshags/ /zhing dang sbrul gyi chun po bri/ /de nas ban+da ⑤dpal ldan la/ /rdo rje dpal gyi yi ge dag /bris la kha sbyar sbub ⑥ste gzhag⑦ /ga'u chung la ral pa can/ /brgyad bris 'byung ba'i gnas su gzhag /las byed brgyad dam ⑧bcu gnyis la/ /las byed bcu gnyis bris la 'god6)/ /thar ba gnas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /gdol pa 'byung po nga rgyal can/ /chags sdang rnams kyis bslad pa'i rgyu/ /de yi dug gsum bshig ⑩pa'i phyir/ /don gyi bsgrub ⑩pa chen po bshad/ /ru dra lnga yi tshogs chen te/ /ting 'dzin ye shes lngas bcom nas/ /rdo rje drod kyis rnam par sbyar/ /mdo yi sa la 8stabs gcig tu'o/ /bgegs kyi bgegs te bgegs chen po/ /dug lnga rtog pa nyid las skyes/ /phyed 'dang gsum gyi dur khrod na8/ /gzhi rtsa ngag dang lus sems sol/ /brjid ldan dpal chen dur khrod bdag /bdag rtog 8rtog 'joms ting 'dzin gyis/ /srid gsum ru dra tsodur khrod du/ /tshogs bdag chen po de brgyad bya / /ma rig mun khang sgo phyed nas/ /glang chen smyon pa de bzung nas/ /gzung 'dzin dam po'i rtod thag bcad(zhe/ /dug gsum rnam rtog rtod phur dbyung ske/ /ngan song 'dam nas drangs nas ni/ /nyon mongs dpung rgod de btul nas/ /ye shes thabs kyis 4)rnam sbyangs te/ /nam mkha'i klong 6)du dmigs ()med par/ /bde chen mchod pa'i tshogs chen dag /ro mchog lnga dang mnyam sbyar bas/ /chos kyi longs spyod rgyas par sbyar/ /mnyam nyid bde 102—209

ba'i snying rje yis/ /dregs ①pa chen po gzhom pa dang / /'khor ba'i dra ba gcad ⑤pa'i phyir/ /khro tshogs ①'bar ba'i sprin 'phros ④pas/ /gtum thung rngam pa mgyogs pa'i (getshogs/ /phyag brnyan ༷char chen phab nas ni/ /'khor ba'i tha 9)ba spangs nas ni/ /bde ba chen po'i zhing bzlog ste/ /byang chub myu gu bskyed nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lo tog nibaskyed/ /dur yo)khrod chen po'i bzhin phyogs ni/ /mgo ni lho nub mtshams su bting ⑩/ /rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bting tunye/ /nga ni dur khrod dbang phyug che/ /sangs rgyas sku ste ye shes yin/ /thugs rje rnon po'i dmag tshogs la/ /ye shes rnon po'i mtshon cha yis / /log rtog kyi'akhor ba'i rgyun bcad (nyedo/ /gru bzhi kha bzhir rdo rje yi / /dbyibs 'dra'i thab ④ni brtsigs nas kyang / /snying gar tso'akhor lo'i thab tu bya/ /rigs kyi yam shing lnga brtsigs te/ /hom lnga 'brel pa'i las chen brtsigs / /thabs tsochen lnga yi hom khung du/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yam shing la/ /ye shes chen po'i me klong rnya du/ /nyon mongs lnga yi bsregs ()sbyangs rdzogs / /bya bar sbyor ba mtha' dag kun/ /ji ltar 'byor cing 'tsham par 'os / /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las dregs pa can gnon 17pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho zad par byed pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zhes ( 3 bya ba bsgrub tsho21pa'i don ni 'di ltar rig ( 2par bya'o/ /'di yang de 'drar kun sbyar nas/ /'khor khang can gyi gzhal yas su/ /khru gang gru bzhi'i tshad de la/ /102—210

bzhi ni 'khor khang khyams de dag /phyogs bzhi dag tu brtsam par bya/ /dri zhim tsan+dan 'de gu btang ①/ /dri spos tshom bu rin chen phrogaphyi /sbyin mchod rgyas par de bsham ①bya/ /lha yi dge bsnyen rnam pa bzhi/ /phyogs mtshams bsrung duba'i las rnams bsgo/ /khyams kyi nang rim phyogs mtshams ⑤su/ /chag phyed ⑥pa yi stegs bu bcu/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar bris la/ /sna tshogs rgyu las byas pa yi/ /mthun (7pa'i gzugs bcu dbang bskur te/ /khro bo gar gyi nang mtshams gcadal/ /de nas ma traṃ gnon yo)par bya/ /dregs pa ru dra ⑩sdig can 'di/ / nams kyang (nyabasgral ba'i zhing yin te/ /dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥtsom hā shrī he ru ka ma traṃ ru dra ha ha pra be sha phaṭa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ phyag rgyas bsgyel nas ni/ /ma rig mun pa'i sgo phye nas/ /rnam shes a ru byin brlabs te/ /gsang chen thugs kyi klong du bstim/ /sbubs ni gzhal yas 'bar bar 4)bya/ /stegs bu ma traṃ gzugs 'dra la/ /'gyel thabs bzhin phyogs ci 'drar bya/ /kha dog sngo skya gan rkyal thabs/ /che chung tshad med gnas kyis sbyarayi/ /de yi tsosnying gar ོbang rim gsum/ /dang por dmar po gru bzhi brtsigasatsho / /gnyis pa mthing nag gru gsum bya/ /gsum pa smug nag zla gam bya/ /yan lag bzhi dang mgo mtshan drug /gsang sgo gnyis te brgyad dag la/ /stegs bu chag phyed gru bzhi brgyad / /de yi mtha' rim sna yongs zad du/ /zla gam gsal ba'i maṇ+ḍal bya/ /de dag me klong 4)'bar bar bskor/ /ya thog zla gam steng dag tu/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i lha mchog bzhugs/ /mthing nag gru gsum me dpung bri / /gru bzhi'i dmar po bang rim la/ /rigs ( glebazhi lha ( snyemachog dpal ldan gzhag /yan lag mgo mtshan g.yas g.yon brgyad/ /dbang phyug gnas kyi bdag mo 102—211

brgyad / /bri bya yang na mtshan ma gzhag /tshigs ①chen brgyad la yul bdag brgyad / /ji ltar 'os pa de ltar bya'o/ /sgo bzhir gsang ba sgo mar gzhag /mtha' zad yongs kyi zla gam la/ /bud med nyi shu rtsa brgyad gzhag /ming ngam mtshan ma rten ②te gzhag /de yi kha la thab tu brtsigs / /pad+ma dpal be'u dbyings 'dra thab/ /mkhas pas yam shing brtsam par bya/ /bya ba'i bya ba thams cad kun/ /gong du sbyor ba de ltar sbyor/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las 'khor ba thams cad sgrol ba bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i ④le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des dug gsum thugs su dbang sgyur ba zhes bya ba'i mdo 'di gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dug gsum dbang du bsgyur (5)ba yang / /'di ltar khong du chud par bya/ /dug gsum rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /sku gsum nyid kyi ngo bo ste/ /gzhan nas btsal ba ci yang med/ /de ltar shes par 'gyur ba dang / /kun rdzob tshul du 'di ltar bsgyur/ /thams cad gong ma bzhin sbyar la/ /stegs bu 'dom gang ba zhig la/ /phyi ra dmar po rgyas par bya/ /de nas mthing skyonag gru gsum brtsigs 7/ /de nas dmar nag zla gam bya/ /zla gam dbus su dpal chen 'bar / /dbang phyug gnas brgyad zla gam mtha'/ /bang rim bar la dur khrod 'bar / /tha 987mar dmar po gru bzhi la/ /sgo bzhi sgo sung yo)bcas par bya/ /de yi mtha' khrim me ris bskor/ /khro bcu 'bar ba'i rtags rnams dgod(ste/ /bsgrub 12dang 'jug dang dbang bskur 1 rnams/ /gong ma bzhin du sbyin par bya/ /1632—212

des ni thams cad rdzogs pa yin/ /dug gsum thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las dug gsum dbang bsgyur ①ba zhes bya ba'i bsgrub ②pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i ②rdo rje dam pa des bud med thams cad la rjodabang sgyur ⑤ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil yi'akhor chen po 'di gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chags pa thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'dod na 'di ltar rig par ⑦bya'o / /bud med chags pa'i rang bzhin te/ /chags pa khrag gi nirgya mtsho yin/ /las kyis 6)'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /chags pa khrag gi rgya mtshor bying / /chags las rnam grol 'gog pa ste/ /chags pa de nyid khrag ces bya/ /khrag gi rgya mtsho bskam pa'i phyir/ /bud med khrag gi rgya mtsho rnams/ /'tsho ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ⑩bsgyur/ /de ltar shes par gyur pa dang / /kun rdzob tshul du 'di ltar sbyar / /las kyi brtsams ⑩pa phun sum tshogs / /rim pa bzhin du brtsams nas kyang ske/ /maṇ+ḍal 'dom gang gru bzhi la/ /'khor lo bzhi yi thig tu gdab/ /mu khyud phyi rim gru chad bzhi/ /de yinas sgo khyams dmar por bya/ /kun gyi phyi rim lag chu hwa'i/ /me ri 'bar bas gtib thag gcad/ /dbus su shar lta zla gam bri / / bhan dha tsodapal ldan yab yum dgod/ /'khor lo bzhi la rigs bzhir ldan / /bar khyams snyiganyis la gnas yul rnams/ /zla gam thig ler ldan par bya / /sgo khyams sgo bzhi zla gam bcas/ /phyi khyams lag chu hwa yi me/ /me yi khro bo thig ler bcas/ /dur 7khrod rgyan gyis tsokun brgyan bya/ /ting 'dzin 102—213

rdzogs dang dngos bsgrub 6)dang / /'jug pa dbang bskur dngos grub rnams/ /gnas bsrung ②la sogs rdzogs par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ①rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las 'khor lo dbang sgyur gyi sgrub lugs kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa des 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs chos ④thams cad ni ⑤bdud rtsi sman gyi rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad kyi don rtogs na ni 'tsho ba chos nyid kyi rtsi yin/ ma rtogs na ⑥ni 'chi ba 'khor ba'i dug yin/ de bas na chos 'di dag ②thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar shes nas kun rdzob tu 'di ltar bsgrub par bya'o/ /ji bzhin 'byung ldan bde sbyar nas/ /ma traṃ khog pa'i snying ga (9ru/ /'dom 6)gang tshad dang mthun 7pa la/ /rtsibs brgyad 'bar ba'i 'khor lor (nyagadab/ /me yi 'od kyis bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje ra bas bskor ba yi/ /mtha' ma sgo khyud 'bar bar bya/ /dbus su rin chen zur brgyad tu bya/ /der ni phyag rgya 'bar ba dgod1)/ /lang ka bsgral ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /ral pa can gyi tshogs 'dus te/ / rak+ṣa 'joms yipa'i mthu chen kun/ /srid pa gsum ril 'dir sgrol ba'o/ /dus bzhi mchod pa'i dam 'ardzas kyis/ /de dag ji ltar rigs ⑩par mchod/ /dus bzhi bcud smin snying po yis/ /dngos grub chen po'i rdzas su bya/ /phyogs bzhi dbus kyi rdzas chen rnams/ /rmad du byung ba'i ral pa can//'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur 7mdzad/ /'byung ba lnga yi cho 'phrul sgrub/ /dbyar 102—214

chu ston me dgun sa ste/ /dpyid rlung nam mkha' gsang bar sbyar/ /cho 'phrul de la dbang thob nas/ /de dag ral pa can du bsgrub/ /ting 'dzin rnam pa lnga gsal ①bas/ /'byung lnga las byung sha rigs lnga/ /khyi sha ba lang ②rta sha dang / /bya dang ri dgas ①sna tshogs ni/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs su sgrub pa'i rdzas/ /sgrub lipa'i rdzas chen 'byung chen lnga/ /'jig rten kun la dbang sgyur ⑤ba'i/ /de ltar rdzas rnams 'byor pa dang / /ting 'dzin bsgom skyodang bsgrub pa dang / /thams cad gong dang mthun ⑦spyar nas/ /'jug dang dngos grub dbang chen rnams/ /ci rigs par ni bde bar sbyar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi rang byung dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i mdo bshad pa'o/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i (kyerdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhan yang bdud rtsi chen po ni/ /gong ma bzhin du legs sbyar nas/ /maṇ+ḍal tshad dang mthun (9)pa la/ /pad+ma dmar po 'od kyi mkha'/ /phyi rim zla gam dmar po bzhi / /rdo rje 'bar bas mdzes par bskor/ /me lce 'bar ba'i phreng ba ni/ /zla gam mtha' zad bri bar bya/ /rin chen ge sar phreng bas ni/ /pad+ma'i lce la bskor bar bya/ /sgo bzhi rin chen 'bar bas 7bya/ /phyag rgya 'bar ba'i lha bkod nam/ /dbus su gser lor sul med la/ /dung chen 'khor ba can gyis tsosbyar / /shar du shel phor sul 'greng la/ /rin chen mdzod spu gsal bas (nyesbyar / /lho ru rin chen sul mang mal/ /rin chen lo 'dab rgyas pas sbyar/ /nub tu rgya phor zla gam la/ /bzhin mtshams rin chen 'bur gnyis sbyar/ /byang du bse maphor rgya gram la/ /gtsug tor rin chen tso'abur bzhi rgyas/ /rtsa ba lnga ni phyogs phyogs sbyar/ /sgo lnga'i gtso bo rigs su sbyar/ /dbus nas shar lho 102—215

nub byang du/ /ka ko la dang du ① ruska/ /dza ②ti pha ①la kha dri zhim/ /lce pog dkar zhes rim par sbyar/ /de bzhin gong gi rim pa bzhin/ /a ru ra dang ga pur ④dang / /gur gum ①pad+ma li ga durayi/ /de na rā ⑦sa yā ⑧na rnams/ /thams cad rigs dang kha dog dang / /las dang mthun ⑨par sbyar bar bya/ /sa bon lnga ni rim par sbyar/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i snod nang du/ /yab yum snying po rim bzhin bya/ /dbus dang pad+ma lce la dgod/ /gnas yul la sogs mdzes par gzhag /dur khrod rdzas dang bkra shis rdzas/ /'byor ba'i yo byad thams cad bshams7/ /de nas byin phab dngos grub gsol/ /thams cad rnam par sbyar bar bya/ /dam pa de nyid gsang chen gyi/ /rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gcig gis/ /thams cad sbyang ba'i mchog tu bya/ /de nas khrol bu sbyang ⑫ba na/ /bsal 7bsngo bsdu dang dbye ba dang / /khrus bya ba dang bshags pa ⑫dang ske/ /yon tan brjod dang byin dbab bya/ /de nas skad cig thang cig ⑫gam / /zhag gcig dag gis sbyar bar bya/ /rtags dag byung na der 'byongs pa'ol/ /phye ma'i mchog tu sbyar ba ni/ /snod kyi sman rnams shes rab mas/ /bsdus te btags skipa'i cho ga yang / /yum gyis bzung zhing yab kyis btags0//rig ⑩'dzin rtsal can dbab cing drang / /so so las kyi sngags brjod cing / /gtan gtun thabs dang shes rab stetunye/ /sman nyid (7byang chub sems su sbyar/ /rdo rje glu 6 7'di lha mos blang ( me/ /kun du bzang mo'i gzhal yas su/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa las( rnye/ /'khor ba bdud rtsi sman du sbyar/ /ye shes lnga ru gsal ba las/ /'bras bu sku gsum ( nyathugs su rdzogs/ /'chi med bdud rtsis gcong rnying tsho 7sbyang / /mtshan ma brtag ( stephyir bcal linas ni/ /rdo rje dpal 102—216

ldan kha sbyor blugs/ /kha dog rigs lnga'i ras kyis dkril/ /rdo rje dbang gi rgya yis gdab/ /rdo rje sngags kyi ②gzungs kyis gdags/ /dpal chen sku lngar mnga' gsol te/ /ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur bya/ /maṇ+ḍal dag tu dgod par bya / /kun gyis bskor zhing dngos grub dbab/ /rtsi dang sman gyi dubadag po dang —/ /rtags ldan rig du'adzin phra mo dag /rol mo cha byad mang pos bsten/ /bsgrub ⑤pa 'bru mchog gtams pas dgang / /bkra shis gos kyis rgyas par bklubs⑥ / /gzungs thag gnyer can rigs su dbul/ /ting 'dzin me yis rnam par sbyang / /rtags chen lnga ni gang byung yang / /sgyuragate dngos grub blang bar bya'o/ /bdud rtsi sgra las drangs nas ni/ /dpal ldan pad+ma ldan pa ru/ /thams cad bdud rtsir sa ma ya/ /mkha' klong ⑧yangs par bde chen rdzogs/ /rang nyid bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /gzhan nas bsgrub pa ci yang med/ /'jug pa la sogs thams cad kyang / /tshul bzhin du ni rgyas par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi phye ma'i bsgrub 6)pa rnam par bshad pa'o/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /thams cad de 'drar sbyar nas kyang / /maṇ+ḍal 'khor lo rtsibs ⑩brgyad pa(nya/ /phyag rgya'i 8lha rnams rdzogs byas nas/ /sman sbyang btags btsags bcal tsonas kyang / /sbrang chang 'o mas gong bur bya/ /bse por mtshan ldan nang du gzhagatso /legs par kha sbyar ras kyis dkrirdzi/ /gong ma bzhin du kun sbyar nas/ /dngos grub mchog rnams bdag gis bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi ri tsolu'i cho ga rnam par bshad pa'o/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /skyo ma'i 102—217

cho ga 'di lta ste/ /thams cad gong ma bzhin sbyar nas/ /mtshan ma gsal po 'byung ①ba dang / /phye ma chu tshags nang nas dbyung / /phye ma'i mchog tu gyur pa dang ske/ /phye ma'i rgyal mo de dag ni/ /bse phor kha sbyar nang du blugasal/ /rgyas btab byin brlabs (kyedabang bskur ④nas/ /bzlas brjod 'phro 'du rgyun mi chad / /sbrang chang rgya chang bu ram chang / /rgyan chang 'o ma la (gesogs pa/ /bcud kyi yikhu ba thams cad sbyar/ /rin chen ga'u mtshan ldan du/ /blugs te kha sbyar rgyas btab nas/ /'phro 'du bzlas brjod gong ma bzhin/ /byas te mtshan ma byung ba dang / /dngos grub chen po blang bar bya/ /phye ma'i bsgrub ⑦rdzas de dag ni/ /cha lnga dag tu bgos nas kyang / /rnal 'byor so so'i cha rnams las/ /ci ran tsam gyis 48)cha gcig dang / /sbyar chang cha lngar bgos pa las(9) / /rnal 'byor so so'i cha rnams las/ /sbyar te dngos grub rten du bya/ /zla ba gcig tu zos 7pas ni/ /ba spu rangs shing gnyer ma rangs/ /zla ba gnyis su zos byas na/ /gzi mdangs thams cad 'bar bar 'gyur/ /zla ba gsum gyi phan yon gyis/ /nad kyi bskal (nyapa dag las thar/ /zla bzhi phan chad gang zag gis7/ /zas dang ma 'dres brtson bsgrubs (min/ /gzhan gyi nad rnams 'joms par nus/ /drug dang bdun dang brgyad rnams la/ /bdud rtsi bcud kyis 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /dgu dang bcu la zag pa zad/ /bcu gcig rig 7'dzin nam mkhar 'phur(7/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi skyo ma'i bsgrub 7pa rnam par bshad pa'o/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje rig 'dzin rtsal lnga'i zas/ /lde 1 tshogu'i cho ga chen po ni/ /'di ltar khong du chud par bya/ /102—218

sbrang rtsi bu ram rgun 'brum rnams/ /lo yi 'tsho bar sbyar nas kyang / /kha dog mtshan ldan dmar po'i ba/ /lo yi ①'tsho ②bar gzung zhing bsrel/ /sman gyi rgyal po ram nye ①bas/ /rgyun du gsos pa'i 'o ma de/ /rig ④'dzin zas kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi rgyal mo ram nye khyab/ /phye ma'i mchog tu byas nas kyang ske/ /lo yi 'tsho ba'i sbyar byas te/ /sus mi mthong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /bsgrub rdzas de dag bkram nas kyang / /bdud rtsi bsgrub ⑥pa de bzhin bya/ /dus ⑦bab pa yi nitshod rnams la/ /bsgrub rdzas de dag thams cad kyang / /ba yi 'o mas lde ①gur bya0/ /cha res bskyed (nyacing bza' bar bya/ /zos pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /zag pa zad nas nam mkhar 'gro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi lde 8gu'i bsgrub hunyepa rnam par bshad pa'o/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'di yang gong ma ltar byas te/ /de dang mi mthun 8bsgrub rdzas rnams/ /bdud rtsir 8'gyur ba'i sman rnams kun/ /thams cad thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /til chen la sogs zhun gyi mchog /thams cad bsdus shing sbyar byas nas/ /gnas kyang gong ma bzhin btsal te/ /bdud rtsi bkram nas bsgrub par bya/ /'phro 'du bzlas brjod rgyun mi gcad/ /grub pa'i rdzas su gyur pa dang / /sman rnams phye mar btag yipar byayin/ /de dag phye mar gyur pa dang / /zhun chen dag dang sbyar bar bya/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /dngos grub mchog ni blang bar bya/ / gzhan nam yoshegazhan gyi sde pa dang / /lo yis bshugs te 'phrad mi bya/ /'tsho ba bdud rtsi zhun gyis sbyar/ /bdud rtsi grub pa'i rtags chen ni/ /ba spu langs dang gzi mdangs 'bar/ /kham gyi zas bral bde bar 'tsho/ /102—219

shes rab gsal zhing thogs pa med/ /zag pa zad nas nam mkhar 'gro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi zhun ①chen gyi bsgrub ②pa bshad pa'o/ /de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rlon pa'i rdzas la sman bsgrub dun/ /thams cad gong ma bzhin sbyar nas/ /maṇ+ḍal thig la dhilnga pa la/ /bkra shis dpal ldan lnga bzhag stenas/ /gtso bo lnga dang 'bras bu lnga/ /rlon par dubakod nas yi ges ①sbyang / /ting 'dzin bzlas pa'i me sbar bas/ /dang po ro 'byung skams ⑧pa dang / /de nas btag btsag yi)gong ma bzhin/ /sbyar nas rigs kyi ⑩bsnyen pas sbyang / /des ni mtshan ma byung ba dang / /de bzhin gong ltar ci (7bder spyad/ /ces gsungs so/ /bdud rtsi rlon 8sbyor gyi bsgrub 8pa bshad pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 0rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ bdud rtsi sman gyi bsgrub ⑩pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje chen po des/ sgrub ⑩pa thams cad kyi snying po gsang chen thugs kyi sgrub 7pa zhes bya ba 'di bshad do/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor 9/)pa thams cad ni dbyings su shes par bya ()ste/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad ni dbyings su 'dus la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ni ye shes su 'dus so/ /de gnyis su med pa ni chos nyid byang chub sems kyi bde ba chen por 'dus par shes par gyis shig /de bas na chos thams cad ni thugs ye shes kyi rang bzhin du 'dus te gnyis su med do/ /de ltar na kun rdzob tu 'di ltar rig par bya ste gnyis su med pa'i don la 'jug par bya'o/ /'dus 102—220

pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dam pa'i don gyi chos rnams kun/ /thams cad rang gi sems la rdzogs/ /kun rdzob chos rnams gang yin pa/ /lus dang ngag la rdzogs par bshad/ / des na ①chos 'di ②thams cad kyang / /rtsa ba rang la rdzogs pa ste/ /'di dag bsgrub ⑧pa'i thabs mchog kyang / /rnam par rtog pa'i rdul bsal dunas/ /bsgrub ⑤pa'i rgyal po yab yum gnyis/ /don la mkhas par byas nas ni/ /so so'i thugs la thig le dag /zla gam dkar dmar gdab par bya/ /de yi rdzas mchog chen po yang / /thabs kyi ga pur chen po dang glu/ /shes rab gsang ba'i tsan+dan gnyis/ /dkar dmar zla gam chen por bya / /yab kyi thugs kur dkar po la/ /thig le kha ni mar lta ba'o/ /yum gyi thugs kur dmar po la/ /thig le kha ni yar lta ba'o0/ /yab kyi thig le'i dbus su ni/ /dpal be'u dbus su nyi ma bri/ /dbus su oṃ gsal nang du rtsu/ /yum gyi thig le'i dbus su ni/ /pad+ma dbus su zla ba bri/ /dbus su a gsal nang du hūm̐/ /de ltar gsal bar gyur pa na/ /kun du bzang po yab yum du/ /gnyis su med par bsgyur bar bya/ /ting 'dzin gsal bar gyur pa dang / /rang las byung ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /gsang ba gnyis kyi mchod pa bya/ /rang las byung ba'i dngos grub dag /rang nyid sa ⑦ni bstim par bya/ /'di ltar sgrub pa gtsor byed na/ /bdud rtsi'i (nyeyo byad thams cad dang / /bcud kyi mchog tu gyur pa rnams/ /lo yi 'tsho bar sbyar nas kyang / /bsnyen sgrub po)yan lag rnam bzhi las/ /bsnyen pa dag gi dus su ni/ /gang zag mi yi zas la brtenayi / /de yang lo yi skad cig gam/ /gnyis dang gsum gyi bar du sbyar/ /lo yi skad cig bar du ni/ /bdud rtsi yo byad rnams la brtenayin/ /de nas lo yi 102—221

skad cig ni/ /gcig gam gnyis kyi bar dag tu/ /rang las byung ba'i rdzas rnam dhilngas/ /'phags pa mchod cing rang gis bza'/ /des ni drod ②la gnas par 'gyur/ /drod thob gyur pa phan chad ni/ /lo yi skad cig thang cig ①gis / /ting 'dzin zas kyi ro rnyed nas/ /kham gyi zas dang bral bar 'gyur/ /drod chen rnam gsum rdzogs nas ni/ /rtags chen dag ni thob par 'gyur/ /rtags kyi cho 'phrul 'byung ba ni/ /rin chen phung po 'dod pa na/ /sa rdo la sogs byas na (ge'agrub/ /chu dang mkha' la 'gro 'dod na/ /brtsams pas mi 'bying thogs med 'gro/ /me yi phung po 'jil 'dod na/ /sdigs pa'i mdzub ⑤mo phyar (67nas kyang / /bden pa'i bsgo ba byas pas 'grub/ /de la sogs pa thams cad nus/ /rtags thob phan chad sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsang chen thugs kyi sgrub (7)pa bshad pa'on)/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i rgyud po)las bka' gsang 'khor lo'i bsgrub 7pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i rdo rje de rdo rje me klong 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas 'dus pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis chos thams cad me'i rang bzhin du snang bar mthong ngo / de nas 'khor rnams kyis shin tu bstod pa/ /e ma'o sems dpa' che ba che/ /ting 'dzin chen po snang ba che/ /cho 'phrul chen po sna tshogs che/ /thabs mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun me klong bzhin du snang / /me nyid ye shes gsal ba'i klong / /'bar 'phro yonyagasal bar gyur pas ni/ /mun bsal ⑫102—222

dngos po thams cad bsregs/ /bde chen dbyings su kun rdzogs par/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis mdzad pa lags①/ /thugs rje chen po a la la/ /don grub chen po a la la/ /sgeg pa chen po a la la/ /'jigs byed chen po a la la /dgyes pa chen po a la la/ /dregs pa chen po ②a la la/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi ①byin brlabs ④kyis/ /bdag cag rnams la bshad pa shod/ /me yi rang bzhin chen po dag /bdag cag rnams la bshad par gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa las/ sems dpa'i rdo rjes dgyes (gete 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje me yi rang bzhin dag /bshad kyis khyed yirnams gus par nyon/ /rdo rje me yi las mchog 'dis/ /rnal 'byor thabs su bde sbyar bas/ /rgyal ba kun mnyes kun bsreg skongasaX/ /don grub las kyi mchog tu bshad/ /skye med rnam dag hom khung du/ /chos can skye ba'i yam shing la/ /spros med byang chub ye shes mes/ /mtshan ma'i bag chags bsregs (shesbyangs thim/ /rnam dag bha ga'i hom khung du/ /chags pa'i yam shing spungs pa la/ /bde chen byang chub me sbar te/ /'khor ba'i dngos po bsregs ⑨sbyangs thim/ /dpal chen zhal gyi hom khung du/ /nyon mongs lnga yi yam shing la//ye shes lnga yi me sbar te/ /gzung 'dzin rdzas rnams bsregs 7sbyangs thim/ /snang srid nam mkha'i hom khung du/ /'byung ba bzhi yi yam shing la/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi me sbar te/ /snang srid dngos po bsregs (7sbyangs thim/ /las bzhi so so'i khyad par gyis/ /phyogs dang kha dog dbyibs dang rdzas/ /ji ltar yin pa de ltar sbyar/ /shar lho nub byang dkar ser dmar/ /mthing ga linag po dzinathal mdog sbyar/ /zlum po pad+ma le'u tse mu/zhi/ /'khor lo gru bzhi zur brgyad rgyas/ /102—223

zla gam gru chad gzhu dbyibs dbang / /gru gsum bha ga kha mngon sbyor/ /sum brtsegs mdangs dang ri mor yo)mdzes/ /las kyi yam shing rdzas kyis ②rgyas/ /ye shes rdo rje'i las rgyud ldan/ /bla ma gsum gyis thabs dumachog sbyar/ /dag pa'i mtha' 'dzin nyes mchog 'dzin/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i glu dubro gar/ /mchod pa gsang ba dus tshigs sbyor/ /rdo rje lam gyi smon lam sbyaraX/ /gsang ba las kyi rgyud ldan pas/ /bshar gdab zhi ba'i lha rgyud dang / /rgyas dang dbang bshar rgyud bshar bas/ /lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /de bzhin rgyud dang 'byor par bya/ /rigs kyi lha rgyud lnga (7rnams ni/ /so so'i rigs su bshar btab nyaste/ /klod niyangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba yis/ /sbyang dang thob phyir bsreg byar 'os/ /bsreg ardzas skye ba'i chos yin te/ /skye bar snang ba'i chos thams cad/ /'dir ni dngos po bzhin snang ste7/ /chos can rkyen dang 'byung nas yidang / /rang bzhin nyid las cho 'phrul ni/ /skye ba nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /'di ni skye ba'i chos can te/ /rang byung sreg ardzas rang zhir thim/ /nyon mongs lnga yi dam rdzas dag /ye shes lnga yi klong (rtedu dbul/ /phung po lnga yi dam rdzas rnams/ /thabs mchog yab lnga'i sku la bstim/ /'byung lngas bsdus pa'i bsreg ardzas rnams/ /shes rab yum lnga'i klong lidu bstabasayi/ /rnam shes brgyad kyi bsreg ardzas rnams/ /ye shes gnas kyi ma brgyad do/ /yul gyi g.yeng ba rnam pa brgyad/ /dmigs med dbyings kyi bye brag brgyad/ /skye bzhi las kyi bsreg ()rdzas rnams/ /rnam thar sgo bzhi'i klong 6)du thim/ /thabs mchog la sogs rgya mcho1re tshogs/ /so so'i yon tan thams cad dag /rdo rje glu yis brjod nas kyang / /de dag mnyes pa'i 102—224

mchod pa brtsam/ /mchod pa thams cad rdzogs pa dang / /sgrib byang ma byang don chen rnams/ /grub dang ma grub don rnams ni/ /me la mkhas pas brtag ①par bya/ /me sgra gnyis dang kha dog gnyis/ /'bar tshul gnyis dang dbyibs rnam drug /de dag yongs su shes par bya/ /gal te mtshan ma mi sdug na②/ /bkra mi shis pa'i rtags yin pas/ /bsreg ①sbyang chen po rgyas par bya de nas 'dod pa'i rtags byung na/ /me la 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnams/ /rnam gsum gang ltar grub pa blang / /ro yi rdzas rnams bsreg ①sbyangs nas/ /ro la sngags kyis ⑤btab nas kyang / /shin tu dri zhim sna tshogs kyis/ /ro la byug dhicing bkru bar bya/ /bdud rtsi zhun 7chen khu ba yis/ /ras la byugs pas ro dkris dute/ /ro yi gnas rnams gang yin par/ /sngags kyi sbyor 6)ba kun bkod nas/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan mas gdab par bya/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gang dag ni/ /gzhung yin pa yi ⑩phyag rgya rnams/ /du 'byung ba dang mnyam pa yi7ske/ /sdong bu'i grangs kyang de ltar bya/ /sdong bu re la lha rnams kyi(9/ /ma nor rtsa ba'i snying po dgatso /ras chen dag la bris te gdagasatso/ /ro yi sbyor ba rdzogs pa dang / /ro yi phyi shun 7thams cad la/ /'khor ba'i bag chags kun bkod de/ /ras sam shing shun shog shog la/ /'khor ba'i sa bon thams cad dgod / /nyon mongs lnga dang dug gsum bcas/ /skye ba'i lam la ④rgyud drug rnams / /ming ngam gzugs su byas nas ni/ /gnas gnas dag tu dgod par bya / /khams dang skye mched phung po lnga/ /gzung zhunye'adzin ming du bcas pa rnams / / brda yi (shetshul du bris nas ni/ /ro rnams khyad par dgod 47par bya/ /de nas ro yi phung po de/ /rten nam glegs sam stegs ( )bu yi/ /steng du mkhas 102—225

pas gzhag par bya/ /thab ①kyi cho ga brtsam pa ni/ /maṇ+ḍal 'khor khyud tsam zhig la/ /dkyil 'khor gang dang gang yin pa'i/ /phyag rgya bzhugs pa'i pho brang dag /thig gis yul gcad (gyiso sor bya/ /de yi steng du shing brtsigs ①pa//dbyibs ni gru bzhi gtams pa la/ /zur bzhi ka ba bzhis brtan ④bya/ /sum brtsegs ⑤yang thog bar khang bcas/ /mtha' ma shing gis brdzang 6)bar bya/ /bar khang dag gi glegs ma la/ /ro yi bzhin phyogs shar du bstan/ /ro yi steng gi khang pa la/ /ras sam shog shog la bris pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dgod/ /ro khang glo skar bzhi phye la/ /thugs rje gzungs thag bzhis btags nas/ /phyogs bzhi bla ma bzhi la dbul/ /shing gi cho ga rdzogs pa dang / /shing gi phyi mtha' stegs bu la/ /phyag rgya'i lha rnams rim par dgod / /stegs bu rdzogs par gyur pa dang / /rdo rje las kyi skos ⑦gdab pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po bla ma la/ /'khor ba bsreg (8)pa'i mnga' gsol te/ /ting 'dzin ye shes rtse gcig pas/ /me yi 'du 'phro rgyun du bya/ /rdo rje las kyi kurma la/ /las rnams rdzogs pa'i mnga' gsol te/ /las kyi phreng ba rdzogs par bya/ /rdo rje chen po'i bla ma zhig /ro yi nyes pa'i mtha' bzung nas/ /las kyi bsags pa bgrang zhing bshags/ /rdo rje skabs sbyor (9)bla ma yis/ /bdud rtsi skabs kyi mchod pa sbreng 7/ /rdo rje bro gar glu tshig gis/ /skabs kyi glu gar mchod pa dang (nye1/ /rol mos drangs te nyanyadabul bar bya/ /rdo rje gnas kyi smon lam ni/ /skabs dang las kyi mjug 12tu gdab/ /rdo rje las kyi ltang 7'dzin pas/ /rtsa brgyad las kyis grangs bzung ste/ /dkar byang nya bla ma'i phyag tu dbul/ /ro yi las ngan ltang tsha'adzin pas/ /grangs med grangs su bzung nas ni/ /mtshan ma 102—226

11:bye/ (pe)go (ste/(pe rmāḥ/ rjes bya)(pe /rdo/ :reḥdzazudab/ drarmithang dra/ spradapo/ / ba/ sprang (1 ①tshon tha/ / bsdo zang thab ba/ bya / /me yi lha ni gang yin pa/ /me yi sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas me yi lha mo gos dkar mgi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'od mchog ste/ /'byung ba me la dbang sgyur zhing / /thams cad kun gyi drod bdag yin/ /srid gsum sreg ③par zhal gyis 'ches④/ /'khor ba'i sreg ⑤pa'i phrin ⑥las la/ /thugs dam dbang gis yong mi 'da'/ /me yi cho ga thams cad ni/ /yum chen dkar mo nyid la bsgog//de nas cho ga kun rdzogs nas/ /ro yi sgrib ⑧pa byang ma byang / /me yi dngos grub thob mi thob/ /me las 6)mkhas pas gong bzhin brtag /mtshan ma mi sdug byung ba na/ /bsreg yisbyang cho ga rgya cher bya/ /gal te mgu na dngos grub thob/ /ro yi thal ba chen po la/ /btags tunyenas thal ba'i bdud rtsir bsgrub/ /des ni bsod nams chen po ni/ /dpag tu med pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje me'i cho ga tsobasgrub tu pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa des dkyil 'khor thams cad byin gyis rlob skipa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje sngags kyi tshig 'di gsungs so/ /sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī he yinyeru ka badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa/ sarba dus yinaso shrī he ru māṃ khyenata ka ha na pa tsa hūm̐ tsū/sa sa sa sa sa ma ya sa nu ne/ sa noṅga ra/ badz+ra gar+bha/ rat+na gar+bha/ pad+ma gar+bhayo / kurma gar+bhayo / be+e tri khri )gabazhunya/ kā ( sheru ṇa gar+bhayo she/ lo ka gar+bhas no/ bi du ma gar+bha/ yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa ( des/ bi 24shwa/ te shwa/ ke sha(2 / ba shwa/ pe khri shwa/tra'i( )rka/ hri shwa/ ka nu )shwa/ pa'i 1)/ ru tis / rat+ta ge/ khā hi/ sa has//102—227

ha ha ha ha/ sidha/ byudzo/ sri ga la/ shwa na/ kṛ rto/ kāṅka / kha ga /u ①lu/ mu mu mu mu mu mu mu mu/ kha kha kha kha kha kha kha kha/ he he he he he he he he / ba ba ba ba/ dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥsri/ ar+ya te ① tsa te da dzaḥ/ pā ④rna ⑤rgyu/ lo ka baṃ/ bhasmi ⑥ya ti hoḥrgya/ ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra/ kro gro kro kro gro kro kro kro gro kro/ dha dha dha dha dha dha dha dha dha dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ/ maṇa maṇa maṇa maṇa maṇa / ḍa ḍa ḍa ḍa ḍa/ la la la la la/ e gar+bha/ yo kurma/ ra rak+ta/ baṃ snisal / ro dz+wa ⑨la/ kau ru dhiḥyi/ phroṃ tu)tshwa na/ paṃ brnya/ ha tsoka pā la/ dz+nyā na par+sha raṃ/ bud+dha kā tunyeya/ ma hā wa gtso /badz+ra tsit+ta/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ8/ e h+ye gyiyi/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ/ badz+ra sa ma ya mu dra hūm̐ āḥyi/ badz+ra shrī 8te ru ka /tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya lhan/ ma hā shrī he ru ka ha ha ha ma/ sa ma ya hoḥyiphaṭa/badz+ra ā (nyar li 0phaṭa/ a ti pu hoḥsma/ pra ti pu hoḥdu/ i dhe ⑤put+pa ⑤ji pa/ba li/ liti dza hoḥ( 7/ kha raṃ khā ( denyi/ ma hā rak+ta/ ru dhi( )/ snisna/pañtsa gu a sri 0ta/ tsit+ta/ bā so su ta/ go ro tsa na/ ḍā ru kyi nās/ yo gi ⑥ni/ ma hā tsit+ta/ kha raṃ khā soganyi/ kha kha le(na/ sha ta pa khā (nyenyi/ a la la ho / sa ma ya hoḥ(zhe/ i da na de nā ce )ra kā 4nyan/ u tsi ra sa ma ya phaṭa/badz+ra sa ma ya a (shebe sha āḥ.āḥce / zhes gsungs pas las kyi 'bar ba'i cho ga zhes thams cad shin tu 'bar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje gsang sngags kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //102wa 229

de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des sgyur ba phyag rgya'i le'u 'di rgya cher gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi lag gnyis la/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i liṅgar ni / /a dang pad+ma gnyis gsal te/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sbyar/ /mnyam pa'i tshul gyis ①gnas pa la/ / me yi ②steng du a nyid gzhagadu /bya ba thams cad bral ba'i rgya/ /a dang ma yi 'bru bcu rnams/ /'phro 'du bya zhing kun du bsgyur④/ /g.yas su 'khyil cing dugayon du 'khyud/ / 'di ni ducho 'phrul 'byung ba'i rgya/ /a dang ma yi 'bru rnams bcurgya/ /so sor bcangs te myu gur bya/ /shin tu bstod de kun du bsgyur/ /'di ni snying por gyur pa'i rgyu/ /ma yis ⑧sbyin pa gtong tshul la/ /a yis thams cad skyob byed pa/ /'di ni tshad med chen po'o6)/ /kun la snyoms pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /ma nyid khrag 'phrog pa yi snod/ /a nyid so phreng mche bar sbyar/ /'di ni thams cad rol pa yi/ /'jigs tshul ston pa'i phyag rgya yin⑩/ /a dang ma gnyis gting yisbyar te/ / so phreng 7mche ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /shin tu kha glal ba yi tshul/ /'di ni 'jigs byed chen po'i rgya/ /ma yis bzung ste 'then nas ni/ /a yis gdengs shing 'joms byed pa/ /'joms byed chen po'i phyag rgya yin/ /ma dang a yis mgo mjug 1nyanas/ /bzung ciba'i tshul du byas nas ni/ /kha yis 8'drad cing 'then byed pa/ /za byed chen po'i phyag rgya yinayi/ /a dang ma yi 7shes rab las / /g.yas g.yon tshul gyis bsgyur byas te/ /so so ji ltar yin thabs sbyar/ /gnas dang yul gyi gtan tshigs su/ /bsgyur tunyeb gar gyi phyag rgyar bshad/ / dpa' bo 3)gdan la bzhengs ( )nas ni/ /phyogs mtshams kun du bltas byas nas / /shin tu 'gyil 37zhing brjid par byed/ /a dang ma yi ( )'bru rnams ni/ /102—230

so sor brdabs stinas dkur ②brten pa( )/ /'gying ④ba'i tshul gyis spyad byas nas / /stag gi stabs kyis kun du bskor/ /de nas mun bya stabs kyis ni/ /gong na dubazhin du bskor bar bya/ /de bzhin rus sbal gzig ⑥dang stag /spyang ki ⑦seng ge dom stabs dang / /phag chen dred kyi stabs kyis ni/ /thams cad thams cad bskor bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dab chags thams cad kyis/ /'jo nitshul stabs rnams rdzogs byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las sgyur ba phyag rgya'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje des 6)mchod pa dam pa gsang ba'i le'u 'di gsungs so/ /hūṃ 'byung ba chen po nam mkha' ni/ /'byung ba chen po lnga yi mdzad ske/ /nam mkha' (spelas ni 'dod pa 'byung / /'dod pa'i 8mchod pa 'byung gyur cig /zla rgyas la sogs snying po mchog /rma 0stes la sogs rnam lnga'i rdzas / /me tog la sogs tsan+dan phreng / /sna tshogs mchod pa 'byung gyur cig /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya mchog /'khril 'khyud sgyur ba'i gzungs chen ma/ /dbang po sbyor ba'i dgyes mchod de/ /bde ba'i mchod pas tshim gyur cig /rdo rje rol pas tshogs mchog 'di/ /mchod sprin kun du rgyas gyur cig /dug gsum brtsigs 8pa'i ri bo 'di/ /sku gsung thugs kyi klong tsodu bstabs/ /dug lnga rol pa'i tshogs mchog 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi yonang du thim/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan ma 'di/ /dbyings dang ye shes klong kyi du thim/ /'khor ba mtshan ma'i chos can 'di/ /chos nyid dbyings kyi ngang du thim/ /phung po 102—231

tshogs kyi yan lag 'di/ /rnam grol phung po lnga ru thim/ /'byung chen rgyu yi mtshan ma 'di/ /mkha' klong ①'bar ba lnga ru thim/ /rol pa chen po mchod sbyin la/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams rol/ /bla med stan 'gan ②mchod pa 'di/ /sngon chad rgyal bas bgrod ③pa'i lam/ /dug gsum gting nas gsod pa'i thabs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam bzhin du bzhesali/ /'chi med bdud rtsi g.yung drung chu/ /ro yi khams rnams slong (9bar byed/ /dug gi phung po 'joms byed pa/ /rtsi mchog sman gyi mchod par bzhes/ /zhes mchod pa'i tshogs rnams ling long phyad par byung bas rgyal ba rgya mtsho ⑥tshogs longs spyod des mnyes par gyur to/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ⑦rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las mchod pa dam pa gsang ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas sems dpa'i rdo rje des rdo rje glu'i ④le'u 'di gsungs so/ /'dir ni rdo rje rnal 'byor rnams/ /bsnyen par snang ba'i dbang thob nas/ /bsgom dbyangs yi ge 'bru brgyad spro/ /yi ge glu 6)yi rgyan yin te/ /glu yi yi ge bcu drug las/ /yi ge yan lag bsgyur bsdebs nas0/ /glu yi bye brag ⑩bsam mi khyab / /dang por glu yi don byung ba/ /o gyis glu rnams rab tu 'dren/ /oṃ yang a yi cho 'phrul te/ /a ni chos kyi yi ge yin/ /a las oṃ byung rgyal ba'i thugs / /rgyal ba chos kyi dbyings las byung / /a las e byung gsung gi mchog /gsung las glu (steyi yan lag 'byung / /dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cur ()grags/ /glu 7yi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba glu yis grub/ /rig tso'adzin rdo rje glu yis 'dren/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug glu yis 'grub/ /bstan pa rgya 102—232

mtsho glu ①yis spel/ /srid pa'i bu mo glu ②yis bstenani/ /bdud dang srin po glu ④yis 'dul/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho glu ⑤yis 'bebs/ /chos nyid dbyings kyi klong ⑥dkyil nas/ /dpal be'u nyi ma dgu shar bas/ /rnam thar sgo ba zhi rab gsal yang / /ma rig mun gnag ⑦'thibs pa yis/ /bsgribs par rig pa'i sgo mo byeni/ /'khor ba'i mun gnag klong 0rum na/ /byang chub sems kyi zla shar bas/ /mun bsal ⑩rnam thar sgo bzhir snang / /rin chen 'bar ba'i nyi ma rnams/ /dpal chen thugs nas yi'od shar bas/ /bag chags sprin mthong ⑫bye ba ru/ /rnal 'byor thugs mar zer tu bab pas/ /mun bsal ④rig pa'i sgo phye ste/ /rnal 'byor don la 'jug par bya/ /rig pa thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas / /ru lu'i 'od zer sgo phye bas8/ /spros pas cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung / /srid pa gsum gyi bye brag byedayi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting nas skems0/ /nyon mongs rgyu drug gnas nas sgrol/ /dug gsum rtsa ba rtsad nas gcadaX/ /bdud dang srin po yigadug pa 'dul/ /byin brlabs ( ) dngos grub char ltar 'bebs / /ji ltar dbang po'i sgo phye nas/ /'dzum mdangs ( nyagasal bar 'byung ba ltar/ /dpal be'u thugs kyi sgo phye bas/ /ru lu'i 'od zer yig 'bru shar / /mthing (nyanag ser nag dmar nag ljang / /smug nag 'bar ba'i yig 'bru rnams/ /yi ge rigs kyi phreng bar drang / /rgyangs kyis ( nyebaskul dang dkar (ste gyis dbabazhu nye/ /bsten kos ( nyanye bar gyur pa la/ /'jim gos mngon sum (spregasal bar bya/ /'bir kwas gnyis su med pa la/ /'dren kos yi ge'i phreng ba drang (nye/ /de nyid la ni glu drug ste/ /sha ta pa dang gar ta pa/ /cang ka de'u dang bang ka de'u/ /breng nge (7ba dang dung nge ba/ /glu yi yan lag sum brgyas 102—233

ni / /rgyal ba mnyes pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ / glu yi ①rgyal po 'di drug gis/ /don drug ②yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sha ta pa yi glu blangs pas/ /gdug byed thams cad spa yang kong ①/ /gar ta pa yi byagru blangs pas/ /gnod byed thams cad rdul du rlog /cang ka de'u yi glu blangs pas/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor me ltar mchod/ /bang ka de'u yi glu blangs pas/ /drag po gtum po lhan ner 'gyur/ /breng nge ba yi glu blangs pas/ /sprul pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad 'gyed / /dung nge ba yi glu blangs pas/ /srid pa'i bu mo dbang du sdud/ /yi ge 'bru dgu'i rang bzhin la/ /phyag rgya'i (snyedakyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs/ /de bzhin 'khor lo mu khyud bcas/ /khyams dang sgo khyud gsal ba'o/ /srid pa mthong yod snang grags kyang / /thams cad sngags kyi tshig tu rdzogs/ /yi ge rgyal ba kun dang 'brel(6)/ /'khor lo'i sa la nye ba'o/ /yi ges dmigs pa thams cad 'grub/ /chags med lhun grub don po che/ /rnam bzhi las kyi khyad par yang / /bya ba med par don du 'gyur/ /yi ge gsang ba'i 'phro 'du yis/ /rgyal ba dpa' bo (7)thams cad mnyes/ /de kun yi shes rnam sprul yang / /rang bzhin dngos med chos kyi dbyings/ /yig 'bru 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul las/ /dam pa'i ngo mtshar sna tshogs 'byung / /de bzhin sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg(8) /gti mug mun sel ye shes 'bar/ /rig pa'i nyi ma gsal bar 'bebs/ /bdag nyid dpal chen 'bar ba'i thugs/ /tsit+ta dpal be'u zur brgyad 'bar/ /rin chen yi ge 'bru brgyad gsal/ /dpal chen rin chen 'bar ba'i thugs/ /dpal be'u smug po zur brgyad las/ /gser gyi nyi ma dgu shar ba/ /'od zer ru lu yig 'bru brgyad/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i rlung sgrom du/ /shin tu 'bar 'phro 102—234

'khrug ①byas te/ /spros ②pas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi/ /na sa g.yas su drang bar bya/ /go ro tsa na'i gzhal yas su/ /sen gazlum tsam gyi ༷rgya khyon la/ /gser gyi nyi ma ga'u dgu/ /shar ba'i dkyil na yig 'bru dgu/ /gsal bas ⑤'od kyi gzhal yas khang / /dngos po'i bag chags kun bsregs ༅te⑦/ /sems ni gser chu zhun ma bzhin/ /ltem la 'tsher zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /rtsal las gyur pa'i zla dkyil 'khor/ /nyi ma'i ⑧steng na dpal be'u 'bar/ /de la ru lu 'phro zhing 'du/ /dpal be'u tsit+ta'i 6)dkyil 'khor 'di/ /yig 'bru 'bar ba'i ga'ur gsal/ /pad+ma kyi'abar ba'i ga'u ⑩'di/ /yi ge phreng ⑩ba 'khyil ba'i gnas/ /dper na me tog 'bar ba las/ /bcud len bud pas bcud blangs te/ /rtsi yi bur bu sog tu)pa ltar/ /dpal be'u thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rin chen 'od kyi me tog 'bar/ /ru lu'i yig 'bru bcud kyis rgyas / /rnal 'byor sems las byas pa yi/ /bcud 'byin bung ba mang po 'phro/ /phar lding 8yi ge'i bcud phyung nas/ /tshur lding snyisems kyi ga'ur bstimatshu/ /dang po shel gyi kha dog la/ /shin tu gsal zhing 'tsher 'bar ba/ /gnas dgu dag tu zla ba yi7/ /thig le dkyil gyi dpal be'u la/ /'bru bkod gsal ba 'gyur ba (nyedang / /shel gyi bung ba mang po dag /khyung chen lding ba'i tu)bong tshod tsam/ /phar lding 6)bcud phyung tshur gsibs pas/ /yig 0'bru ye shes me 'bar bas/ /bag chags bud shing phung po bsregs/ /phar spros ()thugs rjes sa la bskul/ /ji ltar nyi zer khri tsha tsha ltar/ /rgyun mi 'chad par rtse gcig 'bar / /bar du byi ru'i kha dog la/ /gong ma bzhin du bkod gsal la/ /byi ru bung ba mang po dang / /gong ma bzhin du 'phur lding bas(ste/ /bcud phyung 102—235

bstim zhing slar la 'phyonyu/ /ji ltar me mgal 'khor tshul du/ /dpal be'u smug po'i klong ②du bstim/ /kun gyi tha mar bsdu ba ni/ /bkod pa'i gong ma thams cad kun/ /mthing dunag 'bar ba bsgyur nas ni/ /khyung chen gzan la 'jums tshod tsam/ /hūṃ sgra 'byin cing phan tshun lding ④/ /ru lu bcud 'byin dngos grub rlob/ /dran pa'i dkyil nas dza phyung ste/ /lcags ⑤gyu 'bar ba ga 'ur bcas/ /dpal be'u'i yidakyil na spungs pa yis/ /ru lu rin chen ⑦phung po dag /bsdus shing drangs ⑤te gnas su bstim/ /'bab pa'i shugs sam byin brlabs ①ni/ /mtsho la ser chen 'dril ltar ro/ /'di ltar yi ger sbyar ba'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor nyag gcig ma yin gyi7/ /lha mchog dbyings na ⑪bzhugs pa yang / /chos nyid ngang du mi dmigs kyang / /rnal 'byor mchog gi ⑫bskul ba'i tshe/ /thugs rje chags pa'i mdangs phyung tsonas/ /srog rtsol 8dran rig gsung migasung ltar/ /mgur yichu yan lag 'gul 'gul ltar/ /rdo rje yi ger 'bru 'bar ltar/ /gug skyed ski klad kor (nyatsheg 6)par phyin/ /ra ri khal khol sgrib med pa9 )/ /ye shes don la mkhyen rig rgyas/ /de lta mod kyang 'dul dbang gis9 me/ /rgyal ba skul ( steba'i sa la gzhes(ste/ /rnal 'byor gso ba'i cho ga byed / /lha dang gcig tu bya ba'i phyir/ /bzlas brjod grangs dang bsnyen pa dang / /sbyor bas don la nye bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar stor ba'i dus dag na/ /byin brlabs ( 7phebs sam nye ba yi/ /rtags sam drod ( nadam mtshan ma ni/ /rnal 'byor nyid dang bsgrub rdzas dang / /yod mthong sgra thos kun la 'byung / /lus kyi drod dang rmi lam dang / /sems kyi rtags su gsal ba dang / /dbugs ( 9dag la yang nges par 'byung / /shing bal lta bur yang ba dang / /mi bde'i 102—236

gnod pa bral ba yin/ /reg ①la ting 'dzin gsal ba dag /rmi lam du yang myos ②par 'gyur/ /dang zhing dga' la mgu ba skye/ /gdung ba'i byang chub sems skyes shing / /ngo mtshar skyes pa de nyid do/ /'gyur ba'i dbugs la dbang thob ste/ /dgag dang dbyung ①ba ji lta ba'o/ /rdzas ni 'bar dang 'phar ba dang / /dri dang 'od 'byung ro mchog skye/ /mi zad mang du 'phel ba dang / /mngar 'jam dang zhing ro mchog rnyed/ /lto ④la mi gnod mgrin la min/ /zos na bzhin 'gyur lus rtas (pe'agyur/ /sil snyan yid 'ong sgra snyan gzugs/ /dri zhim 'byung ba de lta'o/ /rdo rje pra rnams bzang ba na/ /rtags dang mtshan ma phebs pa ste/ /smyur te dngos grub blang bar bya'o/ /bed ⑥dang ga'u'i phyag rgya dang ske/ /rdo rje bum pa'i 'phro 'du yis/ /dngos grub yum gyi mkha' la dbab / /yab yum sbyor ba'i lhag sems dag /ma phebs pa yi ⑦bar du dag /shes rab gsal ba'i lha mo bzhis/ /ha (shesta me long bhan dha 6)dang / /zhing chen phreng ba la sogs dang / /kha dog lnga yi dar g.yab yikyis/ /g.yab cing rig ⑪'dzin mang po 'boda'i/ /rol mo cha byad mang po dag /rdo rje gar dang snyan ⑫pa'i gluyi/ /srid pa'i ma mo kun rten cing / /byin brlabs 8chen po dzodabab par bya/ /phebs ma dag tu tu dngos grub bstim/ /'di ni rdo rje glu 'khor lo5 nye/ /ye shes rgyan gyi 6)las yin no/ /zhes sems dpa'i rdo rjes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje glu'i 4 )le'u zhes bya ste sum cu ( stepa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rje des rdo rje rnal 'byor 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i 102—237

le'u 'di gsungs so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ba/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /gang dag 'jug par byed pa yi0)/ /rnal 'byor rigs kyi bu rnams kun/ /snod du gyur pa kun bsdus nas/ /byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed de/ /tshig 'di brjod de ②gnas ②par byargya/ /e ma bde mchog dga' tshal ⑤'dir/ /bdag cag kun du 'jug par 'tshal/ /dga' ba byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /gsang ba'i don 'di spyad par bgyi/ /de skad gsol te zhus pa dang / /gsang ba mchog gi bdag po yis/ /rgyud sbyang yirgyud drug las sgo gcad/ / rig pa ⑦'dzin pa'i (nyarnal 'byor kun/ /dkyil 'khor chen po gsal bton te/ /phyag rgya dbang dang bcas pa yi7/ /'khor ba'i rgyud rnams sbyang bar bibya/ /'jug pa de yi gnas lnga ru/ /rgyud drug sa bon bskyed nas kyang / /hūṃ lnga dag gis gnan (nyapar bya/ /bcug pa de yi spyi bor ni/ /pa yi ye shes la bskrun pa/ /pad+ma kha bzhi lte ba la/ /mi dang lha yi tsos bon dgod / /shar lho nub dang byang dag tu/ /lha min dud 'gro yi dgas tsodang / /dmyal ba rnams kyi sa bon gdab/ /hūm̐ gi chalam sgo gcad 7par bya/ /lag gnyis mthe'u 7chung cha/the bos mnan( 7/ /sor mo gsum sbyar dpral par bsnol/ / lha dang lha min gnas dag tu/ /mi gtong bzlog ()pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /lag gnyis bsnol nas mchan khung bsdam/ / mi yi 9/)khams nas bzlog ( )pa'i rgya/ /khu tshur bcangs te 'bru bsgreng (stonas/ /g.yon gyi steng du mnan pa 'di/ /byol song gnas nas bzlog 8 pa'i rgya/ /thal mo mnyam sbyar gung rtse sprad(ste/ /gung mo rgyab tu srin lag bsnol/ /mgul nas mdzub 9 )mos 'khyud pa ni/ /yi dgas sogekhams las bzlog 8 7pa'i rgya/ /g.yon thog g.yas kyi rgyab sbyar te/ /srin lag 102—238

gung mdzub tshigacig nas gcig /'khyud pa dmyal ba'i sgo gcod rgyal/ /lag gi phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /ngag gi rdo rje rgya brjod pani/ /kye stim ru dra ⑤yo dha kyi hūm̐ / /hri sa ma pa tsa hūṃ/ /hri sa ba dza hūṃ/ /'di ltar gsal bar gyur pa dang / /sgrib pa dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba'i phyag rgya ste/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mchog gi lha/ /'gro drug 'dren pa'i dpal mdzad pa/ /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams mgon khyod la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de skad gsol ba ⑥btab pa dang / /rnal 'byor chen po'i zhabs nyid la/ /'jug pa de yi gaspyi bos gtugs(she/ /sangs rgyas bde mchog thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsung ⑨mchog gsum ⑩las byung / /srid pa gsum gyis tu)phyag byas pa/ /dbang bskur gnang ba tsochen po sbyin/ /a 8ti ho sta ṣ+ṭṛ yid khaṃ/ /de nas snod tsodu gyur pa dang / /gsang ba'i mig ni dbye bar bya/ /me tog phog pa'i lha yang sbyin/ /de nas dam tshig chen po bsgrags / /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /dam tshig 'di las gang 'das pa/ /rgyal ba thams cad bslus pa yin/ /khrag 'thung kha 'bar ma yi tshogs/ /khros nas snying khrag thogs ( pas 'thung / /badz+ra sa ma ya i da na the na ra kun/she/ /ba ra skṛ 1)da ya na ma ba sti nān/ /sa ma ya rak+ṣa sidhi babyi badz+ra a phri to pya da rka(3nya/ /rdo rje tha tshig chu blud nas/ /rdo rje gal chen mna' dor ro/ /rdo rje dam tshig sdom shuglepa rnams/ /thams cad thams cad dbog ( shepar bya/ /slob pa'i gnyer yang dbog par bya/ /kye rig 'dzin rdo rje bu mchog khyed/ /rnal 'byor rgyal ba'i sras kyis zhu0yin/ /gzhan yang gsang ba ma smra shig nye /gal te smras (lhan dmyal bar 'tshig /khyod ni rdo rje che ge mo/ /rgyal ba'i sras po gdung rgyud 'dzin/ /gsang ba mchog gi ming sbyin gyisari / /zhing 102—239

khams kun du bde bar spyod/ /des ni sangs rgyas zhing du skye/ /zhes gsungs so / /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje rnal 'byor 'jug pa'i le'u zhes bya ste sum cu ②rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas yang sems dpa'i rdo rjes yongs su rdzogs pa dbang gi le'u 'di gsungs ②so/ /'dus pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ba/ /srid pa gsum gyis phyag byas pas / /bla ma'i sa la gnas pa ni/ /gsang mchog sum cu ④tsa drug yin/ / phyi yi ⑤dbang dang nang gi dbang / /bsgrub (6)pa'i dbang dang gsang ba'i dbang / /bcu dang bcu gcig bcu gsum dang / /rnam pa gnyis kyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de la dang po sbyin pa'i dbang 'di yin te/ /oṃ hūm̐ sa hrīḥXha/kun gyis 'da' bar dka' ba yi/ /tshig btsan yul la dbang sgyur ba/ /rgyal po bka' rtags phyag rgya'i dbang / /sku lnga 57yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /rigs rnams so so'i rgyud 'dzin cing / /rtags kyi mtshan ma chen po ni/ /sbyor ba chen po'i phyag mtshan te/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rdzogs par 'gyur/ /shes rab gzungs kyi gsang mchog ni/ /don dang ldan par gyur pa yipo) mtha' gnyis dag tu mi gtong ba'i/ /gzungs ma'i rgyal mo chen mo yin/ /gnyis med yongs su rdzogs pa na/ /thams cad bde ba chen po'i ngang / /byang chub sems dang don du 'brel/ /shes rab chen po rdzogs pa'i dbang / /bkra 7shis chen po bum pa ni/ /bde gshegs bzhugs 61pa'i pho brang ste/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gyur pa yi/ /dbang chen de la sbyin par bya/ /gsang ba'i bstan pa rgyas nas ni/ /yun ring 1nyaganas par 'gyur ba yi1ge/ /bkra shis rdzas kyi tso 102wa 240

dbang mchog kyang / /gnang ba chen po sbyin par bya/ /don rnams grub par 'gyur ba yi/ /'dod dgur ①re skong rin po che/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /rgyal po mchog tu dbang bskur ②ro/ /rin chen pad+ma seng duge'i khri / /bla mar gyur pa'i gdan mchog de/ /khyad par chen por gyur pa'i dbang //khri chen dag la gzhag par bya/ / cod pan ④me tog phreng la sogs/ /dbang mchog brjid pa'i rgyan gyis bklubs(snye/ /dbu rgyan do shal se mo do/ /dpung rgyan rkang gdub lag gdub rnams/ /dbang thob rgyal pos de la sbyin/ /dbang thob mdzes pas brjid pa'i rgyal po de/ /dbang phyug yin pas de la kun phyag 'tshal / /rdo rje dbang phyug rgyal po'o 6nyezhes par ni/ /kun gyis ④sgra chen bod ⑧cing bsgrags pa ⑨bya/ /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs khyud ldan pa zhig /rgyal po de yi lag tu bskur nas ni/ /'jig rten kun la kha lo sgyur ba yi/ /dbang mchog rgyal po 'di yang sbyin par bya/ /phyi 'khor skyong ba'i rgyal por gyur phan chad / /bla med mchog gi rtags dang ldan 'gyur bas/ /gsang sgo phye nas nang du gzhug ⑩par bya/ /shin tu gsang ba'i rdzas dang ldan gyur nasayi/ /gsang sgo gang las 'dod pa'i don rnams zhu/ /gnang chen po yi tunyertags su byin gyis brlabs8 / /gsang ba'i don la nyan cing slob yipa'i dbang / /dbang thob skal can de la sbyin 8par bya/ /bdud rtsi chu 'dis rna yiba'i gsang sgo dbye/ /sarba ta thā ga ta sta ma ti ho/ glegs yi bam zab mo la sogs thams cad rnams/ /rigs kyi bu mchog de la sbyin par bya/ /des ni tunye'agro ba'i don byed nus pas na / /las rnams rgya mtsho thams cad sgrub pa'i rtags/ /rdo rje rgya gram la sogs rnam (/bzhi'i rdzas/ /bu mchog de la thabs kyis ( sasbyin par bya/ /gzhan gyi re 102—241

'dod skong ba'i bu mchog de/ /rgyal po rgyal rigs rgyud du byung ba bzhin/ /rgyal tshab chos kyi rgyud du byung bas na/ /tan+t+ra la sogs dam pa'i mdzod gsum sbyin / /des ni slob ma'i tshogs kun skyong nus phyir/ /bstan pa sgrogs yo)pa'i sa la gnas bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje rgyal po dpal gyi dbang mchog 'di/ /theg chen dgu yi rtags dang chas ②te sbyin/ /de ni bla med rgyal por 'gyur bas na/ /sa rnams non pa'i rtags mchog gdan khri'i dbang / /lha chen dul sogs zhing chen nyi zlar bcas/ /khyu mchog seng ge ma he gzig ④dang stag /gtum pa'i dom ⑤gyis spar te sbyin par bya/ /rgyal po yin pa'i rtags ni rnam pa bdun/ /skye la dbang sgyur rgyal po mnyes pa'i gsungs6)/ /pha rol dpung 'joms srid thub 'dzin pa dang / /bdag gzhan don sgrub rdzu 'phrul rkang par ldan/ /dgos 'dod yid bzhin skong ba'i rin po che/ /rgyal po de la thabs kyis sbyin par bya/ /de ni rgyal ba'i mchog sras yin pas na/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dbang mchog sbyin par bya/ /ris (7)sam 'bur ram lugs su blugs pa yi/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs brnyan de yi spyi bor gzhag(87 /ye shes chen po'i don dang de ldan pas/ /ye shes lnga yi rtags (9)mchog phyag rgya yis/ /gnas lngar gtugs te thugs kyi dbang mchog sbyin/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya yitā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā (nyab ād+ma (nyeko3rta(nye/ oṃ ma hā yi ā dar+sha bidz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba yi.ād+ma lho 1ko3rta(nye/ oṃ ma hā sa ma 6) tā dz+nyā ( )na badz+ra swa bhā ba 51ād+ma 32ko3rta( ste/ oṃ ma hā pra t+ya bek+ṣa ṇa dz+nyā na badz+ra ( )su bhā ( snye ba ād+ma ( nyako3rta tsho / oṃ ma hā kṛ t+yā nut+ta na dz+nyā na badz+ra 6sheswa bhā ( nyeb ād+ma ko3rta( )/ sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /rnal 'byor bde mchog de yin pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang mchog 'di/ /rdo rje can la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 102—242

kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3lha①/ ②ma sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra ①su bhā ba li.ud+ma ko3rtaphyi / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta ⑥badz+ra swa bhā ⑦ba ād+ma ko3rtani/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ⑨ga ṇa tidz+nyā na badz+ra swa (〉ṅgā ba āt+pa ko3hi.e/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza 8badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta8/ dbang mchog thob pa'i bu mchog de/ /don rnams grub par bkra shis phyir/ /bdud 'dul bkra shis rdzas mchog rnams//rtags kyis ⑩brgyan te sbyin par bya/ /don rnams grub pa'i bu mchog de/ /rdo rje dbang mchog thob pa na/ /zhing khams kun du grags pa yi8/ /rtsal gyi thig le rdo rje sbyin/ /nang du 'jug pa'i dbang thob nas/ /de dag kun la spyod sgrub 4nyepa'i / /dbang mchog dam pa sbyin par bya/ /skye med chos kyi dbyings nyid la/ /sems kyis tsodabang bskur thob pa yi/ /shes rab chen po rig pa'i dbang / /sems lon don gyi gtan tshigs 4)sbyin/ /bya ba'i mtshan ma kun bral zhing / /btsal ⑥ med gnas pa'i byang chub sems/ /snying rje chen po (nyebade mchog gis/ /khams gsum kun la dbang sgyur sbyin/ /srid sa gsum 'gro ba'i don rnams kun//thams cad rdzogs par nus pa yi/ /rtags kyi dbang mchog dam pa ni/ /thong gshol cha'abar ba sbyin par byed/ /dug gsum gting nas sprugs pa yi(pe/ /rtags chen ga'u rnam pa gsum/ /dmar chen dag gis bkang nas kyang / /dbang chen thob de'i lag tu sbyin/ /srid gsum sgrol bar nu bya ba yi/ /dbang mchog chen po ( nyesbyin pa'i phyir/ /ka tar la sogs mtshon cha rnams/ /dbang thob de yi lag tu sbyin/ /'khor ba'i chos la cir ( 7spyad kyang / /skyon gyis ( shegos par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /rtags kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /rnam dag rdzas kyi pad+ma sbyin / /las rnams rdzogs par gyur pa yi/ /dbang mchog thob pa'i rtags chen 102—243

ni / /sti ra'i dbyug 6)pa chen po dag /dbang thob de yi lag tu sbyin/ /yum dang gnyis med 'khril ba yi/ /chos nyid don dang gnyis med rtags/ /sbrul nag 'khril phyiba'i chun ①po 'di/ /dbang thob de yi lag tu sbyin④/ /gsang ba ⑤sbyor ba'i shes rab ma/ /dri med rnam dag lha mo zhig /mtshan ldan shin tu brgyan byas la/ /dbang thob de la sbyin ⑥par bya/ /dbang thob rgyal po chen po de / /kun gyi bdag po yin pas na/ /rol mo dri dang zhal zas dang / /'dod yon lnga la sogs pa dang / /nye ba'i longs spyod rgyan rnams kun/ /thams cad thams cad sbyin par bya/ / sgrub pa'i rgyal po de la ni/ /gasgrub pa'i las la dbang thob phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa/ /rgyal ba thams cad bsgrub 57pa dang / /rdo rje tshe dang sman la sogs/ /sgrub 6)pa ma lus sgrubs ⑩shig ces/ /bsgrub (༅rdzas thams cad sbyin par bya/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dbang thob de gnyis gcig pa'i phyir/ /rig tunye'adzin rdo rje rtsal ⑫gyi dbang / /rdo rje ming ni sbyin par bya/ /bsgrub pa'i dbang dang rdzas mchog dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po yin pas na/ /gsang ba'i dbang mchog sbyin par bya/ /dga' ba byang chub sems chen po/ /kun du tshim par byed pa yi/ /dkar dmar lhag pa'i byang chub sems/ /dbang thob de yi lce la gzhag /btsal mimed byang chub sems chen po/ /shes rab chen po'i rtsal 7gyis ni/ /chos sku sgyu mar dbang sgyur 7nas/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dbang yin pas/ /rdzas dang tshig 1medang gang zag dang / /kun rdzob dbang de ma thob kyang / /chos la sems kyi dbang thob na/ /rgyal ba'i rig yonya'adzin thams cad dang / /srid gsum dbang can thams cad kun/ /de la dbang thob bskur bar 'gyur/ /102—244

dbang gi tshad ni 'di lta ste/ /dad ldan sri zhur ldan pa la/ /gsang ba nyan pa'i dbang chen bskur/ /rnam bzhi las kyi don tshang na/ /las rnams byed pa'i dbang thob po/ /lta ba'i dmigs ①bus chos mthong na/ /rgyalatheb ②'chad pa'i dbang thob bo/ /rkyen thub tshad ma gsum ldan na/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /dam pa mdzod gsum ②thams cad la/ /phyogs med par ni 'chad shes nas/ /rab 'byam ④rgyal po'i ⑤dbang 'thob yipo/ /dad med blo zhan rdzob pa che/ /tshul 'chos mkhan la ras ⑦gcod byed/ /de ni dbang gis 'tshig par bshad/ /gsang med brjed ngas dbang mi 'chags(kye/ /dad med g.yel rmugs dbang mi 'gosal/ /snod 8med bcud bral 0kun stongs pa/ /des ni dbang thob ma yin no/ /snod ldan bcud rdzogs dbang thob na/ /dbang mchog thob pa'i rgyu zhes 8bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las rdo rje dbang gi le'u zhes bya ste sum cu 'artsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba mchog gi bdag po dang / sems dpa'i rdo rje dam pa rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo dang bcas pa chos thams cad kyi me long yin par rig nas/ 'dus pa phal mo che'i 'khor rnams kyis shin tu ngam yizhing ngo mtshar skyes nas/ bstod pa shin tu dga' ba chen po'i glu snyi'adi gsungs yiso/ /e ma hoḥtsho / nyes bcom legs ldan mtshan zhi spelamatha' las 'das/ /dpag med byams snyoms don gyis bdag gzhan dpal/ /don dam gsang sbas nam mkha'i dkyil du 'khyil/ /rdo rje che mchog dbang phyug 102—245

kun gyi bdag /'dzin pa mi rtog sha rus khrag la rol/ /thugs kyi gdung thag 'khor ba'i mtha' ①la rje/ /yul med ma skyes mtshan ma'i g.yul las rgyal/ /bde mchog rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shes rab chen po nam mkha'i nyi mar gsal/ /byang chub sems kyi 'od zer dbyings su 'char/ /dpa' brtul semyur ①ba'i shugs kyis 'gro drug sgrol/ /rtog ④'joms ye shes rdo rje cho 'phrul 'phro/ /dam pa'i don gsungs gnyis med ston pa'i sku/ /smra ba'i seng ge khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen gter ldan 'dod dgur ⑤kun skong ⑥zhing —/ /lung dang rigs ⑦pa gtan tshigs ⑧kun gyi mdzod/ /brda can yang dag len pa'i me long gsal/ /rdo rje kun 'dus 'jigs byed rgyal po'i ⑨rgyudal/ /chos kyi me long 'di la bdag cag 'dud/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las ngo mtshar bstod pa'i le'u ste sum cu ⑩rtsa gsum pa'o// //rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po (7rdo rje bkod pa kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo rdzogs shestetsho / / //tunya102—246
