log /dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa/①༄tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī phyigu h+ya gar+bha ②ta twa bi ni: ya/ bod skad du / dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bshad pa'i dus na/de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das longs spyod chen po zhe'ephyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid/ ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa thams cad dang so so ma yin tha mi dad dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin te/ 'og min gyi gnas mtha' dang dbus med pa na gzhi tshad med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal ba la ye shes rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / rgya phyogs bcur yongs su ma chad pa/ yon tan dpag tu med par rgyas pa'i phyir gru bzhir gyur pa / lhag pa'i ye shes rin po che'i glo 'bur gyis mdzes pa/ rtse mo phyogs bcu 102—287

dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa thams cad dang so so ma yin ngo bo nyid gcig pa'i ye shes kun du 'khyil btu)/ ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rin po che'i dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa rnam pa ②tha dad pa'i bye brag dang khyad par du gyur pa/ spags pa/ tshad dpag tu med pa/ ye shes rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phreng ②ba dang / chun 6)'phyang dang / shar bu'i rgyan dang /gzugs sna tshogs dang / sgra sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs dang / ro sna tshogs dang / reg bya sna tshogs kyis (5)phyogs bcur 'khrigs par rang byung la mi sgrib par gsal ba'i rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab par bklubs ⑥pa/ rnam par thar pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i sgo khyud can/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi nyarta babs dang ldan pa/ phyi dang nang med pa/ kun du yang nang du gyur pa na mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri dang / stobs glang po che'i khri dang / rdzu 'phrul rta'i khri dang ske/ dbang rma bya'i khri dang / thogs (nyapa med pa yonyenam mkha' lding gi khri dang ⑩/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang / gos pa med pa pad+ma rin po che'i gdan la sku mdun dang rgyab med pa thams cad du zhal thal le bar gsal zhing mtshan dang dpe 67byad du ldan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/thams cad du (stesku gsung thugs sna tshogs par kun du snang ba dang (ste/ thabs dang shes rab kyi zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i brtul cha)zhugs kyi skyil mo krung 'du bzhugs pa/ ye shes drug gi phyag ye shes rin po che'i phyag rgya 'bar ba can/sku gsung thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbu gsum dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tshor ba'i rgyal po dang / de 102—288

bzhin gshegs pa 'du shes kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'du byed kyi rgyal po dang / de dag kun kyang mthing ga ①dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang ne/ le brgan dang / ljang gu'i (nyamadog tu 'tsher ba/ btsun mo dam pa snang ba'i dbyings dang / sra ba'i dbyings dang / mnyen pa'i dbyings dang / dro ba'i dbyings dang /② bskyod pa'i dbyings la sogs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med par chos kyi dbyings kun du mtha' yas par khyab pa ni 'di lta ste / dper na til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang nas khyab par bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub chen po rdo rje mthong ba 54)dang / byang chub chen po ④rdo rje thos pa dang ske/ byang chub chen po rdo rje snom pa dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje myong ba dang —/ btsun mo mthong bar bya ba dang / mnyan par bya ba dang / mnam (yepar bya ba dang / myang du bar bya ba'i tshogs dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje mthong byed dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje thos byed dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje mnam nibyed dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje myong byed dang / btsun mo 'das pa dang / da ltar dang / 'byung ba dang / ma byon dzi)pa'i tshogs dang /'joms pa chen po reg pa dang / 'joms pa chen po reg byed dang /'joms pa chen po reg bya dang / 'joms pa chen po reg shes dang / btsun mo rtag par ma yin pa dang / chad par ma yin pa dang / bdag tu ma yin pa dang ne/ mtshan mar ma yin pa la sogs pa de lta bu'i tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba dang gnyis su med par bzhugs tsoso/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med pa'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 51de dag nyid kyi 4shegasang ba 'di nyid sku dang / gsung dang / thugs dang / yon tan dang / phrin tsho 102—289

las rdo rje las phyung ngo / /e e e ma'o/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings nyid ①dbang sgyur / /ye shes dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i ngang / /rang snang ba nyid ting nge 'dzinam/ /gzugs brnyan ④sgyu ma rnam par ②dag /gsal ba ni sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin ④las sel med pa'i yon tan yid bzhin rin po che mi zad par ldan pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rdo rje mchog gi gnas nyid do zhes rdo rje dugasang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las gleng gzhi'i 0le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das byed pa po ⑦rdo rje yid kun du bzang pos ①thams cad ma lus pa'i rang bzhin gyi tshul rdo rje btsun mo bya ba mo chos kun du bzang mo la 'jug par gyur to/ /zhugs pas phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa thams cad gcig gi rang bzhin dbyer med pas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de po)bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o rdo rje phung po yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /skye mched khams rnams mang po kun/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /sa chu ⑩spyan dang mā ma khri(nya/ /me rlung gos dkar sgrol ma ste/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug tshim/ /srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas zhing / /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis (stemi brnyes 8so/ /zhes brjod pas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur to/ /de nas btsun mo bya ba mo ⑫chos kun tu bzang mos/ bcom ldan 'das yid kun du bzang po dang gnyis su 102—290

med par gyur nas ched du brjod ①pa 'di brjod do/ /kye ma phyogs bcu'i stong khams ye nas dben/ /srid pa gsum nyid dag pa'i zhing / /snyigs ②ma lnga nyid dubade ldan gnas/ /phung po lnga nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thams cad mchog gi snying po bas/ /gzhan du rgyal ba'i rtses mi btsal/ /nyid las gzhan zhes bya ba'i chos/ /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi brnyes sodu/ /zhes brjod pas/thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /de nas gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid chen pos ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i sems ye shes su bskyed pa 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad ⑤kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skye/ /skyes pa nyid na'ang duskye ba med/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gag pa med las thams cad 'gag /'gag pa nyid na'ang ⑦'gag pa med/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi (nyachos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /gnas pa med las thams cad gnas/ /gnas pa nyid na'ang ⑨gnas pa med/ /e ma ngo mtshar med kyi kyichos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs/ /dmigs pa nyid na'ang yidamigs pa med/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad 8kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong / /'gro 'ong nyid na'ang ti'agro 'ong med/ /ces brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang —/ btsun mo'i tshogs thams cad kyang mnyes pas khyab par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pas ched tsodu brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o ye nas gsang ba'i chos/ /sna tshogs snang la 102—291

rang bzhin gsang / /ngo bo nyid kyis rab tu gsang / /gzhan du min la shin tu gsang / /zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bo nyid du gcig pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas dbyer med na'ang 6)/ 'gro ba'i rnam par rtog pa ma rig pa las 'gro ba lnga'i ris bsam gyis mi khyab par smin pa la thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chen po skyes nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma bde (migashegs snying po las / /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis (5)sprul/ /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang ske/ /gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /bdag dang bdag gir so sor 'dzin / /sus kyang ma bcings bcings med de/ /bcing bar bya ba yod ma yin / /rnam rtog bdag tu 'dzin pa yis/ /nan gyis stimakha' la mdud pa dor / /bcings med rnam par grol med pa'i/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos / /bstan phyir spro ba sna (5 tshogs mdzad/ /ces de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du gleng ngo / /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi byang chub kyi sems ye shes su bskyed pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs zhes (6)bya ba'i rigs 97)pa'i skyes bu thub pa drug de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las 'thon (nyeto/ /'thon 6)nas kyang las kyi dbang gis snrel zhi khodang yan man gyi 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po re re thub pa bcom ldan 'das 102—292

re res 'dul ba rnam pa 91bzhis 'gro ba lnga'i don mdzad de/ bltams ②pa dang /rab tu byung ba dang / dka' 5)thub mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas pa dang / bdud btul ④ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / cho 'phrul chen po ston pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs par ston pa'i thub pa dus bzhi kun du mkhyen pa dang / thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud kun du mkhyen pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi spyan gyis thams cad kun (snyedu gzigs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi snyan gyis ⑥kun du gsan pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho gas kun du don spyod pa dang /zag pa med pas kun du bzang po'i spyod pa rdzogs pa'i mngon par shes pa chen po drug dang / kun du sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du zhal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i grangs med pa phyogs bcur (7)snang bar gyur to/ /thams cad kyang 'di lta ste/ 'dul ba'i dbang gis lha dang / mi'i theg pa dang / nyan thos kyi ((theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang / bla na med pa'i theg pas ma rig pa'i rnam par rtog pa nyon mongs pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por chos stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad kyang gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa'i phyi nang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'phrul pa las 1)'dogs pa dang / las dang 7rilas kyi 'bras bu chud mi za ba dang / las dang las kyi 'bras bus mi gos/ gos par mi 'gyur/ gos su med par ston pa'i mthar thug go/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ched du 102—293

brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /ji snyed 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i chos/ /ma rig rtog pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gnyis su 'khor/ /mi mthun bde sdug myong bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin nyid las nyams ①pa med/ /yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan med de/ /rnam dag dbyings nyid tshul gcig go/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan rnams ni/ /log par rtog pa tsam nyid las/ /phra zhing zab pa'ang yod ma yin/ /log rtog nyid la nyid spyod de②/ /gzhan du g.yo ba ci yang med/ /log rtog rgyu 'bras rgyun ①nyid kyang ske/ /gzhi rtsa med dbyings skad cig ma/ /rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nyid tshul / /nyid la dbang sgyur nyid spyod phyir/ /bdag dang gzhan dang rtog pa'i rgyun / /rnam dag bla med theg pa'i mchog /theg pa bzhi yis nges 'byung la④/ /theg pa gcig gis ⑤'bras bur gnas/ /yang dag rtogs pas rab brtags na / /rang bzhin med las cir yang 'grub/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan yong ⑥mi 'da' / /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /ma rig smin mdzad 'dul ba'i phyiratshul/ /byung nas (7skya ngan 'da' bar ston/ /'dul ba mdo sde chos mngon dang / /dam tshig sgrub dang grub 6)pa dang / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud//phyogs bcu rnams su rab grags pa/ /gsang ba'i snying po las 'phros te/ /rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /sde snod 7kun dang rgyud (7kun gyi/ /'byung gnas gtan la nges par 'bebs/ /chos rnams ming du btags pa tsam//ston pas don dang mthun (nyaphyogs su/ /ming dang tshig tu btags nas bstan/ /ston min tshig la dngos po med/ /ces ched du brjod do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag nyid kyi gsang ba 'di nyid sku 102—294

dang —/ gsung dang / thugs dang / yon tan dang / phrin ①las rdo rje las phyung ②ngo / /a ho/ srid rtsa nyes dmigs bdag tu rtog las 'phros/ /rgyud drug skye 'gag lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa/ /log rtog nyid las gzhan chagayo ④ci yang med/ /stong nyid bdag med ye mkhyen rang rig thugs/ /dmigs bya dmigs byed med par dran dbang sgyur/ /ngo mtshar sku gsung ⑤thugs dang yon tan phrin stilas zhing khams las/ /gzhan na med de de nyid de ltar yin/ /zhes rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o zhes brjod pas/ thub pa drug gi sprul pa grangs med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa yang de dag tu 'dus par de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /gsang ba'i snying po ⑦de kho na nyid nges pa las chos thams cad gtan la phab pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu gyur nas mnyam pa chen po'i tshul rdo rje'i dbyings su chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i ting nge ⑧'dzin las mi g.yo bar/ chos thams cad ming tsam du gnas pa'i yi ge phreng ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /a rab tu brtan gyur a dkar las/ /shin tu phra ba'i a ponyernams spro/ /phyogs bcu gang bar gsal gyur nas/ /bsdus kyang yi'aphel 'grib med par bstan/ /de las ming tshogs gsal 'bar kun/ /spro zhing bsdu ba'ang de bzhin no/ /'di ni rdo rje dngos grub kyi/ /brtan byung yi shes rgyu yin no / /a ā/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye 47ṇa/ ta tha da dha 102—295

na / pa pha ba bha ma/ ya wa ra la/① sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣaḥphyi/ i khri/ u u/e eni/ o au/ 'di dag phyung bas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos nas/ chos thams cad ming gi mtshan nyid tsam du gyur to/ /hoḥ/④ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /a ni stong dang mi stong gi/ /dbu ma'ang dmigs su yod ma yin/ /thams cad ming tsam sangs rgyas kun/ /yi ge phreng ba nyid la gnas/ /a nyid sna tshogs par snang ba'i/ /ka la sogs pa bzhi bcu gnyis/ /sgra yi ming gis thams cad bsdus/ /mngon rdzogs rgyal por de nyid nges/ /e ma ngo mtshar ya ⑤mtshan gyi/ /'phrul chen bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i ming / /tshig (6)rnams ma lus 'dzin pa'i gnas/ /sna tshogs don chen smra zhing ston/ /dngos med yi ge'i rang bzhin sems/ /bdag med mtha' bral mi dmigs kyang / /dbyibs dang kha dog ming tshogs kyis/ /rol pa cir yang sprul cing ston/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhir gshegs pa yiX/ /ye shes sems dpa' sku gsung thugs/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga nyid/ /yi ge mgo nas k+ṣaḥ9kyil rdzogs/ /sems kyi rang bzhin yi ge ste/ /yi ge'i dngos po yod ma yin/ /dmigs med de nyid sna tshogs pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo che/ /sku gsung thugs ni ngo mtshar gyi/ /ngo mtshar 'phrul chen rab 'gugs pa/ /dbyings la dbyings kyis bris pa ste/ /yi ge zhes ni de phyir brjod / /mgo ni ma nor lam yin te/ /tig (9)ni shes rab ming du smra/ /shad ni thabs chen tshigs su gcod/ /a ni skye 7med de bzhin nyid/ /ā ni thog mtha' stong pa nyid/ /tha (1lhani sgyu 'phrul rdo rje nyid/ /ṭa ni snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul 102—296

nyid / /ḍa ①ni sgyu 'phrul yid bzhin nyid/ /nye ni sgyu 'phrul snang bdag nyid/ /ṇa ni kun du sgyu 'phrul ②nyid/ /tha ni dra bas mngon rdzogs nyid/ /ta ni dra bas brtan ③pa nyid/ /da ni dra bas lhan ne ④nyid/ /dha ⑤ni dra bas 'khril ba nyidal/ /na ni dra bas kun du 'gyur/ /ka ni spyan gyi ⑨thugs kyi mchog /kha ni snyan gyi thugs kyi mchog /ga ni shangs kyi thugs kyi mchog /gha ni ljags kyi thugs kyi mchog /da ni thugs kyang 'jig 9)byed pa'o/ /tsa ni spyan gyi sku yi mchog /tsha ni snyan gyi sku yi mchog /dza ni shangs kyi sku yi mchog /dzha ni ljags kyi sku yi mchog /nya ni sku 'ang 'jig nibyed pa'o/ /pa ni spyan gyi gsung gi mchog /pha ni snyan gyi gsung gi mchog /ba ni shangs kyi gsung gi mchog /bha ni ljags kyi gsung gi 6)mchog /ma ni gsung yang 'jig par byedayi/ /ya ni skye ba rnam par dag /wa ni gnas pa dag pa yin/ /ra ni 'jig ⑩pa dag pa ste / /la ni stong pa dag pa'o/ /sha ni rtag pa med pa ste/ /ṣa ni chad 8pa'ang yod ma yin/ /sa ni mtha' bral bdag med pa/ /ha ni mtshan ma tunyemed pa nyid//k+ṣa ni ye shes thugs kyi thugs/ /i ni rdul snyed lha rnams su/ /khri yini rdul snyed lha ma yin/ /u ni rdul snyed mi rnams su/ /u ni rdul snyed byol song rnams/ /e ni rdul snyed yi dgas 7su/ /e ni rdul snyed dmyal ba rnams/ /oṃ ni thams cad 'jig ⑩par byed/ /au ni thams cad zhig pa yinayin/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen 'di/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phreng bas bsdus/ /zhes brjod do/ /a hoḥ5nye / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang / gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag nyid kyis gsang (6ba 'di nyid sku dang / gsung dang /thugs dang / yon tan phrin ( )las rdo rje las phyung ngo / /a hoḥri spe/ thabs 102—297

dang shes rab dgyes sprin byang chub sems tshogs rgyu 6)'khor lo/ /'bras bu rgyal ba smin grub ngo mtshar ming tshogs bzhi bcu gnyis/ 'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i dam/ 'da' bar mi mdzad dbang med rgyu rkyen 0tshogs pa'i mthu chen yin/ hoḥdu/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yi ge ④'khor lor gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las yi ge phreng ba'i 'khor lo bkod ①pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas yi ge 'khor lo sprin bkod pa las sgyu 'phrul rnam par 'phro ba 'di ched du brjod do/ /rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin / /sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin/ /sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /dra ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon rdzogs pas / /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi 'gyur zhing 'byung ba dang / /bzhi brgya yirtsa bzhi'i nad sel cing / /longs spyod 'byung ba ngan song sbyong / /cir yang gzhan du 'gyur ba 'grub/ /nam mkha' rdo rje sra 'byung zhing / /'bar nas me yang 'tshig pa dang ske/ /chur 'gyur 'bab pa'ang de bzhin te/ /'jig rten khams 'di 'dor ba (pedang / /thams cad stongs shing (7ltung bar 'gyur/ /dgug dang btang dang bcing dang grol/ /gso dang gsad 6)dang pham dang rgyal/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /de nyid ye shes rang snang ba'i/ /ming tshig gzugs sogs yid bzhin gyis/ /mun la snang 'byung ji bzhin du/ /'gyur 102—298

bas ①gser 'gyur sman gyi tshul/ /ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ / ma nyams ②shis shing yo byad ldan/ /'grub 'gyur mi ldan med cing brlabazhu/ /dus gsum rgyal bas thugs chud pa'i//dngos grub mchog gi snying po ni/ /zad pa'i dus med yid bzhin mdzodadu/ /'phel 'grib med par 'byung ba ste/ /dngos po med las dngos po sprin⑤/ /sna tshogs rnam par 'byung zhing 'gyur/ /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med par/ /rtog pa'i dbang sgyur yiting 'dzin yin/ /gang gis dmigs ①med mi shes pa/ /de yis chos kyi dudabyings mi shes/ /de phyir dngos dang dngos med pal/ /'jigs pas dmigs med shes par gyis/ /gzhi 0rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /pho mo ma yin ma ning min/ /mtshan med ma yin rigs rgyud min/ /kha dog ma yin dbyibs ⑩ma yin/ /gnas su ma yin gang yang min/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /thabs kyis 8phyag rgya kun gyi rgyu/ /thabs las 0thabs 'byung ④thabs bsam yas/ /tha dad med la tha dad pa'i/ /nang dang nang gi phyi rol kyi/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas ye shes rol/ /'jigs 8med kun bzang phyag rgya'i mchog /gang 8gis glang chen myos 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par bzhag pas btul yinas su/ /sngags dang phyag rgya phyirab bstan na/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid gzigs mos mnyes par gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las sgyu 'phrul bsgrub ⑩pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin gcig dang du ma med 102—299

pa'i bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad la nyid kyi che ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byung bar bzhed nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /ye shes phyogs bzhi zhi)dbus brtags te/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis 0grub/ /rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /kun 'byung dkyil 'khor chen por spyod/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu (mikhyad bcas/ /gru chad bzhis brgyan bar khyams ldan/ /kun du gru bzhi sgo khyud ldan/ /rol mo sna tshogs sprin phung ④bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis kyis brgyan(5)/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang khyung / /nam mkha' lding gi khri chen la/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin po che / /gdan la rdzogs dang sems dpa'i tshul/ /'khor lo rgyal po rgyal mo dang //g.yas na mthong thos snom pa dang / /myong dang btsun mo'i tshogs su bcas/ /gru chad la ni mthong byed dang / /thos byed snom (7byed myong byed rnams/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas par gnas/ /bar khyams la ni thub drug dang / /mdun dang rgyab na byed pa dang / /bya ba dag ni gnas par bstan/ /sgo khyud bzhi la 'joms pa ni/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par gnas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri dril bu 'bar/ /ut+pal klu shing la sogs mtshan / /mdzes tshul mnyes pa'i yo byad 'dzin/ / mthing ga (7)dkar po ser le brgan/ /ljang gu (8)la sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /mnyen lcug 'khril 5)ldem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun stug bogazi byin 'bar/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen po/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs pa ste/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub11/ /sku yi phyag rgya che mchog ni/ /de bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /yang dag thar pa'i 102—300

gzugs sku dang / /'gro ba ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mthun hu)byas sku ni sna tshogs ston/ /ston ②nyid sgyu ma mig yor tshul/ /tshul nyid dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /ma g.yos bzhin du sna tshogs pa'i/ /de tshe mi mthun ①sna tshogs la/ /so so 'dra bar snang ba ni/ /de bzhin nyid kyis ma bcos kyang / /las 'phro'i dbang gis so sor snang / /dper na me long chu zla bzhin④/ /de tshe 'gro drug thams cad las)/ /sdig spong gzugs su rnam (6)par bstan/ /dge tshul rnams la dgra bcom rtsigazugs/ /rang rgyal rnams la bse ru'i gzugs/ /gzhan yang theg mchog rim pa bzhin/ /'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la/ /de bzhin gsung mchog mi smra ste/ /sku yis chos rnams mjal (shebar ston/ /me long bstan yi)pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /dngos kyi mdog ngan thams cad sel/ /'khor gyis de bzhin sku bltas na/ /byang chub sgrib 7pa gting dpag med/ /me long bzhin du sku la snang / /de nas sa bcu /lharim gyis 'byang (gye/ /bla med byang chub yang dag 'thob/ /chos sku dpag med brjod du med/ /longs spyod zad med rin chen gter/ /sprul pa bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad rdzogs/ /spyod yul kun du maṇ+ḍa la/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par rol/ /thabs dang shes rab sa yi mchog /de la sogs te bsam yas mchog /skye shi med pa'i tsho g.yung drung sku/ /nyon mongs kun gyi zhing du gnas/ /zad mi shes pa'i gter du 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rig pa'i sku/ /thams cad dbyer med mnyam pa'i sku/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yiye shes sku/ /de tshe sku lnga kun kyang rdzogs/ /zhes brjod pas/ 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' 102—301

hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā rat+na ladha raṃ ②ma hā kro dhe shwa rī ① dz+wa la nī ④rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma dha ro ⑤ma hā gro dhe shwa rī yidza la nī ④rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kum dha ro ⑧ma hā kro dhe ashwa ti'i dz+wa la nī 0rgyu phaṭa/ hūm̐ rgyu r+ghaṃ badz+ra tsit+ta oṃ 8a a a badz+ra bha dra sa man+ta āḥtso / oṃ mu ne dz+rī ④ga hā/ oṃ mu ne hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne sum̐ swā ⑩tā/ oṃ mu ne gro swā hā/ oṃ mu ne k+ṣiṃ swā hā/ oṃ mu ne ya swā ⑩tā/ oṃ e h+ye 9nyi bha ga bān spre)ma hā kā yiru ṇi ka ⑩ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ tī/ sa ma ya :du/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ rmāḥrgyu 'aswā hā / ba ba ba ba ba pa pa pa pa pa dza dza dza dza dza pa pa pa pa pa sa sa sa sa sa pa pa pa pa pa ma ma ma ma ma pa pa pa pa pa ya ya ya yaya/pa pa pa pa pa/ oṃ āḥ.in+d+ra swā hā/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin dulas rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen por tsobadag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sdi/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥbya / dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes brjod pas gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'di dag gis 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du khyab par grags so/ /rab tu grags so/ /kun du grags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byed pa po rdo rje dang —/ bya ba mo rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim par mdzad do/ /de nas phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid chen pos bdag nyid chen po'i ye shes dang byin bsdu ba zhes bya ba nuste'adi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje sgyu 'phrul dra ba las phyung ngo / /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā nur+shadz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta( ne+e/ oṃ ma hā ā dar+sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa 4〉ṅgā ba du ād+ma (nako3rta(nye / oṃ ma hā pra t+ya sonabek+ṣa ṇa dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta(3/ oṃ ma hā sa ma tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma zhinako3rta ci ra/ oṃ ma hā kṛ zhi t+ya a nuṣ+ṭha ( )na dz+nyā na (hebadz+ra 102wa 303

swa bhā ①ba ād+ma ('uko3rta / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ④ba ād+ma ko3rtal / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā bāka ⑥badz+ra swa gabhā ba ād+ma ko3rtaphyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta6)/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa ⑩badz+ra swa bhā (nyab ād+ma (nyako3rta8/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pū dza tsobadz+ra swa bhā 8ba ād+ma 8ko3rtayi/ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur(nye/ gsal bar gyur() / 'bar bar gyur to/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad ( )kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung / /sgra dang ming tshig kun las 'das/ /sna tshogs sgra rnams gsal bar 'byung / /gsung gcig dkyil 'khor yan lag ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab kun du khyab/ /sgra dang ming tshig so sor grags/ /thams cad gsung gi (nyuphyag rgya'i mchog /rgyud mchog sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /bde ldan gsung gi ( 3don 'byung ba'ang ( trī/ /thams cad pad+ma'i ngang gyur na/ /grol thar lam dang 'khor ba'i sgra/ /ji skad brjod kyang gsung mchog yin/ /theg pa mtho dman thams cad dang / /log 'gro ma lus ( )thams cad skad/ /byang chub rdo rje'i gsung du bsdus/ /bsdus nyid phyogs bcur 69rnam par grags/ /grags nyid ma chags ngang du gsungs/ /gsung ba nyid na brjod du med/ /brjod med de nyid sna tshogs sgra/ /kun la grags shing so sor 'jal nya/ /dper na de bzhin sbrid 3zhesangs bzhin/ /gsung gcig sgra yis thams cad go/ /'di ni gsung mchog rgyal po yin/ /theg pa mtho dman sa thams cad kyang / /de bzhin nyid las ma gsungs te/ / 'dul ba'i ( gethabs su so sor thos ji ltar gsung rab 3 3kun brjod kyang / /de bzhin nyid las gsungs (nyapa med/ /yi ge med dang rig pa'i gsung / /ljags kyi rtse mor ma phyung yang / /thugs rje 102—304

gsung gi byin brlabs ①kyis/ /'gro don ⑤sna tshogs so sor gsal/ /gsal nyid gsung gi rdo rje mchog /de bzhin gsung gi cha'agro don rnams/ /de bzhin ngang ④las ma yos ①kyang / /dper na brag ca'i 0sgra bzhin no/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dkyil 'khor bsdus pa dang gsang sngags kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yan lag thams cad dudakyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba 'di ched du brjod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgya/ /gsang ba de nyid nges pa yi/ /snying po phyag rgya 'da' dka'o/ /mi bskyod nyi ma'i dkyil yi ge/ /rin chen zla ba'i dkyil yi ge/ /lnga gnyis zung du sprad pa las/ /sbyar bas phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ (sheganyis rtse sbyar te/ /'bru brgyad bsnol nas rtse sprad pa/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /bde ba chen po sbyin pa'i rgya/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan5)/ /hūm̐ bsgreng rtse mor rdo rje 'bar/ /zla brtul 'bru sbas dril gsil yizhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkanatunye/ /sum̐ bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril4ge/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis yi blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkanayi/ /oṃ bsgreng rtse mor 'khor lo 'bar/ /zla brtul 5ge'abru sbas dril gsil zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur tsobakan/ /lī khye /bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil /she'abar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de /zhe'adzum 102—305

pa'i mdangs kyis 6)blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur ②bkan/ /swā ③bsgreng rtse mor rin chen 'bar/ /lizla brtul (snye'abru sbas dril gsil 0zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul ⑦gyis chos la brtan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur ⑧bkan/ /māṃ ⑨bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil ⑩'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur (nyebakan/ / āḥbasgreng tunyertse mor pad+ma 5ge'abar/ /zla brtul 8'bru sbas dril gsil 8zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan / /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur ⑩bkan/ /ṭ+wāṃ (nyebasgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum (7pa'i mdangs kyis ( )blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur 0bkan/ /hā 6)bsgreng rtse mor ral gri 'bar/ /zla brtul 'bru sbas ( stedril gsil phyizhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan ge/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur (9bkan/ /rta ༷ tre bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis 2nyebalta/ /ut+pal klu shing la sogs mtshan/ /rin chen myu gu ral gri 'bar/ /pad+ma dkar po rdo rje 'bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rin chen ste( )/ /gzugs mdzes rin chen phreng ba dang / /pi wang gar mkhan mchog nyid de gye/ /me tog phreng dang spos (1mchog dang / /mar me byug pa la sogs pa'i / /las la 'khril zhing chos la brtan ste/ /dbu (9rnams 'byo 63zhing 'dud pa'i tshul/ /gong gi phyag rgya chen po bzhin/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril snye / /sgo bzhi khro bo'i 8nyaphyag rgya ni/ /mṛ 6nyamago gdengs dang rdo rje gnon/ /thod sbrul chen pos gnon zhi pa dang / /rdo rje rgya gram las kyis gnon/ /lcags kyu zhags pa sbo ṭa zhi ho/ /sgo bzhir gnas pa de dag kyang / /'dud tshul 'khril 102—306

ba gong ma bzhin/ /thub drug phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /mdor bsdus phyag rgya drug yin no/ /gseg ①par dang ni pi wang dang / /go cha po ti rin chen sgrom/ /me dang chu ni rab tu bstan/ /yum ni gnyis med chos kyi dbyings/ /kun bzang ②mnyam gzhag ①ye shes 'phro/ /yum 'gyur mnyam rdzogs pad+mo'i dkyil/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /yang na de bzhin gshegs nyid dam/ /yang na rdo rje thal mo nyid/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs mchog ni/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan 'byor na/ /ma bskyod ④ma bsgul thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du ⑤gnas⑥ / /yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /de nyid yan lag spros bdag ste / /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsum 'phror 'gyur/ /de ltar ldan pa'i gtso mchog gisastim/ /rgyal ba rgyal mchog de bzhin du/ /bcu gnyis drug gi 'od 'phror 'barani / /de la sogs te bsam mi khyab/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi bsam yas sum/ /'dul ba'i don rnams so sor ston/ /theg pa mtho 6)dman thams cad dang / /phyin ci log rnams thams cad dang / /zhi khro tshogs chen thams cad la / /so sor mthun ⑩par kun du ston/ /dper na gar mkhan nyid 'dra 4)ba/ /lus las ma bkod sna tshogs ston/ /mdor na phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /'di zhes gcig ces brjod du med/ /gnyis dang gsum du rnam par 'phro/ /bskyed tso dang spro ba'ang de bzhin nyid/ /mdor na bskul 'baskyod thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du gnas/ /gnas nyid yimi gnas gnas pa min8/ /de skad dag mchog nyid kyis bshad/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las / yan lag dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs tsonas phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //102—307

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen po rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig bkod pa la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /shin tu phra ba'i dam tshig mchog /phyag rgya chen po'i phyag mthil du/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /sor ni bzhi yi tshad du bya/ /'bru lnga spos lnga rin chen lnga/ /snying po lnga dang sman 0)lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga ni rab bsnyams la/ /rig pas thig ni gdab par bya/ /lte ba rtsibs dang ldan pa yi/ /rtsibs bzhi 'khor lo mu khyud bcas/ /gru chad bzhi dang gru bzhi yi/ /bar khyams sgo khyud ldan par bya/ /sen zlum tsam gyi nyi zla la/ /tsa na'i 'bru tsam pad+ma'i gdan/ /yungs 'bru tsam gyi yi ge la/ /phyag rgya til 'bru tsam du bri/ /bcos bu ras ni (misna tshogs dang / /rgyan (7phreng bro ba'i btung (4)bas bskor/ /glu (getshig bro gar rol mo yi/ /sprin dpung tshogs kyis rab tu mchod/ /yum dang 'jo ma sems ma yis ji ltar 'dod pa'i las bzhin mchod/ /dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ldan par/ /zhal du gyur pa'i me bos la/ /bza' btung bro ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /las (5)bzhi'i mchod pa 97rab tu sbyin9su/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin te/ /shin tu phra la 99)sbyangs pa yis/ /bsam yas dag la'ang de bzhin bya/ /rig pas dpag pa tsam du'o/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas zhing / /mnyen 'jam 7reg na bde ba yiyin/ /sna tshogs rin po che yi gzhi/ /mdzes par bris shing spras pa dang / /kun 'byung rin chen phung por 'bar/ /dbyibs legs rdzing bu bro camachog bsil/ /rin chen khang pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan dang dpag zhu bsam 102—308

ljon pa'i tshal/ /glu 6)dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra/ /bla re rgyal mtshan na bza' gdugs/ /do shal dpung rgyan se mo do/ /bza' dang btung ba'i mchog rnams dang / /rang la mdzes par brgyan pa yi/ /lha dang lha mo rdul snyed kyis/ /bro gar la sogs bsam yas kyis(kyi/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas//dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par dbul/ /skal ①ldan gsal ba'i ③khyad par gyis/ /rim gyis yang na cig (snyecar du/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bsgom/ /gsal ldan ma 'am byin brlabs la/ /stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug tshul du/ /dbyings nas dkyil 'khor spyan drang mchod / /mnyes nas grub pa'i dam tshig mchog /bdag nyid chen po mchod pa yis / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum 'gro ba thams cad la/ /dga' ba chen pos khyab par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba brtan ⑥pa yis / /phyogs bcu dus bzhir gshegs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus dang / /khams gsum 'gro rnams mngon du 'gyur/ /lus ngag sems dang chos thams cad/ /gang na'ang mi gnas mi dmigs pa/ /mig yor (/tshul du sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' sgom(8)/ /kun byas dbang phyug rig pas 'jug /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ /rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul/ /dbang phyug longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa yin/ /nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /nyes pa thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /dad brtson brtul zhugs rab rtog 5nanas/ /phan pa'i dbang sbyin nus pa'i dbang / /rim pa bzhin du sbyin par bya/ /snying 102—309

rjes chud ma zos par gzung / /yang na thal mo yo)rab bsnol nas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i 'phang du ni/ /dkyil 'khor mdzub chagang tshad du bya/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /yang na sa gzhi nirab mnyam ④la/ /dkyil 'khor khru gang tshad du bya/ /yang na lus gang tshad du ste/ /yang na lus ni ⑤gsum gyi tshadaX/ /phur bu srad bu tshon phye dang / /gos rgyan stimadzes pa'i yid 'ong grogs/ /thig gdab ⑤cho ga phun sum tshogs/ /mkhas ldan chen pos bsgrims te bya/ /yang na khru ni bcu drug dang / /nyi shu'am nyi shu rtsa lngar 6)bya/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor lnga rnams bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs ldan gzugs kyang dgod/ /yang na rgyang grags dpag tshad tsam/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni bsam yas par sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bsgomatshu/ /ma mthong rmongs la bstan 77phyir mtshon/ /kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga 'amatso/ /lnga yi tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /'dul ba'i cho ga bzhin du bgyi'/ /ting 'dzin rol mo mtha' yas mchog /yi ge'am brda tso'am snying po 'am/ /phyag rgya'am sku gsung thugs ldan par/ /byin brlabs ya mtshan rmad 8po che/ /'grub 'gyur sangs rgyas kun gyi dam/ /sa la tsosogs la phyag rgyar tu)byas/ /rnam grol rim pa thob par 'gyur/ /dag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyangs na(ste / /smos ci dgos te de nyid yin/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che / /mi dmigs ()thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo 6 )/ /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi/ /rin po che dang 'byung ba kun/ /de dag rdzas 102—310

yod ma yin te/ /rang sems bsod nams brtan pa yin/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad po che/ /gzhan nas yong 'ongs ma yin te/ /thabs la brten ①pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu yi ngang du byung / /shes rab dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid / /thabs kyi phyag rgyar gyur pa'i phyir/ /ye shes la ni ye shes rol/ /ye shes rol pa nyid kyang gsog② /rgyal ba mngon byung niskyob pa dang / /byin brlabs 4)ston pa'ang de bzhin te/ /bya byed nus pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /sgyu ma rdo rje btsan (snyepo mchog /cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas shing / /yo byad lnga ni rdzogs par ldan/ /sngags kyi yan lag lnga rdzogs pas4)/ /ma nyams 'jug la rab brtson pas/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis / /dbang bsgyur (perigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyis / /sku lnga lhun gyis ④rdzogs pa ni/ / ye shes thig le de nyid la6)/ /ye shes thig le nyid snang ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /zhing khams rnam dag bsam yas pa7/ /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang / /'khor lo'i rgyan dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsam yas kun/ /mthong nas nye bar mnyes pa dang / /rgya chen gsung las don 'byung ba/ /mthun /nyapa'i shes rab snang ba'o/ /gcig dang du mar bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang 'byung khoye shes gnas med snang / /log par rtog brtags ⑫rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi gzhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos 'brel pas nayi/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang / /bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /stangs dzedapyal gnyis sam yang na lnga/ /byas te dad ldan 102—311

rab zhugs ①na/ /'dod pa'i yid 'ong mnyam par 'gyur/ /skal ba mnyam pa'i ye shes de/ /gnyer na nye bar 'byung ba yin/ /ya mtshan chen po 'byung bar nges/ /dad med nyams na phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes ched du brjod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las rdo rje bkod pa gsang ba dam tshig gi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos rgyal po sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ /ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya las/ /bde ba'i 'bru tshogs gsal ba'i rgyun/ /rdo rje'i ②lam nas pad+mor bskyilag/ / rtsa nas (4)bstim zhing dkyil 'khor bsgyur/ /nyan byed 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba (5)thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /ṭ+wāṃ nyegi phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor gsal spro thim/ /gsang ba gsang lachen gsang mchog las/ /gsang ba kun la mnyan par bya/ /gsang ba'i don nyid brtag (7pa las/ /gzhan du smra bar 6)bya ba yin/ /gsal ba'i 'khor lo yigazhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le ngo bo nyid/ /yi ge phreng ba'i tshogs mchog las/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal spro bstim/ /oṃ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras chen po/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje zung 7/ /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes mchod la/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /lag pa'i 'khor lo gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le ngo bo nyid/ /hūm̐ 7gi phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor gsal spro thim/ /oṃ khyod ni rdo rje las yin gyis(1nyal/ /las rnams ma lus kun gyis shig /pho nya mang po'i 'du 'phro cikun/ /102—312

khyod kyi dgos pa byed pa yin/ /smra byed 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /trī 0)yi phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal spro thim/ /oṃ chos ②kyi bdud rtsi bla med kyis/ /dad ldan skyes bu ngoms par byos/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i blo can la/ /mthun ⑧pa'i gsang bsgrags gzhan ④du min/ /bskyod chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /hūṃ oṃ swā rmāḥhā durnams las/ /dkyil ⑥'khor lnga dang khro phreng bsgom/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung ⑦thugs kyi rdo rje che/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed pa po/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi sbyin pa spyod/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom ri pa rnams/ /'bras bu med cing rlag 6)par 'gyur/ /dbu rgyan tsocod pan phreng ba dang / /go cha rgyal mtshan phyag rgya dang —/ /gdugs dang bum pa bza' btung (nyedang / /snying po lnga yis dbang bskur na/ /dus 'di phyin cad 7rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /tshe ring bde skyid tunyephun sum tsotshogs/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bdag por 'gyur / /zhes brjod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dbang sbyin pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen pos/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyal po sgyur ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum par/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon rdzogs 102—313

rgyal po che/ /yan lag dbang po rnam shes kun/ /rnam smin oṃ du shes par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom6)/ /yang na khros ②pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgomal / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /rnam smin spru ④du shes par bya/ /yum gyi dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom/ /yang na khro mo'i dkyil 'khor sgom⑤/ /gos rgyan yibaza' btung glu ⑦dang tshig /bro gar tshogs kyi sprin phung gis/ /hūm̐ ⑧du shes pas rab spyad na/ /ngo mtshar 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye 'am yang na mi dbye bar/ /bsnyen ⑨pa dang ni nye bsnyen po/ /sgrub ⑩pa dang ni sgrub yichen po/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs ⑩kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la/ /dgyes mnyam tshogs kyi sbyin pas bstim/ / bsgrub pa'i yonyenyi zla'i dkyil 'khor de / /dkyil 'khor rdo rje lce yis blang 8/ /mkha' 'gro gsal 'bar tshe la sogs / /yid bzhin sprin gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /zhing 'gyur mchog dang mchog phran rnams/ /nyi zla'i steng du mkhas pas bzhagatso /nga ⑩rgyal lag gi 'du byed bsgom/ /hūm̐ 7du gyur pas rnam par dag /dbyings su thim nas phyag rgyar 'bar/ /skur 'gyur 'od zer 'phro bas yo brjid/ /gtsug tu rnam par rgyal ba sgom(rte/ /ngo mtshar ngan 'gro thar pa'i thabs/ /ye shes skye med de bzhin nyid/ /sgyu mar snang ba mig yor tshul/ /sbyor sgrol bya ba kun byas kyang / /rdul cha tsam yang gos pa med/ /snod bcud rgyu rnams dag rtogs shing / /mnyam gnyis lhag pa'i mnyam 6 )gnyis kyis/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bzang po'i zhing / /byed spyod tshogs chen gnyis gyur nas/ /yan lag ma nyams yo byad ldan / /cho ga rdzogs par shes pa yis/ /rnal 'byor tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor 102—314

gyis / /nges par legs pa'i dgos pa 'grub/ /lnga dang lnga yi sbyor ba yis /tshom bu lnga yi lha bkod la/ /khro bo bcu dang khro mo bcu/ /'khor lo'i tshul du rnam par bsgom/ /de bzhin rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs/ /pad+ma'i rigs te sku gsung thugs/ /khro bo'i tshogs dang ldan pa yi/ /tshom bu gsum gyi lha rnams bsgom / /rigs kyi rigs te rigs kyi gtso/ /thugs kyi thugs te thugs kyi mchog /khro bo'i tshogs dang ldan pa yi/ /tshom bu gcig pa'i ①lta rnams bsgomacha / /khro bo khro mo'i tshogs chen dang / /pho nya phyag brnyan ③bka' nyan tshogs / /ci bgyi la sogs tshogs rnams kyis/ /dngos grub las rnams rdzogs par byed/ /rnal 'byor sngags 'chang dngos grub ni/ /mnyam rdzogs lhun grub ngang byaganas shing / /spyod pa ci la'ang thogs med pa/ /thams cad ye nas dbyer med pa'o/ /rdo rje rigs su thams cad dkyil/ /'od 'phro 'bar bar rab tu bsgom/ /chags med tshul du bstim par bya/ /gnyis med gyur nas phyag rgya che/ /yang na sku gsung thugs nyid de/ /thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs / /ting 'dzin gsal bar 'od zer 'phro/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du thim/ /rig (ge'adzin dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus 'bar bar 'grub/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal sel bar byed/ /rdo rje rigs su skye ba'i gnas/ /sngags 'chang dngos grub yang dag ni/ /thabs dang shes rab thams cad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor lnga dang khro phreng bsgom/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /'od zer rnam pa mang po 'phro/ /gnyis su med par bstim par bya / /dngos grub mchog gi snying po 'grub/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab kyis / /de bzhin gshegs dang yum du bsgom/ /sems dpa' sems ma nyid du 102—315

bsgom / /so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /ting 6)'dzin yang dag so sor gsal / /gnas dang longs ⑧spyod ci bde dang / /ma nyams blo ⑧ni rab ldan pas/ /dang po dam mnos bzhin du bya/ /le lo sgyid snyom ④med pa yis / /the tshom med par bsgrub (5)byas na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsang mchog dam pa thob/ /bsgrub 6)pa'i zhag dang tshes grangs ni/ /rgyud las smos pa bzhin du bshad/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du gleng ngo / /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 7le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa (8)dgyes pa chen pos rol mo'i sprin rnam par spros te/ rgyan bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor brtan 6)pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bro gar phyag rgya'i 'du 'phro yis/ /'dzul lam nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /glu yitshig sgra yi phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rgyan dang bgo ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po thub med 'grub/ /bza' dang btung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /yid bzhin sku (nyadang bdud rtsi 'grub/ /ā li kā li'i nyi phyag rgya yis/ /thams cad thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa'i gzugs/ /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rig (nya'adzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /mi dang lha dang tshangs pa yi/ /skye ba rnam dag 'dzin mod 102—316

kyang ske/ /khyad par sa la gnas 'gyur yin/ /pha rol phyin pa kun du rdzogs/ /thabs dang shes rab thabs kyi mchog /shes rab mchog gi mchog 'gyur 6)ba/ /sa yi khyad par bcu dang gsum/ /rgyu 'bras khyad par lhun gyis rdzogs/ /mkha' dkyil dag pa'i dbyings nyi (7zla/ /ye shes rgyal po stangs dpyal snyubasgom / /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas kun/ /ma lus par ni bsgom ④par 'gyur/ /dus bzhi (5)phyogs bcu gang nas kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas yim tshol cig /dkyil 'khor kun du rab sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /cho ga lhag gam ma tshang yang / /skyon nyid rdzu )dag ste nyes pa med/ /ces ched du brjod pas rol mo'i sprin gyis mnyes par gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po (8)de kho na nyid nges pa las tshogs bsgrub kyi)pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gcig tu )tu 'dus nas/dgyes pa chen pos chos thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa chen por lhun gyis grub pa'i dam tshig shin tu gsang ba'i snying po sprin bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/gle/ /ma rtogs yi pa dang log par rtogs(ge / /phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs/ /tso'adul ba dgongs pa gsang ba dang / /gerang bzhin gsang ba'i don rnams ni/ /yi ge sgra rtags ming tshogs las/ /brten pa'i tshig gis rab mtshon te/ /khong nas gab sbas 102—317

don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje'i thugs la gnas/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis6)/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i thig le dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /chen po rigs kyi de bzhin te/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje'i tshogs/ /dbang po yul dus rig pa rnams/ /kun du bzang po'i phyidakyil 'khor la/ /bdag nyid chen po lhag pa yis/ /thugs kyi ye shes lngas bltas shing / /snying po thig le mnyam sbyor ba/ /bde ba'i ye shes rol mo yis/ /ye shes dgyes la mchod pa dbulag / /zag pa med pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /ye shes sgyu mar rang snang ba'i / /rol mo dkyil 'khor mtha' yas stimachog /gsang ba'i thig le nyid kyi dbyings / /de ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /sku gsung yon tan phrin (5)las thugs/ /ma lus bdag nyid zhal mthong ba'i/ /dbang sgyur mchog nyid dam pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis rtsigrub/ /rgyan du dkyil 'khor ma lus thogs/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyam sbyor las/ /thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor yongs kyis 'byung / /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor 'dul ba'i mchog /sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrol ba yis/ /bya byed med par dkyil 'khor spyod/ /ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thos bsam bsgom ⑦la mnyam sbyor gyis/ /rang byung ( kun ngom 6)lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /'da' bar mi mdzad dam tshig mchog /gang zhig 'di la mos 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis/ /phyogs dus kun 102—318

nas thams cad du/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen pa yi/ /nye ba'i sras su dgongs par 'gyur/ /bskal ①pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /shin tu sbyangs la rab gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen pa yi/ /'bras bu gsang chen ②'di yin te/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na/ /'das dang da ltar byung ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pag/ /brnyes nas sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs/ /'byung dang ma 'ongs thams cad kun/ /'di yis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni gsang chen nges pa yi/ /'bras bu lam du 'gyur ba ④yin/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /'di las gsang ba'i nges don med/ /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi brnyes so/ /kun gyi phyag rgya chen po'i mchog /thos bsam bsgom ⑤la rab sbyangs pa'i/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams kyis gzung / /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la brtanayi/ /lus dang longs spyod gtong la sbyin/ /gzhan du nam yang sbyin mi bya/ /rmongs la phyar ri skabs gal te byin2/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /bsregs dang sgribs par yun ring 6)gnas/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du brjod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las shin tu gsang ba man ngag gi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o // //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la dgyes pa chen po'i glu 7'di blangs so/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che/ /bsod nams dkyil yina'akhor sku yi tshogs/ /snang stong thig le kun du rdzogs hoḥtso/ /oṃ yi rdo rje bsod nams thig le che/ /rdo rje 102—319

ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan/ /rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po thig le che hoḥ0)/ /oṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che/ /yon tan phrin ②las kun du rdzogs / /ye nas lhun rdzogs kun du bzang / /'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che hoḥ(gyi/ /oṃ mi dmigs ④sgyu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /mtha' yas kun nas sna tshogs 'phro/ /mtha' yas kun nas lhun gyis thim/ /sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po hoḥdu/ /o phyogs bcu'i ⑥'jig rten rdul snyed ⑦du/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams rdul phran snyed/ /sprul pa rdul phran bsam yas kyis/ /skad cig yud la lhun gyis grub hoḥ(8)/ /oṃ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsung thugs kyis kun du khyab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che hoḥkyi)/ /zhes ched du bsgrags so/ /gsang ⑩ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las mnyes pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po sangs rgyas thams cad ⑩kyi ngo bo nyid kyis 62khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du mngon par 'du mdzad do(ste/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag tu rmongs pa'i rtog pa dang / brtags 8pa la mngon par zhen pas yang dag pa'i lam dang bral ba dag gab pa'i gsang ba ma rtogs skipar sbas pa'i gsang ba la mngon par 'chel tshanas/ rgyu dang 'bras bu la rmongs pas srid pa'i sa bon rtsub mos 'phangs nas mtshams med pa'i rab tu tsha ba'i dmyal bar skyes so/ /de rab tu tsha ba'i sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs pa dang /'di bas shin tu grang yang ci ma rung snyam pa'i mod yo la rab tu sbrebs (nyepa dang /pad+ma ltar gas pa'i sdug bsngal drag po dag gis rab tu nyen tu)pa/ de lta bu'i 102wa 320

sdug bsngal rab tu tsha ba la sogs pa brgyad dang / shin tu grang ba la sogs pa brgyad du 'jig rten gyi khams zhu)brgyud cing bskal pa ②chen po stong phrag bcu gnyis su nyams su myong ngo / /de nas rnam par smin pa de zad pa dang yi dgas ②ltogs pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa dang / 'dod pa'i dngos po rnams yid du mi 'ong ba dang / gdug cing rtsub pa'i dngos po sna tshogs su gyur pa dang / yong ④med par yang gyur cing shin tu rid cing skams ⑤pa dang /lus dang yan lag dang / dbang po mi 'tsham par gyur pa⑥/ bskal pa chen po drug tu skyes so/ /de nas las kyi sgrib pa rtsub mo'i rnam par smin pa de khad kyis bsrabs pa dang sngon gyi srid pas mtshams sbyar nas/ yi dgas ( srin po rab tu gdug pa gtum po lus gcig (8)la mgo brgya pa dang 6)/ mgo sna tshogs pa dang /lus brgya la mgo gcig pa dang / lus sna tshogs pa dang / yan lag mang po dang / yan lag sna tshogs pa dang / gdug pa'i lag cha sna tshogs thogs pa dang glu/ 'khor rab tu mang po dang / 'jigs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs dang /'jigs pa'i nga ro ⑩sgra skad sna tshogs pa sgrogs 11pa dang / gzugs dang / nga ro tsodang / dri dang / kha rlangs kyis thams cad skyi tu bung zhes byed pa dang /rab tu 'jigs pa'i rlung nag dang / grang ba tu nodang / tsha ba'i 8dbugs kyis tsophyogs bcu kun du khams 'khrug par byed pa/ / nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhis 'debs par byed pa/ myos shing nyams ‘/snyepar byed pa'i mthus klu'i rigs dang / lha ma yin gyi ris tshogedang / lha'i ris dang / tshangs pa'i ris dang /'od gsal dang / dge rgyas dang / 'bras bu che ba man chad dbang du bsdus so / /de sngon bsten ( ripa'i stobs kyis thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs nas 102—321

thugs rjes 'dul bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa chen po'i ①rdo rje bkod pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra bas 'jig rten drug gi②/ phyogs bcu'i srid pa gsum gyi bdag po 'dul ba'i nga rgyal chen po gzi brjid chen po bstan pa'i phyir/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin 'byung ba chen po rnam par spros pa'i/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyal po ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings las khro mo dbang phyug ma chen mo mngon du phyung ste/ hi hi dgyes pa'i srigazi mdangs kyis pad+ma rgyas par mdzad nas ni gnyis su med par dgyes pa'i 'khril bas ④thom nas/ byang chub sems kyi sprin las/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi zhi)shwa badz+ra gro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa stil phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la ha la gas hūm̐ phaṭazhu)/ ces (9)brjod pas/ 'jig rten ⑩drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa tunyekhyab par gyur to/ /khro bo'i tunyedakyil 'khor gyi yonyetshogs stong gsum gyi 'jig rten tsam phyogs bcu'i rdul phra mo snyed 'thon 8par gyur pas/ 'jig rten drug gis 7phyogs bcu thams cad g.yos/ rab tu g.yos / kun du g.yos tsoso/ /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem mo/ /shig shig /rab tu shig shig /kun tu rab tu shig shig go/ /gtor gtor/rab tu gtor gtor/ kun du rab tu gtor gtor ro/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu'i stong kyi 7khams na gnas pa'i dbang che ba dang / gzi brjid che ba dang / mthu che ba'i dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa thams cad brgyal rab tu (shebargyal bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po nyid 'jigs 102—322

byed ①chen po shin tu rngam pa skyi ②gung zhes byed pa 'bar ba chen po'i khrag 'thung /sku smug gnag cir yang 'gyur ba/ dbu dang phyag dang zhabs stong khams kyi rdul snyed mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa de dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir gyur te/dur khrod chen por dgyes nas khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dkyil na keng rus chen po'i ri rab kyi steng / 'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i klong (midakyil na dbang phyug chen po dang / dur khrod kyi ④bdag po dregs pa khyo shug gi gdan la brkyang bskum du bzhugs ⑤so/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sprin phung gi tshogs thams cad de dag kyang la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po rdo rjer ⑨gyur te shar phyogs su bzhugs so/ /la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po rin po cher gyur te lho phyogs su bzhugs sotshu/ /la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po pad+mar gyur te nub phyogs su bzhugs ⑧so/ /la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po kun du las su gyur te byang phyogs su bzhugs so / /de dag kun kyang 'jigs 6)byed chen po'i cha lugs dang / rngam pa'i nga ⑩ro dang / 'bar ba'i klong na dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhis dri za dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / gshin rje la sogs pa khyo shug gi yigadan byas pa la bzhugs 7so/ /btsun mo khrag 'thung chen mo rnams kyang so sor sku la 'khril (snyeba'i tshul gyis bzhugs so/ / rigs lnga'i he ru ka las gcig tu bstim ste bsdus nas/ gcig gis mang po 'dul ba'i ngo mtshar bstan te/8 de nas dregs pa chen po la sogs pa gtum po'i sems kyis gdug pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po sna tshogs pa bstan nas mgrin gcig tu gdug pa'i nga ros glang po'i tsogatum tshig tu smras pa'i/ thong thong snying rje'i bdag po ci de ltar byed dam zhes 'dzer cing shin tu gdug pa'i sems kyis khros nas rngam mo( / /de nas bcom ldan 102—323

'das dgyes pa chen po dbu dgu 6)phyag bco (mibargyad zhabs brgyad du gnas nas thugs rjes 'dul ba'i thabs kyis shin tu khros nas rngam pa'i skad kyis/ rtsu hūm̐ hūṃ ha ha ha khā hi khā hi khā hi zhes brjod pas/ dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gdug pa chen po'i tshogs chen po de (5)dag gi snying dang dbang po kun phyung /nang grol snikun drangs yan lag kun bcad gtubs nas khrag kun 'thungs nas rus pa kun 'chos so/ /de nas rtsu hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo e ā (per li dzaḥdzaḥyizhes brjod pas/phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha' dang bcas par yungs 'bru gcig tsam gyi nang du chud par bsdus so/ /de nas 'byung po ma lus pa'i rgyal po'i yang rgyal po dregs pa chen po la sogs pa'i chung ma 'byung mo thams cad kyi rje mo'i yang rje mo srin mo chen (7)mo mi'i srin mo dang / tshangs ma dang / 'khrug mo dang / dbang mo dang / 'jug sred namo dang / gzhon nu ma dang / dmar mo dang / bdud rtsi mo dang / zhi ba mo dang / be con 6)mo dang / srin mo dang / za ba mo dang / dga' ba 97mo dang / ra ro khrag 'thung myos pa dang /gcig pur nya7spyod ma tu dang / yid 'phrog ma /snyedang / grub mo dang / rlung mo dang / gsod byed ma bedang / me mo dang / phag mo dang / rgan byed ma ⑫dang / sna chad mo 7dang / chu lha mo dang / nag mo chen mo dang / ra mgo dmar ser 1 chen mo dang / bum sna sngo nag mo dang / gsus 'dzin —4 ser nag chen mo la sogs pa/ bran dang yang 17bran dang / g.yog dang / yang g.yog dang / 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed tsho snabasdus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po dpal khrag 'thung chen pos 'dul ba'i thabs kyis yang rigs lnga'i 'jigs byed chen nyapor snang bar byas nas/ de dag kun dgyes ( 2par rol 102—324

pa'i dkyil gyi 6)'khor sprin 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di dag phyung ngo / /oṃ āḥrgyu ②badz+ra pra be 6)sha a la la hoḥl zhes brjod pas 'byung mo'i rgyal mo rnams shin tu chags pa'i yid g.yos nas pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor sdud cing rgyas par gyur nas/dper na khab len la lcags 'du ba'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po dpal khrag 'thung chen po rdo rje'i sku la srin mo chen mo mi'i 2srin mo dang /dmar mo dang / dga' ba mo dang / gsod byed ma (6)dang / nag mo chen mo dang ske/ dmar ser chen (7༄mo dang / sngo nag chen mo dang / ser nag chen mo rnams 'khril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung chen po rdo rje'i sku la tshangs ma dang / 'khrug mo dang / dbang (kyemo dang / 'jug srid mo dang /gzhon nu ma 6)rnams 'khril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung chen po rin po che'i sku la bdud rtsi mo dang / zhi ba mo dang / be con (3 mo dang / za ba mo dang / srin mo rnams 'khril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung chen po pad+ma'i (1sku la khrag gis myos ma dang / gcig pur spyod /nyam dang /yid 'phrog ma dang / grub mo dang / rlung mo rnams 'khril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung chen po kun du las kyi sku la me yi mo dang / phag mo dang / rgan byed ma tshadang / sna chad mo dang / chu lha mo rnams 'khril lo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po 8khro bo'i dkyil 'khor de dag gis hūm̐ tsozhes brjod pas pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs bsdus nas shin tu bcum par gyur to / /de nas dgyes te ha ha sna zhes brjod the pas byang ṭa//chub sems kyi ( )sprin dag las dkar mo'i tshogs dang / rkun ri 1mo'i tshogs dang / rmongs mo'i tshogs 102—325

dang —/ thal byed ma'i tshogs dang / spos ①mo'i tshogs dang / gtum mo'i tshogs dang ②/ sme ②sha can gyi tshogs dang / ma tshogs ma'i tshogs rnams rang rang ④gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du bcas nas 'thon duto/ /'thon yinas kyang 'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i mtshan shar phyogs nas 'khor bar 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis rang rang gi lag cha dang bcas nas 'khod do/ /de nas shin tu ⑦dgyes te he he zhes brjod pas seng gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / stag gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / wa ⑧gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / khyi gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / bzhad 6)gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / kāng ku'i ⑩gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / dur bya'i gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / 'ug pa'i gdong chen mo'i tshogs rnams rang rang gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du chas (nyenas 'thon ⑫par gyur to/ /'thon (srinas kyang 'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol shar gyi phyogs nas 'khor bar rngam pa'i mdangs kyis 'khod do/ /de nas shin tu dgyes skipas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus par 8khyab par byas nas phaṭa ces brjod pas / rdo rje sring 'gro ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje gdong mo'i tshogs dang tso/rdo rje 'jig rten ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje ro langs ma'i tshogs rnams ⑩rang rang gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du chas nas 'thon (nyepar gyur to/ /'thon tu)nas kyang sonya'abar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgor shin tu rngam pa'i gzugs kyis gnas so/ /de nas dgyes pa'i sprin las phyogs bcu nas phaṭa ces bsgrags pas thams cad khros nas/ ma mo thams cad kyang sonyerang rang gi gnas ga lnga ba der yud tsam gyis phyin par bgyi'o( ste/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po dpal khrag 'thung chen po de dag kun thugs rje chen po bdud rtsi chen po 'byung ba 102—326

zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ①la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra ma hā ②a mṛ gta ma hā byakro dha ⑤sla i i zhes brjod pas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po de dag gi snam yinas bton gnas/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam gyi rgya mtsho chen por chud pa las/ snam (kyenas khro bo uts+tsha stisma gro 0dha phyung nas 'dam ⑩khu kun 'thungs pas dran pa slar rnyed de/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi tsotshogs de dag thams cad kyang dbu dgu brgya/ phyag stong brgyad brgya/ zhabs brgyad brgya0/sku 'bar ba chen po'i dkyil na bzhugs par mthong ngo / /de'i dus su 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu'i srid pa gsum gyi bdag po dregs pa'i dbang phyug thams cad 'dul ba'i thabs sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par so sor snang bas dus gcig tu btul lo/ /de nas de dag shin tu 'dar zhing rab tu bred cing zhum pa'i nga ros smras pa'i tshig /'bangs su mchi/ 'bangs su mchi/'bangs su nan tan ma bgyis na/ /mgo dang lus ni brgyar 'gas shing / /snying yang 'gas shing gtugs ④'gyur cing / /rul myags tshig nas brlag pa dang glu/ /dmyal bar lhung nas 'bod par shog /ces 'bangs su mchi bar mnas bor nas dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du bzhag snyigo/ /thams cad kyis mgrin gcig 7tu smras pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mchis brang dang / /ma dang sring mo bu mo rnams/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bzhes su gsol/ /dpa' bo lha rjes bzhes su gsol/ /bdag cag so so'i 'khor bcas kyis/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang / /gtsug gi nor bu 'bar ba ltar/ /g.yo sgyu dzomed cing gus ldan pa'i/ /sems kyis blangs te spyi 102—327

bo yiya/ /gtsug tu bzhag ste ②bkur bar bya/ /de yi dgos pa ci yang rung / /ma lus rdzogs par bdag cag sgrub/ /gal te dpa' bo'i spyan snga 'dir/ /smras pa bzhin du ma bgyis dun/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mgo lus snying / /bkas gtubs ④dum bur rul bar mchirtsi/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas de dag gi chung ma'i tshogs dang / /sring (7mo dang ma dang bu mo'i tshogs thams cad dkyil 'khor du yud tsam gyis 'ongs nas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig ( )tu smras pa/bdag cag 'khor tshogs (0thams cad kun/ /dpa' bo chen po'i 'bangs su mchi / /dpa' bo chen po bdag cag rnams/ /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol / /zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos lag tu rdo rje byin nas ming gis dbang bskur nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bkod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de 61kho na nyid nges pa las khro bo rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor sprin rnam par spros pa'i le'u ste bco 1 7lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs chen po 'di dag dam (1tshig gis grub par bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa khro bo khrag 'thung chen po btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa de dag gis/ sku dad gsung dang / thugs rdo rje ye shes rngam pa las gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'di dag phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī yonyahe ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā (/2tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta dhika ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta 7ka ha yin da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta 7ka 102—328

gang —/ rab tu gang / kun du rab tu gang bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las khro bo'i tshogs chen po'i 6)gsung gi dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos de dag gi sridakyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa② / /gru chad bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /gru bzhi sgo khyud bzhi dang ldan/ /'bar ba'i bar khyams gnyis kyis mdzes/ /thod sbrul sna tshogs ④nyi mas brjid//'bar ba'i 'phro ba mang pos 'khrug /khyu mchog ma he gzig phyidang stag⑥ /gtum pa dom gyi sbar ba yis/ /dbang phyug lha chen la (7sogs bzung ⑧/ /smug nag sngo nag ser nag dang / /dmar nag ljang nag 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad/ /ko rlon gos ni sna tshogs gyon/ /rngam pa'i sgra skad 'jigs par sgrogs6)/ /sprul dang thod phreng nyi zlas brjidakyi/ /stong gi 'jig rten khor yug bcas/ /rdo rje dung chen gang ba dang / /ral gri dgra (1sta gshol la sogs/ /rang gi lag cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /btsun mo 'jigs pa'i tshogs dang 'khril/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya tu dang / /sgo bzhi phyag rgya rab mdzes shing (ste/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /(cu gnyis dang ni brgyad kyis mdzes/ /rang gi stan yi)dang lag cha dang / /ci bgyi 8zhes ni chas te gnas/ /zhes brjod pas/ 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor kun du gsal bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de 7kho na nyid nges pa las khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun 102—330

tu / /'dul ba'i dbang gis 0)tshul khrims dang / /ji snyed sdom pa bsam yas pa / /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /yod med dbu ma'ang mi dmigs shing / /sgyu ma mig yor ②lta bu'i (0tshul/ /srog med srog gcod bcad ladu med / /srog kyang skyes bu'i log rtog (5)tsam/ /bden pa gnyis kur dbyer med 6)pas / /'phrul dga'i gatshul te tha dad min(9/ /gzhan dang ma byin med pa'i phyir / /blangs med thams cad nyid kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu la/ /ming dang tshig tu brtags pa brdzun(9)/ /brdzun nyid la ni brdzun 7spyod pa/ /brdzun ⑩zhes btags yo tsam yod ma yin/ /ma chags tu pa la chags pa dang / /chags pa nyid na chags pa med/ /de ni tshangs mchog rgyal po ste④/ /shin tu chags pa chen po yin/ /bla med mi spong 'abla ma bkur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad/ /yang dag lam du zhugs la byams/ /gsang ba'i don nyid ⑩smra mi bya/ /'di ni rtsa ba lnga rnams te/ /bsgrub ⑩dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig mchog /gti mug chags dang zhe sdang dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog mi spong (she'o / /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ /dag pa'i snod bcud 1)mi dor ( gyer/ /yan lag bcu yi dam tshig ste nya/ /ye nas dag mnyam rtogs pas spyad/ /bsrung zhing bsgrub pa'i dam tshig lnga/ /rtsa ba yin te rigs med 'gyur/ /mi spong sa mi dor lnga gnyis ni//yan lag dam tshig 'da' dka'o lha/ /mnyam la mnyam par sbyor ba yis( na/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig la gnas na/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po thob tsho nya'agyur bas/ /'das nas sangs rgyas ma yin no/ /rtsa ba nyams pa'i phyal ba dag /gso la nye bar mi brtson dang / /skad cig yud tsam smra mi ( 7byed/ /nyams gyur nyes pa brjod mi lang / /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /sgrub ( pa thams cad log 102wa 332

'khor mchog /'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa la/ /khros pa'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la / /mtshan ma ming du bcas par 6)bya/ /bkug nas rdo rje phur pas gdab/ /rdul du byas nas tshogs la dbul/ /e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams nas/ /bcings 'gyur bskyod na phyogs bcur g.yo/ /myos nas gal te 'tshig par 'gyur/ /rba gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba'i gzi chen lhun chen la/ /chags pa'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /rdo rje gsung yang dbang du 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par ②byas/ /rdo rje chags pa'i phur bas gdang ①/ /chags pa'i tshogs la thim par dbul(7/ /baṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams rgyanas/ /'gug zhi)'gyur rdo rje'ang phyi bzhin 'brang / /ci 'dod de bzhin 'ong bar 'gyur/ /ma yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba'i 'du 'phro gzi byin la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma'i ming du bcas par bya/ /yon tan yid bzhin gter du brtag /nga rgyal dga' 'phro'i phur pas gdang (me/ /rdo rje gzi byin 'bar bar 'gyur(kyi/ / ma yi 6)tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams nas/ /gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'phrul chen 'phro/ /yid bzhin nam mkha' gang bar 'gyur/ /ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /dang ba'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /gtum po rngam po lhan ner 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /gtum rngam 'khrug pa'i ngo bor brtag /lhan ner gsal ba'i phur 102—334

bas gdab/ /'bar ba lhan de'i tshogs su dbul/ /ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas bsdams①/ /'bar ba lhan de'i byin gyis khyabazhu / /thams cad g.yo ba med par byed/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /lhag ma'i mchod sbyin 'dod pa sbyin/ /rang gi dam tshig rab bsgrags na/ /gang 'dod las ni ②byed par bsgo/ /sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka /shin tu gdug cing gtum bag ④can/ /thams cad ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /dbang dang byin brlabs rmad gopo che/ /lha chen la sogs dbang bsdus nas/ /'khor rnams dbang phyug slas su byas/ /so so'i las rnams bskos pa de/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ⑥pa/ /ma thogs 7myur du mngon par phyung / /dam bcas bzhin du ma byas na/ /ji ltar rang gi mnas (kyebor ba'i/ /sdom byas de las 'da' ma byed/ /sdom byas de las 'das gyur na/ /mgo lus snying yang tshal pa bdun/ /yak+ṣa khro bos gtubs tsa)par 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gis7/ /ji ltar bcol ba bzhin du byos/ /las de mngon du ma byas na/ /rang gis 47khas blangs mnas yi bor bzhin/ /rul myags tshig nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /rnal 'byor dam la gnas gyur pa'i/ /las rnams yongs su bya ba dang / /'khor rnams bu gcig bzhin du skyongs/ /phra 8men ma yang dngos grub thob/ /bcol ba'i las rnams mngon du byos/ /zhes bsgo'o/ /khro bo bsgrub yipa'i las kyi gtso bo 'di yin no/ /khrag 'thung chen po la sogs pa'i//bro gar glu 7tshig chen po yis/ /thams cad thams cad ci 'dod par/ /thams cad thams cad byed pa yin/ /mdzod lha chen po la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu smyotshig chen pos ni/ /thams cad kun la za bar byed/ /rdul cha tsam yang med 102—335
