sngag /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba thams cad kyi me long zhes bya ba'i rgyud/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra satwa mā yā dza rgyal gu h+ya sarba ā dar+sha nā ma tan+t+ra / bod skad du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bisgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba thams cad kyi me long zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ /oṃ rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo sa mi bskyod ④pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a (5)snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i bdag /kun gyis dbang bskur gter 'dzin pas/ /dgyes shing spyan gdangs gus bcas pas / /rgyal ba kun la bstod bskor chu)nas/ /spyan sngar gus 'dugaci 'di skad gsol / /e ma'o 97sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rten / /rtog pa kun gyi rgyal po ste/ /cho ga rgyas par bstan pa'i rgyud/ /dri med zab mo brtag dka' po)ba/ /'dul ba mdo sde chos mngon dang / /dam tshig bsgrub bodang grub pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi cho ga'i rgyud/ /ma lus gtan la 'bebs pa 'di/ /rdo rje sems 102—350

dpa' ji ltar lags/ /sgyu 'phrul gang gis bstan pa de/ /drwa ①ba'i rgyud de gang phyir bstan/ /lung ni gang phyir brjod pa nyid/ /gang phyir spyi zhes bya bar bshad / /gsang ba zhes ni ji lta bu/ /snying po'i don ni ci yi phyir/ /de kho ②nyid ces ji ltar brjod/ /nges pa zhes pa ci yi phyir/ /mtshan 'di gang zag gang la gsungs/ /mtshan gyi dri ba dris pa'o/ /thun mong khyad par tshul nyid kyi//ston pa zhes ni ci yi duphyir/ /gnas dang 'khor ni ji lta bu/ /dus dang sdud pa ji lta bu/ /mi bskyod ④pa ni ji ltar bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad ji ltar brjod / /rin chen 'byung ldan gang gi phyir/ /snang ba mtha' yas ⑤gang gi phyiral/ /don yod grub pa ji lta bu/ /spyan dang nam mkha'i dbyings ma dang / /gos dkar mo dang mā ma tī/ /sgrol ma zhes pa gang gi phyir/ / sa yi yisnying po ci yi ⑦phyir/ /nam snying spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /phyag na rdo rje gang phyir brjod/ /sgeg mo phreng dang glu gar ci/ /byams dang sgrib sel kun bzang dang ske/ /'jam dpal zhes pa ci yi phyir/ /dus bzhi bdug spos me tog dang / /mar me dri chab gang phyir brjod/ /rnam rgyal gshin rje gshed po dang / /rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ci/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /dril bu zhes pa gang phyir brjod/ /yid dang chos bzang (rinanaganyis ci dzinyephyir/ /gtso bos bdag la nges par gsungs/ /gang phyir thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /nang dang gsang ba'i gleng gzhi 7las/ /ston pa bstan pa gnas dang 'khor/ /dus dang sdud (spepa ji ltar brjod/ /grags pa thun mong gleng gzhi skilas/ /ston pa 'khor gnas dus ji ltar/ /bstan pa sdud pa ji lta bu/ /skyes bu chen pos bshad du gsol / /'di ni gleng gzhi'i kyi dri ba tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /thun mong thun ④102wa 351

mong ma yin pa'i/ /gleng bslang ①gnyis su ci phyir 'gyur/ /gang gis gang la gleng bslang zhing / /thabs dang 'bras bu ci yin ston/ /thun mong ②thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sems lnga ye shes lnga yi rim/ /gang dang 'brel pa bshad du gsol / /'di ni gleng bslang (0ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /skyes bu chen po ston pa'i gtso/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bar mnga' brnyes ④shing / /phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi rje/ /gzi brjid phung po phun sum tshogs/ /blta bya gang la ci yi ⑤phyir / /gang gis rtogs pas churaji ltar 'gyur/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par ci / /rtogs pa'i sgo ni du (sheru gsungs/ /gtan tshigs tshul dang 'bras bu ci/ /'di ni lta ba'i dri ⑧ba'o/ /thun mong spyod pa ci yi 6)phyir/ / thun mong thun mong gang ci'i phyir/ /7shes rab tshogs dang thugs rje dang / /rtogs dang phyogs gcig (1spyod pa dang / /'brel dang rig 'dzin spyod pa ci/ /gang gis gang la ji ltar spyad/ /de yi 'bras bu gang phyir 'gyur/ /gang du de dang mi ldan pa'i/ / spyad pa'i 7skyon nyid bdag la gsungs/ /'di ni spyod pa'i khyad par gyi dri ba'o/ /thun mong spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /rang bzhin nyid dang lhun grub kyi/ /dkyil 'khor zhes pa gang ci'i phyir/ /de nyid phyi nang gsang ba dang / /'dul thabs gnyis su ji ltar 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor rim yonyagasum gang / /lhag pa ting 'dzin zhes bya ba/ /gnyis la sku gsung thugs sbyor dang / /phyi mi7nang gsang ba'i rim pa ci/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor ji lta bu / /gang phyir gzugs brnyan zhes brjod cing / /gang gi gzugs brnyan gang la snang / /phyi nang gsang bar 7ji ltar 'gyur/ /lhag pa zhes pa gang phyir te/ /gzugs brnyan zhes pa ji lta bu/ /gnyis dang gsum dang drug bstan cing / /102—352

don dam kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /phyi nang gsang ba ji ltar sbyor/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis ci zhig /gang gis gang du gang tshogs nas/ /ji ltar spyad pas ci zhig 'grub/ /'di dag bstan pa'i dgongs pa ci/ /gnas skabs gang dang 'brel par 'gyur/ /yan lag rtsa ba gang dang 'brel/ /dkyil dang 'khor du ji ltar brtag /gsungs shig skyes bu mchog chen po/ /gang dang nges pa ma rnyed par4)/ /kun gyi spyod par ma gyur pa/ /legs par gsungs shig rgyal mchog che/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi dri ba dris pa'o/ /gang gis gang la gang dag tu/ /ji ltar dbang bskur phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gis ji ltar shes par bgyi②/ /gang dang gang du ji ltar 'brel/ /skyon dang yon tan ji lta bu / /'bras bu rim pa bshad du gsol/ /'di ni 'jug pa'i cho ga du/ /las kyi rim pa ji lta bu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /bdag gi the tshom bsal gdu gsol/ /'di ni dbang gi don mtha' dag la dri ba dris pa'o/ /gang la gang gis brten pa yigo/ /dam tshig ces (depa ci yi phyir/ /rtsa ba dam tshig du zhig bstan/ /gang phyir rtsa bar brjod par bya/ /yan lag du zhig bstan pa gsungs/ /'di dag lam dang bsnyen bsgrub 96)dang / /gang zag gang don ji ltar 'brel/ /bsrungs du/dang 'das pa'i skyon yon ci/ /phyi nang gsang bar (9ji ltar gsungs/ /lta dang spyod dang sgrub 5)pa dang / /shes bya ting 'dzin dam tshig tu/ /grub dang mi spong tsobasrung ci zhig /rgyal mchog skyes bus bshad du gsol/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /mchog dang mchog yinagyur ma yin pa'i / /bsgrub pa'i khyad par ji lta bu/ /gang gis gang du ji ltar bsgrub5)/ /102—353

dgug dang bcing dang gso dang bsad6)/ /dbye dang bskrad dang pham rgyal ci/ /gter dang mig rnon rkang mgyogs dang / /rig 'dzin go 'phang ji ltar sgrubadu/ /rgyal ba mchog gis bshad du gsol/ /'di sgrub ③pa'i dri ba dris pa'o/ /phrin ④las rim pa gang ci zhig /gang gis gang du brtsam par bya/ /thab dang rdzas dang phur bu ci/ /ting 'dzin 'dug phyisangs hom zhukhung ci/ /gdul bya rim pa gang ci zhig /khyad par rim pa ji ltar bshad/ /'bras bu yon tan ji ltar ⑦'gyuraX / /gsungs shig gsungs shig rgyal mchog gtso/ /the tshom ①legs par chod ⑩par mdzod/ /'di ni phrin (nyalas kyi dri ba dris pa'o/ / rmad 'byung ⑫skyes bu gang zhig gis/ /dang po lam tshul ji lta bu/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lam ci phyir/ /stong pa'i rnal 'byor snying rje che/ /phyag rgya cig tsodang spros bcas ci/ /rnam smin dbang sgyur phyag rgya dang / /lhun gyis 7grub pa'i mtshan nyid ci/ /mthar phyin rnam tshupa du zhig gsungs/ /phyi nang gsang ba mthar phyin pa'i/ /'bras bu bdag gzhan don nyid ci/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i don ci yiltar/ /gang dag rtog 7pa'i rgyal po stetu / /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bla na med/ /kun lam tu)'bras bu thugs chud pa/ /cho ga rgyas par bshad pa'i rgyud/ /skal ngan rnams kyis ma rtogs pa'i/ /gsang ba ( )gsang chen mdo sde dang / /'dul ba chos kyi phung po dag /nam mkhar tsho nyamatha' thug bshad pa kun/ /gsang ba'i snyirngo po las 'phros pas/ /ji snyed bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i lam/ /ma lus kun gyi snying po 'di / /theg pa dman dang ma sbyangs dang / /rigs chad dbang dang man ngag bral / /ji ltar bltas kyang mi snang ba/ /skyes bu mchog gi spyod yul bas(ste/ /rdul snyed sbyangs pa'i gang nyazag la/ /gsang phyir gsang ba'i thabs dag gis/ /102—354

dngos grub mtha' yas grub phyir bstan/ /phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa'i/ /rten dang brten ①par bcas pa'i chos/ /ji ltar grags dang grags gyur pa'i/ /thams cad ma lus rgyu gcig kyang / /rkyen stobs nus pa so sor snang / /khyad par rim par gang gnas pa/ /rang bzhin gdul bya bde ②gshegs dang / /'khrul pa'i dbang gis so sor snang / /ma bcos ngang la tha dad med/ /rang snang las kyis tha dad pa'i/ /bye brag rnam par bstan pa kun/ /de bzhin nyid la dgod bya'i phyir/ /rgyal mchog bde chen yongs gang bas/ /dri ba'i don 'di lung bstan cing ①/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel gyur pa'i/ /gsang ba'i don la dgod du gsol/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje sems dpa' gsang ba me long gi durgyud las dri ba rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba bshad pa rtogs ⑤pa'i rgyal po rdzogs sgoskyo// //de nas gsang bdag ⑦rdo rje 'chang / /skyes bu mtshan dpe (kyerab ldan cing / /dpag med rgyal bas rab bskor zhing / /rang 'byung yi)dag pa'i gzhal yas na/ /thabs dang shes rab 'khril sbyor zhing / /kun kyang de dang mthun ⑩pa ste/ /'dzum zhing steg pas sos 'debs shing / /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bka' stsal pa/ /dpag med rgyal bas gsungs pa dang / /gsung dang gsung 'gyur thugs kyi rgyud / /thog tsom bar dang mthar dge ba/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i / /cho ga rgyas par dris pa'i mchog /nyon cig da (nyeni sems dpa' tunyebashad / /chos rnams ma lus gnyis med pa'i/ /rang rig byang chub sems nyid de / /tha dad med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /rang 102—355

bzhin mtha' thug med pa'i chos/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa yis/ /thugs su chud cing mngon rtogs pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i sems dpar bshad/ /rang bzhin thabs dang 'bras bu'i don/ /nus pa'i rim pa stsal snang ba/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa'i don/ /sgyu 'phrul zhes ni bzhir bshad do/ /tha dad min ①las tha dad pa'i/ /ngo bo thabs dang bdag ②nyid dang / /byin brlabs ②shugs kyis 'brel pa ni/ /drang ④ba'i don zhes bshad pa yin/ /ma brjod grags pa'i bstan pa nyid/ /sgro skur ⑤med dang zhal nas gsungs/ /dri ma med pa'i lung nyid de(6)/ /las dang ye shes spyi nyid dang / /rdzogs pas rdzogs phyir lung nyid denya/ /bstan pa spyi yi bdag nyid ni/ /thams cad kun gyi bdag nyid pas/ /gcig dang du ma mi gnas kyang / /so so'i bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ /'di ston 'dis ston 'di phyir ston/ /don kun 'di la yongs rdzogs pas/ /lung gi spyi zhes bshad pa yin/ /gang phyir gsang ba zhes bya ba/ /sku dang gsung 98)thugs bdag 67nyid de/ /rang bzhin ye nas ngo bo dang / /thabs dang 'bras bur gyur pa nyid/ /gsang ba'i don du 'di brjod do/ /ngang gis dman dang ma sbyangs dang / /dbang dang dam tshig bral ba dang / /rang brtags bsgribs pas sa'i khyad par/ /de dang de yi dbang gis sa /ro myang 7bral phyir gsang bar bshad/ /rang bzhin thabs dang 'bras bu yi/ /chos rnams thig le chen po'i don/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa/ /ma lus ro gcig 1medabyer med pa/ /ji snyed theg pa'i khyad par dang / /bstan pa'i bye brag gnas pa rnams/ /'dir 'dus thabs 'dis mtshon pa dang / /rtsa bar gyur pa 12kho na yin/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /byang 102—356

chub sems nyid bde ba che/ /rang 'byung 0)ye shes thog mtha' med/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ②bdag nyid de/ /rgyal ba'i byin brlabs (mirab snang ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab che ba rnams/ /'di las ston pas snying po ste/ /snying po dang ni 'od bzhin no/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu bcud 'dus pas/ /snying po zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /gang phyir thams cad byang chub sems/ /mtha' dbus yongs su ma chad pa/ /dngos po gsum gyis khyab gyur pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu yin no//thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ /de bzhin nyid du rdo rjes rig /bdag dang gzhan don nus pa rdzogs/ /'bras bu'i de kho na nyid do/ /gang phyir dngos gnyis tha dad par/ /log par brtags pa'i snang ba rnams/ /mun la snang dang gser 'gyur ltar/ /ro gcig thabs kyi (pede kho na/ /de phyir de kho na zhes brjod/ /dngos po sna tshogs dbyer med pa'i/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /de nyid gsang ba'i nges pa ni/ /gzhi dang lam dang ngo bo dang / /nges pas nges pa gsum du bstan/ /gang du theg pa bzhi gsungs pa/ /'gro ba 'dren phyir ma nges pa/ /ro gcig theg par nges gnas pa/ /nges pa'i theg pa bla na med/ /rang bzhin ma bcos rang byung (5)las/ /bya byed ngang gis bral ba yi / /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor 'phrul/ /rang snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'o/ /rang bzhin mtha' dbus med pa las/ /rgyu rkyen las kyis so sor (5)'khrul/ /de nyid byang chub sems nyid de/ /mtha' dbus med par mnyam par gnas/ /de ltar so sor snang ba'i rgyud/ /nam mkha' dang ris phye ba ltar/ /rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba yi/ /lam gnyis 'brel par mngon bsgoms pas/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ /bde chen thig le mngon snang ba/ /'jug dang 102—357

grol ba'i lam nyid de/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lam du brjod/ /rang bzhin yongs kyis ༅khyab pa yil/ /dngos dbang thabs kyis 'brel pa yis rim pa ji bzhin stobs gyur pas/ /khyad par thabs kyi sgyu 'phrul yin/ /thog ma med pa'i rdo rje sems/ /chos kun rang gi ngo bo nyid/ /zab mo bstan pa spyi yi ①lung —/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ /rtog 0pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud / /bskal pa grangs med sngon rol nas/ /shes rab sbyangs ⑤dang snying rje ldan / /dad dang brtson 'grus dam tshig dang / /cho gas dag par sbyangs pa yis⑥ / /dbang po rab kyi spyod yul yin/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i theg pa ⑦'di/ /ngo bo nyid dang byin brlabs (kyedang / /mtshon dang rdo rjer ⑨grub pa ste/ /rdo rje theg pa bde ba che/ /rang bzhin ngan dang dman pa dang / /phyin ci log dang mi mos dang / /dbang dang dam tshig med pa la/ /gsang phyir gsang ba'i theg par gsungs/ /thabs dang bral ba'i slob dpon gyis/ /snod dang bral ba'i ⑩slob ma la/ /gsang ba'i snying po bstan gyur na/ /bdag dang gzhan kun sdug bsngal zhing / /sreg dang sgrib ⑩par yun rings tsoganas/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rdo rje me long gi rgyud chen po las mtshan gyi don gyi bshad pa dang po'o(3// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /thun mong tsom gyur gsang ba'i dorno/ /thun mong ma yin 'khor dag la/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /dkyil 'khor mngon du phyung ba yi/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'brel 8pa yis/ /byang chub sems kyi ⑩dbang bskur nas/ /thun mong thun mong ⑩ma yin pa'i/ /nyon mongs lta dang shes bya rnams/ /skad cig yud la bsal ()byas te/ /thun mong khyad par gsang ⑪102—358

ba yi/ /lam gnyis nges par ston pas na/ /ston pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /de yi gnas mchog bshad bya ba/ /'byung dang bzhugs dang rten ①pa dang / /mtshon pa byin gyis brlabs phyir ro/ /thabs dang lam gyi ③khyad par gyis/ /kun bdag rdo rje 'chang chen nyid/ /gtsang ma ris sridag spangs pa yi/ /'og min gnas mchog chen po der/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /skal med skye bo gdul ba'i phyir/ /sprul pa po ni 'dir sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gtsang ma rigs dag rnam spangs pa/ /'jig rten las kyis mthar gyur pa/ /'og min 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bcur rgya yongs ma chad pa'i/ /yon tan khyad par spags ④pa na/ /gsang ba yum gyi ②bha ga la/ /bcu gsum sa yi dbang phyug ldan/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dpag med dang / /til 'bru'i tshul du rab tu bzhugs/ /chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /thog ma tha ma dbus med pa'i/ /rang bzhin don gyi 'og min ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi pho brang phyir/ /'das dang da ltar ma byon pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bsten ⑥pa'i gnas/ /de dag nye bar mtshon pa yi/ /yid dang mtshan ma las gyur pa'i/ /bsgoms ( )dang bris dang byas la ⑧sogs/ /de dang 'dra ba'i gzhal yas khang / /rgyal ba sngags dang byin brlabs 5)kyis/ /der gnas don phyir mtshon pa'i gnas/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /bsod nams ye shes khyad par can/ /bsags pa sna tshogs las byung ⑩ba'i/ /rdzogs longs spyod pa chen po ni/ /gtsang ma ris ()dag spangs pa yikyi/ /'og min chen po'i gnas mchog na/ /rigs bdag phyag rgya lhun grub sku/ /gcig dang du ma rnams 7spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs te/ /gdod nas 102—359

theg mchog mdzod nyid phyir/ /sgrib pa mtha' spangs gdul bya la/ /skad cig gcig gis spang bar 6)mdzad/ /chos rnams sna tshogs ji snyed pa/ /dngos po tha dad med phyir zlum/ /khyab dang spags ②dang tshad med dang / /ye shes bzhi phyir 'khor lo bstan/ /chos dbyings 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir/ /mu khyud skum por kun nas bskor/ /sku gsung thugs dang byin brlabs sridang / /thugs rjes ma ༷khyab med pa'i phyir/ /yon tan rgyas pa'i dbyibs su bstan/ /rang 'byung (8)ye shes mtha' bral bas/ /phyogs bcur 'gro 'ong mi gnas pa'i/ /tshad dang bral ba'i sems kyi phyir/ /gzhi rtsa tshad med 'khor lor (6)bstan/ /gdod nas byin brlabs (7ngo bo'i phyir/ /ma bsags lhun rdzogs mdzod nyid de / /'gro ba re 'dod skong ba'i phyir/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang //sna tshogs dngos dang dngos med pa'i/ /chos kun ngo bor rang gnas te/ /bdag gzhan gzung 'dzin bral ba'i phyir/ /phyi dang nang bral sgrib pa med/ /thun mong la brten thabs kyi 'bras/ /ye shes thabs kyis 'phags pa nyid/ /gdul bya'i blo la mngon snang bas/ /glo (8)'bur bzhi 6)ni lhag par mdzes /thun mong thun 7mong ma yin pa'i/ /gdul bya'i rim pa mtho 0skyedaman kun/ /stong smon mtshan med 'od gsal 'jug /de phyir ye shes sgo bzhir shar/ /thabs mang bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /lam brgyad rim par bgrod pa yis/ /'bras bu yon tan yonyakun rdzogs pas/ /rta babs nyustergyu 'bras bcu drug bstan/ /zhen dang spong ba'i lam bral bas/ /'dod yon ye shes lnga rol techa/ /bdag mchod kun mnyes las byung bas/ /'dod yon lha mos 'khrigs par bstan/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis/ /ma chags thabs dang ldan pa dang / /che 102—360

ba'i yon tan lhun rdzogs pas/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin po che/ /las dang thugs rje smon lam gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu bo che/ /smon lam dbang gis de dag tu/ /thos pa rgya mtsho bsag hu)phyir gnas/ /de tshe dus kyi tha ⑤bral yang / /ngo bo dus bzhi mnyam pa'i dus/ /dus kyi mtha' la mngon rtogs pas/ /thun mong min ①pa'i dus su bstan/ /de tshe phyogs bcu rgyal ba yis④/ /bskal pa bye bar lung bstan pa/ /'dul ba'i dus bab gsang ba'i bdag /lag na rdo rjes bsdu ba mdzad/ /dus gsum rgyal bas byin brlabs phyir/ /'khor gyi nang na ⑤skal mchog ldan/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje 'chang (nyabasdus nas/ /'dul ba'i 'khor la ⑦bstan par mdzad/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi(kye/ /sku gsum sku gsung thugs nges pa'i/ /de bzhin nyid du thabs gang gis/ /gshegs shing gshegs dang gshegs gyur pa'i/ /thar pa gsum dang ye shes dang / /pha rol phyin pa drug ldan pa/ /zhing khams tshonayon tan bsam mi 7khyab/ /bye brag brgyad cu ⑪kun 'dus pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi mtshan/ /gang phyir rdo rje thugs chud pas / /las dang spyod pa dka' thub dang / /srid pa'i ri bos mi bskyod pas/ /de ni mi bskyod tsomachog tu gsungs/ no/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa yis/ /ji snyed sku gsung thugs snang ba/ /mos dang thabs kyi khyad par gyis/ / rnam par asnang phyir snang mdzad mchog /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan ni/ /tshogs rnams 'dus pa'i ngo bo ste/ /yon tan rin chen ltar 8'byung bas/ /rin chen 'byung bar gsungs pa yin/ /dpag tu med pa'i gsung gi sgo/ /dbang po thabs kyi bye brag gis/ /don rtags yigasung dang yi ge'i sgo/ /mtha' yas snang phyir mtha' yas mchog /dpag med thugs rje yinamadzad pa yi/ /'gro 'ong med 102—361

pa'i thugs rje yis/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don mdzad pas/ /don grub ces ni rnam par bstan/ /rig pa'i rgyal po 'di dag kyang / /tha mal lnga nyid gnas dag cing / /de las thabs des mngon byas pas/ /der dbang sgyur te ①nyid snang ba/ /rgyal po nyid du brjod pa yin/ /steng 'og gnyis las mngon gyur pa'i / /sbyor dang 'ju 'dul rlung gi rim/ /gang de thabs las mngon gyur pa'i / /bde ba'i gzugs dang tshor ba dang / /'du shes dang ni 'du byed dang —/ /rnam shes (bzag med bde ba'i ros/ /dbang sgyur ye shes rgyal por bshad / /gang phyir snang dang bsgoms dang bris/ /phyag rgya rtsa bcud thig le'i mdog /dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang / /sngo dang ljang dang rims ①ldan pa'odu / /rgyal ba kun gyi bde skyid cing / /spyod dang de las 'byung ba'i yum/ /thams cad de las skyed pa lnga/ /tha mal zhen pa dag pa dang / /dbang sgyur ⑤rgyal mo lnga rang bzhin/ /sra dang gsher dang drod dang bskyod/ /nam mkha'i khams kyis gang phye ba/ /steng 'og thabs las mngon gyur pa/ /yul dang shes pa yidabyer med cing / /thugs rje gshes rab 'brel ba yis/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis med gzigs pa spyan gyi mchog /zag med stong pa'i klong chen gyis/ /skyed dang sdud (nyadang gnas pa'i phyir/ /mtha' dgus bral ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /nam mkha'i dbyings zhes gang brjod pa'o/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /las dang lta ba nyon mongs po)dang / /shes bya'i dri ma mtha' yas pa/ /rtogs pas sbyong zhing sreg pas na/ /gos dkar ma ru brjod pa yin/ /gang phyir las dang ting 'dzin dang / /ye shes thugs rje bar med chus / /gang dag 'khrud dang tshim byed pas/ /chu ni mā ma tī ru bshad/ /gang 102—362

phyir rtogs dang thabs dag dang / /ting 'dzin thabs kyi rlung dag gis/ /bgrod pa med pa'i zhing khams su/ /sgrol bas sgrol ma nyid du bshad/ /snying po rang 'byung ①ye shes nyid/ /kun brten gnas dang khyab pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin la/ /sa yi snying por brjod pa yin/ /rang 'byung ②snying po byang chub sems/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsam brjod nimed/ /mtha' dbus sgro skur gang 'das pa/ /de ni nam mkha'i snying po nyid/ /gang phyir thugs rje dpag med pas/ /'gro ba chu bo rgal gyi bar/ /skyo ba med par gzigs pas na / /spyan ras gzigs dbang pad+ma'i gtso/ /rtogs dang dbyer med rdo rje yis / /mtha' yi bdag rtogs dumatshan ma dag /'joms pas phyag na rdo rje ste//thun mong nyid dang khyad par gyidu/ /gsang ba'i rnam par shes pa bzhiX/ /thun mong yul dang khyad par ni/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa las mtshon dang rtogs dang bsgoms pa yis/ /lha mo ⑦bzhir ni mngon snang ba/ /byang chub sems dang bde ba dang / /thabs kyi bde bas rab sgeg pasani/ /lha mo 'di ni sgeg mor bshad/ /grol dang ma grol 'khor ba yi0/ /phyi nang sgra yi bye brag kun / /brag ca ⑩lta bur brjod ⑩mdzad pas/ /bar chad med pas phreng ba ma/ /tshim pa'i ngo bo gang bstan pa/ /dri tsodang ldan pa'i khyad par nyid/ /dbyangs ⑫nyid tshim zhing yid bde bas/ /de nyid rdo rje gī ti ④ma/ /ro yis tsokhyab cing gar sgyur ltar/ /bde ba chen po bzhi yi gar/ /khyab dang mdzes dang tshim pa dang glu/ /mi gnas bgrol ⑩bas gar mkhan matso/ /rgyan dang chags pa'i sgra dag dang ske/ /yid kyi phreng ba bde ba'i garatso/ /lha mo bzhi yi rang bzhin no/ /ma rtogs 'gro ba mtha' yas la/ /rang bzhin thugs rje mdzad pa yis/ /yongs 102—363

la phan 'dogs skyob pa ni/ /'di ni byams pa zhes bya'o/ /rtogs goms mthar phyin khyad 6)par gyis/ /las dang nyon mongs lta ba'i rim sel ba 'di ni sgrib sel lo/ /thabs dang shes rab gnas rtogs na/ /gang phyir spong len mi gnas pas/ /phyi (minang snod (mibacud ma lus pa/ /dbye ba med pas kun du bzang ske/ /bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin pa kun/ /zag pa med pa'i shes rab kyis / /lta ba'i dra ba gcod pas na/ /zag med shes rab 'jam dpal sku/ /dbang po yi ge thig ler bcas/ /gnas dang rtogs dang bsgoms pa yis/ /mngon du snang phyir brjod pa yin/ /dus bzhi rim pa gnyis brgyad deli/ /de nyid dgrol dang brod skyed dang / /spyod yul dag phyir brjod pa ni/ /dri dang bde bas ngag tshim zhing / /yid ldog med pas rdo rje dri/ /phyi nang khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /me tog thig ler bder bkod pas/ /rdo rje me tog bla na med / /phyi nang sems la gnas bcas pa'i/ /mun pa bsal (5)phyir shes rab dang / /ye shes snang ba bla na med/ /rdo rje gsal ba'i mar me ma/ /phyi nang dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /rang 'byung (6)ting 'dzin bde ba yis/ /thams cad khyab (7)par gnas pa'i phyir/ /khyab byed rdo rje dri chab ma/ /de bzhin nyid la dgongs pa yis/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams ma lus pa/ /byang chub snyid por (kyetshar bcad (9 pas/ /rnam par rgyal ba zhes su brjod/ /gzung 'dzin bral ⑩ba'i ye shes ni1lha/ /gnyis 'dzin rtogs 12ngasa'i gnyen po ste/ /rtogs goms de yis 'joms pas na/ /ya mān+ta kṛta 12gshin rje gshed/ /gang phyir 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /thabs dang bcas pa'i rdzu 'phrul las/ /'joms yidang sgrol bar mdzad pas na/ /rta mgrin rgyal por tshade bshad do/ /'khor ba'i 102—364

bdud kyi hu)dug lnga la/ /ye shes lnga ru gsal goms pas/ /gnyis med rtsi ru gang 'khyil ba/ /sgrib zad bdud rtsi 'khyil par bshad/ /gang du lus dang bcas pa yi(mi/ /dbang po yul dang rnam shes reg /rang rgyud bcad ①pa'i ye shes nyid/ /sgo ba rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ /rang rgyud rtag chad bzlog ④pa dang ske/ /gzungs dang lha dang bde ba dang / /thig le rig par bcas pa nyid/ /gang phyir gnas nas dgug ⑤pa dang / /gang du'ang 'gro bar mi nus dang / /de las 'da' bar dka' ba dang / /bstims yinas bde bas dril bu ma/ /gzung (pedang 'khyud dang bsdam 5nyepa dang / /gnyis su med pas 5)bde chen po/ /rang lus snang srid brtan g.yo 7la/ /rtogs dang goms pa'i tshul gyis sbyar/ /de dag ma lus dran byed pa/ /rig (1pa'i rgyal po kun dbyer med/ /kun gzhi ⑫rdo rje mi phyed pa/ /kun du bzang por de bshad do/ /ma lus 'dus byas ma byas chos/ /ma lus zag 7med khyab pa'i dbyings/ /rtogs dang shes dang gang gyur pa/ /kun du bzang mor de bshad do/ /mi shigs thig le bde chen po/ /ye shes lnga ldan dngas skema'i bcud/ /rang 'byung 7lus can kun gnas pa/ /ston pa rig pa'i lkugasung can nyid/ /dharma tsho tsakra chos kyi gnas/ /'od bzhi e sogs /stetshul du ni/ /lus sbas pa yi tshul dag gis/ /lus can kun la khyab par gnas/ /rang 'byung //thugs kyi bde ba nyid/ /rgyu ba bral ba'i snying po ste/ /bar ma arba byang chub sems/ /nam mkha'i ye shes thugs kyi klong / /ma na ce )ma ta dran rtog ru yid/ /rnam shes rgyu ba'i dran rtog rnams/ /ye shes nam mkha'i ( gegasal 'dod pa/ /dran rtog zhu rig pa 'khor du gnas/ /zag med rnam shes bsam mi khyab/ /ma lus nam mkha'i ye shes su/ /bde chen rig pa'i mi rtog 102wa 365

par / /bsdus te nyams la gnas par mdzad/ /bde ba chen po ma skyes pa/ /nam mkha' lta bur mi phyed pa/ /nam mkha'i ye shes dbyer med sku/ /dus gsum kun gyi ngo bor gnas/ /'di zhes nye bar bstan pa ni/ /e sogs bzhi yi tshul gnas te/ /phyi nang bar khyams khyigadong bar bcas/ /gsang ba'i 'og min rgyan rdzogs pa'o/ /thig le bam̐ dbyibs spros pa med/ /brjod med bstan pa bsrung ②mdzad cing / /byin brlabs bde chen mi rtog pa/ /'khor la snang bar mdzad pa'o/ /ma ni ma nu ma ta ste/ /sdom byed dran rtog yid kyi dngos/ /las can rnam shes de dag gis/ /gsal bar go bar 'khor du brjod/ /chos rnams kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /thig le bcu drug sems lnga'i dngos/ /mi rtog lhan cig skyes pa'i don/ /byin brlabs ①mngon sum tshul gyis gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /thig le zag med skyes pa'i dus/ /bsam med lhan cig skyes pa'i tshe/ /bde ba chen po'i dus su 'dod/ /shes pa rten dang brten par bcas/ /thabs kyi rim pa la brten nas/ /rlung gis bsdus ④pa'i don gyis ni/ /rang rig thabs kyi rgyal por gsal/ /gang dang gang la gang du ni/ /gang gis gang tshe gang gsungs pa/ /brjod 'byung rtsa bar de gyur pas / /gleng gzhi ⑤zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi / /dbyer med ye shes gcig ⑥shi ngang ⑦/ /rdo rje 'chang chen (nyakun bzang las / /sna tshogs sku ni rnam par 'phrul/ /de tshe rgyal ba thams cad kyang / /lha la rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /lha min ston pa phrag dog rje/ /mi la thub pa'i dbang po ste/ /byol song sgra yis 'dul mdzad pa/ /yi ⑨dgas 7drag pos gdung ba sel / /dmyal ba sdug bsngal 11chos kyi rgyal/ /gdul ba'i sprul sku ngo bor shar/ /102—366

la la lha las 'pho ba dang / /la lar lhums zhugs bltam 6)pa dang / /dka' thub bdud btul sangs rgyas nas/ /'khor lo bskor te mya ngan 'das/ /gnas la nges pa yod min te/ /dmyal ba yi dgas byol song dang / /mi dang lha dang lha min te/ /so so'i gnas te gang yin pa/ /'gro ba 'dul ba ②ston pa'i gnas/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams dang / /lha min yi dgas dud 'gro dang —/ /dmyal ba so so'i 'gro ris dag /rang rang mos dang las dbang gis/ /'dul tshul tha dad dbang gis 'khod/ /rang rang mos pas phrad ①pa'i tshe/ /rang rang brda ①skad tha dad pas/ /rtogs dang grol bar gang gyur pa/ /rang rang ji bzhin ston pa'i dus/ /bstan pa'i theg pa sna tshogs te/ /rang rang zhen pa mtha' yas phyir/ /tshul dang mos pa'i dbang gis na/ /theg pa sna tshogs tshul du snang / /theg gcig mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul/ /gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga/ /dgu dang brgyad khri la sogs pa/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i tshul gyis snang / /sku dang gsung thugs las dag gis/ /'dul dbang thabs ni sna tshogs kyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de tshe 'gro ba so so yang / /rang gi gzhi ⑤tsa don rig nas/ /rim pa lnga 'am thabs gcig ⑥shis/ /rig 'dzin sangs rgyas sa la gnas/ /rang rang cha 'dzin sprul pa'i lusaX/ /sar gnas 'khor gyi dang po yis/ /de dag zhus pa'i rim (shegasungs pa/ /blo dang tshig dang yi ger bsdus/ /rgyud ces bya ba rgyun du grags/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud/ /lta spyod dkyil 'khor dbang dam dang / /sgrub pa phrin ponyelas lam rim ni/ /phyi dang nang dang sbas pa ste/ /rang bzhin gnas dang mngon byed pa/ /thabs kyi rgyud ni gsum du gsungs/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon 102—367

rdzogs pa'i/ /mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa dang / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud / /bskyed 0)rdzogs thabs rim gang bstan pa/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bar 'dus pa ste / /de ltar grags pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rtog (7pa'i cho ga kun bshad pa'i/ /rgyud chen sgyu la'aphrul dra jigab ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi mchog /thog ma bar dang mthar (5)dge ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yisgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud chen po las gleng gzhi ⑦ rnam par bshad pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gang zag thabs ni thun mong du/ /blo yi (kyiyul du gang gyur pa/ /de ni thun mong yul nyid de/ /gang zag thabs dang ston pa nyid/ /de yi spyod yul ma gyur cing / /thabs chen gsang ba dang ldan pa/ /de ni thun 67mong ma yin pa'o/ /de nyid skye bo 'khor gnyis don/ /rnam gnyis tshul du snang bar mdzad/ /phung po khams dang skye mched nyid/ /rgyal ba yab yum sems dpa' dang / /sems ma nyid du lhun gyis grubakyi/ /gsang yul dbang po rnam shes reg /ma lus 'joms phyir khro bo ste/ /rtags (nyasogs mtshan ma las skyes phyir/ /yum ste las kyis mi gnas bshad/ /yid chos bzang po bzang mo nyid/ /chags sogs nyon mongs drug po nyid/ /thub pa sprul pa drug tu bshad/ /de nyid phyogs bcu dus bzhi yi/ /phung po 'byung ba rnam shes yul/ /dbang po dus dang lus chos bzhi/ /mtshan ma nyon mongs yum ma 12nyid de/ /de nyid sems phyir ma skyes pas/ /lhag pa'i bden gnyis 'brel pa las/ /byang chub sems lnga rnam par 'phrul/ /dngos po snang grags 102—368

chos thams cad/ /skye ba med dang 'gag ①med dang / /gnas pa med dang dmigs med dang / /'gro 'ong med pa nyid du snang / /bdag phyir ye shes gsal snang yang / /gzhan phyir de dag ma rtogs pas/ /rang bzhin ngo bo ye nas gsang / /shin tu gab sbas gsang ba'i don/ /de nyid legs par bshad pa'i tshe(snye/ /ye nas mnyam nyid gsang ba la/ /ma rig log rtog 0rkyen dbang gis / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de ⑨bor snang / /de nyid bde gshegs snying po stephyi / /dngos med dngos po'i snying po can/ /'gro ba rnams ni smin bya'i phyir/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin las/ /sprul pa rnams ni rnam par 'phrul/ /sku dang gsung thugs sna tshogs kyis(ye/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par bskor/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor de dag kyang / /ston pa 'khor gyis gcig la gcig(pe /yab dang yum dang gnyis med dang / /gang la gang gis gleng bslang ba/ /brda nidang dgongs pa'i yodatshig gis te/ /bstan pa'i tshogs ni snang bar 'gyur/ / 'phan sa rlung yigi sbyor ba yis/ /thabs des yum tshospel gang bskul bas/ /gnyis med 'brel pa'i chags pa'i 'od/ /sa ya bcu gsum sku gsung thugs/ /bde chen lha ru gsal byas shing / /nam mkha'i ye shes mngon phyung nas/ /bde ba'i ye shes gsal ba'i ro/ /skye dang dga' dang gnas pa yi skadang / /'gro 'ong nyid las shes par 'gyur/ /gang gis gang la gang bslang bas4she/ /gang rkyen dbang gis 'de dag las/ /ye shes gsal bar gang snang bas/ /snang srid lus dang dngos por bcas/ /nam mkha'i ye shes cir yang snang / /nang gi gleng bslang thabs chen yin/ /gang phyir thabs kyis shes rab la/ /chags pa'i glu edang sbyor bas bskul/ /shes rab thabs la lan bskul ba'ang / /sha da ba yi glu tsha102—369

gar dang / /sngags sbyor ba yi rim pa yis/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis mngon sbyar bas / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rgyu ba rlung gi sbyor ba yis/ /dgug dang bkug ①pa'i thabs nyid de/ /dbab dang gzung dang bskyil ②ba dang —/ /zlog dang gzung dang sbyar ba yis/ /bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs chen po/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /mthar thug rim pa las byung ⑧ba'i / /kun kyang sems lngar snang ba ste/ /thabs las byung ba'i thig le dang / /shes rab gsang ba'i thig le dang / /gnyis med bde ba las byung bdu/ /sems lnga rim par snang bar 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor zhing / /sku dang gsung thugs las byung ba/ /bye brag brgyad cu kun 'dus pa/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis te/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lngas/ /thabs dang rang bzhin 'brel pa yis/ /'gro ba kun la rgyas btab pa'o/ /snod bcud bde ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /ma lus lhan cig skyes par gnas/ / g.yo ldang ⑤smon 'jug gnas mthar phyin/ /skye ba'i gzhi dang thabs dag dang / /skyes nas nyamathar phyin ⑦ye shes lnga/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /ji lta ba bzhin rnam par gnas/ /'gro ba mos pa'i khyad par gyis/ /gzugs dang kha dog sngags dang 'od/ /dkyil 'khor la (0sogs so sor gnas/ ci /gang zag blo dang 'tsham 6)par bstan/ /rten dang brten chen tshulas byung ba'i/ /rang 'byung 6nyabade chen mi rtog pa/ /lus med lus la gnas pa yi/ /khyab pa gnyis med gang ba'i tshul/ /gang phyir zag med bde ba yi/ /ting 'dzin bde ba khyad par can/ /rang bzhin brtags dang snang ba dang / /byin rlob nus pa'i lha yis 7ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud sku gsung thugs/ /ma lus sbyor ba 102—370

gsum las byung / /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dag /rim par bsten dang sbyor ba dang ①/ /'phen dang sdud pa rlung gis te/ /dngas ②mar ye shes rlung gis 'jug /steng dang 'og las byung ba yi/ /bde ba'i thig le rim pa dag /dngas snyigs rlung gi khyad par gyis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu nyid/ /rkyen gyis nus pa phrad pa ltar/ /rgyu gcig ninus pa so sor snang / /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /lam ni rtsa dang thig le dang / /rlung ni phyi nang dngas snyigs dang / /lam dang rgyu ba'i tshul las byung / /gang phyir med dang nus pa med/ /stongs dang log pa'i nus mthu yis/ /rang lus 'jig dang sdug bsngal zhing / /dbang po ma tshang dman par gyur/ /gang phyir thun mong thun mong min/ /sems lnga ye shes lnga bstan pa/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan du/ /gzungs ma rigs la rten bcas pa'i/ /sems lnga yun ring thung bcas pas/ /bdag gzhan chos rnams ma lus pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te/ /dngos po ma yin dngos med min/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka gnyis med min/ /rang 'byung ④bde chen sgyu ma nyid/ /rdo rje brtan dupo rang snang ba/ /ye shes sgyu ma lhun gyis grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yisgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud chen po las gleng bslang ba bshad pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /kun gyi shes bya yul bshad pa/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /gcig dang tha dad kun bral ba'i/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sgro skur kun bral mnyam pa las/ /rtogs 102—371

dang ma rtogs khyad par las/ /sna tshogs chos ni rnam par 'phrul/ /gzhi dang rtsa ba las 'das pa'i/ / rang bzhin dbyer 0)med de bzhin nyid/ /dngos med dngos po yul (mi'adas la/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /ngo bo sna tshogs rang snang ba/ /gnyis med thabs chen rdo rje nyid/ /e ma'o gnyis med bde chen las/ /sna tshogs gnas dang longs spyod (gyidang / /rigs dang kha dog tshe tshad dang / /bde sdug dbang po bye brag dag54) /rang bzhin sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul/ /sgyu ma chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar/ /byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gnas//las dang rkyen gyis gang snang ba/ /rang rang zhen pa'i tha dad kyis/ /dbang po khyad par sna tshogs pa'i/ /rtog pa'i nus pa sna tshogs mthong / /rang bzhin gzhi rtsa med pa'i dbyings/ /lhan cig skyes dang kun brtags pa'i/ /ma mthong log zhen rtas 95pa yis/ /'khrul 'khor log pa'i stobs su snang / /'khor ba ma bsal 6)dag pa yi/ /zhing dang spyod yul longs spyod dang / /ting 'dzin dbang stobs rdzu 'phrul dang / /mngon shes ye shes dpag med pa'i/ /sna tshogs sku dang gsung thugs dang / /yon tan phrin (7)las rang snang ba/ /bdag gzhan lhun 87gyis grub pa'i don/ /sna tshogs yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /ma bsags lhun gyis grub pa'i sku/ /sna tshogs kun dang dbyer med pa'i/ /kun la yid bzhin mthun 9par snang / /kun kyang rang 'byung (7)byang chub sems/ /bden pa dbyer med don du snang / /gang phyir nam mkha'i rang bzhin ltar/ /gang la de ltar snang ba las/ /yang dag gcig 11tu gzung du med/ /ma bcos rang 'byung 1 zhi ba nyid/ /rnam par dag pa'i snying po ste/ /'khor ba nyid na mya ngan 'das/ /rnam par dag pa'i dbyings su mkhyen/ /sgro dang skur pa kun 102—372

bral ba'i/ /thams cad rang snang snying po las/ /sna tshogs ma lus rnam par 'phrul / /dngos dang dngos po med min zhing / /gang la de nyid yul 'dase pa//nam mkha' lta bur dpag med pa/ /phyogs ris mtha' dbus rgya dpag med/ /gang gis gang la khyab pa yo)ltar/ /mkha' sogs rdul bral 'byung ba'i bcud/ /zag pa med pa'i snying po nyid/ /lus can kun gyi dbang po dang / /dngas mar 'brel bar gang snang yang / /mthong ba log pa'i stobs kyis sgyur/ /bdag gzhan med pa'i rang snang yin/ /ma lus thams cad dbyer med ②pa'i/ /thabs dang shes rab bcud lnga'i rgyun/ /longs spyod thabs su bcas pa nyid/ /'gro ba kun la khyab par gnas/ /gang yang thabs dang shes rab kyi/ /sgyu ⑧'phrul dra ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rang bzhin dbyer med byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /'das dang da ltar ma byon gyi/ /rgyal ba rig 'dzin mtha' yas dang / /ma lus kun gyis rtogs libya ba/ /phyogs med khyab pa'i ngo bor gnas/ /gang (gesnang ma lus de bzhin nyid/ /ma bcos ma byas zhi ba ste/ /gcig dang du ma las 'das pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin nyid//mtha' bral nam mkha'i rang bzhin ltar/ /ma lus gnas pa de dag kyang / /rtogs pa'i khyad par dbang po yi/ /mthong tshul dag dang ma dag gis/ /rang bzhin yul du (ponyem gyur pas/ /phyi nang gsang ba la sogs pa'i/ /dbang dang man ngag 'brel ba yis/ /de nyid mthong rtogs don phyir bshad/ /gang phyir rdo rje slob dpon nyid/ /yon tan yongs rdzogs nus pa can/ /dad dang ( rabartson 'grus brtul zhugs rin)can/ /shes rab khyad par gang ldan la/ /dbang dang dam tshig man ngag dang / /rgyu rkyen 'brel pa'i nus pa yi59)/ /bde ba 102—373

gsal ba mi rtog pa/ /thabs kyis ①phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i gsang chen snying po nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ste/ /phyi nang bdag gzhan ma lus pa/ /thams cad dbyer med de bzhin nyid/ /thabs bral kun la rgyas btab pas/ /mun pa'i tshogs su gyur pa yin/ /mun snang dug dang gser 'gyur rtsi/ /thabs mkhas rang bzhin nges 'gyur ltar/ /gang de'i lta spyod ting 'dzin gyis/ /de ma thag tu de bzhin 'gyur/ /dbyer med nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /kha dog dbyibs dang rdzas la sogs/ /ma lus tha dad med pa ltar/ /thabs mkhas ma lus de bzhin 'gyur/ /tha mal pa dang log pa dang —/ /dka' thub can dang rkyen rtogs dang / /phyi nang can dang tha dad can / /gtsang sme ②can dang phyogs rtogs nyid/ /mnyam nyid lta las gang 'das pa/ /ngo bo nyid dang thabs dag dang / /dbang po la sogs log pa yis / /de nyid gnod pa'i stobs su 'gyur/ /gang la gang gis zin pa'i nad/ /thabs dang brtson 'grus legs pa yis/ /de ltar brtson pa'i khyad par gyis/ /de nyid ma spangs ①rnam par dag /gang phyir de nyid nges pa la④/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par gyis/ /tha dad chos su gang snang ba/ /dngos la de ⑤ltar gnas pa min/ /rdo rje skye med shes rab ste/ /me long thabs nyid sna tshogs snang ske/ /gnyis med 'brel pa'i mnyam pa nyid/ /ma lus dbyer med dam par 6)bshad / /de nas rtogs sgo bshad bya ba/ /gang la gang gi ⑦don med pas/ /lta dang spyod dang lam 'bras dag /'di nyid don gnyer gzhan med pa'o/ /gang gis de dag de don du/ /tshig (8)dang sngags rdzas dka' thub kyis/ /gang bstan de yi byin brlabs (9)kyis/ /bdag gzhan phan par gang 'dod pa'o/ /102—374

gang las gyur pa de zhig pas/ /lus sems 'byung ba'i bag la gnas/ /phyin cad ①phan gnod chos med pas/ /dka' thub 'bad rtsol mi dgos so/ /gang phyir byed pa'i rgyu bzhi dag /mnyes dang dag pas bde bya'i phyir/ /las dang dka' thub drag shul gyis/ /grol zhing thar bar 'dod par snang / /bden ②bzhi bcu drug tha dad lam/ /khams gsum mthong bsgom spong ②tshul gyis/ /rang don zag pa kun bral nas/ /rang ④don thar pa mya ngan 'das/ /rkyen rtogs ⑤bag chags sad pa yis/ /'byung med bcu gnyis rang brtags nas/ /ma rig 'khrul 'khor rgyu 'bras zad/ /yid bzhin bde ba mchog gi sa/ /tha dad med pa'i rig pa'i sems/ /bden brdzun zhi)khyad par cir bltas pa⑦/ /gsal la mi rtog snying po nyid/ /bdag gzhan nus pa'i stobs su snang / /chos rnams sgyu (nyam mig yor dang / /brag ca dzi)chu zla 'dra ba yi/ /de nyid mtha' dbus bral ba ni/ /bden gnyis 'brel pa dbu ma'i tshul/ /rdo rje dam pa gsum bkod de/ /dngos po 0sgyu ma las grol nas/ /dag pa'i rten 7'brel la brten 7nas/ /ye shes sgyu ma mngon sum shar/ /gang phyir las dang bya ba dang //khrus dang gtsang sbra til brten nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu stobs kyis/ /sgo gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /de dag las mthun 8khyad par nyid/ /de kho na nyid bzhi rtogs nas/ /las dang ting 'dzin 'brel goms pas/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i sa la gnas/ /ting 'dzin rig pa gtsor byas nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bsam pa yis/ /cha lugs ji bzhin mngon sgyur tshete/ /goms pas bdag gzhan don grub pa'o/ /thabs dang grol ba'i khyad par gyis/ /dbang po yul dang rnam shes dang / /snang srid phyi nang snod bcud kyi/ /spyod yul ji ltar 102—375

'gyur ba kun/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ /gsang ba'i thabs kyis rgyas btab pas/ /ma lus rdo rje nyid du 'gyur/ /snang srid dpa' bo thabs chen de/ /rang bzhin dbyer med dag pa yi/ /sna tshogs 'phrul pa rang snang bas/ /ma lus gnyis med ye shes yin/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /thabs dang rig pa gang zin pa/ /gzhan gyis dor ba'i 'khor ba'i chos/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor 'gyur/ /ma lus gcig dang tha bral ba'i / /ji ltar mthun 6)pa'i snying po la/ /so so'i don ltar mi gnas pas/ /bskyed pa lha ②dang gzhal yas dang / /rdzogs pa ①nam mkha'i ye shes dang / /dngos po lhan cig skyes pa ru/ /snang ba rkyen gyis sgyur ④ba ltar/ /ma lus de yi (snyengo bor 'gyur/ /de dag bltas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /rang re'i yimos dang bsam pa dang / /nus pa'i rim pa cir snang yang / /nam mkha' dang ba'i rang bzhin las/ /nyi zla gza' skar (chusprin khu (nyanangs/ /rang 'byung 6)rang dngas tso'agyur med ltar/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /dngos dbang don las ma g.yos pas/ /de dag de ltar nyid snang (1bas/ /de nyid nam mkha'i khongs su 'du/ /de nas gtan tshigs yi bshad par bya/ /ma lus 'gro ba thams cad la / /byang chub snying pos kun khyab pas/ /kun gyis mthong goms bya dgos pas / /so so thun mong gtan tshigs 1snyedang / /thun mong lim yin la sogatsu pa/ /rgya mtsho klong skadang chu bo ltar/ /ma lus 'dul shing 7'byung ba yin/ /thun mong bzhi sogs gang yin pa/ /log lta phyogs 'dzin dgag pa dang / /dngos dbang thabs dang 'brel mtshon phyir/ /thun mong gtan tshigs (1brjod pa yin/ /gang phyir gtan tshigs (1 thams cad kyis/ /rang las 'phrul phyir me long nyid/ /102—376

ma lus gcig dang tha dad min/ /gang gi mtha' las yongs grol te/ /dbus su gzung ①med gtan la phebs/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba'o/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang 'bras bu ste/ /thabs de gdod nas dag pa gsum/ /ma lus rang snang rtogs pa nyid/ /mtshan nyid de yi mtshan nyid do/ /rgyu gcig pa dang yig 'bru'i tshul/ /byin gyis brlabs dang mngon sum pa/ /ma lus rtogs pa bzhir shar te/ /de nyid rtogs pa bzhir snang ngo / /ma skyes ngang las gang snang ba/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin gcig pas na/ /de dang der gcig ②dbyer med pas/ /dngos po lo rgyus nyid kyis shes/ /'khor dang (5)mya ngan 'das pa yibya rtsa ba chags sdang lnga nyid de/ /gzhi rtsa (snyem bcos skad cig ma/ /de nyid rang spyir gang snang ba/ /rtogs 6)pas spyi dang rang mtshan shes/ /snod bcud rgyud rnams mtha' yas dang / /mnyam gnyis lhag pa'i mnyam gnyis kyis/ /dngos po snang grags chos rnams kun/ /ma bcos de bzhin (7nyid du gnas/ /ma lus snying po thig le dang / /lnga bdag brgyad cu rtsa gnyis rgyu/ /sa ya bcu gsum rtsa yan (nyalag /ro dang gnas skabs kun las grol/ /dang po gnas dang gnyis pa gnyis / /gsum pa ma lus khyab byed pa/ /nyams su myong byed gtan tshigs so6) / /thig le gnas dang yig 'bru dang / /de yi byin brlabs tso'adres pa yis / /bde ba chen po mngon du snang / /chu las chu bo tha dad de/ /rgya mtsho las ni chu thigs (1dang / /lam dang zhing sa'i 'bras bu ltar/ /thabs kyi khyad par snang ba yin/ /dngas tem lnga las gang byung ba/ /ji snyed lus sems rtsa thig le/ /khams lnga'i ro dang bcud snang ba/ /ye shes chen por gtogs pa yin / /gsum dngos brgyad sogs kha dog grangs5ge/ /gnas pa gang yin de 102—377

snod de/ /so so'i bcud kyi khyad par las/ /byang chub sems nyid gsal bar snang —/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pa'i/ /bden bzhi dbyer med dngas ①ma nyid/ /ma lus khyab pa'i tshul gyis snang / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i / /thig le gcig ②dang du ma nyid/ /bral ba'i ye shes chen po nyid/ /gcig chadang du ma las grol ba'o/ /bcud 'dus thig le gnyis ro rgyu/ /rlung dang gdams ngag rkyen ldan pas/ /'bras bu lhan ④cig skyes par snang / /rang la ⑤gnas pa thabs kyis gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i ro rtsa yig bcas pa bcud 'dus pas/ /thabs dang rlung gi gdams ⑥pa yis ma lus lhan skyes mngon sum ⑦gsal/ /bde dang stong nyid mi phyed pal/ /rang rig bde chen ma skyes gzugs/ /ma lus 'od dang rnam pa ltar/ /dbyer med tshul dang yonyerang snang ⑩ba'o/ /bde bas bskyed (1pa'i rtog pa lnga/ /rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa nyid/ /ma lus ye shes chen po nyid/ /ye shes lnga yi ⑩rgyas btab pa'o8—/ /dbang po snod bcud bcas pa yis/ /yab yum 'brel par bcas pa'i bcud/ /sems lnga'i rgyud du rang snang ba/ /mnyam pa bzhi yi tshul du gsal / /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba mthar thug pa'i/ /gtan tshigs dhimatha' yas bshad pa ste/ /rdo rje me long bshad pa'i rgyud8/ /gang gis rtogs pa de nyid ni/ /ma lus rang snang sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin tsolas rang snang ba/ /zag med rang 'byung tshungang las 'char chos rnams 'bras bur yonyelhun rdzogs pa'i/ /bdag dang gzhan don lhun rdzogs pa/ /ma bcos ji bzhin ngang bzhag las/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung / /gang dag gang lto la gang brten 6)pas/ /lhun gyis grub pas 6)'bras bu nyid/ /102—378

ma bcos sgyu ma lhun grub nyid/ /dus bzhi phyogs bcu ma lus par/ /lhun grub 'bras bur rang snang ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud chen po las lta ba ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /spyod pa'i khyad par ma lus pa/ /'di dag bshad par bya ba ste/ /rang bzhin thabs dang mngon gyur pas/ /spyod pa ma lus bstan pa yin/ /e ma'o rang rig snying po las/ /bde sdug gnas dang longs spyod dang / /tshe dang kha dog la sogs pa/ /la lar mngon par chags pa ste/ /la lar drag shul zhe sdang spyod/ /la lar ri bos non pa nyid/ /la lar ldongs pa'i mun pa nyid/ /la lar phrag dog snang ba yin/ /la lar ser sna 'thab rtsod de①/ /la lar 'chal ②dang bya ba btang / /rtsol dang mi rtsol la sogs pa/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas rnyed/ /chos dbyings mtha' yas mu med pa'i/ /nam mkha' gedabyings ni mtha' yas par / /spyod pa'i khyad par de nyid do/ /rang 'byung thabs ④kyi spyod pa nyid/ /ji ltar bsam zhing brtags pa ltar/ /rang bzhin dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ /sgo gsum byed spyod bsam mi khyab/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyis/ /ma lus sangs rgyas gnas gyur kyang / /ma rtogs thabs dang bral ba'i phyir/ /bde sdug sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /thabs chen dag dang ldan pa la/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog chen po dag /byang chub lam du bde bar bshad/ / thabs dang mi ldan skye bo yis⑤/ /thabs dang bya ba sna tshogs kyis/ /mdzad spyod dka' ba sna tshogs pa/ /mi dang lha las thar yib 102—379

med / /dper na dug dang ldan pa la/ /thabs kyi khyad par ji bzhin du/ /rtogs pa'i khyad par ji bzhin du/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs rgyun/ /rang bzhin gnyis med dag pa las/ /brtags pa'i bye brag khyad par gyis/ /mi mthun bde sdug sna tshogs myong / /ma bcos dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /gang dag thun 0)mong ngo dag las/ /las dang bya ba nisgo nas ni/ /spyad dang spyod dang spyod 'gyur phyir/ /'di skad spyod pas spyod par gsungasag/ /rang bzhin rgyal ba'i spyod pa yis/ /chu dang rlabs ltar khyab 8)gyur kyang / /spong len bya ba sna tshogs las/ /spyod pa thabs kyis zin pa med/ /gang phyir thabs dang shes rab dang / /sgra dang rtogs pa sna tshogs kyis/ /thun mong yul du ma gyur pa/ /thun mong ma yin thabs spyod de/ /la lar thun mong nyid du ste/ /thar pa dang ni ma thar pa/ /kun du rgyu dang mu stegs dang / /bud med dang ni ma rabs dang / /rgyal po dpa' 95)bo dka' thub can/ /byis pa la 6)sogs tha dad de/ /la lar dgod dang drag po dang / /gshe dang 'jigs dang zhi ba dang ske/ /la lar de bzhin chags chen po/ /g.yo sgyu nyaspyod dang g.yem par ston/ /zhi dang rku 9nyadang phrag dog spyod/ /'dod dang longs spyod gzir ba dang / /glu ⑨bro gar dang 'jo sgeg dang / /de bzhin 'jigs dang sdigs 7pa dang / ri /ma rungs pa dang rnam par 'tshe/ /zhing khams rdzu 'phrul spyod pa dang / /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul du ma dag /gang dang gang gis mdzad pa dag /skye bo ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mdzad pa mtha' yas rnam par ston/ /zhi la tshangs dang khro la khro/ /thar pa na chung mdzes dang rol/ /gdung dang rmongs dang sdug bsngal 41ba/ /rang rang ded dpon mtha' yas pa'i/ /sku yi rol pa mtha' yas ston/ /byin 102—380

gyis brlabs dang rang snang dang / /brda ①dang rig pa ting 'dzin dang / /tshig tu chags sdang rmongs pa dang / /shin tu rgyal dang phrag dog dang / /'jam dang dal dang snyan mi snyan/ /rtsub ②dang drag dang sgom phra dang / /ring thung rol mo lha klu dang / /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i ①sgra/ /khyim bdag dbang chen legs dpon dang / /chags can gtum po la sogs pa'i/ /sna tshogs rol pa mtha' yas pa/ /dag dang ma dag tshul gyis ni/ /gsung gi rol pa mtha' yas snang / /la lar byams dang sdang ba dang / /g.yeng dang mi g.yeng rmongs ④dang ri/ /sdud dang mi sdud yal ba dang / /grol dang ma grol rno rtul dang / /ma rig ye shes la sogs pa/ /thugs kyi rol (thupa mtha' yas pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis snang / /mtha' yas dbyer med dam pa nyid/ /lung dang rigs (7pa man ngag gi( )/ /tshad ma dag gis gang bcal (7pa/ /shes bya khong du ( 'orichud par 'gyur/ /de nas chos rnams ma lus pa/ /bdag gzhan phyi nang dbyer med pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis snang / /mtha' yas dbyer med dam pa nyid/ /dran dang shes bzhin brtan po yis/ /dus gsum rgya mtsho gting lta bur/ /mi g.yo gsal ba'i ngang gyur nas/ /sgo gsum mnyam par sbyor ba yis/ /dang po rtogs pa'i spyod pa ste/ /de bzhin nyid la gsal brtan te / /stong pa shes rab spyod par bshad/ /de nas phyogs bcu ma lus pa/ /rang 'byung 7byang chub sems nyid phyir/ /gang snang rang tshostergyud dngos med de/ /sgyu ma mig yor brag ca 7dang / /smig ’ skurgyu chu bur la sogs pa/ /gong ma'i stobs dang 'di nyid stobs/ /mnyam par sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /gang la ma bltas khamangon byas dang / /ting 'dzin rim pa gnyis med pas/ /kun la 102—381

snying rje'i spyod pa dang ①/ /dam pa 'di ni spyad par bya/ /rang bzhin ched du dmigs pa dang / /khyab dang shugs las gang byung ba'i/ /snying rje'i spyod par rnam par spyad/ /de nas sgyu ma lta bu nyid/ /rang nyid phyogs med snang ba yis/ /cir yang bsgyur du rung ba'i phyir/ /rig ②pa dbu mar gang gsal pa/ /nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan du 'bar/ /sa bon gang las thabs cho gas/ /'phro 'du zhu nas mngon gyur pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ①ngo bor snang / /de nyid gcig dang lnga gsum gyis/ /brtan 'bar mdzes par gsal gyur te/ /mdun dang gzhan du skabs ④dag sbyor/ /gcig dang nges med rim pa dang / /'khor lo zhes bya bzhi ru gyur/ /gang gis gang de ma brten ⑤par/ /'phro 'du bsgoms 0pa don med de/ /skyon bral gsal brtan 'dris pa yis/ /gang bsgoms gsal bar mngon du 'gyuraX/ /tha mal zhen rtog zlog pa dang / /lam gyi 'brel par bya ba dang ske/ /dngos grub 'bras la myur 'jug pas/ /rtags kyi lha ni bsgom par bya//de ltar brtan 'gyur gsal ba la/ /bdag gzhan phyi nang ma lus pa'i/ /sgo gsum sku gsung thugs gsal bas/ /thun mong spyod pa rnam bcad la/ /sgo gsum mnyam bzhag nirjes thob med/ /gang gis de ltar gsal bya'i phyir/ /phyogs gcig lho)spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /de nas rtsa ba goms pa dang / /bslab bya khyad par mthar phyin ltar/ /gang de rim par bstan ⑩'phel phyir/ /yan lag spros pa rnam par bsgom/ /lhag pa (7bcu gcig dgur ldan pa'i/ /gcig 7las rgyas bsdus phye ba yis/ /'khor lo'i rtsa ba lha dag kyang / /yab yum gnas dgod gsal bar bsgom/ /de dag lhag pa'i lha dgu dag /yan lag tshul du spros te bsgom/ /'dul ba gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /mdzes 102—382

pa'i tshul dang gdug ①pa 'dul/ /lha dang zhal phyag dbu grangs kyang / /rtsa ba yan lag spros tshul gyis/ /dkyil 'khor grangs dang gang sbyar ba'i/ /rim par spros shing bsgom par bya/ /grangs dang grangs med tshul dag gis/ /dpag tshad rgyang grags mkha' dbyings su/ /zhi dang khro ②la sogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs sna tshogs bsgom/ /dang po'i bar dang tha ma'i bar/ /rig pa'i ting ①'dzin gsal brtan nas/ /sku gsung thugs dang ldan pa yi/ /tshom bu rim par dubasgom par bya/ /dgon pa'i rim pa'am nags tshal dang / /chu 'gram ri rtse medur khrod dudang / /skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa ste/ /dgra dang phyogs mtshams 0skyon med pa'i/ /brtag pa'i rim pa ldan pa yis/ /shis dudang 'thad pa'i sa phyogs su/ /gzhal yas rim brtsegs 6)mdzes ldan pa/ /rgyan dang bcas pa ldan byas la/ /ting 'dzin mnyam pa'i shes rab thabs mi ldan gong ma'i 'od kyis spyad / /bdag dang gzhan gyi nus pa yis/ /mnyam nas tshogs la 'jug par bya/ /yo byad lnga ldan thogs med par/ /cho ga'i rim pa ji bzhin brtsam7/ /bro glu gar dang ting 'dzin bcas/ /bar chad med par bsgrub par bya/ /gal te 'dod pa ma rdzogs par/ /sgyu ma'i lus de ma brtan na / /yid kyis rdo rje gsum gsal bsatso/ /rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin de/ /phyin cad 'a'ajigs bral khyung bzhin no/ /de bas 'brel pa'i spyod ldan na/ /dbang sgyur zag med sa thob ste/ /brgya dang stong sogs 'jig 8bral zhing / /gling dang 'jig rten brgya stong du/ /'dul ba'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas snang / /'jigs snyipa med cing mi ldog satso/ /dpa' bo rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan don spyod ⑩pa'i khyad par dag /'dul ba'i dbang ni sna tshogs kyis/ /102—383

rnam par brtse ba sna tshogs spro/ /'di ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /shes rab phyi yi spyod pa ste/ /cho ga rgyas par bstan pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba / /nang du 'jug pa'i rim pa yi/ /spyod pa'i khyad par cho ga dag /de nas rim pa 'di dag bshad/ /lus can 'gro ba thams cad la/ /tsakra bzhi dang sku gsung thugs/ /spor dang 'bar ma 'khyil pa dang / /'brel dang ma 'brel khug pa dang / /'dzin dang 'dzag dang gnas pa dang / /de bzhin khyab dang 'khrul pa'i rtsa/ /gang du rgyu dang gnas 'dzin pas/ /rtsa zhes de la mngon bshad de/ /de dag rgyu dang lam 'bras dang / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /bde ba chen po skyed par byed/ /gong dang 'og gi rang bzhin las//spyi dang khyad par kha sbyor 'byung / /sa bon khyab byed 'khor lo yis thams cad khyab cing 'dzag pa'i rtsa/ /dngas snyigs rlung dang 'brel pa yis/ /gang de pho mo'i bcud rkyen gyis/ /zag dang zag med bde ba skyed/ /lus kun khyab par gnas pa nyid/ /dngas ma thur gyi rlung dang 'grogs/ /gang na sgra sbyor 'khor lo can/ /des kyang kun khyab rgyu ba can/ /'khrul zhing 0)'khor bas 'khor lo ste/ /gsung gi 'khor lo ngag gi rten(gu/ /rdzogs dang ma rdzogs gang mi gsal/ /sgra sbyor dag dang ma dag gyur/ /bde dang snyan dang mi snyan ༷dang //bya dang dri za bung ba dang / /chags pa'i sgra ni sna tshogs byed/ /mdog dmar lus khyab klu la sogs/ /u tha'i rlung dang 'grogs te gnas/ /dharma tsakra srog gi rten/ /ma lus gzhi ( tshom kun gyi srog /rtsa bzhi yan lag brgyad dang ldan/ /dngas ma lnga 'dus kun gyi gtso/ /phyi rim rin chen sul mang (5)'dra/ /mi shigs thig le bde chen po/ /rin chen phung po za ma tog6) /sna tshogs ye shes 102—384

lnga yi 6)bdag /thung ngu a yi ②rang bzhin can/ /srog gi rlung dang 'grogs te gnas/ /phyi rim pad+ma 'dab brgyad ①de/ /chos nyid ye shes yon tan dang //rang rgyud bzhi la yan lag brgyad/ /thun mong phyi yi rim pa yin/ /'di la rtsa gsum rim pa ste/ /zag pa'i rtsa dang mngon shes rtsa/ /chos nyid rim pa gsum du gnas/ /rlung yang gcig ④gam gnyis yin te/ /de las bye brag dpag med pa'o / /gnas pa dang ni rgyu ba'i rlung / /gnas pa srog dang ye shes te/ /rgyu ba bzhi ni mngon par brjod/ /phyi nang can dang gyen thur can/ /de re'ang dngas snyigs khyad par gyis/ /rim pa brgyad du mngon snang yin/ /gnyid dang 'gro ba'i sa bon gyis/ /chags snang dran rtog (5)kun gyi gzhi/ /gang du gnas dang gnas ma yin/ /rgyu zhing 'pho (6)ba rlung gis te/ /bde dang sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /myong zhing skyed par byed pa yinardzi/ /'di ni gnas dang mi gnas kyis/ /srog dbang dran pa dbang sgyur (8)bas/ /gnas dang 'pho ba pha rol dag /gnas pa srog gi rlung can no/ /gang du 'khrul pa 'dzed pa ninyunye/ /ma lus 'gyed cing spro ba yi7/ /gyen thur 'dzeg cing 'gengs 'byung ba'i/ /sgo gnyis lus kun khyab pa'i rtsa/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi snying po can/ /phyi rim bzhi yi rgyun du 'khyil/ /dbus nas 4nya'akhyil pa thig le'i rtsa/ /'phen yonapa bde ba'i rlung dang 'grogs/ /gang du'ang 'khrul cing sprul pa'i phyir/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo shes rab nyid/ /de 'og gru gsum 'bar tsho ba'i rtsa/ /gyen du 'bar dang thur du 'phro/ /'od kyis 'bar ba'i sa bon can/ /rtse mo'i 'og mas tsoreg pa'i khams/ /gtum mo lte 'og 'bar ba'i rtsal/ /skyes bu chags pa slong ba ltar / /'di dag bde ba bskyed 7pa ste/ /gnas sa tshad dang bcas par 102—385

gnas / /de ②'og g.yo ba rlung gi rten/ /'byed sridang 'dzums ①pa'i las can nyid/ /de dang de gnyis gang ldan pas/ /lus kyi dngas ④snyigs 'dis 'byed pa/ /bye brag brgyad cu rtsa gnyis rtsa/ /'dus pas sku gsung thugs yin te / /lte ba thur du 'dzag pa'i rtsa/ /rtsa gsum 'dom pa'i bde ba'i gnad/ /rgyu ba rlung ni thig ler zhi)rten/ /'gyed cing 'dud pa g.yas g.yon te/ /bcu drug 'dus pa'i srog rtse gong / /rtsa gsum mgrin par 'dus pa ni/ /sgra sbyor 'khor lo ngag gi gnad/ /de nas dngas ma'i thig le la/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i tshul du gnas/ /rig pa'i rtsa la bcud 'dus pas6)/ /thogs med gsal ba'i mngon shes 'byung / /phyi rol zag pa'i rtsa nyid la/ /bde ba chen po'i bcud 'dus pasasti/ /bde chen nyams nyid 2skye bar 'gyur/ /chos nyid thig le mi g.yo ba/ /dngas ma 'dus pa'i bcud thim pas/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa yi / /zag med ye shes bde ba che/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni rgya che ba/ /thog mtha' med par khyab par 'gyur/ /'di nyid rtogs dang ma rtogs las/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /spyod pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /thabs kyi khyad par phyag rgya lnga/ /bskyod pa rlung dang 'bar ba me/ /thig le chu dang 'dzin pa sa/ /bde chen nam mkha'i phyag rgyar gsal/ /bde bas bde ba'i don mthong bas/ /rtsa dang thig le rlung dag dang / /bde ba rang cirig ma skyes pa997/ /de nyid bde chen mi rtog pa / /rang rgyud bral bas zag pa med/ /rang rgyud med pa'i bde ba nyid/ /dngas ma'i thig les kun khyab pasakyi/ /phyi nang dbang por bcas pa yis/ /bde ba sgyu yonyama'i rang bzhin 'char/ /ma lus bde ba chen po nyid/ /de la de yis rgyas btab pas/ /bde ba mi rtog lhan 102—386

cig skyes/ /phyag rgya gcig tu gsal bar gnas/ /gang du 'khor lo rtsa bcud ldan / /sa bon yi ge bde ba dang / /khams lnga ye shes ro ldan zhing / /stong dang bde ba'i thig le 'dres/ /rtag tu dran par gnas pa nyid/ /re re'ang de ltar gnas pa'i phyir/ /'khor stilo rtsa ②bcud thig ler bcas/ /lha dang ye shes sku gsung thugs/ /rang lus snang ba snod bcud kun/ /spros bcas phyag rgya'i grangs su gsal/ /bcud lnga ye shes kho na'i phyir/ /dngas snyigs sridabyer med ༷thig le'i don/ /so so'i kha dog dbyibs tshul dang / /sbas pa'i sku gsung thugs dag la/ /dbyer med gsal ba'i rig pa yis/ /ma lus bde chen mngon du ⑤gsal/ /de nas bde ba chen po nyid/ /gar thabs rlung gis dbang bsgyur dunas/ /ma lus bde ba'i rig ⑦pa 'char/ /gtsang dang 'dzem ⑧pa bral gyur nas/ /bshung ba lnga dang 'dod pa lnga/ /thig le bcud dang dngas mar bcas/ /thig le chen por 'dres pas na/ /mi 'gyur 'chi med tshe la gnas / /rang rig bde ba chen po nyid/ /thog ma tha ma med par gnas/ /thig le rgyu ba rlung dang bcas/ /zag med dngas ma'i snying por thim/ /mngon shes lnga ldan zag pa med/ /dngas ma'i snying por lam mthar phyin/ /de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa dag /thabs dang shes rab kha sbyor ba'i/ /bden gnyis nyi zla'i khyad par las ma lus thams cad gsal bar snang 5)/ /gang du thabs dang bral ba yi/ /gnas dang bde sdug btang snyoms dang / /longs spyod tshe dang kha dog dang / /bdag dang bdag gir ⑩zhen bcas (nyapa'i/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg dang dran pa sna tshogs kyis/ /zhen dang 'ching /sheba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rang bzhin bzhi ni 102—387

gsal bar 'gyur/ /de las tha mal 'khor ba'i lam/ /thog ma med nas ①lus gnas pa'i/ /bde chen nam mkha'i snying po nyid/ /lus gnyis rtsa bcud ma lus pa/ /thabs dang shes rab sku gsung thugs/ /srin bu 'khyugs ②pa'i yi ge ltar / /dbang po gnyis dang 'brel te gnas/ /thabs dang man ngag ldan pa yis / /rgyal rigs rje'u dang bram ze (gudang / /dmangs rigs tshos ma gar mkhan ciram/ /(5)rdol ma nyo tshong ma nyid dang / /ma dang sgyug mo sring mo dang / /mthar sgeg lus 'tshong ma la sogs/ /dngos grub skye ba'i zhing du bshad/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug dang / /bcwa 6)brgyad bcud ldan rab yin te/ /nyi shu la sogs 'bring du bshad/ /rtsa lnga tha ma'i tshad yin te/ /gzhan la dngos grub med par gsungs/ /las dang bya ba ma lus pa/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba rab tu brtsam(7)ske/ /gnas pa 'byung ba'i bcud bzhi la/ /'byung bzhi gsal rkyen gang phrad pas/ /nyi zla 'dres pa'i gar thabs las/ /lhan cig skyes pa gsum gcig dzo las/ /nyams su ye shes lnga shar ba/ /ma lus bde ba chen por 'gyur/ /gnas bzhi rtsa bcud thig le las/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /phyag rgya bzhir ldan mnyam sbyor bas/ /dngas snyigs rlung gis ngos bzung nas/ /dngos po lhan cig skyes pa dang 99)/ /bdag po gdung can sbyar ba yi7 'phro 'du btang dang bzung ba dang / /bzlog pas nyi zla dbyer med myong / byu /dang po 'jig pa la 1lhasogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang chen gsang bdag par/ /lam lnga sems lnga mthar phyin pas/ /stobs kyi khyad par gsal bar 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /'og min nam mkha'i shar sgo nas/ /nyi zla dus gcig 12shar ba la/ /dus tshod gza' yis 1shegang bzung ba/ /nyin mtshan 102—388

med pa'i ye shes nyid/ /'phen pa rlung gi sbyor bas 'byung / /rnal 'byor rig par ①snang ba yi/ /khyab pa nam mkha'i 'jig rten na/ /bde chen mdzes pa'i me tog la/ /bcud kyi ③khyad par gang gnas pa/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba g.yi/ /shel ④dang byu ru'i ⑤dung bsdus nas/ /rnal 'byor bcud kyis rgyas 'gyur dunas/ /bcu gsum sa la lhun gyis grub/ /'khyud pa'i gar thabs las byung ba'i/ /bde ba ( )chen po mi rtog pa/ /skad cig cha las byung ba yi/ /zag med ye shes snying po ste/ /ma lus dngas ma'i blo snang ba/ /zhen bral stong rtog mi gnas pa/ /dngos po lhan cig skyes pa ste/ /ma lus khyab par gnas pa yin / /'du shes zad pa'i rang bzhin te/ /skye dang 'grib pa'i thig le nyid/ /bco (kyelnga rdzogs pa'i tha ma nyid/ /sbyor ba kun zad stong pa'i ngang / /de nyid byin brlabs 6)las gyur pa/ /phyogs dus snod bcud ngo bo nyid/ /thig le rdul bral zhen pa med/ /sgyu ma gzugs brnyan brag ca 7sogs/ /ma lus bde chen rang bzhin du/ /thun mong dran rtog 6glerang 'gags nasatsho / /bde chen sgyu ma mngon sum snang / /bde ba chen po'i sku gsung thugs/ /bcud lnga zhu ba'i ye shes ro/ /thams cad rtse gcig dran pa nyid/ /dbyer med thabs dang shes rab ste/ /dran pa gcig tsoku myong ba nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba yis / /sa ya bcu gsum grangs med tshepa'i/ /thig le bde ba nyid snang ba/ /rang rang ma 'dres thig le la/ /sku gsung thugs dang dran pa dang / /ye shes lnga yi tshargyas btab ste/ /ma lus thig le'i tshogs su snang / /rang 'byung 8bde chen rig pa'i lha/ /gcig kyi dang grangs las 'das pa yang / /nyi zla gnyis kyi gdan la bzhugs/ /khyab pa tsho thig le'i gur nang nas517/ /bzhugs nas bdag 102—389

po rten bdag can/ /rtsa bcud 'brel ba'i rgyan dang bcas/ /ka ①ba gsum dang pho brang bzhil/ /lde mig gnyis la 'byed pa bzhi/ /sgo bzhi phye bas gzhal yas khang / ci/lha dang bcas pa mngon du 'gyur/ /dgon pa dur khrod ldan pa yi / /gsang ba'i 'og min 'bar ba nyid/ /rim pa phyi nang bar ldan par/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan stengs dunas/ /dus gsum thig ler ro gcig ①pa'o/ /bde chen gnyis su med par bzhugs/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ /tshom bu'i tshogs kyang de bzhin te/ /thun mong dam tshig ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub shes rab snying rje lnga/ /gzhan du thabs dang shes rab dang / /spyad dang glu gar rgyan dang bcas/ /ma spangs rol bar longs spyod ⑤pas/ /ye shes nyi zla rgyun 'char ba/ /rlung sems ye shes bcas pa nyid/ /rgyu ba med pas zag pa bral/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug bar nyid du/ /zag dumed bde ba rgyun mi 'chadam/ /de nyid tshad med dkyil 'khor te/ /bde chen mngon du gang bar snang —/ /de dag lam la zhugs pa yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba ma lus pa'i/ /spyod pa'i khyad par thams cad kun/ /'dir ni rgyas par bstan pa yin/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur pas/ /phyi nang gsang ba la sogs pa/ /skabs la bab pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gang yang rung bas spyod ⑦par bya/ /dang po rtogs nas mthar thug pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lam spyod la(kye/ /spyad bya yul zhes gang 'dod de/ /thams cad blang dor med par spyod6)/ /thabs kyi lta spyod ting ⑩'dzin gyis/ /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin nam/ /mun snang gser 'gyur thabs bzhin du/ /thabs la mkhas pas spyad par bya/ /skyes mchod (1thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /zhing dang spyod yul dag 7pa la/ /chags bral bde bar gang spyad ⑫102—390

pas / /nam mkha' ①dbyings kyi longs spyod la/ /bde ba chen por longs spyod cing ske/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /gang dag thabs dang mi ldan zhing glu/ /don med lam la ②ma 'brel bar/ /sgra dang tshig la brten pa yis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa gang brtsams pa/ /gang bsgrubs snang bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /nus med g.yul du zhugs pa ltar/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka brlag pa dang / /mthong ba'i chos la sdug bsngal zhing / /ngan 'gro log pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud chen po ①las spyod pa rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rang bzhin ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dang ske/ /lhag gnyis ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dang / /byang chub sems dang tshogs nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor don ni bshad par bya/ /gang phyir dbang yul rnam shes kun/ /gzhan snang tha dad ma yin pa'i/ /ma lus rang rig byang chub sems / /ma bcos rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /ma lus kun gyi snying po ste/ /phyogs bcu 'das dang ma byon pa'i/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi rang bzhin yin/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /sna tshogs rang bzhin dbyer med pa④/ /de nyid rang bzhin chos sku yin/ /de nyid 'jig rten brtan g.yo ste/ /ji ltar snang grags thams cad kun/ /nges pa'i rang bzhin bzhi bcu gnyis/ /rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs skur bshad(ge/ /de nyid phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /kun du sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /yon tan phrin 6)las bsam yas mchog /rang bzhin sprul sku bsam mi khyab/ /ji snyed 102—391

'gro ba ma lus kyi①/ /lus can snying la gang gnas pa'i/ /rang 'byung (mizag med ye shes gzugs/ /mi shigs thig le bde chen po/ /nam mkha' lta bur kun khyab pa/ /mi gnas chos sku'i (gurang bzhin yin/ /de nyid rtsa ba'i rang bzhin las/ /ma lus snod bcud rang bzhin can/ /rtog pa ma lus dkyil 'khor te/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /de nyid thig le phra rags par/ /snang ba'i mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /de yis de 'dul snang ba'i rgyu / /sprul pa rang bzhin zhes bshad do/ /gang 'dir phung po 'byung ba dang / /rnam shes dbang po yul dus dang / /nyon mongs rtag chad yid chos bcas/ /gang la mngon par mi snang yang / /rang bzhin ma bcos dkyil 'khor te/ /kun la khyab par snang ba yin/ /rang snying dngas ma lngar ldan pa(7/ /dngas ma'i phung po 'byung ba dang / /dbang po'i (5)yul du bcas pa yi/ /rtsa bcud thig ler bcas pa nyid/ /sku gsung thugs su rang snang ba/ /ma lus kun la rgyas btab bo/ /bcud 'dus thig le chen po nyid/ /nyi zla 'dres pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /bde ba'i thig le rang snang ba/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i tshul dag gis / /thabs kyis mngon du gyur na yang / /gnyis med thig le bde ba'i ro/ /'gro ba kun la rang bzhin snang / /de dag yab yum sku gsung thugs/ ji /rtsa bcud thig ler bcas pa (6)nyid/ /'du (77'bral med par ye gnas pa'o/ /gang phyir rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /zag med ye shes rang snang ba/ /dpag med yon tan rgya mtsho nyid/ /ye shes 'og min pho brang ste/ /zag med yon tan rgyan ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i pho brang dbus/ /mi 'jigs phung po'i gdan stengs 98na/ /bdag po kun bzang 'khor lo bskor/ /bka' sdod skyes bu 102—392

mdun na gnas/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba rgya mchosare tshogs/ /sku gsung thugs ①dang yon tan las/ /rang rang rigs lnga gang gyur pa'i/ /rnam thar ②dbu dang ye shes phyag /so so'i bzhugs tshul ldan pa yis / /mdun rgyab phyogs bcur 'khod pa nyid/ /yab yum 'brel pa'i tshul gyis gnas/ /rang 'byung dum bsgribs ye shes phyir/ /zag med tshogs gnyis las byung ba'i/ /nam mkha'i khams dang rgya mnyam pa'i/ /'jig rten grangs ⑤med rdul dang bcas/ /bkod pa phun sum tshogs par gnas/ /gang de zag med ye shes kyi/ /phyag dang zhal dang thabs ldan pas/ /zhal mthong rigs la dbang sgyur ⑥bas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur/ /rgyal ba (7)de dag ma lus pa'i/ /gsung mchog brjod du med pa nyid/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi (snyemathar thug pa/ /brda 6)dang don dang byin brlabs yidang / /gsang ba la sogs ci rigs par/ /dam pa'i chos sgra rgya mtsho sgrogs(nye/ /zag med ye shes rgya mtsho yi/ /byin brlabs 8cho 'phrul mngon shar ba/ /a ā/ i yī/ u u/ e e.e/ o yi.o/ ṛ rī/lo 'aski/ i aḥtso/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ta tha yid dha na/ ṭa ṭha tunyeḍa nye ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣa/ 'di dag rab tu phyung ba yis/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bcas pa'i/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang rgya mtsho dang / /kho 4ger yug dang lhun po dang / /'bab chu lteng rdu )ka mtshe'u bcas/ /de na gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /rang rang longs spyod bde sdug bcas/ /phyi nang snod bcud bcas pa rnams/ /ma lus g.yo ( spezhing ldeg par byed/ /sgra bo che yang sgrogs ri gepar byed/ /de dag sbyangs nas mi gnas par/ /gsung gi ngo bor byin brlabs sa te/ /de dag stong nyid la thim 102—393

pas / /ma lus stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ /a ni stong dang mi stong gi/ /dbu ma dmigs su'ang yod ma yin/ /ji snyed snang grags chos rnams kun/ /yi ge phreng ba nyid la gnas/ /gang phyir de yi rang bzhin yang / /rang bzhin cho 'phrul ting 'dzin dang / /gsang ba bris par gang snang ba/ /rig pa'i khyad par snang ba yin/ /rtsa ba dang ni rgyan zhes dang / /lha yi yi ge mngon snang bas②ske/ /rang bzhin sku gsung thugs nyid de/ /khyab pa'i tshul gyis ma lus snang ske/ /gang du thugs rje byin brlabs (gyidang / /ting 'dzin rig pa'i cho 'phrul te/ /rang rang khyad par mngon snang yin/ /'di dag rang bzhin sna tshogs pa/ /gang du ji ltar gnas pa kun/ /yi ger ma gyur med par gnas/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes rgya mcho1re gsang ba'i thugs/ /mthar thug ①med pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /zag med rgyas pas kun khyab can/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa/ /gcig dang du ma med tshul gyis/ /ye shes ma bsgribs ④gsal ba yis/ /nam mkha' (5)dbyings ltar gsal mkhyen pa/ /dus gsum chos dang 'gro ba dang / /zhing khams rgyal ba dpag med dang / /ri dang rgya mtsho rdul bcas pa/ /snga phyi ma bsgribs da lta nyid/ /me long lta bur ⑥mngon du snang / /dpal ldan nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ye (7shes lnga yis kun khyad (7can/ /kun mkhyen stobs bcu mtha' thug med/ /nam mkha'i dbang phyug bde chen po/ /mngon shes rgya mtsho (1)pha rol byon/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kun/ /sad dang sangs pa'i 7bdag nyid can/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i bdag /bde ba chen po sgyu ma nyid/ /rang 'byung (1thugs las gzhan pa min/ /'di ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang 102—394

bzhin te/ /gdul bya gang gi ngo ①dag tu/ /sna tshogs mngon par 'phrul pa yin / /gang du khro ②gtum gdug ldan pa'i/ /srid gsum dregs pa'i bdag po dag /thugs rje khros ②pas gdul ba'i phyir/ /khro bo'i de bzhin gshegs par mdzadam/ /sku ni ri rab lta bu nyid/ /zhabs dang phyag ni rdul snyed ④de/ /gang de gdul ba'i khyad par gyis/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs ⑤bzhi dang / /dbu dgu bco ⑥brgyad phyag la sogs/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig dbu la sogs/ /de bzhin g.yo rdul mi g.yo ba'i/ /phyag zhabs zhal yang de bskyed ⑦de/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa des/ /ji snyed phyogs bcu 'jig rten du/ /cho 'phrul bzhi la ⑧sogs pa yiX/ /mdzad pa'i gar byathabs sna tshogs kyis/ /dregs pa che dang dbang phyug dang / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug brgya byin dang / /dri za gshin rje gnod sbyin bcas/ /gdug pa'i nga rgyal rgyu 'bras can/ /rgyu 'bras rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /ma lus pa dag ma btang bar/ /nga rgyal khro gtum zhum pa yis / /ji skad smras kyang rang rang gi/ /nyon mongs rgya mtsho ma skams 0par/ /thugs rje zhe la tsomanan tshul gyis/ /de dag mngon du btul (stebar mdzad/ /la lar dpal chen khrag 'thung steci/ /la lar rdo rje khrag 'thung nyid/ /la lar rin chen khrag 'thung ste/ /la lar pad+ma de bzhin gshegs/ /la lar sna tshogs las su bcas/ /rang rang btsun mo tsotshogs dang 'khril/ /rigs kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /mdog dang cha lugs de bzhin te/ /de bzhin sras dang bka' nyan dang / /pho nya yang sprul la sogs pa/ /rdo rje ba spu bu ga nas/ /pho nya bye ba drug cu dag /phyogs bcu kun du rgyas bkye ste/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa yi / /gdug pa'i tshogs ni de dag kun/ /ma lus dus gcig 102—395

mnyes dang gsal/ /thabs lam bcud du 'brel par gsungs/ /gang de thabs chen gsal byas pas/ /lus kyi chos bzhi rtag chad spangs/ /bde ba'i thig le rang snang ba/ /ma lus 'joms las ①khro bo'o(mi/ /bcud las 'das pa'i hūṃ gsum nyid/ /byed pa bral ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /yul gsum bral bas chos kyi dbyings/ /ma lus rnam dag kun du bzang / /dngas snyigs snying por 'brel ba yis/ /nyon mongs sa bon drug bcas pas/ /thig les (gebatul nas bstan pa 'chad/ /sprul pa'i sku ru bshad pa yin/ /kun kyang ye shes lnga yi ④ro / /khyab par ⑤gnas pas rgyas btab (7cing / /snang srid bde chen sku gsung thugs / /dran pa rtag tu gsal bzung ( ba'o/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad par bya / /gsang rtse sna tshogs 'dus (kyepa'i dbus/ /phyi nang rim pa'i dbu rtse can/ /ngo bo byin brlabs 6)'phags pa ste/ /yon tan byin brlabs ྅ )kun gyi gnas/ /gsang ba'i pad+ma'i rang bzhin du/ /rdo rje gnyis med thig ler blta47/ /nyi zla zil pa'i thig le nyid/ /phan tshun 'dres pa rlung gis phye/ /gsang ba'i khams lngas ye shes rol/ /snyigs ma'i phung po lnga dag nas/ /dngas ma lnga yi rang bzhin gsal/ /rgyal po de bzhin gshegs par gsal/ /gsang ba'i 'byung ba lngar bstan pa/ /dbang yul phrad pa'i skabs las shes/ /rigs mchog yum gyi phyag rgya lnga/ /snyigs ma bral ba'i dus na blta/ /thig /gele thugs kyi bde ba rnams / /rang rang thig le bde bar gsal/ /ye shes rnam shes dngas ma rnams / /bde ba chen po gsal bar shes/ /dam tshig bde ba'i chas kyis sgegs/ / /sgo gsum 'brel cing thig ler chags/ /gang du bde ba'i sgra bsgrags gete/ /bskyod cing 'pho yoba'i gar gyis mnyes/ /thugs gang thig le 102—405

brten pa'i gnas/ /gang yul bde bar dbang byed pa'i/ /rten dang bcas pa'i bde ba yis/ /rang rang thig le skyed ①par byed/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /thugs dang thig ler bcas pa nyid/ /dgug 'dzin 'khyud cing gnas pa dang / /thig le rlung dang stod ②smad bsdams/ /bskyod nidang 'be bas pa'i thabs yin te/ /tshim dang thig le dor ba dang / /ye shes gsal bas bde sems rgyas/ /rim pa ji bzhin gsal bar brtags/ /gsang yul dbang po reg pa dang / /rnam shes gang yin ta krita ④de/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin ma skyes pas/ /rtag chad mtshan ma bdag med pa/ /sgo ma'i rang bzhin gsang ba'i sngags/ /shes skyob don phyir gsang ba'i sngags/ /shes pa gsum 'das sgrib zad (snyepa/ /rang rig byed pa yid ces bya/ /rgyun gsum zad pa'i chos dbyings nyid/ /rtogs bya kun du bzang mor bshad/ /'khor ba'i sa bon nyon mongs bcas/ /zil ba'i thig sngon lam bzhin du/ /thabs dusbyor thig le'i 'phro 'du yis/ /gsang ba'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston/ /sa bon thig le ma skyes gzugs/ /bstan pa rim pa gsum du bstan/ /'dod pa'i yan lag sum brgya ⑦dang / /drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pas/ /tha mal zhen pa rang grol nas / /rdo rje ze'u 'bru 'brel bskyod pas/ /rang 'bar thig le gzugs su chags / /yab yum lnga phyi thabs kyis gzung / /nyi ma zla ba shar ba'i 'od/ /rtse nas rtse ru phyin pa yis/ /'khor ba'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ /ma lus lhan cig skyes par gsal/ /de nyid gsang bar 97shes par bya/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /bzhi bcu rtsa lngar gnas pa yi/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin snying po nyid/ /rang rang mtshon pa'i rtags yin te/ /rgyas dang bsdus pa'ang de 102—406

bzhin du/ /rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri 'bar/ /dril bu pad+ma rin po che/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rim bshad pa'o/ /gzhan gang gnas su rdo rje shes/ /dang po thugs dang g.yon 'khyud pa'o/ /rin chen myu gu ral gri 'bar/ /pad+ma dkar po rdo rje che/ /ut+pal klu shing po 6)ti snye/ /gzugs mdzes rin chen phreng ba dang ske/ /pi wang gar sgyur pog me dang / /byug pa so sor ②rim shes bya/ /mṛ ①mgo rdo rje thod rgya gram/ /lcags kyu zhags pa sbo ṭa hoḥbya/ /'od 'phro mnyam bzhag durdo rje thal/ /ye shes rtse lnga 6)chos khams dril/ /thugs la brtan pa nyid du gsungs/ /thub chen nges par phyag gnyis shes/ /gseg ⑦par go mtshon pi wang brdab/ /sgrom ⑤stob po ⑨ti chos 'chad tshul/ /me dpung bum par shes par bya/ /gzhan yang mthun ⑩pa skabs kyis brtag /mi mthun ⑩khyad par rgyas par bstan/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / rgya gram dril bu brgyad shes bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 8mda' se gol/ /rin chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan so/ /pad+ma 'khor lo ral gri lce/ /rgya gram khu tshur go cha mche/ /gzhan yang skabs dang mthun 8pa ste//rang rang don nyid rtse gcig pa'i/ /thugs kyi ④rtags su shes par bya/ /dngas ma'i ye shes lnga 'bar bas/ /gcod dang mi phyed dga' ba dang / /ma gos bde ba bskyed pa nyid/ /rnam par mi rtog rim par shes/ /tsoyon tan bskyed tsodang tha mal gcod/ /de bzhin ma gos ye shes nyid/ /so so yon tan cha las byung / /rang rang rtsa bcud thig le'i dbyibs/ /so so nyid ltar rang gnas te/ /bde ba'i thig le nyid du shes/ /rang 'byung yidangs ma'i thig le nyid/ /'brel pa'i tshul gyis kun snang ba/ /khu ba rtsa yi 4shedabyibs gzugs nyid/ /rang rang las dang rtog pa dang / /snying po phyag mtshan dbyibs bzhin pas/ /bde chen 102—407

de bzhin gsal 6)bar bsgom par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /cho ga las byung rim pa yis/ /gnyis med gsal bas de brtan ②phyir/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs ③rim bzhin bya/ /sbyor ba'i thig le 'phros pa yis/ /gdug pa ma lus btul nas ni/ /rang rang rim pa gsal gyur nas/ /hūm̐ gis phyogs phyogs gdan la bzhugs/ /ha brgyad sa bon las byung ba/ /dkar mo'i tshogs dang rkun mo'i tshogs/ /rmongs mo dang ni thal 0byed ma/ /sbos ⑤mo dang ni gtum mo dang / /sme sha can dang ma tshogs ma'i/ /so so'i cha lugs rngam 'thon (nyanas/ /sprul pa bzhi po la thim zhing / /rang rang las mdzad snying po sgrogasal / /'dus te phyogs phyogs gnas par bya/ /he brgyad sa bon las byung ba / /stag dang seng ge wa dang khyi/ /bya rgod gang 18)ka 'ug pa dang / /pho rog 6)la sogs phra 0men rnams/ /'phro 'du 7las dang phyogs mdog mtshan/ /rim pa ji bzhin de bzhin bsam/ /phaṭa bzhis rta dang phag gdong dang / /sbrul dang spre'u gdong rim pa bzhin/ /las dang sku mdog phyag mtshan yang / /rim pa bzhin du gnas pa yin/ /de dag 'khor lo dbus dang lnga/ /yab yum phyag rgya 'brel par gnas/ /rtsibs mchan tu gru chad bzhi dag la/ /gnas kyi ma mo dgod par bya/ /bar khyams 5nyedang por phra limen brgyad/ /phyogs mtshams rim par dgod par bya/ /sgo bzhir sgo ba rngam tshul gnas/ /bar khyams 'tha ma dag la ni/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul nyid/ /rim pa bzhin du bkod 7par bya/ /rin chen thod pa'i dbu rgyan dag /gnas skabs dag tu 'tsham par kyi bya/ /sku gsung yonyethugs kyang de bzhin te/ /yan lag dkyil 'khor nyid du bshad/ /gang phyir nam mkha'i ye 102—409

shes nyid/ /spros med dam pa nyid du 'dod/ /bde ba'i thig les kun khyab la//chos nyid snying rje kun du snang / /thig le rang snying sa bon ①rgyu/ /zag pa med pa'i snying po yin/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i snying po ②can/ /thig le gong 'og kun dang 'brel/ /gnas pa khong stong tshul dag gis / /ma lus kun la khyab pa yin / /dzhai sgo g.yo ba'i sa sgo can/ /bskyod ④dang las kyis khyab byed pa/ /lus khyab gnas dang las dag ni/ /khyad par so sor snang ba yin/ /de steng ⑤ti la ku'i rang bzhinayi/ /'bar ma brgyad dang ldan pa nyid/ /zhu dang 'bar ba'i las byed pa/ /drag mo zhes kyang 'dod pa yin/ /thig le sgo nas 'dzag pa'i bcud/ /gsher dang 'dzag pa'i baṃ snying can/ /snang dang bebs ⑦pa'i rang bzhin can/ /lus can gnas pa gsal bar bya/ /gang la gang rten ⑧de yi brtan6)/ /thig le rtsar bcas bde ba'i rten/ /de nyid bskyed dang gnas gyur pa/ /brten pas sa yi yidakyil 'khor nyid/ /'khor lo gzhal yas rang bzhin te/ /rim pa gong 'og 'brel pa can/ /lus la gnas pas dur khrod de67 / /kha dog rtsa dang bcud bsdus (nyapa'i/ /rgyan dang gdan du ldan pa nyida'//gang la rten skipa'i thig le nyid/ /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i lha/ /sa bon yi ge bde ba yis/ /sku gsung thugs dang ldan pa nyid/ /gcig kyang khams lnga'i bde ba'i rosali/ /ma lus khyab pa'i tshul gyis gnas/ /lus la thig le chen po gnas / /gnas dang bcud dang bde ba nyid/ /thabs chen thabs las byung ba yi / /nam mkha'i ye shes dpag tu med/ /'jug pa bzhi dang rim pa brgyad/ /thig le gcig gis khyad par 'phags/ /nyon mongs zad pas zad byed de/ /dngas ma'i ye shes lnga 'bar nyid/ /yul dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin las/ /102—410
