'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar snang / /gnas kyi thig le bde ba can/ /dur khrod ma brgyad gsang ba ste/ /gnyis med phra ①men nyid du bshad/ /thig le thabs dang bcas pa nyid/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug ②pa'i sgo dang 'brel/ /snying po thig le nyid du sbyor/ /gang dang lhan cig skyes pa las/ /bde ba chen po skye ba med/ /ma lus bde ba chen po nyid/ /khyab pa rgya yongs ①ma chad pa'o/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i bde ba'i ro/ /sa yang bcu gsum 'dus pa'i mkha'adu/ /rang 'byung lakhyab pa chen po'i gzugs/ /kun 'dus thig le chen por gsal/ /rnam thar gsum ldan e yi gzugs/ /bde ba bskyod yidang thig le bskul/ /'phro dang sdud ⑦dang bsdams pa'i rlung / /rdo rje pad+ma 'dus pa'i sa/ /rten dang bral ba bde ba'i sa/ /shu kra'i thig ④le gang gsher ba/ /gsang ba chu yi rang bzhin yin/ /de dag phyag rgyas gang sbyar bas/ /bde ba'i drod ni rang 'bar skye/ /r+ghaṃ ⑨las gsang ba'i gzhal yas khang / /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma togatso /sna tshogs 'dus pa'i snying po can/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i 'og min te/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i dngos gzhi (1can/ /dga' bzhi 'jug pa'i sgo dang ldan/ /'bab 'dzeg thig le'i skas dang ldan/ /bde ba nyi zla rgyal la ⑫bzhugs / /thig le 'dres pa bde ba'i ro/ /nyi zla 'brel ba'i 'bade ba'i lha/ /'thung dang rngub ④pa'i thabs chen gyis/ /'khor ba'i sa bon zad byed 8pas/ /za yibyed khro bor de bshad pa'o/ /dpag med thig le'i rang bzhin gang / /sa ya bcu gsum pho brang na/ /bde ba chen po ye shes gzugs/ /sku gsung thugs dang lhan cig bzhugs/ /'du shes gsum ldan byin brlabs 'ate/ /gsang ba'i ye shes lnga ldan pas/ /dbang thob rnams la rgyas btab po/ /102—411

gsang ba thig le chen po ni/ /rang 'byung 0)bde ba chen po nyid/ /rnam rtog rgyu ba chad pa yi/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i bar na gnas/ /'og sgo snying po pad+ma ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dkyil 'khor te/ /gsang ba sku gsung thugs nyid du/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med gnas/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i thig le nyid/ /gnyis med bcud du gyur pa na/ /de yi bde ba chen po nyid/ /khyab pa'i tshul gyis gang bar bzhugs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho lhan cig skyes/ /gsang ba'i thig le bde ba'i ro / /nyi zla 'dres ②pa'i tshul gyis snang / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bshad / /de nas rgyal ba thams cad kun/ /gdul bya'i phyibasam pa'i khyad par gyis / /nam mkha' (snyadabyings kyi (51mthas gtugs par/ /rdo rje khro bor snang gyur te/ /bskyed cing (nyagadug pa 'dul ba yi/ /drag po lha yi (7sngags dag dang / /de yi gzhal yas snang bar mdzad/ / rgyu bi (8)shwa bi shudhe/ dz+nyā na kā pa la rat+na pañtsa 99)rgyu/ ma hā de pa sbri bor baṃ/ srur+ya yi tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ de steng so so'i sku nyid dag /gsal pa'i rim pa dgod par bya/ /oṃ pud+dha yi ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta yi ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kha)ma hā shrī lihe ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta sko da ha 7na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta yo ka ha na da ha pa tsa rtsu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta 6)ka ha tsho rin da ha pa tsa hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kurma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan+ta (1ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kro dhī ( sheshā ri sarba duṣ+ṭan ri rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra dha zhu ci/ra kro dhī gshwa ri dza la nī 8 rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā srur+ya rat+na ma hā kro dhī ( shwa ri bi da ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī sha ta sa man+ta 9 napad+ma ma hā kro dhī 29shwa ri khā hi so )rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ sarba 1632—412

tshig① /kun du rab tu tshig par 'gyur②/ /'bar dang rab 'byam ⑧kun du 'bar / /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor khro tshogs kyis/ /gang zhig rab gang kun du gang ske/ /'khrugs dang rab 'khrugs kun du 'khrugs/ /'thor zhing rab 'thor kun du 'thor/ /'gul zhing ldeg pa de bzhin te/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gang ba ④yi/ /sgra bo che yang sgrogs (7par byed/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug ༷pa ma lus pa / /thul zhing brgyal nas myos gyur te/ /de dag bde bas bslang ⑨byas te/ /bde ba chen po dgyes pa'i gar/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar (nyathug par/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i gzugs kyis byed/ /rdo rje gsang ba phyirang bzhin las/ /thig le chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsgyur/ /gdod nas thig le'i rang bzhin nyid/ /ma bcos thig ler gnas pa nyid/ /ma lus thig ler rgyas btab pa/ /nam mkha'i gzugs can de bzhin nyid/ /ma lus bde ba'i thig le nyid/ /khyab pa chen po'i rang bzhin te/ /mtha' dbus bral ba bde ba che/ /snying rje chen por brjod pa yin/ /kun gyi rgyu ni thig le ste/ /ma lus sa bon rtsa ba nyid/ /mi shigs snying ga'i 7pho brang nyid/ /ye shes rdzogs pa'i gzhal 7yas khang / /nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan nyid de'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bzhugs gnas so/ /nyon mongs gdug pa'i gdan khri nyid/ /gdul bya thub pa nyid du bstan/ /phung po nyon mongs lnga tsho dag pa/ /rgyal po lnga yi rang bzhin te/ /rang snying dngas mar bcas pa nyid/ /dbang phyug lnga ru brjod pa nyid/ /rnam shes yul du bcas pa nyid / /rten dang brten par bcas pa yi/ /bde ba phra mimen bcu 7drug nyid/ /phyi lta nang lta dkyil 'khor nyid/ /dgug dang 'dzin dang thig les bsdams/ /thig le'i rang bzhin gnyis su med/ /dbu ma'i thig le bcas pa'i lam/ /102—414

dbang phyug nam mkha'i ①dbang mo tshogs/ /dbab pa nye ba'i tshul bzung nas/ /thig le dbab pa'i thabs bzhi yis/ /phab ②pas rang rgyud dngos po bsregani /dran 'byung rig pa'i 'phro ④'du tshogs/ /bde ba chen po'i ⑤don la 'jug /gnyis med thim pas dkyil 'khor 'bar/ /sku gsung thugs su kun gsal bas//gnyis med thim pas mnyes ⑥par mdzad/ /rang bzhin bde ba'i dkyil 'khor kun / /rig pa nyams myong dbyings la thim/ /dran rtogs ⑦'byung ba nyon mongs kun/ /tshig pa gsum du shes par bya/ /ye shes bde ba chen po nyid/ /'bar ba gsum du shes par bya/ /byang chub sems kyi bde ba yis/ /ma lus gang zhing (9khyab par gyur/ /thig le gong 'og steng 'og nyid/ /thig le gong ma nyid 'og tu/ /'og ma nyid ni steng du 'bar/ /gcig gnyis lus kun khyab par 'thor/ /lus dang rtsar bcas 'gul ba dang / /ldeg cing 'bar ba'i bde bas gang / /bde bas dbang sgyur (9༄tshim pa'i sgra/ /ma lus khyab par sgrogs ⑩par byed/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga nyid/ /bde ba chen po nam mkha'i dbyings/ /'byung bzhi rdo rje pad+ma nyid/ /reg pa 'dus pa'i bde ba nyid(nyam/ /re dogs rgyu chab chad pa nyid/ /de bzhin nyid du blta bar bya/ /thig le 'dres pa'i bde ba yis/ /sa yang bcu gsum khyab pa'i yid/ /ma lus mkha' ltar dri med pa'i/ /rang 'byung / phyogs med kun du snang / /thabs dang shes rab bde ba yis/ /'byung bzhi rim pa'i dngas ma ste/ /sa bon bde ba'i rgyu zhes grags/ /bha ga pad+ma'i snying po nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil tso 'khor gyi/ /bzhugs gnas bde ba chen po'i rten/ /sangs rgyas rin po che yi snod / /phung po lnga dang nyon mongs lnga/ /ye shes lnga yis zil gyis mnanam/ /102—415

nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po ni/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin nyid/ /thig le phrad pa'i dus nyid na/ /ye shes lnga yi ro dang ldan / /gdul bya 'joms pa'i khro bo lnga/ /'byung lnga dbang phyug rnam par bstan / /myong dang yul bcas rnam shes yul/ /phra ge)men nyid du shes par bya/ /phyag rgyar bcas pa'i sbyor ba bzhi/ /sgor bcas nyid du shes par bya/ /sgal tshigs 'dzug pa'i thig le nyid/ /dbang phyug bde bar shes par bya/ /gnyis ka phyogs pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /bde ba chen po spyan drangs pas/ /rtog pa ②bde ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jug /rim pa gnyis med brda mjal chamachog /sku gsung thugs kyi thig le nyid/ /gnyis su med par thim ④par mdzad/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug pho mo kun/ /bde ba chen po mnyes par gyur/ /sangs rgyas gab tse rdo5)snying po la/ /ma lus bde ba'i rang bzhin ldan/ /thig le gnyis med bde ba'i ro/ /ye shes lnga ldan zag pa med/ /phyi nang gang ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid / /ma lus 'dus pa'i rang bzhin te/ /nyi zla 'dres pa'i gar thabs las/ /lhan cig skyes pa gsal bar 'gyur/ /sa ya 96)bcu gsum gnyis 'dus pa'i/ /thig le rdo rje'i rang bzhin nyid/ /gnyis med 'khril ba zhes bya ste/ /rang rig bde ba chen por thim/ /sangs rgyas rin chen de yi dbyig /kha sbyor snying po za ma tog /sku gsung thugs kyi pho brang las/ /ma lus thig le gnas par mtshud/ /sku gsung thugs kyi pho brang ni/ /bde ba chen po'i gnas nyid de/ /rdo rje snying po rtsa dang 'brel/ /gnyis med bde ba'i thig ler gnas/ /gsang ba'i thig le chen po ni/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i bcud nyid de/ /gsang ba yon tan rdzogs pa'i mdzod/ /snying po'i lam la gnas par bya/ / rdo rje nyi ma'i snying po la(ge/ /102—416

rdo rje zla ba'i 'od kyis brgyan/ /gnyis med thig les gang ba yi/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'char/ /brten las byung (1)ba'i rten can nyid/ /gang la gang gis mnyam sbyor ②bas/ / thabs chen (7thabs las byung ba yi/ /bde ba chen po 'bar bar 'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje khrag 'thung nyid/ /rang rang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /gdul bya'i ngo la dgongs mdzad de/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor snang bar mdzad/ /rdo rje rdo rje dril bu dang / /'jig rten 'khor yug bcas pa 'degs/ /de bzhin khor 4)yug bcas pa 'degs/ /de bzhin 'khor lo dgra sta dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ (5)rab tu 'khrol ba'o/ /nor bu rin chen rgyu zhags (5)dang / /rdo rje dgra sta rab tu rdebs5le/ /chags mchog pad+ma chen po dang —/ /dril bu rnga yi sgra sgrogs shepa'o/ /la sa ni ral gri gshol 5)chen dang / /'jig rten rgyang mar 'phen 9pa ste/ /bar ma rdo rje dung dmar yonya'akhrug /snyi ra chen por brdebs 7pa'o/ /btsun /gemo khrag 'thung chen mo yang / /'khril bas pad+ma rak+ta stobasatso/ /gnas dang yul gyi saphyag rgya ni/ /byis dbyug mda' gzhu rgyal mtshan dang / /byis snying rdo rje za rdeg tshul/ /byis snying dung dmar gyis rgyu dzodang / /mgo lus 'brel pa'i tshul du gnas/ /steng 'og phyi nang bsnol 7ba dang / /byis ldag khog pa dral zhing lta/ /rgyu mgo zhing khur rgyu tshonagri dang / /rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog nyugedang / /dril bu 'khrol pas slong bar byed/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogasaru no/ /bcu gnyis dang ni brgyad kyis mdzes/ /rang gi sta na dang lag cha dang / /ci bgyi sanazhes ni chas te gnas/ /kun kyang mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bcas/ /zhal 'dzum steg mig 'khril tshul can/ /dbu skra ral pa lcang 22lo bcings/ /sha da pa yi glu sa 102wa 417

len cing / /dmar la rdul ldem chags pa'i tshul/ /snam zhing che la rked pa phra/ /nu 'bur stod smad ①bye zhing 'gying / /dmar la klan zhing 'dud tshul can/ /gus dang steg pa'i ngang tshul 'chang / /so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ /srin mo smug nag thod rlon 'chang / /tshangs ma dmar ser pad+ma bsnams/ /lha chen dkar ⑧ljang tri shu ①la/ /gtogs 'dod sngon mo 'khor lo 'chang / /gzhon nu ④dmar mo mdung thung 'phen(5)/ /brgya byin dkar mo in+d+ra gdengs/ /rdo rje ser mo tsan+dan 6)'thung / /bdud rtsi dmar mo pad+ma bsnamasaX/ /zla ba dkar mo puṇ+ḍa dri(kyi/ /be con ljang gnag 6nyedabyug to ⑩'phyar/ /srin mo dmar mo dung khrag 'thung / /za ba ljang nag ba su 'dren/ /dga' ba dmar mo ka tar 'chang ske/ /stobs chen dkar mo gshol 'dzin ma/ /rdo rje ser mo spu gri gcod/ /'dod pa dmar mo mda' (/nyagazhu 'gengs7/ /nor srung spyodakar mo bum pa 'dzin / /rlung lha sngon mo ba dan 'phyar/ /gsod byed dkar mo ral gri so/ /me mo dmar mo gsal shing 8'chang / /phag mo nag mo mche 8zhags can/ /rgan byad ⑩dmar mo zhing chung za/ /sna tshogs dkar mo thod khrag 'thung / /chu lha dmar ser sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu 7'dzin/ /rdo rje ser mo ra mgo zhags/ /rdo rje dmar mo lcags sgrog sdom/ /rdo rje ljang gnag ()dril 'khrol timu'agying / /so so brjid pa'i stabs ldan pa'o/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ste/ /rnam par spro ba'i rgyas pa'i phyir/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs nyid dang / /yon tan phrin nyalas khro bo'i k+ṣ-i 7phyir/ /lnga bcu brgyad ldan bye brag lnga / /sngags dang phyag rgya'i ( geting 'dzin dang / /sku mdog bzhugs tshul rim pa dag /rigs ( snyernams ji ltar 'gyur ( )ba brtag( snye /de ltar bsams ( nyadang bris so 102—418

pa dang / /brjod dang mos pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /ji ltar 'tsham ①par bsgom par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan ②dgyes ③chen pos/ /rngam pa'i zhal gdangs duspyan zlog cing / /mche gtsigs phyogs bcur gom pa yis/ /'jigs pa'i stang stabs gar mdzad pas⑤/ /'jigs byed bcu ni rnam par 'phrul/ /oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra/gro gro gro gro kro gro gro kro gro gro/ dha dha dha dha dha dha dha dha dha dha/ hūm̐ kā dur bi dza ya/nī ⑦la daṇ+ḍa/ ya mān+ta ka /ār+ya byas tsa ⑨la/ ha ya spyi ba/ a pa rā dzi ⑩ta/a mṛ ⑩ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ tre+e lokya bi dza ya/ ma hā ba la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐ hūm̐ rtsu hūṃ hūm̐ rgyu / phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ 'di dag mngon ⑩du phyung ba yis/ /ri bo sa gzhi tso'agul byed cing / /rgya mtsho ma lus 'khrug pa dang —/ /sngags kyi sgra chen grag 8par 'gyur/ /hūṃ mdzad rnam rgyal 8dbyug sngon can / /gshed po mi g.yo yirta mgrin dang / / gzhan 'joms ⑩bdud rtsi khams gsum rgyal/ /stobs chen khro bo 'di dag gis/ /rang rang bgegs kun rnam par gzir/ /ma lus 'jigs shing 'joms par mdzad/ /gardza gardza/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ brnya brnya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha(shel/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da /)/ sbo ṭa sbo ṭa/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'di dag kyang //blo dang ldan pa'i 0rnal 'byor gyis/ /bskal sonyepa'i me ri nang rol du/ /bri tso'am bsam mam (snyedamigs bya ba/ /mthing ga ( nadakar po mthing nag dang / /ljang sngon dmar gnag 'dung ka lilngang / /dkar ljang dung dmar mdog tu snang —/ / khro mo so lus dang grib mar zhusheganas/ /'khor lo mṛ ( )mgo rdo rje stir/ /102—419

drang srong 'bar bar hu)bcas pa dang / /gshin rje'i rkang bzung zhing dbyug 'phyar / /ral gri bden bral (gyister dbyug gshog /ba dan brgyad thogs be ro nyidam/ /rin chen mṛ (semago gsum gyi dbyug /rdo rje rtse gsum mṛ ④mgo dang / /thong gshol gtun shing g.yas g.yon thogs/ /yang na zhal gsum ⑤phyag drug ste//blo ldan rnam par bsams nas ni/ /bgegs dang gdug pa (7rnam par 'jig /pho brang 'khor dang rnam par bsgomatshunye/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rang lus rten dang brten (shepa yi/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du gsal bar brtag(9) /lte ba snying ste sku gsung 7thugs/ /thig gis cha chen cha chung bcas/ /gnas bzhi dngas ma 'byung ba ste/ /khog pa dur (1khrod gzhal yas khang / /ka ba gdung dang rta babs dang / /bla bre rdo rje ra ba dang / /'khor lo dra ba dra phyed dang / /nyi zla skar khung rdzing bu dang / /bskyed 1 shing g.yas g.yon 'khor lo brtsegs/ /cod 1 pan nyi zla pad+mar bcas/ /rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i gzhal yas khang / /rang 'byung tsit+ta'i sa7'khor lo na/ /thig le ye shes lnga bdag nyid/ /ma lus thig le 'dus pa'i ros/ /cho 'phrul bstan dang snyigadug pa 'dul/ /so sor tso'akhor lo dgod pa yi/ /ting 'dzin rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom/ /'byung bzhi dngas ma yum nyid de/ /bde ba'i dngas ma nam mkha'i khams/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rang bzhin khams lnga'i rang bzhin bcud/ /zla ba nyi ma gnas pa yi/ /shrī ra tsit+ta'i thig 1 le la/ /nang gi gdug pa 'joms pa dang / /spyod yul bde bar sgyur (18ba dang / /thig le so sor dgod par nus/ /phye bas rim pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /bsdus 19pas thig le chen po nyid/ /thig le ye shes lngar ldan pa/ /thabs nyid dngas ma yum du bshad/ /rnam shes thig le 102—420

nyams myong nyid/ /tha mal 'joms pas khro mor snang / /gnas kyi thig le rtsar ①bcas pa/ /phra ②men nyid du shes par bya/ /gnas bzhi 'jug pa'i sgo nyid de① / /sgal tshigs la rten ④bde ba'i bcud/ /'phro zhi)zhing sdud pa dbang phyug ma / /gnas rten yibacu yi thig le la/ /'joms pa'i rang bzhin gsal bar byed / /nyams myong (7skye dang rnam pa med/ /spyod yul dag pas nang du bshad/ /zla ba nyi ma la brten (shete/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lam rgyud (9)de/ /thig le g.yo dang 'bar ⑩ba dang / /re dogs med dang rnam par dran/ /bde ba'i yan lag bzhi ru 'gyur/ /'khyud pa gar gyi phyag rgya bzhis/ /rdo rje snying po'i pad+mar 'brel / /bskyod ṅge rlung dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /nyi ma zla ba dus gcig ⑪'char / /de nyid kun du khyab pa las/ /ma lus lhan cig skyes par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po gnyis med pa/ /kha sbyar bsrub pa'i 4)thabs las skyes/ /thabs las byung ba'i gsang thig le/ /ma lus 'dus pa yinyebacud kyi ro/ /rten la brten 7can nyams myong ba/ /lhag pa'i ye shes thabs las skyes/ /chos dbyings la sogs ye shes lnga/ /thugs nyid mtshon phyir mtshan ma ste/ /gang la rten dang 'bar dang 'dzag /bde ba'i rlung dang nam mkha'i khams/ /de bzhin btsun mo dgyes skyed pa/ /mi phyed tsoganyis med lhan cig pa/ /gang de thabs las byung ba yi/ /dngos gnyis yul yidang dbang po'i tshogs/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i thig le nyid/ /ma lus bde bar rang snang ba/ /gnyis med 'dus pa'i stobs las byung / /gnas yul phyag rgya'i thig ler bstan/ /dgug dang 'khyud dang bsdam 3 dang 'bebs/ /ye shes 'jug pa'i sgo yin te/ /sgal tshigs brgyud pa /:thig le'i rgyun/ /dbang phyug mar ni shes par bya ba spu 102—421

thig le 'brel ①pa nyid/ /phra ②mo bsam mi khyab snang ba/ /grangs las 'das pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /bsam byas nam mkha'i zhing du sbyar/ /sku bzhi las byung gsang thig le/ /khams gsum bcud 'dus dubade chen po/ /yungs kur dulhung med brtan ①pa las/ /ma lus khyab pa'i tshul gyis snang / /thig le bde chen thabs sbyor dub/ /thob dang gom ⑦pa'i rang bzhin las/ /zhen pa'i 'du shes bral 'gyur bas/ /rang dbang med pa'i rtags 'byung ste/ /sbar zhing mnan pa'i cho ga bya/ /snang dang rig pa sna tshogs chos/ /bde ba chen po'i thig ler brten/ /nyi ma'i snying po lta ba ltar/ /bltas pas mthong ba med pa'i don//ma lus bde chen rgyan du snang / /de nas gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bshad/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /ji snyed ma lus chos bstan pa/ /rang 'byung ⑧ye shes chen po ste/ /de nyid dngos po sna tshogs mchog /ji snyed brtan ⑨g.yo snang ba'i chos/ /chen po rags yipa gnas pa'i chos/ /ma lus kun la mthun ⑪snang ba/ /rang 'byung yonyethabs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /de dag gdod nas tsom skyes pa'i / /rdo rje shes rab stong nyid de/ /gang yang dngos min ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab yum gyi rang bzhin no/ /ji snyed nam mkha'i mthar thug pa/ /rang 'byung tsobyang chub sems kyi gzugs/ /ma lus kun gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /dpag med mthun 7par snang ba ste/ /me long dang ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang 'brel ⑩pa bzhin/ /ma lus rig 7pa'i thig le las/ /ma lus sku yi dkyil 'khor snang / /ji snyed rab 'byam (nyam lus pa'i/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa dang / /zin dang ma zin gnyis ku'i sgra/ /nges pa dang ni ma nges pa'i/ /'khrul 6)dang ma 'khrul sna tshogs pa/ /brjod dang bsam dang 102—422

'phrul pa dang / /byin brlabs 6skumatha' yas rang snang ba/ /byang chub sems kyi gsung ②mchog ste/ /nam mkha'i sgra dang brag ca ②ltar/ /rang rgyud med pa'i rig pa nyid/ khasam pa mtha' yas ji snyed paraX/ /ma lus gsung gi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rang rgyud brtan po min par gnas/ /gang du nam mkha' mtha' ⑤klas par/ /bskal pa mtha' thug med pa'i bar/ /nam mkha'i char dang chu bur dang / /sprin dang chu rlabs phung po ltar⑥/ /ye shes bde dang sdug bsngal medang / /nges dang ma nges dam pa dang / /dman dang chags dang chags bral dang / /zin dang zhen dang ma zhen dang / /rnam pa rnam med brtags ⑧pa'i chos/ /dran rtog ⑨rig pa gang yang rung / /ma lus rig pa rang snang ⑩ba/ /snga ma dran pa'i rnam pa 'am/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i nyams myong ltar/ /sna tshogs snang yang rang rgyud min/ /gang yang rang rgyud kun bral ba'i/ /ma lus dkyil 'khor bshad pa rnams/ /rang rgyud med pas gzugs brnyan te/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 7'khor lhun gyis grub/ /rang 'byung skiye shes skye 'gag med/ /ma lus mi phyed rdo rje'i gzugs / /rnam pa mthar thug med pa nyid/ /yon tan lhun grub rang snang bas / /de yi brnyan ma rang bzhin 'char/ /mtha' bral rang 'byung hudakyil 'khor ni/ /cir yang snang la mi dmigs phyir/ /yang dag brtan par mi gnas pas/ /ma lus gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor shar/ /bde chen rang 'byung alhun grub nyid/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i nor bu ltar/ /dpag med chos su snang ba'i phyir/ /bde ba chen po'i gzugs brnyan te/ /skye bo dag dang ma dag pa'i/ /gdul bya mtho tsodaman rim pa la/ /rig spyad spro ba bskyed ⑩pa'i 102—423

phyir / /dang po nas bzung mthar thug par/ /rang rang bsam pa de bzhin du/ /de dag ngo la de ltar snang / /gzugs brnyan phyi yi rim pa ste/ /thun mong yul du gyur phyir ro/ /ma lus tha dad med pa yi/ /phyi nang snod bcud rdzogs pa'i lus / /bcud ldan bde ba mdzad pa'i gnas4)/ /mi shigs thig le kun gyi dngos / /rang 'byung (gebade ba chen po'i gzugs/ /dngas snyigs 'brel pa'i nus mthu las/ /zag pa yod dang med pa yi/ /dngos po gnyis kyi chos ①su snang / /rgyu yi thig le'i rang bzhin la/ /nus pa'i khyad par so so yis/ /'byung ba dang ni yum nyid dang / /bde ba chen po la sogs pa/ /thig le nus pa'i stobs las snang / /ma lus 'khor lo'i snying po nyid/ /thig le 'bar ba bde ba'i gzugs/ /rtsa yig (41bye brag bcas pa ni/ /bcud 'dus thig le (snyeros gang ba/ /ma lus rten (67can dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ma lus snod bcud kun du snang / /thabs chen gsang ba'i rim pa nyid/ /khams bzhi las brten thig le nyid/ /g.yo dang 'dzag cing gnas dang thim/ /bye brag gsum las rgyud ⑦pa yis / /gru dang sgyu ma'i 'khrul chu la/ /zhugs dang 'thungs (kyepa'i spyod yul lam / /me long (97dang ba'i ri bo yi/ /rtser phyin ma lus bltas pa ltar/ /bde chen 7gzugs brnyan nyid du snang / /rim pa bzhi yi thig le nyid/ /bde ba'i 'du byed gang bskul ba/ /gnas bzhi'i thig le'i bye brag gsal/ /mu tig phreng ba brgyus 11pa ltar/ /'dzag 32dang 'bar ba'i thig le nyid/ /til 'bru 'bras bu smin pa ltar/ /ma lus til gyi phung po ltar/ /thig le'i lus su gnas pa yin/ /nyams myong gsal bar 'bar ba'i tshe/ /'dar dang rngul dang ba spu ldang / /'phar dang sgra 'byin dpa' bo'i gar/ /rnam par rol pa'i tshogs su 102—424

snang / /snang srid bde ba chen po nyid/ /tha mal nub cing brtan ①gyur na/ /thig le nam mkha'i stobs kyis sbyang / /rtse gcig nam mkha'i mthong stobs kyis/ /thig le stong par thim pa na/ /ye shes nam mkha'i gzugs su nges/ /snang srid snod bcud ma lus kun/ /bde chen rig pa'i gzugs brnyan du/ /rgya mtsho mjings ②nas bltas ②pa ltar/ /ma lus de ltar snang ba yin/ /rig pas nyams su myong ba dang / /spyod yul dag pas nang du bshad/ /rang 'byung dubade ba chen po nyid/ /gsang ba'i gang zag gdul ba dang / /gsang ba'i nyams myong mngon bstan phyir/ /⑤thabs dang shes rab 'dus pa yiX/ /cho ga'i bya ba kun ldan cing / /dbang bskur byin brlabs sbyang ba ⑦dang / /brgya phrag gsum dang drug cu dang / /drug cu rtsa bzhi rdzogs pa yis/ /chu skyes snying po rdo rje can/ /nyi ma me shel 'od 'byung ba/ /rang 'byung nirlung gi phyag rgyas bskyod/ /nor bu chu 'dzag rang dbang med/ /ma lus rig pa'i thig ler bsdus / /rgyu ba'i rlung ni chad pa na/ /rig pa stong pa'i thig ler thim sa ta la rten 6)thig le'i tsorim/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i rang bzhin las/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das par snang / /gsang ba'i thig le la rten tunapas/ /ma lus bde chen 'khor lo sgyuratso/ /lus kyi thig le dang por te/ /de nas rig pa'i thig le yin / /de nas ye shes thig le nyid/ /tha ma chos nyid thig ler thim/ /de nas dus gsum 'du 'bral med/ /bde chen nam mkha'i khams nyid de/ /zab cing rgyu ba med pa yi/ /rang rgyud zhen yinachags kun bral ba'i/ /bde ba chen po'i gzugs brnyan shar/ /ma rtogs khyab pa'i gzugs brnyan te/ / rtogs pas skinyams myong gzugs brnyan 7nyid/ /mthar phyin ye shes gzugs brnyan 'di/ /102—425

dman dang yan lag ma tshang dang / /dbang dang man ngag med pa dang / /dka' thub ①can dang ma smin ②dang / /skal med yal ba'i yul min pas/ /gsang ba'i gsang chen dam pa nyid/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /lhag pa gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor nyid/ / tha mal brod ①pa bskyed 0pa'i phyir/ / cho ga rgyas ①par bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rtogs 'od yikyang / /ji bzhin mngon du ma gyur la/ /lhag par 'di yis rtogs 'gyur bsaphya/ /lhag pa zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /gang gis gang la gang mtshon pas/ /lhag par mtshon par ninye ba dang / /gang la brten ①te gang bsgrubs pa/ /lhag par myur du 'grub pa'i phyir/ /'dis ni lhag pa nyid du brjod/ /gang las gang de thabs 'di yis/ /mngon par lhag pas lhag pa'o/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs / /thabs de ⑩gang gis mngon ston cing / /dngos yigazhi nyid 8ma yin pa'i phyir/ /gzugs brnyan (nyanyid du bstan pa yin/ /gang la brten pa'i thabs nyid kyis/ /de nyid 'dra bar snang ba ltar/ /ma mthong mos pa'i gdul ⑫bya 7la/ /de dang 'dra ba'i thabs nyid de/ /dngos min 'dra phyir gzugs brnyan no/ /rgyal ba kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /dpag med ye shes lhun rdzogs pa'i / /ye shes rang 'byung lnga yi yigazugs/ /zag med gdul bya'i ngo la snang —/ /de yi yon tan gzugs brnyan (1gyis/ /zag bcas mos pa'i gang zeg la / /sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa nyid/ /'dra bar mtshon phyir gzugs brnyan (nyano / /gang phyir chos dbyings ngo bo la/ /tha dad dbye ba mi gnas kyang / /mos dang drag po'i dbang gyur te/ /gang gis gang de mi 'dul /)bas/ /thugs rjes kun la khyab pa'i phyir/ /longs spyod sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ /zhen pa 102—426

can dang nga rgyal can/ /thabs dang drag pos tshar bcad ①phyir/ /de ltar so sor 'tsham pa ste/ /lhag pa gzugs brnyan ②gnyis su bshad/ /gang du bkra shis yid 'ong ba'i/ /steng 'og phyogs bzhi bar mtshams dag /legs pas yid 'ong bar chad med/ /phyi nang ri bo chadagon pa'i mchog /rang gi sa gzhi rjolegs brtags ⑤la/ /pra dang nyams kyis ༷ltas brtags la④/ /ma dag mtshan ngan spang ⑧byas la/ /dag cing nyams dga' blang bar bya/ /sa gzhi ⑨byin brlabs bkra shis pa/ /gal te rtsod pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /snang dang mi snang bdag po la/ /mgu bas bar chad med par bslang / /gang de dbang du bya ba'i phyir / /cho ga'i yan lag tikun brtsams 7te/ /mchod dang mnyes pas tshim ⑫byas la/ /sa gzhi tshubadag gis 8dbang du bya/ /thun mong skyon bsal byadag byas nas/ /mi dmigs chos la blo sbyangs shing / /dngos grub myur zhing nyams dga' ba'i/ /phyi nang dag pa chen por sbyang / /rang bzhin byin brlabs kun gyi dngos/ /gdod nas ma bcos gnas pa la/ /lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med pas/ /lha dang gzhal yas ngo bor brlabatso/ /gang de'i bar chad bsrung ⑩ba'i phyir/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ /rdo rje khro bo'i 'khor lo spro / /hūm̐ bzhi sngags dang bcas pas bsrung / /de dag legs par gzung 8ba'i phyir / /ma dag pa ni mtshams bcad de/ /las kyi bya ba kun rdzogs nas/ /rgyal ba kun la gsol btab la/ /'dod pa'i don rnams grub pa'i b.rayi/ /dngos grub gter du ming gis gzung / /gang phyir bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /ma dag pa dang ngan pa dag /rtogs dang ting 'dzin cho ga yis/ /mnyam pas re dogs med par gnas/ /dkyil 'khor phyi nang bshad pa bzhin/ /tshad ni rjes 102—427

su mthun 6)pa ste/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /yang na sor bzhi tshad du ste/ /yang na mdzub ②gang tshad du bya/ /yang na lus gang tshad du ste/ /yang na lus ni gsum bzhi nyid/ /yang na bcwa ①brgyad nyid du'am/ /nyi shu lnga yi tshad du bya/ /yang na rgyang grags dpag tshad de/ /rang gi rig pa rjes mthun ④par / /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa'i (5)tshad/ /tshad (6)dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor te(pe/ /yid 'ong byug bdug nyi shu lngas/ /mdzes shing legs par byas nas ni/ /gang dang 'brel pa'i cho ga brtsam(kye/ /gzhan du longs spyod ma byas pa'i/ /ras bal dur (9)khrod rgyu las byas/ /gsar zhing grims la 'jur mdud med/ /byin brlabs belnga dang sku gsung thugs/ /thim pas ye shes thig skud de/ /rig pas thig ni gdab par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab tunyaganyis med pa'i / /gsang ba'i 'phro 'du de bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor yid 'ong pho kyibrang sa / /ma nor gsal bas thig tu bshad/ /gang gis gang mtshon de bzhin te/ /kha dog lnga dang phung po dang / /khams dang skye mched rnam shes sogs(ge/ /ye shes dkyil 7'khor mtshon phyir ro/ /rtogs pas 'khor ba'i rgya dral phyir/ /tshon 7zhes kyang ni brjod pa nyid/ /ma mthong rmongs la ston phyir tshon7/ /kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga 'am/ / lnga yi nye tshon gyis bri yi bar bya/ /gser dang dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya 1rto/ /pad+ma in+d+ra nī )la nyid/ /rin chen lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /mkhes pas 'byor ldan ci bder bri/ /yang na 'bras dang sā ( 7lu la/ /kha dog bsgyur bas de bzhin no/ /dman dang 'byor pa chung ba yis/ /'byung khungs lnga yis bri bar bya/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rgyal ba bcu nyid thim pa yis / /ye shes rin chen phyi nang med/ /dag pa'i ngo bor blta bar bya/ /oṃ i 6ge102—428

rgyu swā hādhi/ sarba pañtsa rat+na sa ma ye hūm̐/ /'bru bcu spung zhing 'bun ②pa yi/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab ci/ /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /ye shes rin chen rtsig ④pa ste/ /dra ba dra phyed rta babs dang / /rdo rje zla phyed 'dod yon dang / /rin chen sa gzhi (5)skyed shing dang / /rdzing bu dril bu g.yer khas 0spras/ /rtag tu bri zhing bsgom par bya/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thod pa sna lnga sna gsum dang / /thod skam rtsig (7)pa'i rim pa bzhin//tshangs dang lha dbang la brten pa/ /mchog chen brgyad ni yin par 'dod/ /lhag ma rnams kyis thog phub ste/ /gza' brgyad nyi zla'i glo (0skar ldan/ /sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng ba nyid/ /dra ba dra phyed rnam par spras/ /phyi nang rgyu 'bras gdug pa dag /gdul phyir hunyerta babs bzhir bshad de/ /sor phreng ⑩thod pa'i phreng ba dang / /dbang po nyi zla'i phreng bas spras/ /khro mo sha lnga bdud rtsi dang / /dur khrod 'dod yon ldan 6nyapa'o/ /dur khrod sa gzhi tshogekhrag dang bcas/ /skyes bu gsal shing phyogs mtshams brgyad/ /rak+ta'i mtsho brgyad rba rlabs 'khyil/ /thod tshal brgyus pa dur khrod rlung / /'jigs pa'i sgra dang me 'od ldan/ /zhing 'phan tu phyogs mtshams brgyad dang bcas/ /lha chen thod pa sbub stengs yin/ /tsit+ta'i 'otog las 'od zer 'phro/ /he ru ka yi gludakyil 'khor nyid/ /ma lus bri zhing bsgom par bya/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong bas/ /rin chen phreng thi dang rgyan du ldan/ /mi 'jigs stobs sogs kun ldan pas/ /stobs ldan theg par gnas pa yin/ /spyod la /sheskyon gyis ma gos pas/ /pad+ma 'bar bas nyugemadzes par snang / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /nyi zla mdzes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /bde chen don las mi 'da' bas/ /'khril sbyor dgyes pa'i tshul 102wa 429

du bzhugs/ /sku gsung yon tan phrin yo)las thugs/ /yongs rdzogs sku yi ②rgyan dudu gnas/ /lam dang byang chub yan lag rnams/ /rdzogs phyir phreng ba la ④sogs tshul/ /thugs rje 'khor ba mi gtong bas/ /chu srin klu phrug bzung ba bzhin / /thugs rje bar chad mi mnga' bas/ /'brel pa bar chad med par gnas / /brtson 'grus 'khor ba spong ba'i phyir/ /ri dgas dag ni mnyam par ⑤gnas / /zag med spyan gyis kun gzigs pas/ /dge sdig spyan gyis gzigs par bstan/ /ma lus zil gnon stobs rdzogs phyir/ /bya khyung dag ni gnas par bstan⑥/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ༷byas shing / /nyon mongs tshad pa'i gdung sel bas/ /thugs rje gdugs kyi (nya'akhor lo bstan/ /ma lus gcig 6)tu 'dus pas na/ /tog stong 'od zer 'bar ba ste/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa'i don phyir bstan/ /lha rnams so so'i rnam pa ni/ /sku mdog sna tshogs bzhugs tshul dang / /gdan dang phyag mtshan rgyan du bcas/ /pho mo'i tshul dang bcas pa rnams/ /de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa dang / /gdul bya gzigs pa'i tshul nyid kyis/ /gtso 'khor phyi nang lta tshul gyis/ /bzhugs thabs rim pa so sor bstan / /rang rang snying po gang yin pa/ /kha dog so sor phye nas ni/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir7/ /rim pa bzhin du gsal bar bya rang rang thugs mtshan gang yin pa/ /kha dog dbyibs dang bcas pa nyid/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir/ /rim pa ji bzhin dgod par (nyabya/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor yang / /dung chen ras chen la sogs pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 7'khor lo nyid/ /rim pa bzhin du gsal bar dgod/ /de bzhin nyid la dmigs med de/ /stong zhing mi dmigs rig pa nyid/ /gang la 102—430

rtog dpyod ①mi gnas pa/ /chos dbyings de bzhin nyid du bsgom/ /bden gnyis dbyer med mnyam pa nyid/ /ye nas khyab ②myang ma rtogs pas/ /phyogs med snying rje nam mkha' ltar/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bsgom par bya rang 'byung ①ye shes rnam pas ni/ /yig 'bru rnam pa gsal ba las/ /zhen 'dzin sbyangs nas yig 'bru yi/ /'phro 'dus 'byung lnga rim gyis ④bskyed/ /phroṃ gyis duganyis med 'od sbyangs yinas/ /gzhal yas khang ltar yin par bsgomaX/ /rnam pa'i gang yin de dag dang / /rang rig sa bon gnyis med las/ /'dres pas gang yin gtso bo nyid/ /bskyed cing dbang bskur byin brlabs nas/ /'khor yang mi phyed 'dres par bsgom/ /yongs rdzogs smin cing rtas pa la(nya dzaḥhūṃ ⑨ hos gnyis med de/ /'dod pa mthar thug bar du bsam/ /las kyi bya ba kun zin nas/ /thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs dang / /kun bzang mchod pa la sogs pa/ /lha mo brgyad dang bcu drug gis/ /mchod kyipa'i rim pa brtsam 47par bya/ /rin chen sna lnga ()rta glang dang / /'bru dang bang mdzod khang khyim dang / /bu dang chung ma bran khol dang / /gnas dang zhing dang na bza' dang / /rgyan phreng bza' 4)btung longs spyod dang / /rdzing dang chu mig 'bab chu dang / /mtshe'u dang khron pa lu ma dang / /ri dang de'u dang skyed yimos tshal8/ /kho ra yug dang lhun po tsodang / /skye bo mang po bro glu 4 dang / /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa yi/nye/ /mchod pa sna tshogs rgyas par mchod/ /dpa' bo sha lnga bdud rtsi tu)lnga/ /bcud dang rol mo snang ba dang / /sna tshogs dri dang byug pa mchog /dag cing legs par dbul ( )bar bya/ /thar ba la sogs zhing gi mchog /dngos dang lta spyod ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsgrub zhunyabya ma lus kun bsgral ( ge102—431

te / /rdo rje zhing du bskyed par bya/ /lha mo mi mo rig pa mo/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba rang rtog bzhin/ /dngos dang ting 'dzin sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba chen po rol mo yis/ /phyi nang nam yo)mkha'i khams bkang ste/ /rin chen lha mo yo byad dang //reg pa nyams myong phyibade ba yis/ /rgyal sras zhing gi rdul snyed la/ /gnyis med dag pa'i tshul gyis mchod/ /rol mo glu dbyangs bcas pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bstod par bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi (7bzlas pa yis/ /mtshan ma legs par snang ba na/ /sbyang dang byin brlabs dbang bskur ④dang / /mchod dang brtan (5)pa'i cho ga dag /rtog pa'i cho ga rgyas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyogs bzhi ru(6)/ /rnam bzhi las kyi me thab ⑦la/ /dus bzhir rang rang rdzas dag gis/ /lha bzhi tshul gyis mchod par bya/ /de nas gnang thob dbang phyug (kyinyid / /dkyil 'khor zhugs shing nus ldan nas/ /thugs rjes 'khor ba bsgral ba'i phyir/ /skal ldan slob ma gzhug par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi79)ske/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo che/ /mngon du mthong zhugs bsod nams gang / /'dir zhugs pa nyid de bzhin no/ /gang du sku gsung thugs ldan pa/ /gang du mos pas spro bskyed phyir/ /rgyal ba kun kyang 'phrul mdzad de/ /sgo gsum byin gyis rlob par mdzad/ /rnal 'byor cho ga rdzogs pas kyang / /gdul bya zhi dang khro 7ba la/ /so so'i mtshan ma nyid bstan phyir/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa dag(11 /bris dang brdungs tu dang blugs pa dag /so so'i gnas su legs par dgramanyan/ /ma lus sku gsung thugs dkyil 'khor/ /'di las ma gtogs skalha gzhan med/ /gang du dbang dang 'brel ba niski/ /bco yilnga'i rim pas byin brlab yo 7phyir/ /bzhi dang brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /yab 102—432

yum bcwa ①brgyad gnas par bya/ /bcu gnyis bcu drug dkyil 'khor la/ /bzhi bcu gnyis dang ldan par bya/ /nyi shu'am nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga rim par dgod/ /'di dag lugs dang 'bur dang bzo/ /bri dang bsgom pa dag kyang rung / /'di ni phyi yi (snyedakyil 'khor ro/ /zab mo'i dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /thun ②mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sor bzhi mdzub gang la ④brten (5)te/ /phyi rol rnam pa'i rjes 'brang min/ /mthong dang brtan (7dang goms pa ni/ /rim pa bzhin du gsal bas 'byung / /brgyud (7pa lam gyi rim pa yis/ /mthar phyin nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /dbang bskur thabs kyi rim pa yis/ /byin brlabs man ngag yid ches bya/ /'di ni dbang gi dkyil 'khor te/ /de bzhin gnas skabs gzhan du yang / /thun mong tshogs la sbyar ba'i phyir/ /'byung lnga rgyu dang bdag nyid dang / /mkha' dag byin brlabs so sor gdon/ /rang gi cho ga'i sbyor ba yis/ /ji ltar brtsams pa 'grub ri par 'gyur / /bsod nams tshogs zhes bya bar bshad/ /gzhan yang stobs ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /gang 'dod mngon du bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'chi med tshe yi 5)dkyil 'khor dang / /mtshan ma pra yi 57dkyil 'khor dang / /dug 'joms bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dang / /cho 'phrul ro langs la sogs pa/ /gang bsgrub don phyir gang bshad pa/ /de nyid bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /las bzhi lha yi tsho17rnal 'byor gyis/ /rigs dang mthun 1 pa'i sa gzhi 12la/ /thab khung so so'i mtshan ma can/ /phrin skolas dkyil 'khor nyid du bshad/ /slob dpon nus pa stobs ldan pas/ /rdo rje lus su brtan bya'i phyir/ /rgyang grags dpag tshad la sogs pa/ /sku gsung thugs su mngon gsal ba/ /rnal 'byor 102—433

skal ldan spyod yul te①/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid du bshad/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /mtshan ma rtog ②pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /mthong bya don la sgrib pas na/ /de dag sbyang ba'i cho ga bshad/ /tha mal zhen pas brtags pa'i don/ /lhag pa'i bden gnyis rtogs bsgoms pas/ /phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang du bsregadu /dkyil 'khor lha yi dumatshan ma dag /rnam pa ji snyed gnas pa dag /rang rig rnam par 'phrul pa nyid/ /mtshan ma thig le'i ngang du sbyangs⑤/ /thig le rim pa'i snang tshul te/ /phyi nang med pa'i byang chub sems/ /dngos dang dngos med kun sbyangs te/ /rang rig byang chub sems kyi me(6)/ /phyogs bcur 'bar zhing dbyings la sdud/ /rnal 'byor las rung goms pa yis/ /gzhan don rtsom pa'i don byed na/ /dang por nyes byas gsum sbyang phyir/ /rnam gsum khrus kyi rim pa brtsamacha/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /bar chad bgegs dang dbral ⑧byas la / /bkug bcings bstims (9)la rnal du gzhag /bsrung dang byug bdug ⑩rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'khor ba'i sa bon kun bkod de/ / las kyi cho ga thim pa dang —/ /(1dkyil 'khor 'phro 'du rim pa yis/ /'khor ba'i sa bon sbyang bar bya / /de tshe sdong bu gnas bkod de/ /sdong bu re la lha rnams kyi/ /snying po tshang bar gdags pa dang / /gsol gdab snyiganang byin sras su bskyed/ ri /'jug dang dbang bskur las rdzogs nas/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin te/ /las bzhi me yi lhonyalas byas nas/ /rtog tshogs lha gsum dbyer med pa'i/ /rang rang gnas su dag pa la/ /sbyin sreg glu gro 'gar gyis mchod/ /las kyi bya ba kun zin nas/ /thig le chen po ngang tshil bsdu / /de nas gzhan yang 102—434

bshad bya ba/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /ma lus byang chub sems nyid de/ /de rtogs bya phyir bshad par bya/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad dang ske/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus thams cad kun/ /tha dad dbye ba mi gnas te/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rang 'byung mtho ①dman med pa yizhu/ /sku gsung thugs dang lus ngag yid/ /ma lus gzhi durtsa snying po ste/ /rang 'byung ④byang chub sems la 'dus/ /de nyid rang rig 'od gsal ba/ /dngos po ma yin dngos med minaX/ /gnyis ka ma yin gnyis med min/ /mtha' dbus cha shas kun bral ba'i/ /zab cing yangs la rgya che ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul te/ /rtog ge rnams kyi yul min pas/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba byang chub sems/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid las skye ba med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gag pa med las thams cad 'gag /'gag pa nyid na du'agag pa med/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar med kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ske/ /gnas pa med las thams cad gnas/ /gnas pa nyid la gnas pa med / /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang //dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs/ /dmigs pa nyid na dmigs pa med//e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong / /'gro 'ong nyid na (7)'gro 'ong med/ /ma skyes rig pa'i byang chub sems/ /dngos med dngos po'i rang bzhin du/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid/ /g.yo dang mi g.yor bcas pa yini/ /phyi nang snod 102—435

bcud ma lus la6)/ /rang 'byung (misems kyi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rang bzhin gnas dang rtogs pa dang / /bsams chadang dmigs dang goms pa yi sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan ma dang / /lha dang lha min gsang ba dang / /sha za 'byung po mi 'am ci/ /grul bum yi dgas klu ④rnams dang / /rgyu ba'i srogs (snyechags ma lus dang / /rtsa shing gel pa 'bras bu dang / /phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa/ /ma bcos (ne'edon gyi lha nyid de/ /byang chub sems su khyad ⑦par med/ /lha zhes gzhan du bstan pa yang 98)/ /tshig gi tha snyad tsam du zad⑨/ /byang chub sems la gnyis med par/ /rtogs pa'i don la gcig 7tu bstan/ /snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gang / /gnas pa'i don dang ma phrad pas/ /ma lus snying rje'i gnas gyur pa/ /snying rje byang chub sems yin te/ /mi 'gal don (1du rab sbyor ba/ /kun rdzob 12byang chub sems su brjodayonya/ /ji snyed rnam par bcas pa'i chos/ /ma lus mtha' yas bstan pa kun/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam 'phrul te / /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs snang bzhin dngos po med/ /de dag ji ltar gnas kyang rung / /byang chub sems las gzhan min yang / /thun mong yul phyir phyi ru bshad/ /rang lus phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rang 'byung tsha'akhor lo drug gnas pa/ /g.yo ba yo gis skyod (7byed pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi lus la gnas/ /'phen dang sdud pa'i rang bzhin can/ /snyigs ma'i dus su'ang bde ba 'char/ /smin pa gru gsum smad na gnas/ /rnam thar sku gsum rtsa mdud lacan/ /'bar zhing thig le 'bebs dang gnas/ /rang lus bde chen smin byed pa/ /de la gang rten 1 bde ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas rin chen gab tse 1 la/ /thung ngu a snying lte bar gnas/ /'khrul zhing 'dzag dang gnas 102—436

pa'i rtsa/ /rdo rje dbu ma'i lam dang 'brel/ /khyab cing rgyas pa'i snying po can/ /sum cu ①gnyis gnyis rtsa yig ldan/ /dharma ⑤tsakra snying po'i gnas/ /rtsa bzhi yan lag brgyad kyi dngos/ /dngas snyigs shes pa brgyad kyi rten/ /rgyu ba bzhi yis shes par bya/ /dngas ma 'dus pa'i thig le nyid/ /a la brten pa'i hūṃ gis sdud①/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /bde ba mngon shes chos nyid la / /rim pas mthar phyin ④'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcu drug sgra sbyor thig le can / /'dab ma ā ⑤li ldan pa yis/ /ma lus sgra skad bdag nyid can/ /khyab pa gsung gi bdag nyid can/ /sde tshan bcu dang ldan pa nyid/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa'i lam yin te/ /thabs dang shes rab bskul ba yis bde ba 'byung 'gyur the tshom 6)med/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor na/ /thig le de yi mnyam ⑦pa'i dbyings/ /ma lus 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cing (kye/ /lus can kun la khyab par gnas/ /kun gyi dngos yin kun gyi gtso8/ /ma lus kun 'dus gnyis su med/ /spyi gtsug ⑩'dus pa'i snying po nas/ /rkang mthil ⑨gsang ba'i gnas yan chad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ka 8bas bzung ⑫/ /snod bcud rgyud rnams rang bzhin bcud/ /dngas snyigs 'dres pa thabs kyis 'byed / /g.yo ldang smon 'jug gnas mthar phyin/ /skad cig rim pa skye 'gyur ba / /khams lnga 'dus pa'i ro yi stobs/ /sems lnga rim pas shes par 'gyur/ /'di nyid gsum du bshad pa ste/ /skabs kyi rim pas sbyar ba nyid/ /rtsa dang thig le bde ba yis/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul du bshad/ /de nas rgyal rigs rje 'arigs dang / /bram ze gdol pa gar mkhan ma/ /yid 'ong na tshod dar la bab / /nus dang chags pa che ba dang / /bka' blo bde zhing yid mi 'khrug /102—437

lus ran sha mdangs dkar dmar phyed/ /skad snyan dran pas yid 'phrog ma/ /bcwa ①brgyad bcu drug bcu bzhi dang / /bcu gnyis ldan pa'i bu mo la/ /sbyor ba tshang zhing rtags byung nas/ /tha mal spangs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa ya ②bcu gsum gnyis ldan ③pa'i/ /gsang dbang 'dus pa'i khams lnga las/ /gser 'gyur sman dang mun sel ltar/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /nyi ma zla spyab rtse phrad pa'ibya/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i rtse 'khor lo/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa rlung dang 'grogs/ /ldang bas tha mal shes pa 'gag /g.yo bas nyams ⑤nyid rtse gcig ⑥pa/ /smon pas yid gcig ⑦'dres pa ste/ /'jug pa dzaḥs rba hoḥste/ /shes pa bde bar 'jug pa nyid/ /gnas pas yun ring gnas pa ste/ /mthar phyin 'dres pa'i gar thabs kyis/ /brjod bral thig le'i bstan pa mtsharani/ /tha mal zhen pa nub gyur nas/ /zhen pa ldog cing rig pa thim / /rnam shes brgyal 6)ba la sogs 'byung / /yid 'ong gzi ldan phyag rgya ma/ /mthong bas lus sems bde ba dang / /phrad pas sdug bsngal nyams par 'gyur/ /'dris ⑩pas bde ba brtan po 'byung / /thabs dang ldan pas spyad gyur na/ /bskal ⑩par sbyangs pas mi 'byongs pa'i/ /rnam rtog zhen pa log gyur nas/ /da lta bde ba chen por smin/ /thob pa brtan 'dod rnal 'byor pas/ /mthong dang thos dang lhan cig gnas/ /'khyud dang phrad tsodang spyad pa yis/ spya/lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye/ /dbang dang mi ldan skal ngan dang / /dman pas mi rtogs yul min pas/ /gsang ba zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rim pa'i ting 'dzin mthar phyin nas/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs ldan pa'i/ /tshom bu gsum par ldan pa yi/ /sum cu'i (nyadakyil 'khor 102—438

bsgom ①par bya/ /gang du rgyas pa'i dbang gyur la/ /rigs lnga ye shes lngar ldan cing / /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan las/ /bdun cu'i ②rim pa bsgom ①par bya/ /mos chung gsang bar spyod 'dod pas/ /tshom bu gcig dupa'i dkyil 'khor te/ /bcu 'am yang na bcwa ⑤brgyad pa'i/ /tshom bu tha ma bsgom par bya/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor kun 'dus pa'i/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bsgom ⑥par bya/ /gang du gdug pa 'dul ba yi7/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa de bzhin teni/ /rim pa bsgyur ba'i khro bo ni/ /rim pa ma 'dres tsam du bsgom/ /rnal 'byor yo byad tshogs pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin spyod tshogs pa/ /ma lus tshogs pas tshogs zhes bya/ /dang por dad dang brtson 'grus dang / /dam tshig lta sogs sngon song zhing / /rim bzhin ting 'dzin mthar phyin pas/ /nus pa yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /skal ldan drod tshad mnyam yo)pa 'am/ /mi ldan 'phro 'dus ⑩sbyangs pas 'grubatso/ /rab tu dben zhing yid 'ong ba/ /ri rtse gsang 'dab chu gling ngam/ /dur khrod ri 'or 8nags 'dab stetunye/ /skye bo 'dus dang rnam bral zhing glu/ /bar chad bral ba'i sa phyogs der/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po ④lta bu'i phyir/ /rin chen yid 'ong mdzes brgyan snyipa'i/ /'khor khang phyi nang bar ldan pa/ /'chag tsosar bcas par brtsam yonapar bya/ /rnal 'byor pho mo grangs mnyam pa/ /lta spyod ting 'dzin dam tshig tshang / /bro gar 'du 'phro (nyayo byad dang / /glu ⑪tshig sgra yi yo byad dang / /bza' dang btung ba'i yo byad dang / /rgyan dang bgo ba'i yo ( kye byad dang / /ā li kā (nyali mnyam sbyar zhing / /nyi zla brtsegs pa'i ngo bor bzhugs/ /lha dang mi dang yo byad dang / /gnas dang spyod pa kun tshogs pas/ /de dag tshogs su (nyebashad pa yin/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel 102—439

gyur nas/ /yab yum gsal ba'i ting 'dzin la/ /mtha' thug med pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /nam mkha'i char bzhin kun bkug 6)la/ /yab yum gnyis med 'dres pa la/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs rgyan ②btags te/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga dang / /bza' btung lha la lha rol zhing / /'od kyis ma lus tshim pa dang ske/ /'gro mang (kyebade ba thob par bya/ /bro lnga gar lnga stabs tshig lnga/ /bro gar rtse 'jo brjod pa yis/ /rigs kyi 'od zer 'phro 'dur gsal/ /'gro ba'i phyi nang mun bsal ④te/ /rig (nya'adzin sa nas sa ru sbyang / /glu khyilnga tshig lnga rigs lnga yis/ /phyogs phyogs bltas te brjod pa ni/ /'gro ba kun gyis bde thob cing / /chos kyi dung chen sgra yang sgrogs / /phyi nang rgyan gyi ⑧gro byad ni/ /rin chen ze'u prog 6)rna cha tsodang / /lag gdub rkang gdub mgul do tunyedang —/ /na bza' rgyan gyis gang brgyan (9pas/ /yid 'ong ting 'dzin gsal ba dang —/ /'gro bas blta yi ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ /rlung dang nus pa'i stobs ldan zhing —/ /sgo gsum bag chags zad 'gyur te/ /byin brlabs ⑩rlung la dbang thob pas/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyar ba/ /bcu drug rdzogs pa'i dus sbyar bas/ /bdag po gdung can phrad pa'i tshe/ /nyi zla dus gcig shar ba'i tshe/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /spyod yul nus pa kun bzlog nas/ /mthong lam rang gi mtshan nyid skye/ /zla ba'am zla phyed dus mtshams sogs/ /bde chen nyams myong rgyun mi 'chad/ /mthong ba'i don la mnyam bzhag 8pas/ /brtan zhing nges pas gdeng du gyur/ /sku ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ /bde chen zag med ting nge 'dzin/ /bskal pa brgya phrag stong du yang / /bde ba chen po yirgyun mi 'chad//sprul pa'i longs spyod mdzad pa yis/ /'jig rten khams mang 'gro ba dgatu) /102wa 440

de tshe 'gro ba'i dbyings su sbyor/ /rdo rje lus thob de phyin cad①/ /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung yin/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyis/ /ye shes thig le de nyid la/ /ye shes thig le nyid snang ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /gang zag rim par 'jug pa rnams/ /dang por dngos don mthong ba yis /tshe 'dis las la bgrod bya zhing / /bsam byas lhun grub nyid thob phyir/ /lta spyod ting 'dzin rim 'brel ③bas/ /bar chad med pa'i lam la 'bad/ /gnas skabs rim pa ji snyed kyang / /tha mal pa dang log spyod dang / /mos pa la ④sogs yul min te⑤/ /nus dang grub pa thob pa yis/ /gsang ba lam dang 'brel par bya/ /rnal 'byor chen po lnga la gnas/ /rim nas rim par brtan gyur te/ /gsal ldan mi g.yo thob pa la/ /nyam nga med pa'i stobs ldan pas/ /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin te/ /spyod pa so so gnas pa yis/ /rtsa ba spros bcas rnal 'byor te/ /bsgrub ⑥pa dus kyi tshogs la gnas/ /yan lag tshogs kyi spyod par gsungs/ /gang phyir dkyil 'khor nges bstan pa/ /rang rig mtha' dbus med pa dkyil/ /ye shes bzhi 'phros 'khor lo'i tshul/ /'jig rten 'das pa dkyil nyid de/ /'jig rten sna tshogs (pe'akhor du bshad/ /rig pa'i don nyid dkyil nyid de/ /cho 'phrul rang 'byung (kye'akhor du gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dkyil nyid de/ /rigs bzhi lha dang lha mo kyi)dang / /khro bo khro mo 'khor du bshad/ /lha yi ting 'dzin dkyil nyid de/ /spyod pa yo byad 'khor du bshad / /gang la gang gis rgyas btab pa/ /goms dang rtas pa'i dbang gis na / /ji ltar snang grags chos thams cad/ /de dang de yi (1ngo bor 'gyur/ /102—441

rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu ①'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud las dkyil 'khor ma lus par bshad pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dbang bskur ⑤cho ga phun sum tshogs/ /thabs kyi sa la sbyor byed pa'i/ /rtog pa'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen po/ /ma lus pa yi rgya mtsho nyid/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs te/ /'khor tshogs ye shes rgya mtsho la/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lhan cig tu/ /ye shes lha mo la brten nas/ /ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang chen 'gyur/ /ye shes rgya mtsho dbang phyug gis/ /dang po nas bzung bcu pa'i bar/ /ting 'dzin 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa'i lha mo la ①brten nas/ /ting 'dzin chu bos dbang bskur bas/ /sa dang ye shes zhing khams dang / /rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa'i rim par 'phel mthong lam rdo rje sku thob pas/ /nges 'byed nyams ldan rnal 'byor la/ /rig pa nyams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa rtsal gyis gzungs brten nas/ /zag med rdo rje sku la sbyor/ /rig pa brtan thob ④rnal 'byor pas/ /las dang skal ldan rnal 'byor pa(nya/ /lhag pa gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor du/ /rig ⑥ma'i phyag rgya mdzes ma la/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs brten byas nas/ /cho ga thabs kyi dbang bskur zhing / /brgyud pa dbang gi man ngag gis/ /sbyor ba nyams ldan ⑦rnal 'byor thob/ /ye shes rgya mtsho blo ldan zhing / /thugs rje rgya mtshos 'gro ba skyob/ /dam tshig dbang dang rig pa'i (kyidrod/ /rim par brgyud pa'i dbang thob cing / /dgongs zab (97don la mkhas pa dang / /rkyen thub sa bon 102—442

gzi brjid che/ /las dang bya ba ma rmongs shing / /ma yengs brtson 'grus bar chad med/ /ri dgas ①rgyal po seng ge ltar/ /gzi chen ②gzhan gyis ②nyam nga med/ /byin brlabs 'dus pa'i nus pa can/ /tshig dang bden pa'i byin brlabs du'agrub/ /de yis dbang bskur cho ga brtsamadu/ /dad dang dam tshig ldan pa dang / /snying rje che la slob la brtson⑥/ /brtson 'grus shes rab phun sum tshogs/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /thos bsam bsgoms ⑦la rab gnas pa'i/ /'gyur med brtan pa'i bsam pa yis tha mal bsam pa spang ⑧byas te/ /bla ma la ni de bzhin gshegs/ /'dul dbang thabs mkhas bsam par bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas des kyang ni/ /snying rjes nad pa bzhin bsam zhing / /skyon dang mnar dang slu sems spang / /rang rang nus pa ldan pa dang / /bdag gzhan don nus brtson 'grus ldan/ /brtul zhugs gsum dang rab ldan zhing / /dngos grub don du gnyer ba yi/ /gsang chen rigs su nges pa dang / /gzhan gyi dbang du mi 'gyur na/ /dbang dang man ngag sbyin par bya/ /ri bo'i phyogs sogs 'byor pa mod/ /sngon shing me tog rgyas pa'i tshul / /tsan+dan dri bsung yo)ldan pa'i ri/ /bdag dbang bar chad med pa'i gnas / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi/ /ri bo dgon pa yon tan gnas/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i dgon pa der/ /rnyed dang der ni gnas par bya/ /sa bcu mthar phyin gang zag la/ /zhing khams mtha' thug yimed gnas su/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen gyis7/ /ye shes lha mo la brten 7te/ /skad cig ye shes dbang bskur tsobs/ /bcwa ④brgyad yon tan lhun grub pa/ /skad cig nyid la lhun rdzogs te/ /pad+ma spyan gyi sa la gnas/ /yi ge 'khor lo sa la smin/ /bdag 102—443

gzhan 'byed pa med pa yi/ /bde chen phyogs ris med par dgongs/ /'phel 'grib med pa'i rang bzhin pas/ /gzhan don yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /sa thob goms brtan 6)skyes bu la/ /ting 'dzin rig pa'i pho brang du/ /rgyal tshab ②skyes bu mtha' bdag ①gis/ /rig pa'i lha mo na so med/ /rigs byabral ting 'dzin stobs las grub/ /de la slob mas nges brten (snyenas/ /ji ltar chu la ji bzhin du/ /ting 'dzin byin brlabs yidabang bskur bsaX/ /rnam pa dang bral dbang rnams ni/ /nyams dumyong dbang du rang shar te/ /thob dang brtan dang goms pa yis/ /'jig rten brgya dang stong phrag bcu/ /'bum sogs bdag gzhan don rdzogs te/ /skad cig nyid la rag lus 5)pas/ /rgyal tshab 0chos kyi rgyal por bshad/ /lam zhugs rigs phyed rtags thob la/ /slob dpon mthar nye lam gnas pas/ /rgyang grags dpag tshad la sogs par/ /rdo rje thig tshad sbyor brjod pa'i(rmi/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor gsal ldang ba/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsungs/ /sna (nyatshogs rig 4)pas dbang sgyur chaba'i/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor du/ /stobs ldan bu mo la brten te/ /thabs dang ting 8'dzin dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje tshe la dbang thob cing cho 'phrul mngon shes ldan par 'gyur/ /dang po yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /rigs su nges pa'i bu mchog ste/ /dad brtson brtul zhugs ldan pa yi/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i rigs can la/ /drod ldan gnang 7zhing dbang thob pa/ /rgyal po lta bu bla ma yis/ /lhag pa gzugs brnyan byin ldan du/ /dad mos brtson 'grus 'jug pa'i yo sems(1nya/ /mi ldog dang brtan tshul gyis bzhugs/ /dbu rgyan ()cod pan phreng ba dang / /gdugs dang bum pa ( 1bza' btung dang / /go cha 102wa 444

phyag rgya rgyal mtshan dang / /snying po lnga yis dbang bskur ba/ /rang bzhin ngo bos gnas tshul la①/ /rdzas thabs ting 'dzin dbang bskur ②bas/ /nus pa'i byin brlabs dumangon shar nasakhyi/ /theg chen rdo rje rigs su 'gyur/ /de nas skal ldan slob ma dephyi/ /tha mal 'du shes kun bzlog ste/ /rang rang lhar byas gsal ba la/ /nus pa'i tshad dang nyams sbyar nas/ /nyan pa'i dbang dang bsgom ⑥pa dang / /'chang dang phrin ⑦las byed pa dang / /rdo rje rgyal po slob dpon dbang / /rang bzhin ngo bos gnas pa la/ /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang —/ /thabs dang ting 'dzin dbang bskur bas/ /mi nus nus pa thob pa'i tshad / /mi nus pa la bskur ba min/ /tshad ldan rnams la rim pas bskurani/ /rig ma las kyi phyag rgya mo/ /bcu drug bcwa 5)brgyad ldan pa yi/ /dri zhim yon tan ldan pa la/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bcud 'dus pa'i/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i rtsa 'khor lo/ /ye shes lnga yi ro ldan pa/ /thabs dang shes rab snod kyi mchog /thabs gsum tshul gyis rtser bstims pas/ /dus tsogasum rgyal ba thams cad kun/ / yungs kur tshostetshad tsam rdo rje sems/ /rtse nas rtse ru thim pa las/ /gnas ngan len pa gsum sbyangs te/ /rtsa bcud thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /mar me 'od ltar gsal gyur pas/ /bde chen nyams dang rtags thob pa/ / da lta 7nyid 'byung the tshom /shemed/ /rdo rje yinyi ma rab ldan pa'i/ /bcu bzhi bcu drug rab lon pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i yon tan nyid / /byin brlabs 7rig ma lha mor byas/ /chags pa bskyed pa'i 7thabs rnams nyid/ /blo dang ldan pas mngon sum bya/ /de nas cho ga kun rdzogs nas//bla mas gnyis med gtad bya'i phyir/ /byin brlabs tsho sbyor ba byas nas yang / /102—445

gnyis ku'i srin lag bzung nas ni/ /slob ma 'di la legs gtad ①la/ /gsang ba'i gnang ba sbyin par bya/ /skyes ①bu 'di bzung bzang ba ①yin/ /di ring phan chad bu mchog khyod/ /sgo gsum lha ru mnyam sbyor bas/ /tha mal dman pa'i lta ba spongasadu/ /bde ba chen po nyams myong bas/ /dka' thub theg pa'i lta ba spongasaX/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas/ /bde ba'i nyams myong brtan par byos/ /brtan pa bar chad med bsgoms pasadu/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa la 'gro/ /de bas skal ldan rigs bzang ⑦kyi/ /gtan du 'bral bar ma byed cig /sbyor ba'i thabs dang ting 'dzin dang / /rgyu ba'i rlung la dbang thob pas/ /thig le'i las la thogs pa med/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul phran snyedage/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i thig le nyid/ /sa yang bcu gsum gnyis ldan pa / /nyams myong brten cing gnyis med sbyar/ /rlung gis brten pa'i thig le nyidate/ /ro gcig 6)dus mnyam tshul byung ba/ /drag pa ma yin dal ba min/ /dgongs pa nyams dang zhen chags min/ / ā li 0kā li zhu ba'i sems /sangs rgyas phreng ba gnyis su med/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab bskyod ⑩cing / /'khyud pa gar gyi phyag rgya las/ /nyi zla rtse phrad 'byor pa na/ /byed pa rlung gi thig le bzung ⑫/ /rgyu ba bcad 0cing thig tsole mnanatso/ /shes pa nam mkha'i ngang la gtad / /dbang po shes rab che chung gis/ /lan gsum ⑩brtan par gyur pa ⑩'am / /ma thob bar du hunyesbyin par bya/ /rdo rje zla 'od mdzes ldan ma/ /dman dang rigs ngan rnam par spangs/ /rdo rje dbang pos ma phog 7cing / /gzhan dbang longs spyod ma byas pa/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bco 0lnga'ang rung / /thabs dang zas dang spyod lam gyis/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga gzhung bzhin bya/ /rdo 102—446

rje lce dang srin lag dang / /srin lag bcos ma la sogs pa/ /thabs dang byug pa'i yan lag gis/ /gsang ba'i pho brang rgyas par bya/ / 'khor ba zil gnon rtsa rnyed nas/ /bdag po gdung can rnam par sbyar/ /thig le myur bul rtags byung nas/ /rgyu ba rlung gi tshad du zung / /nyi zla dus gcig shar ba la/ /①'khor ba zil gnon thabs chen po/ /myong ②bas chu rgyun ting 'dzin thob/ /gal te rtsa dang bral ba na/ /phaṭa dang ldan na 'phro bar 'gyur/ /dngas ①rlung mnyam pas zin par 'gyur/ /bzlog pa 'dren pa'i hūm̐ gis shes/ /sdud pa'i hūm̐ gis bsdams gnas pa/ /thig les ④lus la khyab par byed/ /dang por sa bon 'jog pa ste/ /gnyis pas nus pa bskyed ⑤pa yin/ /gsum pas nyams myong bskyed ⑥pa yin/ /bzhi pas de nyid brtan par byed/ /lnga pas brtan pas nyams blangs pas/ /mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dis 'grub/ /rdo rje slob dpon gnang thob pa/ /nus ldan rab gnas cho ga brtsamacha/ /de nas slob ma tshul bzhin gzhug⑧ /sgo gsum nyes pa kun bral ba'i/ /sdom pa'i dam tshig phog byas la/ /dbang bskur rim pa sbyin par bya/ /dbang gi nyams myong khyabartan bya'i phyir/ /gdams ngag rjes mthun 7sbyin par bya/ /gdams ngag nyams brtan lam rim ste/ /lam mthar tu)phyin pa 'bras bu nyida'/ /drod mthar phyin ⑫dang sa brgyad dang / /grags chen sangs rgyas sa dag la/ /rang rig rtags ⑫dang thugs lirje yis/ /'dren stobs mkha' 'gro gsum du snang / /mkha' dang sgra dang gzugs can gyi/ /pad+ma can zhes grags pa yi/ /sbyor dang glu skyadabyangs snang ba dang / /gzugs tsam brtan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /dbang bskur 8rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ma bcos rdo rje dbyings dkyil 'khor/ /khro bo'i dkyil 102—447

'khor yan lag ste/ /bsgrub ①dang gdug pa gdul phyir yin/ /dang la rtsa ba'i dbang ②thob nas/ /phyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbang thob bya/ /gdul bya mos pa'i dbang brtsan ①la/ /thun mong tsam du nges pa med/ /dang po gnyis ④pa gsum pa dag /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur yin/ /bzhi pa dang ⑤ni lnga pa nyid/ /he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /dus gsum rgyal bas byin brlabs pa'i/ /ma nor lam ston slob dpon la/ /mnyes dang bkur bar mi byed cing / /rang rang nus shing 'jug pa la/ /dbang bskur gnang ba ma byin par/ /gsang ba bshad dang nyan pa dang / /bsgom (5)dang bsgrub ⑦pa la sogs pas/ /bskal pa bye ba dpag med du/ /'bras bu thob par mi 'gyur gyi/ /dmyal ba'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni dam pa kun brnyas pas/ /nad dang sdug bsngal mang po dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang gdon gyis 'tshe(kyi/ /de nas nges par 'chi bar 'gyur / /byin brlabs 6)ldan pa'i bla ma yis/ /dad brtson brtul zhugs rab ldan pa'i/ /rigs nges skyes bu mchog nyid la/ /thabs kyis dbang bskur byin brlabs na/ /rgyal ba dang ni mkha' 'gro dang / /rig ⑩'dzin grub pa pho mo yis / /tshe 'dir bsam pa kun skongs shing tshome/ /byin brlabs yidabang dang dngos grub kyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /gang gis gang la dbang bskur bas/ /tha mal zhen pa dag pa dang / /bde chen lam la mtshun zhugs pas/ /dngos grub gang la thogs med de/ /las rnams gang brtsams 'grub pa dang / /'dod pa'i don la rol pa yis/ /sa (nyabacu rim pa mthar phyin nas/ /pad+ma spyan gyi sa thob ste/ /yi ge 'khor lo sa la gnas/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan las/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga lhun grub pa/ /dbang gi 'bras bu rang 102—448

las shar/ /thabs chen 'di dang gang bral na/ /bskal pa gang gā'i bye snyed du//brtson pas 'bras bu tshol byed pa/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu stongs ①par 'gyur/ /gang phyir slob dpon slob ma dang / /dkyil 'khor rim pa ji bzhin du/ /las dang ting 'dzin byin brlabs ②kyis/ /'jug pa'i cho ga gsum du bshad/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen po/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lam chen po/ /ma lus cho ga ①rgya chen po/ /dpal ldan rdo rje me long gi/ /'jug pa'i rim pa ji bzhin du/ /gsang ba kun la shes par bya/ /rdo rje bla ma de nyid kyis/ /cha byad gus ①ldan mdzes pa yis/ /me tog ldan pas 'khor lo nyid/ /mngon byas sku gsung bskul ba yis/ /dam tshig dran te dgongs par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i (snyedakyil 'khor du/ /gsal dang rig pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /rdo rje slob ma byin brlab (6)phyir/ /slob dpon dag kyang 'jug par bya/ /de nas slob ma 'jug bya ste/ /khrus byas dri zhim gos bzang gyonag/ /dad dang gus ldan rin chen bcas/ /gus bcas snyan pa'i tshig gis ni/ /lus dbul dag pa'i sems kyis gnas/ /bdud rtsi (kye'akhyil pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bar chad sbyor bsal bsrung 5)ba bya/ /cho ga gang yin lhar bskyed la/ /mtshan ma rdzogs par nan tan bya/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig lnga/ /'bru gsum sku gsung thugs ldan sbyin/ /snying gar yirdo rje brtan byas la/ /dam tshig legs par dbog par bya/ /tsan+dan dkar dmar byin brlabs chu/ /lan gsum 4)blud la snod dor ro/ /de nas rang gis dam bsgrags te/ /gsang ba'i don la nges par bya/ /rang rang 'brel ba'i lha nyid la/ /rin chen dor te tu brtag par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de bkug la/ /bstim yi la dbyer med 102wa 449

gnas pa la/ /rtag tu byin brlabs gnas pa'i phyir/ /legs par brtan pa'i cho ga bya/ /mi shes rab rib bsal byas la/ /'khor lo mngon pa'i nga rgyal bya/ /de nas lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dag pa rim gyis bstan ①par bya/ /de nas bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /ma lus ci yod dbul ②par bya/ /byin brlabs cho ga dag pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mchod dang bsgoms ①pa dang / /zhugs pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'gyur/ / des na ④rigs su nges pa yisadu/ /dang por 'jug pa'i rim pa bstan/ /rtsa ba yan lag kun thob nas / /rim pa bzhin du dbang bskur ro/ /de nas bla ma'i bka' mnos la/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgrub (7par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ④sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba ⑧me long gi rgyud las dbang bskur ba ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje dam tshig bla na med/ /sdom pa brtan 9)po dam bcas pa/ /'di dag legs par bshad par bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /'das dang ma byon dus gsum du/ /rgyal khrims tha tshig 7bkas bcad ltar/ /rim pas (medamod bor bkas snyibacad pa'i/ /byin brlabs rang bzhin 'da' dka' 1)ba/ /kun gyis bsrung bya yin par bshad / /gang phyir dam pas byin brlabs pa 'i/ /dam tshig chen po 'di nyid la / /'das dang da ltar ma byon pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang / /rig (7'dzin rnams dang mkha' 'gro dang / /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams dang / /klu dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i lha chen kyang / /dam pa 102—450

'das pas 'tshig par 'gyur/ /dam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin 'di/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa la/ /sgra bzhin spyod pa'i gang zag rnams/ /log par spyad pas tshig par 'gyur/ /dam pa rnams kyis bkas bcad cing / /byin brlabs dmod bor rang bzhin grub①/ /dam pa 'di las gang 'da' ba/ /rdo rje can yang tshig ②par 'gyur/ /dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa la/ /dbang dang byin brlabs ⑧thob pa yis/ /dam pa'i tshul bzhin nges spyad na/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams 'tshig par 'gyur/ /de phyir dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis/ /dam tshig ces ni rnam par bsgrags/ /bla na med pa'i dam tshig ni/ /ma lus rang rig byang chub sems/ /mtha' dbus 'gro 'ong las grol ba/ /gzhi ④ma med pa'i sems nyid de/ /gang gis don rtogs gnas gyur pa/ /don dam byang chub sems su brjod/ /ma skyes byang chub sems nyid ni/ /skye ba'i rang bzhin nyid snang ba/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i phyag rgya ste/ /ma lus der snang ngo bo gcig /rang ltar chasgo gsum gsal rtogs pa/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems su bshad/ /gsang ba bshad dang dbang bskur dang / /man ngag lung dang nyams chag skong //mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa/ /dngos grub ster zhing grol yibyed pa/ /'di ni sangs rgyas mnyam pa'i phyir/ /skad cig gdung ba nyams mi bya/ /rang gi lha dang gnyis med nas/ /phyag rgya bzhir gsal rnal 'byor pas/ /rang gi sgo gsum ma nyams par/ /chu bo lta bur bar chad med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /theg chen gsang ba nyid yin pas/ /snod med dman sogs log pa la/ /gsang (7bcu la sogs brjod mi bya/ /dang por gsang bar srog gcig pas/ /byang chub snying por mi 'bral (kyebs/ /rang srog rang gis gcod 102—451

kyang sla0)/ /brtse gdung dam tshig bral mi bya/ /lam dang bsgrub ②pa'i rtsa ba dang —/ /dngos grub ①kun gyi rtsa ba dang / /'di dag nyams na kun nyams pas//rtsa ba zhes su bstan pa yin/ /yan lag thun mong dam tshig dang / /thun mong min par bshad ④par bya/ /dang por gsang ba'i lung thob nas/ /nus pa mngon (gedu snang bar du/ /bdag dang gzhan phyir khyathun mong gi/ /'gal dang sgro skur ⑦kun 'das shing / /kun dang bsam pa dga' byed pa/ /thun mong dam las mi 'gal (gyib/ /thun mong dam tshig yin par 6)bshad/ /thun mong ma yin gang zag gis/ /thabs chen thun mong ma yin pa/ /nyon mongs lnga dang spyod ⑩pa lnga/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang shes pa lnga/ /grub pa lnga yi chos rnams nyid/ /skyes bu (nyerigs phyed spyod yul te/ /thun mong rnal 'byor yul min pas/ /thun mong ma yin zhes su bshad/ /dang po nas bzung rtags thob par rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa yi/ /lus sems ma yengs rtse gcig pas/ /rnam pa dang bcas dang du blang / /sa thob goms dang mthar phyin par/ /ting 'dzin don la gnas pa'i tshe/ /'gal ba'i sgo gsum mi 'byung bas/ /ting 'dzin rgyun gyi dam tshig la/ /rnam pa'i dam tshig ma lus 'dus/ /don las langs tshe snying rje dang / /rtsa ba yan lag shugs ldan yin/ /sangs rgyas sa la gnas pa na/ /'da' ba med pa'i dam tshig ste/ /rgya mtsho rlan bzhin 8thob spangs med/ / bsrung med nya ye shes dam tshig ste/ /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /bsnyen pa rtags dang ldan par du/ /spyi yi dam tshig bsrung bya zhing / /bsgrub skipa gang yin 'grub 7pa na/ /khyad par rang rang rtog yipa yi/ /dam tshig med par 'grub mi 'gyur/ /gang zag gang la dga' ba la/ /dam tshig dka' thub sgo 102—452

nas ni/ /gsang ba'i don la dgod bya'i phyir/ /dam tshig rnam pa mtha' yas bstan / /dang po las can rnal 'byor la/ /rtsa ba thun mong dam tshig bstan/ /brten ①nas nyams ldan gang zag la/ /thun mong min pa'i dam tshig bstan/ /rtogs pa'i 'jigs med gang zag la/ /'da' nyams med pa'i dam tshig bstan②ske/ /sa thob goms mthar phyin pa la/ /ting 'dzin rgyun gyi dam tshig bstan / /dngos grub rtogs pa kun dang 'brel/ /dam tshig 'di ni rdo rje chedu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa 'di/ /thob nas dam par gang bsrungs ④pa/ /yon tan chung yang 'grub par bshad/ /mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa/ /dngos grub rtog pa ma lus pa/ /cho ga gang dang ting 'dzin gang / /bsgrub ⑤pa gang dang gang yiyang rung / /ma nyams tshul ⑦du rab brtson (0pas/ /myur du 'grub 6)pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gal te byin gyis ma brlabs na/ /rdo rje 'chang nyid brlag par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan nyid/ /dam tshig rdo rje las byung bas/ /dam pa 'di la gang brten ⑩pas/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gyur/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang yan lag gi/ /bsrung bya dka' thub dam pa 'di/ /kun gyis 'da' ba ma yin zhing / /gnas pa dam pa nyid yin te/ /las dang skal ba dman pa dang / /rigs dman le lo 4rjeche ba tsho dang / /rang bzhin ngan pa'i gang zag gis/ /blun snyo po gang zhig 'da' byed cing / /dngos grub gnyis la rgyab phyogs nas/ /dam pa rnams la dmod yibyed pa/ /sangs rgyas kun la nyes byas pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni/ /bdun rgyud tshun chad brlag par mdzad / /mkha' 'gro ma dang rig tshe'adzin dang / /kha 'bar gtum 'khrug rngam 102—453

pa'i tshogs/ /de ma thag tu srog bcad nas/ /dmyal ba'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur / /gal te 'jig par gyur na ni/ /'jig rten gzhan ①du skye 'gyur zhing —/ /ji srid nam mkha' 'jig pa'am/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho zad pa'i tshe/ /thar te gzhan du nam yang min/ /dam pa'i bla ma spong ba dang / /rdo rje mched la 'khu ba dang / /byang chub sems nyid mi dran zhing / /sngags dang phyag rgya yal ba dang / /snod min gsang ba bshad pa dang / /gsang ba'i don la skur ②ba ni / /'dir yang sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /skad cig 'gags pas de ma thag /bar ma'i lus dang bral gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /gang du rtsa ba yan lag bcas/ /bsrung dang dbog par bya ba'i chos/ /thun mong dbang dang 'brel bcas pa'i/ /thun mong spyi yi yul gyur pa/ /de ni thun mong bsrung bya ste/ /'di ni phyi yi dam tshig go/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyar ba'i sems / /thig le'i sems lnga'i lam gyi rim/ /rig pa ma lus gsal ba'i tshe/ /thig le gnyis med nyams su byung / /bde ba'i thig le'i ①bcud bsgyur bas/ /tshogs drug rang snang thig le'i grogs/ /ma lus thig les ④byin brlabs pas/ /thams cad bde chen phyag rgyar gsal/ /thig le rig (5)pa khar dbyung min/ /'khor lo kha sbyor bde ba yis/ /tha mal bde bar dbang por bsgyur/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod thabs kyis myong / /tha mal zhen pa rnam par bzlog /thabs ldan don la gsang ba'i don/ /rang snying 'od kyi dkyil 'khor lnga/ /'char dang nub pa'i rim pa yis/ /thabs chen gsang ba'i thig le ltar/ /shes nas spang du med par gnas/ /rang 'byung 6)gnas pa'i bcud lnga (7ni/ /rang lus rten gyi don snang ba/ /khyab par rgyu ba'i tshul dag gis/ /dngas snyigs gnyis 102—454

kyi ②tshul du gnas/ /rang lus rtog pa ②dngas snyigs dang / /kha dog yan lag nying lag ②gis/ /bde ba'i ye shes lngar shes dang / /bde dub chen po nyid du gsungs/ /khams lnga bcud las skyes pa yiphyi/ /ma lus thig le'i rang bzhin te/ /ye shes lnga yi ro ldan pas/ /rgyal ba lnga ru yang dag gsungs/ /thabs dang shes rab rdo rje dril(dzin/ /nyi zla'i (7rim pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /sems lngas mkha' la gsal ba'i tshe/ /rten can rten dang gnyis med pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes snang / /ma zin rdo rje lce yis blang / /gnyis kyi rtog pa ma lus pa / /bde chen ro gcig (7byin gyis brlabs/ /skad cig bral 6)med bde ba'i sems / /dus gsum mi 'bral brtan par gnas/ /rlung dang thig le'i bzlas pa yis/ /thams cad bde chen phyag rgyar gsal/ /bde chen thabs dang nyams kyis te⑩/ /brjod dang tshig gis phebs pa min/ /gnyis sbyor phrad pa'i bde ba (nyayis / /tha mal zad dang bde chen sbyor/ /gang gis sbyin par mi nus pa/ /da ltar nus pa rang gis myong / /gzhan gyi brdzun 7pa'i don 'di ni/ /thabs kyis bden par tsomangon du bstan/ /tha mal yizhen pa spang ba'i phyir/ /kha na ma tho bag tsha bral/ /skyes dang nus dang gnas pa'i tshe/ /rang bzhin lnga ni shugs kyis grub/ /rang gi rtsa bcud 7so so las/ /bdud 7rtsi bral ba med par gnas / /'byung lnga dbang po gzugs sogs bcas/ /thabs ldan sbyor ba'i byin brlabs 7kyis/ /bde chen lhan cig skyes par shes/ /nyi zla rlung gis zin pa yi/ /mtshan ma bral ba ngo bo las/ /zhen pa med pa'i thabs chen pos/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ye shes lnga yi ros tshoshegang bas/ /ma lus rgyal ba lnga ru grub/ /'di ni phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /rang bzhin dam tshig chen 102wa 455

po yin/ /dam tshig rnam pa mtha' yas pa/ /shin tu bsdus 6)pa rnam pa gnyis/ /'bring du rtsa ba lnga nyid dang / /yan lag bcu ru shes par bya/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i dam tshig ni/ /spyir ni sum brgya drug cu (miste/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal ba nyid dang / /nyid kyi dkyil 'khor snang ba dang / /dus bzhi rgyal mchog nyid dang ni/ /bsgrub ③med mnyam par rdzogs pa nyid/ /lhun grub bde gnas dam tshig dang / /rnam dag byang chub gzung go'adzin bral/ /rtogs nas don 'dzin dam tshig dang / /sems la gnas bcas dam tshig dang / /ye nas ma bcos dam tshig dang / /'dus byas rnam dag dam tshig dang / /chos rnams dbyer med dam tshig dang / /zhu)thams cad 'jigs med dam tshig dang / /yigayung drung tshe 'phel dam tshig dang / /thams cad bsrung du med pa ste/ /'di dag lta ba'i dam tshig yin/ /thams cad sbyor ba'i dam tshig dang / /ma lus bsgral ba'i dam tshig dang / /ma byin len pa'i dam tshig dang / /brdzun du smra ba'i dam tshig dang / /thams cad spyod pa'i dam tshig dang / /dam rdzas spyod pa'i dam tshig ste/ /'di dag spyod pa'i dam tshig yin/ /bsgrub pa'i dam tshig rnam gsum ni/ /rdo rje skye laganas dam tshig dang / /'dren byed gnas stobs dam tshig dang / /lam la ston byed dam tshig dang / /rab tu rtogs byed dam tshig dang / /sgyur byed byang chub dam tshig dang / /thams cad dbang sgyur (nyadam tshig dang / /rig 'dzin gnas stobs dam tshig stekyi)/ /bsgrub bya rtogs 7pa'i dam tshig yin/ /yum gyur dbyings phyug dam tshig dang / /thabs nyid shes rab sbyor dam tshig /shes rab thabs su sbyor de bzhin/ /glang po brjid gnon dam tshig dang / /thams cad mi chud dam tshig dang / /thams cad bsrung (1102—456

ba'i dam tshig dang / /ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i yo)dam tshig ste/ /bsgrub ②pa thabs kyi dam tshig yin/ /tshogs kyi ①mchod pa'i dam tshig dang / /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dam tshig dang / /tshogs kyi phrin ④las dam tshig dang / /phra ①men tshim byed dam tshig ste/ /bsgrub ⑥pa'i phrin ⑦las dam tshig yin/ /yang dag don ston dam tshig dang / /gsung mchog mtha' yas dam tshig dang / /thams cad skad mjal ⑧dam tshig dang / / yi ge ⑨med mjal ⑩dam tshig dang / /stong gsum kun grags dam tshig dang / /ye shes gsung (nyamachog dam tshig dang / /bsam yas rdo rje gsung dam tshig /mi 'gyur tunyerdo rje'i tunyedam tshig ste/ /bdag gis shes bya'i dam tshig yin/ /shes bya ting 'dzin dam tshig bzhirmu/ /nam mkha' snang byed dam tshig dang / /rten byed sa yi dam tshig dang / /sreg 8byed me yi dam tshig dang / /'khrug 8byed chu yi dam tshig dang / /g.yengs 0byed chen po'i dam tshig ste/ /shes rab lnga yi dam tshig dang / /phung po lnga yi dam tshig ni(3/ /thabs mchog lnga yi dam tshig yinatu)/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan dam tshig dang / /sgra ltar shes pa'i dam tshig dang / /dri ltar shes pa'i dam tshig dang / /ro ltar shes pa'i dam tshig dang / /reg ltar shes pa'i dam tshig ni / /gnyis su med pa'i dam tshig yin/ /kha dog lnga yi dam tshig dang / /phyogs lnga yi ni dam tshig dang / /dbang lnga yi ni dam tshig ste/ /gsum po spyir khyab dam tshig yin/ /bde ba'i ngang nyid dam tshig dang / /lhun grub ye shes dam tshig dang / /mi 'jigs rgyal mchog dam tshig dang / /mnyam rdzogs lhun grub dam tshig dang / /phyogs dus dbyer med yi )dam tshig dang / /nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dam tshig dang / /chos la skyon med dam tshig dang / /brjod med 102—457

spros med dam tshig dang / /phyogs dus gnyis med dam tshig dang / /gnyis med byang chub sems dam tshig /'dus ma byas pa'i dam tshig dang / /thams cad rgyas 'debs dam tshig dang / /thams cad mi 'gog dam tshig ste/ /ngo bo ting 'dzin dam tshig ①yin/ /grub par bya ba lnga bstan pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i dam tshig dang / /rin chen 'byung ba'i dam tshig dang / /pad+ma chags med dam tshig dang / /don rnams grub pa'i dam tshig dang / /'jigs byed rdo rje dam tshig dang / /de bzhin sku nyid dam tshig dang / /thams cad 'byor ldan dam tshig ste/ /sku yi dam tshig bdun du bshad/ /yang dag don ston la sogs pa / /gsung gi dam tshig brgyad po nyid/ /rang la rdzogs par shes bya ste/ /'bras bu'i bsrung ②bas bsgrub bya yin/ /rang rig dbang sgyur chadam tshig dang //che mchog rnam dag dam tshig dang / /rang bzhin 'od gsal dam tshig dang / /byang chub sdom byed dam tshig dang / /thams cad dbang sgyur rgyadam tshig drug /thugs kyi dam tshig nyid du bshad/ /byang chub zhing bkod dam tshig dang / /ye shes bzhugs gnas dam tshig dang / /gzhal yas khang bstan dam tshig dang / /sna tshogs kun sgyur dam tshig dang / /zad med gter ldan dam tshig dang / /bsgrub 'a)pa zad med dam tshig dang / /zad med gter chen dam tshig ni/ /yon tan dam tshig bdun du bshad/ /thams cad byin rlob dam tshig dang / /bdud sde tshar gcod dam tshig dang / /sems can don byed dam tshig ni/ /phrin 6)las dam tshig gsum du bshad/ /spong ba rdo rje dam tshig dang / /chags pa'i ye shes dam tshig dang / /gti mug chen po'i dam tshig dang / /phrag dog chen po'i dam tshig dang / /nga rgyal bde mchog dam tshig dang / /nyon mongs lnga 102—458

yi dam tshig ste/ /mi spong ①ba yi dam tshig yin/ /gtan du ma yengs bsrung ②ba ni/ /mnyam pa lnga yi dam tshig dang / /bden pa dbyer med dam tshig dang / /sku gsung thugs sbyor chadam tshig dang / /lam lnga rdzogs pa'i dam tshig dang / /thams cad bde dusbyor rjodam tshig dang / /rdo rje log 'joms dam tshig dang / /'khor ba zil gnon dam tshig dang / /ma bcos lhun grub dam tshig dang / /thig le bde sbyor dam tshig ni/ /lta ba rgyun bsrung rjodam tshig yin⑦/ /ting 'dzin rgyun bsgom ⑧dam tshig dang / /bcing ba phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang / /bzlas pa sgra snyan dam tshig dang / /sgo gsum mnyam pa'i dam tshig dang / /shes rab bde sbyor dam tshig ni/ /ting ⑨'dzin rgyun gyi dam tshig yin/ /tha snyad zil gnon dam tshig dang / /spyod lam bde 'byor dam tshig dang / /rig pa thod rgal dam tshig dang / /ma bcos gnas dag dam tshig dang / /rang 'byung ⑩gnas bral dam tshig ste/ /cig 7car gnas pa'i bsrung 7thabs yin/ /thams cad skyed byed dam tshig dang / /rgyud 8drug sbyor byed dam tshig dang / /rtogs pas tshim byed dam tshig dang / /khyab pa nam mkha'i dam tshig dang / /gzhan don shugs grub dam tshig ni/ /dam tshig che ba bstan pa yin/ /dmyal chen dmyal ba phal pa dang / /yi tsodags byol tsosong srin po tsodang / /gnod sbyin mngal srin kha 'bar lce/ /lha dang lha min ru dra 6)dang / /rtsangs pa la tsosogs 'khor ba ste/ /chad pa'i skye hunyeganas bstan ( )pa yin/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig chen po yin/ /gal te stong pa'i don rtogs na/ /bskang ( nyadang nyams pa'i tshul med de/ /chad pa'i yul las 'das pa yin/ /gang zag 'ga' zhig spyod yul yin()glu/ /gal te rtsa ba'i dam nyams na/ /bla ma grogs po brgya dag la/ /102wa 459

bshags pa stong phrag brgya ①ru bya/ /bzlas ②pa bye chab phrag bdun bya/ /gtor ma 'bum phrag bdun du bya/ /sbyin sreg ④'bum phrag bcu gcig bya/ /de nas slar yang blang ba 'am/ /bla mas gnang nas gnas par bya/ /gal te yul de mi gnas sam/ /lo gsum phan chad 'das pa 'am/ /gal te bshags (snyepa'i tshul mthong bas/ /ma dad 'dod pa'i (6)sems skyes nas/ /bskang ⑦ba'i tshad las 'das pa ste/ /bskal pa chen po brgyad khri'i bar/ /bshags kyang dag par mi 'gyur te/ /rdo rje dmyal ba zhes bya bar/ /mi bzad (bsdug bsngal myong nas ni/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa'i bar/ /mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /zla (9)ba bdun du smra bcad bya/ /sbyin sreg ⑩stong rtsa brgyad du bya/ /bzlas pa 9/1bye ba tshad 'bum gcig /gtor ma khri phrag gcig (stetu btang tunya/ /de nas slar yang blang ba dang / /dag dang tshangs par bsgrags 7par bya/ /dag pa'i snod dang mi ldan par/ /gsang ba ston cing 'chad pa snyidang / /dbang ma thob par bka' 'gom dang / /bder yigashegs bka' las 'das pa dang / /tshad dang ldan pa'i snod min la/ /gsang ba tshad du sgrogs 7pa dang / /gsang ba nyams su mi len par/ /'phyar bas kun la spel ba ni/ /tshad las 'das pa'i gang zag ste/ /sangs rgyas kun la brnyas byed pas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas khros pa yis(ste/ /bdun rgyud tshun chad brlag par mdzad/ /bla ma dang ni grogs rnams dang / /pha ma gnyen bshes rgyal blon dang / /rgyal 'bangs nyes med sdang ba ni/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags su bshad/ /zab mo dag la gegs 'byung 17dang / /bsgrubs ne )pas 'dod pa mi 'byung zhing / /bsrung ( 1ba'i lha rnams g.yel ba dang / /ma nyes ya 102—460

kha ①'byung ba dag /dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags ②su bshad/ /dang por bla ma'i lung thob nas/ /rang gis nyams pa ma tshor zhing / /bde legs bsam pa 'grub 'gyur zhing / /bdag gzhan bsam pa'i khyad par dag③ /sngon du yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /'grub cing bsngags ④pas thob pa ni/ /ma nyams don dang ldan pa'i rtags/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug (brgyal po yin/ /gal te ma nyams rtags byung nayi/ /bskang gso'i cho ga myur du brtsam/ /gal te nyams la rtags med cing / /legs par snang na mi rung ste6)/ /bdag gi nis bon tshig pa ste/ /bde ba zad byas gtan du sdug /ma nyams rtags byung myur bskangs ⑨na / /sngon gyi bag chags zad par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu ⑩'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud las dam tshig ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o // //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mchog dang thun mong tunyel sogs pa/ /bsgrub tu pa'i khyad par ji snyed pa'i/ /rtog pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus bshad/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po ma lus las/ /thun mong dag la mos zhugs pas/ /thun mong yo byad ting 'dzin dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya 'bral (snyegoms pas/ /rtags dang nus pa mthar phyin pas/ /gang ltar dmigs pa 'grub 'gyur te/ /zag bcas yithun mong dngos grub yin/ /de las gzhan pa bshad par bya/ /gang du mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ /dbang dang dam tshig ting 'dzin dag /phyi nang gsang ba'i rim thob nayi/ /mi ldog brtan pa'i rnal 'byor thob/ /mthong nas bsgom 9lam ma nges rigs/ /ting 'dzin gang bsgom tsho bar chad hu med/ /tshe 'dis //102—461
