dbang sgyur ①'jigs bral te/ /de nas sku lnga'i ②bdag nyid thob/ /mchog ldan mchog gis ①mchog thob pas/ /mchog gi dngos grub thun mong min/ /dad dang dam tshig shes rab dang / /brtson 'grus brtul zhugs bzod pa thob/ /brten ④cing snying brtse byadabang rdzogs shing / /bsgrub rjodang lam gyi sbyor ba shes/ /yid ⑦phub mi ldog brtan pa canani/ /nyams thob dang du len pa ni/ /gcig ⑨dang lnga gsum gang zag gis/ /ri bo ri sul gsang ⑩bar dang / /chu gling ngam grog 7brag rdzong dang / /dur khrod ri phug chu mdo dang / /yid 'ong bkra shis nyams dga' bar/ /cho ga byin brlabs tu)rdzogs pa nyid/ /las kyi cho ga gang yin pa/ /bdag gam gzhan gyis byas pa ni8/ /bdag dbang bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig dbang dang lta ba dag /sngon du bya ba rdzogs pa yis/ /sngon du rnal 'byor gsum thob bam/ /dang po yid brtan gang yin kyang / /gang la yid kyis dmigs pa de/ /cho ga ting 'dzin 'brel pa nyid/ /rang rang rtog rnyipa ji 8bzhin du/ /tha mal pa dang le lo dang / /the tshom ⑩dad pa'i stobs kyis te/ /gal te de dag mi ldan na/ /sa thob kyis kyang ma yin na/ /gang 7zag skye na)bos smos ci dgos/ /gal te dgug pa'i las bya na/ /bdag nyid dbang drag khro bo ⑩ste/ /dmar thag dud ma'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /gong zhu ltar gnas pa'i 'phro 'du ni/ /zhags pa lcags kyu sha stag ( meste/ /dmigs pa brtan cing rtags 9 nyethob nas/ /mngon du gyur gyi bar du ni/ /rang sngags brjod pa de yi mthar/ /che ge mo zhig dzaḥ/ 0zhes/ /dgra dang bgegs dang lha dang gzungs mi/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ldan yang rung / /tha mal dbang med bzhin du dgug /gal te de yi dgos pa dag /myur du grub par ma gyur sosnyen/ /102—462

de dag legs par grub kyi bar/ /gang yin mkhas pas bcing bar bya/ /ngag ①dang thabs dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /'grub par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /bdag nyid dbang drag gsal ba yig/ /lce la dbang gi 'khor lo bsam/ /yi ge gsum ldan dgu bkod nas/ /'od kyis nam mkha'i khams bkang ③zhing / /pad+ma rā dug zhu 'dra bas/ /gang thim bdag gi dbang gyur ⑤zhing / /bden pa bdar zhing ngag gis bcing / /yang na gang la gang chags pa'i/ /rdzas la ring du 'dod pa ltar/ /'dod pa grub na dam bcas shing ⑥/ /yid 'ong 'dul ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dga' ba'i thabs kyis bsten ④byas na/ /gal te 'gro zhing 'phro ⑧'dod na/ /dbang drag phyag rgyas bsdigs bcing 6)gzir/ /dga' ba'i thabs kyis yid 'phrog yinas/ /rol mo sgyu mkhan dag de yis/ /'dus pa'i gang zag chags pa can/ /bya ba thabs kyis bral ba ltar/ /bral ba med par gnas par 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin brtan pa'i nus pa yis/ /gang yang rung ba'i sems can de/ /sna tshogs khro bo khro mo yis/ /'od dang phyag rgya 'bar ba yis/ /bcings nas mdun du gnas par blta/ /dga' dang bsdigs pa rdzas kyi mtha'/ /ting 'dzin brtan pas nges par 'grub/ /⑨med las dngos por nges grub cing / /mi mthun tsobargyad sogs nges 'grub na/ /yod (snyedang snang ba'i 'gro ba dag /dbang pos bsgyur ba smos ci dgos/ /gal te gso ba'i las byas na/ /las ni gnyis te brtsams skipas 'grubasnyi/ /bdag nyid rtag par skyes nas ni/ /dbang bskur 7byin brlabs (/nakun bstims nas/ /mdun du shel gyi bum pa ru/ /thugs las chu yi lha mo bskyed/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba der gyur nas/ /bum par lha mo 'od du zhu/ /nad dang sdug bsngal (she102—463

byang bar bsam/ /dmar ser ba yi 'o ma dang / /sman dang rin chen spos dang 'bru / /bdud rtsi snying po cha rkyen la/ /mā ma tī ①yi sngags kyis gdab/ /oṃ mā ma tī gisarba pa ①ba du ru du ru swā hā/ nad dang sdug bsngal ldan pa'i lus/ /bkrus ④pas 'tsho bar the tshom ⑤med/ /bdag nyid brtul zhugs bde ldan pas/ /sngon du bya ba sngon song bas/ /dgon pa bas mtha' rab dben par/ /ma smas ⑥ma rul tshad ldan pa'i/ /dur khrod zhing chen mtshan ①ldan la/ /khrus dang byug bdug kun byas nas/ /pho mo la sogs yin pa yi/ /las de nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /de dag maṇ+ḍal gtsang ma yi/ /dbus su legs par bzhag ⑧nas ni / /bdag nyid khro bo gang yang rung / /gsal bas 6)tshangs pa brgya byin rung ⑩/ /rang sngags srog snying dza yis dgug /phyag rgya bzhi yis dbab par bya / /gal te 'dar dang rgod pa dang / /ngu dang 'jigs pa'i sgra byung na/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bstan 11par bya/ /dam chu byin la mnas bsgrags 7te/ /gang 'dod las la mngag par bya/ /gal te 'jig rten the tshom zos/ /de yis zos dang brgyal 1steb dang / /'phral du bdag nyid 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig ting 'dzin brtan pa yis/ /bar chad med par bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /mdangs 8ldan yid 'ong dang po ste/ /dri zhim 'od chags gnyis pa 7yin/ /dga' ba'i sgra sgrogs 7gsum pa yin/ /bkrag dang gzi mdangs nyams sod yin/ /zhing chen kha nas hri byung na/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje so yis bcad/ /ro langs brdabs na gser du 'gyurayo 7/ /lce yi ral gris de bcad na/ /cis yi kyang mi tshugs go mtshon te/ /lha min g.yul yang pham byed na/ /dpa' bo stobs ldan smos ci dgos / /de yi dbang po lnga dag la/ /mngon shes lnga yi dngos grub yod/ /102wa 464

rang gi rtog pa ji ①bzhin du/ /mkhas pas bsgrubs na 'grub par 'gyur/ /gal te bcu bdun bcwa ⑤brgyad ma'i/ /zhing mdzes bkru ①zhing byugs byas te/ /rgyan dang gos kyis legs par gdags/ /dri zhim dbang po dag pa la/ /bdag nyid dbang drag rnal 'byor gyis/ /ye shes 'jig rten gang rung ba'i/ /lha mo yid 'ong 'od 'bar ma/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas bkug bcings nas/ /rtags byung bar du bstim ④par bya/ /dri dang sgra dang 'od dag dang / /'dar dang 'gul dang dgod (5)pa dag /dang po'i rtags ni yin par bshad/ /lha dudang gtam dang gnyis pa ④ste/ /dngos su langs pa tshad yin pas/ /dam ⑧bdar mnas bsgags 6)dbang du bsduyi/ /gal te sbyar du sad pa na/ /cho ⑪'phrul che zhing log ston na/ /dbang drag (steng rgyal chen po yis/ /dbang du bsdu dang zil gyis mnan/ /de dag chags pas rol spyad na/ /skad cig cho 'phrul bzhi thob ste/ /skye shi med par gnas pa dang / /ma lus bde chen 'bar ba dang / /zhing khams kun du bgrod (snyepa dgatso /thogs pa med par 8'grub par 'gyur/ /gtsang ma byis pa rma med pal/ /yid 'ong legs pa btsal blangs nas / /dag cing bdud rtsis dri byugs la/ /'da' hū ma tas legs byugs ⑩la / /kha dog lnga yi gzungs kyis gdags/ /tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /lha mo gang rung snying pos dgug /rtag tu phyag rgya bzhis bstim zhing / /bdag nyid ha ya spyi tunyeb 'am/ /ya mān+ta ka la sogs pa/ /gang rung khro bor gsal bsgoms la/ /drag tu dgug cing bstim par bya/ /rtags byung mthar thug mngon gyur nas/ /legs nyes de yis smra bar 'gyur/ /gal te 'dar zhing mi brjod na/ /oṃ gyi 'od dang a mṛ tsho/tas/ /lce la so )thabs kyis dbang bskur 102—465

zhing ske/ /ha ya shrī 6)bas gad mos bsdigs/ /legs par smra bar the tshom med/ /gal te gsad pa'i las byed na/ /gsal la brtan thob rnal 'byor pas/ /dur khrod shing gcig ②bzhi mdo 'am/ /lha 'dre ①mngon du gnas pa'i sar/ /bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje ste/ /dud ka (gnag po 'od 'bar ba/ /spyan bzlog ⑤mtshon cha me ltar 'bar/ /sprul pa'i char ltar 'khrug par bsam/ /mdun du hom khung 0khru gang tshad/ /gru gsum dur sol khrag chen byug /nang du liṅga ⑦bdud rtsi lnga/ /chags pa'i rgyu dang tsha ba dang / /shes pa chags pa'i rten la ⑧byas / /pho nyas ming 6)rus bcas bkug la/ /bstims la phyag rgyas bcing bar bya / /lcags sam nag po'i shing las byas/ /drag po'i phur pas gnas gsum gdabaske/ /hriḥsnyiḥ7drag pos g.yas g.yon nas/ /khros pa'i sems kyis bsreg (mebyas nas/ /de nang drag po tsher ma can/ /nam phyed gcer bus bsregs byas nas / /lta ⑩yang rung ste brlag par 'gyur/ /gal te dbye ba'i las byed na/ /bdag nyid ya mān+ta ka ste/ /rngam zhing gdug gtum nga rgyal can/ /shin tu 'jigs shing bsdigs 7par bsgom/ /nyi mas 'jigs pa'i dang rung dang / /mun pas 'jigs pa'i gung ru la/ /gang yin de nyid bris la blan/ /lha dang lha min gnyis la gtad/ /rlung gi phyogs su de yis bskyod/ /sprul pa pho nyas g.yul 'gyed cing / /'thab cing rtsod par rnam par bsam/ /bar du khra yidang bya rog 'thab/ /me chu rlung gis 'bud bsams na/ /de ni gang yin su yang rung —/ /'bral zhing 'thab pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rgyal po bram ze blon po dag /gdug pa gnod pa can gyi rigs/ /mi gnas bskrad par bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid a par tsit+ta 7ste/ /drag po khros pa'i tshul du bsgom7/ /dgra 102—466

bgegs gang yang rung ba yi/ /'og tu rlung snying bcas pa ①byi/ /steng du ming rus ②bcas bskyon la/ /mdun nin gnas pa'i gdul bya de/ /rlung lha rnga mo'i steng du zhon/ /pho nya sprul pa mtha' yas kyis/ /'khrid ④cing 'tshog ⑤par rab bsams la/ /gshin rje'i drung du khrid ⑥par bsam/ /'dis ⑦ni dbugs med brgyal ba yang ⑧/ /gzhan du drag pos phyin 'gyur na/ /srog dang ldan pa 0smos ci dgos/ /gal te dgra dpung pham 'dod na/ /bdag nyid mi g.yo mgon po ste/ /ji ltar gnas par rab tu bsgom/ /de yi gzugs brnyan bris nas kyang / /cho gas de ru byin brlabs la/ /sngags ni bdun 'bum la sogs pa/ /lcags sna ⑩bdun las bcu gnyis chad⑩/ /ral gri snying por bcas pa la/ /gsal bar de dag rtags byung bzlasatso/ /'od dang sgra dang sa g.yos dang / /ral gri skad ni 'don pa na/ /phyung bas g.yul las ldog pa dang ske/ /bskor bas dmag dpung 'bros 7par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rgyal zhing che 'dod na/ /bdag nyid gsal zhing brtan ⑩gyur nas/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal byas la/ /dur khrod ras la ming rus bri'o/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas bkug bstims layi/ /nges par brtan 7pa'i ltas byung nas/ /he ru ka yi zhabs kyis gnon(3 / /rta mgrin 5)gad mo drag pos bsdigs/ /khyung gshog phyag rgya ( 3 zil gyis gnon(me/ /bdag dang khyi yi ( )sgroms nas gdon/ /bdag nyid them pa'i 'og tu gnon(nye/ /yang na bdag gi 'og tu gnon(ste/ /rdo rje rgya gram phyag rgya yis / /steng nas gnon ( gecing bden pa bdar/ /bdag nyid de yi rgyal por 'gyur / /dbul po gter dang phrad 'dod na/ /bdag nyid las la goms pa yisal/ /rigs lnga 0lhag pa'i lha gsal nas/ /so so'i phyag mtshan yungs 'bru 102—467

tsam / /dbang por mthong gi bar du ni/ /bsam zhing sngags bzlas bden pa bdar / /mtshan ma brtan po gsal ba na/ /gang na yod pa'i phyogs der dong //bden pa ting 'dzin sngags bcas mthus/ /'dug gam smra 'am mthong ba 'am/ /phra mo der ni lhung bar 'gyur/ /de nas gter dang phrad gyur nas/ /dbul ba kun las thar bar 0)'gyur/ /de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor pas/ /mngon shes mig dang ldan 'dod na/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor pa/ /rab tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mig sna lnga dang bdun pa'i zhag② /de yi zhun mar dud ②par bcas/ /'phrul gyi 'o ④ma dag gis sbyar/ /rdo rje pra yis zhag bdun bsgrubasti / /nyams dang drod rtags thob pa na/ /mig la legs par sngags kyis byug6) /skad cig stong gsum bcas pa yi7/ /phyogs bcu mngon par shes pas mthong ske/ /gang zag rgyud (8)ni brtag pa dang / /sdug bsngal drag pos zhen bzlog cing / /so so dag pa'i zhing khams kyis/ /yid bde grub par bya ba'i phyir / /mngon shes mtshan mas legs par bsgrub/ /rkang mgyogs thob par 'dod pa yis/ /bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms nas/ /brtan zhing bar chad med thob nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'dug ste/ /yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor te6)/ /skad cig dpag tshad brgyar 'gro ba/ /de la gnas bsam ma yengs pas/ /rlung gis khyab pa ji lta bar/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma yang —/ /skad cig tsam gyis bgrod par 'gyur/ /gal te rdzu 'phrul bzhi dag gis / /rig 7'dzin go 'phang 'gro 'dod na/ /sngon du dag pa'i don thob nas / /phyag rgya gsal bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha' liṅga 11zla ba la/ /hūm̐ las rdo rje cho ga gsum/ /rim par brtan yi pa'i dbang thob nas/ /dngas ma'i 102—468

phyag rgya la brten pas/ /rdo rje zlar tshibacas rlung brten pas/ /gang 'thad zhing ⑧du bskyod pa'i sa/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin pa yisal/ /zhing khams dag pa'i bya ba 'grub / /mdun gyi nam mkhar zla ba la/ /oṃ la cho ga'i tshul gyis bsgyur/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo zla rlung gis/ /dngas ma'i stobs kyis lus gnas pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rig 'dzin pa/ /zhing khams so sor bskyod ④byas nas/ /rang gi bsam pa bsgrub par bya/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi zla ba la/ /traṃ las skyes pa'i cho ga phyiyis/ /rin chen rlung zlar bcas pa yis/ /ting 'dzin drag po bskyod pa'i shugs/ /dngas ma lus yid bcas pa yis/ /dag pa'i zhing khams kun bskyod de/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par(zhe/ /pad+mar bcas pa'i zla ba bsgom9)/ /hriḥlas sna tshogs chos mchog sems/ /gsal brtan rlung gis stobs bstan pas/ /dngas ma'i lus yid gang yin pa/ /zhing bskyod bsam pa grub par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' (kyedabyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /gsal byed sna tshogs bcas pa bsgom / /a 'am ha las rang nyid kyi/ /las kyi phyag rgyar goms par bya/ /brtan nas dngas ma rlung stobs kyis/ /zhing khams gang du mngon bsams 6)pa'i / /'dod pa'i bsam 7pa 'grub 6stepar 'gyur/ /'dis 8ni 'byung zhing dbang med cing / /'chi med rlung la dbang (1 thob nas/ /cho 'phrul bzhi yis zil mnan nas/ /mngon shes gdug 7pa 'dul ba yis/ /las rnams mi 'grub gcig 7kyang med/ /de nas gzhan yang chags ldan rim/ /skal bas tsodaman dang sbyor bas zad/ /bde ba'i don 'dod dka' tu thub can/ /'di dag don la thabs kyis tsho dgod/ /thabs ldan lus kyi gong bu la/ /rang rang 102—469

cho ga'i thabs ldan na/ /bde chen gar thabs sna tshogs pa/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i ro yis byed①/ /bde chen longs spyod chos kyi gnas/ /sprul pa'i thig le bde ba'i ro/ /ma lus mkha' lnga'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rang lus ma bcos gnas nyid bde/ /brtul zhugs thig le gsum thob nas/ /sgrol ma dang ni thig le dang / /gnas dang thabs dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /bye brag brgyad cu ②kun 'dus pa'i/ /thabs kyis mtshon pa las byung bas/ /dngos grub cho ga sna tshogs 'grub/ /rang rten thig ler bcas pa yis/ /dngas ma'i rang bzhin khyab gnas pa/ /bskul ②ba thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /ma lus bskyod cing 'gugs par byed/ /dngas snyigs rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i/ /rlung gi thig les dbang sgyur 6)nas/ /'phro zhing 'dzag pa'i thig le nyid/ /rlung gis 'ching ba nyid yin te/ /thig le snyigs mar nyams gyur pa/ /thabs dang rlung bcud stobs ldan pas/ /pad+ma la ni chu bzhin no/ /rang 'byung ⑤jig le'i rang ⑥bzhin las/ /rten dang zag pa snyigs ma dang / /'khor ba'i rtsa dang sa bon dang / / log rtog gzig le zhen bcas pa/ /rang byung (minam mkha'i thig les 'jig97) /rang lus bde chen snying po la/ /nam mkha' sprin ltar mi phyed cing / /dngas snyigs bde ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /thig le chu dang 'o ma dang / /gnas pa rlung dang rten stobs kyis/ /dngas snyigs phye la dngas ma bstim/ /rang snying lus la 'od snang ba'i/ /phyi nang dngos rtog (7ma lus pa/ /rlung sogs 'khor lo'i 'phen stobs kyis/ /der mi (nyaganas par goms par bya/ /gang du sa bon snyigs bcas pa/ /nam mkha'i ye shes lnga 'bar bas/ /gang du rgyu bar bcas pa'i yidakyi/ /de ma thag par rnam par brlag /rlung dang rtsa dang thig 102—470

ler ①bcas/ /thabs kyis bskul ba'i ro ldan pas/ /ma lus thig le'i rang bzhin pas/ /mi mthun zhen pas rnam grol bas/ /rang sems rten bcas thig le ni/ /dngas ma'i ye shes blo ldan pa②/ /kun khyab bde 'byung snying po can/ /gsang ba'i rig pa'i gter kha 'byed/ /phyi nang rgyu ba thig ler bcas/ /snying nang bde bar 'bar gyur nas/ /rang lus rtags su bde chen 'bar/ /mngon shes rin chen rtsa la phog /rig pa'i mngon shes lnga ru 'char/ /de nas mi 'gyur stong pa'i rtsa/ /'gyur med kun snang rlung la thim/ /dman pas mi 'grub khyad par thabs/ /gsang ba'i thig le 'bab zhon ①gyis/ /rtsa bcud ting 'dzin 'brel ba'i stobs/ /bskal pa du ma'i stobs 'gags te/ /dngas ma'i ye shes rlung du grub④/ /phyin pa med par mthar song ba/ /bde chen goms pa'i stobs las gyur/ /bcud lnga 'dus pa'i thig le ni/ /ro lnga 'dres pa'i bde chen de/ /bsgom ⑤dang mthar phyin khyad par gyisagyi/ /bde ba chen po rigs mchog gnas/ /de nas gang yin brjod bya ba/ /zab mo kun rdzogs brtul zhugs can/ /dbang po dar zhing smin pa yi/ /chags can nyi zla 'dzin nus (7pas/ /spyi gtsug thig le'i 'khor lo dang / /gsang ba'i 'og min nus ldan pa/ /'byor pa'i rten can 'di nyid gnas/ /thabs dang rol pa'i khyad par dang / /ting 'dzin rlung gi dbang thob ste/ /'byung bzhi snyigs phye dngas dus su/ /nyi zla 'dres pa'i gar thabs kyis/ /lha mo rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /rol pa'i thabs kyis gang rtsen pa/ /bye brag brgyad cu (sheganyis 'dus pa'i / /pad+ma'i snying po kun bkug ste/ /thig le dpa' bo lnga yi stobs/ /mi sdod 'phro ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /102—471

bcings la gzung ①zhing gnas par bya/ /de dang rtse phrad gnyis bzlog pas/ /bde ba'i myu gu gso byas pas/ /tha mal zhen pa kun bral nas/ /rtog dang lhan cig gang skyes pa/ /dngas snyigs phye (kyeba'i nyams dag gis/ /snyigs ma bag chags zhen bcas pa/ /de yi stobs kyis gnas mi 'gyur/ /gsang ①ba'i thig le stobs ldan pas/ /rigs ngan tha mal zhen chags dang / /dran rtog ④ma lus pham 6)byas te(7/ /phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin du/ /ma lus dpang (7btsugs rgyal bar mdzad/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i snying po la / /dga' ba'i rol pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab gsal ba'i rol/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'dus pa'i tshe(kye/ /zag med yon tan gter chen de6)ske/ /gsang ba thabs kyis 8stobs las grub/ /bde chen snying po thig le'i ro//dbab (medang gzung bzlog 'byongs pa yis/ /rtsa gsum gang zhig thim pa'i tshe/ /bar chad med pa'i bde ba dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mngon shes dang / /skye shi med pa'i tshe 'thob 7cing / /mi 'gyur chos sku thig le la/ /rgyu ba spangs pa'i tshul gyis gnas/ /bde chen cho 'phrul dpag med yi pas/ /gsang ba'i zhing khams dag byed cing / /gsang ba chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /bde chen nyams dang dga' ba'i gar/ /chags pa'i sgra ni sna tshogs pas/ /ji srid nam mkha'i mthar thug par/ /glu 7ni sna tshogs len byed cing / /mdzes dang ngo tsha spangs pa'i tshul/ /mdog dmar rlan dang ldan pa yis/ /rol pa'i tshul ni sna tshogs kyis/ /rdo rje bcud chen zlar bcas pas/ /nyi ma chags pa dang bcas pa'i / /pad+ma'i snying po'i spongs tshamadzad cing / /dga' ba'i 'od dang 'khyud pa'i gar/ /rlung gi snying po rjod 7byed cing / /srid pa'i myu gu 'gog par 102—472

mdzad / /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba'i 0)me long gi rgyud chen po las / bsgrub ②pa ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rtog pa'i rgyal po ma lus pa/ /bya ba las kyi rim pa dag /bzhir ni gsal bar gsungs pa yin/ /dang por zhi ba'i rang bzhin te/ /de 'og rgyas pas rgyas phyir ro/ /rgyas pas dbang du bya ba dang ske/ /dbang mi 'du ba bsgral phyir te(gyi/ /thun mong khyad par yon tan rdzogasal/ /bya ba'i las la ma rmongs shing / /nus pa brtan pa'i rang bzhin gyis//rim pa ji bzhin brtsam ④par bya/ /gangs dkar 'dab (snyedang yid 'dang yib/ /zhi ba'i ljon shing me tog tshal/ /'bras ldan rgyas pa'i rang bzhin no/ /sum mdo ngam grog (pegating zab pas(she/ /dbang du bsdu ba'i gnas su bshad/ /dur khrod mtshan gcig 9༄rgya gram gnas/ /'byung po 'du sar drag po shis/ /zhi la sa gzhi yidakar ldan pa/ /zlum po sum 97rim oṃ dang bcas/ /'khor lo 'od dkar dang bcas pa/ /zhi ba'i thab kyi tsorang bzhin no/ /rgyas la ser po tsan+dan bcas/ /gru bzhi rim gsum tram̐ dang bcas/ /rin chen 'od zer 'phro bcas pa/ /thab ni rgyas par gsungs pa yin/ /dbang la sa dmar chags 'od can/ /zla gam gzhu 'dra pad+mas mtshan/ /rim gsum hri (rnyedang bcas pa ni / /dbang du bya ba'i thab yiyin no/ /drag po sa nag dur sol can/ /gru gsum rdo rje rtse gsum gdeng / /thod phreng tso'od nag rim gsum r+ghaṃ/ /drag po ⑩thab kyi rim pa yin/ /'o ma can dang gser can dang / /chags pa can dang tsher ma can/ /phrin yilas bzhi ni so so yi/ /yam shing bsreg yo shing nyid du 102—473

bshad / /liṅga kha dog so so ste/ /gnas kyang thab 0)khung bzhi dang mtshungs/ /mar dkar 'bras dkar ②til dkar dang / /nas dkar chan dang 'o ma zho/ /dngul phye gtor ma dkar por bcas/ /zhi ba'i bsreg chagator rdzas su bshad/ /mar rnying ④bu ram sbrang rtsi dang / /'bras dang chan rnams ldong ros dang / /me tog gser dang tsan+dan bcas/ / gser phye gtor ma ser por bcas ⑤'di dag rgyas pa'i rdzas nyid de/ /dpal dang gzi byin rgyas par 'gyur/ /tsha ba'i mar dang chang skyur dang / /ram bu pad+ma rak+ta dang / /'bras dmar tsan+dan zangs phye dang / /gtor ma dmar po dbang rdzas ⑥yin/ /tshil chen mar dang tsha ba gsum/ /klung chen sha khrag sran chan (/tshadang / /dug gsum thal chen dutsha ba'i mar/ /ske tshe phye gsum mi khrag dang / /ming 6)rus spel ⑩mar bcas gtor mas / /bsgral ba drag po'i rdzas su bshad/ /dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la / /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zlum po/ /logs la zhi ba'i lha bkod ⑩la/ /de bzhin gshegs par gsal bas gdab/ /gser ram ser po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo rtse rgya mdud gru bzhi bcas/ /logs la rgyas pa'i lha bsgoms te/ /rin chen nga rgyal bcas pas gdab/ /zangs sam byu biru dmar shing rnams/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla yigam/ /logs la dbang gi lha bkod tsol/ /chags pa rdo rjer gsal bas gdab/ /lcags sam nag po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur skegasum/ /logs la drag po'i lha bkod deyi/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal bas gdab/ /oṃ dang traṃ hri (1rtsu nyid las/ /'byung lnga'i rim pa gsal stengs sulha / /e baṃ ma ya r+ghaṃ 6)las bskyed( rte/ /gzhal 67yas zlum po gru bzhi dang ske/ /zla gam gru gsum ji bzhin dbyibs/ /kha dog rang gi tshul bzhin 102wa 474

bskyed / /rang rang sa bon ①gdan stengs ②la/ / 'od bzhi 'phro du'adu'i cho ga yis/ /las bzhi gtso bo skyilas bzhin bskyed/ /'khor mang dugatso bo'i cha 'dra ba/ /phyag mtshan rang rang ⑨thugs rtags la/ /las bzhi rtags kyi mtshan ma ste/ /kha dog las kyis dbye ⑦bar bshad/ /dbang bskur las bzhi rigs kyis brgyan/ /las ⑧bzhi 'od kyi 'phro 'du can/ /cho gas gsal bar bskyed byas la/ /spyan drang ⑨bstim sogs las rdzogs bya/ /las dang ting 'dzin bzhi nyid kyis/ /las bzhi rtse gcig ting 'dzin bya/ /gang du dmigs pa rtse gcig pas / /las bzhi bya ba'i cho ga dag /ma lus pa dag 'grub 'gyur na/ /phra mo'i las rnams smos ci dgosakyi/ /shar phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /dang ba'i yid ni mi g.yo bas/ /rdzogs pa'i skyil krung (nyal gnas te/ /ma rungs gdug pa zhi bar bya/ /lho phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /dga' ba'i 'du shes rtse gcig pasal/ /rin chen skyil krung skil gnas pas/ /dpal dang gzi byin 'phel bar bya / /nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas 3 te/ /chags dang zhen pa rtse gcig pa/ /pad+ma'i skyil krung tshul gnas te/ /ma lus dbang du bsdu bar bya8/ /byang phyogs nyid du kha bltas te/ /khros pa'i sems kyis so bca' 7zhing / /rus ⑩sbal dang ni gyad stabs kyis/ /gdug pa bsgral te lam du gzhug(nye /so so'i sngags kyi rim pa dag /snga dro zhi ba'i las byas te/ /gung la rgyas pa nyid du bya/ / dgongs ka 6)dbang gi dus nyid de/ /drag po nam gyi gung la bya/ /nam zla dus bzhir bsgrubs pas na/ /nges par las bzhi 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ che ge mo shīn+ti ne ku ru swā hā/ swā (nyache ge mo puṣ+ṭi ( giku ru swā hā/ hrī ( nache ge mo pā shaṃ khri raku ru ( sheswā ahā/ hūṃ che ge mo mār ya phaṭa/ liṅga'i gnas kyang las bzhi'i 102—475

dbyibs / / dgug dang phur bu bzhi btab la/ / ril bu'am lhag ①ma gtubs phyipa de / /so so lha yi zhal du bstabasasti/ /rtse mo zhi byed yal ga ⑤rgyas / /sdong po dbang la rtsa ba drag /kha dang mngar skyur ༷tsha ba'i shing / /ro yi mchod pa de bzhin te/ /rgyud bzang ⑦rgyal po smad 'tshong ma/ /shan ⑧pa'i khyim nas me khyablangs te/ /las dang mthun ⑩pa'i ra skyes mnan/ /sa bon bzhi las rim pa bzhin/ /pa pa ka dang dbang chen dang / /gzi (7byin can dang 'joms byed bzhi/ /sku mdog las bzhis phye ba ste/ / gun dhe 8sgrom dang zhags pa dang / /rtse gsum g.yon pa bgrang phreng nyid/ /rigs bzhis las bzhi byin brlabs dbu/ /spyan drang mchod ston alas rdzogs nas/ /lto bar r+ghaṃ tsolas gzhal yas su/ /las dang mthun 7pa'i lha bskyed la/ /rang rang rtog pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /bsreg yidang bro gar las byas pas/ /gang yang 'grub par the tshom med7/ /zhe sdang can dang nga rgyal can/ /sdug bsngal gdug ()sems nad gzir ba/ /de 'dra zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zhi ba'i las ni rtsom pa yin/ /tshe thung nad mang dpal longs spyod/ /phongs 67dang nyam nga 6 1'jigs pa dag( 7/dngas snyigs zad nas snying por thim/ /thig le mi shigs so bcud 'dus pa/ /stong nyid thig le'i ngang du 'gag /rgyu ba'i rlung la dbang thob cing mngon shes skye 'jig 6 thob bral bas/ /bde chen nam mkha'i ye shes nyid/ /rdo rje thig le 'gyur 'jig med/ /steng dang 'og las gang sbyar 6 )bas/ /sku gsung ( stethugs kyi pho brang dag /bde chen til 'bru bcud bzhin du/ /nyi zla gnas pa'i bar du 'bar/ /'bab pa thig le zla ba'i gzugs/ /kha bcad rlung gis gzung tsho 5bya zhing / /'og gis phul zhing steng gis drang / /ma lus bde chen khyab 102—476

par gnas/ /mi rtog gsal ba 0)mthar phyin pa/ /seng phrug zla ba rdzogs pa ltar / /thabs dang ting 'dzin sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba'i ye shes chen po la/ /ma lus yon tan rdzogs par gnas/ /chags can brtul zhugs bral ba yi/ /lus dang dran rtogs ②bag chags bcas/ /rigs dang rigs min gang yang rung —/ /sgo gsum ma lus bcas pa dag /steng sgo'i gdul bya des 'dul yin/ /dang por gsang ba'i rim thob pas/ /rlung dang thig le'i las goms nas/ /bde chen byang chub sems kyi ro/ /sems lnga'i tshul gyis gang snang ba/ /g.yo thob brtan pa'i nyams nyid kyis/ /lus dang phyi nang dran rtogs dubacas/ /nam mkha'i gzugs can nyid du skyekha/ /lus dang snang bar bcas pa yi/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar mi phyed pa/ /bde chen thig le a 'byedang gnas/ /thig le stong pa'i ri mo can/ /gsal bar shes pa rgyu bas mngon/ /'og nas bskul zhing steng nas mnan/ /dngas snyigs bsre ba'i thabs la 'jug /bde ba'i rlung can yaṃ gi (ye sgo/ /bskyod (7pa'i sbyor bas gyen du phul/ /rgyu ba rlung gi snying po can/ /dpa' bo lam nas thur du 'then/ /rig (kyepa'i ye shes gnas pa'i rlung / /stong nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su thim/ /phyi nang rgyu ba chad pa dang / /rig pa thig le'i ngang la gnas/ /bde ba'i rtags ni 'byung 'gyur te//'dar dang rngul dang ba spu ldang / /sgra dang lus bde rgyug pa dang / /dgod ⑨dang brgyal sogs gang byung ba/ /brtan dang sbyang ba'i cho ga bya/ /mi mthun tsolog pa'i chos brtags na/ /thabs kyi rim pa'i cho ga yis/ /gdon dang spos dang gnon 67pa dag /ji ltar rigs par brtag yi par bya/ /rang lus thig le'i nyams myong la/ /bar chad med par gsal 'jug payon/ /tha mal zhen pa 102—477

bsgyur hu)ba dang / /bde ba'i dbang phyug smin pa dang / /dran rtogs ②rgyud sogs zhi ba dang / /bde chen rgyas pas khyab pa dang / /rlung dang bde ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /thams cad dbang du sdud pa dang / /dran rtog a yi ngang ①du gnas/ /'di ni nang gi rim pa yin/ /de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa las/ /gsang ba'i phrin ④las bzhir 'byung ⑤ba/ /dka' yithub can dang tha mal dang / /thun mong lam las bzlog ⑦phyir ro/ /'dod chags zhen cing dbang po smin/ /tshad ldan yum dang bcas pa yini/ /bde chen dgon 6)pa thig le'i gnas/ /yon tan khyad par kun du rdzogs/ /gnyis med 'khril ba'i ngo bo ni/ /bde ba chen po 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gsang ba'i bha ga rgyas pa ni/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag tshul bzhin dang / /nus pa byin brlabs 7gang ldan pa/ /gsang ba'i thig le'i tshul la gnas/ /pad+ma gsang ba'i thab khung du/ /gsang ba'i sbyin sreg (nyugang phul ba/ /lo dang zla ba ma yin par / /myur du bde chen lus su 'gyura'i/ /thabs dang shes rab las byung tu)ba'i / /dngas snyigs bcud dang bag chags dang / /nyi zla khu bar bcas pa ni//bde chen gsang ba mchod pa'i rdzas/ /gdung dang bde ba bral ba dang / /zhen rtog de nyid chags pa yi/ /rang gi liṅga de nyid la/ /gsang ba'i phur ba bzhi rdzogs pa/ /gsang ba'i yul la btab pa yis/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ting 'dzin la/ /las bzhi ma btsal rdzogs par ldan/ /rol pa'i tshul dang thig le gnyis / /pad+ma rdo rje snying po'i rtsa/ /nyams dang sbyor tshul gang yin pa/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba'i dus su blta/ /gnas pa rtsa yi tshul dag ni/ /kha dog dbyibs losogs tha dad pas/ /mchod rdzas nyi zlar bcas kun la/ /gzar bu 102—478

gnyis bcas thab ①phul bas②/ /thig le chen por 'bab par 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i don la dga' ba dang / /rig pa'i brtul gzhugs spyod pa dang / /dbang po dar cing dusmin pa dang / /thig le'i don la mos pa dang / /rlung dang bcud la goms pa yis⑤/ /rnal 'byor pho mor yibacas pa kun/ /dran rtog phyi ma bcas pa'i yid/ /gdul bya'i don du de bshad do/ /gang dag thabs la mkhas pa dang / /dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /thabs dang sbyor ba la brtson ④zhing / /nyi zla rtse sbyor dbang thob nas/ /gzung duzlog 'byangs ⑨pa'i gar thabs kyis/ /dngos po lhan cig skyes pa'i don/ /sems lnga'i tshul gyis gsal bar skye/ /nyi zla zhin pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / /rgyu ba'i rlung la dbang thob pas / /khams bzhi 'dus pa'i snying po las/ /bde chen thig le mi rtog ⑩pa/ /thabs kyis da ltar mngon du snang / /thabs dang bral ba'i slob dpon gyis/ /skal med las kyis dman pa la/ /dbang dang brgyud 7pa bral ba yis/ tshig dang rigs pas 7ci bstan kyang / /rigs ngan rgyal sar bzhag pa ltar/ /bdag phung gzhan brlag tso'ajig par 'gyur/ /gang du gsang ba'i thig le nyid//gsang ba'i lam lngar yinyams skyes pas/ /zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mkha' 'gro gsum la gang brten menas/ /ye shes thig le rgya dpag medabya/ /rim pas ⑩mthar thug gnas su 'ugyur/ /gang zhig 'di la 'dris (nyegoms pas/ /rgyu ba thig ler thim pa dang / / dran rtog yi nam mkhar ( — )gsal ba dang / /bde chen sngon du smin pa yis/ /'chi med sangs rgyas sa la sbyor/ /'jigs pa kun las grol ba dang / /lha mo tshogs kyis byin brlabs nas/ /rol rtsed sna tshogs sgyur (nyebyed cing / /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med cing / /longs spyod rdzogs 102—479

'du shes bsgyur ba'i phyir/ /drag po bsgral ba'i phrin ①las brtsam/ /gang yang rung ba'i dngos po la/ /dang po mi mthun (mizhi bar bya/ /de nas yon tan rgyas par bya/ /de nyid dbang bsdu ( )las la sbyar/ /gal te dbang du ma gyur na/ /drag pos gzir te bsgral bar bya/ /gal te log par ltung gosrid pas/ /'og min gnas su phaṭa kyis 'phang ⑤/ /nges par 'grub 'gyur gdon mi za/ /dang por sngon ⑥bya'i las kyis ni/ /nus dang mi nus khyad par brtag⑦ /de nas nus pa thob pa ste/ /de nas bde ba'i rtsal thob nas/ /thogs pa med pa'i phrin (kyelas 'grub/ /zag med lam la goms (9dasbyangs pas/ /cho 'phrul bzhi dang phrin tshulas bzhi/ /gdul bya zhing dang nus mthu dang / /byin brlabs rtsal gyi (nyakhyad par 'phags/ /mthar phyin sku lnga'i zhing thob pas/ /ma rtsal chu dang rlabs 7bzhin du/ /dpag med yon tan ngo bo'i phyir/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin (nyalas yin/ /las dang nyon mongs gdug pa dang / /sdug skibasngal rtog pa ji snyed pa/ /cho ga thabs dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /lhan ne lhang nger zhi bar 'gyur / /nga rgyal rin chen gzi 8brjid kyis/ /dpal dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /tshe dang lang tsho stobs ldan zhing / /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam / /'dod chags rdo rje ting 'dzin gyis/ /bdud dang gdug pa rgyal po dang glu/ /lha dbang srin po mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag na rdo rje'ang dbang du 'gyur/ /zhe sdang rdo rje ting 'dzin gyis/ /cho ga rdzas dang sngags 9ldan pas/ /chos sku rdo rje'ang 'jig 'gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /rang lus bde chen kun gyi dbyings/ /rang lus thig le'i thabs mkhas pas/ /sbyor ba rlung gi goms stobs can/ /dkyil 'khor nang la gnas gyur pas/ /nyams kyis 102—481

bshad / /de nyid nang du rtsa 'khor lo/ /thig les nang du nyams skyed ①pa/ /rim pa 'di ni nang du bshad②/ /dbang thob ①sbyangs pa ma rtogs ④pa/ /skal ngan rigs chad yul min pa⑤/ /gsang bas gsang ba zhes bshad do/ /dang por blo ldan gang zag ni/ /ma lus bden pa dbyer med la/ /rang bzhin rig pa'i gtan tshigs kyisaX/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /thabs dang shes gnyis med pa'i don/ /ye nas sangs rgyas rdzogs pa nyid/ /de nyid dus gsum ma skyes pa/ /gang la brten ⑦nas rtogs pa la/ /lam gyi yan lag kun rdzogs te/ /sa bcu rim par (shem bkod rdzogs/ /ma lus yon tan rang shar bas / /thams cad ma lus ma 6)'da' la/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu nyid / /dbang po cig car yispyod yul yin/ /gang su blo dang mos pa dang / /rtogs chung mtshan ma dga' ba la/ /thun mong sgo mthun ⑩khyad par can/ /rim pa'i rnal 'byor bslab 8par bya/ /dang por phyi nang snod bcud kun/ /rang sa nyid na tsomi dmigs pa/ /ma bcos ma bsal ④mi gnas pa/ /dngos po ci la'ang 8mi brtag ⑩cing / /de nyid la yang mi rtog pa/ /'dzin rtog zhen pa mi gnas par/ /bsam dang bsam bya med tshul gyis/ /bdag gzhan phyi nang ma lus pa/ /gang gi ngo bor (nyem grub pa/ /ci la'ang yonyemi gnas sbyor ba yis /rang sar mi rtog ngo bo nyid/ /bcos pa med pa'i tshul du bsgom/ /gal te mtshan ma'i rgyu ba dag /chu las rnyog pa'i tshul byung na/ /ma bcos rang bzhin bzhag (7pa yis/ /ma lus rtog med de bzhin nyid/ /rang bzhin bzhag pas dag par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' dag par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /sprin kyang rang 'byung 6 )dag pa ltar/ /byung tshor dran rtog sastom lus pa/ /chos nyid stong pa'i rang 102—483

bzhin no/ /gang du snang srid ma lus pa/ /phyi nang med pa'i sems nyid de/ /de nyid stong pa'i rang bzhin du/ /goms shing nus pa brtan pa'i tshe/ /de nyid rnal 'byor de nyid ni/ /stong pa chen po rnal 'byor yin/ /sgo gsum byed spyod ma bcos pa/ /ma brtags mi rtog cir mi gnas/ /'di ni rnal 'byor rtse gcig pas/ /bya ba spangs pa'i spyod pa yin/ /de nas de las langs pa'i tshe/ /sgyu ma chu zla smig rgyu 6)dang / /'ja' tshon dbu ②ba chu bur ltar/ /snang yang dngos por gnas ma yin/ /rig ①pa phyi nang ma lus pa④/ /stong pa'i cho (ge'aphrul snang du zad/ /ma lus rig pa'i ngo bo ste/ /de yang sgyu (bema'i rang bzhin ltar / /(7zhen (nyachags med dzi7pa'i tshul du bsgom7/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ni / /dpag med ngo bor rang snang yang / /byin brlabs 7cho 'phrul rang snang ba / /de ltar ma rtogs dman pa la/ /rang 'byung tu snying rjer 'char ba'i phyir/ /snying rje chen po rnal 'byor yin/ /'gro ba gang dang gang dag las/ /snying rje chen po gang gzigs pas/ /sna tshogs mdzad pa'i tshul nyid kyis/ /de snyed spyod la mtha' yas te/ /don dang mthun pa tu)'ba' zhig ston/ /tha mal ba dang thabs nyid dang / /lus ngag yid kyis ci 'tsham 'a)par/ /don 'gyur spyod pa bsam mi khyab/ /gang du byams dang snying rje yis/ /ma khyab ming gi rnal 'byor te/ /theg pa chen po'i rigs chad cing / /dman pa'i rigs su gyur pa yina'i / /rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /nam mkha'i ris dang dbyer med ltar/ /ma lus rang rgyud bral ba yiyi ngo bo bden min brdzun 1 7pa min/ /chos rnams ming tsam dngos po med/ /sgo gsum 'di ltar brtan pa ni/ /thugs rje chen po spyod pa yin/ /de nas sgyu ma'i 102wa 484

rang bzhin nyid/ /rang bzhin gnyis med rig pa ni①/ /yi ge rtsu du gsal bar bsgom/ /phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa/ /'phro 'dus tsū du gsal bar bya//rdul phran de snyed 'dus pa las/ /thig le mi dmigs stong par blta/ /ma dang a las nyi zla'i gdan/ /gang bsgril hūm̐ bcas gsal bar bya rang rang gsung yang 'gal ba med/ /sgril ma'i snying po phyag mtshan te/ /'phro 'du phra ②mo'i rang bzhin sku/ /gsal la skyon dang bral bar bsgom(kye/ /de nas rang rang tshad gyur pal/ /rigs pa'i phyag rgya chen po nyid/ /zhi dang khro bo skabs nyid ⑤du / /ji ltar 'thad par bsgom par bya/ /yang na zhal gcig (7phyag gnyis te/ /yang na zhal gsum phyag drug bsgom/ /gnas gcig 6)gnas gsum gnas lngar yang / /yan lag lha ni tshang bar bsgom/ /goms (kyenas bstims 6)te spyod yul kun / /de ltar gsalabar brtag par bya/ /rtsa ba gcig 7pa'i lha bsgom (nyapa/ /phyag rgya gcig 8pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ /sgo gsum bsgom la rab 'bad yonyepas/ /rnam par g.yeng ba'i chos spyod 'das/ /ma lus rtsa ba'i spyod pa ste/ /phyogs gcig khapa yi spyod par gsungs/ /de nas rtog pa'i yan lag dag /gnyis ka thabs dang shes rab tu/ /brtags te de ltar bsgom par bya/ /'od zer 'phro ba 'bru gsum nyid/ /yang na ye shes lnga nyid de/ /gnas gcig 7snying por gnas par bya/ /de bzhin gtso bo gtso mo dang / /sems dpa' tsodang ni sems ma dang / /khro bo khro mo sprul pa dang / /yid chos dag la'ang shes par bya//zhal dang phyag dang lha grangs dang / /tshom bu spros pas spros bcas yin/ /sku gsung tu thugs dang yon tan las/ /tshom bu lnga la khro yo bcas bsgom/ /yang na sku gsung yi/thugs ldan pa'i/ /tshom bu shu rigasum dang bcas pa yi/ /khro bo khro mo 102—485

'khor du bsgom/ /rigs kyi gtso ste thugs kyi mchog /khro bo tshogs dang bcas pa yi/ /mos pa'i tshul dang sbyor ba yis/ /tshom bu gcig pa'i lha rnams bsgom//slob dpon mthar nye'i lam gnas pas0)/ /rgyang grags dpag tshad la sogs pa//rdo rje thig tshad bor tsam gyis/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ldan pa/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsungs/ /dang po rgyang grags ②dkyil 'khor te/ /de nas dpag tshad dkyil 'khor nyid/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni bsam yas par//sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bsgom/ /de nas yo byad lnga ldan pas/ /ting 'dzin mos pa spyod mthun (5)pa'i/ /skye bo tsam du grangs mthun pas / /tshom bus 'dod pa'i don bsgrub bya/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba yi/ /pho mo 'dus pa'i grangs mnyam par/ /yo byad 'dus pa'i tshogs ldan pas/ /dgon par 'khor khang rab brtsigs te/ /rang rang thabs dang shes rab tu/ /brtags te yo byad longs spyad cing / /rdo rje glu bro gar thabs kyis/ /zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /tshe la dbang sgyur tshor zag med thob/ /de nas brgya (6)phrag bcu drug gis/ /sku lnga lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /skye bo mdza' ba kun tshogs pa/ /rnal 'byor 'dus pa'i tshogs zhes bya/ /'byor pa'i longs spyod tshang ba ni/ /bde ba'i longs spyod tshogs su bshad / /lha dang dam can kun 'dus pas97/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshogs su gsungs / /thams cad spyod pa mi 'dzin pas/ /(2)tshogs gnyis rgyun du rdzogs byed pas/ /tshogs chen po ru nges par bshad/ /bar chad med pa'i lam rdzogs pas/ /rig pa'i skyes bu thub pa med/ /lha mi cha byad 'dzin mod kyi/ /'byung lnga cho 'phrul dbang sgyur thob/ /zhing dang longs spyod dag pa yis/ /102—486

gong nas gong du mnyam par sbyor/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin gyi sku/ /zhing khams kun la gnas par byed/ /gal te mtshan mar zhen dbang gis/ /rtogs pa'i stobs ni chung gyur na/ /byang chub phyag rgya rdo rje sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa/ /cha 6)lugs mngon du byung na (geyang / /zhi ba de nyid mthong ba min / /gang du sbyar ba'i yum rnams kyang / /thun mong lam dang skabs gnyis su / /nus pa'i khyad par che chung gis/ /phrin chalas bzhi ru bshad pa ni/ /dkar mo bong chung skad che ( ril/ /bzhin lus gtsug phud phyigayas su 'khyil/ /yan lag phra 'jam skad gsal zhing / /rlung khar lci bas zhi ba bya/ /zla dang yan lag mang ba (5)dang / /phra zhing bshan la gzangs (7su ring / /bzhin lus ser zhing (9gru bzhir gnas/ /rnam 'phyangs 5)sha dang nu ma rgyas/ /'phel ba'i dus su 'di dag gzung kyi/ /bzhin mdog pad 'dra sog tunyeka la/ /smin dkyus ⑫ring la stod ( smad phyed/ /lus dang chu rlung dri zhim zhing / /bde ba ldan zhing yan lag med/ /'di ni sdud dzapa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /nag mo gru gsum rtsid mgo ma/ /khro gnyer byis pa'i lus ldan zhing / /gtum zhing brlang tshig 'dzem pa med/ / gtsang sme'i rtog 7bral gsod par bshad/ /gang du nus pa brtan thob pa/ /de dag sa nas sar sbyong ba/ /rig pa'i skyes bu dam pa nyid/ /rnal 'byor rim pa'i lung ldan pa/ /ma skyes mnyam la dbang sgyur yizhing / /ma lus gsal bar mthar phyin pa'o/ /rang rig ye shes rgyud don phyir/ /tu rang snang rig pa mngon byas pa/ /rig yige'adzin mchog ste lhun grub pa'o/ /ting 'dzin nus pa'i mthu med kyang / /sa sbyong sems dpa' bskyed 47du med/ /bder 6 nigashegs nyid dang spyod yul gcig gle /rig pa'i skyes bu'i lung thob pa'o/ ge/ /102—487

gal te 'byung ba'i lus 'jig na/ /bdag nyid sgo gsum lhar 6)lta zhing / /'byung ba bsags pa'i lus las grol/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya chen por smin/ /khyung phrug sbubs dang bral ba ltar/ /ma lus phyag rgya sgyu ②ma'i mchog /rnam par smin ces de la brjod(mi/ /zag pa zad pa rdo rje lus/ /phyin cad ④'gyur 'jig chos dang bral/ /bde ba chen po (gelung thob pas/ /zag bcas bslab pa'i chos dang bral/ /zhing la dbang sgyur sprul pa'i lus/ /ting 'dzin longs spyod dpag tu med/ /bsgrubs 96)pa'i nus pa gang brtan pa/ /rdo rje lus gyur 'jig pa med / /'jig 7pa lnga bral zag pa zad/ /dbang sgyur (8)gsum la dbang thob pas / /bde ba longs spyod dpag tu med/ /grangs med bskal par don byed cing ske/ /mthong bas de bzhin gnyis med rigs/ /rgyal tshab dzi〉skyes bu sa sbyong ⑩ba / /phyi nang snod bcud ma lus pa/ /nam mkha' lta (1bur dpag med cing / /mtha' dbus bsam pa'i rgyun las 'das/ /'jigs bral dbugs phyin mya ngan 'das / /rang snang dpag med zhal mthong bas/ /gzhan du blta ba'i yul dang bral / /ting 'dzin rig pa goms (1nyapa'i mthu/ /mtshan ma sdug po yul las 'das / /'jig rten stong phrag dbang sgyur zhing / /gnyis med phyag rgya chen po'i rigs/ /nam mkha' mthar 1 thug med pa ltar/ /bsgoms dang nus pa'i rtsal stobs kyis/ /bag chags mtshan ma'i tshang tshing la/ /ting 'dzin rig pa'i me byung thubs/ /zhing khams rgya bral dpag med du/ /ting 'dzin rig 8pas gang sbyangs pa/ /bsgoms dang ting 7'dzin rig pa yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lung thob pa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin yin/ /de nas rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs shing / /ye shes lha mo rol dbang gis/ /mthar phyin rig pa'i skyes bu 102—488

ste / /zhing khams bye khyakeba'i dbang thob cing / /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyi sras/ /dbang dang cho 'phrul kun thob pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar dgongs pas khyab/ /mnyam bzhag ②rjes thob khyad par gyis/ /rgyal ba'i lung mnod bka' dul gnas / /zhing khams dag par skyikun spyod kyang / /rmad 'byung gsang ⑤ba'i rang bzhin la/ /spyod kyang lta ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /phyogs bral nam mkha' mi mthong bas/ /dbang dang dgongs pas mthar phyin 'gyur/ /dbang dang dam tshig brtul zhugs te/ /dang po bslab ⑥pa mthar phyin cing / /thig le rdzogs par 'dod pa yis/ /gsang ba nang gi gdon la sbyar(8)/ /thun mong bya ba mthar phyin nas/ /lus dang spyod yul bcas pa dang / / lha yi 6)rnal 'byor ma lus pa/ /bde chen thig le nyid du blta/ /lha dang bde bar mnyam sbyor bas/ /thig le bde bar snang ba nub/ /sku bzhi dkyil 'khor khams thig le/ /dngas ma lnga ru mnyam sbyor bas7/ /ngo bo dang ni rkyen dag gis/ /thabs kyi rim pa bskul 9nyalas shes/ /bde ba'i thig le nyams myong ba/ /mi rtog bde ba cha shas med / /mi shigs thig le kun gyi skabadag /stong nyid 'brel pa'i ri mo can/ /tha mal bya ba kun bral ba/ /spyod pa nyid du bstan pa yin/ /thig le bzhu ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'dzag 'bar thim gang bde ba ni/ /sa yang bcu gsum bde bas brgyan/ /lus kun khyab pa'i thig le shum/ /til 'bru bcud kyis khyab pa ltar/ /ma lus khyab pa'i ros gang ba/ /ma lus 'od dang snying po ltar/ /snang srid thig le chen po nyid/ /bde ba chen pos khyab par gsal/ /ma lus 'dus pa'i thig le ni/ /khams lnga 'dres pa'i snying po ste/ /mi shigs thig le bde ba'i bcud/ /ma lus bde ba'i rgyas btab 12pas/ /nam mkha'i 97)ye shes 102—489

cir yang gsal/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ste/ /thig le gcig 6)gis kun khyab pas/ /bde chen snying rjes gcig (btu 'khyil/ /de nyid bde chen phyag rgya ste/ /nang gi phyag rgya gcig par bshad/ /de nyid nges par las rung bas/ /thig le bde chen dang bcas pa'i/ /bye brag ①brgyad cu ma lus par/ /so so'i thig ler sku 'phros shing / /khams lnga ye shes ro dang bcas/ /sa bon thig le bde bas brgyan/ / mi rtog 47thig le thugs mchog sgra/ /rang lus smin nas snang bar spro/ /gang nas gang la spros gyur pa/ /de srid thig le'i phyag rgya ste/ /bde ba'i thig le grangs (57las 'das/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs/ /mi phyed ro yis gang khyab pas/ /grangs 'das bde chen tshogs rdzogs nas/ /ma lus bde ba'i phyag rgyar snang / /gang de de yis ⑥rgyas btab pas/ /de nyid bde chen thig ler smin/ /rnam pa phyi nang snyigs mar bcas/ /bde chen thig le'i ngo bor smin/ /snyigs ma 'byung ba'i lus las 'das/ /snying po (7bar chad med pa'i lus/ /thig les tha ma'i rin snod gang bas/ /ma lus bde ba chen por smin / /de nas thabs dang ting 'dzin dang / /rlung gi 'dren 6)pa'i stobs ldan pa / /rin chen lung gi thig ler zhugs/ /skad cig mngon 7shes lngar yo)smin cing / /'gro ba ris dang thar par 'gyur/ /mi shigs a la thig le thim/ /'byung 'jug med pa'i rlung 'thob cing / /(nya'agyur 'jig med tu pa'i lus la gnas / /'phel 'grib med pa'i bde ba nyid/ /snang ba thig le nyid du ste/ /thig le thung ngu a ru thim/ /gnyis med bde ba cha shas bral/ /'di ni zag med rang byung ba/ /rkyen dang bral ba'i bde chen nyid/ /dper na me yidang tsha ba 'am/ /rgya mtsho dang ni rlan bzhin no/ /rlung dang thig le rig pa dang / /102—490

tshe dang longs spyod 'byung 0)ba dang / /'dod lnga kun la dbang sgyur thob/ /bde ba'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /ma lus zag med thig le ste/ /rgya bral rig pa'i thig le nyid/ /snyigs ma'i zag pa rlung zad ②pas/ /ting 'dzin bde chen thig ler gsal/ /rig pa bde chen ror bgasal bas/ /ci mthong bde chen phyag rgya nyid / /'du bas sgyur ba'i spyod yul lam/ /mun 'gyur dug rtsi ji bzhin du/ /rgya dang bral ba'i zhing khams dag /bde chen phyag rgya chen por 'gyur/ /gang dag bsgoms ④pa'i skyes bu ni/ /tha mal pa dang brkam chags pa/ /rnam pa'i spros pa ma lus pa/ /bsgoms dang ched du ma byas par/ /bde chen thig ler lhun gyis gruba'abye/ /dper na chu dang rlabs bzhin nam46)/ /rgya mtshor phyin pa'i 'du shes ltar/ /goms pas bde chen gsal mthar phyin/ /rkyen dang gnod pa ma lus pa/ /reg dang mthong thos dran pas kyang / /bde chen thig le nyams su 'bar / /bskal pa du mar gnas gyur cing / /'byung ba lnga dang spyod yul kun//rang lus bde bar bsre ba 'grub/ /gsang ba'i lam la goms byed na/ /mtshon byed rig ri pa'i bde ba yis/ /lhan 58cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rtogs/ /mthar phyin lam gyi rim pa 'grub/ /dbang po dar zhing chags pa dang / /bde chen mos pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /e dang baṃ la gnas pa yi(9)/ /byang chub rdo rje dril las 'byung / /dngos po lhan cig skyes pa yis/ /ma lus bde bar rtogs byas la/ /phyi nang sbyor ba'i cho ga yis/ /gang zhig rtags dang ldan pa'i tshe/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya bzhi ldan pas7/ /bde chen mchog la rol par bya/ /ye shes nyi zla mnyam ldan /lhapas/ /re dogs chad pa'i thig le 'byung / /lhung med gnas dang thim pa dang / /bdag po gdung can phrad pa las/ /nyin mtshan 102—491

bral ba'i snang ba ltar/ /dus gcig 0)nyi zla shar ba'i tshe/ /ma lus bde bas khyab gyur na/ /g.yo ba med pa'i thig le 'char/ /gal te nyams pa'i ltas byung na(mi / /thabs dang nyams dang rol (0pa yis/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bya/thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /nyi zla 'dres pa'i thig le nyid/ /dngos bral lhan cig skyes pa nyid/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phyag rgya yin/ /lhan cig skyes la gnas pa'i tshe/ /ma lus bde chen ro gcig pas/ /bde chen phyag rgya gcig liku gnas/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i thig le nyid/ /sa ya ⑤bcu gsum phrag gnyis rtsa / /nyi zla 'dres pa'i gar thabs kyis/ /so so bde ba'i pho brang du/ /thig les gang bar spros pa'i tshe/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga/ /nyams myong ro yis rgyas btab bo/ /lus kyi bde ba mthar phyin nas/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las 'das pa'i/ /rig pa'i bde ba la gnas bya/ /gal te nyams na bsam pa 'am / /blta dang mnyan pa la sogs pas/ /bar chad med par bsgom par bya/ /rig pa bde bar gang smin pas/ /sgo gsum bde ba chen por smin/ /spyod yul rlung dang thig ler bcas/ /goms pa'i thabs la dbang sgyur 96)bas/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa yi77)/ /thig le rlung la dbang sgyur (8zhing / /lha mo mi mo gnod sbyin mo/ /mkha' 'gro rnams la dbang byed nus/ /thig le dbab dang 'dzin pa dang / /zlog dang sbyor la dbang sgyur (9)te/ /gal te mkha' la 'phros pa'i tshe/ /dngos grub lam dang bral ba yin/ /phyin cad 7mchod dang nus pa sbyin/ /rang gi skabs ni ma gtogs yinyapa/ /gzhan du thig le mi ltung zhing / /dbang sgyur lam la goms par bya/ /nyi zla 'dres pa'i bde ba nyid/ /zag med snying por thim pa'i tshe/ /sems kyi bde bar rang snang zhing / /sems 102wa 492

kyi bde ba bar chad med/ /gsal byed stobs dang bral ba'i tshe/ /ma lus bde chen phyag rgya ste/ /lus 6)sems (snyemanyam du gnas pa nyid/ /tshad dang rgya dbyings ro las ②'das/ /dpag med bde ba'i rol mo ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgyes chen te/ /thig le sa bon zag ④pa bral/ /bde chen nyams myong rgyun mi chad(pe/ /rang nyid thig ler nyams myong bas/ /snying po'i thig le bral ba med / /phra zhing rdul bral dri ma med/ /rdo rje thig le dril bu nyid/ /'bad rtsol med par rang snang ba/ / bral thob (6)med pa'i ngo bor gnas/ /gang du yon tan tshogs kyis rab rgyas pa/ /bde chen chu rgyun lta bu'i rgyun las byung / /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs bdag gzhan lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan na med de rang nyid snang bar zad/ /rang bzhin gnas phyir gzhan nas 'ong ba med/ /zhen pa bzlog pas bdag zhal bdag gis mthong / /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud chen po las lam gyi khyad par ma lus pa bshad pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /ma lus kun gyi bsgrub bya nyid/ /phyogs bcu ma lus rdul snyed kyi/ /che ba'i yon tan bshad par bya/ /mthar phyin lnga yi rang bzhin ni( ne+e/ /rtogs dang 'bras bur gnas (shemod kyi/ /mthong dang goms dang grub pa nyid/ /thun mong 'bras bur yang dag bshad/ /yang dag mthar 5)phyin 'bras bur niyi/ /thabs chen thabs las byung ba yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /dpag med yon tan lhun rdzogs pa/ /tshad dang dmigs pa las 'das pa/ /bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa ste/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ltar 102—493

dpag med pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 0)ye shes ni/ /ma lus mchog gi gter gyur pa/ /zad 'phel med pa'i nor bu ste/ /ma lus kun la mnyam du gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /rgya dbyings tshad las 'das pa yiphyi/ /dag dang ma dag ci ①snang yang / /blang dor phyogs ris yongs kyis ④med/ /rang 'byung (nya'od gsal maṇ+ḍal la(6nye/ /ma lus gcig ⑦gi rang bzhin te/ /thugs rje'i (0byin brlabs (she)tshad med pas/ /ma lus bsam pa skong bar mdzad/ /rang byung 0ye shes lhun grub ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi ngo bo bas/ /ma lus phyogs med rang snang yang / /zhen dang ched du byas pa med/ /sa dang lam la sogs pa yi/ /theg pa kun gyi 'bras bu ni/ /rang rang ltos pa'i mthar thug kyang / /che mchog lhun grub mnyam dang bral/ /skad cig nyid la (7lhun rdzogs pa'i / /sangs rgyas dpag med yon tan rnams/ /rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /ye shes lha mo rol dbang gis/ /nyi zla'i bde ba mngon ()thob ste/ /rdo rje 'chang gi sa la bkod1 / /dpag med rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba'i gdul bya mtha' yas pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyang de bzhin te/ /bzhugs tshul dpag med rnam par snang / /che ba'i yon tan lhun rdzogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas drug pa'i rang bzhin te/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs mtshan pa yisayi/ /bde chen ye shes rgyas par gnas/ /bcu drug zhag gis rdzogs pa ltar/ /ma lus rdzogs pa'i ye shes nyid/ /sa mtha'i nyes pa kun bral ba/ /kun gyi yon tan bdag nyid gnas/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mtha' yas pa'i/ /nam mkha'i mtha' thug bar du ni/ /gdul bya'i rdul tshosasnyed gnas kyi bar/ /skad cig 'du 'bral tshamed par gnas/ /bcud 1 sna'adus thig le chen po ni/ /bde ba'i zag 102—494

med thig le ste/ /a dang bde bar 'brel ba yi0)/ /ma lus khyab pa'i tshul du bzhugs / /thig le'i bye brag brgyad cu'i ②rtsa/ /bcud 'dus gsang ba'i thig le'i ro/ /ma skyes mnyam la gnas 'gyur zhing / /ma lus gang ba'i tshul gyis ni / /zhing khams phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa/ /zag med thig ler ro gcig ②pasal/ /nam mkha'i gzugs can de bzhin nyid/ /sku bzhi 'dus pa'i khams thig le/ /dngas ma lnga 'dus snying po can/ /gsum 'dus mi 'gyur snying po ste//bdes gang bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis po/ /thig le ro yis gang phye ba/ /dpag med sku gsung yon tan thugs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rang lisnang ba/ /thig le phyag rgya bsam mi khyab/ /phyi nang dngas snyigs ma lus pa/ /rang 'byung 6)dngas ma'i thig le nyid/ /gzhan med phyogs med rang snang ba/ /phyogs med bde ba chen po nyid/ /gsang ba'i thig le chen po ni/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i ngo bo ste/ /bde ba chen po'i snying po las/ /dpag med yon tan rnam par 'phrul/ /bde ba chen po'i thig le ni(6)/ /'du 'phro brel bas zag pa med/ /phyogs ris 'das pas ma khyab med/ /thog mtha' med par mnyam pa yin/ /rgyal ba kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /thig le ro la mnyam bzhugs pas/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs chos thams cad/ /bde ba chen por gsal bar myong (pe/ /mtshan dang dpe byad tshad 'das pa/ /rang la rdzogs pa'i thig le nyid/ /ji snyed bde ba'i rol pa kun/ /rang la rdzogs pa nyid du gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba ni / /rang 'byung (kyithig le chen po ste/ /ā li kā 5)li zhu ba las/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i bde ba 'byung / /gsang ba'i thig le kun gyi rgyu/ /nam mkha'i thig le gsang ba'i ngang / /khyab pa chen po phyogs cha med/ /lus gnas rang bzhin ma 102—495

skyes pa/ /bde ba'i dbang phyug sku gsung thugs/ /nam mkha' lta 6)bur dpag tu med/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i/ /gsang ba'i thig le bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /dpag med til 'bru rdul snyed kyi/ /rgyal ba kun dang lhan ②cig tu / /ma lus bde ba chen po'i ro/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /ma gsungs rig pas nyams btang tsho bas/ /mi 'dzin longs spyod chen po'i gnas/ /rang 'byung (༄nyi zla rten gyi ro/ /ma spangs 'dus pas 'du 'bral (5)med/ /gsang 17ba'i thig le bcud 'dus pa/ /nam mkha' gang ba bde ba'i ro/ /gnyis med 'khril ba'i stobs las byung / /mkha' kyi)dbyings byang chub 'byor pa'i sems/ /ma btang tshonasnam spros thig le che/ /nam mkha' 6)rgyas pa'i mtha' bzhin du/ /bde ba'i tshad kyang dpag tu med/ /yab yum gnas pa'i grangs tshad kyang / /nam mkha'i khams kyi rdul snyed de/ /re re'ang bde ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /rdul snyed nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /yab yum gnyis med 'brel pa yi/ /thabs dang shes rab bcud 'dus pa/ /gang yang mi sgrib thig le'i ro/ /snang gsum mtshan ma las 'das pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen kun gyi bcud / /bye ba rdul snyed grangs 'das pa'i/ /ma lus kun dang lhan cig tuyi / /mos dang chags pa'i khyad par gyis/ /cha lugs 17mtha' yas snang ba ni/ /la lar chags par lta ba'i tshul/ /de bzhin 'jam par smra ba dang / /la lar 'khyud cing lta ba ste/ /la lar nya sen thabs zhal sbyor zhing / /la lar mnye dang rdebs 12dang 'bud / /'gyed dang 'dud dang 'gying snyib yi/ /dkar 'dzin ston dang lte ba ston/ /'o dang 'tshir (7dang dgod yi tshopa dag /sna tshogs rol pa 'di dag gis/ /ma chags pa dag chags byed cing / /chags pa yinyemyur du 102wa 496

nyams par byed/ /tha skam myur du bengs 6)byed cing / /bde chen lo tog ②skyed par byed/ /bye ba rdul asnyed bcas pa yi/ /lha dang lha mo 'khor bcas pas/ /steg cing 'dzum pas lhan cig tu/ /rol cing glu ni len par byed/ /e ma'o ④sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin bde ba che/ /lhan cig skyes pa phyimakha' ltar rdul dang bral ba ste/ /rdo rje pad+mar bcug stibaskyod pas ni brtags pa'i snang ba nub//ma lus khyab pas mkha' ltar dga' bar byas kyang dbang po rlung gis rlabs(pe / /bde ba'i sa bon zag pa rnams ni slar yang ldang bar byed/ /rgyu ba rnam par chad pa'i kha sbyor bde chen ni/ /nam mkha'i rgya mnyam yun yang de srid bar du gnas pa ste/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ni lha mo khyod la tshang ba ste/ /(2)bdag ni khyod la bsten 6)cing dga' bas mig bteg tsom lus rgyal ba'i zhing du blta4nye/ /gang tshe 'gro ba 7tha mal bder spyod yul la chags par zhugs pa na/ /dga' dang bde dang rtse gcig 7yid 'ong 'dod par rab zhugs 8pas/ /dbang po gnyis rol nyi zla phrad cing bde chen mchog skyes che/ /skye rga na 'chi tsore dogs ngo tsha mi tsotsha grags pa'i chos brgyad tshod kyang byis pas mi shes so/ /gang zhig thabs dang shes rab bral bas gsang ba'i don 'jug pa/ /rgya mtsho la ni sa bon btab bzhin 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' tha skabs te/ /rgyal ba nyid kyang thabs dang shes rab bral bas byang chub myu gu gtan nas skams 4 7ho/ /'di ni glu ru blangs pa yis/ /rdul snyed bcas pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams/ /rang rang rgyan tshoshedang gos dor tetsho kyi/ /dpa' bo sgeg mo'i tshul 'dzin cing / /dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu'i rdul snyed du/ /glu sa )dang gar ni sna tshogs kyis/ /tha mal yid rtogs 21bcad nas ni/ /bde chen 102—497

yid ni 'phrog par mdzad/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor bsam yas dang / /zhing thabs bde ba rmad 'byung 6)ba/ /'dul ba'i thabs ni sna tshogs pa/ /dpag med mtha' mas ②cir snang yang / /rang byung ye shes byang chub sems/ /thig le gcig ①gi ngo bo las/ /mdzad pa'i gar thabs sna tshogs kyis/ /'dul ba'i dbang du ci yang spro/ /thabs la thabs kyis dbang sgyur ④bas/ /thabs chen thabs las byung ba yiphyi/ /ngo mtshar ya mtshan rmad ༅po che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /thabs chen sgyu ma rmad gdu byung / /sgyu ma skye 'gag med pa'i dbyings / /sku gsung yon tan phrin ⑧las thugs/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /thams cad rang rig byang chub sems/ /kun nas 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor te⑨/ /kun gyi rang bzhin 'byung gnas nyid/ /bya ba byed la byas pa med/ /zad dang 'phel ba med pa yi/ /dngos grub gter chen bsam mi khyab / /ye shes thig le rang snang yib/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /mtha' dbus med pa'i ye shes ni/ /gcig ces 'di zhes brjod du med/ /nam mkha' rang 'byung 6)rtag pa ltar/ /'pho tso'agyur med pas de bzhin no/ /nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa bzhin/ /rang 'byung snyi/ ye shes thog mtha' med//ma byung ma skyes byang chub sems/ /ye shes nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal/ /sangs rgyas sems can grol thar kun/ /ma lus rang rig 'od gsal bas/ /ra( 'byung skiye shes rang snang phyir/ /mkhyen dang bsgribs yipa chung yizad med/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyag gcig 6gel/ /rang gi cha shas chos bral bas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' thug chos rnams kun/ /skad cig ma 'dres tshul du mkhyen/ /rang rig byang chub sems nyid las/ / mtho dman 1steblang dor ma dmigs pas/ /102—498

'khor ba'i ngo bor rang snang yang / /ma chags skyon 0)med pad+ma 'dra/ /dpag med yon tan ngo bo joms/ /rang 'byung ②rig pa rang snang bas/ /ma lus ngo mtshar rgya mtsho rnams/ /rang snang gzhan las thob bya med/ /byin brlabs ①cho 'phrul rmad kyi chos/ /rang 'byung ④nyid las rnam par spro/ /tshul ni rnam pa sna tshogs te/ /dag dang ma dag khyad par gyis/ /ngo bo gcig ⑤las ma g.yos kyang —/ /mos pas mthong tshul de bzhin no/ /gsung ni nam mkhas yikhyab par ni / /phyogs bcu khyab par sgra sgrogs ⑦pa/ /mos pa bzhin du sna tshogs pa'i/ /bsam yas 'dul thabs sna tshogs snang / /thugs ni ma lus mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /phan ⑧dang bder ⑨bcas brtser 7ldan pa'i/ /mngon shes mkhyen pa'i ye shes spro / /ye shes thugs la khyad ⑩par med/ /yon tan tshad khyad bral ba ste/ /nam mkha'i nor bu gter 'chang ba/ /dpag med bsam pa bskang tu ba'i phyir/ /byin brlabs tu yid bzhin nor bu'i tshul/ /phrin skelas byin brlabs tsorang snang ba / /'gro 'ong med pa'i don tshul gyis/ /dpag bsam bum dang rin chen gyi/ /bya byed med par don rnams rdzogs/ /ma lus spros pa rnam dag cing / /rang 'byung 8rig pa mtha' dbus med/ /ma lus kun gyi 'byung gnas te/ /bde ba chen po chos kyi sku/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /gnyis med ngang la kun rdzogs pas/ /de nyid tshad bral mnga' brnyes pas/ /longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sku gcig 1 7thig le'i ngo bo las/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul bzhin du/ /rnam par 'phrul pa sprul pa'i sku/ /ma byung ma skyes don rtogs pas/ /ma lus dbyer med rdo rje nyid/ /mi 'jigs gnyen yi po kun bral ba/ /rdo rje sku zhes rnam par bstan ge/ /gang du 102wa 499

mngon par byang chub pa'i/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i 6)mtha' dbus med/ /sku bzhi mtha' yis ⑧ma reg pa/ /dang po mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /ma lus dbye ba mtha' spangs shing / /de ltar kun dang mnyam par gnas/ /don gyis ma lus khyab 'gyur ba/ /brjod med don gyi gsung nyid do/ /sku dang phyag rgya gzigs tshul gyis/ /ting 'dzin dgongs pas 'dul ba la/ /brjod med tshul gyis gang ston pa/ / brda yi (migasung du rnam par bstanasti/ /gang yang rung ba mthong thos tshe/ /dpa' bos bltas pas g.yul sel ltar/ /dngos pos byang chub nam mkhar rtogs(5)/ /byin brlabs rtogs (5)pa'i gsung (3)zhes bya/ /gang gi don du gang snang ba/ /gnyen po (8)bar chad mi gnas (9)shing / /gzhan dag pham byed mi thub pa/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i gsung du brjod/ / tshig gcig 7brjod pas tshig mtha' yas/ /mos pa de rnyed (1rnam grol cing / /yon tan rgya mtsho phun sum tshogs/ /'di ni brjod pa tshig gi gsung / /ji snyed mang por pho rnam spros kyang / /chos kyi dbyings la khyad par med/ /rtog la rnam rtog mtshan ma yang / /mi rtog ye shes grol ba'i thugs/ /gnyis med bde ba chen po yis / /'dod pa'i longs spyod lnga la rol/ /ma lus bde bar snang ba'i tshe/ /'di ni bde ba chen po'i thugs/ /bdag gzhan phyi nang mi mnga' yang rang 'byung 3nyaganyis kyi phyogs bral bas/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa kun mkhyen pas/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i thugs/ /ji snyed rig pa'i don snang zhing / /ma lus kun gyi ngo bo la/ /skye 'jig 1riganyen po gdod nas stong / /mi 'gyur rdo rje thugs zhes skabya/ /dpag med nam mkha'i 7zhing khams dang / /che ba'i khyad par bstan pa'i gdan1 / /zag pa med pa'i rgyan rnams dang / /ye shes 'bar 102wa 500

ba'i stigazhal yas khang / /mtha' dbus med par ()khyab pa yi/ /'od zer tshogs ni rnam par snang / /gzhan yang yon tan chen po ni/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i nam mkha' ltar/ /dpag cing gzhal bar mi nus te/ /zag med che ba'i yon tan snang / /gzhan yang mdzad pa'i phrin chalas ni/ /gdul bya'i yul ni ji snyed pa/ /mdzad pa'i sgo ni bsam yas te/ /rmatha' thug med par rnam par snang / /'di dag bsdus (0pas bshad bya na/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pas/ /mtha' yas bzhis ni rnam par bsdus/ /lhun gyis grub par kun kyang 'grub(snye/ /mdor na 'bras bu'i rnam grangs ni/ /bsdus pas yinyi shu rtsa lngar gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba me long gi rgyud chen po las lhun gyis grub pa ma lus pa (pebashad pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gsang (0bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpag med rgyal bas dbang bskur bske/ /gsang ba'i bdag po sngags kyi mdzod/ /gter 'dzin rgyal po stobs po che / /rang gi lag gi rdo rje nyid/ /dga' zhing mgu bas gsor byas te/ /bye ba rdul snyed bcas pa yis/ /rab tu bskor ba byas pa yis/ /'jig rten drug tu bcas pa sdog /'khrugs shing rnam par g.yo mdzad de/ /kun du rab g.yo 6)rnam par g.yo/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'khor yiyug bcas/ /'od dang sgra yis gang mdzad de/ /rmad 'byung hu)sku gsung thugs rnams kyi/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phral rnarme par snang / /ngo mtshar cho 'phral rmad 'byung yo gi/ /phyi nang gsang ra ra ba'i mchod pa dang / /'dod yon lnga yis khyab mdzad de/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs kun mnyes par byas/ /kun kyang dga' zhing mos pa yis/ /zhing khams rdul 102—501

dang mnyam pa yi/ /'khor tshogs rnams ni bstod pa 'di/ /sna tshogs sgras ni glu ru blangs/ /oṃ āḥs 6)a la la ho/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i thugs ni mi skye ②ye shes bde ①ba'i thugs/ /mi rtogs ④gsal ba'i thugs ni kun la khyab par gnas / /gang yang dbyer med 'dus byas ma yin 'dus ma byas min skye 'jig med / /dam pa'i thugs la byung tshor g.yo 'gog ci yang med pas bde ho/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku ni sna tshogs 'od 'bar bde ba'i sku/ /sna tshogs mtha' yas ji ltar snang ba ngo bos dben/ /de nyid 'du ba'i thabs kyis de ltar yid 'phrog tshim pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas sna tshogs bye brag ⑤ji ltar gsal yang nam mkha'i ngang du bye brag med ho/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i yon tan yid bzhin nor bu rin po che / /mi zad par ldan rgyan gyi 'khor lo dpag ⑥med rgyas par snang / /'gro ba rnams ni ⑦yid 'phrog bltas pas chog shes med par mdzes/ /rgyal ba ma lus yon tan rdzogs par snang la de dag mtha' thug med ho/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gsung ni zab cing rgya (87cher nam mkha' 'dra/ /ma lus go zhing tshim mdzad rdo rje'i sgra 'byin snyan sgrogs (9)pa/ /rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas mos yidang 'thad pa de bzhin rnam par snang ho/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i phrin (nyalas sna tshogs bya ba lhun gyis grub/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed 'gro ba ma lus kun 'dul ba/ /thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'di ni rnam par rol ho8//de nas rgyal mchog skyes bu yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ /bye ba rdul snyed bcas pa la/ /gsang ba 'di ni gtad par mdzad/ /nga yi gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi7/ /bstan pa kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /ma lus kun gyi thabs su snang / /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ste/ /102—502

'khor ma lus pa thams cad so so ma yin ngo bo nyid gcig 6)pa'i ye shes kun du 'khyil pa/ ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rin po che ②dbyibs dang kha dog dul sogs te④/ rnam pa tha dad pa'i bye brag dang khyad par ⑤du gyur pa'i tshad dpag tu med pa/ ye shes rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dang / chun 'phyang dang /shar bu'i rgyan dang / gzugs sna tshogs dang / sgra sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogasakyi / ro sna tshogs dang / reg bya sna tshogs kyis phyogs bcur 'khrigs par rang byung la/ mi sgrib ⑦par gsal ba'i rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pas bklubs (nyapa/ rnam par thar pa bzhi'i 7sgo nas 'jug yo )pa'i sgo khyud can/rnam par thar ba brgyad kyi rta babs dang ldan pa'i phyi dang nang med par kun du yang nang du gyur pa na (nyemi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri dang / stobs kyi glang po'i khri dang ske/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rta'i khri dang / dbang gi rma bya'i khri dang / thogs pa med pa ⑩nam mkha' lding gi khri dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang / gos pa med pa pad+ma rin po che'i gdan la sku mdun dang rgyab med pa thams cad du yang zhal thal le bar gsal zhing / mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad du sku gsung thugs sna tshogs par kun du snang ba/ lhun gyis grub pa'i sku gsung thugs chen po las thabs dang ⑫shes rab kyi zhabs gnyis mnyam yipa'i brtul zhugs kyi skyil mo krung ⑩du bzhugs pa / ye shes drug gi phyag /ye shes rin po che'i phyag 'bar ba can/ sku gsung thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbu gsum dang ldan pa 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tshor ba'i rgyal po dang / de 102wa 535

bzhin gshegs pa 'du shes kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'du byed kyi rgyal po dang / de dag kun kyang mthing ga 6)dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang / le brgan 2dang / ljang gu'i da)mdog tu 'tsher ba/ btsun mo dam pa'i snang ba'i dbyings dang / sra ba'i dbyings dang / mnyen pa'i dbyings dang / dro ba'i dbyings dang / bskyod pa'i dbyings la sogs pa/ btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi canodabyings kun du mtha' yas par khyab pa ni 'di lta ste/ dper na til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang nas khyab par bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub chen po rdo rje mthong ba dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje thos pa dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje snom pa dang /(5 byang chub chen po rdo rje myong ba dang / btsun mo mthong bar bya ba dang / mnyan par bya ba dang / bsnam ( par bya ba dang / myang 7bar bya ba'i tshogs dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje namathong byed dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje thos byed dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje snom byed 9dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje 9myong byed 1stodang /btsun mo 'das pa dang / da ltar 'byung 12ba dang / ma byon pa'i tshogs dang / 'joms pa chen mo reg pa dang / 'joms pa chen mo 1lhareg byed dang /'joms pa chen mo 7reg shes 15dang / btsun mo rtag tshapar ma yin pa dang /chad par ma yin pa dang / bdag tu ma yin pa dang / mtshan mar ma yirno pa la sogs pa de lta bu'i tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba dang gnyis su med par bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag nyid kyi gsang ba 'di nyid sku dang / gsung dang /thugs dang / yon tan phrin 1 las rdo rje las phyung ngo / /e/ e/ e ma'o/18//102wa 536

de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid dang / dbang sgyur ye shes dkyil 'khor thugs dang 0)rang snang ba nyid ting nge (5)'dzin gzugs brnyan sgyu ma rnam dag gsal ba ni sku dang gsung dang thugs yon tan phrin (gelas sel med pa'i yid bzhin nor bu rin po che mi zad par ldan pa rgyan 4)gyi 'khor lo rdo rje mchog gi gnas nyid do zhes rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las gleng gzhi'i (5)le'u ste dang po'o(yi// //de nas bcom ldan 'das byed pa po rdo rje yid kun du bzang po thams cad ma lus pa'i rang bzhin gyi tshul rdo rjes btsun mo chos bya ba mo kun du bzang mo la 'jug par gyur te ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /oṃ chos kyi chos nyid shes bya'i dbyings/ /kun du bzang mo bde ba'i yum/ /ma g.yos rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /bdag yin bdag gi spyod yul ba/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs so sor gsal / /nub phyogs 'og min gnas mchog tu/ /ma chags pad+ma'i gdan bting ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi la/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dbang dang skal (7)min gsal ba'i phyir / /nad dang phyi rim 8lcags dang ldan/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi sbas pa yi9ri/ /sus kyang gting dpag dka' ba de/ /kun du bzang po nyid kyis gzigs/ /zhes 7brjod pas btsun mo bya ba mo chos kun du bzang mo la 'jug par gyur to/ /zhugs nas btsun mo bya ba mo chos kun du bzang mos bcom ldan 'das yid kun du bzang po dang/ gnyis su med pa'i longs spyod bde ba la mnyam 1 par gnas te ched du brjod pa brjod do/ /sems kyi sems nyid byed pa'i gtso/ /kun du 102—537

bzang po rdo rje yid/ /ye shes drug gi rang bzhin te/ /shar phyogs mngon dga'i bsam 0)yas na/ / nī la ②lta bu'i gter 'byin pa/ /gsang 'dus ③'phrul gyi lde ④mig gis/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo phye nas/ /byang chub mchog gis nang gtan (snyedagrol/ /mnyam sbyor pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'gro don byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /'gro lnga skye bzhi yidabang du bsdus/ /sku gsung thugs gnas dbang bskur to/ /zhes brjod pas thams cad mnyam pa chen po'i tshul rdo rje nyid du gsal bar gyur to/ /zhugs pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa thams cad gcig gi rang stibazhin dbyer med pas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ⑧la ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o dhirdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /skye mched khams rnams mang po kun/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyidam/ /sa chu spyan dang mā ma khriyi/ /me rlung gos dkar sgrol ma ste/ /nam mkha' 1medabyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas shing / /thams cad ma lus chos so cogatso /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa minatunye/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi rnyed do/ /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur to④/ /de nas btsun mo bya ba mo chos kun du bzang mos bcom ldan 'das yid kun du bzang po dang gnyis su med par gyur nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o skaphyogs bcu'i stong khams ye shes dben/ /srid pa gsum nyid yidag pa'i zhing / /snyigs ma lnga nyid bde ldan nas/ /phung po lnga nyid mngon sangs rgyas / /thams cad mchog gi snying po bas/ /gzhan du rgyal bas chos mi 'tshal/ /102—538

nyid las gzhan zhes bya ba'i chos/ /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi rnyed do/ /zhes brjod pas thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las gleng bslang ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid chen pos ye shes sangs rgyas pa'i sems ye shes su bskyed pa 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o 0)ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes pa nyid na ②skye ba med/ /e ma'o ⑤ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gag ④pa med las thams cad 'gag⑤ /'gag pa nyid na 6)'gag pa med/ /e ma'o (3)ngo mtshar rmad kyi duchos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /gnas pa med las thams cad gnasal/ /gnas pa nyid na gnas pa med/ /e ma'o yingo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /dmigs pa med las thams cad dmigs/ /dmigs yonyapa nyid na tsodamigs pa med/ /e ma'o tunyengo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /'gro 'ong med las 'gro dang 'ong / /'gro 'ong nyid na tso'agro 'ong med/ /ces brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang btsun 7mo'i tshogs thams cad mnyes 7pas khyab par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad btsun tsho 7mo'i tshogs dang bcas pas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o /sheye nas gsang ba'i chos/ /sna tshogs snang la 06rang bzhin gsang / /ngo bo nyid kyis rab tu gsang / /gzhan du min yang ( ska102—539

shin tu gsang / /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bo nyid du gcig pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas dbyer med na/'gro ba'i rnam par rtog 6)pa ma rig pa la 'gro ba lnga'i rigs bsam gyis (mimi khyab par smin pa la thugs rje chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chen po skyes nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o tsho47bde gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul/ /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / / gnas dang 5cisdug 'chibasngal la sogs pa/ /bdag dang bdag gis so sor 'dzin/ /sus kyang mi 'ching bcings med de/ /bcing bar bya ba yod ma yin/ /rnam rtog bdag tu 'dzin pa yin/ /nan gyis mkha' la mdud pa 'dor/ /bcings med rnam par grol med pa'i/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /bstan phyir spro ba sna tshogs mdzad/ /ces de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du gleng ngo / /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las don dam pa dang kun rdzob kyi byang chub kyi (pesems ye shes su bskyed pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las thugs rje chen po (8)byin gyis brlabs 9zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i skyes bu thub pa drug de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las bton to/ /bton nas kyang las kyi dbang gis snrel zhi kyi dang / yan man gyi 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po 11re rer thub pa chen po bcom ldan 'das re res 'dul ba rnam 1 bzhis 'gro ba lnga'i don mdzad de bltams kyi pa dang / rab tu 'byung skab dang / dka' tsho'athub mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas pa dang /102wa 540

bdud btul 0)ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo 6)bskor ba dang / cho 'phrul chen po ston pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa ston pa'i thub pa dus bzhi kun du mkhyen pa dang / thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud du kun du mkhyen pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi spyan gyis (8)kun du gzigs pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi snyan ④gyis kun du gsan (gepa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho gas kun du don spyod ༅pa dang / zag pa med pas (7)kun du bzang po'i spyod pa rdzogs pa'i mngon par shes pa drug dang /kun du sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du zhal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun du gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa dang 8ri/ bsam gyis mi khyab po)pa grangs med par yang ⑩phyogs bcur snang bar gyur to/ /de ltar snang bar gyur nas ji snyed pa'i thub pa chen po snying rje'i go 'phang chen po thams cad kyang 'di lta ste/ 'dul ba'i dbang gis lha dang mi'i theg pa dang/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang / bla na med pa'i theg pas ma rig pa'i rnam par rtog pa nyon mongs pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po stong phrag 11brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur rol/ /de dag thams cad kyang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i phyi nang gi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'dzin pa 'khrul 4nyepa la dgos ④pa dang / las dang las kyi pa'abras bu chud mi za ba dang / las dang las kyi tso 'bras bus mi gos gos 1 par mi 'gyur ba dang / gos pa med /snyepa'i ston pa'i mthar thug go/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ 'khor ba'i skyon dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan bstan pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs 102—541

pa nyid la ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o ①dkyil 'khor bsam yas par / /snying po bla med ji snyed pa'i/ /gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs ②rang bzhin rgyal / /mtha' dang bral bas bdag med ⑧pa'o/ /de nas ④de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ①ched du brjod pa 'di brjod doyi/ /e ma'o ⑦ji snyed ⑧'jig rten 'khrul pa'i chos/ /ma rig rtog pa'i gzung 6)'dzin gyis/ /stong gi tso'ajig rten bsam yas par/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gnyis su 'khor/ /rtog ⑩pa'i bag chags stug po 8yin/ /mi mthun bde sdug myong bar 'gyur/ /de nyid ji bzhin dbyings nyid dang / /rang bzhin bdag med tshul gcig tiste/ /rang bzhin nyid la nyams pa med/ /yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan med de/ /de nyid ngo bo nyid dbyings pas/ /rnam dag dbyings nyid tshul gcig (7go/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan rnams ni/ /log par rtog pa tsam nyid las/ /phra zhing zab pa yod ma yin/ /log rtog nyid la nyid spyod de / /gzhan du g.yo 7ba ci yang med/ /log rtog rgyu 'bras rgyun nyid kyang ske/ /gzhi rtsa med de skad cig ma/ /rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nyid tshul/ /nyid la dbang sgyur nyid spyod phyir/ /bdag dang gzhan (zhedang rtog pa'i rgyun/ /rnam dag bla med theg pa'i mchog /theg pa bzhi yis nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig 18gi 'bras bur gnas/ /yang dag rtogs pas rab brtags na/ /rang bzhin med la cir yang 'grub/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan yong mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /ma rig smin mdzad gdul ba'i phyir/ /'byung gnas mya ngan 'da' bar ston/ /'dul ba mdo sde chos mngon dang / /dam tshig sgrub dang grub pa dang / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud/ /ji snyed 102—542

'jig rten mtha' 6)klas par/ /phyogs bcur kun du rab grags pa/ /gsang ba'i snying po las 'phros ②te/ /rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /sde snod kun dang rgyud kun gyi / /ston pa'i thub pa bsam yas pa/ /'byung gnas gtan la nges par 'bebs/ /chos rnams ming du btags ④pa tsam/ /ston pa'i ⑤don dang mthun 0phyogs su/ /ming nyid tshig tu btags ⑦nas bstan/ /ston ming (9tshig la dngos po med/ /ces brjod pas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis lhun gyis grub pa chen por gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lhun gyis grub pa gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag nyid kyi gsang ba 'di 6)nyid sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin kyilas rdo rje las phyung ngo tu te/ /a'o kyisrid rtse'i nyes dmigs bdag tu rtog las 'phros/ /rgyud drug skye 'gag lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal 'khrul hunye'akhor la rdzisogs pa/ /log rtog 7nyid las gzhan du ci yang med/ /stong nyid bdag med ye mkhyen rang rig thugs/ /dmigs tsobya dmigs med 3)med par dran dbang sgyur/ /ngo mtshar sku gsung yon tan zhing khams la/ /gzhan na med de de nyid de ltar yin//zhes rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /thub pa drug gis sprul pa grangs med tunyepa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa tunyeyang ru )de dag tu 'dus par 4)de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las chos thams cad (gegatan la phab pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos 'gro ba thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi dkyil (ri she'akhor yod par bstan pa dang / rigs 102—543

rgyud drug tu yang bshad/ de la chos nyid kyi rigs ni thams cad kun la yang yod do/ /nam mkhas kyang hu)kun la (mikhyab par gnas so/ /de ltar chos kyi dbyings dang / nam mkhas ①kun la khyab kyang rnam par thar pa'i don ma rtogs na me long g.yas g.yogs pa dang 'dra ste gzugs brnyan snang ba'i bya ba byed mi nus so zhes gsungs nas yang 'di skad rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs so/ /mnyam nyid don rtogs rang rig rgyal po dang / /rgya ④mtsho chen por chu klung 'bab pa ltar / /bla med don rtogs thabs chen 'di dag tu/ /rnam pa'i theg pa bsam yas ma lus 'dus/ /a ho/ bdag med gnyis rtogs pha rol phyin rdzogs pa/ /sa bcu rim gyis (5)bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sangs rgyas sar 'gro go 'phang thob pa'i lam/ /bden pa gnyis kyis rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /phyi nang rten 'brel sgyu ma mig yor chu)tshul shes pa'i/ /dngos po gzugs la thogs med rab tu 'jug /dge bshes ( mi slob rang gi rig pas rtogs(8)/ /byang chub sar 'gro yid bzhin bde ba'i mchog /bden bzhi 99)don rtogs rab tu spong ba yi7/ /ye shes bcu drug cha sbyangs rab zhi ba'i/ /rgyun zhugs la sogs rim par sbyangs nas ni/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams rab tu zhi ba'i sa ru 'gro/ /theg pa gang du bstan pa ma nges pa'i/ /yang na kun la mthun nas 'byam 67par 'jug /yang na nges med 'di zhes brtag tu med/ /'di ni ma nges rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs / /dge bcu spyod cing mi dge spong byed pa/ /'dod khams lha dang mi ru skye ba'i rgyu/ /tshad med bzhi spyod mi g.yo sgom byed pa/ /tshangs gnas lha 12sogs skye ba'i rgyu yin no12/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis kun la 7khyab gyur kyang / /rang rig rtogs pa'i skal dang mi ldan nas/ /ji ltar dmus long mdun du 102—544

mdog bstan bzhin/ /'di ni skal med rigs chad sa yin no/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis kun la khyab pa yis/ /bla med theg pa bsam yas gsungs pa yang / /so so rang rig blo la snang bar zad/ /ngan song 'gro drug sna tshogs rgyu ba yang / /'khrul ba'i blo log rtog pa nyid snang ste/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba 0)med/ /mi dmigs (gerang rig goms byas bla na med pa'i mchog /log rtog bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin gyur na/ /dngos med mi sdug sna tshogs snang bar 'gyur/ /yang dag shes pa'i rang rinasarig blo med na/ /bde gshegs zhing yang ngan song gnas su mthong / /theg mchog mnyam pa'i don nyid rtogs pa ni/ /ngan song gnas nyid 'og min dga' ldan gnas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni de nyid bsam yas par54ci/ /nyi zla gza' skar mtshan ma glog 'gyu ⑤dang / /'ja' tshon sprin mang (phyi sna tshogs 'khrugs gyur kyang / /nam mkha'i dbyings la gyur cing nyams pa med/ /mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings ni bsam yas par / /sku gsung yon tan phrin 7rilas rmad 'byung yinanodang / /'jig rtog gtso mchog ma lus thams cad dang / /'khrul 'khor sdug bsngal sna tshogs rnam mang yang / /de bzhin nyid la 'phel zhing bri ba med/ /ces rdo rje 5)gsang ba'i tshig tu'o / /rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las thams cad la chos nyid kyi nyu rgyu yod pa dang rigs rgyud chad tsho)pa dang rigs brgyad /gso sor dbye ba'i mdor bshad pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs pa 12gcig muku gyur nas mnyam pa chen po'i tshul rdo rje'i dbyings su chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas 102wa 545
