pa'i ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo bar chos thams cad ming tsam du gnas pa'i yi ge phreng ba 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di sku gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /a rab tu brtan 'gyur ②a dkar las/ /shin tu phra ba'i a rnams spro/ /phyogs kun gang bar gsal gyur nas/ /bsdus 0kyang 'phel 'grib med par brtan6)/ /de las ming tshogs (gegasal 'bar kun/ /spro zhing bsdu ⑤ba'ang de bzhin no/ /'di ni rdo rje dngos grub kyi/ /brten 4)'byung ye shes rgyu yin no/ /a/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha tshuḍa nye ṇa/ ta tha da dha (nyan/ pa pha ba bha ma/ya wa ra la/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣa/ i yī/ u u/ e e/ o skyo'ikye/ 'di dag phyung bas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/rab tu g.yos kun du g.yos nas chos thams cad ming gi mtshan nyid du gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ched du brjod pa 'di brjod dorta / /a ni stong dang mi stong gi/ /dbu ma dmigs su yod ma yin/ /thams cad ming tsam sangs rgyas kun/ /yi ge (stophreng ba nyid la gnas/ /a nyid 8sna tshogs par snang ba'i/ /ka la 7sogs pa bzhi bcu gnyis/ /sgra yi ming gis thams cad bsdus / /mngon rdzogs rgyal por de nyid nges/ /e ma'o ④ngo mtshar ya mtshan gyis / /'phrul chen bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i ming / /tshig rnams ma lus 'dzin pa'i gnas / /sna tshogs don kun smra zhing ston/ /dngos med yi ge rang bzhin sems / /bdag med mtha' bral mi dmigs kyang / /dbyibs dang kha dog ming tshogs kyis/ /rol pa cir yang sprul cing ston/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gshegs pa yi/ /ye shes sems dpa'i 7sku gsung thugs/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa lnga nyid / /yi ge mgo nas k+ṣa la 97rdzogs/ /sems ni rang bzhin yi ge ste/ /yi ge 102—546

dngos po yod ma yin/ /dmigs med de nyid sna tshogs pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo che/ /sku 0)gsung thugs ni ngo mtshar gyi/ /ya mtshan 'phrul chen rab 'gugs ②pa/ /dbyings la dbyings kyis bris pa ste/ /yi ge zhes ni de phyir brjod/ /mgo ni ma nor lam yin te/ /tshig ni shes rab ming ③du smras//shad ni thabs chen tshigs su gcod/ /a ni skye med de bzhin nyid/ /ṭha ④ni sgyu 'phrul rdo rje nyid/ /ṭa ni snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul nyid/ /ḍa ni sgyu 'phrul yid bzhin nyid / /nye ni sgyu 'phrul rnam dag nyid/ /ṇa ni kun du sgyu 'phrul nyid/ /tha ni dra bas mngon rdzogs nyid/ /ta ni dra bas brtan pa nyid/ /da ni dra bas lham me nyid/ /dha ni dra bas 'khyil pa nyid/ /na ni dra bas kun du 'gyur/ /ka ni spyan gyi thugs kyi mchog /kha ni snyan 5)gyi thugs kyi mchog /ga ni shangs kyi thugs kyi mchog /gha ni ljags kyi thugs kyi mchog /nga 4)ni thugs kyang 'jig byed pa'o/ /tsa ni spyan gyi sku yi mchog /tsha ni snyan gyi sku yi mchog /dza (7)ni shangs kyi sku yi mchog /dzha ni ljags kyi sku yi mchog /nya ni sku yang 'jig byed pa'o / / pa ni spyan gyi gsung gi mchog /58)pha ni snyan gyi gsung mchog ste/ /ba ni shangs 6)kyi gsung mchog yin/ /bha ni ljags kyi gsung gi mchog /ma ni gsung yang 'jig par byed/ /ya ni skye ba rnam par dag /wa ni gnas pa dag pa yin/ /ra ni 'jig 〉pa dag pa ste/ /la ni stong pa dag pa'o/ /sha ni rtag med dag pa ste/ /ṣa ni chad pa'ang yod ma yin/ /sa ni mtha' bral bdag med pa / /ha ni mtshan ma med pa nyid/ /k+ṣa ni ye shes thugs kyi thugs/ /i ni rdul snyed lha rnams su/ /khri ni rdul snyed lha ma yin/ /u ni rdul snyed mi rnams su / /u 67ni rdul snyed byol song rnams/ /e ni rdul snyed yi dgas nyugesu/ /e the 102—547

ni rdul snyed dmyal ba rnams/ /o ni thams cad 'jig par byed/ /skyo'ini thams cad zhig 6)pa yin/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen 'dis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phreng ba 5kyibasdus/ /a ho/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshobatsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag nyid kyi gsang ba 'di (5)nyid sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin /cholas rdo rje las phyung (2ngo a ho/thabs dang shes rab dgyes sprin byang chub sems tshogs rgyu 'khor lo/ /'bras bu rgyal ba'i smin grub ngo mtshar ming tshogs bzhi bcu gnyis/ /'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i dam/ /'da' bar mi mdzad 56)dbang med rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i mthu chen yin/ /a ho/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yi ge (77'khor lor gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po 8)de kho na nyid nges pa las yi ge 7phreng ba 'khor lo bkod pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las shin tu gsang ba'i phyir 7gsang sngags kyi rgyud de'i 1 phyi pa dang / nang pa thabs kyi rgyud gzhan la 7khams bcwa brgyad 12du bstan/ gtsug lag thams cad la yang 1 khams bcwa skabargyad du bstan pa yin/ lung gi spyi 'di ni shin tu zab pa'i phyir khams nyi shu rtsa gcig 7tu bstan te/ lung gi spyi yang rgyud dang gsung rab thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin/ gsang ba'i dbang po dang gsang ba'i yul gnyis ka 1 yang / skye mched dang khams thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir 18shin tu gsang bar gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor de dag shin tu gsal bar 102—548

bstan ①pa'i phyir nyid la nyid ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o ye nas (migasang ba'i chos/ /thams cad kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /ngang gis dag mnyam ma rtogs ①pas/ /kun la yod cing rang bzhin gsang / /gzhan du min la shin tu gsang / /don nyid kyis ni gsang ba'i rgyu/ /mnyam pa'i rdo rje can gyis gsung ④/ /'di ni byang chub snying po mchog /a ho/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /dbang po yul du snang ba'i rnams(5)/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ /rigs lnga yab yum bcu ru 'byor / /skye mched (7khams rnams bcwa 57ribargyad po5)/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /thams cad byang chub sems ma yikyi)/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i dbang por 'dus/ /rdo rje dbang po gsang ba'i thabs/ /dbang po yul nyid shes rab dbyings/ /dbang po'i thugs ni rdo rje sems/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i gter nyid dang / /thams cad 'gro ba'i gnas nyid de/ /de yis ma bskyed gang yang med/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyu/ /de las thams cad skye zhing 'byung / /kun gyi phyag rgya'i rgyu yin te/ /bde ba byang chub sgrub pa'i rdzas/ /de las bskyed cing de las spro/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa'i gnas / /dbang po rdo rje pad+mor ldan/ /gnyis med byang chub sems 'phro natso/ /mi dmigs bde dang longs spyod 'phro/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga/ /gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi rnams dang / /mchod pa'i lha mo rdzogs ldan bzhi41)/ /'jug dang ldang dang gnas dang smon pa'i 1 byang chub sems/ /g.yo dang bskyod dang ldang yo dang gnas/ /'gug dang 'dzin dang de bzhin te/ /bsdus dang 'khril ba'i don bsgrub 7phyir/ /bsdams dang mi gtong dbang sgyur 8te/ /bde 102wa 549

ba sgra snyan phyogs bcur sgrogs1)/ /shin tu sgeg ②pa'i gzi brjid 'bar/ /yid bzhin rin chen phreng bar 'bar/ /dbyangs snyan yid 'phrog gzi ldan 'bar / /gzugs mdzes bskyod pas phyogs bcur g.yo/ /kun du tshim byed bro bsung ( thim/ /lha mdzes rin chen phung po 'phro/ /'od gsal 'phro bas kun du 'bar / /bdud rtsi bsil dro 'jam pa'i dbyings/ /a la la ho/ gsang ba'i dbang po pad+mar boldan gyur nas/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /pha rol phyin bcu rgyu 'bras rdzogs/ /sa bcu rim gyis ⑤bkod med rdzogs/ /kun du 'od gsal pad+ma spyan yang rdzogs/ /yi ge (7phreng ba 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa / /yang dag rdzogs chen thabs dang ldan/ /thabs dang shes rab bla (7)med sa yang rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs par rol(gyi sa la la ho/de bzhin nyid kyi gsang mchog las/ /khams ni nyi shu rtsa gcig (9)ste/ /bcwa tībargyad po ni rgyud gzhan bzhin/ /gsum ni de bzhin kun gyi bdag /bcwa (mebargyad 'byung ba'i gnas yin te/ /byang chub 'grub (12pa'i zhing yang yin/ /bde ba 'byin pa'i rgyu yang yin/ /gsang ba'i mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /dbang po rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyal/ /yul ni pad+ma bde mchog dbyings/ /sems ni byang chub 'byung ba'i gter/ /dbang po yul sems ldan gyur nas/ /gsang ba mchog gi 'phrul chen spro/ /dkyil 'khor rdul snyed 12grangs med dang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i lhun grub rnams/ /gsang ba mchog gis 'byin par byed/ /'di ni rtse gcig sayin par gsungs/ /gsang ba'i don mchog 'di dag ni/ /lta ba dman la bshad byas na(ska/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /mgo 'gas snying yang tshig 7par 'gyur/ /khab len gyis 7ni lcags sdud ltar/ /mi 102—550

'dod bzhin du dbang med par/ /ngan song mi khom bskal par brgyud par 'gyur / /de bas 'di ni shin tu gsang bar bya/ /shes rab rgya chen blo zab yangs pa yis/ /blo brtan snying rje che dang dad ldan ngang tshul bzang la brtan①/ /gzhan du nams kyang ②sbyin mi bya zhes nyid la yang nyid brjod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las khams nyi shu rtsa gcig ①tu bsdus rgyanas/thams cad ma lus par dbyings su bkod pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bkod pa las sgyu 'phrul rnam par spros ⑤pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin / /sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /dra ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon rdzogs pas/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /bdud rtsir 'gyur (5)zhing 'byung ba dang / /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi ge nad sel cing / /longs spyod 'byung zhing ngan song sbyong / /ci yang gzhan du 'gyur bar 'grub(kye/ /nam mkha' rdo rje sra 'byung zhing / /'bar nas me yang 'tshig pa dang / /chur 'gyur 'bab pa'ang de bzhin te/ /'jig rten khams ni gtor ba dang / /thams cad stongs shing lhung bar 'gyur/ / dgug dang btang (9)dang bcing dang dgrola'i/ /gso dang bsad 4gledang pham dang rgyal/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /de nyid ye shes rang snang ba'i/ /ming tshig gzugs tshogs skoyid bzhin gyis/ /mun la snang byung ji bzhin du/ /'gyur bas gser 'gyur sman gyi tshul/ /ston pa mchod brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /102—551

dam tshig sngags dang phyag 6)rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes shing yo byad ldan/ /'grub 'gyur mi ldan don med (gebarlag /dus gsum rgyal bas thugs chud pa'i/ /dngos grub mchog gi snying po ni/ /zad pa'i dus med yid bzhin mdzod/ /'phel 'grib med par 'byung ba ste/ /dngos po med las dngos po'i sprin/ /sna tshogs rnam par 'byung zhing 'gyur/ /dngos rnams nyid na dngos med par/ /rtogs pa'i dbang sgyur 55)ting 'dzin yin/ /gang gis dmigs med mi shes pa/ /de yis chos kyi dbyings mi shes ge/ /de phyir dngos dang dngos med pa/ /'jigs pas dmigs med shes par gyis/ /gzhi (5)rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /pho mo ma yin ma ning min/ /mtshan med ma yin rigs rgyud min/ /kha dog ma yin dbyibs ma yin/ /gnas su ma yin gang yang min/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya kun gyi rgyu/ /thabs las thabs byung thabs bsam yas/ /tha dad min la tha dad pa'i/ /nang dang nang gi phyi rol pa / /dkyil 'khor bsam yas ye shes rol/ /'jigs med kun bzang phyag rgya mchog /gang gis glang chen myos 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par bzhag ( pas btul nas su/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rab brtan na/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid gzigs mos mnyes par gyur to7/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las gsang ba'i tshig 'di tsho(phyung ngo / /e ma'o misnying por lam bcas pas / /'jigs med dbyings nyid kun bzang phyag rgya mchog /rang bzhin sku gsung thugs chen po/ /byang chub lhun grub bdal ba'i ngang / /snying po nyid ni snying 11por kun bcas kun du gnas/ /de nyid rdzogs pa'i ngang las dngos grub 102—552

kun shar kun du gnas/ /a ho rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las sgyu 'phrul sgrub pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor las lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis zhisngags 'chang rnams lhar (misgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di don yod par bya ba'i phyir ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do//e ma'o ye nas rnam dag pa'i/ / thabs dang ri shes rab ldan par (geganas/ /byang chub mchog tu nyi zla shar/ /de nyid bzhugs gnas yin par gsungs/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med pa'i/ /dbyings su thim pa'i 'od zer gsal//gcig (5)dang spros pa thams cad med/ /dkyil 'khor spros med zlum po'i tshul/ /ye nas mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /ye shes rgyu dang 'bras bu ldan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sku/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yongs kyis bskor/ /thugs rje 565byin brlabs ri 'phros pa yis/ /ye shes bzhi yi ri ridakyil 'khor spro/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs/ /byin brlabs 9ya mtshan bsam mi khyab/ /rang snang ba yi ོthabs las 'byung / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pa'i/ /thugs rje /lhargyas pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dbus mtha' med par rgyas par gnas/ /stong tsosmon mtshan med 'od gsal 'jug /de phyir ye shes sgo bzhir bshad/ /der 'gro lam stegs 12brgyad dang ldan/ /rang bzhin ye nas 'od gsal phyir/ /nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan khri 'bar/ /ye nas rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /ma chags pad+mo 'bar ba'i gdan/ /zad 7med ye shes gter gyur pas/ /yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba'i gdan/ /ye nas mnyam nyid mi 'da'i phyir/ /ta 102wa 553

la'i ljon shing rang bzhin gnas/ /re ba yid bzhin skong ba'i phyir/ /dpag bsam 0)shing gi rin chen 'bar/ /yid bzhin rin chen rgyan ②gyis bskor/ /thams cad la ni dbang sgyur phyir/ /'jig rten lha chen rnams kyis bskor/ / gsang ba (gede nyid nges pa las/ /'phrul chen bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /thams cad lha nyid rtag tu sbyor/ /thams cad ma lus dkyil 'khor mchog /'di ni rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dang / /gzugs brnyan ④lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ /ting 'dzin lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor dang phyi/ /byang chub sems dang tshogs mchog brten(6)/ /zhes nyid la nyid bshad do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las shin tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan bstan ⑦pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin gcig (snyedang du ma med pa bdag 997nyid thams cad kyis 7'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad la nyid kyi che ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byung bar bzhed nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /ye shes phyogs bzhi dbus brtags (1te/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub ni/ /rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bas7/ /kun 'byung dkyil 'khor chen por lho spyod/ /'khor lo rtsibs cibazhi mu khyud bcas/ /gru ⑫chad bzhis brgyan bar khyams 7dang / /kun du gru bzhi tu sgo khyud ldan/ /rol mo sna tshogs sprin phung bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis kyis brgyan/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang khyung / /nam mkha' lding gi khri chen la/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin po che / /gdan la rdzogs dang sems dpa'i tshul/ /'khor lo rgyal po rgyal mo dang //102—554

g.yas nas mthong thos mnam hu)pa dang / /myong dang btsun mo'i tshogs su bcas / /gru chad la ni mthong byed dang / /thos byed mnam ②byed myong byed rnams(5)ske/ /btsun mo dag dang bcas par gnas/ /bar khyams ④la ni thub drug dang / /mdun(snyedang rgyab tu byed pa dang / /bya ba dag ⑥ni gnas par bstan / /sgo khyud bzhi la 'joms pa ni/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par gnas / /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri dril bu 'bar/ /ut+pal klu shing la sogs mtshan/ /mdzes tshul mnyes pa'i yo byad 'dzin/ /mthing ga dkar (7po ser le brgan/ /ljang gu 58)la sogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /mnyen lcug 'khril 6)ldem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun stug yigazi byin can/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen po/ /'bar ba'i phreng huskrebs 'khyil pa ste/ /dbus mtha' med par khyab pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas ()lhun gyis grub/ /sku yi phyag rgya che mchog ni/ /de bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /yang dag thar ba'i gzugs sku dang / /'gro ba ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mthun byas sku ni sna tshogs ston/ /ston hunyenyid sgyu ma mig yor tshul/ /tshul nyid dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /ma g.yos bzhin du sna tshogs pa'itso/ /de'i tshe mi mthun sna tshogs la/ /so so 'dra bar snang ba ni/ /de bzhin nyid kyis ma bcos kyang / /las 'phro dbang gis so sor snang / /dper na me long chu zla bzhin/ /de tshe 'gro drug thams cad la/ /sdig spong gzugs su rnam par bstan/ /dge tshul rnams la dgra bcom gzugs/ /rang rgyal rnams la bse maru'i tshul/ /gzhan yang theg mchog rim pa bzhin/ /'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la/ /de 102—555

bzhin gsung mchog mi smra stezhiri / /sku yis chos rnams mjal ②bar ston/ /me long bstan pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /dngos kyi mdog ngan thams cad sel/ /'khor gyis de bzhin sku bltas(min/ /byang chub sgrib pa gting dpag med/ /me long bzhin du sku la snang / /de nas sa bcu rim gyis 'byung ④/ /bla med byang chub yang dag 'thob/ /chos sku dpag med brjod du med/ /longs spyod zad med rin chen gter/ /sprul pa bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /mtshan (57dang dpe byad thams cad rdzogs/ /spyod yul kun du ⑥maṇ+ḍa la/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par rol/ /thabs dang shes rab sa yi mchog /de la sogs te bsam yas mchog /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung sku/ /nyon mongs kun gyi gzhing du gnas / /zad mi shes kyi gter du gyur/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin gyi sku/ /thams cad dbyer med mnyam pa'i sku/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sku/ /de tshe sku lnga kun kyang rdzogs/ /zhes 98)brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa thams cad du 1)dkyil 'khor brjod kyis mi lang ba zhing gi rdul snyed du gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 7btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med pa'i yon tan chen po'i dkyil 'khor de dag nyid kyi gsang ba 'di nyid sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin 1nyalas rdo rje las phyung ngo / /a ho/dmigs bya dmigs med mi dmigs dpag med bsam mi khyab/ /ye shes rang rig dkyil 'khor sna tshogs brjod mi lang / /mnyam dang mi mnyam kun khyab khyab med khyab pa'i dbyings/ /ye nas kun gsal dkyil 'khor rnams spro spros pa med / /ye nas kun khyab dkyil 'khor bsam yas zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /ye nas rnam spros snying po kun gnas gnas pa med/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /102—556

a'o 6)zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid la bzhugs nas 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad kyang / nyid la nyid mnyes par mchod cing / kun du bzang po dgyes te/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi ma lus pa thams cad kyi bzhugs gnas thams cad gzhal yas khang rin po che sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ tshad dpag tu med pa/ rgyas pa/ mtha' dbus med par khyab cing 'od zer sgrib pa med pa rang byung ba la bzhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /nyid kyi dbyings nyid 'phro ba dpag tshad med/ /kun nas dkyil 'khor yongs su ma chad pa'i/ /srid gsum yang dag mnyam sbyor spyod yul te / /mtshan 'dzin 'das pa mchog gi rgyu 95)las byung / /dbang sgyur shin tu rnam par dag pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'og min gnas bzhugs nas/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i bla med rjes 'dod dang / /'jig rten 'khor gyi gtsos ③bkur dbang phyug dang / /gzhan dang 'jig rten phyogs bcu khams gnas pa/ /bdud rtsi (4)ro yis dga' ba bde chen 'grub/ /dug gsum dri bral bdud sde tshar bcad (5)pa'i/ /'das dang ma byon de bzhin nyid du sbyor/ /shes rab thabs ldan nges pa'i don phyung ba/ /rig pa'i thabs chen dbang sgyur (7nyid du bsgom / /stong smon mtshan med rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i/ /zad med bsod nams tshogs kyis brgyan par 'gyur/ /r+ghaṃ/ rang byung nyi zla pad+ma rin chen rgyas la bzhugs/ /rdo rje mnyam nyid thugs su chud pa yi/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po 102—557

lhun la rol pa mdzad/ /bde gshegs dbyings nyid de bzhin nyid gnas pa/ /dus bzhi rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par 'ubasti/ /thams cad 'od gsal dkyil 'khor thugs chud pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang las 'byung (kye/ /spyod yul 'phrog med brjod kyis mi lang ba'i/ /dus bzhi mnyam nyid nges pa'i don nyid nyon/ /thugs rje dbang gis 'gro drug dus gnas bzhugs/ /nga dang bdag med mnyam pa'i dbyings mkhyen pa/ /mnyam pa'i don grub rdo rje can gyis bya / /rnam par rtog med byang chub rdo rje can gyi sku/ /shes rab mchog gis ma lus yongs bsdus pa/ /bde gshegs mi gnas mnyam nyid ngang du byon/ /thabs chen ma 'dres rnam par sbas pa yi/ /dmigs med bde gshegs nyid dbyings thugs chud pa/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyings nyid dam pa'i mchog /phyogs bcu dus bzhi dbyings gnas mthas gtugs pa/ /shes rab mchog ldan gsal ba'i ngang 'chang ba/ /thugs rje (7byin brlabs (4)sna tshogs 'phro ba yi(snye/ /bde gshegs ma lus thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid bzhin rin chen mi zad par ldan 'phro/ /rang rig rgyal po che yis rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes nyid la nyid du ched du khyabarjod de rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las gzhal yas khang dbub pa thabs dra ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las 'di dag phyung ngo / /r+ghaṃ bi shwa bi shud dhe / hūm̐ badz+ra :ka 1 /oṃ dzī na ṭīka(9 / swā rat+na pa:kayime /rmā a.ā ro lī ka/102—558

de nas bcom ldan 'das byed pa po rdo rje dang / bya ba mo rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim par mdzad do/ /de nas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid 6)chen po75)/ ye shes dang byin bsdu ba zhes bya ba 'di sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba las phyung ngo / /oṃ shu n+ya tādz+nyā ①na badz+ra swa bhā ba (4)ād+ma ko3rta(5)/ oṃ ma hā ā 56)dar+sha (meshu n+ya tā dz+nyān badz+ra swa bhā (sheb ād+ma ko3rta97/ oṃ ma hā pra t+ya tshabe nyustok+ṣi ṇa kyi shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā tsob ād+ma ko3rtabo / oṃ ma hā sa man+ta 8shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa tibhā ba ād+ma ako3rta(she/ oṃ ma hā kṛ /62 2 7a nujo sartan shu n+ya tā (2shedz+nyā na badz+ra swa ri bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta4ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 2 ma hā kā ( 5ya badz+ra swa (2 /bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta(2 / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta k+ṣ-i tem hā so )bā da1ka sa badz+ra swa ri bhā ba ād+ma rigako3rta(nya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ri)ma hā tsit+ta badz+ra swa (shebhā ba ād+ma ko3rta rte/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa ( snabadz+ra swa (1bla ba (nye.ād+ma ko3rta rta/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ce mo)ma hā pū dza badz+ra swa 6 bhā ba āt+pa (nyako3rta(nye/zhes brjod pas thim par gyur to/ /gsal bar gyur to/ /'bar bar gyur to/ /e mtho :ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /sgra dang ming tshig kun las 'das/ /sna tshogs sgra rnams gsal bar 'byung / /gsung gcig dkyil 'khor yan lag ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab kun tu khyab/ /sgra dang ming tshig so sor grags/ /thams cad gsung gi phyag rgya mchog mu /rgyud mchog rgyud chen dra ba las/ /bde ldan gsung gi don 'byung ba'ang / /thams cad pad+ma'i ngang gyur na/ /grol thar lam dang 'khor ba'i sgra/ /ji skad brjod kyang gsung mchog ste/ /theg pa mtho ne tshodaman thams cad dang / /log 'gro ma 102wa 560

lus thams cad skad/ /byang chub rdo rje gsung du bsdus/ /bsdus nyid phyogs bcur rnam par grags/ /sgra nyid ma chags ngang 6)du gsungs/ /gsungs pa nyid na ②brjod du med/ /brjod med de nyid sna tshogs sgra/ /kun la grags shing so sor 'jal(kye/ /dper na de bzhin sbrid sangs ④bzhin/ /gsung gcig sgra yis (5)thams cad go/ /'di ni gsung mchog rgyal po yin/ /theg pa mtho 6)dman bsam yas kyang 7ri/ /de bzhin nyid las ma gsungs te/ /gdul pa'i thabs su so sor thos/ /ji ltar gsung rab kun brjod kyang / /de bzhin nyid kyis gsungs pa med/ /yi ge med dang rig pa'i gsung / /ljags kyi rtse mor (kyem phyung 9)yang / /thugs rje gsung gi byin brlabs ⑩kyis/ /'gro don sna tshogs so sor gsal/ /gsal nyid gsung gi rdo rje mchog /de bzhin gsung gis 'gro don rnams/ /de bzhin ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /dper na brag ca'i tsho'isgra bzhin no/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang gsang sngags kyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas nyid kyi phyag rgya ston pa'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/badz+ra pra bhā na hūm̐/ hūm̐ tsho badz+ra gan tu dha skorgyu/ oṃ tsa kra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ tso/skye/ lī tu badz+ra gan bhā yinag lī rte/ swā rte cirat+na pra bhā na sa rte/ oṃ badz+ra gan dha bhā khri ṣa ā( she/ oṃ pad+ma pra bhā na /( )/ paṃ badz+ra garnya pra bhā na ge r+pā/ hṝ zhi badz+ra shrī ga tīk+ṣa ru pra bhā sa na 'i rta sto / tai badz+ra gan dha bhā nag pra bhā na rta/ shī dgerat+na pra bhā na shī sa rtsu/ badz+ra gan dha ri pra bhā na gho ṣa hūm̐/ ṭ+wāṃ khan 65bra bhā na rtas / ṭ+wāṃ so badz+ra gan dha bhā cigeg pra 102wa 561

bhā hunyen tre②/ hrīḥcha/ pad+ma pra bhā ④na ༷hrīḥbya/ badz+ra gan dha bhā ṣa pra bhā na hrīḥl/ha ⑧badz+ra garnya bhā ṣa pra bhā na haṃ/ a badz+ra gan dha bhā ṣa pra bhā na āḥkhya/ me kā la pra bhā na me/ hūm̐ badz+ra ⑩gan dha pra bhā na bhā ṣa ⑩/hūṃ/ ṭ+wāṃ pra bhā na maṇ+ḍa la 48/ ṭ+wāṃ badz+ra gan dha bhā ⑩ga ④rta pra bhā na 〉bya/ hūm̐ rat+na swe 7sā dha bha / dra pra bhā na sī yihrīḥ/badz+ra gan dha bhā 4)ga pra bhā 63na trīḥ( ) mu ut+pa la nī la pra bhā na mu/ ā dubadz+ra gan dha bhā 'u nyaṣa pra bhā tson āḥ( nye/ phaṭa badz+ra a maḥ/ muṅga ra pra bhā tson phaṭa phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra garnya bhā snyig pra bhā na oṃ oṃ/ phaṭa ma hā badz+ra nu)pra bhā na phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ ma hā rat+na su)badz+ra gan dha bhā 0ṣa bra bhā dun hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa hriḥdu/ pad+ma mun (ster pra bhā na trī ⑥hrīḥ/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra pad+ma badz+ra gan dha bhā (nyaṣa pra 0ṅgā na hrīḥ/ hrīḥ/ a kurma muṅga thar badz+ra pra bhā na phaṭa phaṭa/ a kurma badz+ra gan dha bhāṣa 0pra bhā na hūm̐/a kyis a zhes brjod pas phyag rgya gsung gi dkyil 'khor kun du gsal bar gyur to / /'bar bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las don dam pa dang / kun rdzob kyi byang chub kyi sems las phyag rgya gsung gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pas rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba bstan pa las/chos thams cad nam mkha' dang yum gyi dbyings su 'dus par bstan nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /yang dag don gyi gsang mchog ni/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /nges pa'i don chen (me bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ /yid bzhin rin chen gsal 'bar thim/ /thams cad ma lus thig le'i dbyings/ /sku lnga'i 'od zer mang po kun/ /thams cad yum 'gyur dbyings su thim/ /102wa 562

gsal 'bar sprin gyi bdag por 'gyur6)/ /byang chub sems kyi thigs pa (snyeni/ /kun la khyab cing mi gnas pa/ /kha dog gnas dang dbyibs ma yin/ /yon tan mchog gi snying po ni/ /rtog ge ①spyod yul yong ma yin/ /zab cing rgya chen rab sbyangs pa'i/ /gsal ldan brtan (gepa'i spyod yul te/ /gzhan nas ⑤btsal zhing brtag tu med/ /thams cad nam mkha'i 6)mtshan nyid de/ /sna tshogs 'jig 9)rten brtan g.yo dang / /rgyal ba mngon byung thams cad kun/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su ma gyur (8)pa/ /dus bzhi phyogs bcu gang na medakyi)/ /dus gsum bde gshegs nyid kyi mnga'/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs thugs chud pa'i/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su thams cad thim/ /thams cad shes rab dbyings nyid de / /dbyings la dbyings ni rnam par sbyor/ /shes rab dbyings nyid 'byor pa yis / /byang chub rdo rje thig le yin/ /dkyil 'khor gzhal yas lhun grub dang / /rgya dang bral ba'i bsam yas kyis/ /kun la khyab cing mi gnas pa/ /yon tan mchog gi gnas yin te/ /ma bcos rgyun gyi skad cig ma/ /de yis ma zin gang yang med/ /rang gi rnam rtog ma yin pa/ /yang dag gshegs dang log rtog dang / /gzhan yang sprul pa mang po'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad kun/ /de la gsad 7cing gzung /nyadu med/ /kha dog dbyibs dang gnas ma yin/ /skyes bu dam pa mchog 'dod pas/ /de la rtag 'grus gsal bar gyis7/ / de yi tshona'abras bu mthar phyin ni/ /rgyu 'bras med pa'i dus gcig ste/ /thams cad ming gi mtshan nyid du/ /yi ge 'bru gsum rdzogs par gyur / /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor los bsdus/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs skyapar rol / /skye 'jig med pa'i dbyings la zhugs/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig /ri102—563

rten pa'i/ /mtha' yas 'jig rten bsam yas kun/ /rgyal ba yum gyi dbyings su thim/ /thams cad ma lus chos skur 'dus①/ /ho/ chos thams cad ming gi mtshan nyid do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las thams cad yum gyi dbyings su 'dus pa shin tu gsang ba'i le'u ste bco (9lnga pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ yan lag thams cad dkyil 'khor du lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba (miched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pas/ /thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgya/ /gsang ba de nyid nges pa yi/ /snying po phyag rgya 'da' bar dka'(ge/ /mi bskyod (5)nyi ma'i dkyil yi ge/ /rin chen zla ba'i dkyil yi ge/ /lnga gnyis zung du spros pa las/ /sbyar ba phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /oṃ dang sbo (nyaganyis rtse sbyar te/ /'bru brgyad bsnol nas rtser sprad pa/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i / /bde ba chen po (7sbyin pa'i rgya/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkanatshon3 / /hūṃ bsgreng 99)rtse mor rdo rjer kyi'abar/ /zla brtul 57'bru sbas dril gsil 62zhing / /'khril pa'i tshul gyis chos la brtan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur (1stebakan/ / hūm̐ gyi 7rtse mor dril gsil zhi'abar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril7/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis bltadzo/ma/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur yi bkan/ /oṃ 39bsgreng rtse mor 'khor lo 'bar/ /zla brtul 'bru sbas dril gsil ( 7zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan( me/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur ‘ stobakan/ /lī gegyi rtse mor dril gsil ‘ /'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis blta/ /'bru bzhi 102wa 564

sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /sī 6)rtser 'bar ba rin po che/ /zla brtul 'bru sbas dril gsil ②zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /māṃ ③gyi rtse mor dril gsil ④'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lngas (snyelas su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /āḥyigyi rtse mor pad+ma 'bar/ /zla brtul 'bru sbas dril gsil (7)zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /dzā (kyebasgreng rtse mor dril gsil 6)'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lnga las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis blta/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ / hṝ gyi 7rtse mor ral gri 'bar/ /zla brtul 'bru sbas dril gsil 41zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtanatso/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /t+t+waṃ (gebasgreng rtse mor dril gsil tso'abar/ /nyi ma 'bru lngas las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis tsobalta/ /ut+pal la a+yosogs klu shing mtshan/ /rin chen myu gu ral gri 'bar/ /pad+ma dkar po rdo rje 'bar / /chos kyi 'khor lo rin chen te/ /gzugs mdzes rin chen phreng ba dang / /bi bang(rtegar mkhan mchog nyid de/ /me tog phreng ba spos mchod ma/ /mar me byug la sogs pa yis/ /las la 'khril cing chos la brtan/ /dbu rnams byon nas 'dud pa'i tshul/ /gong tshoshegi phyag rgya chen po bzhin/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du thim/ /sgo bzhi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /mṛ tsho/mgo gdengs dang rdo rjes gnon/ /thod phreng chen pos gnon pa dang / /rdo rje rgya gram las kyis gnon/ /lcags kyu zhags pa sbo ṭa hoḥ(2 kyi/ /sgo bzhir gnas pa de dag kyang / /'dud tshul 'khril ba gong ma bzhin/ /thub drug phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /102—565

mdor bsdus phyag rgya drug yin no/ /gseg 6)par dang ni pi bang phyidang / /go cha po ②ti rin chen sgrom/ /me dang chu ru rab tu bstan④/ /yum ni gnyis med chos kyi dbyings/ /kun bzang mnyam bzhag (geyi shes 'phro/ /yum 'gyur ⑥mnyam rdzogs pad+ma'i ( byedakyil/ /gzhan yang phyag rgya sna tshogs te/ /yang na de bzhin gshegs nyid de(she/ /yang na rdo rje thal mo nyid/ /phyag rgya chen po tshogs mchog ni/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan 'byor na/ /ma 6)bskyod ma bskul thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du gnas/ /yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ldan / /de nyid yan lag spros bdag ⑩ste/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis sum 'phror 'bar / /de ltar yi7ldan pa'i gtso mchog gis/ /rgyal ba rgya mchog de bzhin du/ /bcu gnyis drug gi 'od 'phro 'bar/ /de la sogs te bsam mi khyab/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi bsam yas su/ /'dul ba'i don rnams so sor ston/ /theg pa mtho tshadaman thams cad dang / /phyin ci log rnams bsam yas dang / /zhi khro tshogs chen thams cad la/ /so sor mthun byas kun du snang / /dper na gar mkhan nyid 'dra ba/ /lus las ma dgod sna tshogs ston/ /mdor na phyag rgya thams cad ni/ /'di zhes gcig ces brjod du med/ /gnyis dang gsum du rnam par 'phro/ /bskyod dang spro ba de bzhin nyid/ /mdor na bskyod 'gul thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du gnas/ /gnas nyid mi gnas gnas (7pa'ang min/ /de skad dag mchog nyid kyis bshad/ /mthe bo mdzub ⑫mo rdo rje 'dzin/ /mthe bo gung mo rgyal ba 'dzin/ /srin lag mthe bo chags pa che / /mthe'u (7chung mthe bo legs pa mchog /hūm̐ hoḥ(tsha/ mdzub kyi 7mo gnyis sbyar rin chen mchog /gung mo gnyis sbyar gzi brjid don/ /srin lag gnyis sbyar 102—566

rgyal ba'i tog /bzhad ①pa'i sgras ni mthe'u chung sprad/ /tram̐ te ru ha/ mdzub ②mo steng 'og chos kyi mchog /gung mo steng 'og 'jam dpal mchog /srin lag steng 'og 'khor lo mchog /mthe'u chung steng 'og smra gsung yin/ /hrīḥni/ r+ghaṃ ṭ+wāṃ rtabya/ mdzub (7mo rgya gram las kyi mchog /gung mo rgya gram bsrung ⑥bar byos//srin lag rgya gram gnod sbyin mchog /mthe'u chung rgya gram gnas par bshad/ /ha hūm̐ a r+ghaṃ/ phyag rgya brda ⑦tshig chen po 'dis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor mdzes par snang / /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor phun sum tshogs/ /glu gnyis phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /sa ler gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bebs/ /phyag rgya spros pa chen pos ni/ /gzung (kyedang 'dzin pa rnam gnyis pa/ /dag par gsal bas phyag rgya yin/ /yi ge so so ⑨gsal ba yis/ /gar du bsgyur bas mya ngan 'das / /dzaḥyidang hoḥ(sprel sogs pa yis/ /gar du bsgyur bas rdo rjer 'ching ske/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid kyinges pa las phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang pos mtshon cha dam tshig ces bya ba'i glu 'di blangs so/ /hūṃ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang gnas pas / /ye shes rdo rje gsor zhing spro.a/ /e ma'o rdo rje che mchog ni/ /nyid kyi mtshan du gsol ba ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi phyed la/ /cis kyang ma g.yos ma 'dres pas/ /bde chen mchog tu gyur pas na/ /kun kyang phyag rgya bzhi 8rgyas gdabali / /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs nyid la/ /rdo rje 'chang rgyal thams cad kyi/ /102—567

rang gi rtags su bstan pa'i phyir/ /mi phyed rdo rje 'chang zhes bya/ /ju/ ji 6)ltar rgyal po rang gi rgyas/ /rgyal po gtsigs la btab pa ltar/ /bde chen snying la gnas pa dang / /dbang chen dus la brtson pa yis/ /thams cad kun la de ltar 'debs/ /'da' dka' ji bzhin mi shigs pas/ /rgyal po phyag rgya mchog gi gnas/ /bdag nyid chen po (snyematshan ma'i gzugs/ /hūm̐/ phyag rgya zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /nyid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /rdo rje rdo rje drag chen dang / /rang nyid che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /'dul ba thabs kyi rgyal po yis/ /phye zhing bshig dang bcom la (5)sogs/ /dkrugs shing thal ba rdul phran (pebazhin/ /57btsan (67zhing 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du 'dis/ /thams cad rdo rje nyid pas na/ /nam mkha'i khams kun bkang ba yin/ /de las rdo rje gsung tso'abyung ba'o/ /o badz+ra 8)dza lā na lā rka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes te/ / snang mdzad 'khor lo dpa' bo yin/ /(9)snang mdzad 'khor lo rang gnas pas/ /ye shes 'khor lo gsor zhing spro/ /e ma'o 'khor lo che mchog gi/ /nyid kyi mtshan du gsol pa ni/ /cis kyang mi 7shigs mi phyed pas/ /cis kyang ma g.yos ma 'dres pas/ /bde chen mchog tu gyur pas na/ /kun kyang phyag rgya bzhi yi7rgyas gdab/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs nyid las / /'khor lo 'chang rgyal thams cad kyi/ /rang gi rtags su bstan (1 pa'i phyir / /mi phyed 'khor lo 'chang zhes bya/ /hūṃ/ ji ltar rgyal po rang gi 12rgyas/ /rgyal po'i gtsigs ni btab pa ltar/ /bde chen snying la gnas pa dang / /dbang chen 'dus tshal brtson pa yis/ /thams cad kun la de ltar 'debs/ /'da' dka' ji bzhin mi shigs pas/ /rgyal po phyag rgya mchog gi tshaganas1 / /102—568

bdag nyid chen po mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /nyid kyi 6)lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /oṃ/ 'khor lo 'khor lo drag chen dang / /rang nyid che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /'dul ba'i thabs kyi rgyal po yis phye zhing gzhig dang bcom (bal sogs/ /dkrugs shing thal ba rdul phran bzhin/ /hūm̐ / btsan ( zhing 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du 'dis/ /thams cad 'khor lo nyid pas na/ /nam mkha'i khams kun bkang ba yin/ /de las 'khor lo gsung 'byung ba/ /oṃ tsakra dz+wa (4༄lān lārka rtsu phaṭa/ /oṃ/ lus ngag yid gsum pad+ma ni / /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /pad+ma sems dpa' dpa' bo yin/ /pad+ma sems dpar (5)rang gnas pas/ /pad+ma dgra sta gsor zhing spro/ /e ma'o (6 pad+ma che mchog gi/ /nyid kyi mtshan du gsol ba ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi phyed la/ /cis kyang ma (7rigayos ma 'dres pas/ /bde chen mchog tu gyur pas na/ /kun kyang phyag rgya bzhi rgyas btab(8)/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs nyid las/ /pad+ma 'chang rgyal thams cad kyis/ /rang gi rtags su bstan pa'i phyir/ /mi phyed pad+ma 'chang zhes bya/ /oṃ ji ltar rgyal po rang gi (9)rgyas/ /rgyal po lagatsigs ni btab pa ltar/ /bde chen snying la gnas pa dang / /dbang chen dus la brtson pa yis/ /thams cad kun la de ltar 'bebs(me / /'da' dka' ji bzhin mi shigs pa(ge/ /rgyal po phyag rgya mchog gi gnas / /hūm̐/ bdag nyid chen po mtshan ma gzugs/ /phyag rgya zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /nyid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /pad+ma dgra sta drag chen dang / /rang nyid che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /'dul ba thabs kyi rgyal po yisatshon /phye zhing bshig dang bcom la sogs/ /dkrugs shing thal ba rdul phran bzhin/ /102—569

btsan hu)zhing 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du 'dis/ /thams cad pad+ma nyid pas ni/ /nam mkha' ②khams kun bkang ba yin / /de las pad+ma'i gsung phyung ba/ /oṃ pad+ma dz+wa lā na rgyalārka rtsu phaṭa/ /〉phyi/ lus ngag yid gsum rin chen ni/ / sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes te/ /yisku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /yon tan chen po dpa' bo yin/ /rin chen sems dpar nga nyaganas pas/ /ye shes dbyug pa gsor zhing spro/ /e ma'o phyirdo rje rin chen che mchog gi/ /nyid kyi mtshan du gsol ba ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi phyed la/ /cis kyang ma g.yos ma 'dres pas/ /bde chen mchog tu gyur pas na/ /kun kyang phyag rgya bzhi rgyas gdab / /86)/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs nyid la/ /rin chen 'chang rgyal thams cad kyi/ /rang gi rtags su bstan pa'i phyir/ /mi phyed rin chen 'chang zhes bya/ /〉kyi/ ji ltar rgyal po rang gi rgyas/ /rgyal po'i gtsigs ni btab pa ltar/ /bde chen snying la gnas pa dang / /dbang chen dus la brtson pa yis / /thams cad kun la de ltar 'debs/ /'da' dka' (nyaji bzhin mi shigs pas/ /rgyal po phyag rgya mchog gi gnas/ /bdag nyid chen po mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /nyid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro / /rin chen dbyug 7pa drag chen dang / /rang nyid che ba'i bdag nyid dang //'dul ba thabs kyi rgyal po yis/ /phye zhing bshig dang (gebacom la sogs/ /dkrugs shing thal ba 〉rdul phran bzhin/ /btsan yizhing 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du yis / /thams cad rin chen nyid pas nayi/ /nam mkha' tu khams kun bkang ba yin/ /de las rin chen gsung 'byung ba/ / sī rat+na dz+wa lā na lārka ṭ+wāṃ yinyephaṭa / /sno17/ lus ngag yid gsum phrin ( )las ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye 102—570

shes te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /las kyi sems dpa' dpa' bo yin//las kyi sems dang rang 0)gnas pas/ /ye shes ral gri 'debs shing spro/ /e ma'o ②las kyi che mchog gi②/ /nyid kyi mtshan du gsol ba ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi phyed la/ /cis kyang ma g.yos ma 'dres pas/ /bde chen mchog tu gyur pas na/ /kun kyang phyag rgya bzhi rgyas btab/ /'o④/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs nyid las/ /ral gri 'chang rgyal thams cad kyi/ /rang gi rtags su bstan pa'i phyir/ /mi phyed ral gri 'chang zhes bya/ /lhu8/ ji ltar rgyal po rang gi rgyas(6)/ /rgyal po'i gtsigs ni btab pa bzhin/ /bde chen snying la gnas pa dang / /dbang chen dus la brtson pa yis/ /thams cad kun la de ltar 'debs / /'da' dka' ji bzhin mi shigs pas/ /rgyal po phyag rgya mchog gi gnas / /bdag nyid chen po'i mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /nyid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /haṃ ral gri ral gri drag chen dang / /rang nyid che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /'dul ba thabs kyi ⑦rgyal po yis/ /phye zhing bshig dang bcom la sogs/ /dkrugs (kyeshing thal ba rdul phran bzhin/ /btsan 5)zhing 'bar ba'i 'du 'phro 'dis/ /thams cad ral gri nyid pas na/ /nam mkha' yikhams kun bkang ba yin/ /de las phrin khyenyalas gsung byung ba'o/ /tsā 7karma dz+wa lā na lārka 4)rgyu phaṭa/ mū 7lus ngag yid gsum dril bu las/ /sku gsung thugs nyid gtum por 'gyur/ /bskor thabs che ba'i mchog tshul du/ /rdo rje lan gsum gsor ba yis/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /dam can rnal 'byor dbang du 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pho mo gang snang ba'i/ /thams cad gcig tu 'dus par ni/ /yul la mngon du snang bar 'gyur/ /mi bskyod rdo rje thabs 102—571

ldan pas/ /oṃ dang haṃ ni ma thal bar/ /lan gsum gsor chen gur dkar bsgom / /lhan (1)de'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu 'gyur/ /oṃ dang haṃ ni thal tsam du / /kun du gru bzhir bdag gnas te/ /lan gsum gsor la gang brtson (mipa / /tshe dang skal ( ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ /longs spyod ci 'dod grub par 'gyur / /de nas zla gam mdog dmar sham/ /'brel ba mnyam par lan gsum gyis ) / /khros pas gsor la gang brtson pas/ /yid la dmigs dang las thams cad/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor nyid du 'gyur/ /de las gtum pa'i mdog gnas te/ /drag tu phaṭa ces brjod pas ni/ /kha dog nag por bdag gnas shing / /bskal pa 'bar ba'i dbus gnas pa/ /khros te dgug pa nyid dag tu/ /rgyang ni ring du 'phangs pa na/ /ci 'dod las rnams 'grub ( par nges / /oṃ badz+ra da ha dz+wa (6)la ha na badz+ra pa tsa dz+wa la badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ chos la brtan pa phyag bsnams pa/ /sbubs ni dril bu chos khams te/ /shes rab yum gyi tshogs su brtag(7 /skad ni gsung snyan bde ba mo/ /lce ni gar mkhan mya ngan 'das / /chos sku thugs kyi thugs nyid las/ /rab tu gsor la gang brtson pas/ /hūm̐ 98la sogs pa'i yi ge bsgom/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma 'bar/ / s+t+waṃ gyi (9)tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /kun du dbang sgyur 7yid 'ong ba'i/ /'dod pa bzhin du mthun pas 'grub11/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa yo pā yo sha dharma dhā cha)ra/ hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas 7de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yil dgyes yi 7par gyur to / /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las sgyu 'phrul chen po thabs dang shes rab tu 'byung ba phyag mtshan gyi le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //102—572

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen po rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig bkod pa la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /shin tu phra ba'i dam tshig mchog /phyag rgya chen po'i phyag mthil du/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa dezhi)/ /sor ni bzhi yi tshad du bya/ /'bru lnga spos (kyelnga rin chen lnga/ /snying po lnga dang sman lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis rab mnyam (5)la /rig pas thig ni gdab par bya/ /lte ba rtsibs dang ldan pa yi/ /rtse bzhi 'khor lo mu khyud bcas/ /gru chad bzhi dang gru bzhi yi/ /bar khyams sgo khyud ldan par bya / /sen zlum tsam gyi nyi zla la/ /tsa na 'bru tsam pad+mo gdan/ /yungs 'bru tsam gyi (ri)yi ge las/ /phyag rgya til 'bru tsam du bri/ /bcos bu'i ras ni sna tshogs dang / /rgyan phreng dung dang bro bas bskor/ /glu tshig bro gar rol mo yi55༄ //sprin phung tshogs kyis rab tu mchod/ /yum dang 'jo ma ri kyisems ma dang / /ji ltar 'dod pa'i las bzhin mchod/ /dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ldan pa'i/ /zhal du gyur pa'i me bos la/ /bza' btung bro ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /las bzhi mchod pa ( rab tu sbyin/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor de bzhin te/ /shin tu phra la (0sbyangs pa yis/ /bsam yas dag la de bzhin bya/ /rig kyi)pas dpag pa tsam du'o/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis / /phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas zhing / /mnyen 'jam reg na bde ba yiti/ /sna tshogs rin po che yi gzhi/ /mdzes par bris shing spras pa dang / /kun 'byung rin chen phung po 'bar/ /dbyibs legs rdzing bu bro nyu1)mchog bsil//rin chen khang pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan dang dpag bsam 512sngon pa'i tshal /glu dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra/ /bla re rgyal mtshan na bza' gdugs/ /102—573

do shal dpung rgyan se mo do/ /bza' dang btung ba'i mchog rnams dang / /rang la mdzes pas brgyan pa yi/ /lha dang lha mo rdul snyed kyi/ /bro gar la sogs bsam yas kyis/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par dbul/ /skal ldan gsal pa'i khyad par gyis/ / rim gyis 6)yang na cig char ②du/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam sbyor zhing / /mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po bsgom / /gsal ldan ma'am byin brlabs ④la/ /stong gsum yungs 'brur la'ajug tshul du/ /dbyings nas dkyil 'khor spyan drangs mchod/ /mnyes nas 'grub (5)pa'i dam tshig mchog /bdag nyid chen po mchod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum 'gro ba ma lus la( / /dga' ba chen pos khyab par gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba brtan pa yis / /phyogs bcu dus bzhir gshegs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus dang / /khams gsum 'gro rnams mngon du gyur/ /lus ngag sems dang chos thams cad/ /gang na mi gnas mi dmigs pa/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i chos nyid la/ /mig yor tshul du sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgomacho / /goms pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /kun byas dbang phyug rig pas 'jug /de nas slob ma gzhug par bya/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ ci/rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul/ /dbang phyug longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa yin/ /nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /nyes pa thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /dad brtson brtul zhugs rab rtogs nas/ /phan pa'i dbang sbyin nus pa'i dbang / /rim pa bzhin du sbyin par bya/ /snying 102—574

rjes chud ma zos par gzung 0)/ /yang na thal mo rab bsnol phyinas/ /phyag ①chen po yi ④'phang (snyedu ni/ /dkyil 'khor mdzub dugang tshad du bya/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /yang na sa gzhi mnyam ⑦pa la/ /dkyil 'khor khru gang tshad du bya/ /yang na lus gang tshad du ste/ /yang na lus ni gsum gyi tshad/ /phur bu srad bu tshon phye dang / /gos rgyan dumadzes ma yid 'ong grogs/ /thig gdab cho ga phun sum tshogs/ /mkhas ldan chen pos bsgrims te bya/ /yang na gru 6)ni bcu drug dang / /nyi shu'am nyi shu rtsa lngar bya/ /rigs ⑩kyi dkyil 'khor lnga rnams bsgom/ /sku gsung thugs ldan gzugs kyang dgod/ /yang na rgyang grags dpag tshad dam/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni bsam yas par sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bsgom/ /ma mthong rmongs pa ston phyir tshon/ /kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga 'am/ /lnga yi tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /'dul ba'i cho ga bzhin du dgye7 / /ting 'dzin rol mo mtha' yas mchog /yi ge'am gdan nam snying po 'am / /phyag rgya'am sku gsung thugs ldan par/ /byin brlabs ⑩ya mtshan rmad po che/ /'grub 'gyur sangs rgyas kun gyi dam/ /sa la sogs pa phyag rgyar byas//rnam grol rim par thob par 'gyur/ /dag pa'i ye shes kyis byas pa/ /smos ci dgos te de nyid yin/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo / /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor ba/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ /yi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ni/ /kun du bzang mo mi bsnyengs 8yin/ /kun du bzang mo rang 8gnas pas / /ye shes dril bu gsil ⑩zhing spro/ /e ma'o /shesangs rgyas yum chen gyitu// /nyid kyi 102—575

mtshan du gsol ba ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi phyed la/ /cis kyang ma stigayos ma 'dres pas(snye/ /bde chen yum du gyur pas na/ /kun kyang phyag rgya yum lngas ①btab / /sbo(ge/ kun du bzang mo'i thugs nyid las/ /rdo rje yum chen thams cad kyi/ /rang gi rtags su bstan pa'i phyir/ /mi phyed dril bu 'chang zhes bya/ /hūm̐ sniji ltar rgyal po'i gnas bshams te/ /rgyal pos gtsigs chen 'gyed pa ltar / /bde chen yum du gnas pa dang / /dbang chen dus la brtson pa yis/ /thams cad kun la de ltar 'debs/ /'da' dka' ji bzhin mi shigs pas/ /rgyal po phyag rgya mchog gi gnas/ /bdag nyid yum chen mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /phyag rgya zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /nyid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /hūm̐ 6)dril bu dril bu grags snyan dang / /yum nyid che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /'dul ba thabs kyi rgyal mo yis/ /phye zhing bshig dang bcom la sogs/ /dkrugs shing thal ba rdul phran bzhin/ /btsan 9)zhing 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du 'dis/ /thams cad dril bu nyid pas na/ /nam mkha' (8)khams kun bkang ba yin/ /de las chos sku gsung 'byung ba/ /sbo 99lha dz+wa lā nya )na 1ste lārka sbo (nyezhes brjod pas phyag rgya'i 12tshogs su snang bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po yide kho na nyid nges pa las mtshon cha dam tshig phyag rgya glu'i 7le'u ste bcwa yibargyad pa'o// // de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang pos thabs dang / shes rab 'byung ba 1 zhes bya ba 'di ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /de nas yid dang chos mthun par/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya rdo rje 'chang / /shes rab dril yi bu chos la brtan1rte / /tsū dang hūm̐ gyi 2 /snying po 'bar/ /de las rdo rje rtse bcur 'bar/ /102—576

oṃ dang hūm̐ gyi hu)mchog tu brtag /shes rab nyi zer zla rgyas thabs/ /'bar ba'i phung pos chos la brten②/ /de las gzung thabs gnyis kyis ni/ /'bru lnga phyag rgya nyid du ste/ /de las rdo rje phyag bsnams gsor/ /de las 'khor lo phyag bsnams gsor/ /de las nor bu phyag bsnams pa/ /de las pad+ma phyag bsnams 'dzin / /de las ral gri phyag bsnams gcod/ /de nyid rdo rje phyag bsnams pa/ /thabs chen drug tu yang dag gsor/ /de las (5)rdo rje gzung 4)thabs gnyis/ /oṃ dang spru (5)gyi mtshon bzhin du/ /rdo rje rtse bcu thabs chen po/ /thugs kur brtan (6)pa'i tshul du 'bar/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag na mi 'jigs thugs kur 'dzin/ /hūm̐ (7)las phyag rgya chen po ni/ / dril gsil (nya'abar bas sangs rgyas yum/ /mchod gnas chos la brten 5 par 'dzin/ /thams cad kun du phyag rgya yi/ /thabs dang shes rab rdo rje 'chang / /sku gsung thugs ni thams cad pa/ /yon tan phrin 7las kun du rdzogs/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas byang chub pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang du dmigs/ /de las rdo rje mchog bsnams pa/ /de las mi bskyod nyi ma'i lam/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan las/ / oṃ rtsu ṭ+wāṃ 41)gyi rtser 'dzin pa/ /nyid las tshogeyang dag bskyed tshul du//shes rab yum du shin tu brtags/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rab brten tsho pa/ /thabs chen yid ni sangs rgyas yab/ /gcig dang du rilam yongs kyis medas/ /de las 'gro don phrin las 'charas/ /yid dang chos su rab brtags pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang rgyal tshul chen las/ /rdo rje drag por lan gsum gsor/ /gtum pa'i (1 sngags brjod de bskyed pas/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /dpag bsam 18shing dang yid bzhin gyi/ /102—577

rin chen dbyig dang 'byung ba kun/ /de dag rdzas yod ①ma yin te/ /rang sems bsod nams brtan②pa yin/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad kyi chos / /gzhan nas yod 'ong ma yin te/ /thabs la brten ③pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu yi lingang du 'byung / /shes rab dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid/ /thabs kyi phyag rgyar gyur pa'i phyir/ /ye shes la ni ye shes rol/ /ye shes rol pa nyid gang choge)gsog /rgyal ba mngon byung skyob ⑥pa dang / /byin brlabs ⑦ston pa'ang de bzhin te/ /bya byed nus mthu'i gzi byin gyisadu/ /sgyu ma rdo rje btsan ①po mchog /cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas shing / /yo byad lnga ni rdzogs par ldan/ /sngags kyi yan lag lnga rdzogs pas/ /ma nyams 'jug la kyirab brtson pa/ /zhag ni sum cu ⑩phyag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang sgyur ⑫rigs kyi dam pa 'grubatso/ /de tshe bcu drug tshun chad kyis/ /sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs pa ni/ /ye shes thig le de nyid la/ /ye shes thig le nyid snang ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /zhing khams rnam dag bsam yas dang / /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang / /'khor lo rgyan dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsam yas kun/ /mthong nas nye bar mnyes pa dang / /rgya chen gsung las don byung ba/ /mthun pa'i ye shes rang snang ngo / /gcig dang du mar bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi gzigs te/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med snang / /log par rtog brtags rnam dag cing / /ye shes dbyings las mi gzhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos 'brel pas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas (7)ma lus snang / /bde ba chen mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /stangs dpyal 102—578

gnyis sam yang na lnga/ /byas te dad ldan rab zhugs na/ /'dod pa yid 'ong mnyam par 'gyur/ /skal ba mnyam pa'i ye shes de6)/ /gnyer na nye bar mnyam pa yi/ /ya mtshan chen po 'byung bar nges/ /dad med nyams na phung bar 'gyur / /zhes ched du brjod do/ /rdo rje bkod pa gsang ba dam tshig gi le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu ②'phrul dra ba las lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan ①gyi dkyil 'khor gyi ④dngos grub blang ba'i thabs 'di gsungs so / /ye nas mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor la/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan byas te/ /rang rig 6)ye shes rgyal po yis/ /thams cad ma lus maṇ+ḍa la/ /de bzhin nyid kyi gzhal yas la/ /rig pa rang byung (phyiragyur pa yis/ /mnyam par mnyam la mi gnas pa'i/ /chos sku'i phyag rgya chen por bsgomag/ /'jig rten brtan g.yo thams cad la/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gnas mod kyi/ /gzung (kye'adzin rnam rtog zhags pa yis/ /rang rig bsgribs shing bdag 5)tu bcings/ /kun gyis kyiyang dag rtogs bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin chos sku'i gzugs brnyan bstan/ /rtog dang mi rtog rang rig dang / /yang dag thabs chen rdzogs pa'i don/ /rin chen sna tshogs la sogs dang / /'byung ba bzhi las gyur rnams kun/ /thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgyu/ /gzugs sogs ri mor bris pa dag /ye shes chen po rab 'byam gyisanyu / /don du mi 'gyur yong ma gsungs/ /de bzhin ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyis/ /thams cad dbyings su bsdus nas ni/ /nyid kyi thugs la bstim 12byas te/ /thams cad chos sku'i phyag rgya che/ /dkyil 102—579

'khor rnam gsum dag byas pas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rang rig ye shes 'du 'phro yis/ /thams cad chos sku phyag rgya che/ /yang dag rtogs pa'i khyad par gyis/ /ting 'dzin don rnams gsal bsgoms te/ / mā ma tī yi 0)rgyun chags la/ /yang dag chos sku phyag rgya che/ /de bzhin ting 'dzin gsal bsgoms (minas/ /don mchog ma lus rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /mkha' la 'phro ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dri med chos sku phyag rgya gsal(7/ /dbyings dang de bzhin nyid med par/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bsgyur nas/ /kha dog dbyibs dang gzugs su bsgyur/ /sna tshogs phrin (4)las rnam par rol/ /don gyi snying po mchog rnams kyang / /byang chub phyogs rnams rab tu rdzogs/ /'jig rten gtso mchog rnams kyis bskor/ /a hoḥ57chos sku phyag rgya de dag las//las lnga'i dkyil 'khor rab tu bsgrubasgyu kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bsgyur (7)na/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /drag po gtum po gdul 8ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid drag po bsgoms nas ni/ /chos sku nag po 'od 'bar gyis/ /bgegs kyi liṅga mnan 997par bya/ /gtum po rngam po'ang brlag khapar 'gyur/ /mi mthun phyogs kyang rdul du rlog /'di dang 11'gro ba thams cad du/ /shin tu stobs drag che ldan 'gyur/ /thams cad gnyis med dbyings bsdu'i phyir/ /bdag nyid ha ya spyi bar bsgom(12/ /dmar po'i chos sku gsal bsgoms te/ /rme mthun phyogs rnams gdan du gdeng 1 / /ting 'dzin gsal bas byin brlabs na / /thams cad ma lus dbang du bsdu/ /mthu chen dag kyang phyi (7bzhin 'brang / /ci 'dod las rnams byed par lo'agyur/ /thams cad yon tan 'phel bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid rgyal ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /gser gyi mdog 'dra 1(32—58()

phyag rgyar bsgom6)/ /gang 'phel chos sku gdan du gzhag② /de ltar dag pas byin brlabs na/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs ③kyis/ /gtum khro ma lus zhi bya'i phyir/ /dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i chos sku bsgom/ /gang zhig ④gtum khro zhi ba'i gdan/ /de bzhin ting 'dzin byin brlabs na/ /gtum po rngam po'ang zhi bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin/ /zhi zhing dul ba nyid du 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rnam bzhi dkyil 'khor dbyings su bsdus/ /bya byed med par dkyil 'khor spyod/ /lhun grub ⑤dkyil 'khor ye nas rdzogs/ /a hoḥ༅/chos sku phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dngos grub gang 'dod sbyin par nges/ /nye ba'i lha ni gang bsgrub pa/ /phyag rgya'i snying po bris bcug na/ /gang bsgoms the tshom med par 'grub/ /de ni rgyal ba kun dang mnyam/ /the tshom med de nges 'grub 'gyur / /'jig rten pa yi ⑦lha sgrub (nyan/ /lha yi snying po gang yang rung / /bris te dkyil 'khor nang bcug na/ /lha de nye bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /chos nyid 6)rten cing 'brel bris na/ /chos kyi don rnams rtogs 'gyur te/ /rang dang spyi yi don rtogs nas/ /skye rga na 'chi med par rtogs/ /phyag rgya chen po de dag la/ /nyon mongs las rnams sbyong byed pa'i/ /snying po ma nor don bris na / /ngan song sdug bsngal med par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor bsam yas dang / /dpag tshad med pa'i phyag rgya che/ /sku gsung thugs ni rgyun mi chad7 / /zhing khams bye ba rdul dang mnyam/ /a hoXnya/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o / /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las lhag pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis dngos grub len pa'i 102—581

thabs te mchod rten gdab pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po rgyal po dbang sbyin pa khya)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do②/ /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya las/ /bde ba'i 'bru tshogs gsal ba'i rgyun/ /rdo rje lam las pad+mor dkyil / /rtse nas bstim zhing dkyil 'khor sgyurali/ /nyan byed 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le ngo bo nyid/ /traṃ gi phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor gsal spro bstim/ /traṃ gsang ba'i gsang chen gsang mchog dang / /gsang ba kun la mnyan ⑤par bya/ /gsang ba'i don nyid rtogs pa las/ /gzhan du smra bar bya ba min/ /gsal ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le ngo bo nyid/ /yi ge phreng ba'i tshogs mchog las/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal spro thim/ /oṃ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras chen po/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje zung 6)/ /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes mchod la/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /lag pa'i 'khor lo gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /hūm̐ gi phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog las/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor gsal spro thim/ /oṃ khyod ni rdo rje las yin pas / /las rnams ma lus kun byos shig /pho nya 'du 'phro mang po kun/ /khyod kyi dgos pa byed pa yin/ /smra byed 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsang ba'i thig le ngo bo nyid/ /hrīḥ(7phyag rgya (na tshogs mchog las/ /chos kyi 'khor lo gsal spro thim/ /oṃ chos kyi bdud rtsi bla med kyis/ /dad ldan skyes bu ngoms par byos/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i blo can la/ /mthun par gsang bsgrags 102—582

gzhan ①du min/ /bskyod chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /gsal ba'i thig le'i ngo bo nyid/ /hūm̐ oṃ swe i haṃ ②rnams las/ /dkyil 'khor lnga dang khro phreng bsgom / /phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kyis / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje che / /dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed pa po/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi sbyin pa spyod/ /slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par ma byas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa ④rnams/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang / /go cha rgyal mtshan phyag rgya dang / /gdugs dang bum pa bza' btung dang / /snying po lnga yis dbang bskur ⑤na/ /dus 'di phan chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /ngan song thams cad med pa dang / /gnyen por gyur pa'i rtsal 'chang bas/ /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /kun du bzang po la sogs mtshan/ /⑥mtho ris thar pa'i dbang por 'gyurasti/ /lus ⑧dang phung por bcas pa'i sa6nye/ /rig 'dzin sa la gnas pa yin⑩/ /rig 'dzin sa la gnas pa'i sa(nya/ /bla med kun du bzang por 'gyur/ /yum dang sgeg mo la sogs la/ /de nyid byin gyis rlob par 'gyur8/ /pho nya 'du 'phro mang po rnams/ /sangs rgyas bka' las mi 'da' zhing / / de yi tsodagos pa byed pa dang / /sgro dang skur skepa la sogs pa/ /de ni myur du brlag snyipar 'gyur / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bdag por 'gyur / /zhes ched du brjod do/ /tsogasang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dbang sbyin pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen po mnyam pa nyid la bzhugs nas 102—583

lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dngos grub myur bar len pa'i thabs 'di gsungs so / /de bzhin nyid dang mnyam sbyor phyir/ /dam pa'i don gyis bsgom par bya /byang chub phyogs la gzung bar gnas①/ /mchog tu bde ba'i zhing gnas pas/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po ②lhun bsgom ③zhing / /byang chub sems su brtan par gzung ④/ /bya ba med las bya byed bya/ /mi gnas gnas la gnas par bsgom/ /bha ga'i dkyil du liṅga a/ /shin tu 'tsher zhing gsal bsgoms nas/ /'od 'phro 'bar bas thams cad khyab/ /dus gsum ngan song gnas bsregs nas/ /bha ga'i dkyil du 'od 'phro thim/ /thim 'gyur ⑧dbyings nas 'od 'phro 'bar/ /a ma las ni zla nyi 'bar/ /phyogs bcur 'joms pa'i mun sel zhing / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal bsil ba'i sman/ /thugs rje'i byin brlabs ⑥bsam mi khyab/ /rol pa'i phyag rgya bsam mi khyab/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon sprin mang yang / /nam mkha'i ⑦dbyings su thams cad bsdus/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid ⑧bsam yas kyang —/ /chos kyi dbyings su thams cad 'dus/ /thams cad yi ge hūṃ du gyur/ /hūm̐ nyid gsang ba'i thugs rje'i dkyil/ /'od zer 'phros pas 'bru gsum ste/ /yang na 'od zer 'bru lnga yi/ /lnga pa'i don spros bzhi bcu lnga'i/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor bsam yas mchog /ma bcos ngang gis gnas pa la6)/ /ye shes lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom7/ /sen zlum zla ba gang ba yi/ /thugs kyi dkyil du gnas par bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang ba yi/ /gzhal yas 'od zer 'bar ba'i khang / /pad+ma'i gdan dang rin po che/ /de dkyil yi ge rtsu gnas pa / /shin tu phra zhing yungs 6nya'abru 'bar/ /gnas gcig dang ni gnas gsum dang ske/ /gnas lnga dag tu rab tu bsgomatshi/ /shes rab spyan (gyel 'dris yipa 102—584

dang / / dz+ra yi 6)mig gis bltar yod par/ /shin tu phra zhing gsal bar bsgom / /shin tu blo gsal 'dris gyur nas/ /phyogs bcu'i stong khams rdul snyed du/ /thugs rje'i byin brlabs (gyebasam yas spro/ /spros kyang rtsu las nyams pa med/ /bsdus kyang phyogs bcu bri ba med/ /spro med bsdu med de bzhin las//yi ge rmu du thim par gyur/ /thim 'gyur chadabyings nas phyag rgya 'bar/ /shin tu gsal zhing 'dres ④pa dang / /phyag rgya'i sku nyid gsal bar bsgom/ /sku de tshon gang 'od 'bar nas/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i rgya/ /'od 'phro 'bar zhing don byed bsgoms(ge/ /yang na phyag rgya chen po ste/ /bdag nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis bsam/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rtag tu bsgom/ /gzhal yas khang dang gdan khri rnams/ /phra ba'i tshul de snga ma bzhin/ /mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad ldan/ / dbu rgyan yi ge lnga dang ldan/ /⑥rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri 'bar/ /rin chen pad+ma dril bu 'bar/ /phyag rgya chen po de dag las/ /phyogs bcu ma lus gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla gza' skar dkyil 'khor gdan dang rgyan/ /bde gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus bsgom/ /thugs rje byin brlabs ⑦'gro don mdzad/ /zhi ba phyogs gcig shes bya spro/ /sa bcu mnyam par sbyong (0byed cing / /bde gshegs 'khor yang dag par byed/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i rigs mchog de6)/ /'bras bu mngon du ma smin kyang ⑩/ /sdug bsngal thams cad yong mi 'byung / /lha mi mtshan rdzogs yongs su 'grub/ /theg pa dman par yong mi skye/ /bde gshegs 'byung dang skol mi 'gyur/ /byang chub gzungs la zhugs pa yin/ /zhes nyid la nyid gsungs so/ /rdo rje gsang (spreba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las rdo rje sems dpa' 102—585

sgrub pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyal po sgyur ba zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /rgyu gcig dang ni yig 'bru tshul/ /byin gyi brlabs 6)dang mngon sum par/ /rab tu rtogs pa rnam bzhi yis/ /thams cad mngon rdzogs rgyal po che/ /yan lag dbang po rnam shes kun/ /rnam smin oṃ du shes par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom/ /yang na khros pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /rnam smin sum̐ du shes par bya/ /yum gyi dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgom/ /yang na khro mo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /gos rgyan bza' btung glu dang tshig /bro gar tshogs kyi sprin phung la/ /hūm̐ du shes pas rab spyad na / /ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes par 'gyur/ /lha mo klu (mimo rigs ngan mo/ /dbye ba'am k+ṣ-i ciyang na mi dbye bar/ /bsnyen ④pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa'i/ /sgrub /5)pa dang ni sgrub chen po/ /yum gyi pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la96)/ /dgyes mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstim/ /grub pa'i nyi zla snying po de / /'gro (7 drug dus gnas de dag nyid/ /mchod pa chen por mnyes sbyar zhing / /dkyil 'khor rdo rje rtse yis blang / /mkha' 'gro gsal 'bar (8)tshe la sogs / /yid bzhin sprin gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /zhing 'gyur mchog dang mchog phran rnams/ /nyi zla'i dkyil du mkhas pas gzhag6) /nga rgyal lag gis 'du byed bsgomango/ /hūm̐ du gyur pas rnam par dag /dbyings su thim nas phyag 102—586

rgyar 'bar/ /skur 'gyur 6)'od zer 'phro bas brjid/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba bsgom/ /ngo mtshar ngan 'gro thar pa'i thabs/ /ye ②nas skye med de bzhin nyid/ /sgyu ma snang ba mig yor tshul/ /sbyor sgrol bya ba kun byas kyang / /rdul cha ①tsam yang byas pa med/ /snod bcud rgyud rnams dag rtogs shing / /mnyam nyid lhag pa'i mnyam nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bzang po'i zhing / /byed spyod tshogs chen gnyis gyur nas/ /yan lag ma nyams yo byad ldan/ /cho ga rdzogs par shes pa yi/ /rnal 'byor tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /nges par legs pa'i dgos pa 'grub/ /lnga zhing lnga dang sbyor ba yi/ /tshom bu lnga yi lha bkod la/ /khro bo bcu dang khro mo bcu/ /'khor lo'i tshul du rnam par sgomaskyi//de bzhin gshegs dang rdo rje'i (nyarigs/ /pad+ma'i ⑥rigs dang sku gsung thugs/ /khro bo'i tshogs dang ldan pa yi/ /tshom bu gsum (7gyi lha rnams bsgom/ /rigs kyi rigs te rigs kyi gtso/ /thugs kyi thugs te thugs kyi mchog /khro bo'i tshogs dang ldan pa yi/ /tshom bu gcig gi lha rnams bsgom/ /khro bo khro mo tshogs chen dang / /pho nya phyag brnyan bka' nyan tshogs/ /ci bgyi (9la sogs pa rnams kyis/ /dngos grub las (9)rnams rdzogs par byed/ /rnal 'byor sngags 'chang dngos grub ni/ /mnyam rdzogs lhun grub ngang gnas shing / /spyod pa ci la'ang thogs med pa'i/ /thams cad ye nas dbyer med pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rigs su thams cad dkyil/ /'od 'phro 'bar ba rab tu bsgoms/ /chags med tshul gyis bstim par bya/ /gnyis med gyur nas phyag rgya che/ /yang na sku gsung thugs nyid de1nya/ /thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /ting 'dzin gsal bar 'od zer 'phro/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du thim/ /rig tsho /'dzin 102—587

dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus 'bar ba 'grubatu)/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal sel bar byed/ /rdo rje rigs su bskyed pa'i gnas/ /sngags 'chang dngos grub yang dag ni/ /thabs dang shes rab thams cad kyis/ /dkyil 'khor lnga dang khro phreng bsgomatshu/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'od zer rnam pa mang po spro/ /gnyis su med par bstim par bya/ /dngos grub mchog gi snying po 'grub/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs dang yum du bsgom/ /sems dpa' sems ma nyid du bsgom/ /so so sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /ting 'dzin yang dag so sor gsal/ /gnas dang longs spyod ci bde dang / /ma nyams blo ni rab ldan pas / /dang po dam mnos bzhin du bya/ /le lo sgyid snyom ①med pa yis⑤/ /the tshom med par bsgrub (yebyas na(pe/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsang mchog dam pa thob/ /sgrub 90pa'i zhag dang tshes grangs ni/ /rgyud las smos pa bzhin du bya/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste nyi shu gsum pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen po rol mo'i sprin rnam par spros te/rgyan bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor brten 6)pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /bro 7gar phyag rgya'i 'du 'phro yis/ /'dzul lam nam mkhar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /glu tshig sgra yi phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi dngos grub thob par 102—588

'gyur / /rgyan dang bgo ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /'bar ba'i rgyal po thogs med 'grub / /bza' dang btung ba'i phyag rgyas ni/ /yid bzhin sku dang bdud rtsir 'grub / /ā li kā li'i phyag rgya yis/ /sku gsung mchog gi thugs ldan pas/ /thams cad thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa'i gzungs / /'bras bu smin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rig 6)'dzin rgyal ba'i (mizhing du grags/ /mi dang lha dang tshangs pa yitshi/ /skye ba rnam dag 'dzin mod kyi/ /khyad par sa la gnas gyur yin/ /pha rol phyin pa kun du rdzogs/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog gi mchog ④gyur pa'i/ /sa yi khyad par bcu dang gsum/ /rgyu 'bras khyad par lhun gyis rdzogs/ /mkha' dbyings dang ba'i dbyings nyi zla/ /ye shes rgyal po stangs dpyal sgomadzub/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kun/ /ma lus par ni bsgoms ⑥par 'gyur/ /dus bzhi phyogs bcu gang nas kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnyed mi 'gyurasti/ /sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du ma tshol cig /dkyil 'khor kun du rab sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad grub par 'gyur//cho ga lhag gam ma tshang na/ /skyon nyid dag ste nyes pa med/ /ces ched du brjod pas rol mo'i sprin gyis mnyes par gyur to/ /rol mo'i sprin gyis mnyes par gyur te(kye/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin (9)las rdo rje las rdo rje ⑩gsang ba'i tshig 'di phyung ngo / /a hoḥ47/ ma mthong rmongs la chags pa yis/ /chos rnams ming du btags tsho pa tsam/ /'gro drug dus gnas ming tshogs khyad par rab snang ba'i/ /zab chen spyod yul log par rtogs btags yonyeming tsam padhi / /ā snyili kā li la sogs 'dod pa'i snying po nyid/ /phyag rgya glu tshig sku 102—589

gsung thugs/ /thugs kyi thugs chen yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /nyid de mnyam pa'i thugs su rab tu gsal6)/ /mnyam nyid khyab pa'i stangs dpyal (miyon tan 9tsho/dmachog ste sngags kyi phrin gi)las rdzogs/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las tshogs sgrub ⑤pa'i le'u ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas dgyes pa chen pos chos thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa chen por lhun gyis grub pa'i dam tshig shin tu gsang ba'i snying po'i sprin bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs76)/ /phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs/ /'dul ba dgongs pa gsang ba dang / /rang bzhin gsang ba'i don rnams ni/ /yi ge sgro btags 7ming tshogs la/ /brten ⑧pa'i tshig gis rab mtshon te(9)/ /khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje thugs la gnas/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i thig le dkyil 'khor dbyings / /sku gsung thugs rig kun mnga' ba'i/ /bder gshegs kun gyi snying po rdzogs/ /'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /chen po rigs kyi 7de bzhin te11/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rje tshogs/ /dbang po yul dus rig pa'i rnams / /kun du bzang po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bdag nyid chen po lhag pa yi/ /102—590

thugs kyi ye shes lngas lta 6)zhing / /snying po ②thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba'i ye shes rol mo yis/ /ye shes dgyes la mnyes par dbul①/ /zag pa med pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /ye shes sgyu ma rang snang ba/ /rol mo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /gsang ba'i thig le nyid kyi dbyings/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /sku gsung yon tan phrin dulas thugs/ /ma lus bdag nyid zhal mthong ba/ /dbang sgyur ⑤ mchog nyid dam pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis ⑨grub/ /rgyun ⑦du dkyil 'khor ma lus thogs(kye/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyam sbyor las/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs kyis 'byung ske/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor 'dul ba'i mgon/ /sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrol ba yis/ /bya byed med par dkyil 'khor spyod/ /ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thos bsam bsgom 6)pa'i mnyam sbyor gyis/ /rang byung kun nas 7lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /'da' bar mi mdzad dam tshig mchog /gang zhig 'di la mos gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis/ /phyogs dus kun nas thams cad du/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen pa yis5nye/ /nye ba'i sras su dgongs par 'gyur/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /shin tu sbyangs la rab gnas shing / /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsnyen pa yi(snye/ /'bras bu gsang chen 'di yin te/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na/ /'das dang da ltar byung ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pas//brnyes pas sku lnga lhun gyis rdzogs/ /'byung dang ma 'ongs thams cad kun/ /'di yis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni gsang chen nges pa yi/ /'bras 102—591

bu lam du gyur pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus la/ /'di yis gsang ba'i nges don med/ /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi rnyed do/ /kun gyi phyag rgya chen po 6)mchog /thos bsams bsgoms (snyel rab sbyangs pa'i/ /shes rab mig ldan rnams kyis gzung ②/ /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang la brtan/ /lus dang longs spyod gtong la sbyin/ /gzhan du nam yang sbyin mi bya/ /rmongs la 'phyar bas gal te sbyin/ /dus min par ni srog zad nas/ /bsregs dang sbrebs par yun ring gnas/ /zhes ④de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la ched du brjod do/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgomaske/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las shin tu gsang ba man ngag gi snying po'i le'u ste nyi shu lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang pos dgyes pa chen po'i ngang las gsang ba 'byung ba bya ba 'di ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e mtho thams cad ma lus dus gsum bder gshegs mchog /gdod nas ma skyes rnam dag byang chub sems/ /rang bzhin dbyer med gdod mtha' mi 'byed ⑤cing / /ye nas mnyam pas rgyal ba rgya mtsho yin/ /'gro 'ong med par dus gsum cig char 6 rdzogs/ /dbye bsal med phyir (7)bzang ngan blang dor med/ /rnam rtog nyid na ye shes rang bzhin te/ /rnam rtog mi skyed ye shes brjod du med/ /bdag tu med pa'i skyes mchog sngon sbyangs pa/ /khri la 'ga' tsam gal te 'byung 'gyur zhing / /snga rabs phyis 'byung dag dang dbyer med pa'i/ /mngon sum 102—592

sangs rgyas skyes mchog de dag la/ /bskal pa 'ga' nas shes rab blo sbyangs pa/ /dad ldan 'ga' yis 'tsham par ci theg gi/ /bdag nyid ma mthong shes rgyud ①ma 'byongs pa/ /gzhan du tshol zhing rmongs pa'i sems can gyis/ /bstan ②kyang ma thos mtshon ①kyang ma mthong ba/ /bdag cag gzhan du tshol bas sangs mi rgyas/ /de dang ma bral ston pa mi mthong zhing / /bgrod par 'dod pas phyin par mi nus te/ /shes rgyud ci yin gang gis ngo shes shing / /bya byed las 'phags gyin da ④'dug byed pa/ /gang zhig blo la dpyod pa (9byang chub thob/ /ma spangs mtshan ma kun bral yod med pas/ /dran byed mi spong 'khor rgyun mi 'byed ⑥de/ /ma snyigs mi 'byed mngon sum sangs rgyas la/ /blo yi rig pas dpyod cing nan tan dang / /mchod cing bsten ⑦pas byang chub thob mngon te/ /nam mkha' gzung ⑧bas sprin gyis khebs par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' med par gang gis shes pa na/ /sprin zhig 'byung zhing khebs par mi srid do/ /rnam par rtog pa'i g.yung drung sangs rgyas la/ /thams cad ye nas mnyam gnas rnam dag cing glu/ /mi rtog ponyes ler gnas la rtog pa mdzad/ /bsnyad tu )du med pas sna tshogs 'byung ba yin/ /bdag med bdag chen thams cad 'byung ba'i gter/ /ma bkag pa las rgyu zhing 'byung med pa'i/ /thams cad sems kyi ngang ste sems zhes gdags su med/ /ma bcos lhun gnas ye nas byang chub cing / /thob rgyu med pas ye nas bder (1gshegs yin/ /zhes brjod pas chos dang ye shes kyi khams thams cad rang bzhin sangs rgyas par de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /mkhyen nas ji bzhin pa'i bdag nyid chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje sgyu 'phrul dra ba las rdo rje gsang 102—593

ba'i tshig 'di phyung ngo / /e ma'o ma bsgrubs 4)grub chen po/ /grub pa chen po ye shes che/ /blang dor med pa'i sa chen po/ / mi g.yo ②'du 'bral ②med pa'i gzungs / /rtog pa'i ye shes yid bzhin gter/ /thams cad la yang me long bzhin / /bltas kyang gzugs brnyan mi snang ngo / /gang na gsang chen 'di yod par/ /me ma mur gyi dong 'bogs la/ /spu gri so ni gtamasalgepa la /'dzegs nas 5)bu dag 'gro bar byos/ /khong na gnas pa'i yang khong du/ /lcags kyi sgrom bu kha bsdam mo/ /dbyings nyid la ni nyid spyod phyir/ /dbyings nyid mchog gi gnas la spyod/ /de nyid mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las gsang ba chen po man ngag gtan la phab pa'i le'u ste nyi shu drug pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen pos mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs nas nyid kyi sku la thams cad ma lus par ston te ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /'das dang da 6)ltar ma 'ongs dang / /'byung bar ma nges dus 'di dag /snga phyi med par mnyam yin par/ /nges pa med par yang dag gsungs / /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /rang dang spyi ru bstan pa dang / /ji snyed brtan 97g.yo la sogs pa/ /sgyu ma mig yor tshul yin te/ /skyes bu blo rtsal rab ldan pas/ /de la rtag tu mnyam sbyor zhing / /sems can kun gyi zhing gyur pa/ /de dag gnyis med dbyings su sbyor/ /thams cad thabs kyi mtshan nyid de/ /thabs la thabs ni rnam par sbyor/ /thabs dang thabs las byung 987ba yi/ /de ni byang chub rdo rje mchog /ji snyed brjod pa'i kha 102—594

brgyud 6)kyang / /yang dag ②don gyi snying po ni/ /gang nas btsal kyang mi rnyed de / /rang rig sgrib med dag pa yin/ /de la rtag 'grus goms pa ni/ /bsnyen pa'i dam pa de yin te/ /de ni ma nor lam yin par/ /a yis bho dhi ⑧rab tu bsdus/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid ni/ /gcig gam 'di zhes brjod du med/ /gsum du sna tshogs 'byung zhing 'phro/ /byin brlabs libasam yas mtha' yas mchog /don bsdus gsung rab bzhi bcu gnyis/ /de las lhag pa'i don smra ba/ /de ni rnam (snyedag lam min yite/ /rang blos bsam ⑦pa'i 'khrul pa yin/ /thams cad rang rig byang chub sems/ /de ni lung gi tshad mar bshad/ /tshad bzhis phab pa'i don yin te/ /dag pa rnam gsum tshul bsgom zhing / /'bru lngar bsdus pa thabs chen (gyite/ /'gro ba kun la rang rig gnas / /bya ba med la byas pa med/ /zad pa'i dus med yid bzhin gter/ /bum pa bzang dzi)dang yid bzhin mdzod/ /za ma tog dang yid bzhin rgyal/ /gzhan nas yod 'ong ma yin te/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bsnyen pa'i le'u ste nyi shu bdun pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyis khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du mngon par 'du mdzad de/ de 7ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag tu rmongs pa'i rtogs (1)pas brtags pa la mngon par zhen pa dang yang dag pa'i lam dang bral ba dag gab pa'i gsang ba ma rtogs par sbas pa'i gsang ba la mngon par 'chel yinanas rgyu dang 'bras bu la zhu rmongs pas/ srid pa'i sa bon rtsub mos 'phangs nas mtshams med pa'i rab tu 102—595

tsha ba'i dmyal bar skyes so/ /de rab tu tsha ba'i sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs pa dang 'dod pas gdungs nas 'di bas shin tu grang yang ①ci ma rung snyam pa'i mod la rab tu sbrebs pa pad+ma ltar gas pa'i sdug bsngal drag po dag gis rab tu nyen pa de lta bu'i sdug bsngal rab tu tsha ba la sogs pa brgyad dang / shin tu grang ba la sogs pa brgyad po dag tu 'jig rten gyi khams brgyud ②cing bskal pa chen po stong phrag bcu gnyis su myong ngo / /de nas rnam par smin pa de zad pa dang yi dgas ltogs ( )pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen ④pa dang /'dod pa'i dngos po rnams yid du mi 'ong ba dang / gdug ⑤cing rtsub pa'i dngos po sna tshogs su 'gyur ba dang / yong med par yang 'gyur zhing shin tu rid cing skams (7pa dang / lus dang yan lag dang dbang po mi 'tsham ⑦par gyur pa dang / bskal pa chen po (7drug tu skyes so5)/ /de nas las kyi sgrib pa rtsub mo'i rnam par smin pa de khad kyis bslabs ⑩pa dang sngon gyi 0srid pas mtshams sbyar nas yi dgas 0srin po chen po rab tu gdug pa gtum po lus gcig la mgo brgya /rtepa dang / mgo sna tshogs pa dang / lus brgya tsomago gcig pa dang / lus sna tshogs pa dang / yan lag mang po dang / yan lag sna tshogs yidang / gdug pa'i 7lag cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa 'khor rab tu mang po dang / 'jigs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs dang / 'jigs pa'i nga ro sna tshogs sgrogs 1 tshopa/ gzugs dang 18/ ro dang / dri dang / kha rlangs (1kyis thams cad skyi ri )bung zhes byed pa/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i rlung grang ba dang tsha ba'i dbugs kyis phyogs kun du khams 'khrugs ( nyapar byed pa/ (stend bzhi brgya 6)rtsa bzhis 'debs 1par byed pa/ myos shing nyams par byed pa'i mthus klu'i ris ( nye102wa 596

dang ske/ lha ma yin gyi ris ①dang / lha'i ris ②dang / tshangs pa'i ris sridang /'od gsal dang / dge rgyas dang / 'bras bu che ④man cad ⑤dbang du bsdus so / /de sngon gyi rten ⑥pa'i stobs dang thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs nas thugs rjes 'dul ⑦bar gyur te thams cad kyis mtshan nyid bstan pa'i glu (nya'adi blangs so/ /e ma'o po)'gro ba yongs ni bder ⑩gshegs la ma yin te/ /sdug bsngal sreg 7mdzad sgyu ma'i sprul par snang / /yon tan rmad 'byung tsoche ba'i rang bzhin 'di/ /sdug bsngal kun la bshes tsoganyen mgon po yin/ /rmongs dang 'khrul pa rab sel zhe sdang 'joms/ /kun 'byung bde ba rdo rje sku mchog ste//rdzogs ldan mdzad pa'i phrin tsolas bsam yas pas/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis bdud rnams 'joms/ /sku mdog sna tshogs thabs mkhas bsam yas la/ /rol pa'i rtsed mor 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / /byang chub sems kyis lam la gnas par mdzad/ /'gro ba kun las bde ba gcig pu pa/ /a hoḥtso/ dgyes pa'i mnyes pa nyid la gnas par mdzad/ /byin brlabs tsokun gyis bde ba nyid la snang / /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la kun las ()rnam par rgyal ba nyid du mkhyen nas mnyes par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa che ba'i (sterdo rje bkod ()pa'i sgyu ( )'phrul dra ba las 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu'i srid pa gsum gyi bdag po 'dul ba'i nga rgyal chen po gzi brjid ston pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin chen po rnam par 'phro ba'i sgyu ()'phrul dra ba'i rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms ( )par zhugs te/de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nas khro mo'i dbang phyug chen mo mngon du phyung ( nyeste hi hi 102—597
