zhes dgyes pa'i gzi mdangs kyis pad+ma rgyas par mdzad nas gnyis su med par 'khyil 6)pa'i dgyes pas thim nas byang chub sems kyi sprin las/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la na maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la ha la ②rgyu zhes brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa thams cad khyab par khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs stong gsum gyi 'jig rten tsam phyogs bcu'i rdul phra mo snyed 'thon ②par gyur pas④/ 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad g.yos⑤/rab tu g.yos kun du rab tu g.yos/ 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 5kye'ur 'ur/ chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem mo/ /shig shig rab tu shig shig /kun du (7shig shig go/ /gtor gtor rab tu gtor gtor/ kun du gtor gtor ro/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu'i stong khams thams cad na gnas pa'i dbang che ba dang mthu che ba'i dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa thams cad brgyal (nyarab tu brgyal 6)bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po nyid 'jigs byed chen po shin tu rngam pa'i skyi bung zhes byed pa'i 'bar ba chen po khrag 'thung sku smug gnag ⑩cir yang 'gyur ba dbu dang phyag dang zhabs stong khams kyi rdul snyed mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa de dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir gyur te/ dur khrod chen por dgyes nas khrag 11gi 6gergya mtsho'i dkyil na keng rus chen po ri rab kyi steng gi 'bar ba chen po'i klong gi 'khor lo'i dkyil na dbang phyug chen po dang dur khrod kyi bdag po dregs pa chen po khyo shug 1stegi gdan la brkyang bskum du bzhugs so/ /khro bo'i dkyil kha'akhor gyi sprin phung de dag kyang la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po rdo rjer snyigyur te shar phyogs su bzhugs so/ /la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po rin po 102wa 598

cher gyur te lho phyogs su bzhugs so/ /la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po pad+mar gyur te nub phyogs su bzhugs so/ /la la ni dpal khrag 'thung chen po kun du las su gyur te byang phyogs su bzhugs so/ /de dag kun kyang 'jigs byed chen po'i cha lugs dang / rngam pa'i nga ro dang / 'bar ba'i klong na dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhis dri za dang / gnod sbyin dang / gshin rje la sogs pa khyo 6)shug gis phyigadan du byas pa la bzhugs so/ /btsun mo khrag 'thung chen mo ③rnams kyang so so'i sku la 'khril ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs so/ /rigs lnga'i he ru ka las gcig tu bstims ④te bsdus nas gcig gis mang po 'dul ba'i ngo mtshar bstan nas dregs pa chen po la sogs pa gtum pa'i sems kyis gdug pa'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas mgrin gcig tu 'dug pa'i nga ros brlang po'i gtum tshig tu ⑤smras pa/ thong thong snying rje'i bdag po ci de ltar byed dam zhes 'dzer zhing 4)shin tu gtum sems kyis rngam nas khros so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po (7thams cad kyi bdag nyid des dbu dgu phyag bcwa ⑧brgyad zhabs brgyad du gnas nas rngam pa'i skad kyis thugs rjes 'dul ba'i thabs kyis shin tu khros nas/ hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐/ ha ha ha/ khā hi khā 6)ti zhes brjod nas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gdug pa 7chen po'i tshogs de dag gi snying dang dbang po kun phyung / nang grol tunyekun drangs/ yan lag kun bcad gtubs nas khrag kun 'thungs/ /rus pa kun 'chos so/ /de nas t+t+waṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ e ā (ger li dzaḥdzaḥhurtezhes brjod pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha' dang bcas par yungs tso'abru gcig tsam du chud par bsdus so/ /de nas 'byung po ma lus pa'i rgyal po'ang rgyal po dregs pa chen po la sogs pa'i chung ma/ 'byung po thams 102—599

cad kyi chung ma/ 'byung mo thams cad kyi rje mo'i yang rje mo/ /srin mo chen mo mi'i srin mo dang / tshangs ma dang / 'khrug mo dang / dbang mo dang /'jug sred mo dang / gzhon nu mo dang / dmar mo dang / bdud rtsi mo dang /zhi ba mo dang / be con mo dang / srin mo dang / za ba mo dang / dga' ba mo dang / ra ro khrag 'thung myos byed dang / gcig spyod mo dang / yid 'phrog ma dang / grub 1)mo dang / rlung mo dang / gsod byed phyimo dang / me mo dang / phag mo dang / rgan byed mo dang / sna chad mo dang / chu lha mo dang ske/ nag mo chen mo dang / ra ①mgo dmar ser chen mo dang / bum rna stisngo gnag 97chen mo dang / gsus 'dzin ser nag chen mo la sogs ⑥pa/ bran dang yang bran g.yog dang yang g.yog 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed kyang bsdus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po dpal khrag ⑦'thung chen po'i 'dul ba'i thabs kyis yang rigs lnga'i 'jigs byed snang bar byas nas de dag kun dgyes pa rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sku dang gsung dang (8)thugs rdo rje las 'di dag phyung ngo / /oṃ hūm̐ (1)i badz+ra pra be sha a la la hoḥyizhes brjod pas 'byung po'i rgyal mo rnams shin tu chags pa'i yid g.yos nas pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor sdud (7cing rgyas par gyur nas / dper na khab len la lcags 'du ba'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po dpal khrag 'thung rdo rje'i sku la srin mo chen mo ( mi srun tu mo dang /dmar mo dang / dga' (7mo dang / gsod byed mo dang / nag mo chen mo dang / dmar ser chen mo dang / sngo gnag 7chen mo dang / ser nag chen mo rnams 'khril to/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sku la tshangs 102—600

ma dang / 'khrug mo dang / dbang mo dang / 'jug sred mo dang / gzhon nu mo rnams 'khril to/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung rin po che'i sku la bdud rtsi mo dang / zhi ba mo dang / be con mo dang / za ba mo dang / srin mo rnams 'khril to/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung pad+ma 6)chen po'i sku la khrag gis myos pa dang / gcig pu spyod pa dang / yid 'phrog ma dang / gru ②mo dang / rlung mo rnams 'khril to/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i likun du las kyi sku la mi ④mo dang / phag mo dang / rgan byed ⑤mo dang / sna chad mo dang / chu lha mo rnams 'khril to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor de dag gis hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas pad+ma'i yidakyil 'khor gyi tshogs bsdus nas shin tu bcum ⑦par gyur to/ /de nas dgyes te he (nyezhes brjod pas byang chub sems kyi sprin las dkar po)mo'i tshogs dang / rkun mo'i tshogs dang / rmongs mo'i tshogs dang / thal byed ma'i tshogs dang / sbos mo'i tshogs dang / gtum mo'i tshogs dang / sme sha can gyi tshogs dang / ma mo'i tshogs ⑩rnams rang gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar dang chas nas 'thon to/ 'thon yonyenas kyang 'bar ba chen po 8'khor lo'i mtshan shar phyogs nas 'khor bar 'jigs pa'i gzugs dang rang gi lag chas chas nas 'khod do/ /de nas shin tu dgyes nas he zhes brjod pas seng gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / stag (gegadong chen mo'i tshogs dang / wa gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / khyi gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang / bzhad tsogadong chen mo'i tshogs dang /kāṅka yigegadong chen mo'i tshogs dang / dur bya gdong chen mo'i tshogs dang /'ug gdong chen mo'i tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du chas nas 102—601

'thon ①par gyur to/ /'thon (snyenas kyang 'bar ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i ②mtshan shar phyogs kyi phyi rol nas 'khor ba'i rngam pa'i mdangs kyis 'khod do/ /de nas shin tu dgyes pas (7phyogs bcu'i zhing du ma lus par khyab nas phaṭa ces brjod pas rdo rje bsrings (snye'agro ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje gdong mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje 'jig rten ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje ro langs ma'i tshogs rnams rang gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du chas nas 'thon par gyur to/ /'thon nas kyang 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgor (7shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs kyis gnas so / /de nas dgyes pa chen po'i sprin las phyogs bcu nas phaṭa ces bsgrags pas thams cad khros nas ma mo thams cad kyang rang rang gi gnas ga la ⑦bar yud tsam gyis bgyi'o(she/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po dpal khrag 'thung 6)chen po de dag kun thugs rje chen po'i bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sku dang gsung dang yithugs rdo rje las 'di dag phyung ngo / /o badz+ra ma hā a mṛ 9/steta ma hā 'gro dhe i i i zhes brjod pas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po de dag gi sna nas 'thon 12to/ /mi gtsang ba'i 'dam gyi rgya mtshor btsud pa las snam tso nas utsuṣ+ṭha 'gro dha 8phyung bas 'dam kun 'thungs te/ dran pa slar rnyed nas khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs de dag thams cad kyang dbu dgu brgya/ phyag stong brgyad brgya zhabs brgyad brgya/ sku 'bar ba chen po'i dkyil na bzhugs ⑩par mthong ngo / /de'i dus su 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu'i srid pa kun du dregs pa'i dbang phyug thams cad 'dul ba thabs sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par so sor snang bas dus gcig tu btul to/ /de nas de dag shin tu 'dar 6nyezhing 102—602

bred pas rab tu zhum pa'i nga ros 'bangs su mchi 'bangs su mchi/ 'bangs su nan tan ma bgyis na/ mgo dang lus ni brgyar 'gas shing / /snying yang 'gas shing gtubs gyur cig /rul myags tshig nas brlag 6)pa dang / /dmyal bar ltung gonas 'bod par shog /ces 'bangs su mchi bar mna' bor nas dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la bzhag zhu)go/ /thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu yang smras pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi ④mchis brang dang / /ma dang sring mo bu mo rnams / /dkyil 'khor chen por bzhes su gsol/ /dpa' bo lha rje bzhes su gsol / /bdag cag so so'i 'khor bcas kyis/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang / /gtsug gi nor bu 'bar ba ltar / /g.yo sgyu (9med cing gus ldan pa'i/ /sems kyis blangs nas spyi bo yinye/ /gtsug tu bzhag ste bkur bar bgyi/ /de yi dgos pa ci yang rung / /ma lus rdzogs par bdag cag sgrub/ /gal te dpa' bo'i spyan snga 'dir/ /smras pa bzhin du ma bsgrubs na/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mgo lus snying / /gas gtubs dum bur ral ⑦bar mchi/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas de'i chung ma'i tshogs dang sring mo dang bu mo'i tshogs thams cad yud tsam gyis 'ongs nas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig (8)tu smras pa/ bdag cag 'khor tshogs thams cad kun/ /dpa' bo chen po'i 'bangs su mchi/ /dpa' bo chen pos bdag cag rnams/ /las kyi dngos grub stsal du stsol5)/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos lag tu rdo rje byin nas ming gi dbang bskur te dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bkod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin rnam par spros pa'i le'u ste nyi 102—603

shu brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos dkyil 'khor tshogs chen po 'di dag dam tshig gis grub par bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khro bo khrag 'thung chen po ①btsun mo dang bcas pa'i tshogs de dag gi sku dang gsung phyithugs rdo rje rngam ①pa las gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'di dag phyung ngo / /oṃ ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa nisarba dus ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa phyisarba dus ta yika ha na da ha pa tsa rtsu hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa / oṃ rat+na ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa nyasarba dus ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa 6)sarba dus ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kurma ma hā shrī he stiru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa tsosarba dus ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ta thā ga ta ma hā gro dhe shwa ri dz+wa la ni (mesarba dus hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ ma hā badz+ra dhā ra ma hā gro dhe shwa ri dz+wa la nī yis phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā srur+ya rat+na ma hā kro dhe shwa ri bi dha ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hriḥ(snye ma hā sā ra swa ta ma hā pad+ma ④gro dhe shwa ri khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba a mo gha ma hā gro dhe shwa ri bi shwa hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra gau rī haḥtso/badz+ra tso rī haḥ7/ badz+ra pra mo he tu haḥtuste/ badz+ra be () tā lī ( )haḥ( nya/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa zhustelī 8)haḥ ste/ badz+ra puk+ka sī haḥ mi/ badz+ra ghasma rī ( nyahaḥ( haṃ/ badz+ra sma shā nī ( stehaḥso)/badz+ra si ha mu khri he/69 badz+ra byā gh+ra (1mu khri (nyahe/ badz+ra sro gla (stemu khri (nyahe/ badz+ra shwa nā mu khri he mi/ badz+ra skṛ nye 8)mu khri 6 7he/ badz+rakaṅka mu khri he ste/ badz+ra kha ga mu khri 87te/ badz+ra u lū 8 )ka mu khri 6nyahe/ badz+ra ār+ya te dza te dā dziḥ6 / badz+ra a ma (nyeka hūm̐/ badz+ra lo kā ‘ nya / badz+ra bha 6nyethi pa la ya ba ho hoḥ8/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/102wa 604

bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ/ e h+ye hi ① ā na ya ②dzaḥ rtsu baṃ hoḥdurlol / oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya phaṭa/ /oṃ khro la khros pas zhi mdzad pa/ /thugs rjes khros dpal rngam pa'i tshogs/ /'bar ba'i byin brlabs khyirmad po che/ /de nyid du ni bdag la stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra gro dha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya ho/ a li u thesti/ ta (sheli 6)ta pa ti/ rdas/ go nā ro⑩ / tri kha raṃ yo gi nī tu)khra hi 8hoḥ(nya/ hūṃ ha he phaṭa ces brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad tshig rab tu tshig kun du tshig go/ /'bar rab tu 'bar kun du 'bar ro/ /thams cad du 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs kyis gang rab tu gang kun du rab tu gang bar gyur to④/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las khro bo'i tshogs chen po gsung gi dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u ste nyi shu dgu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa khro bo chen po'i byin brlabs ⑩phyag rgya 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ⑩ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /dbang po'i yul de 6)rig pa'i tunyernams/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur cing / /mnyam pa'i ngang nyid rtogs gsal na/ /thams cad bde ba chen po'i rgya/ /bskyod (7chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /khro bo khro mo thams cad kun/ /gsal zhing 'od zer 'phro bsgoms na/ /bsgul bskyod ( )thams cad phyag rgya yin/ /zla ⑤med chen pos de skad gsungs/ /yan lag snying po rtse lnga rtse dgu bcu gcig tu/ /las rnams so sor rab tu bsgom/ /thabs dang 102—605

shes rab ldan pa'i zhabs/ /rtag tu rdo rje 'bar bar 'gyur/ /thabs chen re re bskyod na ni/ pad+ma chags med re re 'byung / /rdo rje pad+ma de 'byor na/ /sems can thams cad bla na med/ /byang chub zhing du skye bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyang / /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom 6)byas te/ /dbu yi dkyil 'khor bsgul 9gyibaskyod na/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor thams cad g.yo / /lag gi 'du byed bskyod (7byas na④/ /rig 'dzin zhing khams thams cad g.yo/ /rkang pa'i stabs chen gnan (snyemachongs na/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad ⑥thams cad dang / /bdud dang log 'dren thams cad gnon⑦/ /yan lag thams cad bsgrul bsig na(8ri/ /ba spu bu ga re re nas/ /khro bo grangs med rdul snyed 'phro/ /de dag sprul pa grangs med kyis/ /phyogs bcu khams mang rdul snyed du/ /khro bo'i don rnams rdul phran snyed/ /thugs rjes gdul kyizhing dbyings su bstim/ /thams cad khro bo'i dkyil 'khor dang / /khro mo'i dkyil 'khor rab tu 'dus/ /thams cad rdo rje'i brag stengs yidang / /me ri'i turnyedakyil 'khor rab tu 'bar/ /'di ni spyi rgya chen po yin/ /steng gi bgegs rnams 'dul 7ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'khor lo mṛ 1nyamago gdengs/ /'og gi 'jig rten bgegs 'dul ba'i/ /rdo rje thong gshol mṛ 7spar dang / /rdo rje gtun ⑫chen dril bu'o/ /shar gyi bgegs rnams 'dul ba ni/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba dang / /ste tshar chen po'i dbyug pa'o/ / lho yi 7bgegs rnams 'dul ba ni/ /rin chen mi mgo'i dbyug pa dang / /gshin rje chen po'i rkang bzung ba'o/ /nub kyi bgegs rnams 'dul ba ni/ /sbrul dang sti ra'i dbyug pa dang / /khyung chen gshog gis rab tu rdebs1nya/ /rgya mtsho che rnams rked par gtub(1/ /byang 102—606

gi bgegs rnams 'dul ba ni/ /rin po che yi hu)dbyug to dang / /mṛ ⑧mgo gsum pa'i dbyug to can/ /gnod sbyin gdon rnams tshar gcod pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi'i bgegs rnams 'dul ba ni/ /phyogs bzhi dag gis gdul bar 'gyur / /gal te de yis ma dul na/ /byang shar mtshams kyi bgegs 'dul ba/ /rdo rje rtse gsum dz+ra ③mgo gdengs/ /i sha nyid kyang phyag na bsnams/ /'byung po de kun rab tu btul/ /shar lho mtshams kyi bgegs 'dul ba/ /rdo rje ye shes me lce 'bar/ /mi ④de nyid kyang 'tshig par byed/ /drang srong nyid kyang phyag rgyar bsnams⑤/ /me lha gdon 'khor dbang du bsdus/ /lho nub mtshams kyi bgegs 'dul ba/ /rdo rje dang ni srin po'i mgo/ /rab tu rno ba'i ral gri 'bar / /bden bral nyid kyang phyag na bsnams/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams dbang du bsdus/ /nub byang mtshams kyi bgegs 'dul ba/ /rlung gi ba dan mṛ stimago gdengs/ /shin tu drag po 7glang po'i brjid/ /tshig srung nyid kyang phyag na bsnams/ /g.yeng ba thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /'og tu 'jig rten bgegs 'dul phyir/ /phyag rgya ri rab chen po ste/ /phag chen po ni phyag na bsnams / /cha'og gi bgegs rnams 'dul ba'opor/ /gzhan yang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /tsha dang grang yiba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /me yi dkyil 'khor chen po yis / /thams cad ma lus sreg tunyepar byed/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor chen po yis/ /thams cad ma lus 'khru bar byed/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po yis/ /thams cad ma lus gtor tsobar byed/ /gzhan yang ral gri 'khor lor 'bacas /mda' gzhu 8tho chen gri chen dang / /rdo rje mdung chen dgra star bcas/ /mche gtsigs spu gri so dang ni/ /mda' dang mdung dang sti ra dang / /gzhan yang 102—607

phyag rgya sna tshogs so/ /dbus kyi he ru'i phyag rgya ni/ /sti ra dbyug to chen po dang / /'khor lo chen po rab tu 'bar/ /dung ①chen dmar gyis gang ba la(9 / /rdo rjes dkrug cing rab tu gsol/ /shar gyi ①khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/ /sti ra chen po'i dbyug pa dang / /rdo rje chen po rab tu 'bar/ /dz+ra ④mgo dmar chen bkang ba gsol/ / lho yi (5)phyag rgya chen po ni/ /sti ra chen po'i dbyug ⑥pa dang / /yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhal yas su/ /dmar gyi ar+gha ⑦rab tu gsol/ /nub kyi khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/ /sti ra chen po'i (shedabyug pa dang / /pad+ma chags med rab tu 'bar/ /dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba gsol/ /byang gi khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/ /sti ra chen po'i dbyug pa dang / /rdo rje rgya gram rab tu 'bar/ /dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba gsol/ /khro mo rnams kyang khro dang mthun/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya ni/ /rgyud gzhan dag dang mthun par bshad/ /ma mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ /'jig rten 'das mdo che 6)las bshad/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba las phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u ste sum cu 7pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos de dag gi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi pa / /gru chad bzhi yis rnam par brgyan17/ /gru bzhi sgo khyud bzhi dang ldan/ /'bar ba'i bar khyams gnyis kyis mdzes/ /thod sbrul sna tshogs nyi mas brjid/ /'bar ba'i 'phro 91nyab mang po 'khrug /khyu mchog ma he gzig dang stag /gtum pa'i ha dom gyis sbar bas ni/ /dbang phyug lha chen la sogs bzung tso/ /smug 102—608

gnag hu)sngo gnag ②ser gnag (snyedang / /dmar gnag k+taljang gnag 6)'jigs pa'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /ko rlon gos ni sna tshogs gyon / /rngam pa'i sgra chen 'jigs par sgrogs(6)/ /sbrul dang thod phreng gnyi zlar (shebacas / /steng gi 'jig rten khor yug bcas/ /rdo rje dung chen gang ba dang / /ral gri dgra sta gshol la sogs/ /rang gi lag cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /btsun mo 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang 'khril/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya dang / /sgo bzhi phyag rgyar rab mdzes shing / /slas dang byi mo tshogs kyi gtso/ /bcu gnyis dang ni brgyad kyis mdzes/ /rang gi stan dang lag cha dang / /ci bgyi zhes te chas te gnas/ /zhes brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor kun du gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas dgyes pa chen po bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang po)thugs rdo rje sgyu 'phrul dra ba las rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig 'di phyung ngo / /a ho/ bskal par bcas shing dug tshogs 'bar ba yi/ /nyon mongs kun g.yo dkyil 'khor 'khor lo brjod dka' ba'i/ /ji snyed 'jig rten rgyan gyis rdul snyed bsam yas pa/ /ro tshogs khrag la brkam pa dpung gnyen kun bkye nas/ /zhen pa'i gdug mo shin tu gsal ba nyu )dka' ba yi(7/ /mi mngon dbyings nas gzugs kyi cho 'phrul bsam yas kyis/ /snyigs mar bcas shing mtshams sbyor kun ngam zil gyis gnon/ /rab tu gnon pa'i 'jigs byed bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin de nyid gnyen por kun byung yi kun du gsal/ /ho/ chos rnams ji snyed 'gro drug smin byed brjod mi lang /dus mtha' rmongs la gnas pa brjod mi lang / /'dod pas yinazhen pa'i las kyang ji snyed ji srid par/ /drag po bdo kha ba'i rlung chen bsam mi khyab/ /bde 102wa 609

bar bcas pa ①gzhan du med par brjod mi lang / /bskal par bsags pa'i dug chen rab rtog kun du rtog /de rnams zil gnon khrag 'thung sku gsung 'jigs byed par/ /rkyen du bcas nas sbu bus 'bras bu smin pa rab smin ltar//dgyes pa chen po bcom ldan 'das ni mang po'i tshogs/ /dpag med bsam yas lhun grub pas/ /rab tu 'dul bar shin tu gsal/ /ho/ khro bo'i rang bzhin gdug par 'jigs pa ma yin zhing / /zhi ba mdzes pa kun gyi yid dang 'thad par gnas rgyud yong ma yin/ /de nyid gnyis su min pa'i cho 'phrul bsam yas thams cad kun du khyab/ /rigs lnga khrag 'thung 'jigs pa'i rol pa rdul snyed rab ston pa'i/ /rnam dag byang chub mchog gi dbyings te gsang ba'i snying por ②rab bstan nges pa nyid de shin tu gnas par gsal/ /ho/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu ①gcig pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos nyid kyi 4)byin brlabs 6)dang yon tan ston pa zhes bya ba 'di ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /oṃ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes snying po'i mchog nyid de/ /sangs rgyas kun du bzang po nyid/ /'di yin gzhan na med pa ste/ /rol pa kun la mnga' brnyes shing / /srid pa 'jig rten thams cad kun/ /sangs rgyas nyid de dus gsum du/ /ma g.yos lhun gnas snying po ste / /rang bzhin che ba'i yon tan las/ /ma rtogs rmongs pa'i 'gro ba la/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pa/ /snying rje chags pa'i dam tshig gis/ /nga 102—610

rgyal nyid kyi sku chen bstan/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i khams gsum na/ /'dul ba'i zhing du rab sbyor zhing / /phrin 0)las rnam bzhi rdzogs par mdzad/ /ye shes ngo mtshar tsham ngam gyis/ /chos bzhi rnam dag che ba'i lha/ /ye shes sku ste khyad par che/ /chags pa'i tshogs kyis mtshan ma ni/ /'dod chags chen po nyid kyi sku/ /gtum rngam (migadug pas mtshan pas na/ /zhe sdang chen po nyid kyi sku / /gdul ()bya zhing du rab sbyong ④zhing / /chos nyid mnyam las bzhengs pas na / /gti mug chen po nyid kyi sku/ /snod bcud dag pa'i spyod yul ba/ /thugs sku gsung las 'phros pa dang / /rgyal ba nga yis mtshan pas na/ /nga rgyal chen po nyid kyi sku/ /gsang ba'i snying po bzhi bcu gnyis/ /thig le thugs su bsdus pa nyid/ /gzhan du mi gtong mtshan pas na/ /de nyid phrag dog nyid sku (she rdzogs / /stong gsum stong gi stong chen po/ /'jig rten khams mang sna tshogs pa / /rdul dang (6)bye ba la sogs pa'ig/ /bgrang ba las ni rab 'das mtshan/ /de nyid snang zhing srid pa nyid/ /'jigs byed sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings/ /chos sku ye shes rang bzhin la/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i thig le mchog /snying po thig le bsam yas nyid/ /'jigs byed dbu dgu bcwa (7brgyad phyag /sgyu mas mtshan pa'i dra ba yin/ /de nyid tshogs dang dkyil 'khor sngags/ /gcig la gsum du mchog tu sngags6)/ /yul dang 'byung ba de nyid do/ /bdag rig gzhan don snying po nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag mtshan pa/ /gnyis med rig pa'i ye shes che7/ ming dang gzugs dang dbur gyur pa/ /phyag dang zhabs su rnam par brtags/ /brtags pa las ni 'phros pa'i sku/ /ci yang med las cir yang snang / / skal bzang tsho mchog gi sgyu 'phrul ba/ /dra ba'i 102—611

dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /brtags hu)pa zil gnon chos nyid spyan/ /spyan ni chos nyid mnyam pa nyid/ /ji bzhin dbyings kyi yul la sbyor/ /rol pa'i rtsed mor sdang mig pa/ /gzhan du mi gzigs yul la gzigs/ /pad+ma 'khyil pa nyid sku gsung / /mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dngos po 'jig /ye shes chen po'i spyan bgrad ②las/ /khro gnyer glog stong 'gyur ①ba yi/ / me yi ④tshogs kyi gzhan phug glog / bdud rtsi zhing du sbyor bas na/ /6)bdud rtsi mchog gi khro bo yin / /sku nyid mnyam pa rdzogs pa las/ /sna tshogs 'char bar rab ston ⑥pa/ /ye shes sgyu 'phrul stobs chen po/ /mi g.yo mchog gi 'du 'phro las/ /gshog pa rdo rje gtams pa ni/ /shes rab tshogs la 'phrul pa dang / /thugs rje dra ⑦ba'i byin brlabs 6)kyis/ /'khor yug ji snyed mtha' klas pa/ /dbyings nyid bde la skyod ⑨pa ste/ /'phros nas dbang du byed pa'i don/ /rta yi gar thabs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gcig kyang yal ba ma yin pa'o/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor mthas klas par/ /rtsed mo mchog gi phyag rgya ni/ /brkyang dang bskum pa zhabs tshul te/ /7thabs dang shes rab rol pa'i don / /rang dbang thabs chen rgyal po yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung ba/ /thig le mchog gi gnas la rdzogs/ /dbang phyug lha chen la sogs la/ /zil gnon khros pa'i phyag mtshan pa/ /sna tshogs mtshon rnon mang po bsnams/ /nga rgyal gdug pa'i zhe sdang gcod/ /gti mug chos sku sgyu 'phrul ba/ /dra ba'i thugs rje mtha' dag ni/ /khros pa'i dam tshig snying rje 17yis/ /mnyam pa'i thig ler dgod pa ni/ /gshin rje gshed por gdug pa'i rgyal/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams mchog sgrol bden3nya/ /'gro la mgon du gyur pas na/ /dug dang bdud 102—612

rtsi khyad med pa'i/ /chos sku gdug pas brgyan pa'i sbrul/ /dbang rtags ye shes rgyan du bzhag /dur khrod rdzas dang khrag 'thung ba'i/ /g.yang gzhi stag gi pags ①chen bgos/ /'jigs byed snying rje'i dam tshig ni/ /skye shi rtsa ba gcod ②mdzad pa/ /mi g.yo mgon zhes mchog tu bsgrags/ /nga rgyal lag gis 'du byed pa/ /nga rgyal 'phrog pa'i dam tshig ste/ /kun du bzang po'i spyod yul la/ /sngags kyi snying po de nyid pa/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis sdud za ga'athung / /rdo rje thugs kyi byin brlabs ④kyis/ /hūṃ mdzad ches ni rnam par bsgrags/ /mi mched gti mug chen po ni/ /nyon mongs rgya mtsho rngub pa'i phyir/ / bhan dha klong ①chen 'thung bar snang / /'jig rten 'bar ba'i sprin chen po/ /bskal pa las kyi zil gnon ⑥pa/ /rdo rje me yi ⑦'bar ba 'byung / /nyon mongs rgya mtsho skems ⑧par byed/ /'jigs byed thabs kyi ⑨dam tshig gis/ /bsam yas 'jig rten 'khor 0yug bcas/ /rang gi sku yi gzhal med bsdus/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ye shes ni/ /zil gyis gnon pa dur khrod gling / /tshom bu gnyis kyi lha chen po/ /rdo rje sku yi byin brlabs (nyekyis/ /thig le mi g.yo bde ba las/ /rang bzhin rol pa chen pos ni/ /rdo rje phra 8men pho nya'i tshogs/ /khams gsum 'dul bar yang dag mdzad/ /ha ni thig le zhi ba nyid/ /ha ni thig le zhi khro snyoms/ /ha ni thig le dbang chen yin/ /ha ni thig le drag po nyid/ /ha ni thig le rol pa nyid/ /ha ni thig les phrin (snyelas nyid/ /ha ni thig les chags dbang 'dul / /ha ni thig le las kun rdzogs/ /he ni thig le ye shes thugs/ /he ni thig les gsung snyan pa/ /he ni thig les tsham ngam 8rtse/ /he ni thig le rol pa nyid/ /he ni thig le dbang rtags yin/ /he ni thig les drag shul btso/ /102—613

he ni thig les thugs chen rdzogs/ /he ni thig les dkyil 'khor ba/ /'jigs ①byed mchog gi sgyu 'phrul te/ /dra bas ①zil gnon lam 'gog go/ /hūm̐ ni ye shes thugs kyi thugs/ /hūṃ ni ye shes thugs sku nyid/ /hūm̐ ni ye shes thugs sku gsung / /hūm̐ ni ye shes yid bzhin las/ /hūṃ ni thig le ye shes so/ /phaṭa ni sku yi thugs kyi thugs/ /phaṭa ni gsung gi gsung gi thugs/ /phaṭa ni thugs kyi thugs kyi thugs/ /phaṭa ni chos sku'i thugs kyi thugs/ /phaṭa ni chos sku'i gsung gi thugs/ /phaṭa ni chos thugs thugs kyi thugs/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas dgyes pa ho/ /dbang phyug chags pas dgyes pa ho/ /gar thabs rol pas dgyes pa ho/ /sku gsung thugs ldan dgyes pa ho/ /yon tan las kyis ①dgyes pa ho/ /pho nya 'du 'phros ④dgyes pa ho/ /kun la snang bas dgyes pa ho/ /byin gyi brlabs ( kyis dgyes pa ho/ /chos kyi sku la dgyes pa ho/ /ye shes rol pa dgyes pa ho/ /ci yang min pas dgyes pa ho/ /gnod pa sdud pas ⑥dgyes pa ho/ /chos kyi dbyings nyid dgyes pa ho/ /des dgyes pa chen po nyid la nyid shin tu dgyes par gyur te/ chos thams cad gcig gi rang bzhin du gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa stong phrag brgya ⑦las dgyes pa chen po'i byin brlabs 98)dang yon tan mchog ston pa'i le'u ste sum cu 99)gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos 'jigs byed kyi ⑩bsod nams sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /'khor lo bar 17khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed 'khor lo tunye102—614

rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo ①tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ /zhi dang drag po dbang dang rgyas/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs chen de dbus su/ /bdag nyid drag po bcos tshul du/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed rdo rje rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khro mo'i tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ /zhi dang drag po dbang dang rgyas/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs chen de dbus su/ /lus dang ngag yid byin brlabs (minas/ /bdag nyid drag po bcos tshul du/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /③'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs byed rin chen ④rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas / /khro mo'i tshogs dang ldan par bsgom/ /zhi dang drag po dbang dang rgyas / /'jigs pa'i tshogs chen de dbus su/ /lus dang ngag yid 0byin brlabs yinas/ /bdag nyid drag po bcos tshul du( )/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgomacha/ /yang na rigs dbang dkyil 'khor ro/ /'khor lo bar khyams sgo rnams su/ /'jigs pa'i phrin ⑨las rigs kyi gtso/ /btsun mo 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khro mo'i tshogs dang 7ldan par bsgom/ /zhi dang drag po dbang dang rgyas/ /las bzhi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par dgod/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs chen de dbus su/ /lus dang ngag yid byin brlabs yonyenas//bdag nyid drag por rab gnas nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom//'jigs 'byed lnga rdzogs dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin sgo las rdzogs par bsgom/ /rgyan dang cha lugs la sogs pa/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs ni ji bzhin par/ /tsham ngam chen po'i cha lugs bsgomatso/ /102—615

glu dang gar dang phyag rgya dang / /shes rab thabs su shes pa dang / /byang chub sems kyi mchod pa dang / /brda la ①sogs pa'i yon tan dang / /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad kyi②/ /mdor na ②tshogs rnams mngon du bsgrub/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las 'jigs byed chen po'i bsod rgyanams sbyin pa dam tshig gi phyile'u ste sum cu ⑥gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos cho tshug dang dkyil 'khor yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dkyil 'khor ro/ /gsang sngags spyi yi dkyil 'khor las/ /shes 'jug yum gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /rgyang grags ⑧dpag tshad la 6)sogs dang / /lus gang lus do gsum gyi tshad/ /rang gi rig ⑩pas ci nus par/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /gnod bskrad 7sa gnon 7byin gyis brlab/ /ljon pa lcug phran sdong gcig dang //ma rig tshon (stegyis ji bzhin du/ /goms par bya ba'i ting 'dzin dbab/ /'jigs byed sku gsung dkyil 'khor bzlas/ /gnas dang zla spyodang rdzas rnams ni / /tshogs kyi mchog tu dmigs pas gzhag /dang por mchod sbyin dam pas mchod / /gzugs dang lugs chen dung mchog ni/ /ci 'dod snang bar bdag gis 'dagod/ /'jigs byed dbang du bdag zhugs nas/ /khro mo ji snyed 'khor du bya/ /bar chad ting 'dzin mchog gis zlog /gsang ba'i snying por nyid bshams te/ /'das pa bdag 7tu mnyam sbyar zhing / /thugs kyi sngags 102—616

kyis spyan drangs nas/ /bdag gi ①lus la zhugs ②tshul du/ /de yi gzugs gzung mchog tu bstim/ /dzaḥlazhes lan gsum brjod pas na/ /de nyid bsod nams lus thob cing / /ye shes lnga yi ④dngos grub sbyin/ /pho nya 'du 'phro mang po rnams/ /de yi dgos pa byed par 'gyur/ /yang na sa gzhi ⑤rab mnyam la/ /phyag rgya gzugs dudang snying po rnams/ /lnga yi tshon ⑦gyis bri dubar bya/ /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ /rdo rje dung chen dmar rtsis 6)dgang / /dung dang srog shing gsar rnying dang / /zhing 'gyur mchog dang mchog phran dang / /ji snyed pa yi rdzas rnams kun/ /'jigs byed chen po'i ting 'dzin dang / /nyams pa med pa'i sems kyis spyad/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdeng tshudang bcas pa'i bsam pa yis/ /re ba med par rab tu bsgrub/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa/ /sgrub pa dang ni sgrub 7chen pos/ /zhag ni tshang zhing rtags byung na / /dkyil 'khor mthun pa nyid tunyedu sbyar/ /zhag ni sum cu 'phrag drug gam / /drug cu tsodagu bcu rtsa drug tu/ /'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsgom / /'jigs byed tshogs la bdag lus dbul/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor nyid du brtag /'da' bar mi mdzad dam tshig las/ / nams kyang 8'da' bar mi mdzad do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dgyes pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig gi le'u ste sum cu ⑩bzhi pa'o// // de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos sngags kyi snying po 'di ched du brjod do/ /a ki du na dz+wa yonal maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā kro dhe shwa tunyeri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ru lu ma hā sa ma ya rtsu ru lu ru 4)lu hūm̐ bh+yo 102—617

hūm̐ / oṃ ma hā badz+ra shrī he ru ka 6)badz+ra kro dhe shwa ②ri sarba duṣ+ṭa srin hūm̐ phaṭa/ ru lu ma ④tā sa ma ya tsū ru lu ru lu tsū bh+yo hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ma hā shrī he ru ka rat+na ma hā kro dhe shwa ri bi dha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐ bh+yo rgyudu/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ⑥ma hā shrī he ru ka pad+ma ma hā kro dhe shwa ri khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐ ru lu ru lu ru lu ④rgyu bh+yo hūṃ/ oṃ kurma ma hā shrī he ru ka sarba a ga ma hā gro dhe shwa ri ③bi shwa rū be hūṃ phaṭa/ ru lu ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐/ ru lu ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na pad+ma a mo gha ma hā badz+ra shrī he ru ka /ma hā sa ma ya ha he hūm̐ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu ru lu ru lu tsū bh+yo rtsu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pad+ma shrī he ru ka man+t+ra dz+wa la ma hā maṇ+ḍa la kā yonyeya bā tika tsit+ta/ oṃ oṃ o hūṃ rdzu rtsu/ sī ṭ+wāṃ r+sā7/ māṃ māṃ māṃ/ tsā hṝ tsā'/ badz+ra ma hā ka pā la khan 'daṇ+ḍi na dz+wa la sid dha/ ma hā shrī he ru ka a me du me sid stod tibhā tsobe/ si ha ra ṇa0/ hūṃ hūm̐ rgyu / ma hā yo ga yod dha ma hā sa ma ya/ ru lu ru lu/ a la la hoḥ7/ ho sems nyid thig ler rab gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis nyid rdzogs / /sangs rgyas rdo rje he ru ka /tshom bu dkyil 'khor bsam yas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra gro dha (nyes ma ya hoḥ()/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha 9 rtas ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ i hūm̐ su ra s+t+waṃ/ ka ma la ma hā su kha mā le ma nus man dz+wa la ni dha na a ba yo ga khā hi a la a ( nyal hoḥ( nya/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las 'jigs byed chen po sngags kyi 8 bzlas pa snying po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste sum cu 89 lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po'i dam tshig chen pos phung po dang /102—618

'dod par ni rab tu bsngags①/ /dpal ldan 'grub pa sgyu 'phrul ba/ /dbab par bya ba'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /ljon pa mchog dang 'bring rnams la/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga ②mtshan/ /'bru lngas byin brlabs tsā ③du brtags/ /de ni e 0yi tshogs yin te/ /de nyid goms ⑤las gsang mtshan pa/ /me ⑥yi tshogs kyi lha rnams bsgoms/ /de nyid steng gi lha rnams ⑦te/ /bdag med mtha' bral mi dmigs las/ /don yod ngang tshul de bzung nas/ /don yod mchog gi tsa na ka /shes rab yum dang ldan par bsgom/ /de las rgya gram byin brlabs ⑤te/ /pad+ma gsang 6)nas 'dzul thabs yin/ /sbubs su zhugs la de lus dgang / /rgya gram tshon 0gyis khengs pa dang / /so so'i snying pos ming yang dgug /de goms blo bde gsal spro thim/ /rdo rje la la rnams ṭ+wāṃ bsgom7/ /snod gnas bde ldan khengs gyur par/ /yum gyi tshogs kyang gsal bar gnas/ /phyag rgya snying po gzugs la sogs/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgom/ /brtan pa tsā 7gyi 'phro 'du ltar/ /rnam shes byin brlabs (nyangang du brtags/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid las/ /grub pa sgyu 'phrul sprin tshogs bsgom/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /'phro 'du rigs dang mthun par ni/ /bsgoms nas bzlas dang mngon sum ni/ /dgyes pa gar gyi gsung snyan cing / /rjes su chags pa'i phyag rgya bzhis/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgom/ /phyogs su yi'agro dang dbrog pa dang / /tshe bstung skib dang las rnams dang / /mngon sum ci 'dod smra ba'i mchog /rigs kyi yum dang rtsen par 'gyur/ /srid pa las 'phags mya ngan 'das/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pas rnam par smin pa'i tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba'i yiyon 102—636

tan nyid du mkhyen to/ /mkhyen nas de bzhin nyid kyi 6)dbyings sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig 'di phyung ngo / /a hoḥchabasam bya bsam par zin pa yi/ /bsam pas mi zin bsam mi khyab/ /bsam yas lhun gnas mi g.yo dpag med bsam mi khyab/ /rgyu dang 'brel pa'i rkyen du shes pa'i dbyings nyid zad mi shes/ /ngo mtshar srid lam mtha' bral dmigs med pa/ /de nyid yon tan mchog gi 'khor lo lam mchog yin/ /a hoḥ(5)/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nas che ba'i yon tan ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang pos che ba'i yon tan ston pa'i sgyu 'phrul chen po gsung gi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba cho ga dang bcas pa 'di sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ④ngo / /dbab pa mchog gi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /kha dog grangs bcas ma brlabs ⑤pas /shes pa blo che khongs ⑥yangs la/ /zab par spyod la mi skyo bar/ /zas srung gos rjes ⑦dam zas sbyin/ /dung chen snod du chu yis bsing / /rten du rung par ting 'dzin dang / /dbang dang sgrub pa mchog kyang bstan/ /mi smra gsang ba'i dam tshig dbog /oṃ dang hūm̐ (2)gyi blo bstan 59rinas/ /gsang bas mtshan ma lnga nas sbyang 7/ /sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /phung po khams dang skye mched sbyar/ /longs spyod lnga ldan mchod sbyin bya/ /rdo rje dag lam gsung chen bzlas / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzī 6nyan oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ku la hūm̐ badz+ra(ge/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sī rat+na r+sāyon/ oṃ pad+ma ta thā skṛ sked ya ā tsor lika8 / hā pradz+nyā 34na/102—637

dhā tī 1)shwa ri ②②/ de ṣa char ti chug/ mo ha ra ti /⑤/ rā ga ra ti 'phyo/badz+ra ra ti rtal/ hūm̐ hūm̐ sbol/ lī lī shāsti/ rmāḥ.āḥ.āḥkyi/ r+pā nā spruyi/ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ rta8/ e baṃ ma ya ba ba ba ba ba dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra sa sa sa sa sa/ma ma ma ma ma/ ya ya ya ya ya/ s+t+waṃ hoḥ(gezhes brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas par dam tshig thams cad kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs yirje'i bdag nyid dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma chen mo dang / spyan chen mo dang ⑫/ mā ma tī chen mo dang / gos dkar mo chen mo dang / dam tshig ⑩'phags ma sgrol ma chen po'i rang ⑩bzhin nyid du kun du snang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid dbab pa'i gsung gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang pos (stesgyu 'phrul chen po'i byin bsdu ba zhes bya ba'i dam tshig la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje sgyu 'phrul dra ba las phyung ngo / /sgeg mo mchod pa (6byin ( )bsdu ba/ /gzugs ston dbab par bya ba ni/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga ( nyamatshan/ /'bru lngas byin brlabs ( rteya nyid sbyin/ /de nyid pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /de nyid goms la stegasang mtshan pa/ /ya yi tshogs kyi lha rnams bsgom/ /de nyid hūm̐ gi lha rnams te / /bdag med mtha' bral mi dmigs las/ /rang gi ngang tshul de bzung nas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje tsa na ka /shes rab yum dang ldan par bsgom/ /102—638

de las rdo rjer byin brlabs te/ /pad+ma gsang nas ①'dzul thabs yin/ /sbubs su zhugs la de lus dgang / /rdo rje tshon gyis khengs pa dang / /so so'i snying po ming yang bod(gyi/ /de goms blo bde gsal spro thim/ /ming yang snying po bcas pas sridagug /rdo rje lha rnams hūm̐ du bsgom/ /snod nas ④lhag mo khengs gyur par/ /yum gyi tshogs kyang gsal bar gnas/ /phyag rgya snying po gzugs la sogs/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsam/ /brtan pa hā ⑤yi 'phro ⑥'du ltar / /rnam shes byin brlabs ngang du brtags/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid las / /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sprin tshogs bsgom/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /'phro 'du rigs dang mthun par ni/ /bsgoms nas bzlas dang mngon sum na⑦//sgo ma bzhi yi phyag rgya bcing / /rjes su chags pa'i phyag rgya bzhis/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgomadu/ /rin chen phreng ba'i byin bsdu ba/ /gzugs ston dbab par bya ba ni/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga ⑨mtshan/ /'bru lngas byin brlabs ⑩e nyid sbyin/ /de nyid pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /de nyid goms nas gsang mtshan pa/ /e yi tshogs kyi lha rnams bsgomayi/ /de nyid sī 'gyi lha rnams te/ /bdag med mtha' bral mi dmigs las/ /rang gi ngang tshul de bzung nas/ /sangs rgyas rin chen tsa na ka /shes rab yum dang ldan par bsgom/ /de las 8rdo rje byin brlabs 'ate//pad+ma gsang nas 'dzul thabs yin/ /sbubs su zhugs la de lus dgang tso/ /rin chen tshon gyis khengs pa dang / /so so'i snying pos mi ⑩yang dgug /de goms blo bde gsal spro thim/ /rin chen lha rnams sī ⑩du bsgom/ /snod gnas phreng snyib khengs gyur par/ /yum gyi tshogs kyang gsal bar gnas/ /102—639

phyag rgya snying po gzugs la sogs/ /rigs 6)dang mthun pa nyid du bsam/ / brtan pa ṭ+wāṃ ②gyi 'phro 'du ltar/ /rnam shes byin brlabs gangang du brtags/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid las/ /sangs rgyas rin chen sprin tshogs bsgom/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /'phro 'du rigs dang mthun par ni/ /bsgoms nas bzlas dang mngon sum na/ /sgo ma bzhi yi phyag rgya bcing / /rjes su chags pa'i phyag rgya bzhis/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgom/ /pad+ma'i dbyings kyi byin bsdu ba/ /gzugs ston dbab par bya ba ni/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga ④mtshan/ /'bru lngas byin brlabs larba du brtags/ /de nyid pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de nyid goms la 6)gsang mtshan pa/ /baṃ gyi tshogs kyi lha rnams bsgom/ /de nyid i gyi lha rnams te/ /bdag med mtha' bral mi dmigs las/ /rang gi ngang tshul de bzung nas/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma tsa na ka /shes rab yum dang ldan par bsgom/ /de las rdo rjer byin brlabs 97)te/ /pad+ma gsang nas ⑧'dzul thabs yin/ /sbubs su zhugs la de lus dgang / /pad+ma'i tshogs kyis khengs pa dang / /so so'i snying pos ming nas dgug /de goms blo bde gsal spro thim/ /pad+ma'i lha rnams oṃ 37du bsgom/ /snod gnas dbyangs ma khengs 'gyur bar/ /yum gyi tshogs kyang gsal bar gnas/ /phyag rgya snying po gzugs la sogs/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgom/ /brtan pa hṝ 1 )gyi 'phro 'du ltar/ /rnam shes byin brlabs 3lhangang du brtags/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid las/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i sprin nyi tshogs bsgom/ /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /'phro 'du rigs dang mthun par ni/ /bsgoms nas bzlas dang mngon sum na(nya/ /sgo ma 102—640

bzhi yi phyag rgya bcing / /rjes su chags pa'i phyag rgya bzhis/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgom/ /gar ①mkhan las kyi byin bsdu ba/ /gzugs ston dbab par bya ba ni/ /rigs chadang mthun pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga gamatshan/ /'bru lngas byin brlabs ma ④nyid sbyin/ /de nyid pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de nyid goms las gsang mtshan pa/ /ma yi tshogs kyi lha rnams bsgom⑤/ /de nyid traṃ 6)gyi lha rnams te/ /bdag med mtha' bral mi dmigs las/ /rang gi ngang tshul de bzung nas/ /sangs rgyas las rnams tsa na ka /shes rab yum dang ldan par bsgom/ /de las rdo rjer byin brlabs (7te/ /pad+ma gsang nas 'dzul thabs yin/ /sbubs su zhugs la de lus dgang / /las kyi tshogs kyis khengs pa dang / /so so'i snying pos ming nas dgug /de goms blo bde gsal spro thim/ /las kyi lha rnams tsā (nyadu bsgom/ /snod gnas gar mkhan khengs 'gyur bar6)/ /yum gyi tshogs kyang gsal bar gnas / /phyag rgya snying po gzugs la sogs/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgom / /brtan pa hṝ 7gyi 'phro 'du ltar/ /rnam shes byin brlabs 4nyangang du brtags / /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid las/ /sangs rgyas las kyi sprin tshogs bsgom / /phyag rgya gsal ba nye bsnyen pa/ /'phro 'du rigs dang mthun par ni/ /bsgoms nas bzlas dang mngon sum na ge/ /sgo ma bzhi yi phyag rgya bcing / /rjes su chags pa'i phyag rgya bzhis/ /rigs dang mthun pa nyid du bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /lha rnams mngon du snang ba dang / /sgo ba sgo ma mang po dang / /dus bzhi'i lha mo mchog dbab turnyedang / /lha dang klu yi tsotshogs bcas las/ /mngon du smra bar bya bar mthun/ /rgyal srid dang ni 102—641

'khor 'phrog dang / /bsdu dang dbang du bya ba dang / /gsad ①dang bskrad ②pa'i tshogs bcas dang / /bdag 'gro myur du phyin pa dang / /nor 'dod pa dang ci bya ba/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /dus med par ni mchod dang phrad/ /ces brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad byin bsdu ba'i mchod pa chen por gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las byin bsdu ba dang dam tshig dbab pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i thugs rje zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu gsum pa'o // //de nas dgyes pa chen pos longs spyod chen po rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sgyu 'phrul chen po'i dam tshig mchod pa'i longs spyod ces bya ba 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje sgyu 'phrul dra ba las phyung ngo / /rab 'bring tha ma'i blo rnams kyis/ /nges par bsgom par bya ba ni/ /rgyal po'i stis 'dzin mchog 'dod pas/ /gzugs su bri 'am rten bcas la/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga ⑤mtshan/ /goms par dzaḥ0nyid mdog dmar bsgom/ /de goms zhu)gsang nas dukhong bsdus te/ /rang lus mdog dmar ngang tshul 'dzin/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga kyi)mtshan/ /'bru lngas byin brlabs kyi du brtags67/ /de goms gar gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dzaḥtsozhes rgya bcings drang bya zhing / /goms par gsang nas 5)zhugs tshul du/ /lam nas ngag gi dbang por mibasdu/ /oṃ las sangs rgyas tsa na ka /snod gnas ⑫dkyil 'khor khengs par bsgom/ /ming dang snying po goms pas dgug /mngon sum lkugasal bar gyur pa na/ /lcags kyu la sogs mtshan pa yi/ /rjes su 102—642

chags pa'i mchod pas bsham4)/ /yid la goms ②pa gsal ba na/ /gang la bya ba dbang du 'gyur/ /blon po'i gas 'dzin mchod pas bshamadu/ /yid la goms dupa gsal dub na/ /gang la bya ba kha dang snying ga ⑦mtshan/ /goms par dzaḥshenyid mdog dmar bsgom/ /de goms gsang gnas 'khong bsdus te/ /rang lus mdog dmar ngang kyitshul 'dzin/ /spyi gtsug kha dang snying ga ⑨mtshan/ /'bru lngas byin brlabs tsobo du brtags/ /de goms gar gyi dkyil 'khor bsgomatso / /dzaḥ8zhes rgya bcings drang bya zhing / /goms par gsang gnas zhugs tshul du/ /lam nas byangag gi mchog tu bsduyi/ /āḥtunyenas sangs rgyas tsa ⑫na ka /snod gnas dkyil 'khor khengs par bsgom/ /ming dang snying po goms par dgug /mngon sum gsal bar gyur pa na/ /lcags kyu la sogs mtshan pa yi / /rjes su chags pa'i mchod par bsham/ /de la las su stsal ba na/ /gang la bya ba dbang du 'gyur()/ /lha mo klu mo rigs ngan mo/ /yud tsam rtag sum̐ )par 'dod sgrub rnams/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis byed 0par 'gyur 3/ /dbang phyug lha chen lha dbang po/ /rgyal chen phyogs skyong mang po la/ /chung ma bu mo la sogs mtshan/ /'dod spyod dbang bar blo 'chang rnams/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /de yi dgos pa thams cad pa/ /ma lus kun rdzogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad rab tu g.yos kun du gsal bar gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i longs spyod chen po kun du snang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang 'thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las sgyu 'phrul chen po dam tshig gi mchod pa'i longs spyod ces bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi 102—643

bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas thub pa chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid du snang bar gyur to/ /gdug pa'i las klu'i tshogs 'dul bar gyur nas lasgrub pa chen po la mos pa'i ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /klu'i tshogs rigs gnyis pa dang / rigs gsum pa dang / rigs tha dad pa dang / phyogs gnyis pa las 'khor du byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas khengs pa'i gnas su nyid kyi bsnyen pa che chung la ②ma gtogs pa yid la dga' ba ci byas kyang mi 'grub cing bar chad byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir gegs bsal chab lnga pa zhes bya ba 'di 'thon ④par gyur pa 'di ched du gsungs so/ /sgrub la 'dug pa mi gnas dang / /sa gzhi ⑤bdag tu dbang ba dang ske/ /sgrub ⑥pa'i rdzas rnams ci yod pa/ /gdug pa'i sbrul rnams bsal ⑦ba dang ske/ /'khor du gtogs pa mang nyung la/ /gdug pas zin par mi 'gyur zhing spyo/ /ljon pa lcug phran la sogs la/ /gdug pas gnas par mi 'gyur phyir//lnga pa zhes ni rab tu bsngags/ /bdag gis gdug par mchod pa'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ting 'dzin las/ /bdag nyid gdug pa'i mthing gnag ⑧mdog /lag na zhags pa ut+pal 'dzin/ /mgo la gdengs ka sbrul chen bcu/ /nyi shu brgya 'am stong dang khri/ /bsam yas dag gi sbrul chen po/ /kha dog nag po lce gsum 'bar79)/ /gdug pa klu yi tshogs mangs ⑩pas/ /'khor mang 'jigs brjod skyi bung pas/ /mchog tu phyag rgya 'di bca' bya/ /mi bskyod rin chen yig 'bru rnams/ /phral te go ran byas pa na/ /gdug pa sbrul gyis tunye'og tu 102—644

gding ske/ /nā ga pu ka 6)la nā ga phaṭa ces brjod/ /'di la goms par gang brtsom ②pas/ /nga yi cha lugs 'di bzung na/ /me lce'i tshogs la phung po bzhin / /rgyal po chen po'i rgyal chen por/ /kun la snang bar gsal gyur nas/ /rang dbang med par 'bros pa dang / /de la bran bzhin byed par 'gyur/ /sa la bdag tu bya ba ni/ /thog mar sa gzhi rab mnyam ste / oṃ dang māṃ gyi ④tshogs kyis dgang / /rin chen pho brang dkyil 'khor las/ /'jug pa'i lha tshogs dkyil 'khor bsgom⑤/ /de la gshog pa rab brkyang ste/ /rdo rje thal mo drag tu rdab⑥/ /oṃ badz+ra gro dha du na mu ne du nā ⑦gats+tsha/ de nas yig 'bru shin tu gshig(snye / de nas yig 'bru tha ma bsgreng / /de nas yig 'bru 'phral bskyed 6)pa/ /nga yi cha lugs 'di bzung ste/ /sa gzhi mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de la shin tu dngangs 'gyur yite/ /phyogs bcu kun du 'bros hunyepar 'gyur/ /de la bran bzhin byed par 'gyur/ /'khor du gtogs pa nga yi 'khor/ /'khor mang ji snyed mchog byed pa/ /gdug pa mang pos gnod bsgrub phyir/ /rdzas la mes ni rab sbar nas/ /nga yi snying pos brjod nas 'byung / /de la yig 'bru drug brjod na/ /de la gnod par mi nus shing / /gdug 8pas mchod cing bkur bar 'gyur/ /de yi nad rnams sos par 'gyur/ /mngon sum snang ba'i (stegazugs brnyan dang / /mchog dang tha ma 'bring rnams la/ /gdug pa'i tshogs kyis zhen pa ni/ /snying gar oṃ ④gyi 'bru rnams te/ /kha dog dmar po 'bar ba'i nang / /gzugs su snang ba kun bzhun te/ /thub pa'i ngang tshul de bsgoms nas/ /rin chen yig 'bru yi ge bsam/ /de la lirab tu 'jigs par brkyang ⑩/ /yi ge dang po tha ma mig /e 'gyi tshogs su 'bar tunyeb 102—645

gzhan / /mi bskyod nyid mas be con 'chang / /thod pa'i dbyig par chas 6)nas ni / /lce la sngags ni ②dran pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur zhing / /gdug pa'i klu rnams 'dul 'gyur te/ /phyogs bcu kun du 'bros par 'gyur/ /de la mchod dang bran du 'gyur(7/ /oṃ mu ne pad+ma sa ma yo gi hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza/ 'di la goms par gang brtson pas/ /nga yi cha lugs ④'di bzung nas/ /bkur gnas mchod pa ( byed pa dang / /sgrub pa thams cad myur bar 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na 6)nyid nges pa las thub pa chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i tshogs kyi gdug pa'i las 'dul ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang pos 'byung rtsipo'i tshogs zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba 'di'i 97ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /tshom bu gnyis kyi lha rnams bsgom/ /nga 6)nyid 'dug ⑩pa'i gnas bshams te/ /lo dang zla ba gsum dang lngar/ /rdo rje dung chen gang ba dang / /rdo rje phyag bsnams dril bu la/ /sngags bzlas ting 'dzin goms par bsnyen/ /rdzas la tshon gyis mdog bsgyur (skyebazhin/ /rtags 6)dang mngon du gyur par ro/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje phyag bsnams nas/ /khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal / /rang gi rang bzhin der 0stebasgyur spyonas/ /spyan bgrad mche gtsigs ⑫sdang mig 'bar/ /brkyang bskum rngam pas zhing stengs ⑩bsgom/ /shig shig drag tu gyur par 1 tshon/ /de yi snying po bzlas nas ni/ /de bsnyen nyams su lon pa yin/ /de ltar 'grub pa'i rtags rnams ni/ /gang la dmigs pa'i mdun dag tu/ /bzhin bzlog mig gis bltas nas ni/ /lce la drag /nyetu phaṭa ces 102—646

brjod / /brgyal 'gyur i nas dmar rtsi dbab/ /de las hūm̐ zhes bya ba yid6)/ /dang po'i gnas su 'dus pa na/ /mchongs ②par 'dod na langs par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /tshom bu gnyis kyi lha rnams bsgom/ /nga ③nyid 'dug pa'i gnas bshams te/ /lo dang zla ba gsum lnga bdun/ /de yi dung chen gang ba dang / /rdo rje phyag bsnams dril bu la/ /sngags bzlas ting 'dzin goms par bsnyen/ /rdzas la tshon gyis mdog bsgyur (gebazhin/ /rtags ⑤dang mngon du gyur par ro/ /sangs rgyas ⑥rdo rje phyag bsnams nas/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje rgyal/ /gshin rje khros pa'i rgyal mor sbyor/ /rang gi rang bzhin der bsgyur nas/ /spyan bgrad mche gtsigs sdang mig par/ /brkyang bskum stirngam pas zhing stengs bsgomacha/ /shig shig drag tu gyur pa na/ /de yi snying po bzlas nas kyang / /oṃ zhes pas ni rked par gcad⑨/ /des ni yidabang du gyur par bsgom/ /sa las yigaser dang chu las sa/ /yid dang 'thad pa nyid du ni/ /ji bzhin ji bzhin 'grub par 'gyur/ /de las ()'dod pa bzhin du nges/ /de bsnyen nyams su lon pa yin/ /de ltar nges pa'i rtags 8rnams ni / /ming dang gzugs dang mngon sum na/ /dbu gsigs snang mig drag pos blta / /oṃ gyi rtse mor phaṭa ces brjod/ /brgyal 'gyur oṃ las dmar rtsi dbab/ /ngag las i zhes bya bas ni/ /bzlas brjod bcas de bdag nyid bstim/ /de nas 'dod pa bzhin du nges/ /de bsnyen nyams su len 8pa yin/ /de ltar nges pa'i rtags rnams ni/ /ming dang gzugs dang mngon sum la/ /bzhin bzlog mig gis bltas nas ni/ /oṃ las drag tu phaṭa ces pas/ /brgyal 'gyur i las dmar rtsi dbab/ /de las rtsu zhes bya ba yin/ /dang po'i gnas 102—647

su bsdus pa na/ /'tsho bar 'dod na langs par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i mngon rdzogs pa/ /byang chub mchog gi kun ngo bo/ /phyag rgya bzhugs yun ①la sogs pa/ /gcig pu cha yi ting nge 'dzin/ /rdo rje dung chen gang ba dang / /rdo rje phyag bsnams dril bu la/ /sngags bzlas ting 'dzin goms par bsnyen/ /rdzas la tshon gyis mdog bsgyur (mibazhin/ /rtags dang mngon du gyur par ro/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje phyag bsnams nas/ /khro bo chen po rta mchog dpal/ /rang gi rang bzhin der bsgyur nas/ /spyan bgrad mche gtsigs sdang mig par/ /brkyang bskum rngam ①pas zhing stengs rgyabasgom/ /shig shig drag tu gyur pa na⑤/ /de yi snying po bzlas nas kyang / /oṃ zhes bya bas 6)rked par gcadag/ /des ni dbang du gyur par bsgom/ /sa las gser dang chu las sa/ /yid dang 'thad pa ji lta ba/ /ji bzhin ji bzhin grub par nges/ /de la (kye'adod pa bzhin du 'gyur / /de bsnyen nyams su lon pa yin/ /de yi grub pa'i rtags rnams ni/ /ming dang gzugs dang mngon sum na/ /dbu gsigs 6)snang mig drag pos blta7ne/ /i las drag tu phaṭa ces pas/ /brgyal 'gyur oṃ las dmar rtsi dbab / /de las hūm̐ zhes bya ba yid/ /dang po'i gnas su bsdus pa na/ /mchongs 11par 'dod na langs par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po de nyid las/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje phyag bsnams pa/ /khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /bdag nyid rang bzhin der bsgyur nas/ /spyan bgrad mche gtsigs sdang mig par/ /brkyang bskum rngam pas zhing stengs yi bsgom/ /shig shig drag tu gyur pa yi las/ /mgyogs par phyogs su song ba na/ / de yi 7snying po mchog bzlas nas/ /hūm̐ zhes pas ni bskul ba yis/ /dang po'i gnas su phyin par byed/ /des ni 102—648

dbang du gyur par bsgom/ /de las sna tshogs ci 'dod par/ /thams cad thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /de bsnyen nyams su lon pa yin/ /oṃ la drag tu phaṭa ces pas/ /gang la bya ba mngon bsam ①nas/ /se gol snol ②mar gtogs pa yis/ /brgyal 'gyur oṃ las dmar rtsi dbab/ /yid la bsgoms pas langs par 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las sgyu 'phrul chen po rab tu rgyal ⑧bar byed pa dam tshig mchod ④bkod pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu dudrug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po'i spyan sngar dregs ⑥pa chen po dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / phyogs skyong par gyur pa sde dpon dang chung mar bcas/ bran dang g.yog dang yang g.yog gi rab tu 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i sems kyis ⑦gas par dam bcas shing /rang rang gi dkyil 'khor dang / snying po zhes bya ba 'di mgrin gcig tu yang smras so/ /dregs pa 'khor bcas dkyil 'khor dang / /lus dang ngag yid dbul (kyeb ni/ /'khor g.yog bye ba drug cu 5)rnams/ /keng rus gsar rnying gnas su gyur/ /rlon pa sha khrag tshogs la spyod/ /thod par 'thung za med pa'i nang 4 )/ /mdung thung ral gri dgra sta (11dang / /zhags pa dbyig 5nyepa zor ba dang / /rnga dang lda ldi khrag yonye'athor zhing / /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun gyis bskor / /dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di rnams la/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yis/ /zhabs kyi mthil du 'di bsgoms te/ /rang gi snying po 'di brjod na//de bran bzhin du bdag cag bgyid/ /de yi dgos pa ci yang rung / /ma lus 102—649

rdzogs par bdag cag bsgrubasti/ /'dug nas snying po 'di bzhin dbul/ /oṃ khaṃ dhu ha swā lahā/ dbang phyug lha chen dkyil 'khor dang / /lus dang ngag yid dbul ba ni/ /'khor g.yog bye ba brgyad cu ③stong / /me tog sil ma bkram pa dang / /ras stan 'phar ma mang po dang / /rin chen bcal rjodang brdung ⑤ba dang ske/ /rol mo glu gar rab tu snyan/ /rin chen khang pa'i gnas su ni/ /lha mo mang por bdag spyod cing / /rin chen snod du bdag cag 'thung / /gdugs kyis rgyas par steng nas g.yogs/ /gzugs mdzes pas ni gda' bar bgyid / /rin chen me tog la sogs dang / /lha yi me tog phyogs su 'thor⑥/ /lha yi tshogs mang kun gyis bskor/ /dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di rnams la/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yis/ /zhabs kyi mthil ⑦du 'di bris te/ /rang gi snying po 'di brjod na/ /de la bran bzhin bdag cag bgyid/ /gtsug tu bzhag nas bkur ba dang / /de yi dgos pa ci yang rung / /ma lus rdzogs par bdag cag bsgrubasnyi/ /de gzugs ston cing gda' bar bgyid/ /oṃ sarba de bā ma 6)tā u ba ha/ /rgyal po rnam thos yul 'khor srung ⑩/ /'khor tshogs stong phrag mang po yi/ /lus dang ngag yid 'bul ba ni/ /'khor g.yog stong phrag bye ba brgya/ /me tog sil mar tunyebakram pa dang / /rgyan mang byug pa gcal snyibakram pa/ /sde dpon nyi shu bye ba rnams/ /ci legs par ni rab tu smra/ /rim pa che zhing sri 7zhu gus/ /mchod par byed cing lugs mchis pa'i/ /bdag gi 'khor dang bcas pa lags/ /rin chen bcal skidang 'thung tshub dang / /rol mo glu gar snyan pas brgyan/ /rin chen khang par bdag mchis shing / /bzhon pa dmag tshamangs (7'khor bar mchis/ /rin chen snod du chang 'thung ba/ /102—650

gdugs kyis brgyan par steng nas g.yogs①/ /gzugs mdzes pas ni gda' bar bgyid/ /rin chen me tog phyogs su 'thor/ /rgyal po'i tshogs mang kun gyis bskor/ /dri za med pa'i ②bdag po dang / /dbang ldan rlung gi bdag po rnams / /'di bzhin gus par bdag cag bgyid/ /dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di rnams la/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yis/ / zhabs kyi mthil du bris nas kyang / /nirang gi snying po 'di brjod na/ /de la bran bzhin bdag cag bgyid / /gtsug tu bzhag nas bkur ba dang / /de yi dgos pa ci yang rung / /ma lus rdzogs par bdag cag bsgrub(ge/ /de la gzugs ston gda' bar bgyid//oṃ sid dha dhi dhi dhu ho swā hā/ rgyal po mig mi bzang dang 'phags skyes po/ /'khor tshogs khri phrag mang po yis/ /lus dang ngag yid dbul ⑤ba ni/ /'khor tshogs khri phrag bye ba brgya/ /me tog sil ma bkram pa dang / /rgyan ⑥mang byug pa gcal ⑦bkram pa/ /sde dpon nyi shu bye ba rnams/ /ci legs par ni rab tu smra//rim pa che zhing sri (nyezhu gus/ /mchod par byed cing lugs mchis par/ /bdag gi 'khor dang bcas pa lags/ /rin chen bcal dang btung ba dang / /rol mo glu gar snyan pas brgyan/ /rin chen khang par bdag mchis shing / /bzhon pa dmag mangs 5)'khor par mchis/ /rin chen snod du chang 'thung ba/ /gdugs kyis rgyas par steng nas g.yogs/ /gzugs mdzes pa ni gda' bar bgyid / /rin chen me tog phyogs su 'thor/ /rgyal po'i tshogs mang kun gyis bskor / /gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs rnams dang / /chu bdag gshin rje'i 'khor mang rnams/ /de bzhin gus pas bdag cag bgyid/ /dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yis/ /zhabs kyi 102—651

mthil du bris nas kyang / /rang gi snying po 'di brjod na6)/ /de la bran bzhin bdag cag bgyid/ /gtsug tu bzhag nas bkur ba dang / /de yi dgos pa ci yang rung / /ma lus rdzogs par bdag cag bgyid/ /de la gzugs ston gda' bar bgyid/ /oṃ dha ka bhi du bha bi shu pa ②shi oṃ hūm̐/ zhes mgrin gcig tu smras pas/ srid pa ji srid pa ④rnams thugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dis 'dul bar gyur yinas/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos sku dang gsung dang thugs yon tan phrin (nyalas rdo rje las rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig 'di phyung ngo / /a ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam yas snying po bsam yas par/ /'bru gtor bsdu ba las ni 'das bzhin bsnyags (6)dka' ba'i/ /ma nor las chen gcig gis rab tu 'dul 'gyur zhing / /de yi bsngags ⑦pa'i bka' las 'da' bar ngas mi nus/ /thugs kyi thugs rjes ji srid ma nor lam nyid la/ /gsang ba'i snying po nges pa sgyu 'phrul mchog nyid pa/ /nga (nyanyid 'dud 'gyur gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /de nyid thugs las sprul pa'i thugs nyid do/ /ho rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las shin tu 'dul bar gyur pa gnas dang / snying po dbul ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu 6)bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po'i bdag nyid dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i spyan sngar dregs pa chen po dang / dbang phyug chen po la 7sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i tshogs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs (hunyakyis sems 'dun pa chen por gyur te/ ched du bstod (nyapa'i glu 'di mgrin gcig tu smras so/ / e ma'o yo ya mtshan 'phrul chen gyi/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i rang bzhin 102—652

dpal / /dug dang bdud rtsi khyad med par/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor thugs / /kun du bzang po rdo rje'i sku/ /ye shes lnga yi 0)khro rgyal gtso/ /khrag 'thung 'jigs byed he ru ka /sangs rgyas mtha' yas 'gro ba rgya mtsho 'dul/ /thugs rje bsam yas khro rgyal kun gyi gtso/ /khrag 'thung kun las ches ②'phags yid bzhin mdzod/ /ser gnag ③mthing gnag ༷ljang gnag ⑤dmar gnag ⑥dang / /sngo gnag ⑦mi rab lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /bskal (nyepar bcas pa'i me ri'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /ro tshogs mang po'i dkyil nas zhal rngam pa'i/ /bsod nams lus bsdus rdo rje mi zad 6)pa'i/ /skar tshogs mang la nyi zla'i 'od bzhin du/ /che btsan dregs pas 'jigs pa'i tshogs kun 'joms/ /mtshungs med cho 'phrul khyad par rab ston cing / /'dod pa'i dbang phyug gar gyi tshul du bzhugs / /za byed brkam ⑩pas thugs sku gsung 7gi zhal/ /khrag mtsho tsomatha' med skems (nyeshing sgal 8tshigs 'joms/ /khro gnyer snying 'dren 'jigs byed glog ltar 'gyu7/ /dur khrod 'bum gyi dbu smug 'jigs par brjid/ /'khor ba'i rtog pa 'jig 7mdzad thod rlon phreng bas bsgogs(na/ /rol phyir rtse mor tunyesnang bas a a ha las bzhad/ /rang nyid che bas dbang rdzogs rgyal bas dbu la brgyan / /smin ris khro gnyer glog bzhin rab 'gyu bas(khe/ /phyogs dang mthun pa'i khrag 'thung 'gyed cing sdud( )/ /sprul pa de lta bus ni zil gnon pa/ /'jigs pas mun pa'i tshogs chen rab bshams kyang / /sdang mig spyan ni nyi zla rgyas 'bar bas/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs phung sdug bsngal gtan nas sbyong / /khros pas zhal gdangs so ( nyechen gtsigs 'bar bas/ /srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal khams snyegs khu pa ltar/ /'jig rten dus gcig ( stemid mdzad lam drug gtan 102—653

nas gcod/ /ye shes phyag bsnams phyag mtshan 'bar ba yis/ /srid gsum ma lus rdul phran stongs par mdzad/ /rkan sgras rol pas 'gro la pheg brdabs bzhin / /khams gsum kun la chos ston rgyas par mdzad/ /zas su khrag 'thung rdo rje che mchog gsol/ /'jig ①tshogs sad 90pa'i ko rlon g.yang gzhi bsnams/ /klu 'dul yon tan sbrul nag ②stong gis bklubs④/ /'jigs bcas klu yi tshogs kyang zhabs 'og mnan/ /'dod chags 'dul (snyeb 'dod chags kun gyi gtso / /'dod chags chen po 'dod chags nyid kyi sku/ / mang po'i du'akhor bcas ( )'jigs pa'i 'khor du byas/ /zhe sdang 'dul ba zhe sdang kun gyi gtso/ /zhe sdang gdug pa zhe sdang kun gyi sku/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams zer gyis kun bzhu ba'i/ /rab tu brjid pa 'jigs pas 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gti mug 'dul ba gti mug kun gyi gtso/ /gti mug blo sel gti mug chen po'i sku/ / mi 'byed (9khrag 'thung sran chen ri rab brtan/ /nga rgyal 'dul ba nga rgyal kun gyi gtso/ /'jigs tshogs sad 99)nas ro tshogs mang gi gnas/ /zhabs bgrad ⑩mche gtsigs chog 17pa'i dus mtha' med/ /'jigs pas phebs par dga' zhing shin tu sdang / /phrag dog 'dul ba phrag dog kun gyi gtso/ /phrag tu)dog che mchog phrag dog chen po'i sku/ /bud med kun bsdus dkyil 'khor dbus gnas shing —/ /lam nor gdug par bcas pa phaṭa kyis gsod/ /zhing gi sham thabs gdug pa 'dul bar bsnams/ /sku 'dra 'jigs tshogs gzugs kyis sku la brgyan / /zhabs dang phyag tu gyur pa bsam thag chad/ /zhabs chen g.yon mang brkyang bas lha gnon bdud la khyab/ /zhabs g.yas thabs chen 4stemang pos dbang sdud sa 'dor zhing bskum7/ /rdo rje se gol phyar brdabs gnyid yicher rab 102—654

sel mdzad/ /'od chen dbus nas glog chen rab 'gyu ①ba'i/ /'jigs par gong na med pa'i dpa' bo khyod/ /zas ngan bdud rtsi ②sbyor ba'i sman chen bdag /'jigs byed khyod lta bu ni rab tu dkon/ /bskal par bkrus kyang slar skye dri ma la/ /ye shes nyi gzer 'od kyi byin brlabs ④dang / /thugs rje dag pa'i char gyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /brda 0tsam yud la rmongs ⑥'khrugs las sbyong ⑦zhing / /shi ba'i lam 'gog shes rab dkyil 'khor du/ /skye ba gtan nas sbyong ba'i thugs rje 'char/ /byams sdang mi mnga' bka' drin chen po'i gter/ /khrag 'thung sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bka' drin dran pa'i glu ⑧zhes bya ba'i le'u zhes bya ste bzhi bcu ⑨brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di brtan zhing mi 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su gnas par bya ba'i ched du 'byung po rnams kyi/ jo mo'i yang jo mo/ mi srin mo chen mo/ mi srin mo dang / tshangs ma dang / 'khrug mo dang / dbang mo dang / 'jug sred ma ⑩dang / gzhon nu ma tunyedang / dmar mo dang / bdud rtsi mo dang / zhi ba mo dang / be con mo dang / srin mo dang / za ba mo dang / dga' ba mo dang /ra ro khrag 'thung myos dang / gcig pu spyod dang / yid 'phrog ma dang /grub tsomo dang / klung tsomo dang / gsod byed mo dang / mi mo dang / phag mo dang / rgan byad mo dang / sna chad mo dang / chu lha mo dang / nag mo chen mo dang / ra mgo dmar ser chen mo dang / bum rna 8sngo gnag 8chen mo dang /102—655

gsus 'dzin ser gnag 6)chen mo dang / rgyal mo dang / blon mo dang / sde dpon mo dang / g.yog dang yang g.yog dang / bran dang / yang bran la sogs pa/ slas dang byi mo dang / bran mo rnams la ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po nges pa 'di/ /gsang sngags kun gyi rgyal po yin / /thabs chen mtshon pa'i shes rab ni/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i snying po dang / /gsang ba rgyud ni mang po rnams/ /nga yi thugs las sprul pa yin/ /tshangs pa dang ni brgya (7byin dang / /dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa/ /sde dpon 'phrog ma'i yul rnams dang / /lus 'phags pa tshulang spyod pa dang / /sgra mi snyan ④dang 'dzam gling du)snye/ /nga yi thugs kyi snying po 'di/ /phyogs bcu kun du spel ba dang / /de yi gzugs la gtad 16)pa ni/ /yid bzhin mdzod 'byor bka' yi 97)gnas/ /phyi nang theg pa bstan bcos dang / /stong phrag brgyad cu (kyirtsa bzhi rnams/ /spyod dang bsgom 6)dang bzlas ⑩pa dang / /sdom pa kun la mkhas pa yis/ /bsgom 11pa sran dang chos phyogs dang / /bstan pa 'dzin par nus pa yisnyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po mchog tu gtad/ /gzhan la bsnyad par ma yin no / /mi 'khrug blo zab rkyen thub cing / /yid bzhin sbyor bar mos pa la(nya/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bstan / /zla dang bcas pas dam tshig che/ /sbyor ba gnyi tshag mkhas pa dang / /lung dang tshad du ldan thub dang / /gzhan la bsnyad par mi byed cing / /bstan pa mchod par byed pa'o/ /nye ba bsnyen pa dam tshig la / /bsgrub 7pa bsnyen 3 tshopa nye bsnyen pa/ /ci nus par ni shin tu brtson/ /sems can ngang tshul kun bor nas/ /gang gi yid kyang mi 'khrugs shing / /mchod pa tshogs la stobs la rub/ /bud med 'gugs pas gtso la dbul/ /102wa 656

zung thub gsang la mkhas pa yis/ /nges pa can la shin tu gtad①/ /gzhan du bstan par mi bya'o/ /thogs med phyal bar 'dod pa spyod/ /bud med ②yon tan kun yod cing / /'dod chags kun dang mthun spyod la/ /rtsa ba dang du blang ba dang / / 'tsham par lha (0yi sku bstan te/ /nye bsnyen ligasang ba'i man ngag rnams/ / nams kyang (5)sbyin par mi bya'o/ /de la sbyor stangs 6)de bstan nas / /gzhan ni ( bstan par ma gsungs so/ /dad ldan srun (8)cing blo rno ba/ /dad pa che zhing chos la gus/ /chags par ran pa bka' nyan cing / /gnas pa dga' zhing lung nyan pa/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig sgrubal/ /mchod pa'i gnas shom sdom ⑩pa srung spyo/ /bsnyen pa la ni byin phab nas/ /gsang sngags tshogs kyi mchod gnas su/ /nga yi gsang ba byin phab ste7/ /thogs pa med par mngon sum la(/nye/ /sbyor ba'i thabs ldan mnyam sbyor ba/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /bdag nyid mnyes pa'i mnyam sbyor zhing / /mnyam pa'i grub pas tshogs la mchod/ /dam tshig mi ldan spyod rtsing dang / /gting nas bstan pa mi 'dzin la/ /'dod chags spel bar mi byed cing / /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na / /nges pa'i don ni mi ston la/ / nga yi rdzidabang dang bslab pa rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du rab tu sbyin/ /rigs ngan pho mo 'dod spyod ni/ /spro thung 'dod chags rab tu che/ /blo zhan phrag dog sgro skur 7can/ /gnyid che chang dad brtson 'grus chung / /slob la mi gus nan tan med/ /slob dpon mi dran spun sems chung / /gal te dam la gnas na yang / /nga yi gsang ba 'dzin pa la / /mngon du dga' bar mi nus te/ /lta zhan bka' las 'das pa dang / /grol ba 7dka' zhing nus mthu zhan/ / /mun dang lkog dang skye bo la/ /gar tshon102—657

dben phrad par 'dod spyod cing / /'dod chags 'ga' lam de dag la/ /tshig rnams gsang ba smra byed pa/ /dngos kyi ①don dang mthun pa las/ /gsang ba'i snying po sbyin mi byal/ /bskal pa'i 'jig rten bar du yang / /thugs kyi bde ba mi spro zhing / / nams kyang nibastan par mi bya'o/ /'jig rten 'dod pa dga' rnams phyir/ /gal te rmongs pas byin pa ni/ /rims dang nad kyis srog bcad de/ /rtsa ba yan lag spangs pa yin/ /bsregs dang sgribs par yun ring ④gnas/ /zhes brjod pas srid pa mtha' dag gi bud med kyi tshogs rnams dam tshig 'dis 'dul bar gyur te6)/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po 6)sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin (7las rdo rje las rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig 'di phyung ngo / /e e ma/ e ma'o chos rnams sgyu ma yi/ /ngang nyid bud med gsang ba sngags pa yi/ /lnga drug dus btab snang srid 'byung ba'i gter/ /yang dag lam rnyed mngon par kun gnas kun du gnas/ /chos mang chos nyid mnyam pa'i phyag rgya ji snyed las/ /las ngan dge ba'i cho 'phrul lam chen 'di/ /kun gyi khyad par nyid ni bud med bde ba gcig pu yin/ /chos kun de nyid yin phyir dman pas mi smad 'tsham (nyapar bstan/ /sgyu ma 'byor pa nyid ni bder ⑨gshegs 7nyid yin rab tu gsal/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dam tshig chen pos bud med btul ⑩ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu chadagu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das (nyadagyes pa chen pos mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'di ched du mibarjod do/ /de la mchod sbyin chen po ni/ /thog mar bdag nyid 102—658

rtogs goms bsgral/ /de nas gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje/ /gnyis su med par bsgral hu)bar bya/ /'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid mnyes pas mnyes par bya/ /mnyam pa'i grub rdzas chen po dag /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gshegs pa yi/ /bder lgugashegs yon tan rmad po che/ /gzhan na yod pa ma yin nag/ /lha srid ④la sogs smos ci dgos/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya chen po rdzogs gyur cing / /gsal ba'i yid gnyis med pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'bar bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pas/ mnyes pa chen pos ⑤'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad khyab par gyur 4)to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las mchod sbyin gyi le'u ste lnga bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos don yod par bya ba'i phyir/dam tshig ( chen po ched du brjod do/ /bla med theg par nges gyur pas/ /nyon mongs las rnams kun spyod kyang / /byas la mi sogs (khutshogs gyur te5)/ /tshul khrims sdom pa phun sum tshogs/ /bla med mchog gi dam tshig tu/ /'dul ba'i dbang du tshul khrims dang / /ji snyed sdom pa bsam yas pa/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /yod med dbu ma'ang mi dmigs shing / /sgyu ma mig yor lta bu'i tshul/ /srog med srog gcad gcad 7du med/ /srog dang skyes bu log rtogs (1tsam/ /bden pa gnyi tsogar 'dabyer med pas/ /'phrul dga'i tso 102—659

tshul te 6)tha dad min/ /gzhan dang ma byin med pa'i phyir/ /blangs med thams cad nyid kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu dang / /ming dang tshig tu btags ②pa brdzun/ /brdzun ①nyid la ni brdzun ④spyod pa/ / brdzun zhes ⑤btags tsam yod ma yin/ /ma chags pa la chags pa dang / /chags pa nyid na chags med pa⑥/ /de ni tshangs mchog rgyal po ste/ /shin tu chags pa chen po yin / /bla med mi spang bla ma bkuraX/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad(nya/ /yang dag lam du zhugs la byams/ /gsang ba'i don phyir smra mi bya/ /'di ni rtsa ba lnga rnams te/ /bsgrub dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig mchog /gti mug chags dang zhe sdang dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog mi spang ngo / /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen / /dag pa'i snod du mi dor ro/ /yan lag bcu yi dam tshig mchog /ye nas dag mnyam rtog 99 pas spyad/ /bsrung zhing bsgrub pa'i dam tshig lnga/ /rtsa ba yin te rigs med 'gyur/ /mi spang mi dor lnga gnyis ni/ /yan lag dam tshig 'da' dka' ba'o/ /mnyam la mnyam par sbyor ba yi7/ /mnyam pa'i dam tshig la gnas na/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po thob par 'gyur/ /'das na sangs rgyas ma yin no/ /rtsa ba nyams pa'i phyal pa dag /gso la nye bar mi brtson dang / /skad cig yud tsam smra ma 37byed/ /nyams 'gyur nyes pa brjod mi lang rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur 12na/ /bsgrub 1nyapa thams cad log par 'gyur/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs pa'i/ /'bras bu mi 'dod bzhin du 'dul/ /yan lag dam tshig tshanyams gyur na/ /'bras bu med cing ngan 'gror ltung / /dam tshig rnams ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga la ni/ /gcig la'ang gnyis dang bcu phrag gsum/ /yan lag dam 102—660

tshig lnga gnyis la/ /gcig la bcu phrag gnyis su dbye/ /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na/ /srid gsum 'gro ba ji snyed pa'i/ /rtog 'dul 0)dam tshig de snyed spro/ /gzhan yang rgyal mchog kun bzang gi/ /thams cad ma lus phyag rgya yi/ /bsgrub ②med dam pa ma lus 'grub/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /rgyal ba'i rigs mchog 'dzin pa ste/ /'jig rten gtso dang 'khor gyis bkur/ /dam pa'i mchog dang dam pa yis/ /sras dang spun dgongs byin gyis rlob①/ /bder gshegs nyid kyi yul la bzhugs4)/ /'jigs med kun du bzang por sbyor/ /ji bzhin nyid dang 'dul ba'i thabs/ /ji snyed sdom pa bsam yas pa/ /ma lus rnam dag lhun gyis 'grub(5)/ /nyams na bskangs (5)pas rdzogs pa dang / /de la sogs pa bsam yas mchog /ces brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la 'dul bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las dam tshig gi (7)le'u ste lnga bcu (gugacig pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ sngags 'chang rnams don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ /dam tshig sum brgya ba'i rtsa ba mdor bsdus nas/ /sngags 'chang rnams kyi (9)don ched du yibarjod pa 'di brjod do/ /phyogs bcu'i /1'jig rten rdul snyed du/ /log rtogs / mi bzad rdul phran snyed/ /rtog 'dul gnyen po bsam mi khyab/ /'dul ba sdom pa bsam yas dang / /rdo rje theg mchog mang po kun/ /nyid las g.yos nyugeshing spros med kyang / /rang rig 'khrul pa'i rtog 7pa yis/ /lta ba mtho dzadaman bsam mi khyab/ /de 'dul 102—661

don phyir 'tsham par bstan/ /yang dag nyid dang log rtogs 0)gnyis/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gnas gyur nas/ /de la bcos shing bsgyur du med/ /ye nas ngo bo nyid med na/ /nyon mongs spangs shing don bsgrub med/ /thams cad ma lus ro gcig 'gyur/ /kun rdzob chu zla ltar ②yin pas/ /cir yang 'gyur zhing cir yang 'grub/ /rnal 'byor de nyid rtogs pa yis/ /don dam skye 'gag med pa ste / /kun rdzob sgyu ma cir yang 'grub/ /ces rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las dam tshig sum brgya drug cu ①pa'i rtsa ba bco rtsilnga pa mdor bshad dupa'i le'u ste lnga bcu ( snaganyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas/ thugs rdo rje rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /nam mkha'i mkha' dkyil dang ba yi/ /yid bzhin sprin tshogs rnam pa 'byung / /sna tshogs 'byung zhing 'od 'phro 'bar/ /raṃ/ srid gsum sreg pa'i me yin te/ /yid kyi ye shes me ru 'bar/ /rtasti/ dbang po dang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /spyod yul rdzas rnams bsdus nas ni/ /lhan ⑧de lhang 6)nger 'od du zhi/ /a/zhi 'gyur dbyings nas phyag rgya 'bar/ /thugs rje byin brlabs tsormad po che/ /hūṃ / 'gro ba sna tshogs don byed pa/ /'di ni byang chub mchog tu gsungs/ /ho / bzhi po 'joms shing lhonyangan song sbyong / /ṭ+wāṃ (nyata/ sman bcud len gyis dug sbyong bzhin32/ /phyi dang nang gi dri ma dag /bdag med gnyis kyis dag par byed/ /hri8/ gsal 7zhing gzhag 7par bya ba med/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od bzhin du/ /snang dang mi snang gnyi ga 6 7med/ /de bzhin (nyamanyam gnyis ye shes 102—662

kyis / /thams cad rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor/ /oṃ/ rang rig ye shes rgyal po yisal/ /phyogs bcu khams rnams dbang bsdus nasanyu/ /thams cad mi dmigs dbyings su thim/ /thams cad khro bo'i tshogs su 'gyur/ /rtog pa rnam bzhi mi dmigs dbyings gyur pa/ /shes rab yum gyi mtshan nyid dbyings su thim/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med dbyings gyur pas/ /chos rnams thams cad dbyings kyi khro bo khro mor 'gyur/ /a ho rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las chos thams cad khro bo dang khro mo'i phyirang bzhin du gyur pa dang / rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi mes lisbyong ba'i le'u ste lnga bcu ④gsum pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa thams cad kyi rgyal po'i 'bar ba'i thugs rjes gtum 'khrugs ging tshogs chen por bsgyur dunas/ thams cad 'od dpung 'phro zhing 'bar bar bstan pa ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bstan pa yis/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus par/ /rbu yidang tsakra'i 'khor lor sprul/ /'od 'phro 'bar ba'i tshogs chen hūṃ/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i ༷me ltar 'bar/ /raṃ/ nyi ma'i thod sbrul mang po'i gzi/ /khro gnyer glog stong 'gyur (gyib bzhin/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir/ /phaṭa/khros 6)pa'i sprin chen phyogs bcur 'bar/ /khros pa'i me dpung rdo rjer 'bar/ /rdo rje 'khor lo brtsegs par 'bar/ /tsakrali/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor//gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya mdzes/ /ha te/ slas dang bran mo (7byi mo'i tshogs/ /rang gi stan dang mal cha dang / /ci bgyi zhes te chas te gnas/ /ste ra'i 7rgyu 102—663
