dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'bar ba yi/ /oṃ dang seng ge mgos bskor te/ /brgyan ①pa'i rdo rje phyag rgya kun/ /rdzogs ldan zhi bas bskor bar bya/ /rgyal po lus mdzes 'khor lo 'bar/ /rgyan rnams zhi la dkar ba dang / /byang chub mchog 'bar lhan (miner bsgom/ /mkha' la rgyu dang bar snang 'phyo/ /gzhan yang 'gro drug ma lus kun/ /zhir 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gar dang glu yis mchod byas te/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug pa ma lus pa/ /gdug pa'i yid ni rnam bor nas/ /lha dkar po yi 'od du 'gyur/ /bde ldan byang chub 'od 'phro 'bar / /gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam (mikun / /skad cig yud la zhi mdzad de/ /zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las thams cad ma lus par zhi bar gyur nas zhi ba'i hom gyi le'u ste lnga bcu ④dgu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos lhun gyis grub pa'i ⑤dam tshig byin gyis rlob ⑥pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ⑦yi tshogs kyi (kyedakyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa la/ /khros pa'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la6)/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par bya/ /bkug nas rdo rje phur pas btabatso/ /rdul du byas nas tshogs la dbul/ /e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams nas/ /bcings 'gyur bskyod na phyogs bcur g.yo/ /myos nas gal te tshig par 'gyur/ /bo gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba gzi 102—671

brjid lhun chen la/ /chags pa yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /rdo rje gsung yang dbang du 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par bya / /rdo rje chags pa'i phur pas gdab/ /chags pa'i tshogs la thim par dbul / /baṃ gyi zhi)tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu (migu rgyud (gyidu sbrel nas bsdams / /'gugs 'gyur ci yang phyi bzhin 'brang / /ci 'dod de bzhin 'ong bar 'gyur/ /ma yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba 'du 'phro gzi chen la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /yon tan yid bzhin gter du brtags( tsho / /nga rgyal dga' 'phro'i phur pas gdab/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'phel bar dbul/ /ma yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu (7gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams na6) / /gzi brjid 'bar ba'i 'phrul chen spro/ /yid bzhin nam mkha' gang bar 'gyur/ /ya (7yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /dang ba'i 8yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /gtum chen rngam po'ang lhan ner 99)'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /gtum rngam 'khrugs ⑩pa'i ngo bor brtag3nya / lhan ne nyanagasal ba'i phur bas (nyagadab/ /'bar ba lhan thune'i tshogs la dbul/ /ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud 7du sbrel nas bsdams/ /'bar ba 7lhan ner byin gyis brlabs7/ /thams cad g.yo ba med par 'gyur/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /lhag ma'i (nyamachod sbyin 'dod pa sbyin/ /gang gi dam tshig rab bsgrags nas/ /gang 'dod las de byed par bsgom/ /sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka /shin tu gdug cing gtum bag can/ /thams cad ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /dbang dang byin brlabs 102—672

rmad po che/ /lha chen la sogs dbang bsdus nas/ /'khor rnams dbang phyug slas su byas/ /so so'i las rnams bskos ①pa de②/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /ma thogs myur du mngon par phyung / /dam bcas bzhin du ma byas na/ /ji ltar rang gis mna' bor ba'i/ /sdom bcas de las 'da' ma byed / /dam tshig de las 'das gyur na/ /mgo lus snying yang tshal pa bdun/ /yak+ṣa khro bos gtubs par 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor sngags 'chang gis/ /ji ltar bcol ba bzhin du byos/ /las de mngon du ma byas na/ /rang gis (khumana' bor khas blangs bzhin/ /rul chamyags tshig nas ⑤dmyal bar 'gro/ /rnal 'byor dam la gnas gyur pa'i/ /las rnams yongs su bya ba dang / /'khor rnams bu gcig bzhin du skyongs/ /phra (5)men ma yang dngos grub 'thobasti / /bcol ba'i las rnams mngon du byos/ /zhes bsgo'o/ /khro bo bsgrub (8)pa'i las kyi gtso bo ni 'di yin no/ /khrag 'thung chen po la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen pos ni/ /thams cad thams cad byed pa yin/ /mdzod ldan chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos 5)ni/ /'du bar 'dod na 'du bar byed / /'phel bar 'dod na 'phel bar byed/ /sbos mo chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos 7ni/ /lhan (nyaner 'dod na thim par byed/ /rmugs rmeshepar 'dod na myos par byed/ /seng gdong chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos hu ni/ /thams cad kun du za bar byed/ /rdul cha 8tsam yang med par byed/ /bzhad skegadong chen mo la sogs pa'i/ /bro gar glu tshig tsochen mos zhu ni / /thams cad kun la za bar byed/ /kun la rab tu nyams par byed/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo yi/ /bro gar glu tshig tu chen mos ni/ /sbod yi cing gtong 102—673

bar byed pa ste/ /thams cad thams cad byed pa yin/ /sngon pa dang ni lhug phran tshal/ /sdong gcig dang ni me reg tu/ /dang ba dga' ba chags pa dang ske/ /khros pas ka li rab tu bya/ /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid sbyong bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin 6)las byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste drug cu (gepa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las chos thams cad yid dang / chos su 'dus par bstan pa (kyedang / shes rab thams cad ni yum bzhir 'dus/ yum bzhi yang gcig tu 'dus so/ /thabs thams cad ni rigs bzhir 'dus/ rigs bzhi yang gcig tu 'dus te/ thams cad dbyings dang / dbyings kyi ye shes su 'dus par bstan nas/ tshig mgo mjug dugi don bsdus nas yang 'di skad brjod de/ don gyi rtsa ba'i mchog yin rnam/ /thams cad ma lus mi lus shing (nye/ /mi dmigs ma chags chos nyid de/ /de bzhin dbyings nyid mang po sna tshogs thabs su snang / /thabs nyid sgyu ma mig yor chu zla gzugs brnyan yin/ /de nyid rang rig ⑥yi shes chags med sna tshogs snang / /thabs dang shes rab ldan pas mchog gi gnas gyur pas/ /ji ltar spyad kyang zad med gnyis med sgrib mi 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs chen mchog la ye nas rol pa yin/ /de nyid phyag rgya (7)sna tshogs sprul pa rang rig ste/ /rgyu 'bras ye nas dbyer med snga phyi ma yin pas/ /'bras bu lam du gyur nas dus gcig (31mnyam par sbyor/ /'di ni yid bzhin rin chen thams cad 'byung ba'i 102—674

gnas / /thams cad 'du ba'i gter dang yid bzhin mdzod/ /gnyis bral mnyam dang mi mnyam thams cad nyid kyi dbyings/ /nga dang bdag med mtshan ma sna tshogs dbyer med pa/ /stong dang mi stong mi gnas de bzhin nyid du 'dus/ /rang byung rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zad med dkyil 'khor spro/ /'das dang ma 'das dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub dang / /mi zad par ldan rgyan gyi 'khor lo drug rdzogs pa/ /skye med dbyings kyi rang byung 'od gsal phreng ldan mchog /ye nas ma bcos ma byas rang rig ngang gis gsal/ /thams cad 'byung 'jug rang rig gter chen ngang du bsdus/ /phyogs bcu ma lus mi lus 0)thams cad kun 'dus dang / /zhing khams gzhal yas bsam yas (mirin chen mchog chen kun/ /skye med dbyings dang rang gi gnyis su yang dag 'ub / /mos spyod stong nyid rgyu 'bras yang nas yang sbyangs mi dmigs pa/ /ye nas 'od gsal chags med ma chags dkon mchog gnas/ /ming tsam mchog rol thabs dang shes rab mchog gis rdzogs/ /lam stegs nyid du pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs par rgyu 'bras spyod / /mnyam nyid pa yi rdo rje thabs chen yang dag ldan/ /'gro med 'ong med mi gnas kun khyab khyab med nyid kyis bshad/ /a ho/ rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sa bcu gnyis dang / thabs kyis ④mchog dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus par (5)yid dang / chos su 'dus par bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu (phyiragacig pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes lnga'i dkyil 'khor la mnyam par bzhugs nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /lnga phung yan lag thams cad 102—675

kyang ske/ /'bru lnga gnas pa'i byang chub ste/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ 0)du 'brel pa yi/ /byang chub rdo rje nyid las byung / /spyir na brjod pa thams cad kyang / /kun kyang ming tsam yi ge a/ /skye 'jig nyid kyang yi ge lnga/ /de ni byang chub sems yin te③ / /dmigs med byang chub mchog 'byung ba/ /gsum shar lnga 'bar bcu 'byor pa/ /zad med rin chen gter yin te/ /mngon shes drug ldan mtshan bzang spags(mi/ /e las 'phro zhing ar 'dus pa/ /gsang ba'i thig le nyid kyi dbyings / /nam mkha'i dbyings nas sprin byung ba/ /kun la khyab cing sna tshogs sprin / /bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i khong nas bsam mi khyab/ /byin brlabs ④ya mtshan rmad po che/ /yon tan mi zad ri gter du gyur(67/ /ho/ ye nas mnyam nyid gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /dbyings las mi gzhan (7ye nas thig le'i ngang (kye/ /ye shes dbyings nyid gzugs brnyan sgyu ma'i tshul/ /snang byed nyid na bya byed med par gnas/ /ye shes 'phrul chen bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i don/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub dam pa ni/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mnyam par gnas/ /dag mnyam rnam gsum don rtogs bsgom yi/byas shing / /mnyam pa rnam bzhis ⑩don rtogs mchog gi gnas/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub phun sum tshogs bzhir 'dus/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs sku gsung thugs kyis bsdus/ /chags med zhi ba'i lam nas thig ler 'jug /ye shes lnga rdzogs spyod yul mi 'da' (stol / /ma chags 'od gsal dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ldan/ /thams cad ma lus rang rig rgyal po yis/ /dkyil 'khor dag mnyam khro bo khro mor sbyor/ /chos rnams rang bzhin nyid kyis stong / /nang dang nang gi phyi rol gyi/ /rnam rtog sna tshogs 'dzin pa yang / /dngos po med dbyings skad cig ma/ /de nyid rnam 102—676

par dag pa'i lam/ /phyin ci log nyid yang dag ste/ /ma rig pa ni ye shes gsal / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal byang chub mchog /thams cad yon tan mchog gi gnas/ /a ho/ /phyogs bcu'i ①rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun/ /nges pa'i don dgrol bzhi bcu rtsa lngar 'dus/ /bsdus pa'i don nyid yi ge 'bru lngar bsdus/ /lnga po'i don nyid 'bru gsum nang du 'dus/ /gsum po de nyid yi ge ar 'dus te/ /a nyid ma skyes mnyam rdzogs dbyings su thim/ /a ho/mi dmigs stong pa nyid kyang brjod mi lang / /mi dmigs de bzhin gshegs kyang bsam mi khyab/ /ma skyes mchog gi (midabyings kyang bsam mi khyab/ /ma 'gags byang chub sems ni skye 'jig med/ /'gro med yong ③med mi gnas pa'i / /thugs rje byin brlabs lirnam par 'phro/ /zhes nyid la nyid gsung ngo / /dbyings las dbyings byung (5)thabs kyi phyag rgyar gsal/ /thabs las dbyings byung yum gyi phyag rgyar gsal/ /dbyings su dbyings kyis ye shes 'byor pas na/ /byang chub sems tshogs dkyil 'khor brjod mi lang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nges pa'i don ma lus par mtshan nyid med pa'i phyag rgyar thim pa'i le'u ste drug cu yiganyis pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pas rgyal po tshe ( )mtha' yas su sprul nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do(kyi/ /sgyu (9)'phrul dra ba bstan bsdus te/ /phroṃ yidang bi shwa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ma dang a yi dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rab bsgoms nas/ /bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i don bsgoms te/ /de yis phyogs bcur gang bar bsgom / /r+ghaṃ (1nyadang dzaḥyon/ bam̐ hos dgug /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po 102—677

mchog /lus ngag sems la thim par bya/ /mṛ 6)nyid dngos sam yid bzhin mdzodam/ /bum pa mchog ni bzang po yi/ /tshe gzhag ciganas ni 'di yin te/ /yang nas yang du dgug bya ste/ /mngon sum smin ①par gyur pa dang / /dbyings su yang ni sba bar bya/ /rdo rje go cha bsrung ④ba yis/ /brtan zhing 'khor los dgag par 0bya/ /snying po 'bru lnga'i nang du bstim/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ma lus kun/ /rgyal po tshe dpag med pa bsgomayi/ /sku mdog ⑦gangs ri 'tsher ba la/ /rgyan phreng sna tshogs rnams kyis brgyan/ /yid bzhin rin chen phreng ba dang / /yid bzhin rin chen za ma tog /rin chen rgyan dang bum pa bzang / /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i don bya ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas mchog /bgegs kyis mṛ /kyernams mi ster na/ /tshe dpag med dang khro bo ste / /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /sgra skad drag khyapo bton ⑩nas ni/ /thams cad ma lus thul (1bar bya/ /dbang du tshe dpag med pa ⑫bskur / /tshe bsnyen tunyedang ni nye bsnyen dang / /tshe sgrub tsodang ni sgrub 8chen dang / /thabs dang shes rab 'byor pa yis/ /ci 'dod las rnams grub par byed / /tshe dbang mo ni rgyud 'phel ma/ /dkar mo'i mdog la 'od 'phro 'bar/ /phyag na rin chen gang ba yi7/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na/ /gnas pa'i 'gro drug ma lus la/ /phan pa'i tshe dbang 'di sbyin no/ /de las lhag pa'i rgyud 'phel med/ /yi ge bzlas pa 'phrul chen 'di/ /rnam gsum tshul gyis ma 'khrul bar/ /sngags bzlas cho ga bar ma gcod/ /'dris gsal brtan pa mchog gis bya/ /oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ i rgyu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ/ sī sī sī sī sī/ rmāḥ.āḥ.āḥ.āḥ.āḥ/nyen tsā hṝ tsā tsā tsā/102—678

phroṃ ①pa phroṃ phroṃ phroṃ/ bā bā bā bā bā/ dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra/ ā ā ā ā lhakha/ yu yuyuyu yu/ ste ste ste k+ṣe ste(9/ hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ a a a a a o tshe rnams dbang du ma gyur na/ /bder ④gshegs la yang tshe dpag med/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i ⑤khams bkang nas/ /phyag rgya mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis/ /'jig rten phyogs bcu'i bdud bcom nas/ /'gro lnga tshe rnams dbang du bsdu/ /phyag rgya gshol la sogs pa yis/ /'og gi 'jig rten khams dkrugs (6)nas/ /gshin rje'i gnas nas tshe bkug ste/ /snying po lnga la bstim par bya/ /phyag rgya 'khor lo chen po yis/ /steng gi 'jig rten khams dkrugs (7te/ /dbang phyug lha chen la sogs dang / /bar snang bgegs rnams rgyu ba las/ /mṛ (nyatshe rab tu dgug par bya/ /'khor lo'i 'bru la bstim yonyenas ni/ /de nas yi ge 'bru lnga de/ /mṛ kyiyi gnas lngar bstim par bya / /oṃ oṃ badz+ra ka pa tsa badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 4)badz+ra a adhi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā/ phyag rgya bsrung 7ba'i cho ga ste/ /'bru lnga'i yi ge 'bru gcig ste/ /'bru gcig mi dmigs dbyings su thim/ /oṃ/ yid bzhin bum pa'i ④rin po che / /rgyan dang rin chen phreng bas brgyan8/ /rin chen lnga dang sman lnga dang / /'bru lnga spos lnga yungs kur 7lnga/ /sngags mkhan rab brtan 4 blo ldan pas/ /yan lag ma nyams sngags bzlas bsgom/ /rgyan nyunyechas lnga dang ldan byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas rigs kyi bu de yis/ /yo byad ma lus ldan byas nas/ /mchod yon rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mnyes mchod dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las tshe'i cho ga dbang dam pa shin tu gsang ba'i le'u ste drug cu 4)gsum pa'o// //102—679

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sdud 0)pa pos 'gro ba lnga dbang med par smra zhes bya bar yang bsdus nas ched ②du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid kyi dbyings/ /kun du bzang po thugs rje'i ngang / /sku gsung thugs ldan yon tan rdzogs/ /mnyam pa'i zhing du sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje rab tu gsang ba yis/ /rdo rje rab tu kun sbyar te/ /oṃ dang hūm̐ ①du 'byor par bsgom / /thams cad dbyings su thim par bsgom/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa dang / /thig le man+t+ra de dag tu/ /mṛ ④thal man+t+ra bzang po'i thig /rta babs sgo khyud bzang po dang / /rdo rje rtse gcig 'od 'bar dang / /'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dam pa yis/ /rdo rje rtse gcig rtse gsum briX/ /dkyil 'khor rgyu ⑥dang ldan par bya/ /mchod yon sna tshogs mchod par dbulaphya/ /yaṃ/ dud ku'i niye shes 'od 'phros nas/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dzaḥ(9)las lcags kyu grangs med pas/ /de yis 7snying du zhugs par bya/ /ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dzaḥ(nyalas lcags kyu mang po yis/ /gang dgug de yi snying ga ⑫nas / /drangs te de yi khar gzhug bya/ /ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dzaḥ(stelas lcags kyu mang po yis/ /gang dgug de yi snying ga cinas/ /drangs 7te de yi khar gzhug bya/ /sngags 'di rab tu brjod par bya/ /oṃ dzaḥrgyu baṃ ho / a mṛ pra ⑩du/ ming pra be sha /ci 'dod las de bzlas par bya/ /lag gnyis sor mo spyir bsnol ṇa/sterte/ /khu tshur (7dam du bcangs ri 7nas ni/ /srin lag mthe'u chung mthe bo gnyis/ /bar du mthe (1bo de drangs te/ /oṃ ming pra be sha ā ā/ /thal ba yungs kur 22drag tu rdeg /ming de khong du zhugs (nyapar bya/ /babs 102—680

gnyis med 'brel pa thabs chen yin/ /kun kyang shes rab ngang du gnas/ /snang dang gnas pa thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid las ma ①g.yos phyir/ /g.yo dang med pa gnyi ga med/ /gnas dang mi gnas dbye ru med/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings su thams cad 'dus/ /'dus nyid (miganas su thibs ①pa yiX/ /thams cad de lta bu yi ngang (nya/ /mnyam gnyis dbyer med sus mi tshugs/ /de nyid sems dpa' yibazhugs gnas yin/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i rigs mchog de/ /sems dpa' nyid dang rigs mthun ⑦pas/ /de nyid rdo rje zhal mthong yin/ /rgyur byas phung po khams rnams la/ /gzhi nirtsa de bzhin nyid du gcig /sgyu mar snang ba gzugs brnyan tshul/ /snang ba nyid ni dngos po med/ /dngos nyid de nyid sna tshogs ston/ /phung po lnga nyid de bzhin gshegs/ /dbang po rnams ⑨sems byang chub sems/ /yul dus po de chen po 0yin/ /bdag rtog rnam pa ⑪khro bo yin/ /rtag chad mu bzhi khro mo yin/ /de sems rang rig nyid ces bya/ /thams cad dbyings 'gyur kun du bzang / /de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ /gang gis de ltar rtogs gyur (nyen/ /sems dpa' nyid dang dgongs mthun pas//de nyid rdo rje zhal mthong yin/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /ming dang tshig dang yi ge dang / /sgra yis mtshon nas don bstan pa/ /kun kyang yi ge ming gcig bzhin/ /gang yang dngos po ma yin te/ /dngos med de nyid sna tshogs snang / /snang ba nyid na gang yang med/ /bya byed sna tshogs kun byed kyang / /dngos po med de yang dag nyid/ /de ni cis kyang mi tshugs pa'i/ /sa rdo dran med ma yin te/ /de nyid shin tu 'od gsal yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de ltar gnas/ /gang gis de ltar rtogs pa ni/ /rigs mchog dam pa rgyu yin 102—689

te / /rdo rje'i 4)rigs dang dbyer med phyir/ /de nyid rdo rje zhal mthong yin/ /skyes bu blo rtsal rab ldan pas/ /kun dang dbyer med don rtogs te/ /'bras bu mngon du ma gyur kyang / /byang chub sems (7la gnas bcas pas③/ /dper na mngal dang sgo nga yis6)/ /mngon du ma gyur bsgribs gyur kyang / /rtsal chen 'dus pa 'byung ba bzhin/ /rnam rtog (gegazugs ni bor ma thag /thams cad kun la dbang sgyur (6)zhing / /rigs mchog dam pa 'dzin par 'gyur / /rdo rje sems dang mnyam pa yi/ /dngos grub mchog rnams yongs su rdzogs / /bde ba can gyi zhing yang thob/ /byang chub mchog la rol bar 'gyur/ /lha mi ⑦rnams kyi ston pa po/ /lus ngag sems la dbang thob nas/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /tshad med bzhi la dbang byed 'gyur/ /bde ba'i ro mchog kun la spyod/ / tha mar rinyaskye rga na 'chi (9)la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal zad pa'i go 'phang thob/ /rdo rje rigs mchog 'dzin 'gyur te/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs 7kyis/ /'gro ba ma 47lus thams cad kun/ /rdo rje rigs su 'dren par byed/ /bdud sde tshar gcod nyon mongs 'dul/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yang dag bskor/ /'gro ba ma lus thams cad la/ /mi rtag pa yi tshul yang ston/ /nyan thos rnams la dgra bcom tshul/ /byang chub rnams la rang byung tshul/ /bla med theg pa 32sangs rgyas tshul/ /lhun grub rnams la rdo rje dbyings / /kun la mthun pa'i tshul yang ston/ /rang bzhin dbyings las g.yos pa med/ /ma g.yos bzhin du kun du ston/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /de lta bu yi ngang du gnas/ /zhes rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /nyid la nyid de skad ces brjod do/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa 102wa 690

las skyes bu dam pa blo rtsal rab gcig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong ba'i le'u ste drug cu ①bdun pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las sngags 'chang rnams don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ dam tshig sum brgya'i rtsa ba mdor bsdus nas sngags 'chang rnams kyi don du ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rdul snyed du/ /log rtog mi bzad rdul phran snyed/ /rtog 'dul gnyen po bsam mi khyab/ /'dul ba sdom pa bsam yas dang / /rdo rje theg mchog mang po kun/ /nyid las g.yos shing spros med kyang / /rang rig 'khrul pa'i rtog pa yis/ /lta ba mtho rgyadaman bsam mi khyab/ /de 'dul don phyir 'tsham ①par bstan/ /yang dag nyid dang log rtogs ④nyid/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gnas gyur na/ /de la bcos shing bsgyur du med/ /ye nas ngo bo yod yin phyin//nyon mongs spangs shing byang bsgrub ⑥med/ /thams cad ma lus ro gcig 'gyur//kun rdzob chu zla lta (7yin pas/ /cir yang 'gyur zhing cir yang 'grub/ /rnal 'byor de nyid rtogs pa yis/ /don dam skye 'gag med pa ste/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma cir yang 'grub/ /gnas ngan dus na log rtogs (nyenyid/ /gzung 6)'dzin bral ba nyid rtogs na⑩/ /bdag med ye shes rang bzhin nyid/ /snying rje thabs mkhas ting 'dzin gyis/ /cir yang dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /so so rang bzhin nges zhe /nyan/ /yang dag lam nyid bcos su med/ /de bas yang dag blo chen gyis/ /thams cad dngos po med par bshad/ /dper na dug gi rigs shes pas/ /dug gis mi tshugs bzhin du snang / /ha la ha la'i dug rnams 102—691

kyang / /bsgrub 6)na ra sa ya na'i ②sman/ /bdud rtsir 'gyur la tshe ring 'grub/ /nyon mongs rang dang spyi bstan pa/ /mtshan nyid ma nor rtogs pas na/ /rnam par byang ba'i lam du 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub kyang / /gang na med de de yin te/ /nang gi chen po lnga nyid kyang / /rang dang spyi yi don brtags na/ /mtshan nyid med pas rnam par dag /so so'i rtsal rnams 'dzin gyur pas/ /thabs chen du ni rnam par spro/ /mtshan rnams rang bzhin mi gnas pas/ /shes rab dbyings su rnam par sbyor/ /gti mug ces ni brjod pa ni/ /ma rig ming gi rnam grangs te/ /gnyis med don gcig ①yin par bshad / /rang gi mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /chos dang bdag dang dngos po rnams / /ngo bo nyid la 94 sogs brtags pa/ /rtog nyid sgyu ma klung gyur te/ /log rtogs (༄spros 6)pa'i 97)rgyun yin la/ /thams cad chos dbyings ro gcig ste/ /bzod pa'i chos nyid mig gcig yin/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /ma rig pa ni spang du med/ /rig pa yang dag bsgrub tu med/ /thams cad dbyings su ro gcig thim/ /sgyu ma dudangos por rtog pa ni/ /sgyu ma rtog nyid mi dmigs pa/ /mi dmigs de nyid sna tshogs snang / /skyes pa nyid na chos nyid gcig /dbyings nyid mi dmigs de bzhin nyid / /de nyid chos sku phyag rgya che/ /mi dmigs sgyu mar dngos po la/ /rtog pa'i yul gyi dngos nyid kyang / /chos nyid mi dmigs ye nas dag /sgyu ma mi dmigs dbyer med phyir/ /yod med gnyis (9)ga dbyer med pas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis khodabang bsgyur na 1lha/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /chos nyid dmigs su med pa ste/ /mi dmigs bzhin du sgyu mar spros/ /gdul 7bya'i bya 102—692

ba bsam mi khyab/ /gsung gi phyag rgya chen po'o/ /de ltar gti mug spang du med / /rnam par snang mdzad rgya chen yin/ /zhe sdang rang dang spyir ①bstan pa/ /kun nas mnar sems rtog pa yi/ /sgyu ma'i dngos po thams cad kun/ /'jig par mos pa'i rang bzhin can/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /zhe sdang snying rje spangs bsgrub med/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig phyir/ /sgyu ma rang bzhin mnar sems pa/ /dngos po thams cad 'jig rtogs na/ /sgyu mar snang ba thams cad kyang / /chos kyi dbyings las mi gzhan te(mi/ /mi dmigs pa nyid sgyu mar skyes/ /chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin ni/ /bdag srog gso ba'i rang bzhin med/ /snang ba thams cad chos kyi dbyings/ /mnar sems sgyu ma chos nyid do/ /thams cad mi dmigs de bzhin yin/ /kun kyang dbyer med chos phyag rgya/ /mi dmigs sgyu ma kun nas mnar/ /rtog pa kun nas mnar sems te/ /chos nyid sgyu ma mi dmigs te/ /chos nyid sgyu ma mi dmigs phyir/ /don dam kun rdzob ro gcig ste / /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bsgyur na/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /mi dmigs kun nas mnar sems pa/ /'dul ba'i bya ba bsam mi khyab/ /gsung gi phyag rgya chen po'o/ /zhe sdang spyi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /yang dag nyid kyis rab brtags na/ /rnam par byang ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /gnyis med zhe sdang spang du med/ /nga rgyal mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ /khong nas 'gying zhing khengs sems pa/ /pha rol zil gyis gnon par byed/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid bshad pa ni//mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /nga rgyal spangs nas zhi bsgrub med/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pas/ /kun rdzob sgyu mar khong 'gying nyid(5)/ /de 102—693

bzhin nyid las mi gzhan te/ /chos nyid mi dmigs 'gying bar skyes/ /skye 'gying nyid na chos nyid de/ /'gying ba'i rang bzhin mi dmigs dag /'gying dang mi 'gying dbyer med phyir/ /chos sku phyag rgya chen po yin/ /mi dmigs pa nyid sgyu ma 'gying / /'gying bas zil gyis gnon pa nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings las mi gzhan te/ /sgyu ma chos nyid dbyer med phyir/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyi ga 6)gcig /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang sgyur ②na/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po yin / /mi dmigs sgyu mar 'gying ba ni/ /nga rgyal 'dul ba bsam mi khyab/ /gsung gi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /nga rgyal rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rnam par byang ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ /zhi bsgrub (ming rgyal spang du med/ /'dod chags rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ /srid ④pa kun la zhen pa ste/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /chags spangs dum chags bsgrub tu med/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig phyir/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /'dod cing chags pa sgyu ma srid/ /mi dmigs pa las mi gzhan phyir / /mi dmigs de nyid sgyu mar skyes/ /chos rnams bdag las mi yigazhan phyir / /mi dmigs de nyid sgyu mar skyes/ /spyod pa sgyu ma ro gcig phyir/ /chos nyid chos can dmigs su med/ /rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med pa'i/ /chos kyi sku yi phyag rgya yin/ /mi dmigs sgyu mar 'dod cing chags/ /'dod chags chos nyid mi dmigs te/ /sgyu ma mi dmigs dbyer med phyir/ /bden pa gnyi gar po dbyer med gcig /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bsgyur na/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /mi dmigs dbyings nyid 'dod chags spros pa ni/ /'dul ba bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /gsung gi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /'dod 102—694

chags rang dang spyi yi mtshan/ /rnam par byang ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ /chags dang ma chags gnyis med pas/ /'dod chags mtshan nyid spang du med/ /phrag dog kun gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa la/ /sems dog rtog pa sgyu ma gzhan/ /thabs kyis sbyor ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can/ /phrag dog spyi mtshan bshad pa ni/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /phrag dog spang zhing yangs 6)bsgrub med/ /chos nyid du ni ro gcig phyir/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma gzhan gyi phun sum la/ /phrag dog rtog pa sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid/ /mi dmigs pa las mi gzhan te/ /mi dmigs pa nyid sgyu mar skyes/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i lhag par sbyor ba yi/ /thabs kyi rtogs pa sgyu ma'i chos nyid de/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang chadabyer med pas/ /chos sku phyag rgya chen po yin/ /mi dmigs sgyu ma gzhan gyi phun sum la/ /phrag dog rtog par 'dzin pa dang / /rtog dang phrag dog mi dmigs te/ /sgyu ma mi dmigs dbyer med pa'i/ /bden pa gnyi gar laro gcig pas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi (shedabang bsgyur du na/ /thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /mi dmigs gzhan gyi phun sum la/ /phrag dog rnam par spros pa (6)ni/ /gdul ba'i bya ba bsam mi khyab/ /gsung ⑦gi phyag rgya chen po yin/ /phrag dog rang dang spyi bstan 93)pa/ /rnam par byang ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ /dog pa spang zhing yangs (9)bsgrub med/ /sems can rnam pa mang po kun / /nang gi chen tsopo lnga sogs bstan/ /rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya / /thabs dang shes rab ma rtogs pas/ /ma grol khams gsum 'khor ba yin / /de ltar nges par ci mthong na/ /sngags kyis yongs su zin pa'i nad/ /kun la gnod par byed mi nus/ /de bzhin thabs dang shes rab rtogs/ /102wa 695

dug gsum sdug bsngal gnod mi 'gyur/ /thabs la mkhas pas ①ma zin na/ /lam gyi dge spyad ②stegs bcas kyang / /mtho ris lha dang mi ru skyes/ /skye shi med pa'i sa mi thob/ /thabs mkhas snying rjes zin pa ni/ /mtshams med sems can ma lus (7kun/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rjes bsad/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob/ /ma bsad na yang sems can yal bor te/ /snying rje med de sdig yod 'gyur/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog chen po dag /gang phyir byang chub sems de ni/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs par gsal/ /nyon mongs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs/ /ngo bo yin par gsal por gsungs/ /chos kun rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba yongs su dag par 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs thams cad byang chub rgyu/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin bdag med pas/ /de phyir de bzhin gshegs bsam yas/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur pas/ /phyin ci log nyid byang chub lam/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi dmigs phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa yod ma yin/ /gsang sngags bla na med pa yi/ /thabs kyis stiji ltar zin bzhin 'grub/ /bsam gyis mi khyab nges pa med/ /don dam cir yang ma grub la/ /sgyu ma'i sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /thabs chen dag gis zin pa ni⑤/ /nyon mongs lam yang rnam par grol/ /thabs chen dag gis ma zin na/ /dge ba spyad kyang grol mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor don dam ldan pa yis/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba'i chos spyad kyang / /rnam par grol (6)bar 'gyur ba yin/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ / gnyi ga (77yod pa ma yin pas/ /'khor ba yongs su shes pas na/ /de ni mya ngan 'das pa'i mtha'/ /nyon mongs phyin ci log 102—696

rnams dag /thabs la mkhas pas zin 'gyur ①yang / /grol la (mithar bar mi 'gyur na/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis bya byed kun/ /rngon dang smad 'tshong ③ston pa'ang ltung / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod tshul bzang / /phal la med pas mi rung na/ /sngags mchog shin tu zab pa yibyam/ /skye bo kun gyis bya bar phyi'abyung / /bdud rtsi dang du blang ⑥bar gsungs / /mnyam dang mi mnyam dbyer med na/ /sku gsung rdo rje dbang thob 'gyurag / /grub pa'i rdzas su de phyir gsungs/ /shes rab mnyam pa ma rtogs ⑧na / /byol song la la chos dang ldan 'gyur ⑨yang / /drang srong 'tsho dang rtag mthun dang / /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du 'dod pa spong byed pa/ /de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs su dag pa yi/ /rnam bzhi tshul gyis don rtogs mngon/ /rgyu rnams rang bzhin dag pa dang / /'bras bu yongs su dag 'gyur te/ /rgyu yi mtshan nyid rnam par dag /phyi rol chen po lnga rnams te/ /sems nyid gzung ⑩'dzin gnyis snang ba/ /gzung (1ba'i yul nyid 'byung ba che/ /rgyud nyid rang gi sems yin pas/ /'byung ba chen po rgyu las dag /'bras bu yongs su dag pa ni/ /sems can kun gyi rus pa ste/ /rdo rje byang chub sems yin te/ /sha ni pad+ma rak+ta yin/ /dri chen dri chu gur gum 8chu/ /so so'i lus la gnas pas dag /don dam dmigs med dag pas ni/ /phyi nang chos rnams thams cad kyang / /gang gi ngo bo ma yin te/ /skye 'gag med pas ye nas dag /kun rdzob ye nas dag pa ni/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin thams cad snang / /chu zla'i tshul du mi dmigs gnas/ /mi dmigs pa nyid 8sna tshogs snang / /de bzhin gshegs par ye nas mnyam/ /de bas gtsang sme med 102—697

par spyod/ /sems can rtog pa bzlog phyir sman/ /gtso ru dang du blang bar bya /de bas sems can phyin ci log /chos rnams thams cad dag par ma shes te/ /thabs dang shes rab don ma rtogs/ /kha cig gis ni 'tsho ba'i bar du zos/ /kha cig gis ni drang srong hu)ji bzhin du/ /sha spangs rtswa dang chu la zos/ /zos ②kyang ma grub don ma rtogs / /rnal 'byor thabs ldan rnams kyis ni/ /rang bzhin yongs kyis dag pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings kyis rab rtogs pas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel hu)pa yi/ /the tshom med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /dngos dang dngos med rtogs pa mtshan/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang rtogs pa mtshan//mtshan ma nyid kyang rnam spangs te/ /mkhyen pas dbul la gnas mi 'gyur/ /bsgrub (51pa'i rdzas su yang dag gsungs/ /byang chub sems dang sha chen dang / /dri chen dri chu rak+ta dag /sgrub pa pos ni nan tan bya/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po 'grub/ /tshe la dbang dang rig pa 'dzin/ /mkha' la 'phyo dang thogs med 'grub/ /mthar ni skye med rdo rje yis/ /gzhan yang ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin / /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gsang ba'i snying po'i don nyid kyis / /yi dam mi spang rtag bsgom zhing / /ye nas lha yi mtshan nyid ni/ /dus gsum gshegs pa thams cad kyitsho67/ /lha spangs dge spyad don med 'gyur/ /lha ni mi spang don nyid ni/ /lhun grub ye shes thams cad kyi/ /bdag dang gnyis med so so ma yin pa'i/ /dus gsum bder tsho cigashegs dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bdag po ste/ /yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa'i don / /dkon mchog gsum spangs tshangs par spyad pa'i (nyadon med 'gyur/ /bdag nyid lha dang mnyam sbyor na/ /yon tan chung yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /102—698

ye nas mnyam nyid sbyor nas su/ /lha nyid du ni rtag tu bsgom/ /bder ①gshegs kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sku gsung ye shes lnga rdzogs grub/ /rdo rje slob dpon smad ②mi bya/ /byang chub ston ①pa 'dren pa po/ /long ba dmigs bu 'dren dang 'dra/ /nyon ④mongs sdug bsngal mtsho skems (9yin/ /slob dpon de la smod ⑥pa ni/ /dpen na mun khung sgron bsad na/ /mthong ba'i don ni mi rtogs bzhin/ /sdug bsngal nyam ⑥thag yun rings suphyi/ /bskal pa mang por myong bar mngon/ /de bas de la gus pa rtag tu gyis/ /lus la dbang ba'i rgyal po bas/ /shin tu gtso bor blang bar bya/ /drin chags bskyed pa'i pha ma bas/ /shin tu lhag pa'i ri mo bya/ /rdo rje mched dang lcam dral ni/ /bla med byang chub zhing 'gro ba'i/ /chos nyid dam tshig smon lam mthus/ /byang chub rin chen sar nges pas/ /de la ldog cing 'khu ba ni/ /rang la rang gis mtshon btab na / /rang srog tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar/ /rang gis srog gcod ṇiphung bar 'gyur / /tshe 'di mi bde sna tshogs pa/ /mi bde bzhin du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu yang / /ngan song gsum dang mi khom pa'i/ /sdug bsngal kha brgyud yimyong bar 'gyur/ /yun ring yirtag tu mi thar ba'i/ /shin tu nyam tu)thag myong bar 'gyur/ /grub pa gcig bzhin lhan cig spyod/ /gnyis med dad pas rjes spyod spun/ /bder 4snyegashegs dkyil 'khor bla med yin/ /shes rab gsal bas rtag tu gdung 8/ /zhes gsungs/ gsang ba gzhan la mi bsgrags shing / /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig 8rnams/ /rnal 'byor mnyam pa rnam gnyis kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel rtogs nas/ /mnyam pa'i spyod pas la yidor te/ /phul dang mi 'dra yang dag rtogs/ /ma rtogs pa yi phyogs 102—699

rnams dang / /skye bo kun la rab tu gsang / /gsang ba'i brda ngag ①sna tshogs gsungs/ /thabs la mkhas pas byas pa yin/ /gsang sngags skyon yod ma yin te/ /thugs rje chen po ②thabs mkhas kyis/ /snod ma yin dang blo rtul ②rnams / /las 'phro ngan pa'i don phyir gsang / /brgya la gang zhig gsang don 'di / /las 'phro ngan la bsgrags 'gyur phyin/ /dper na gtsub 6)shing mes gtsubs yinas/ /gtsub 9)shing nyid kyang 'tshig par snang / /gzhan yang tshig par gyur pa bzhin/ /chos don bzang po me dang 'dra/ /skal ⑧ba chung zhing yonyeshes rab dman⑩/ /blo ngan rgyu 'bras rmongs pa rnams/ /mnyam pa nyid la skur ( spe'adebs pas/ /ngan song gsum du 'phangs par 'gyur/ /gsang don ma rtogs sdug bsngal myong 'gyur 7na/ /gsang ba 'phel bar byed pa yang /smra byed lce la zhing rmo zhing / /sdug bsngal chen po myong bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sems can don phyir gsang / /rlung phyogs tsam du'ang 1stebarjod mi bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcada')/ /sngags zhes rab tu bsgrags pa ni/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pa'i/ /mnyam pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge oṃ/ /de la sogs pa bzhi bcu gnyis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gshegs pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga/ /bdag dang dbyer med phyag rgya che/ /gsal la brtson pa'i yon tan ldan/ /yid bzhin ma chags dbang bskur te/ /goms shing brtan par bya ba yin/ /de bas bar chad brtson med na/ /dper na sa bon tshig pa las/ /'bras bu 'dod pa dang 'dra ste/ /bsgrub skepa 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /mi khom 'khor bar gnas 'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor chen po la zhugs pas/ /phyi 102—700

nang chos rnams thams cad la/ /dmigs med gcig dang du mar bral /mtha' dbus gang yang ma yin pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid med mtshan nyid med/ /mnyam pa'i phyag rgya chen po yis/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad 6)dang / /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /yon tan skyon rnams skye 'gag med/ /gang gi ngo bor ma grub mnyam/ /kun rdzob chos rnams skye 'gag med/ /mi dmigs gang gi gingo bo minani/ /chu zla'i tshul du sna tshogs par/ /snang zhing bya ba byed nus pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen po'i phyogs bcu dang / /dus gsum khams gsum thams cad dang / /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das/ /yon tan skyon rnams thams cad dang / /sgyu mar mnyam par ye nas gnas/ /sngags 'chang rgyal por lirtogs byas nas/ /bdag nyid chos nyid skye 'gag med/ /ngang las ma g.yos par gnas na/ /phyag rgya chen po thams cad kyang / /rdzogs par phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /thams cad dbyer med ye mnyam la/ /ma 'dres rgya ri yongs ma chad pa'i/ /gzhal yas khang dang nyi zla yi/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings chen rdzogs par bsgom / /de ltar dam tshig 'di gsum ste/ /de la gnas na 'grub (6)par 'gyur / /yan lag ma nyams sngags bzlas shing / /'dod pa kun la longs spyod bya/ /lus dang ngag sems brtan 'gyur (7༄na/ /byang chub rab 'byam (mithob par 'gyur/ /dam tshig chen po las 'das natso)/ /nyen ni shin tu che bar gsungs / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi spyod pa don bsgrub yi )pa/ /rmongs pas gal te 'das byas na/ /de mi 0mesrog kyang der zad 102—701

'gyur / /dam tshig bsrungs dang sngags ①bzlas dang / /phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad ②pa bzhil/ /brtson 'grus che zhing brtan pas gzung ④/ /rnal 'byor brtson 'grus chung 'gyur phyin/ /mi 'grub nyen yang che bar gsungs/ /ji ltar ral gyi ⑥so la nan tan du/ /skyes bus 7myur du ma bzung na/ /lag pa nges par chod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nan tan med pa'i gsang sngags pal/ /'chi 'am yang na 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dam pa rnams kyis ni/ /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams gsal/ /don dam ma nyams dag byas shing / /brtson 'grus cher bskyed khyimyur bar 'grub/ /sngags bsgom ma nyams phyag rgya gsal/ /cho ga yo byad gtsor ma gsungs/ /tshogs na yang ni nyes pa med/ /ma tshogs na yang nyes pa med/ /ma tshogs na yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rang gi ⑩lhar sbyor bas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /cho ga lhag gam ma tshang na'ang / /'grub par 'gyur te nyes skyon med/ /ces (nyegasang ba'i tshig tu'o / /dam tshig sum brgya pa rtsa ba bco yonyelnga mdo tsobashad pa'i le'u ste drug cu 8brgyad pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa chen pos bzhugs gnas dang / spyod lam dang / lta stangs bstan pa/ theg pa chen po 7lhun grub don 'dod na/ /rgya 8chen zab yangs shes rab myur/ /zab pa'i don rtogs mi ldog bde/ /nga dang bdag med yangs pa bde/ /gnas su chos dbyings gnyis med bstan/ /thabs chen kun mdzad 'od gsal byams/ /thams cad dgyes mdzad dbyings ma gtum/ /che chung byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor/ /g.yog 'khor lha srin sde 102—702

mang gtso/ /bdag gi mtshan gzugs shin tu spags/ /chos dbyings mkha' dkyil yangs pa la/ /shes rab myur du don hu)'gro ba/ /'gro med 'ong med mi gnas pa/ /byang chub sems mchog a re bde/ /shes rab zad med dkyil 'khor la/ /thugs rje rol pa'i ye shes 'phyo/ /gnyis med dbyings sbyor a re bde / /ma rig 'khrul pa'i 'dam dbyings su/ /ye shes sgron ma'i (nyamada' 'phangs nas/ /gti mug mun pa rnam (0bsal te/ /rang bzhin ④'od gsal bde ba'i mchog /dge dang mi dge gnyis su med/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma yong mi (nya'adzin/ /rang bzhin ye nas 'od gsal ba'i/ /dge sdig med pas shin tu bde / /bde dang mi bde gnyis med pas/ /ye shes chags med rnam par dag /thams cad dbyer med ye shes yin/ /sems nyid dang bas a re bde/ /rgyan du dkyil 'khor thams cad mdzes/ /ye shes rgyu las grub pa yi/ /phyi nang sgrib med gsal ba'i ngang / /ye shes blo brtan shin tu bde/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad la/ /gtsang dang sme ba'i blo mi 'dzin/ /thams cad chos nyid ro gcig pas/ /gnyis med pas ni shin tu bde/ /shes rab chung chen ting 'dzin gyis/ /thams cad ma nor gzhung lugs bzhin/ /'khor ba ma spangs sdug bsngal med/ /gnyis med tshim pas a re bde/ /thams cad ma lus gcig pa'i ngang / /lta dang lta ba gnyi ga (6)med/ /ye shes sgron ma bsgreng bar ni / /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad mthong / /'di dang pha rol gnyis med phyir/ /'gro dang 'gro bar bya ba min/ /yan lag stabs 57)chen ma mchongs par / /phyogs bcu stong khams thams cad na/ /thub mchog ston pa'i spyod yul ni / /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /chos rnams thams cad dmigs su 102—703

med / /chos nyid sgyu ma cir yang 'grub/ /zag med zab pas don brtags ①na / /dag par ma gyur ②gang yang med/ /ye shes ma bcos kun du gsal/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'o/ /ye nas de ltar gnas mod kyang / /ma rig rmongs pa'i ling tog gis/ /gsal ba'i sgron ma bsgribs gyur te/ /khams gsum mun nag rgyun du 'khor/ /rnam rtog mtshan mar 'dzin pa yis/ /lus dang longs spyod gnas dang ni/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /de la su zhig byed pa yod/ /yang dag mthu chen sus ma byas/ /rang la rang gis bcings par zadal/ /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /snying po yod pa ma yin te / /sgyu ma mig yor sprul pa dang / /smig rgyu 'ja' tshon rtsichu zla'i tshul/ /de ltar gang gis rab rtogs pa/ /de nyid sangs rgyas yin par bshad/ /sangs rgyas sa la gnas pa yin/ /skye med phun sum tshogs yin te/ /byed med pa yi mchog kyang rdzogs/ /zhes nyid la nyid brjod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las bzhugs ga nas khang pa bstan pa'i le'u ste drug cu rgyadagu pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mi 'chi ba'i rdo rje bsgrub ⑥pa 'di gsungs so/ /rdo rje zhing chen bsgrub 'dod pas/ /thams cad skye shi med pa'i tshul/ /mnyam nyid dag pa nyid du bsgom/ /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yicha/ /dzaḥlha baṃ hos dgug par bya/ /bdag dang khro bo gnyis med par/ /yang nas yang du bsgrub par bya/ /sku rnams gsal bar gyur pa dang / /zhing chen 'og tu gzhug 987par bya/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus der bkod nas/ /khro bo khro mo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom99/ /mngag 7pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur gtong yonya/ /thams cad ma 102—704

lus dbang du sdud0)/ /bsgrub ②pa gcig gam yang na gnyis/ /gsum dang lnga ru bsgom par bya/ /pho nya mang pos dz+ra ①bkug nas/ /zhing la yang nas yang du gzhug /snar dang ser dang mdog snum 'byung / /de nas bdud rtsi'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /lan grangs 'bum phrag mang por ni/ /bzlas pa'i tshul yang rnam gsum dag /rdo rje sngags ④bzlas rtse mo gsum/ /de yi bar nas bzlas pa 'byung / /'od zer lnga dang ldan par bya/ /zhing de ldem ldem por gyur dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis bskul bar bya/ /de nas yi ge 'bru lnga dgod/ /gsal zhing 'tsher (snyebar bsgom ⑥par bya/ /dbang po lnga dang dbang po'i tshul/ /yan lag lnga la rigs lnga'i tshul/ /rdo rje ting 'dzin de yis bsgom/ /de nas zhing de 'gul 'gyur ( )nas/ /zhing de drag tu 'gul ba dang / /shin tu zhags pas bsdam po)par bya/ /yan lag rnams kyang gzhum 6nyepar bya/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu thod pa bstan7/ /ha ya shrī 4nyaba'i skur bsgoms shing / /sngags ni 'bum phrag mang du bzlas/ /phyogs bcur spro zhing zhing la bstim/ /de nas zhing de drag 'gul nas/ /rdo rje ting 'dzin de yis ni/ /brtan pa nyid du bsgom par bya /de nas par par byed pa dang / /a mṛ pri 8du gang yin pa/ /rdo rje drag tu bdeg 4)cing dbab/ /thod pa'i kha nas mṛ 8phyung nas/ /rdo rje ting 'dzin so yis gcad7/ /rdo rje sngags zos khong du bstim/ /gnyis su med par bsgom par bya/ /de nas zhing de langs pa dang / /rdo rje dbyings nas dbang yang bskung tso/ /bdud rtsi chu yang blud par bya/ /las rnams thams cad byed du gzhug /zhing des rab tu smras pa'i tshig /dpa' bo ci bgyi mi rgas skye med chos rnams dang / /las rnams ma lus kun bgyid do/ /de ltar bsgrub the pa'i 102—705

rigs mchog gis0)/ /thal ba thams cad sos par 'gyur/ /bsgrub ②pa'i sa ni dur khrod dang / /ri brags gnyen ①po bgegs gnas dang / /nags khrod stong pa tsher ma can/ /ri bos bskor ba'i lcug ma can/ /rab tu rnam par dben pa dang / /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de dag tu ni bsgrub par bya/ /dgu dang bcu gnyis bcu gsum dang / /bcu drug man chad bsgrub par bya/ /the tshom med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyi nang 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams / /lam lnga'i zhing dang sman lngar bcas/ /'bru rnams thams cad bcang bar bya/ /rtag tu tshogs chen mchod par bya/ /gsum dang lnga ru bar mi gcad④ / /kha zas rnams kyang thod par bza'/ /btung ba dag kyang de bzhin te / /mar me rtag par gtang 'a)bar bya/ /rgyu ni dz+ra ⑥yi mar las bya yan lag bsku ba'ang 9)de bzhin to/ /sdong bu pad+ma'i rgyu las bya/ /snod ( ni dung chen srubs 99)med pa/ /lcang lo 7yod dang med kyang rung / /de byi bu tra ma byung ba/ /mdog ni ban lang can la yod/ /rdo rje bsgrub 31pa bar gcod phyir/ /rtag tu mtshams ni gcad nyartepar bya/ /dṛ 1 yi rkang pa g.yas g.yon nas/ /sbom po ma yin phra ba nyid/ /de la ki la ya byas nas/ /phur bu'i sngags dang khro sngags kyis / /lan 'bum du ni bzlas par kha7bya/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon thal sor la/ /khro bo bcu dang khro mo bcu/ /'od 'bar gzungs kyi sku ru bsgom/ /de nas gnyis med sbyor tshul du/ /sgrub po rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /sgrub 7pa dngos la ma gtogs 7pa/ /phyogs bcu rnams su mtshams kyang gcadanya tsho/ /dngos grub ma thob bar du ni/ /bsgom 1snyedang bzlas dang phyag rgya gsum/ /bag yod mgo la me 'bar bzhin/ /bar mtshams med par bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar sgrub 9/tepa'i 102wa 706

rigs mchog gis/ /lha ma srin rnams bran bzhin 'khol/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dbang du sdud①/ /rdo rje rigs mchog 'khor rkyen rnams/ /yid bzhin du ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'di dag ni/ /lus sbed nus nas mngon du dbyung ②/ /de ma yin par shin tu gsang / /sku'i sgrub ①pa nges pa'i don du bka' stsal to/ /ro langs bsgrub dupa'i le'u ste bdun cu ⑤pa'o// //gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bro ⑥gar rtse 'jo bro gar gyi dam tshig ces bya ba nges par ched du brjod pa 'di ⑦brjod do/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas dus bzhi yi/ /thams cad dbyer med maṇ+ḍa la'i/ /nyi zla shar ba'i gzhal yas la/ /pad+ma chags med gdan bting ⑧nas/ /rin chen zad med pho brang sa/ /che chung dpag tu med pa yi/ /byang chub bde ldan dkyil 'khor la/ /bde ldan byang chub rab bkod nas/ /ma lus kun bsdus dbyings bsdus te/ /lus bskyod yan lag bsgul bsigs 6)dang / /dbang po lnga yi lta spyod kun/ /phyag rgya chen po yin par bshad/ /gong gi dkyil 'khor tshad nyi zla/ /mi ⑩ 'khrugs pa yi yis gzhi la/ /pad+ma ma chags gdan bting nas/ /thabs dang shes rab chags med tshul/ /yan lag dbang po thams cad kun/ /rang bzhin yongs su dag pa dang / /ting 'dzin de bzhin gshegs lnga'o/ /ye nas ma bcings yongs kyis te/ /lhag pa'i ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor/ /yan lag bzhi la rigs bzhi 'khor/ /kha dog dbyibs dang phyag rgya dang / /thabs dang shes rab gsal bsgoms te/ /phyogs bcur spro zhing ngan tu song sbyong / /gnas su bsdu zhing dkyil 'khor spro/ /'das 102—707

dang ma 'das thams cad kun/ /bder gshegs zhing du rnam par sbyor/ /yan lag chen po lnga bskyod na4)/ /rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ma lus g.yo/ /'gro lnga byang chub lam du mdzad/ /snyigs ma lnga yang rnam par dag /bzang mdzes legs pa'i gos bgos nanano/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bar 'gyur(gu/ /de nas mthar thug med pa'i bar/ /ye shes (gelnga yis brgyan (5)par 'gyur/ /skyes bu blo rtsal rab ldan pas/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor de ltar bsgom/ /tshig tsam (6)ma yin blo gting du/ /bdag dang dbyer med nyid du'o/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur nas/ /shar gyi phyogs su kha bstan te/ /seng ge'i stabs chen mchong bar ⑦bya / /ljags kyi yi ge tram̐ bsgoms la/ /lce ni 'bum phrag bsam yas dang / /hri (kyiyang bsam gyis mi khyab spro/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi bsam yas su/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /gsung gcig dkyil 'khor yan lag ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab kun du grags/ /sgra dang ming tshig so sor gsal/ /ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas gsungs/ /thar dang ma thar gnyi ga (9)brjod/ /nges pa kho 7na yang dag tu/ /de bzhin nyid kyis yong ma gsungs/ /sna yi dbang po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /traṃ gi yig 'bru gsal bsgoms nas/ /dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu dus bzhi yi/ /mtha' yas bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /traṃ yang bsams pas nyanya'od 'phro 'bar/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor ma lus thos(gye/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas kyang thos/ / sgra dang tsho thos pa gnyis med pa'o/ /de bzhin dri dang ro reg rnams/ /so so'i mtshan nyid gsal bsgoms nas/ /yig 'bru'i snying po de bzhin dgod/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus dang / /'gro drug ma lus thams cad sa kun/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis rol/ /dri 102—708

la sogs pa bde mchog gis/ /kun la tshim par yang dag mchod/ /'gro drug ma lus thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'tsham yonyepa'i don yang byed/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes de ltar ston/ /de bzhin rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs/ /ma chags la sogs shes rab ldan/ /gtso bo lnga dang gtso mo lnga/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan bsgoms te/ /tshom bu gcig gam yang na gsum/ /lnga yi dkyil 'khor rab bsgoms te/ /thabs dang shes rab phan tshun du/ /lha gsal 'od 'phro bstim (mibyas te/ /dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar bar bsgom/ /ting 'dzin shin tu gsal gyur nas/ /bdag dang phyogs bcu (kyedabyer med par/ /gnyis su med par bsgom par bya'o54)/ /de nas thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /lta spyod ya char ma gyur par(5)/ /dkyil 'khor dag la gsal bsgoms 6)na/ /dbus nas shar phyogs kha bstan nas/ /rkang pa'i stabs chen bskyod zhu byas shing / /lag gi 'du byed kun bskyod nas/ /bro dang gar gyi phyag rgyar bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'od zer dkar 'phro ba she/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dag /shin tu gsal dang 'od zer 'bar/ /thabs dang shes rab de grub shog /cis kyang mi tshugs rdo rje yis(9)/ /bdud bzhi dag ni 'joms 7par byed/ /theg mchog rdo rje'i rig (1)'dzin pa/ /thabs dang shes rab de grub shog /bdag nyid rigs sna pa'i rdo rje yis / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal med par shog /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab gsal 'gyur /geshog /nyon mongs sdug bsngal rtsad tsobacad nas / /ma rig mun pa med par byed/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer nyi shar bsake/ /thabs dang shes rab 'od 'bar shog /shin tu sra 7zhing skye shi med/ /rdo rje'i zha thugs rje rol ston pa/ /'gro la thugs rje yongs kyis 'byung / /thabs dang 102—709

shes rab byams ldan shog /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur pas/ /yon tan phyogs su kha bstan te/ /lus bskyod yan lag bskul bsigs nas/ /stobs chen dag kyang brdung bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus 'byung ba'i gter/ /zad med nor bu rin po che/ /ma lus kun gyi re ba skong 0)/ /thabs dang shes rab de grub shog /nam mkha'i dkyil gyi mdog bstan pa/ /yang na thams cad gser btso ma/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas zad mi shes/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /yon tan rin chen bsam yas kyang / /thams cad mnyam pa'i ngang gnas nas/ /de bzhin mnyam nyid ye shes te/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam 'gyur gshog /bder gshegs yon tan rmad po che/ /ye srinas chags med byang chub zhing / /yang dag nyid du thams cad gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur pas/ /nub phyogs su ni kha bltas nas/ /yan lag dang po bskyod byas te/ /gar rnams shin tu gsal byas nas/ /stobs chen dag kyang brdung bar bya/ /chos rnams ma lus kun spyod kyang / /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin no/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis gnas//thabs dang shes rab de grub shog /las dang nyon mongs nub 'gyur ba'ili/ /bag chags mtshan ma rdul tsam med95)/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /byang chub chags med dkyil 'khor ni/ /gang nas ma 'ongs nyid kyi (6)dbyings/ /mi gnas tshul gyis dbyings na bzhugs/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur pas/ /byang phyogs su ni kha bltas te/ /lus bskyod yan lag gar byed cing / /phyag rgya so sor gsal gyur nas/ /rkang pa'i stabs chen brdung bar bya/ /yang dag rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /bskal pa 102—710

bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /sgrib pa thams cad byang byas te①/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs ②kyis/ /bdud bzhi bcom nas mi mthun bsal①/ /bya byed med la don rnams grub/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /thams cad ma lus rdzogs byed pa/ /sna tshogs kun du ༅'gyur ba'o/ /ljang gu'i ⑤tsal du mdog bstan pa/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /thams cad ma lus don grub pa/ /las rnams ma lus rdzogs par byed/ /nan tan chen po bya ba rdzogs(kye/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /sdug bsngal dra ba tshar bcad de/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus kun byas kyang / /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub shog /bder ⑦gshegs ma lus thams cad kun/ /phyogs dus kun du bdag nyid che/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /thabs chen dkyil 'khor yang dag pas/ /bder gshegs kun la rnam par 'phro//thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi9)/ /bde ba'i dkyil 'khor mkhas pas bsdu/ /thams cad ma lus rigs bzhi yi/ /nang du ma 'dus 6)gang yang med/ /de nyid bder yigashegs dkyil 'khor nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab bde grub shog /rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor dbur bsdu zhing / /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro /phyogs bcu gsal bar gang gyur nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'od 'bar shog /de bzhin rigs mchog 'dzin pa yi/ /thams cad ma lus dbyings bsdus te/ /thams cad kun du bzang por ston/ /thabs dang shes rab gtsor grub shog /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs 61 kyis/ /phyogs dus gnas pa ma lus la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog 'grub nyi shog /102—711

'gro ba ma lus thams cad la/ /de bzhin nyid kyi sku yod pas/ /ma mthong rmongs la nam mkha'i mdog /thabs dang shes rab dbyings grub shog /sku ni sna tshogs cir yang snang / /thabs rkyen01rnams la mnyam pa'i tshul/ /nyan thos rnams la dgra bcom tshul/ /rang rgyal rnams la bse ru'i tshul/ /pha rol phyin rdzogs shākya'i tshul/ /lha mi rnams la dge bcu (getshul/ /dud 'gro rnams la e na ya(kye/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin du ston/ /de lta bu yi sku ston pa/ /thabs dang shes rab sku grub shog /thabs dang shes rab ldan bsgoms nas/ /rgyan lnga yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /yan lag lnga la dkyil 'khor bkod/ /ye shes rgyan gyis (7pho brang brdung / /gnyis med dkyil 'khor skum po'i tshul/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lhun grub tshogs chen byang chub tu/ /thabs dang shes rab myur grub (5)shog /chos dbyings dam pa bdag med pa/ /mi dmigs dbyings su ma lus 'dus/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam dbyer med pas/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyings grub shog /bder (57gshegs dkyil 'khor dbu bskyod na/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams ma lus g.yo / /lag gi 'du byed bskul bskyod na/ /rig 97)'dzin zhing khams dag par byed/ /rkang chen dag gis stabs mchongs ri tshon/ /'gro drug gnas rnams stongs par byed/ /spyan gyis phyogs bcu blta byas na/ /bdud bzhi dpung rnams pham par byed/ /thabs dang shes rab ma lus kun/ /de lta bu yi don grub shog /thams cad ma lus de bzhin te/ /de ni gang yang mi dmigs la/ /skye dang 'gag 9tshodang gnas pa dang / /'ong dang yo 7'gro ba'i dngos po med/ /rnal 'byor bro gar rtse 'jo yi11/ /sna tshogs byed la byas pa med/ /de nyid rnam 102—712

pa sna tshogs pa/ /rnal 'byor las rnams grub par shog /thabs dang shes rab thams cad kyis/ /de lta bu yis 6)longs spyod na/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum 'gro rnams thams cad la②/ /dga' ba chen pos khyab par 'gyur/ /lus ma spangs par rig 'dzin sa/ /yun rings chos kyi bde spyad nas/ /bla med rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /dpe byad mtshan gyis rnam par brgyan / /mngon shes drug ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par rol/ /sangs rgyas zhing la dbang sgyur ④te/ /spyod yul kun du maṇ+ḍa la/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /'di lta bu yi las rnams bya/ /'bras bu mngon du ma gyur kyang / /lus ngag yid la dbang thob nas/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang skar ⑤mi 'gyur/ /theg pa dman par yong mi skyes// /ngan song gsum du yong mi ltung / /gnas ngan longs spyod mi bde ba'i/ /ngan pa'i sa ru yong mi ltung / /rdo rje theg mchog brjed ( mi 'gyur/ /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /lus byad bzang zhing yan lag rdzogs/ /dbang po tshang zhing lhag chad med/ /skad gdangs snyan cing (8)'gro don byed/ /bdag gi longs spyod thams cad kun/ /gzhan la gnod pa med par 'grub/ /tshan po che yi mthu stobs ldan/ /'gro ba'i don du yang dag byed/ /gzhan la gnod pa yang po)mi byed/ /snying rje che zhing shes rab ldan / /mthu stobs che zhing thabs ldan pa(7/ /bdag dang gzhan don rdzogs par spyod6me/ /mthar ni skye shi med pa'i sa/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rin po che/ /bkod pa'i gzhal yas thams cad la/ /dbang sgyur tu spyod pa'i dngos grub thob//rnal 'byor gang zhig 'di 'dra'i don/ /ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas ni/ /102—713

gsang don nges pa'i don ston pa/ /bla med mchog tu grub par shog /dbyer med byang chub thor tshugs can/ /shin tu bstan pa'i ri bo gnas/ /mu stegs rlung gis tshugs mi 'gyur/ /theg mchog rdo rje de lta bu/ /dkyil 'khor mi zad 'byung ba'i gter/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /byi dor ma 6)byas shin tu gsal / /bskal pa grangs med gnas bcas kyang / /sku ni shin tu gzhon pa'i tshul / /skye shi med pa ༷kyerdo rje yi/ /thams cad 'byung ①ba'i gter yin te/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs dang ldan/ /bla med byang chub 'grub gyur snyunas/ /ye shes rdo rje lhun grub shog /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs gyur cig /thams cad kun gyi ston pa po/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ /sangs rgyas zhing la dbang byed shog /de rtogs kun kyang rdo rje'i rigs/ /sku gsung thugs kyang grub par shog /rnal 'byor pa thabs (51dang shes rab dang (5)ldan pa rnams kyis(7/ dus thams cad 'dod yon lnga spyod cing bro thabs bya'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las bro gar rtse 'jo'i le'u ste bdun cu (nyagacig pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon du phyung ste 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings ldan las(9)/ /sgyu dang dra ba 'brel 'gyur 7nas/ /sku mchog rdo rje 'od snang bas / /mthun pa'i rdo rje rang snang ngo / /rgyud drug 'khor ba'i lus snang ba/ /rnam rtog mthun pa'i las snang ngo / /de bzhin sku mchog dri bral dang / /bde 6megashegs sku lngar mdor bsdus te/ /bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub gzugs/ /102—714

bla med gzugs dang rdo rje sku/ /de la sogs te sku bsam yas/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi sku ston pa/ /thabs kyis 'gro 'dul sku ston te/ /byang chub mchog gi rdo rje sku/ /chags med zhing du sku ston cing / /dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du snang / /sku ①snang de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /rnam dag sku ston ma yin te/ /log 'gro rtog pa thams cad la/ /so sor 'dul ba'i skur yang ston/ /de tshe skye shi med pa'i sku/ /las dang ma chags pad+ma'i sku/ /thar dang ma thar sna tshogs kyang ⑧/ /sna tshogs snang la gnas pa med/ /snang dang mi snang gnyi ga ①med/ /de ltar rtogs ④pa'i rigs mchog ni/ /badz+ra zhes ni gdags pa yin/ /ji snyed sku ston bsam yas pa/ /thams cad ma phyilus rdo rjer bsdus/ /'khor lo zhes kyang brjod pa ni/ /de la sogs te sku bsam yas/ /byang chub thabs kyi dkyil nas gyur⑥/ /sku ni sna tshogs thams cad kyang / /'ja' tshon chu zla 'dra shes na//dbyings nyid las ni dbyings snang zad/ /thugs nyid gsung gi dkyil 'khor snang / /gsung nyid sku yi dkyil 'khor te/ /dbyer med de bzhin yong gis so//dkyil 'khor bzang po 'grub 'dod pas/ /rtag tu dus gsum thams cad du/ /bdag dang bdag gi dbyer med pas/ /ye nas dkyil 'khor yin par brtag /'di ni dngos grub mchog yin par/ /kun du rgyal gyis de skad bshad/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ( )sgyu 'phrul dra ba las sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon du phyung ba zhes bya ba(kye / le'u sku'i dkyil 'khor zab tu ni rgyud kyi rgyal po phyi ma las bshad de/bod la ma 'gyur 5)zhes 'byung ngo / /rang bzhin sku'i dkyil 'khor du bsdu ba'i le'u ste bdun cu lkuganyis pa'o// //102—715

de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las ting nge 'dzin gyi rim par sbyor 0)zhing dngos grub myur du len pa'i thabs dra ba las 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas dngos grub ni/ /mi dmigs dbyings nas don 'byin te/ /ma bcos (0ji bzhin ngang bzhag dang / /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung / /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las / /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bsgyur (min/ /ye shes sprul pa sna tshogs 'grub / /spyod yul thams cad maṇ+ḍa la/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thar byed skyong / /longs spyod sku dang sangs rgyas zhing / /ji ltar 'dod pa smon pas 'grubasti/ /yangs shing rgya che lhun grub ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud ye nas dag /dag rtogs nyid kyang dbyings nyid yin/ /de nas rdo rje mnyam yin no/ /dngos grub myur du 'grub (5)'dod na/ /shin tu phra zhing zab par bsgom/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan rnams ni/ /shin tu mi dmigs dbyings su bsgom/ /ting 'dzin de ni goms pa dang / /thams cad sgyu ma mig yor dang / /sprul pa'i tshul de (6)shes par bya/ /de bzhin yang nas yang goms nas/ /de nas phra mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom / /phyi nang snod bcud hūm̐ du bsdu/ /gang bsgrub 97yi ge so so ste/ /spyir ni gang bsgom kun du 'dra/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'du/ /yan lag lnga dang rnam shes nyid/ /yi ge hūm̐ du shin tu bsdu/ /mṛ (8)yi mig gis bltar yodari par / /yang nas yang du 'dris pa dang / /'od zer mang po 'phro bar bya/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi gang ba dang / /slar yang hūm̐ la bstim par bya/ /hūm̐ nyid mi dmigs dbyings su thim/ /thim 'gyur dbyings nas a dkar (9)'bar/ /shin tu 'tsher 1 bar gsal bsgoms la/ /thams cad a ru gyur par bsgom/ /102—716

de bzhin nyid du 'dris 'gyur 1)nas/ /a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor spro/ /e ma gsal bar 'byor 'gyur tshobanas/ /nyi zla gang ba'i nyi zlar bsgom/ /trī ③gsal pad+ma chags med bsgom/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas bsgom/ /nyi zla gdan dang gzhal yas khang / /thams cad bsdu ④zhing phra bar bsgom/ /de bzhin yi ge hūṃ gnas pas/ /mthing ga (55'tsher la gnas pa yi/ /'od zer 'phro ba rnam par bsgom/ /'od 'phro dbyings su slar bsdus nas/ /shin tu rdo rje 'od zer 'phro bar bsgom/ /rdo rje 'od 'phro gsal 'bar nas/ /dbyings su yang ni bstim par bya/ /de nyid sems dpa'i skur gyur nas/ /shin tu phra zhing 'dus par bsgom/ /de bzhin gnyis med gsal 'gyur (penas/ /sku gcig rdo rje dril bur bsgom/ /de bzhin nyid du gyur pa dang / /dbu gsum phyag drug nyid du bsgom/ /gzhan yang khro 'dul sna tshogs bsgom/ /blo 57yi shes rab che chung las/ /rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /yang na cig car (gyibasgom par bya/ /nyi zla gza' skar dus gcig tu/ /chu dkyil dngas ponapar gsal ba bzhin/ /de ltar goms rtogs rigs mchog des/ /ji ltar dbang bsgyur tshabazhin du 'grub/ /mkha' la 'phyo ngang rig /ste'adzin gnas/ /chu rgyun bzlog dang rlung mi 'gul/ /ri brags (1 la sogs thogs med 'dzul/ /chu la mi 'bying mes mi 'tshiganyi /dug dang mtshon gyis 'jigs yimi 'gyur/ /mi snang ba dang mang por sprul/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /lha srin rnams la dbang sgyur 'azhing / /tshe dang dus la bsring bstung spudang / /stong gsum yungs 'brur bskyed pa dang / /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grubadzin/ /sprul dang gcan gzan tu gdug pa rnams/ /khyi bzhin phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur/ /102—717

bdud dang gdug pa la sogs pas/ /tshugs par mi ①'gyur bran bzhin 'gyur//lus ma spangs par rig ②'dzin sa/ /ye shes bsod nams longs spyod kyis/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs mchog brnyes/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i byin brlabs ②kyis/ /so sor thar pa'i lam yang ston/ /'gro ba ma lus don yang byed/ /las rnams thams cad kun byas nas/ /skye 'chi med pa'i g.yung drung thob/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun gyis brgyan④/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen ldan/ /mthar phyin bya ba med pa phyi'agrub/ /bsgrub med spangs 6)med chos kyi dbyings/ /'gro med 'ong med de bzhin nyid/ /de ltar bsgrubs te bsgoms byas na⑦/ /'bras bu mngon du ma gyur kyang / /tshe rabs skye ba thams cad du/ /las ngan kun du skye mi 'gyur/ /theg pa dman par yong mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje rigs mchog 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las shin tu gsang bar (nyabya ba rgyud dngos grub thob par bya ba'i yonyele'u ste bdun cu ⑩gsum pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las hom rnams kyi phrin 67las 'di gsungs so/ /dang por de bzhin nyid du gsal zhing 'dris par bsgom/ de nas bdag gi snying gar turnyes gsal zhing 'tsher ba gcig bsgom mo / /a de shin tu gsal bar gyur pa dang / phyogs bcur 'od du 'phros par bsgom / 'od de slar a la bsdu zhing bstim/ ma dang a las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bstim zhing 'tsher la gsal bar bsgom/ hrī 6)las pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgom/ hūm̐ shin tu 'od 'bar bar bsgom/ snying gi dkyil 102—718

'khor du rdo rje sems dpa' mtshon hu)gang ba gcig phyag rgya dang bcas par bsgom/bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags dang / yig 'bru dang / phyag rgya yang gsal bar bzlas / 'bru gsum dang 'bru lnga yang bzlas/ 'dug 'bru bzhes ②mtshams gcad / rtag ①tu hom bya/ tshogs dang mchod pa yang bya/ mang po mi nus pa'i don du hom gang bgyi (peyang rung/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gtso bor spyi ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ drag po yang rdo rje/ dbang pad+ma he ru ka /rgyas pa rat+na he ru ka /zhi ba budha he ru ka /spyan drang ba ni e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru tī (5)ka zhes hom gang byed pa'i lha gtso bo nas spyan drang / mchod pa dang ar+gha yidabul ba ni drag po'i mgor ni/ sngags ril rtsu(7)/ zhi ba la mgor ril i bar ma rnams la yang de bzhin sbyang (ni/ spyan drang ba ni gang mdzad pa'i gtso bo nas zhi 5)la shārnyi 7bsnan/ spyi ni nyi la so so rang sngags u rdzogs/ drag po lho/ dbang nub / rgyas pa byang / zhi ba shar/ spyi gang yang rung gru gsum dang thod pa kha gdangs so/ /zla gam dang tu / pad+ma dang / chags med deyi/ phyag rgya rnam pa bdun la phyag rgya chen po dang / chos nyid kyi phyag rgya dang / dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / las kyi phyag rgya dang / thabs dang / shes rab kyi phyag rgya dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang / lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las hom rnam bzhi'i le'u ste bdun cu tshebazhi pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 47sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/rmad du byung ba'i dam tshig bco 1 lnga mdo 'di ltar yang bshad de/ thams cad 102—719

mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i ngang nyid du/ /dbyings su ro gcig de bsdus te/ /don du 6)mi 'gyur yong (mim gsungs/ /yon tan mchog gi 'dod pa ni/ /snang srid ma lus thams cad kun/ /mnyam pa'i zhing du sbyor bas na/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul du spyod/ /'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam/ /byang chub mchog tu 'gro ba'i gnas/ /bde chen mi zad gter du 'gyur / /cis kyang mi tshugs rdo rje'i sku/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'dod chags ni / /lus dang zas kyis bsgribs 'gyur te/ /yi dgas (miganas nas gnas su 'gro / /skom dang bkres pas 4nyon mongs 'gyur/ /rnag khrag ngan skyugs (brtag tu mthong / /bde la spyod pa'i dbang yang med/ /rtsub (ne cing gdug pas bsrung tsorabar 'gyur/ /thugs rje chen po'i zhe sdang ni/ /'khor ba'i mya ngan sgo bcad cing / /bder 8)gshegs lam du 'dzud par byed/ /yang dag don dang ldan par 'gyur/ /thugs rje /1)tshul gyis khro ston zhing 7/ /shin tu mnyam pa'i ngang du 'jog67 /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhi ba yis(rte/ /yang dag mchog gi bde ba 'grub/ /ye shes gsal ba'i bde ba ni32/ /bdag dang bdag gi dbyer med deyi/ /rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su rol/ /thams cad brjod du med pa'i ngang / /kun du khyab pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /shin tu 'od gsal rnam dag lam/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sgrib pa sbyong / /sems can nyon mongs dug sel 'gyur/ /thams cad zhing sbyong nga rgyal ni/ /yon tan bskyed pa'i mdzod yin te/ /nga med bdag med mi dmigs la/ /su zhig de la nga rgyal skyedakro/ /dpung bzhi'i tshogs kyis mi thub pa'i/ /shin tu rgyal ba'i khyu mchog 'grub/ /lha srin bdud sde tshar bcad pa'i/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin thob/ /phrag dog yangs pa'i 102—720

don sbyor ba/ /nga dang bdag med don rtogs na/ /dog dang yangs pa gnyis med de/ /bde mchog dkyil 'khor yangs pa 'grub/ /phrag dog dngos po mi shes shing / /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin 'gyur 5)na/ /lha ma yin gyi gnas su skye/ /de nas yi dgas ②gnas su 'gro/ /gal te yul sa rnyed gyur (5)na/ /shin tu mi bde dog par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang longs spyod thams cad la/ /dbang byar med cing gzhan dbang 'gyur/ /mdor na nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'grub/ /phrag dog yang dag rtogs pa ni/ /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / /phyin ci log la phrag dog ste/ /thams cad gnyis su med par sbyor/ /bde ba mchog kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnyis med don yang rtogs par 'grub/ /nga med bdag med dbyings su thim/ /lhun grub don mchog 'grub par 'gyur/ /yid la lha ni rtag bsgoms na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /bdag gis zhi)kun du dbang bsgyur 55)te/ /rig (6)'dzin gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i (7rigs kyis bsgrub bya ba/ /sgrol dang sbyor bas mthar phyin 'gyur/ /sbyor ba nyid ni sgrol 58)ba yin/ /rang bzhin gyis ni sbyor sgrol dang / /sgrol ba nyid na 5༄sbyor ba yin/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyor sgrol dang / /dbang po'i yiyul dus sbyor sgrol dang / /thabs chen dag gi sbyor sgrol dang / /mngon du phyung ba'i sbyor sgrol lo/ /yang na sbyor sgrol bdag la sogs/ /shes rab dbyings dang bdag tu sbyor/ /thabs chen sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /dbyings dang dbyings su thams cad sgrol/ /rol pa'i phrin tsho1las bsam mi khyab/ /thugs rje sprul pa bsam mi khyab / /sbyor sgrol phrin nyu las bdag la rdzogs/ /byang chub sems sprul phyogs bcur 'phro/ /ngan song gnas rnams stongs par byed/ /rig yige'adzin bde 102—721

ldan thob par byed/ /bla med zhing rnams dag par byed/ /sku gsung lhun grub phyogs bcur 'dul/ /rdo rje zhes ni mtshan bsgrags te/ /theg dman rnams kyang rdo rjer dgod/ /zad mi shes pa'i gter yang 'grub/ /rdo rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i sku/ /thams cad dbyer med mnyam pa'i sku/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog /thugs rje sprul pa dpag med kyis/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus mkhyen/ /'gro ba nyid na nyid kyi sku/ /nyon mongs byang chub lam du mkhyen / /'khor ba nyid ni bde gnas so/ /chos kyi dbyings dang sems can mtha' / /dbyer med yang dag nyid du'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las rmad du byung ba'i dam tshig bco 6)lnga 'di ltar yang bshad pa'i le'u ste bdun cu 2lnga pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba las dam tshig rnam par spros pa 'di nyid la nyid (51ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /spros pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i thugs rje'i ngang ⑥/ /dmyal ba'i gnas rnams tshar gcod pa'i/ /brgyad gnyis bcu drug zhing du sbyor/ /tsha ba rnams la bsil ba'i sman/ /grang ba rnams la dro ba'i sman/ /bsil dro 'jam (gertsub cha snyoms pa/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs de ltar ston/ /byin rlabs (6)ya mtshan rmad po che/ /chags pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod bya/ /ji ltar bde ba'i ro myong zhing / /myong tshor nyid na rang bzhin med/ /chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyis / /yi dgas 97gnas rnams tshar gcod cing / /lus dang zas kyis 102—722

bsgribs pa yi/ /nyon mongs gnyi ga ①med par ston/ /gti mug ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ nga dang bdag med gnyis med pa'i/ /shes rab chen po'i 'od gsal gyis/ /dran smra med pa'i sdug bsngal bsal/ /rmongs med sgrib pa dag par byas/ /ye shes gsal ba'i thugs rje yis/ /bya byed med par nyon mongs sgrol / /byol song gnas ni stongs byed cing / /thugs rje'i sgron ma de ltar sgron②ske/ /phrag dog ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ yangs pa chen po'i ye shes kyis/ /nga dang bdag 'dzin rnams la ni/ /thugs rjes gnyis med mnyam sbyor zhing / /dog chadang yangs pa gnyi ga ④med/ /rgya chen yangs pa'i blo ldan pas/ /'di la mi chud gang yang med/ /thams cad yangs pa nyid du sbyor/ /lha ma yin rnams stongs par byed/ /nga rgyal bde mchog ces bya ba'i ⑤dam tshig ni/ ye ⑥nas chos nyid mnyam pa la/ /nga dang khyod ces bya ba med/ /thams cad dbyings su ro gcig ste/ /gnyis med mtshan nyid bsnan du med/ /che chung med pa'i ngang yin pas/ /bya ba dag ni med par bstan/ /nga rgyal bdag med rtogs pa yis/ /dregs pa'i gnas rnams ⑦stongs par byed/ /rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'jig rten 'di na ci yod pa/ /ming dang tha snyad 'dzin pa dag /so so'i mtshan nyid gzhig byas na(8na/ /rang bzhin med de yang dag nyid/ /rang byung chen po'i ye shes 6)kyis/ /thams cad sangs rgyas zhing du sbyor/ /ma bcos ma byas ngang gis gsal/ /ye nas 'od gsal sangs rgyas zhing / /nyid kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/rang bzhin nyid la gnas pa yibo/ /sus kyang ma byas rang byung ste/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid du sbyor/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du thim/ /rang byung 102—723

ye shes dkyil 'khor gyis/ /ma lus de bzhin nyid du sdud6)/ /sdud dang mi sdud (miganyi ga med/ /yang dag kho na nyid du'o/ /bde ba'i ngang nyid ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thams cad ma lus rnam par dag /nyid kyi dbyings las mi gzhan phyir/ /bde dang mi bde gnyis ka (7med/ /thams cad dbyings su ro gcig ste/ /ji bzhin nyid kyi ngang btsan 3)par/ /yang dag nyid kyis de skad gsungs / /bshad dang nyan pa'ang gnyi ga (37med/ /de bzhin nyid du gnyi ga 6)'du / /dus bzhi rgyal mchog ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ gong na med pa'i ye shes mchog /thams cad kun la dbang bsgyur (7)te/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du sbyor/ /'das dang ma 'das (lithams cad dang / /'byung dang 'byung bar ma nges pa'i/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i khyad par gyis/ /dus bzhi snga phyi med pa yi / /mnyam pa nyid du lhan ner sbyor/ /lhun grub ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /thams cad dbyer med byang chub ste/ /ye nas rnam par dag pa'i chos/ /ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /byang chub lam chen 'di yin te/ /thams cad dbyer med nyid du 'dus/ /byang chub don sgrub ri9)yi nas rdzogs/ /mnyam pa'i zhing du thams cad thim/ /rdo rje skye gnas zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ theg pa che mchog rigs su nges/ /rigs te byang chub bstan pas gzung 7/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i dbyings shes na(nya/ /rigs mchog kun gyi skye gnas yin/ /skyes pa nyid na skyes pa med/ /las dang las kyi bag chags med/ /cis kyang ma gos thams cad 'joms/ /skye shi med pa'i sa yang yin/ /byang chub kyi zhing bkod pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba ni/phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i/ /snang grags bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /102—724

phyi dang nang gi gnas pa dag /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su thim/ /mdor na zhing khams ma lus par/ /yon tan rin chen bkod pa yi/ /ye shes rgyan gyis spros pa rnams/ /zhing de yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /ye shes bzhugs gnas zhes 0)bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ gzung (mi'adzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /gsang sngags chen po grub ③'dod pas/ /gzung ④'dzin bral ba'i ye shes thob/ /chos kyi dbyings dang rgyasems can ni/ /gnyis med de bzhin nyid du gcig /de ltar rtogs pa'i skyes bu ni/ /rdo rje bzhugs gnas yin par bshad/ /mi 'jigs pa'i rgyal mchog ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/rnam par byang dang nyon mongs gnyis/ /so so yod pa ma yin te/ /nyon mongs gnyen pos bcos su med/ /thams cad dbyings su ro gcig pas/ /de la 'jigs 4)pa'i gnyen po med/ /cis kyang mi tshugs gong na med/ /mchog tu bde ba'i zhing yang yin/ /nga med bdag med rgyal ba'i mchog /gzhal yas khang brtan (7zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kun/ /rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor ba ni/ /dog yangs tshad kyang dpag tu med/ /sangs rgyas spyi gtsug lta bu'i mtshan/ /ye shes rgyu (kyelas grub pa'o/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /zag pa zad las grub pa yi/ / nams kyang 59sku'ajigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /sna tshogs kun sbyor zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ gdol pa can gyi chos min pas/ /ci 7ltar bsams yinyepa bzhin du 'grubazhushe/ /rig pa rang dbang gyur pas na/ /stong par bya 'am mi stong bya/ /thams cad dbyer med ngang yin pas/ /kha dog dbyibs dang rin po che/ /thams cad khyab par yungs 'bru'i yo tshul/ /bsam yas mtha' dbus med pa'o/ /'dren byed gnas 102—725

stobs zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ma rig log rtog zhi)bsam yas kyis/ /'jig rten khams rnams bsam yas pa/ /'khor ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i skad cig ma/ /yang dag byang chub sems rig na/ /ma ②rig rgyu 'bras rnam par dag /nyon mongs pa nyid byang chub ste/ /thams cad ma lus bde gnas so/ /lam lnga ston byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom ②byas te/ /nyon mongs lam lnga'i sgo bkag nas/ /lam lngar snang ba rnam rtog yin/ /rtog dang mi rtog ④ gnyi ga (nyamed/ /gnyis med de ni yang dag lam/ /thabs dang shes rab ngang nyid du/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag rtogs ⑥bya zhing / /bla na med pa ston par bya/ /yang dag don ston zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ theg pa bsam yas ston pa yang / /de bzhin nyid kyis ma brjod kyang ske/ /sems can blo yi (7rim pa bzhin/ /so sor 'tsham par kun la gsal//'di ni rdo rje theg mchog ste/ /rgya mtsho klung du chu 'bab bzhin(she/ /thams cad chu yi ngo bo nyid/ /theg pa thams cad rdo rje'i sa/ /rab tu rtogs kyi)byed ces ⑩bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ shes rab blo chen rab ldan pas/ /don du mi 'gyur yong ma gsungs/ /srid gsum 'gro ba bsam yas su/ /thugs rje snyoms pa skyobasam mi khyab/ /don dang mthun yi pa 'ba' zhig 1steston/ /mi mthun zhags pa 'khor ba gcod/ /bder bogashegs zhing rnams dag par byed/ /thams cad dbyings su dag par 'dus/ /sgyur byed byang chub ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ rang rig ye shes dbang thob nas/ /dkar po tshon 7gyis mdog sgyur yibazhin/ /dug kyang sman du 'gyur ba dang / /de bzhin byang chub dug gsum ste/ /'gro lnga byang chub lam du sbyor/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal thar byed lam/ /thar dang ma thar 102—726

gnyis med na/ /thams cad ma lus byang chub rgyu/ /mnyam rdzogs lhun grub ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ye shes sgyu mar snang ba dang / /log 6)rtog sgyu mar snang ba gnyis/ /sgyu ma yin pas rang bzhin mnyam/ /mnyam pa nyid na mi gnas pa'i/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te/ /ye shes gnyis kyi ②dkyil 'khor la/ /theg mchog rdo rje ma lus rdzogs/ /dpe byad bzang po dpag tu med/ /thams cad dbang sgyur ①zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ shin tu rtogs pa'i khyad par gyis/ /spyod yul thams cad smon na mkhyen/ /de bzhin nyid dang kun rtog la/ /gnyis su med pas dbang bsgyur ④te/ /ma lus thams cad bde ldan zhing / /thams cad byang chub mchog tu 'gyur/ /ye nas dngos po med pa la/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /rig 'dzin gnas stobs zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ shes rab rnam (shegasum goms byas nas/ /ting 'dzin mnyam pa'i don rtogs te/ /rtag tu yangs pa (7chen po bsgom/ /rgyu 'bras dus gcig rdzogs pa yi/ /rang rig nyid la dbang thob ste/ /tshe ni bcu dang drug pa yin/ /brgya brgya dag tu (7)bsnur zhing gnas/ /lus ma bor bar sangs rgyas pa'o/ /zad med gter ldan zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ shes rab chen po rnam dag pas/ /spyod yul thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /shes dang spyod yul gnyis su med/ /de bzhin nyid du ro gcig ste/ /thams cad rgyal ba'i zhing sbyor bas/ /zad med rin chen gter du 'gyur/ /mi zad par ldan dam tshig mchog /'og min mtha' dbus bsam mi khyab/ /bsgrub med mnyam rdzogs zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thams cad mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rang byung ye shes 'phyo ba yi/ /dbyings dang rig pa gnyis med pa'i/ /de 102—727

bzhin nyid de rdo rje'i hu)rigs/ /thams cad gnyis su med pa la/ /bsgrub dang sgrub ②pa yod ma yin/ /ye nas lhun gyis grub pa la/ /de la ③lam gyis bcos su med/ /thams cad byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams ye dag gyur pa yang / /phyin ci log gi blo log nas/ /log rtog ④gnas na longs spyod pa/ /ma rig 'khrul 'khor bsam mi khyab/ /'khrul rtog ngan pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen po thabs mkhas pas/ /nyon mongs 'dren cing mtho ris gnas/ /byang chub lam chen rtogs par ston/ /gsung mchog mtha' yas zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /ming dang tshig tu brtags (5)nas ston/ /ji snyed mang po'i don brjod kyang / /rdo rje gsung la spros (67pa med/ /spros med de ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /kun du brda 'jal 57)ye shes gsung / /sgra dang ming tshig kun las 'das/ /thams cad pad+ma chags med pa'o/ /bsgyur ba zad med ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis/ /snang srid ma lus thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid kyis (8)dbang bsgyur te/ /thams cad ye shes dbyings su bstim/ /zad med ye shes gter ldan pas/ /thugs rje 57byin brlabs yo tshobasam mi khyab/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /so sor don rtogs rnam par dag /thams cad skad 'jal (11zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thar pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bum phrag dang / /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus la/ /gsung gcig 4)tshig tu ma brjod kyang / /sngon gyi thugs rje byin brlabs yi kyis/ /thar dang ma thar gnyi ga (snyel/ /so so ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /chos kyi gsung mchog dam pa yis thar pa skibaskul zhing ngan song sbyong / /rang rig dbang sgyur 7zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/102—728

phyogs dus bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de na ji snyed yod pa yil/ /mtshan ma sna tshogs brtags pa yang / /rang rig rnam par rtog ②pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byam gan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sprul pa bsam yas 'byung ba yang / /ye shes sprul par dag pa'i yul/ /yi ge med 'jal ④zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ yi ge tshig dang sgra spangs pa'i/ /brjod med ngang du gnas pa ni/ /gsung nyid rang bzhin med pa yi/ /chos rnams thams cad ye nas dag /thams cad thugs su gyur pas na/ /sgra dang tshig la gnas pa min/ /thugs la thugs ni mi gnas pa'o/ /bdud sde tshar gcod ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ nyon mongs pa nyid rnam par dag /phung po lnga nyid mngon sangs rgyas/ /bdag nyid lha yi chadakyil 'khor te/ /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung gnas/ /bdud bzhi bcom pa'i skyes mchog gis/ /dregs pa chen po thams cad bcom/ /ma rig log 'dren 'dul bcad de/ /chos kyi dbyings su thams cad thim/ /stong gsum kun grags zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs 6)kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rdul snyed du/ /'gro ba'i phrin galas bsam mi khyab/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes kyi/ /thams cad gdul bya chud ma zos/ /ngan song sbyong zhing byang chub zhing / /ye shes rdzogs chen kun tu ston/ /ye shes gsung mchog ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'das dang ma 'das thams cad kun/ /yang dag shes pas rab brtags na/ /rang bzhin med la cir yang snang / /snang ba nyid na dbyings nyid de/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ /kun la dbang sgyur (sherang dbang can/ /thams cad tshig gi sgra ltar snang / /'di ni ye shes gsung 102—729
