mchog yin①/ /bsam yas ye shes rdo rje gsung zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /mtha' dang dbus med kun du khyab/ /khyab dang khyab med rdo rje'i gsung / /sgra skad sna tshogs bsgrags pa dang / /dngos po med la dngos po'i sgra/ /ji ltar pi bang ②lag thogs na/ /sgra ni sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur yang / /dngos po med pa de bzhin nyid/ /phyogs dus dbyer med ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad dang / /dus bzhir 'byung ba ma lus kun/ /phyogs dang snga phyi med pa yi/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /so sor snang ba thams cad kun/ /rang rig rgyal por yang dag 'du/ /rang rig de nyid thams cad yin/ /'jigs med rdo rje zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas yin/ /'dus byas snang dang mi snang gnyi ga min/ /yod dang med pa'ang dbyer med de/ /rang bzhin ye nas dag pa yi(gu ma bcos ma byas ngang gis gsal/ /'jig dang gzhig (4 par bya ba min/ /cis kyang mi tshugs rdo rje'i bdag /ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin sku nyid ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ de bzhin zhing khams bsam yas dang / /'gro ba ma lus thams cad la/ /thar pa rnams la dag pa'i sku/ /rtog pa can la 'khor ba'i lus / /so sor 'tsham par don ston cing / /ston pa nyid la dngos po med/ /chu zla'i tshul du kun la snang / /kun la de ltar rtogs par byos/ /lhun grub bde gnas 5zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /byang chub snying po yod pa ltar/ /rang bzhin ye nas 'od gsal ba'i/ /byang chub snying por thams cad 'dus/ /phyi nang ma lus thams cad kun/ /bdag 102—730

gi ngang du gnas pas na/ /bdag la bdag gis dbang bsgyur ①nas/ /spyod yul thams cad smon mi dgos/ /che mchog rnam dag ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/rig pa'i rgyal po rang gyur pas②/ /thams cad kun la dbang bsgyur ①te④/ /gong na med pa'i sa mnan pas/ /thams cad kun gyi gtso bo yin/ /thams cad ma lus gnyis med pas/ /bsgo ⑤dang bsgo bar bya ba min/ /de bzhin nyid la dbang bskur bas/ /thams cad dbyings ⑥su ro gcig go/ /chos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyi nang snod bcud bdag rnams la/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ye nas gnas/ /chen po'i gzugs snang thams cad ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /sgyu ma'i rtsal rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i(spyi/ /de bzhin yum gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /rang rig byang chub dkyil 'khor te/ /thams cad kun nas 'khyil bar gnas/ /zad med gter chen zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ zag bcas gnod sbyin nor dang 'dra / /sems can 'phel 'grib zad 'gyur gyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan ni/ /zad med 'phel 'grib med pa yi/ /mang po spros pas 'phro mi 'gyur//nyung ngu bsdus pas sbom po min/ /zad med rin chen gter yin pas/ /thams cad kun la khyab pa'o/ /rnam dag byang chub ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /ye nas rnam par dag pa la/ /rnam rtog rkyen gyis glo ri gebur du/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson kyi)rar gnas/ /rang rig sgrib med 'odag pa yis17/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba gnyis/ /rang bzhin med par 'don rtogs na/ /sangs rgyas zhing du rnam par dag /gzung tu 'dzin dril 7byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyin ci log tu rnam brtags na/ /102—731

bdag dang bdag gir so sor snang / /de la 'dzin pa gnyis zhugs nas/ /rang bzhin med bzhin so sor snang / /yang dag rtogs pas rab brtags na①/ /dngos po thams cad stong pa yin/ /dngos dang dngos nyid mi gnas pa/ /de rtogs sdug bsngal bral byed yin/ /yum 'gyur phyidabyings phyug ma'i dam tshig ni/'gyur chab lnga la brten li'agyur (snyen/ /thams cad 'byung zhing ma lus gnas/ /skye 'khrungs thim 'u sa/ gzhi yang yin/ /thams cad kun gyi rgyu yang yin/ /de bzhin shes rab rnam gsum gyis/ /le lo med pa'i brtson pa 'bod/ /de bzhin dbyings nyid rtogs gyur na/ /bla med byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas/ /chos la skyon med ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /ngan song gnas rnams ma lus kun/ /rgyu nyid rang bzhin gnyi lag dag6) /rang bzhin ye shes de bzhin no/ /'bras bu rnam par dag pa yikyi)/ /'jig rten brtan g.yo la sogs pa/ /snang ba nyid na ngo bo med/ /de nyid chos sku chen po yin/ /sems can don byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ byang chub sems su don gcig pas/ /rtsa ba snying rje chen po 'byung / /thabs kyis ⑩pa rol phyin pa spyod/ /nyon mongs lam nas 'gro bar byed/ /nyon mongs khams gsum gnas pa yang / /phyin ci log nyid snang ba yin/ /der rtogs mtho ris thar pa'o/ /rtogs nas don 'dzin ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thams cad lhun gyis grub pa dang / /sgyu ma mig yor tshul shes pa/ / gnyis ka yonyarang rig nyid du 'dus/ /de nyid yang dag yin par bshad/ /sgra dang tshig tu brjod pa ni/ /yang dag don gyi snying po 'byin/ /ming tshig sgra la mi rten tunyepar/ / blo yi yonyegating du go bar bya/ /sems la gnas bcas zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/102—732

thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sems nyid las ni gzhan na med/ /sems dang chos su dbyer med pas/ /byang chub lam de ring ba min/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar mi 'gro/ /rtog med rang rig kho na tsam/ /sangs rgyas sems can sems la gnas/ /brjod med spros med ces 6)bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /sna tshogs ji snyed brjod pa yang so so'i mtshan nyid ma gtogs 90pa/ /ba spu tsam yang brjod pa med/ /bsod nams chen pos bstangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas zhing nyid dag pa'o/ /las ngan dag gis khams gsum gnas/ /de nyid dbyings las spros pa med/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje gsung zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ rnam dag sku gsung sprul ba dang / /che mchog sna tshogs bstan pa yang / /byang chub sems la snang 'gyur te/ /snang ba nyid na dbyings su 'ub(kye/ /phyin ci log g.yo bsam yas kyis/ /khams gsum gnas dang lam lngar 'khor/ /de nyid log rtogs 6)sna tshogs snang / /de las ma gtogs gang yang med/ /ye nas ma bcos zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ blo med byang chub smon mi dgos/ /'gro lnga ma lus thams cad kun/ /ye nas byang chub snying por gnas/ /de bzhin dbyings kyis kun du khyab/ /ji lta ba yi ngang gnas la/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i blo 'jug pas/ /gnyis su med par rtogs 'gyur (5)na/ /su zhig bcos shing su yis (ne rtogs/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /rang rig ye nas dag pa yi/ /sus kyang ma bcos ngang gis gsal/ /ma chags pad+ma 'dra ba yi / /ye shes can gyi spyod yul de/ /kun dang thun mong de ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul de/ /skyes bu blo rtsal rab kyis rtogs/ /thams cad 102—733

dbyings phyug ma zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ mi zad yon tan gter gyur pa6)/ /zad pa'i dus med yid bzhin mdzod/ /bdag dang bdag gi med pa yi/ /shin tu zab pa'i blo las byung / /chos dbyings zab mo'i don rtogs na/ /sku dang ye shes bsam mi khyab/ /rang rig ye shes don rtogs na/ /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung thob/ /byang chub sdom byed ces bya (7ba'i dam tshig ni/ gzung ②'dzin bral ba'i ye shes kyis/ /chags med dbyings la mnyam bzhag na/ /thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi zhing / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal 'byung mi 'gyur/ /chos kyi rang bzhin ji lta bur/ /bdag gis yang dag rdzogs byas te/ /theg pa dman dang phyin ci log /thams cad mnyam pa'i dbyings su dgod/ /phyogs dus gnyis med ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi thams cad kyang / /rtogs pa'i mtshan ma so sor snang / /snang ba nyid na dbyer med de/ /mtha' dang dbus med zlum po yi(ge/ /de bzhin rang gis rig pa yang / /mtha' dang dbus med du ma min/ /gang du mi 'gro kun du khyab/ /kun la bde sbyin mi gnas pa'o/ /thams cad 'byor ldan zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams so sor rtogs byas shing / /thams cad gnyis med dbyings shes na/ /mi zad 57par ldan rgyan thob ste/ /kun du zad med rin chen gter/ /de bzhin nyid la gnas bcas na/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal mi 'byung ste/ /rtag tu bde gnas byang chub nyid/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun dang ldan/ /thabs gnyis 7shes rab ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ji ltar snang ba thams cad kun/ /thams cad thabs kyi rang bzhin te/ /thabs la thabs ni rnam par sbyor/ /sbyor dang sbyor ba gnyis ka 7med/ /sna tshogs snang ba thams cad kyang / /snang 102—734

ba nyid na rang bzhin med/ /de nyid shes rab yin par bshad/ /rtag tu thabs nyid mi dmigs pa'o/ /shes rab nyid la thabs su sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid las/ /rol pa sna tshogs cir yang 'byung / /'byung ba nyid na rang bzhin med/ /med pa nyid na 6)sna tshogs snang —/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyings las byung / /mnyan ②bsams bsgoms (gepa'i shes rab kyis/ /shes rab thabs su don rtogs byos/ /kun la de ltar 'byor par gyis/ /gnyis med byang chub sems zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/thabs dang shes rab ldan 'gyur 4)na/ /gnyis med byang chub sems 'phros na/ /kun gyi 'byung gnas byed pa po/ /de yis ma byas gang yang min/ /kha dog dbyibs rigs gang yang min/ /shin tu brtag dka' sus (de)mi rig5yi /bdag gis bdag kyang mi mthong na/ /gzhan gyis rtogs par ga la 'gyur/ /thams cad sbyor byed yi nyeces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ye nas lha dang lha mo yin/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag sbyor ba dang / /dbang po yul du sbyor ba'o/ /phung po lnga nyid de bzhin gshegs/ /'byung ba lnga nyid yum du sbyor/ /dus bzhi'i lha mo nyid du sbyor / /rtag chad mu bzhi (8)khro mo'o/ /thams cad ma lus 'byung ba kun/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings dang rig 9par sbyor/ /yang na 7shes rab dbyings ma la/ /bder (nyagashegs dkyil 'khor kun bkod la/ /bdag nyid rig pa'i lhar bsgoms te/ /gnyis su med par ldan par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu ldan gyur nas/ /byang chub pad+ma shin tu spro/ /phyogs dus dkyil 'khor mnyes pa dang / /'gro ba mang po bde 8thob nas/ /slar yang gnyis med dbyings su bstim/ /thim 'gyur dbyings nas phyag rgyar 'bar/ /bder tsho gshegs thabs dang shes rab 102—735

rdzogs / /phyag rgya drug kyang yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs/ /thams cad dbyings su 'byor pas na/ /ngan 'gro ①mi ltung yang dag 'grub/ /'di ni bsgral ba chen po yin/ /sgrol ba nyid ni sbyor ba yin/ /sbyor ba nyid ni ②ma lus bsgral/ /thams cad ma lus par sgrol ①byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyi nang snod bcud ji snyed pa/ /gnas pa'i sems can ma lus kun/ /bdag nyid chen por rtogs pa yis/ /dbyings su yang ni bsgral bar bya/ /shin tu khro bo chen po yis/ /thabs kyis lha chen bsgral ba ltar/ /chos nyid rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gnyis su med par thabs kyis bsgral/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs (0kyis/ /lam lnga'i sems can kun bkug nas//thams cad ma lus bsgral bar bya/ /ri rab chen po'i gling bzhi la/ /gnas pa'i sems can ma lus kun/ /thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs 'a)te/ /ye shes me chen bsgom 6)byas na/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg par byaspyi/ /dbyings su yang ni bstim 'a)byas te/ /de bzhin gshegs par byin gyis brlabs6)/ /rgyal ba'i sras su dbang yang bskur/ /de ltar bsgral ba 7kun byas kyang / /bsgral ba'i dngos po gang yang med/ /phung po lnga po bshig pa la/ /bshig (nyanas 'byung ba bag la zha/ /ma bshig 6nyan yang 'byung ba yin/ /rnam shes med pas bsad byas na/ /gnas pa nyid na dngos po med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin de la ni / /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgrar (snyelangs kyang / /sus kyang mi zin sod pa med / /'o na thugs rjes gang bsgral nayo / /rnam rtog mtshan ma thams cad kun / /phyin ci log las bzlog byas te/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya dang //shin tu goms skepas dbang bskur te/ /byang chub zhing la dgod par bya/ /de 102—736

tsam la ni bsgral zhes gdags/ /bsgral ba nyid na sbyor ba yin/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal rtsad bcad nas/ /byang chub gnas su bsgral bas na/ /gnyis med dbyings su sbyor ba yin/ /thabs nyid shes rab shes rab 0)nyid thabs te②/ /gnyis su med pa nyid byang chub kyi sems so/ /sbyor ba ni lha dang lha mor sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / dbang po yul dus ④sbyor ba dang / chen po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lngar sbyor ba dang / so so rtsal sgyu ma tsam du yod pa yum du sbyor ba dang / dbang po yul dus lha dang lha mor sbyor ba dang / rtag chad mu bzhi khro bo khro mor sbyor ba dang / mngon sum du sbyor ba'o/ /sgrol ba ni thabs kyis sgrol rgyab dang / 'pho bas bsgral (5rib dang / dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid du bsgral ba dang / thams cad ma lus par dbyings su dus gcig bsgral ba dang /thams cad thugs rje chen pos gnyis su med par sgrol (6)ba'o/ /'di gnyis (pedus gcig tu mdzad de/ ya char ma gyur par bya'o/ /dngos grub mchog kyang der thob ces/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis bshad do/ /ma byin par (8len pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan na med/ /rang bzhin rang gis bdag med pa/ /kun la thogs med spyad 'gyur 59)yang / /spyad dang spyod pa gnyi ga tsho )med/ /thams cad ye nas stong pa la/ /gang gis tsho len cing gang la spyod/ /snang srid ma lus thams cad la/ /thogs pa med pa'i spyod 'gyur yang / /bcing par mi tshona'agyur bsod nams 31gas/ /chags med ye shes chen po /geyin/ /ma lus thams cad chos kyi dbyings/ /de ltar rang rig yin par bshad/ /gnyis su med par 102—737

rtogs gyur na/ /blangs pa nyid na (1)kun du bzang / /brdzun du smra ba zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /ye nas dngos po yod ma yin/ /rang bzhin 5)ngang gis 'od gsal la/ /ming tsam tshig gis (mimatshon mod kyisage/ /ming dang tshig la dngos po med/ /ma rig pa yi (5)'khrul rtog gis/ /nga dang bdag tu med pa la/ /so so mtshan ma dngos por bzung / /'dzin pa'i dngos po yong med de/ /chos rnams thams cad ming tshig tsam/ /ji snyed mang po brjod pa yang / /rjod (57par byed dang brjod pa med/ /chos rnams thams cad brdzun 7du snang / /brdzun 8nyid la ni brdzun 5)spyod de⑩/ /brdzun 11zhes bya ba btags 12pa tsam/ /thams cad brdzun 12gyi tshig yin no/ /rdo rje 'joms byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thog ma med nas phyin ci log /bdag dang bdag gi med pa la/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma so sor 'dzin/ /'dzin pa'i dngos po yod ma yin/ /mi mthun mtshan ma gzhom pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bdag rtog bag chags kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje dbyings su thim par bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs 1 7kyis/ /khams gsum nyon mongs 'khor ba 7rnams/ /gzhan gyis bcings te 'khor ba min/ /'dzin rtog tshachags pa nyid kyis 'khor//blo chen rab tu ldan pa yis/ /chos kyi don po 1 mchog nyon la/ /'khor ba spang sa med sangs rgyas zhing / /thams cad ma lus chos nyid rtogs/ /rin chen 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ nor gyi mchog ni dkor 17bdun yin/ /'dod pas btsal bar tshomi rnyed de/ /sku gsung thugs 'das mi dmigs pa'i/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /gnyis su med par 'byor byas na/ /nor 102—738

bdun chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan dang dpe byad sna tshogs ldan/ /pad+ma chags med ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /bsgo 0byedang bsgo bar bya ba med/ /pad+ma 'dam nas skyes pa 'dra/ /ji ltar snang ba mtha' ②yas kun/ /bdag las gud na gcig ①kyang med/ /bdag nyid shin tu mi dmigs pas/ /nyon mongs nyid kyang byang chub zhing / /don rnams bsgrub ④pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ rdo rje rigs kyis thams cad bcom/ /rin chen rigs kyis yon tan 'byin/ /pad+ma rigs kyis chags med 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga/ /thams cad don rnams rdzogs par byas/ /gzung (zhedang 'dzin pa rnam (7spangs te/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings la sems kyis lta(pe/ /skye 'chi med pa lhun gyis grub/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /phrin (gelas rmad 'byung tshikun grags pa/ /gzhan na yod 'ong ma yin te/ /rang byung miye shes gnas med yin/ /mthong ba'i tshul gyis gzugs snang dang / /bla med byang chub skur tunyesnang ba/ /me long lta bu'i tshul bzhin du/ /sna tshogs kha dog dbyibs su snang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rnams ni/ /sgra dang yonaming tshig kun las 'das/ /brjod med rang bzhin kun du go/ /nyon mongs med cing bla med sgra/ /ma brjod stong gsum grags pa yi/ /gsung tshonabarjod bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /brjod pa nyid na stong gsum med/ /de nyid sna tshogs brjod pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs ldan pa/ /yang dag rtogs skopas rab brtags (7pa/ /gzhi tsom med dbyings skad cig ma/ /mtha' dang dbus kyang brtag nyu 1tu med/ /de nyid sna tshogs 'byung yosheba'i rgyu/ /sus kyang ma bcos ma byas pa/ /bdag gis 5)bdag kyang 102—739

dmigs mi 'gyur/ /dngos med kun la dbang sgyur 0)ba/ /sku gsung yang dag ldan 'gyur ②na/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' chadang mnyam/ /mi 'gyur sangs rgyas zhing du 'ub④/ /spyod yul ma lus thams cad la/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'byung / /mi zad pa yi (5)gter chen 'grub/ /gzhan gyis dbrog tu med pa yi/ /po de'i dkor (6)ni rin po che/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs ⑦kyis / /bya byed med par rnam bzhi (8)mdzad/ /mdzad dang mdzad par bya ba med / /ye nas lhun grub sangs rgyas chos/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du kun la spyod/ /spyod med ngang gi dkyil 'khor la/ /chags med tshul du rnam par rol bya byed rnam pa sna tshogs kyang / /byed pa nyid na chu zla'i tshul/ /gzung yo)'dzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /rtsa ba lnga zhes brjod mod kyi7/ /brjod pa nyid na yong med de/ /mtshan nyid med pa sna tshogs snang / /de nyid thams cad mkhyen nyid yin / /kun la khyab cing mi gnas pa/ /de ni rig pa rang dbang 'gyur/ /bsam 17gyis mi khyab kun du khyab/ /nam mkha' snang byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni / chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /de bzhin nyid kyis kun du khyab/ /snod bcud ma lus thams cad la/ /snang ba chen pos khyab par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' gzung 1 du med pa ltar/ /snang srid thams cad de dang 'dra/ /chos rnams thams cad sems yin te/ /sems ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /rten tu byed sa chen zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ji ltar sa gzhi chen po la/ /sems kyis zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /skye 'khrungs ma lus thams cad 'byung / /thams cad kun gyi gnas brten 1 te/ /de bzhin theg chen bla med la/ /byang chub sangs rgyas kun kyang gnas/ /theg pa mtho 15dman thams cad 'byung / /thams cad 102—740

theg chen dbyings su 'dus/ /sreg byed ye shes me zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/bdag med ye shes rang rig gis/ /dngos dang dngos med bag chags 0)bsregs / /rang dang spyi yi ②chos rnams dang / /sems kyi phrag dog thams cad kun/ /dngos po med par rtogs byas na/ /'khor ba ma spangs rnam par dag /mya ngan mi 'da' ye nas gnas/ /'gro dang gnas par ①bya ba min/ /rtog ④pa thams cad ye nas tshogs/ /thams cad 'khru byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ sems can ma lus thams cad ni/ /sgrib gnyis dag gis 'khor bar 'gyur / / mnyan bsams bsgoms (5)pa'i shes rab kyis/ /bdag med gnyis ni rtogs byas na/ /pha rol phyin rdzogs sa bcu bsgrubs/ /sa gsum yang dag rdzogs byas te/ /mnyam pa'i zhing la thams cad 'god/ /khrus kyi (6)mchog ni 'di yin no/ /g.yeng byed chen po zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ sems can ye nas dag pa la/ /bdag 'dzin rdul snyed ⑦g.yogs par 'gyur/ /sems dang rdul rnams med rtogs pas/ /ye shes rlung gis bag chags gtor/ /chos rnams ye nas rlung dang 'dra/ /de la gzung (shedu med pa ltar/ /kun la de ltar 'byor par gyis/ /ma bcos ye nas de ltar gnas/ /thams cad kun la dbang sgyur 6)zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ rang rig phyin ci ma log pa'i/ /gzung tso'adzin gnyis med rtogs pa yis/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i ngang 'gyur 47na/ /thams cad ma lus bdag yin pas/ /thams cad kun la dbang sgyur tu te/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /ji ltar spyad tsa kyang bsod nams tshogs/ /mnyam rig ye shes chen po yin/ /chos thams cad gzugs brnyan ltar shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin te/ /snang ba nyid na tso102—741

'ja' tshon bzhin/ /rang bzhin med par kun du snang / /de nyid chos sku yin par bshad/ /cis kyang ma gos ma spangs pa'o/ /so sor snang zhing mthun pa'i gzugs / /bdag dang bdag tu ma brtags 6)pa/ /de lta bu yi ngang du snang / /chos rnams sgra ltar shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ sgra rnams ji snyed brjod pa yang ske/ /dngos po med las dngos po sgra/ /brjod dang sgra yi (9dngos po min/ /chos rnams sgra ltar shes par byos/ /thams cad ma lus don 'byung ba/ /tshig gis mtshon pas (gugud na med/ /sgra nyid don gyi ④dngos po min/ /don nyid sgra las gud na med/ /chos rnams dri'i mtshan nyid du shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sna tshogs 'byung zhing rnam par 'phro/ /de bzhin dri yi dngos po yang / /yod pa ma yin kun du mnam/ /the tshom med pa'i shes rab kyis/ /chos kun de ltar shes par gyis/ /dri yis (gerab tu tshim 'gyur yang 6)/ /dri dang dngos po gnyis su med/ /dngos grub thams cad de ltar ro/ /chos thams cad ro ltar shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /gzhi (7rtsa med las thams cad byung (kye/ /de bzhin dbang po dngos med dang / /rdzas kyi dngos po med pa yi/ /rnam shes dbang po yul tshogs na/ /ro yi dbang po thams cad 'grub/ /ro dang ro ru rtogs pa yang / /rang bzhin med pa skad cig ma/ /chos ⑨thams cad reg bya ltar shes par bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ gzugs rnams dbu ba rdos pa 'dra/ /tshor ba chu yi chu bur bzhin/ /mtshan 'dzin smig rgyu bzhin du gnas/ /rnam shes sgyu mas dbang sgyur bon/ /mtshan ma sna tshogs 'byung bar nges/ /bde ba'i ro mchog kun kyang myong / /de nyid bsod nams tshogs chen te/ste/ /bde ba chags med 102—742

ye shes yin/ /reg gi dngos grub de ltar ro/ /'dus byas rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ yang dag nyid la gnas bcas 6)na/ /phyi nang snod bcud rnam par dag /rags (9par snang ba de bzhin gshegs/ /sgyu mar 'dzin pa yum gyi dbyings/ /gzugs ni mtshan ma dngos po med/ /gcig la lnga lngar bshig pa dang / /thams cad nam mkha'i ngang du gnas/ /nam mkha' de bzhin chos kyi dbyings/ /'dus byas nyid kyi dngos grub bo/ /'dus byas kun du 'byung ba ①zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ gshegs sku sgyu mar snang ba dang / /log rtogs ④sgyu mar snang ba gnyis/ /gzhi rtsa ⑤med de rang bzhin stong / /rigs dang rgyud du brtag (9tu med/ /rigs dang kha dog dbyibs med pas/ /phyi nang snod bcud rnam par snang / /snang ba nyid na chos kyi sku/ /cir yang 'gyur zhing thams cad 'grub/ /kun 'byung dngos grub de ltar ro/ /glang 7po brjid gnon zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ /rnam rtog 'du byed mang pos g.yengs/ /ji ltar bus pa shed ma bye(kye/ /bya byed mang pos g.yengs par gnas/ /bya byed mang po 13bdag med pas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang sgyur yin/ /mtshan ma mnyam pa'i dbyings su gnas/ /'du byed sna tshogs mi g.yo brtan/ /dbang lnga rdzogs pa 'es bya ba'i dam tshig ni/chos rnams thams cad skye med pas/ /shin tu brtan pa'i tunyedabang thob 'gyur/ /rang rig ye shes 'od gsal bas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang yang thob /chos rnams thams cad dbyer med pas/ /kun la spyod pa'i dbang thob ste/ /spyod cing chags pa med pa'i tshul/ /kun kyang rang bzhin ye nas zlum/ /thams cad rgyas 'debs zhes nyu )bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi 102—743

steng 'og bcu/ /rang bzhin chen pos kun du khyab/ /rang byung de nyid dngos med par/ /kun gyi phyag rgya sgyu yin no0)/ /chos dbyings de nyid zab pa yi/ /bdag la gnas shing brtag dka' ba'o/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings su thams cad 'dus / /ye nas bde gnas zhing du'o/ /chos rnams dbyer med pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ye nas dbyings su ro gcig pas/ /de la nga dang bdag ma rtogs / /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa la/ /gtsang dang sme ba'i blo tsam med/ /thams cad bder gshegs snying po bas/ / rkyen gyi (brdul gyis ga la 'go/ /shes rab mchog gis de ltar rtogs/ /ma lus kun 'dus dbyings shes byos/ /thams cad 'jigs byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ shes rab blo rtsal ldan pa yis / / brtag rtog nimatshan ma kun bshig nas④/ /mtshan ma med pa'i phyag rgya ru / /thams cad 'dus par yang dag rtogs/ /rtog pa nyid kyang dngos med la / /de nyid sna tshogs bar snang ba'i(snye/ /snang ba nyid na (6) byang ba (7med/ /de nyid 'jig (8)pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /g.yung drung tshe 'phel zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni / chos rnams thams cad bdag yin pas/ /gang du 'gro zhing gang du skye/ /'jig dang skye ba'i dngos po med/ /dngos med de la su zhig gsod/ /gang zhig gnyis su 'dzin pa la/ /skye dang 'chi ba de la yod/ /ye shes can gyis 6)brtags pas ⑩na/ /skye 'jig nyid na dngos po med/ /thams cad mi 'gog pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ mchog gsum rdzogs pa man chad nas/ /ngan song gnas rnams yan chad du/ /yang dag par ni dbyer med de/ /gang yang spang bar bya ba min/ /theg pa mtho 1medaman bsam yas pa/ /don du mi 'gyur yong ma gsungs/ /ngan song gnas rnams thams cad kun/ /bla med byang chub rgyu 102—744

yod pa'o/ /thams cad spyod pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thams cad kun du bzang po yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la/ /thogs pa med par spyad byas te/ /bsod nams tshogs chen yin par brtag /de bzhin gshegs pa lngar yang brtag6) /gzhan yang stong khams thams cad ni/ /shes rab dbyings dang 'dod yon rnams/ /rab 'bring tha ma thams cad spyod/ /thams cad mi chud pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phyogs dus mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje rigs mchog ma rtogs par/ /theg pa dman dang lta ba dman/ /des ni theg mchog rtogs mi 'gyur/ /mi mnyam pa yi don nyid kun khyab kyang / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal nyid kyis bsgribs/ /de yis yang dag nyid mi mthong ma mthong ba la mi chud bya/ /thams cad bsrung du med ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/thams cad ma lus sangs rgyas la/ /bsgrub cing bsrung bar bya ba med/ /dge dang mi dge gnyi ga (mimed/ /nyon mongs spang zhing (lde)byang bsgrub med/ /de bzhin nyid kyi klong (gegyur na/ /bde dang mi bde dbyer med de/ /ye nas dag mnyam nyid du gnas/ /de la bsrung bya rdul tsam (5)med/ /thams cad bsrung ⑥ ba med pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ sems can khams gsum 'khor ba yi/ /thog ma med nas 'khor ba yi/ /phyin ci log la 'jol (7nyog spyod/ /gzung (kye'adzin don la shin tu chags/ /des na 'khor bar rtag tu 'phyan5)/ /de bas rang sems rtogs byas te/ /le lo med par yongs spangs te/ /nga med bdag med mnyam par bsrung / /thams cad 'jigs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ rdo rje sems dpas dzobakas bcad pa/ /sdom pa'i rtsa ba thams cad kun / /don bzhin du ni ma bsrungs na/ /yak+ṣa khro bo me yinadapal gyis/ /snying 102—745

nas drangs te khrag 'thungs nas/ /ngan song gsum du skye bar 'gyur/ /de yi sdug bsngal bzod blag 6)chad/ /dam tshig 'di ni rdo rje che/ /dam rdzas so sor spyod pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ rigs lnga so sor dbye ba yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' glang po'i sha /rin po che ni rta yi ②sha /pad+ma rigs ni a ri ka yi ③sha /don yod nam mkha' lding gi sha /bder ligashegs rigs ni sha chen no/ /dbye ba'am yang na mi dbye bar/ /nges par dang du blang (snyeba'o/ /yang na thams cad gcig tu bsdu/ /yang na mtshan nyid med par brtag⑥ /ting ga'adzin phyag rgya'i dam tshig ni/ /bder ⑧gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus kun/ /ye nas rang bzhin gsal ba la6)/ /thams cad kun la yod par bshad/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /bla na med pa'i mchog yin te/ /rdo rje rigs mchog thams cad kyis / /bar ma chad par rtag tu bsgrub/ /byang chub shing drung skye bar 'gyur/ /bla med byang chub mchog kyang 'grubayi/ /skye 'chi med pa'i pad (7'grub ste/ /sems la dbang yang thob par 'gyur/ /spyod yul thams cad smon na shes/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las dam tshig rnam par spros pa'i le'u ste bdun cu 1nyedrug pa'o// //gang zhig dkyil 'khor 'di spangs na/ /nyon mongs ngan song gnas su skye/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /bla med 'gro ba'i rgyu yang chad/ /rigs chad nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub cha'adod pas/ /rtag tu mnyam pa'i don rtogs la/ /sku ni 'ja' tshon tshul 'dra bar/ /snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /'khor rnams chu zla'i tshul shes par/ /gsal la rang 102—746

bzhin med par bsgom/ /lha yi sku rnams gsal bsgoms yonyen/ /bsod nams tshogs chen thob par 'gyur/ /de nyid gzugs brnyan tshul shes na/ /ye shes tshogs chen thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgom/ /yi dam lha de spangs byas na/ /ngan song mi bde rtag tu myong / /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad ②pa'i don ni/ sngags dang phyag rgya bar mi gcad①/ /rnal 'byor 'grub pa'i lam yang yin/ /mi gtong sdom zhing 'dren pa'ang yin/ /don mchog rdzogs pa'i gnas yin te/ /rtag tu mnyam gzhag chaphyag rgya yin/ /dug gsum gting 'byin sngags yin te/ /yang dag don chen klung 'dod pas/ /dus mtshams med par phyag rgya sngags/ /yid brtan drag tu bzlas brjod bya/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /phyag rgya bskyod dang yi ge oṃ/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa/ /bla med dkyil 'khor ston pa po/ /yon tan zad med sbyin pa yin/ /byang chub lam chen ⑤'dren mdzad pa/ /chags med zhing du 'god pa yin/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal rtsad khyigacod cing / /'khor ba'i lam rnams stongs ⑦par byed/ /ma rig mun sel sgron ma (nyayin/ /long ba rnams kyi dmigs bu mkhan/ /de la rtag tu mchod byas na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thag mi ring / /rdo rje mched dang lcam dral gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa / rdo rje rigs kyi spun yin te/ /thog ma med nas las mthun po)pas/ /lta spyod mthun ⑩pas 'dir skyes te/ /gcig la gcig yinyeni mig dang 'dra/ /shin tu gdung zhing brtse bar bya/ /dam tshig ngan sems dpya (gebyas natunye/ /dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur/ /de bas dam tshig 'da' ma 'byed/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig bstan pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /srid gsum 102—747

ma lus kun la khyab/ /phyin ci log gis rab bsgribs nas/ /dbul po gter dang gyad kyi nor bu 'dra/ /de bas rdo rje gsang mchog 'di/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis/ /chos la skyon yod ma yin te/ /sems can don phyir shin tu gsang / /theg pa dman dang phyin ci ldog6) /de la gsang don bstan gyur na/ /rang bzhin gsang don mi shes par/ /'phral gyi spyod yul de dag la/ /shin tu nges pa'i don bzung nas/ /gsang don de nyid log par khrid(ge / /ma rtogs de nyid dmyal bar 'khor/ /de bas shin tu gsang bar bya/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ /thar lam kun la mkhas par bya/ /shes rab mchog dang ldan pas na/ /sems can snod kyi rim pa bzhin/ /theg pa mtho ③dman don nyid ni/ /so sor 'tsham (gepar bstan dgos so/ /dang du blang dang mi spang ba/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu spyad/ /chags pa med par gyur pa dang ske/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po ni/ /dam tshig mdo bshad nang nas 'byung / /ma rtogs (5)pa zhes spyad gyur na/ /yi dgas (5)srin po'i nang du skye/ /yang na dam tshig 'di lta bural/ /ji ltar spyad kyang sdom pa mi 'da' ste/ /byed spyod 81tshogs chen gnyis su 'gyur/ /'gro dang nyal dang 'dug pa na/ /mnyam pa de yi dbyings na gnas/ /shes rab mchog gis rtag tu gyis/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /bya lam nam mkha' gcod bzhin gyis/ /'dzin chags ma lus thams cad kun/ /mkha' la rlung chen 'phro ba bzhin/ /yid kyi rtog chags ma lus pa/ /chu la nya chen 'phyo (9)ba ltar/ /rnal 'byor lta ba de ltar ltos / /de ltar rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig tsam ma yin blo gting spos/ /rdo rje theg mchog kha bo'aches la/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid mi shes par/ /gsang 102—748

sngags dam tshig mnyam zer zhing / /thugs thub dag gis spyad byas pa/ /dmyal khams dag tu brgyud 0)par 'gyur/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid ji lta bu/ /mnyam dang rtogs pa gang yang med/ /ji la ②mi gnas yul la spyod / /spyod par byed dang spyod pa med/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i rigs mchog ni/ /rdo rje rig ④'dzin skye ba na/ /'jigs (5)med kun tu bzang por sbyor/ /yon tan mi zad gnas pa yin/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid mi shes shing / /kun rdzob don dam gnyis med la/ /chos dang gang zag gnyis med na/ /'di ni byang chub sa pa yin / /las dang nyon mongs thams cad la/ /mnyam pa'i don du mi shes shing //rten 'brel rgyu 'bras yod 'dzin na/ /'di ni rang sangs rgyas kyi sa/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /bden bzhi'i dngos po yod lta zhing / /spang dang mi spong byed 'gyur ba/ /'di ni nyan thos sa pa yin/ /dge bcu dag la gtsor len cing / /dge dang mi dge mi mnyam pas/ /lha dang mi yi (6)skye gnas te / /'dod khams dag tu 'khor (7༄ba'i sa/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid mi rtogs shing / /tshad med bzhi dang bsam gtan bzhi/ /rim par (8)so sor bdag 'dzin cing / /gzugs tshogs dag la bdag tu rtog(9༄ /'di ni tshangs gnas rim par skye/ /mnyam dang gzugs med ma rtogs par/ /ming bzhi med par ma shes te/ /skye mched bzhi la gnas 'gyur bas/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i sa ru skye/ /thams cad mnyam par (7ma shes na/ /ma lus kun la zhe sdang zhing / /snying rje yang dag med 'gyur 1 na/ /'di ni mi bzad (1 rachen po yi/ /dmyal khams bcu drug gnas pa yin/ /chags med dngos po mi shes nas/ /thams cad kun la 'dod chags shing / /lus kyis bsgribs dang zas kyis bsgribs5ge/ /yi dgas sko102—749

chen po'i gnas su skye/ /nga dang bdag med mi shes shing / /chos rnams kun la rmongs byas pas/ /shes rab mi gsal don med pas/ /dge sdig gnyis kyi don ma rtogs/ /'di ni byol song gnas su skye/ /shin tu nga rgyal cher bskyed ①cing ske/ /thams cad bdag gir bzung phyibs na/ /kun dang rtsod pa'i las byed pa / /lha ma yin gyi (miganas su skye/ /theg mchog mtho ④dman thams cad dang / /'jig rten lta ba thams cad kun/ /ye shes chen pos rab brtags ⑤na/ /rang bzhin med la cir yang 'grub/ /rang bzhin dbyings las nyams pa med/ /shes rab chen po mig ldan pas/ /mtho yidaman gnas dang lam drug dang / /rang bzhin med la cir yang 'grub/ /so sor de bzhin 'khor bar gzigs/ /sngags mchog bla na med pas ni/ /mtshan ma kun dang mi brtag ⑦par/ /mtshan ma kun dang thams cad med/ /kun dang mnyam pa nyid yin pas/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /so sor lta ba brjod mi bya/ /spyi ni log rtog bsam yas pa/ /ye nas yod pa ma yin te/ /so so'i rnam rtog bag chags kyis / /gzung (8)'dzin dra bas bsgribs 'gyur te/ /ci yang med la cir yang snang / /snang ba nyid na dzi)rang bzhin med/ /de ltar rtogs na bder ⑩'gro'i gnas / /rdo rje can gyis de ltar rtogs/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i lta spyod ni/ /cir yang spyod kyang rang bzhin med/ /mkha' la bya chen lding ba yibazhin/ /chu la skyar chen 'phyo ba bzhin/ /mkha' la rlung chen 'gro ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor lta ba de ltar blta(7/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa chen po ni/ /thams cad kun la dbyer med spyod/ /bde ba'i ro mchog myong bar 'gyur/ /de la su zhig chags par byed/ /spyod bzhin ma chags ye shes yin/ /bde ba'i mchog nyid bsod 102—750

nams tshogs/ /de lta bu yi hu)ngang du spyod/ /'di ni spyod pa rlabs ②chen yin//lta spyod ya char ma gyur par mi/ /sngags 'chang rnams kyis rtag tu spyad/ /kha cig lta ba mnyam gnas kyang / /spyod pa dag dang yong mi mthun/ /kha cig spyod pa rdzogs byed kyang / /mnyam pa'i lta ba yong mi shes/ /kha cig lta spyod gnyi ga ④med / /yang dag skyes mchog dam pa yis/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med pas / /yang dag nyid du rab tu rtogs/ /bla med theg chen ngang gnas ni/ /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med de/ /kun rdzob tsam du thams cad la/ /dag dang ma dag gnyi gar la'adzin/ /thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni/ /rnam par byang dang sdug bsngal dag /kun rdzob tu 'ang (gyedabyer med de/ /lta ba mtho medaman de tsam mo/ /thabs kyi lta spyod chen po ni/ /bla med theg pa las 'phags pa/ /don dam du ni nor bdun no/ /kun rdzob tu ni mnyam rdzogs so/ /mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya chen po ston/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam par dag /thams cad dag ces bya ba (8)yang / /dngos po gsal dag ma yin te/ /snang spyod nyid poran rnam par dag /dam tshig chen po'i mdo rnams las / /rigs lnga dag tu bstan pa ni/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /rigs chen dag tu zad par 'dus/ /ma lus chos kun dbyer mi dmigs/ /cis kyang mi tshugs rdo rje yin/ /rigs ngan 'joms pas rdo rje yin/ /mi dmigs dbyings nas kun 'byung ba/ /yon tan chen po gnas yin te/ /zhing khams mi bzad yiganas kyang yin/ /'di ni rin chen rigs su gsungs/ /chos rnams thams cad dbyer med pas/ /chags dang chags par bya ba med/ /de bzhin nyid du gcig pa ste/ /nyes pas mi gos pad+ma bzhin/ /thams cad ma 102—751

lus dbyings 'dus pas/ /'di la bya ba rdul tsam med/ /ma byas bzhin du don grub pa/ /skyon yon 0)byang chub nyid du sbyor/ /'di ni las rnams grub pa yin / /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /mtha' dang dbus med du mar bral / /gang yang ma yin de bzhin nyid/ /dbyer med pa yi ②tshul rtogs te/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /snang srid ma lus thams cad la/ /gsal zhing dro ba'i gnas byed cing / /mtshan ma bag chags sreg byed pa/ /'di ni me yi rigs su bshad/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /dngos por snang la gzung du med/ /bskyod (snyen thams cad kun smra stergya/ /'di ni rlung chen yin par bshad/ /dam tshig chen po'i mdo rnams las/ /'byung ba lnga rnams bshad pa ni/ /thams cad ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thams cad kun gyi mdzod skyed yin/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /sra zhing brtan (snyepa'i gnas yod pas/ /dngos po med pa'i tshul rtogs te/ /'di ni sa chen yin par bshad/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /de bzhin nam mkha' chen po yis/ /phyi dang nang gi go 'byed pa'o/ /thams cad gsal ba'i ngang nyid de//'byung ba bzhi po thams cad kyang / /thams cad nam mkha'i ngang du thim/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su 'ub6)/ /nyon mongs lnga ⑦pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ ma rig pa ni rig par 'gyur/ /phyin ci log ni yang dag ste/ /nyon mongs lnga po de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos med rtogs na byang chub lam/ /ma rtogs ngan song gsum du 'gro/ /de bas thos bsam bsgoms (8pa yis/ /yang dag don nyid rtogs byas te/ /thams cad sangs rgyas nyid du sbyor/ /'dod chags rang bzhin med pas na/ /yang 102—752

dag don la chags byed de/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis gnas/ /ma chags pa la chags pa dang / /shin tu chags mchog chen po yin/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'byung 'gyur te/ /snang ba mtha' yas zhing dag yin/ /thams cad pad+ma brdzus nyuskyes yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyi sa ru skye/ /zhe sdang chen po'i mtshan nyid ni//phyin ci log la zhe sdang zhing / /zhe sdang dngos po med shes na/ /sdang dang mi sdang mnyam shes te/ /cis kyang mi tshugs rdo rje yin/ /mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid ni/ /thams cad kun la dbyer med de/ /de ltar ma rtogs kun la snang / /de bzhin phal gyis mnyam mi shes/ /des ni zhe sdang nyid du mthong / /yang dag rtogs pas rab brtags lan/ /zhe sdang thugs rje chen po yin/ /gti mug rmongs pa zhes brjod pas/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /don dam du ni dbyer med la/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma mig yor (getshul/ /snang ba nyid na dngos med pas/ /de la su zhig bdag tu 'dzin/ /thams cad dbyer med mi dmigs pa/ /shes rab can gyi gti mug yin/ /de rtogs de bzhin gshegs pa'o / /nga rgyal mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /mnyam pa nyid la gnas bcas ④nas / /phyin ci log dang theg dman la/ /shin tu nga rgyal chen por snang / /nga rgyal zhi ba so so min/ /rang bzhin med pas dbyings su 'dus/ /'di ni yon tan 'byung gnas yin/ /de bzhin dag par shes par byos/ /phrag dog mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa ste/ /'dzin nyid dngos po yod ma yin/ /mnyam mi shes la phrag dog cing / /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du 'dus / /mi mnyam pa la shin tu sdom/ /de bas phrag dog chen po yin/ /phyin ci log tu bdag tu bcings/ /gzung 55༄dang 'dzin pas shin tu dog /gzung 102—753

'dzin bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /dog yangs med de thams cad mnyam/ /de nyid shes pas las rab 'grub/ /phung po lnga zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ phung po lnga por snang ba yang / /kun rdzob bya ba sna tshogs byed/ /bde ba'i yul dang mi bde'i yul/ /so so'i ro rnams myong byed cing / /lnga po'i mtshan nyid bshig byas nas/ /so so'i mtshan nyid dngos po med/ /gang gis de la dngos bzung na / /ngan song gsum du skye bar 'gyur/ /de la gzugs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /snang ba nyid ni rang bzhin med/ /snang med de nyid sna tshogs ston/ /snang dang mi snang gnyis su med/ /de rtogs rnam par thar pa'i gnas/ /gzugs nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /tshor ba'i mtshan nyid brjod pa ni/ /kun la rnam yonyegasum 'byung mod kyi/ /bde dang mi bde dngos po med/ / gnyi ga (nyam yin lung ma bstan/ /sna tshogs tshor ba 'byung 'gyur yang / /tshor dang 'byung ba gnyi cig stong / /stong nyid dngos po yod ma yin/ /de rtogs chos kyi go bgos ( )yin / /'du shes mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ /gsum tshogs mtshan mar 'dzin pa yin / /so so mtshan nyid bshig pa na/ /dngos po med de de bzhin nyid/ /dngos po de ni sna tshogs pa/ /bya byed med par kun du 'jug /khams gsum ma lus thams cad la/ /mtshan ma che chung bsam mi khyab/ /khyab med dngos po yod ma yin/ /de ltar rtogs na sangs rgyas mtshan/ /'du byed mtshan nyid 'di ltar gnas/ /rtsa ba 57brgyad pa'i grangs 'gyur te/ /lnga bcu rtsa gcig kun la 'pho/ /der rtogs rtsa ba yod ma yin/ /med bzhin log g.yo rnam par 'byung / /de la dngos por 'dzin pa ni/ /rtag tu nyon mongs g.yengs gyur nas / /khams gsum btson 'tshor kun du 'khor/ /yang dag don phyir rig pas 102—754

ni / /'phro ba'i gzhi rtsa de bzhin de0)/ /de la rnam rig 'byung ba ni/ /dngos po med de skad cig ma/ /ye shes dbyings la rol pa mdzad/ /sprul pa'i tshogs chen yin par bshad/ /kun gyi 'byung gnas rnam shes te/ /de yi dngos po'i rang bzhin ni/ /kha dog dbyibs dang rig rgyun min/ /gang yang ma yin nyid mi dmigs/ /'di ni kun la dbang bsgyur ①te/ /mtho ris 'gro 'am ngan song 'gro / /rtogs dang mi ①rtogs khyad par ro/ /bzhi po mnyam pa'i ngang shes na/ /'di ni ye shes chen po yin/ /kha dog lnga yi dam tshig ni/ /sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /ye shes lnga yis kun khyab kyang / /rang gi rnam rtog bsgribs byas te/ /ye shes lnga yi don ma mthong ma mthong rmongs pa thams cad la/ /ye shes mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang / /ljang gu ④la sogs nag por bstan/ /chos rnams bdag med rtogs byas nas/ /byang chub sems nyid dag pa'i phyir/ /shin tu mdog ni dkar bstan pa/ /de rtogs bya phyir dag pa'i mdog /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /pad+ma rā ⑤ga zhes brjod de(neste/ /chags dang chags par bya ba med/ /chags med phyir yang dmar po'o⑦/ /yon tan gter chen zad mi shes(nya/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin te/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ma lus la/ /zad med rin chen gter 'gyur ba6)/ /mdog ni gser gyi mdog tu bstan/ /chos rnams phyin ci log rnams la/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin brlabs ⑩kyis/ /dbyings su yang dag bsdu dgos pas/ /las rnams ma lus rdzogs par byed/ /kun du las ni ljang gu'i mdog /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid las/ /cis kyang mi tshugs bcos su med/ /kha dog nag po dngos po la/ /tshon tshostegazhan dag gis bsgyur 102—755

du med/ /de bzhin kun la shes par byos/ /phyogs lnga zhes bya ①ba'i dam tshig ni / mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin du/ /dbyer med ngang du gnas pa la/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i don bya phyir/ /phyogs dang dbus su gnas par bya /sems can ma rig mdongs ②pa la/ /nyon mongs ma rig bsal ③bya'i phyir/ /ye shes sgron (4)ma 'od 'bar bas/ /ma rig mun pa sel bar byed/ /de phyir de la shar zhes bya/ /sems can ma lus thams cad la/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal mi gnas shing / /ma rig mun pa nub 'gyur (5)bas/ /de la nub kyi phyogs zhes bya / /sems can kun gyi nyon mongs kun/ /ye shes chen po bdag med pas/ /sdug bsngal rab tu byang byas nas/ /de la byang gi phyogs zhes (6)brjod/ /de ltar ma lus thams cad la/ /thugs rje shar dang sgrib pa nub/ /rnam rtog mtshan nyid byung (7)gyur na/ / de yi 8yon tan chen po rdzogs/ /de ltar chos rnams ma lus kun/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi (9dbyings su 'dus/ /phyogs rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid du zlum pa'i tshul/ /phyogs rnams kun la de ltar blta / /ma rig phyin ci log rnams kyis/1/ /phyogs rnams so sor bzung 'gyur snyin/ /rtag tu nyon mongs 'khor bar 'gyur/ /dbang po lnga zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ yul lnga dag la dbang byed cing / /phyin ci log ni dngos por 'dzin/ /dngos por bzung bas khams gsum 'khor/ /gzugos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /snang zhing dngos po med pa dang / /lha dang lha mor 1spyadangos por brtagasas/ /bdag dang lha nyid gnyis pa'o/ /sgra rnams sna tshogs grags pa yang / /sgra nyid dngos po med par shes/ /sgra brjod ma lus thams cad ni/ /chos kyi sgra chen sna tshogs yin/ / dri yi tsodangos por snang ba 102—756

yang / /dri nyid rang bzhin gang yang med/ /dri snom chos kyi dri yin te/ /shes rab chen pos de ltar rtogs/ /ro yi dngos por (1)snang ba yang / /ro yi rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /ro bro de bzhin nyid kyi ro/ /bde ba de yis tshim par byed / /reg bya sna tshogs snang ba yang / /reg bya'i dngos po yod med de/ /reg byar snang ba longs spyod yin/ /bde ba chen po chos kyi sku/ /mi shes phyin ci log rnams kyis/ /dbang po'i tshon)yul la chags 'gyur (5)na/ /rtag tu 'dod dang mi 'bral (4)zhing / /ngan song gsum dang mi khom brgyad/ /rtsa ba sog (5)ma'i me bzhin du/ /khams gsum dag tu 'khor bar 'gyur/ /de bas ye shes chags med rtogs/ /byas la mi sogs 4)bsod nams byos/ /kun la spyod cing mi gos pas/ /ye shes chen po rtag tu bsgoms4)/ /mnyam pa lnga zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ don dam par skye ba med par mnyam pa dang / kun rdzob sgyu mar mnyam pa dang / don dam pa dang kun rdzob tu dbyer med par mnyam pa dang /chen po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lngar mnyam pa dang / rnam par shes pa brgyad ye shes lngar mnyam pa'o/ /de la don dam par skye ba med par mnyam pa ni/ chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /de bzhin nyid dang stong ba'i mtha' yang dag pa dang chos kyi dbyings/ /mtshan nyid med cing dmigs su med/ /gzung du med cing smon pa med/ /ye nas mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /kun rdzob sgyur ri rimar 9rimanyam pa dang / /'dus byas dngos po sna tshogs ni/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du thams cad snang / /'phral gyi bya ba kun kyang byed/ /rtogs tsho pa kun gyi mtshan ma snang / /'di dag thams cad gzugs brnyan te/ /bya byed snang zhing dngos 102—757

po med/ /chu zla'i tshul du thams cad gnas/ /thams cad snang 0)la rang bzhin med / /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med ni(gyi/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun / /gzhi ( nirtsa med las thams cad 'byung / /yod dang med pa gnyi 6)ga min / /don dam kun rdzob dbyer med de(5)/ /'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas snang ske/ /snang ba nyid na dngos po med/ /dngos med de nyid sna tshogs te/ /de nyid sgyu ma mig 6yor tshul/ /'byung ba chen po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lngar mnyam pa ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' las/ /ya mtshan sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur ba/ /gzhi rtsa yod pa ma yin te/ /rang bzhin ngang gis de ltar 'byung / /so so'i rigs tshogs snang ba ni/ /thabs chen dag tu rtag tu mnyam/ /mtshan nyid so sor gnas pa ni/ /shes rab dbyings kyi ngang du mnyam/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad ye shes lngar mnyam pa ni/ rnam rtog kun gzhi 97ma yin pa/ /rang bzhin med pa don gyi gzhin/ /'di ni chos kyi dbyings zhes bya/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes so/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun/ /nga dang bdag tu mi 'dzin cing / /kun kyang dbyer med pa yin pas/ /thams cad me long lta bu'i tshul/ /thams cad kun la yud rtog cing / /rtog dang brtag 7)par bya ba med/ /dus gsum kun du mi dmigs pa/ /'di ni mnyam nyid ye shes yin/ /log rtogs khodabang po'i spyod yul spangs/ /dbang po'i (1yul rnams dngos med par/ /thams cad dbyer med de bzhin nyid/ /so sor rtog tu pa'i ye shes yin/ /mnyam pa rnam lnga de ltar brtags/ /chos rnams ma lus thams cad la/ /ye nas rang bzhin med pa dang / /thabs chen lhun gyis grub par brtags12/ /'di ni yang dag rtogs pa yin/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 102—758

zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te/ /rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil/ /ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul/ /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /rigs bzhi'i lha dang lha mo dang / /'khor gyi khro bo khro mo dang / /yang na 'das pa'i dkyil nyid de/ /'jig rten sna 6)tshogs 'khor yin no/ /tshogs kyi (namachod pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur cing / /byang chub sems dang ma chags pa'i/ /gnyis su med par thim gyur na/ /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par ldan/ /'dod yon lnga po thams cad dang / /sna tshogs snang ba thams cad kun/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /gzugs mdzes lha dang lha mor brtags/ /thams cad ma lus sgra rnams ni/ /chos kyi sgra chen yin pa dang / /ngan song sbyong zhing thar lam ston/ /stong gsum grags pa'i sgra chen dang / /thams cad 'jal ba'i sgra yang yin/ /bde ba tshim byed bsod nams te/ /brjod med mi gnas ye shes yin/ /'di ni chags med pad+ma'i gsung ( kyi/ /chos nyid dngos po med pa la/ /dri yis mchog tu tshim byed pa/ /bsod nams tshogs chen yin par bshad/ /chags med ye shes tshul yin te/ /de bzhin dri yis mnyes mchod na/ /rig (4)'dzin sa rnams bskul 5bar 'gyur/ /ngan song gsum du chos kyi dri )/ /kun du bde gnas 7)thob par byed/ /bder 48)gshegs dkyil 'khor ma lus la9ri/ /bde ba'i ro yis mchod par 'gyur/ /tshim byed bsod nams tshogs chen 'gyur/ /dngos por mi 'dzin bsod nams tshogs/ /de lta bu yi ro mchog gis/ /thams cad kun la tshim par 'gyur/ / yi dgas 7gnas su longs spyod ldan/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus mchod pa yin/ /bde ba 102—759

chen po rdzogs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyis/ /rnam pa mang pos brgyan pa dang / /sbyor mchod dag gis longs spyod na/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub 'gyur(1)/ /bde chen dkyil 'khor 'bar 'gyur rin)nas/ /sdig pa'i mun nag sel bar byed/ /dpung gi tshogs kyis mi thub pa'i/ /mthu chen dag kyang 'grub par byed/ /tshogs kyi phrin (5)las zhes bya ba'i dam tshig ni/byed pa med pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /kun la thogs pa med par spyad/ /thams cad ma lus 'dul bar byed/ /mi mthun phyogs nas dbang du byed/ /yon tan chen po 'phel bar byed/ /khro bo gtum pa'ang zhi bar byed/ /thams cad kun la spyad bde ba/ /chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis gnas/ /dbyings su bsdus pa'i ri dkyil yin te/ /'phro 'du mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid ni5/ /de lta bu 07yi tshul du gnas/ /'khor gyi phra (7)men tshim par 3byed ces bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ bdag nyid 'dul ba'i dbang phyug tu/ /rtag tu mnyam bzhag khro bo'i tshul/ /'khor gyi khro rnams de bzhin te/ /mdog dang phyag rgya thams cad dang / /sngags mchog dam pa ma lus 'don/ /de nas phra 9men 'khor bsdus 1 tshonas/ /so so'i las dang mthun byas te/ /so so'i gnas su gzhag 1 par bya/ /dbang du bsdu 1 dang bsgom 1 pa'i thabs ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du bya/ /ma lus thams cad byos shig par/ /lhag ma byin nas dbang yang bskur/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad la/ /'dod yon lnga yi sbyin pa btang 1 / /de nas las rnams rdzogs byas nas/ /dbang phyug chen po'i gnas brten tshanas/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga la sogs/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /bdag la thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /de ltar bsgrub nyunyapa'i 1(32—760

ngang 'chang ba/ /ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs byas nas/ /rig 'dzin rig pa'i sa la gnas/ /theg dman spyod par yod mi 'gyur/ /mi khom gnas su skye mi 'gyur / /skye shi med pa'i g.yung drung thob/ /sangs rgyas zhing yang sbyong bar byed / /ngan song gnas rnams stongs 1)par byed/ /yang dag mchog gi snying po 'grub / /dbang po yul du snang ba kun/ /yul rnams yod pa ma yin te/ /kun gzhi (gurnam par shes pa nyid/ /dngos po sna tshogs par snang ste/ /snang ba'i dngos po rnam bshig tsho smin/ /so so'i mtshan nyid rnam bshig nas/ /gzhigs can nam mkha'i ngang du zhi/ /nam mkha' de nyid lngas gzhigs na(5)/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i dbyings su thim/ /thams cad kun gyi 'byung gnas so/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i skad cig nerim/ /snang ba mi 'gog thabs yin te/ /rang bzhin med pa shes rab nyid sku/ /nyon mongs rnam par shes pa ni/ /kun gzhi 58rinyid snang spyod yul la/ /de 9dang bdag tu rnam par rtog(7 /bde sdug mtshan ma so sor 'dzin/ /kun gzhi 11dngos po med pa la/ /bag chags sogs dzi pa'i gnas med de/ /snang 12ba'i dngos po med pa la/ /nyon mongs blo yis blang du med / /bsgo bodang bsgo dbar bya ba med/ /de ltar sgo yobyed dngos po med/ /med bzhin sems kyis log brtags pa/ /khams gsum btson 1 rar rtag tu 'khor / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni/ /snang dang mi snang gnyi ga nyu la/ /skad cig yud tsam rtog pa yin/ /rtog pa nyid kyang ma grub 19na/ /yul gyi dngos po ga la 'grub/ /yid kyi de bzhin rgyun nyid ni/ /snga ma 'das shing mi dmigs pa / /phyi ma ma byung brtag 2 tu med/ /de ltar rang bzhin dmigs su med/ /rtsi shing kha na rlung 'phyo 'dra/ /rgyud ni yongs su ma chad pa/ /'di ni kun du 102—761

btsal zhing gzhag tu med/ /yod las btsal 0)na sgro btags 'gyur/ /med las btsal na skur (thubatab ste/ /yod med gnyis las btsal byas na/ /de ni lung du ma bstan 'gyur(5)/ /rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' ste/ /de yis mi mkhyen ci yang med/ /rnal 'byor lta ba de lta bu/ /tshig gis snga (7phyi yod mod kyang / /don gyis cig char tshos)rdzogs par bsgom(5)/ /de lta bu yi (7don rtogs kyang / /'gro nyal 'dug sdod longs spyad 85kyang / /theg chen sgom las nyams pa med(9)/ /gong gi don ltar ma rtogs pa'i/ /blo ngan mnyam par khungs phyung nas/ /ma rtogs le lo snyom las byas/ /don ma grub par ngan song 'gro/ /sems kyis mnyam par ma rtogs na/ /tshig gis mnyam 7pas sangs mi rgyas(1sto/ /de bas don tshig ldan par byos/ /'on tang the tshom (12med par 'grub/ /rnal 'byor don chen rtogs pa yis/ /dus mtha' med par de ltar bsgom/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /spyod yul sangs rgyas nyid du gcig1ge /rtag tu bsod nams tshogs chen ldan/ /bya byed med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /des ñtsani byang chub snying po len/ /zhes gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las dbang po dang yul du 'dus pa bstan 15pa'i le'u ste bdun cu skibadun pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las sngags 'chang rnams don yod par bya ba'i phyir thams cad phyag rgyar 'dus shing phyi nang snod bcud thams cad la 'di ltar brtags shing phyag rgya'i 1 /dam tshig bsrung ba dang / dam tshig ni gnas yin no/ /phyag rgyas nya bsdus shing spros pa 102wa 764

yang 'di yin te/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /gsang ba de nyid kho na las / /byang chub mchog 'di bstan pa'o/ /mnyam pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor ni / /phyogs bcu dus bzhi ma lus pa'i/ /'das dang ma 'das thams cad kun / /ye nas dbyer med de bzhin nyid/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam bya ba min/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du 'ubazhu)/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /brjod pa ma lus thams cad kun/ /chos nyid ngang las ma rtogs pa/ /log rtogs ( nyon mongs rdul tsam med/ /phyag rgya sna tshogs 'od 'bar yang / /de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos te/ /bdag nyid dbyings las mi gzhan phyir/ /mnyam la mnyam par gnas pa yi/ /rnam gsum tshul gyis bsgom (darabyas shing / /phyag rgya skyed (4cing log 'dul ba/ /bya byed med pa'i tshul gyis (5 su/ /las rnams ma lus rdzogs par byed/ /de ltar rtogs shing rigs kyi mchog /bdag nyid phyag rgya kun gyi bdag /ye nas rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ /byang chub skye 'khrungs 'dirgyu yang yin/ /'bras bu yang dag nyid du'o/ /rgyu 'bras dbyer med rdo rje'i sa/ /bcu gsum don grub de gnas pa/ /mthar phyin gang la'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rang bzhin phyag rgya ri rachen po ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun/ /thams cad shes rab ngang du gnas/ / rigs lnga bder sne cigashegs yab yum du/ /ma bcos ye nas de ltar gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab nyid la rol / /bde min ma chags tshogs chen po/ /yang dag nyid la rab tu rdzogs/ /lhag pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /nang gi rtags ni phyir byung ste/ /mdor bsdus phyag rgya chen po dang / /gzhan yang phyag rgya sna tshogs pa/ /lag gi 'du 'phro bsam yas dang / /yan lag stabs chen bskul bsigs 59kun/ /nyid kyi 102—765

dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /rang bzhin nyid kyis de ltar gnas/ /'joms (1shing cis kyang mi tshugs pa/ /rang byung chen po lha yi lha/ /thams cad kun la 'bigs par byed/ / dpa' bo tshon)zhes kyang gdags par bya'o/ /las dang las kyis mi gos pa/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi don rtogs shing / /ma chags pa la chags pa dang / /shin tu rnam par dag pa yi/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings dkyil 'khor la/ /sku gsungs 95)thugs ldan zad mi shes/ /yon tan mi zad gter du 'gyur / /gzhi (4)ni mi zad par ldan pa'o/ /sku gsung las rnams rdzogs byed pa'o / /rnam par rtog 5)med tshul gyis ni/ /thams cad kun la chags med rol / /'dul ba'i don lan bsam mi khyab/ /'joms dang ma chags kun 'byung dang / /thams cad dbang bsdus 'don 'grub ri pa/ /ma lus kun 'dus rnam par dag /kun nas zlum zhing 'od zer 'phro/ /rigs bzhi ma lus thams cad kun/ /mnyam rdzogs dbyings su thams cad 'dus/ /rigs rnams gcig med gcig pa ste/ /lhun grub dkyil 'khor ngang nyid du/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig mtshan nyid ni/ /thugs kyi rtags su bstan pa yin/ /dper na rgyal pos rgyas btab na/ /sems can kun gyi 87yong mi 'da'/ /de bzhin mnyam nyid phyag rgya yin/ /kun la khyab cing thams cad snang / /sku gsung thugs kyi (9rgyas btab na/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang po kun/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis 7dbang byar med/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs nges na/ /'di lta bu la 11)rtag tu gnas / / de lta bu yi yo blo med na/ /rdo rje'i rigs su yong mi bshad/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las phyag rgya'i dam tshig gi le'u ste bdun cu brgyad pa'o// //102—766

bas 'dud tshul lo/ /de yi pho nya bka' nyan ①ni/ /rdo rje phra ②men gtum ①bag can/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can mang po ste/ /de dag cir yang 'grub par byed/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las khro bo'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje srin mo chen mo ni/ /'jigs byed chen mor snang ba ste/ /phyag kyang srin mo (4)chen po zhi ltar/ /mthun ri note zhabs kyang de dang 'dra/ /de lta bu yi dkyil 'khor du/ /rin chen me tog bor nas ni/ /lcags la bab pa'i lha de ni / /gnyer na 'grub par gathe tshom med/ /dge dang mi dge'i chos rnams la/ /lhag par bsten par mi bya ste/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i klung (gyizhugs nas/ /ci la thogs pa med par spyod/ /rdo rje dbyug pa blangs nas su/ /g.yab mo lnga yang g.yab par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bzhugs par brtagatsor /mchod pa chen po dbul bar bya/ /se gol gtogs pa tsam gyis kyang / /mgyogs mas phyogs bcu gar yang phyin/ /de la zhon nas yo'agro byed pa/ /bya rog mgo can la sogs kun/ /sbed byed ma yis sbas pa ni/ /mthu chen lha srin gang gis kyang / /de la mthong bar mi nus na/ /gzhan gyis mthong bar ga la nus/ /skul /gebyed las ni gzhan 1 'debs yin/ /mgyogs ma'i las ni phyin par 'gro/ /gsod ma'i las tsho ni grub pa yin/ /so sor ma bsgrubs yinyid 'gro ma/ /'phags pa thabs 7kyi zhags pa pad+mo 'phreng las rdo rje srin mo'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha sa ma 102—827

ya s+t+waṃ/ e h+ye hi bha ga bān 4) dzaḥ/ rba hoḥrgya/ ru lu ru lu ru lu hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ a a a hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha bi dza ya hūṃ/ ha na ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa las/ da ha da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ④ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha ār+sā 6)tsa la hūm̐/ brnya brnya brnya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya spyi ba (3)/ hu lu hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā ⑦ dzi ta dun)rgyu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha a mṛ 6)ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ/ sbyin tshin+da sbyin 76 phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tre+e lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐/ bhin+da bhin+da bhin+da yi phaṭa / oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ sbo ṭa sbo ṭa sbo ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las khro bo bcu'i rtsa ba'i 8sngags dang las kyi sngags ril 'dus 8pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //oṃ badz+ra kro dhe tsha / ha la ha la ha la ha la aha (tso/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ⑩//ru lu ru lu ru lu ru lu ru lu hūm̐/ ma ma ma ma ma hūm̐/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo hūm̐/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ(1 hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las rdo rje srin mo'i 6)sngags kyi le'u ste bco zhi lnga pa'o// //mnyam pa nyid du rtogs byas nas/ /bskul zhing gsigs pa thams cad kyang / /phyag rgya yin zhes rgyal pos 9 nyabashad/ /mdo tsam du ni 'di ltar brtag /lag pa thal sbyar gyen du bsgreng / /rkang pa mthil ( shesbyar thur sa du gzugs/ /tshigs chen bzhi yang gcag ne 7par bya/ /mgo dang mtshan yang snying por brtag( nya /102wa 828

rdo rje rtse gcig rtse 6)dgu dang / /bcu gcig tu yang rnam brtags te/ /'di ni khrag 'thung chen po yil/ /phyag rgya yin par dpa' bos bshad/ /lag pa thal sbyar gyen du bsgreng / /rkang pa phral nas brkyang bskum zhing / /gom pa'i stabs ③kyis gar byed pa/ /'di ni rtsu gi rgya byachen yin/ /rkang pa phral mthil thur 97du gzugs / /lag pa phral nas gar byed cing / /stabs ⑥su mchod par byed pa ni / /'di ni stobs chen phyag rgya yin/ /rkang pa g.yon gyis g.yas la 'khyud/ /lag pa gar thabs bskor nas kyang / /thal mo drag tu brdabs pa ni/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya yin/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon mthe bo yis/ /mthe'u chung sen mo'i mthil du gnon/ /gdangs (7)pa'i thabs su bsgreng ba ni/ /dbyug sngon can gyi phyag rgya yin/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /rdeg pa'i 5kyethabs su gdengs 6)pa dang / /g.yon pa dku yil brten pa ni/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i phyag rgya yin/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i thal mo yis4ste/ /gdab 51 pa'i thabs su gdengs pa dang / /g.yon gyis 6nye'adzin pa ltar byas pa/ /mi g.yo mgon gyi phyag rgya yin/ /lag pa thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /gung mo rgyab tu bsnol yibar bya/ /mthe bo gnyis kyang phral te bsgreng / /spyi bor bzhag pa gre skaba'i rgya/ /rkang pa g.yas pa thur 7du gzugs/ /lag pa g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng / /g.yon pa'i rkang 1 pa lag phyar 18ba'i/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phyag rgya yin/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon dkur yi brten te/ /rkang pa gshibs te mchongs pa 2 rini/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya zhes/ /dpa' bo chen pos yang du bshad/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon bsnol ba dang / /rkang pa ( glebarkyang zhu bskum byas pa ni/ /khams gsum rgyal ba'i phyag rgya zhes/ /mgon po dpa' bos yang du bshad/ /lag pa 102—829

g.yas g.yon sprugs 0)pa dang / /lus kyang drag tu gsigs pa ni/ /rdo rje phra ⑧men ma rnams kyi/ /phyag rgya yin par 'dren pas bshad/ /phyag rgya 'di dag bcings nas ni/ /stabs ( chen drag tu mchongs byas na/ /khams gsum dag las mchongs par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang go 'phang ④thams cad kun/ /grub (gepar gyur te the tshom med/ /rig pa'i skyes bu chen pos bshad/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng 96)las phyag rgya'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //'khor lo chen po'i 57rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ /dkyil du khrag 'thung spyan drangs te / /mdun du hūṃ yang spyan drang ngo / /rgyab tu stobs chen spyan drangs nas/ /'khor lo 87)rtsibs kyi steng dag tu/ /bcu po rnams kyang go rims (9)bzhin/ /so so'i gnas su spyan drangs te/ /dmar gyi ar+gha 7gsol nas ni/ /mchod yon gzhan yang dbul bar bya/ /rdo rje dbyangs 17kyis bstod byas te/ /de nas las rnams bsgrub 7par bya/ /zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam 7kun/ /khros pas yud tsam rlag mdzad de/ /brlag (7par ma gyur tshagang yang med/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las las kyi le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //rdo rje phra tshamen sbyor ba yis/ /yud tsam gyis ni de bkug nas/ /rtod pa'i tshul du rab bstabs na/ /lha yang rung ste brlag ’ 7par 'gyur/ /lug pa'i mgo can la sogs pa'i18/ /phra yi men ma rnams sbad byas te/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lce/ /de yi sems 'phrogs bsgom ‘ nyanyams 'gyur/ /phra ‘ gemen rnams ni 102wa 830

sbad 6)byas te/ /de yi sgrub ②pa'i bar gcod ①cing / /gsang ste 'khrul par bsgom ④byas na⑤/ /sgrub pa nyams shing 'bye bar 'gyur/ /'phags pa ⑥thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las drag po'i las kyi le'u ste bcwa stibargyad pa'o// //hom khung zur gsum gdengs pa la/ /rdo rje mda' gzhu ldan byas te(she/ /thod pa dag gis rnam par brgyana'o/ /spyan drangs bsregs na lha yang 'chi/ /phra 'imen mngags te bkug nas ni/ /thab kun bsregs na mod la 'chi/ /bsur /stodang bsres pa'i sha rnams kyis/ /lha rnams thams cad mchod par bya/ /rdo rje glu ni blangs nas su/ /'byung po'i sha ni shin tu zhim/ /'byung po'i khrag ni shin tu zhim/ /'byung po'i rus pa zhim pa ste/ /gsol te 'thams cad dgyes par mdzod / /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng (shelas drag po hom gyi le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //lcags sam nag po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum/ /khro bo khro mo rnams bsgoms te/ /btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las drag po'i liphur pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o // //lcags phye dug skyedang rdo phye dang / /khrag las sprus te bsres pa dang / /mud ga'i tshan dang sbyor ba dag /sbyor bas gtor na de brlag 'gyur/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las drag po'i gtor ma'i le'u ste nyi shu 102—831

gcig pa'o// //khro mo'i dkyil 'khor gtun khung du/ /khro bo'i ①tho bas brdungs pa yi/ /rdo rje gtun phrugs bsgom tshodabyas na(ge/ /lha yang rung ste brdungs par 'gyur/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las drag po'i sbyor ba'i le'u ste nyi shu (geganyis pa'o// //drag po'i las kyis bsgrubs pa'i (snyernams/ /'khor ba'i lam lnga sgo bcad nas / /rnam shes hūm̐ gis bsdus gtums 6)te/ /'og min bla med gnas mchog na / /gtso bo lnga dang gtso mo lnga/ /sems dpa' dang ni sems ma dang / /khro bo dang ni khro mo rnams/ /sbyor ba'i lhums su phaṭa kyis 'phang / /'phags pa thabs kyi 7zhags pa pad+mo phreng las gnas bstabs pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gsum pa'o// //zla gam dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa/ /khro bo khro mo spyan drangs te/ /mchod pa glu la sogs pas mchod/ /de nas las rnams brtsam par bya/ /chags pa'i rdo rje tsho 'khor bcas pa/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam (9rikun/ /chags pas yud la dbang mdzad de/ /dbang du ma gyur gang yang med/ /rdo rje phra 1 men mngags nas su/ /bkug nas khro bo chen po yis/ /chags pa'i tshul gyis de lus las/ /dpa' dang gzi yonyabarjid bsdus nas 'grub/ /phra tu men rnams ni mngags nas su/ /de yi mig rna sna dang lce/ /lus ngag sems bsgyur rnams bsgoms na/ /kun la mdzes shing dga' bar 'gyur/ /'phags pa 102—832

thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las dbang gi 6)las bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu bzhi pa'o // //hom khung zla gam gdengs pa la/ /rdo rje zhags pas brgyan par bya/ /de nas lha rnams spyan drangs te/ /mi phan rnam rtog bsregs na 'grub/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las dbang gi hom gyi le'u ste nyi shu lnga pa'o// //zangs sam kha dog dmar po'i shing / /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gam/ /mgo la khro bo'i 'khor bsgoms te/ /btab na nges par de dbang 'gyur(9/ /'phags pa thabs kyi (guzhags pa pad+mo phreng las dbang gi phur pa'i las bshad pa'i le'u ste nyi shu drug pa'o// //zangs (dephye dang (5)ni bu ram dang / /dmar po'i 'bras can 56ril sogs pa/ / sbyar bas 77gtor ma gtang ri ribar bya/ /mthong bas nges par de dbang 'gyur/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las dbang gi gtor ma'i le'u ste nyi shu bdun pa'o// //khro mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /khro bo'i 59dkyil 'khor bsgoms byas na/ /lha yang rung ste dbang du 'gyur/ /de ni bde ba chen po yin/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las dbang gi sbyor ba'i le'u ste nyi shu brgyad pa'o// //102—833

gru bzhi dkyil 'khor rtsibs ①brgyad par/ /lha rnams 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /mchod pa glu ②la sogs pas mchod/ /de nas las rnams brtsam par bya/ /nga rgyal rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam ③kun / /dpal dang gzi brjid chen po rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni rgyas par mdzod⑨ske/ /khro bo khro mo 'khor bcas dang / /rdo rje phra phyimen 'khor bcas pas/ /dpal dang gzi brjid 'phel bsgoms na/ /bdag nyid chen por de 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa thabs 6)kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las rgyas pa'i las kyi le'u ste nyi shu dgu pa'o // //hom khung gru bzhi gdengs pa la/ /rdo rje 'khor los brgyan par bya/ /de nas lha rnams spyan drangs te/ /bsregs pas mchod cing dpal 'phel bsgom/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las rgyas pa'i hom gyi le'u ste sum cu (7pa'o // //gser ram ser po'i shing rnams la/ /mgo bo rgya (nyamadud rtse zur bzhi/ /lha rnams bsgoms te gdab par bya/ /'di ni rgyas pa'i las la shis/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las rgyas pa'i phur pa'i le'u ste sum cu yiskugacig pa'o// //gser phye 'bras chan ⑩ser po rnams/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi yonyegator ma ni/ /rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gtor ma ste/ /mkhas pas rgyas par yo bsgom zhing sbyin/ /102—834

'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng 0)las rgyas pa'i gtor ma'i le'u ste sum cu (miganyis pa'o// // lha mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom/ /byang chub sems ni 'phro bsgoms na/ /'di ni rgyas pa'i las 'grub bo/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las rgyas pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u ste sum cu ( ngegasum pa'o// //zlum po'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad (gepar/ /lha rnams 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /dkar po'i yon gyis mchod pa (5)bya/ /de nas las 55)rnams brtsam (rmipar bya/ /gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam 8)kun/ /yud tsam nyid la zhi mdzad de/ /zhi bar grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rnams 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /'khrug pa thams cad zhi mdzad par/ /bsgoms na thams cad yud tsam gyis/ /zhi bar 'gyur te the tshom 595med/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng tsho )las zhi ba'i las kyi le'u ste sum cu 511bzhi pa'o// //hom khung zlum po gdengs pa la/ /rdo rje pad+mos brgyan yi par bya/ /phur pa dkar po drug btab ste/ / /spyan drangs rdul phye sogs pas mchod/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las zhi ba'i hom gyi le'u ste sum cu ñtsalnga pa'o// //102—835

phur pa kha dog dkar po la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse rlum por/ /lha rnams bsgoms la gdab par bya/ /'di ni zhi ba'i las la shis/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng yo)las zhi ba'i phur pa'i le'u ste sum cu ②drug pa'o// //dngul dang 'bras chan dkar po rnams/ /'o mar ①sbyar ba'i gtor ma ni/ /zhi bar 'gyur ba'i gtor ma ste④/ /mkhas pas zhi bar bsgoms shing gtor/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng (51las zhi ba'i gtor ma'i le'u ste sum cu ⑥bdun pa'o// //lha mo rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lha yi grub pa bsgom par bya/ /byin gyis thams cad zhi bsgoms na/ /lha rnams kun kyang zhi bar 'gyur/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las zhi ba'i spyod pa (7las kyi le'u ste sum cu (kyebargyad pa'o // //mtshan nyid med pa'i phyag rgya dang / /de las dngos byung (9)phyag rgya rnams / /nges pa med par dpa' bos bshad/ /mkhas pas ci dgar bsgyur ⑩na 'grub/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng las las bsdus pa'i le'u ste sum cu 11dgu pa'o// //drag pos thams cad 'dul bar 'gyur/ /dbang gis 'byor ba mchog kyang 'grub / /rgyas pas gzi brjid rnam par 'phel/ /zhi bas yi bde ba'i tu mchog 102—836

kyang 'grub/ /'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad+mo phreng ①las las sgrub pa'i phan yon gyi le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //dkyil 'khor 'di'i mtshan ni dbang chen bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ de la dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi ②skum por bya ba ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa med pa'i don rnal/ /'khor lo rtsibs ②zur can du bya ba gzhi ①skum po'i nang na gnas pa ni chos kyi ⑤dbyings spros pa med bzhin du byin gyis brlabs ⑥kyi lha dang / lha mo dang —/ khro bo dang / khro mo dang / pho nya la sogs pa dang nyid kyis 'phro ba'i don no/ /rnam pa gcig tu chos kyi dbyings rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ci yang mkhyen pa lhun gyis grub pa'i don no/ /mtha' gru bzhi bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i snod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad la dbang bsgyur ⑦bas bde ba chen po rgyas pa'i don⑧/ dkyil nas lha mo lnga phyir lta ba/ lha mo ni dbyings nyid nye ba'i byin brlabs khyate/ sems dpas dbyings nyid dang nye ba mthong ba'i don no/ /sems dpa' lnga nang du lta ba ni dbyings nyid nye ba la lta ba'i don no/ /sems dpa' gzhan phyir lta ba ni/dbyings nyid thams cad dus ⑩do lta bu bems 0po ma yin gyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan zhing sems dpa' nyid dbyings las mi gzhan pa'i tha tshig go/ /sems ma gzhan nang du lta ba ni mkhyen pa'i ye shes dngos po la sogs pa thams cad du rnam par rtog pa ma yin gyi dbyings nyid dang ldan zhing dbyings nyid kyang mkhyen pa'i ye shes las mi gzhan pa'i tha tshig go/ /rnam tsogacig tu sems dpa' phyir lta ba ni snod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad ()dbang bsgyur 4steba'i don/sems ma nang du lta ba ni snod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad dbang du 102—837

'dus pa'i don/ sems dpa' dang sems ma phyi nang du gcig la gcig gzigs pa ni mnyes par byed pa'i tha tshig go/ /khro bo dang khro mo ril phyir lta ba ni phyi'i dngos po dang rgol ba la sogs pa 'joms shing 'dul ba'i don/ de la dbyings ni dper na 6)nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta ①bu'o/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/nyi ma'i 'od snang zhing gsal ba lta bu'o/ /de'i byin brlabs nini dro zhing 'jam pa lta bu'o/ /phyi'i dudangos po la sogs pa 'joms shing 'dul ba ni rtsi shing bskams pa dang tshig pa lta bu ste/ lha mo dang sems ma ni chos kyi dbyings rig pa'i don sems la snang ba'o/ /lha dang sems dpa' ni dbyings la snang ba'i don mthong ba'o/ /dbyings ⑤nyid ⑥la snang ba dang mthong ba'i byin brlabs ⑦kyi ngang gis dngos po dang rgol ba'i rang bzhin lhun gyis 'joms shing dbyings su sbyor bar 'dul ba ni/ khro bo dang khro mo las rnam bzhi rang bzhin du mdzad cing thugs rjes 'jig rten skyong ba'i (kyedon no/ /'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa ni byin gyis brlabs (she)las pho nya ltar gnas pa yin/ rnam ⑩gcig tu 'jig rten gyi lha mthu bo che 'khor du 'dus par bstan pa'i don no/ /bkra shis brgyad ni thams cad la dbang bsgyur zhing 'khor ba la spyod kyang nyon mongs pa'i tunye'aching bar mi 'gyur ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la spyod kyang nyan thos kyi zhi ba phyogs gcig par mi 'gyur te/ gang gis kyang zil gyis mi non pa'i phyir bkra shis so/ /de la dpal be'u ni mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i bkra shis so/ /'khor lo ni thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bkra shis so/ /rin po che ni zad mi shes pa yidang ldan pa'i bkra shis so/ /pad+mo ni 'khor bas ma khri zin pa'i bkra shis so/ /gdugs ni nyon mongs pas ma 102—838
